review_text:
this place has completely fallen to pieces.

KASAPI in the most sarcastic, taunting tone yelled these exact words "GOOD LUCK WITH YOUR GED" in the middle of the hallway. Well I did get that GED not even 2 weeks after leaving this school. Sad that Pride high school in Lockhart got shut down but places like this seem to get away with treating grown people just trying to do right like they're little imbeciles at the schools or should I say Ms. Kasapi's mercy. I had passed all my STAR exams as I had even passed the last one for a class I hadn't even taken yet (G&E) & all I wanted was to see if putting me on the minimum plan (required less credits to graduate) was possible because I would turn 21 in a couple of months & wouldn't be able to continue school there. I was told I wanted special treatment & blown off. There was an extremely childish, unprofessional encounter with a teacher aide or whatever she was that sent me over the edge on deciding to leave this unempathetic school run by big kids who would rather be on their phone & engage in inappropriate/child like behavior with students. Tiny Scholars Academy has truly been a blessing for our family! We’re so grateful to have found a child care center that not only met our needs but went above and beyond. We have a 2- and 3-year-old who attended from October until December 2025, when I was laid off and had to remove them from the daycare. I absolutely love this place, and so do our girls! They would get excited every time I pulled into the parking lot.

Ms. Nae was the absolute best with our 3-year-old, who can now count to 10 in English and Spanish! Ms. Nae is very smart and nurturing. Our 2-year-old went from being very shy to the life of any room, thanks to Ms. Tasha.

The staff here genuinely care about the children and their growth. Let me also add how the meals were never frozen, microwave dishes! Food was cooked on-site, and it was fresh, hot meals for our girls!

Ms. Toya is an absolute JEWEL and heaven-sent. Let me also add how much they love Ms. Met (Nanna) and always talked about her at home!

I am purposing to keep the structure they had at the daycare with my girls at home and can’t wait to get back to work so my girls can attend this daycare again! This is the place to be!!

I can’t say enough good things about this daycare! My son has been attending for about three months now, and it’s his very first time in daycare. From day one, the staff has gone above and beyond to make both of us feel comfortable and supported. They treat him with so much love and care—it truly feels like he’s at home when he’s there.

The team is very organized, professional, and attentive to every child’s needs. I really appreciate how they take the time to teach, engage, and nurture each child, not just watch over them. My son is learning so much every week—songs, colors, numbers, and even sharing and kindness. I’ve noticed how much more confident and happy he’s become since starting here.

As a parent, it gives me so much peace of mind knowing he’s in such great hands. I 100% recommend this daycare to any family looking for a safe, loving, and educational environment. They truly treat your child like one of their own.

Omg!! I wish I could give a million stars! I highly recommend this daycare facility especially as a first time mom Mrs.Latoya has been so kind and supportive with everything. Soon as you walk in the atmosphere is warm and welcoming the staff are gentle and foster in a welcoming atmosphere and experience. I think I called 100x and each time they were extremely polite and you can tell they love what they do!! One of the best decisions I made this year was enrolling my child at Tiny Scholars Academy!!

This Daycare has exceeded all of my expectations. The facility is exceptionally clean, will organized and structured more like a school than a traditional daycare. The curriculum is thoughtfully designed to support early learning and development, effectively preparing children for kindergarten and beyond. My daughter has learned  and grown tremendously in a short period of time and it’s clear the staff is dedicated to providing a nurturing and educational environment. I highly recommend this daycare to any parent seeking quality early childhood education.

Ive had my son enrolled at The little engine learning center for a few years now. At first It was for full-time care, And now it is for drop in care only since he started pre k recently. On the days hes not at the daycare he talks about missing the daycare. All the staff have been kind and patient with my child and I. The director Mrs. Tawnya and her family are very involved at the center and within the community. They really treat us like family and we love the LELC!

Hello parents and other readers, I hope that this review will aid you in your decision to choose the appropriate day care for your child. This is a review of my experience with The Little Engine Learning Center on in the beginning of April 2023. First, I notice that there are multiple good reviews that were given approximately between 2-4 years ago. I consider this a great deal and I make the choice to enroll my at that time 6 month old baby girl. The ladies that operate at the front desk (I cannot recall their names) were extremely nice and welcoming. They made me feel like I was valued and that my interest in their daycare was important to them. When I arrived to the daycare, it appeared to be unders some construction and first room upon entrance was packed with boxes, papers, childrens belongings, etc. It was crowded with little room, maybe enough room for 1 person standing. I got my daughter enrolled paid the registration fee and first week of day care fee costing a total of $225. My initial thought was wow, this is so affordable + the daycare staff seem so friendly, this is too good to be true. My daughter had her first day April 3 and I met a sweet lady named Ms. Nancy she assured me as I cried from the fear of leaving my baby with a stranger, that she was in good hands and she had years of experience. She also mentioned that there was a change of teachers around noon time so there would be someone different taking care of my daughter in the afternoon. That was understandable. Day 3 at this day care, Wednesday, April 5, 2023 I go to pick up my daughter. I requested to meet the afternoon teachers so that I could introduce myself and learn more about my daughters day. (I do not remember her name only that she was dark colored woman who wore scrubs possibly no younger than 40 years old) I learned that there were two babies (including mine) in the classroom that afternoon and both were being picked up at the same time. When I introduced myself as my daughters mother and asked how her day was, she was not very pleasant or welcoming. She immediately told me that my 6 month old baby girl was " BAD" and she gets bored easily. She proceeded to tell me, using her hands to emphasize that my daughter cries a lot and is only okay for 5 minutes on the 6th minute she is crying. I was speechless and waited for her to finish. She continued to say that my baby girl was too heavy for her and she could not be giving her all the attention because she had another baby to take care of. I informed her that describing my baby girl as " bad, bored, and too heavy" was very inappropriate for an infant and also very concerning to me that she felt this way. I asked her if this was too much for her? Which she responded no, I have taken care of babies for years and she is BAD. AGAIN! I told her MY BABY IS  NOT BAD. I could see my daughters' eyes staring at me, with no sign of happiness or pleasure, she had a flat affect. I was absolutely broken hearted and in disbelief that this teacher at The Little Engine Learning Center was taking care of MY BABY with full trust from me for 8 hrs of the day. My baby girl did not go back to this day care after that day. I attempted to reach Daja, the directors daughter or any front desk staff to share my concerns and my calls were never answered. I hope that parents who are reading this consider the quality of this daycare and most importantly understand that YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR.  No low cost daycare is ever worth your child suffering at the hands of people who do not care for your children.

I have been taking my little one to this daycare since she was 5 months old. I recommend this day care! The director is caring and nice! She listens to all special requests and makes sure that she understands them as well (reiterates it to the parent) to make sure their children receive the best care. Any issues that we have had we have brought it to her attention and it's been taken care of then and there. The teachers who watch the little ones are also very friendly every time I drop her off!

I am a returning long time customer. Ive had my 4 children start there since 3 months old. They take great care of the children and cook healthy meals. It's always clean and the employees are friendly. They always listen to special instructions regarding the handling of birth injured babies or special feeding instructions. I recommend this daycare for all your daycare or afterscholl needs.

This is one of the best daycares in San Antonio. They go above and beyond to provide not just care but love for the children. The owner took my autistic son under her wing and helped me get him the care he needs. She really has a passion for what she does. A big thank you to her and her staff

We cannot say enough wonderful things about Spanish World School. The teachers have such a genuine love for the kids — it’s clear in every interaction.

The curriculum is incredibly thoughtful and engaging, even for the youngest students. We’ve been amazed at how much our child is learning and absorbing — not only academically but socially and emotionally.

The Spanish immersion approach is phenomenal; our child is picking up the language naturally and enthusiastically, and we love that they are developing this skill in such a fun, playful, and immersive way.

The administrative staff are outstanding — responsive, organized, and always helpful. Communication is clear and consistent, which gives us so much peace of mind.

OPERATION_NAME: Bright Beginners Preschool and Infant Care
review_text:
From the moment we first stepped into Bright Beginners, we knew we'd found something special. The leadership under Kim is top-notch, always accessible and genuinely passionate about creating the best possible environment for children.

But what truly sets Bright Beginners apart is the incredible faculty. Our son's teachers are amazing – patient, nurturing, and invested in his development every step of the way. We see the love and care they pour into each child in the mobile app updates and the way our son interacts with his teachers. Every child is truly cherished, not just ours.

We feel that the values Bright Beginners instill go beyond academics. The focus on Christian principles creates a foundation of kindness, respect, and compassion. Chapel time on Wednesdays is a highlight for our son, and we love seeing him embrace these essential values at such a young age.

Of course, safety and security for us are also paramount, and Bright Beginners delivers on that front too. The facility is pristine, well-maintained, and equipped with all the necessary measures to keep our little ones secure. We always have peace of mind knowing our son is in such capable hands.

In short, Bright Beginners isn't just a daycare; it's a loving community where children thrive. We can't recommend it highly enough! If you're looking for a nurturing, values-based environment for your precious little one, look no further than Bright Beginners.

OPERATION_NAME: Bright Beginners Preschool and Infant Care
review_text: We are so thankful to have found Bright Beginners. They are taking such wonderful care of our son. I feel completely at ease knowing he’s there. The school has more reasonable ratios for kids and I truly feel like my kiddo is getting an education and attention he needs. So thankful for them and the love they show him, while teaching him about god.

OPERATION_NAME: Bright Beginners Preschool and Infant Care
review_text: To the staff and admin, Thank you for taking care of Gunther as if he is your own family. You have set a high standard for me to search for another childcare here in the South.  Thank you for your patience, love and dedication for the children and for your work.  To Ms Carla and Ms Carmen, you are an angel and my son adores you so much! God bless you in what you do!

review_text:
Our daughter has been going to this school since she was 8 weeks old and now she's almost 2 and a half. I can't say enough good things about the facility, the school, or most importantly the staff. Their leadership team and staff of great teachers are excellent professionals that make sure my daughter's pre-school experience is top tier.

As a parent I always feel welcome and my daughter has made friendships that have grown not only in the classroom but also outside of the classroom. We were referred to this school from a neighbor and have never second guessed our decision to enroll our daughter in this school. We love our teacher's and are so happy to have our daughter here.

OPERATION_NAME: Bright Beginners Preschool and Infant Care
review_text: Best school ever. Drive past every other daycare and school to get to Bright Beginners. Their staff and their program are amazing!!! From the moment we arrived on his first day, we could tell this was going to be a wonderful place for him to learn and grow. ZyAire gave us a tour and walked us through all of the questions we had as first-time parents, and she has been so great ever since. Every time we drop him off, our son gives a big smile to the teachers that reassures us he’s having fun and feels safe. ZyAire and Alexis are fantastic with the littles and we feel really good about them watching our son. We recommend La Petite to anyone with kids.

The teachers and director always have a variety of learning activities and opportunities for the kids to gain more confidence by treating them like young adults. The teachers are fantastic! They foster learning and accountability. They help reiterate life skill teachings we do at home and help them become more self-sufficient. The place is always clean and it is apparent communication is paramount. The director is a fantastic leader and leads by example. Her professionalism and can do attitude exceed all expectations. It is really is a simple question. If you want your kids to be in a healthy, clean, and quality day care, there’s no other choice. You must take them to this daycare. 1,000% recommend!

This daycare has exceeded our expectations in every way. The teachers create a safe, structured, and nurturing environment where children thrive. I’m impressed by the educational activities, daily updates, and the genuine attention to each child’s needs. The facility is well-maintained, and the staff is always welcoming. We truly feel like our child is in the best hands.

As a parent, there is nothing better than seeing your child run into their classroom with excitement. From the moment we toured, everyone has been very welcoming and professional. Choosing La Petite was the best decision we made for our family... Highly recommend!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Exceptional Care—A True Second Family
We have children ages 3, 6, and 7, and this daycare has been an incredible part of their lives. Our 6-year-old has been attending since he was in Toddler 1, and our youngest started here at just 6 weeks old. At this point, they truly feel like part of our family.

The level of care in each classroom is outstanding. Yolanda, in Preschool 1, goes above and beyond every single day. She is patient, engaging, and genuinely invested in the growth of every child in her class.

For our older kids, Linda in the School Age classroom is phenomenal. Her background as a former principal really shines—she keeps the older children engaged, well-mannered, and excited to learn. She understands how to challenge them while still making every day fun and meaningful.

Beatrice, the cook, is the sweetest person. She pours so much love into the meals she prepares, and the kids absolutely adore her.

And of course, Marie, the director, is the heart of the entire center. She works tirelessly to ensure the very best experience for both the children and the parents. She is transparent, honest, and always willing to step into any classroom—even the infant room—whenever she’s needed. Her leadership and communication are unmatched.

This daycare doesn’t just provide supervision—they provide genuine care, structure, enrichment, and a sense of belonging. I cannot recommend them highly enough. If you’re looking for a place where your children will be nurtured, supported, and treated like family, this is it.

As a parent, finding a childcare center that not only meets but exceeds national standards is a rare gift — and Play N’ Learn has done exactly that for our family. From day one, the care, structure, and attention to detail this center offers has been nothing short of exceptional.

The staff goes above and beyond to ensure each child is receiving a well-rounded, personalized education. One of the most impressive things about Play N’ Learn is how open and available the teachers are when it comes to discussing your child’s progress. They’re not just willing to meet — they want to. Whether it's a quick check-in or a deeper conversation about how to support learning at home, they always make time. It truly feels like a partnership.

A standout in our experience has been Ms. Chantal. She has an incredible gift for working with children — warm, attentive, and always encouraging. Her dedication shines through in every interaction. Any negative feedback regarding her, or Ms. Mae, honestly baffles me. These two women are the heart of the center. They consistently demonstrate care, patience, and a deep commitment to every child’s growth and well-being. The love they have for their work and for the children is unmistakable.

Thanks to Play N’ Learn’s thoughtful and immersive curriculum, my child is now fluent in both English and Spanish — a skill that will serve them for a lifetime. The bilingual education is seamlessly integrated into everyday activities, making language learning natural and fun.

Play N’ Learn is more than just a daycare — it’s a community that nurtures, educates, and empowers children. We are beyond grateful for the foundation they’ve helped build for our child.

Transitioning our daughter from the dedicated, compassionate care of in-home nannies to a preschool environment was a significant and initially daunting decision. To ensure we made the best choice, we meticulously toured, met with, and interviewed representatives from numerous local schools. While we encountered many excellent institutions staffed by kind and proficient professionals, our primary focus remained on our daughter's comfort and educational development. We sought a Montessori-inspired approach (or similar), loving and compassionate teachers capable of providing the individualized attention she received at home, and a curriculum that introduced foundational preschool knowledge early on. As we are not of the Jewish faith, Jewish schools were not initially at the top of our list. However, after visiting a dozen schools and still feeling uncertain, we decided to tour the Becker School.

We were pleasantly surprised to learn that nearly 40% of the students and families at Becker were not Jewish, which immediately conveyed an inclusive and welcoming environment. What was even more impactful was our daughter's immediate connection to the outdoor area, complete with chickens and gardens, and the warmth of the teachers in her classroom. She gravitated towards the entire environment and was reluctant to leave. We felt Becker offered the ideal setting for her to develop motor and social skills within a family-like atmosphere.

Our daughter's first week at Becker was a resounding success. A particular concern for us was her need for contact napping, but her teachers demonstrated incredible patience and understanding, facilitating a smooth transition to independent napping – a challenge we had struggled with at home. Their approach was devoid of judgment or condemnation, which we deeply appreciated. Previously, she struggled with sitting still at a table, but now she engages with lessons attentively. While it is common for children her age to struggle with peer interaction, the school environment fostered her social development, and she now shares and interacts with other children much more effectively. She has even become exceptionally interactive and welcoming of affection.

Beyond the classroom, the staff at Becker has been exceptionally accommodating, whether we needed before-care, after-care, flexible scheduling (three or five days), or were occasionally delayed for pickup. They have also been wonderfully compassionate regarding my limited knowledge of Jewish culture, from which I have learned a great deal. The introduction of Hebrew to the curriculum is an added bonus. The teachers consistently include children from all backgrounds, which we believe is invaluable for her and future generations.

I want to extend a special shout-out to Mrs. Sarah and Mrs. Monica, who have been absolutely fabulous. I genuinely wish they could care for our daughter all the time, as they are truly exceptional. I wholeheartedly recommend Becker School to anyone seeking a safe, nurturing environment where their child is treated with genuine care and affection.

We recently moved north of town, but I still make the half hour drive to Becker because I haven't found a school closer to us that can compare. We trusted this school with our child.

Teachers were underpaid. Supplies were missing. Ratios were questionable. Parents noticed. When a beloved teacher resigned after being stretched thin and under-supported, she was immediately removed from campus. Parents were told a sanitized version of events that did not align with reality.

When families calmly asked for transparency, the response from ownership was not accountability. It was retaliation.

Our child — who had done absolutely nothing wrong and was thriving — was abruptly expelled because his parents dared to question leadership. A school that claims to be child-centered removed a thriving child to avoid discomfort.

The most painful part is that the teachers were wonderful. Dedicated. Loving. Doing everything they could. The problem was not the educators. It was the administration — specifically the owner — who consistently chose optics over honesty and control over collaboration.

A school’s culture is set at the top. When leadership is insecure and reactive, children and families pay the price.

We are heartbroken for the teachers who work hard without support. We are heartbroken for the families who will eventually discover these patterns for themselves. And we are heartbroken that our child had to absorb the consequences of adult ego.

Families deserve transparency. Teachers deserve respect. Children deserve better.

At the end of the day, here’s what this experience taught me:

Pay attention to how leadership responds when questioned. Any organization can look polished when things are smooth. The real culture shows up when someone asks a hard question.

We saw teachers working hard, often without adequate support. We saw parents raising reasonable concerns. And we saw leadership respond by closing ranks instead of opening dialogue.

When trust erodes, it’s rarely because of one incident. It’s because transparency feels optional.

We don’t regret advocating for a teacher. We don’t regret asking about ratios. We don’t regret standing up for what felt misaligned.

If anything, this experience clarified something important… The right school for our child will welcome engaged parents, not remove them.

I am beyond disappointed with the service—or lack thereof—provided by the manager, Matthew, at the Life Time Fitness in San Antonio.

Despite explaining that I had already been granted access hours prior and was actively evaluating the gym for a potential membership, Matthew was completely inflexible. Instead of honoring the precedent set by his own staff or showing any level of professional courtesy, he essentially gave me an ultimatum: find the member immediately or pay for a day pass.
Why this was a "Despicable" Experience:
• Zero Consistency: Rules apparently change depending on who is standing at the front desk. You cannot hold guests to a standard that your own team doesn't follow.
• Poor Sales Tactics: If your goal is to convert guests into long-term members, nickel-and-diming them for a day pass when they already have a valid multi-day guest pass is a great way to lose a lead.
• Lack of Empathy: Matthew showed zero interest in resolving the situation or acknowledging the confusion caused by his staff’s earlier actions.
If this is how management treats potential members before they even sign a contract, I can only imagine how little they care once they have your credit card on file. Save yourself the headache and look at other luxury gyms in San Antonio where the managers actually value customer experience.

Now everyone is trying to book the remaining hours, spots fill up very fast, and it’s almost impossible to rely on the service anymore. I’ve tried to communicate and find a solution, and I’ve already sent more than two emails, with no response at all.
For the price we pay at Life Time, this level of communication and service is honestly unacceptable.
On top of that, the gym floor itself is overcrowded and under-equipped. I am currently training for a bodybuilding competition, and the lack of equipment is very frustrating. There is only one hack squat, one hip thrust machine, one seated curl, one abduction , and very limited cable stations for the amount of members using the gym. When one machine is taken, there are no alternatives, which makes training inefficient and stressful.
There are simply not enough machines or variations for the volume of people using the gym. Almost every machine has only one unit, which is not realistic for such a busy facility.
Overall, I am extremely disappointed. For a premium-priced gym, I expected better organization, better communication, and equipment that actually matches the number of members.

They are camping on machines for 10+ minutes scrolling and talking on their phones like they’re sitting on their couch at home. It’s incredibly frustrating when you actually need to use the equipment you’re paying premium prices for, and trying to keep tempo. Put in the work and move to the next movement.

Just recently, an older man was posted up on a machine for a full phone call. When I asked to work in, he snapped at me, which escalated to a heated exchange that required someone to step in. That says everything about the culture here.

No Hammer Strength high pull
No pullover machine
Only one plate-loaded Hammer Strength incline press
Only one plate-loaded Hammer Strength chest press
Only one hip thrust machine
Only one adduction and one abductor machine
*These machines are always tied up by phone-sitters*

The entire place is sterile, bland, and completely disconnected from real physical progress. This is a “fitness facility,” not a gym, and the difference is obvious the moment you walk in.

If you actually train, value equipment availability, or expect even basic etiquette from other members, this location falls way short. I stay for the childcare—and absolutely nothing else.

I absolutely love this daycare. Being first time mom the staff helps me out in so many ways. They helped with all my sons milestones, they also keep him safe. My son loves it here he's always smiling and laughing. The staff here treat you like family.
We love Chapelwood! …even though we might cut up a bit during Christmas Eve Service! 😬

I've been attending the "Mercy Street" service at Chapelwood since 2011/12. I've heard they have something like 30 different services at Chapelwood, but don't quote me on the numbers. If you are new to Recovery, or been involved for a while, but have never been to Mercy Street, you need to check it out. It's definitely a good place to spend a Sat evening, and I've always loved the Candlelight Christmas Eve service at MS. Just grab a couple of friends, and make it a start to your night. Super casual, laid back atmosphere, which is pretty original in church services, imo. You might just learn something that will save you and your family. I hope that you do!!💯 If you need help, this is a good place to be. There are people that attend the church service and the subsequent NA/AA meetings that can, at a minimum, lend an ear and possibly offer suggestions. Don't think, just GO!!! God Bless everyone that reads this post, whether you want it or not, I'm praying you and your family find what you lack have more than enough to share with the next family. 💯🔥🔥🔥♥️

I grew up in Chapelwood with my parents and 4 siblings.  I was married in this church. I am now in my 60s and live in Colorado. I recently googled the church to see how it was growing, and was saddened to see that the 13 original founders names were not listed in the church history.  I remember the stories my parents told about knocking on strangers doors, inviting them to attend. Once my father was greeted by a man and his shotgun and was told to leave!  They worked hard to establish this legacy. I wish that their names could have been recognized for all their hard work, all 13 of them!  My parents were Bill and Nitis English.
I went for the first time for Easter. A very nice experience. Great Songs and singing. The pastor was contemporary and on point without being way too long.  I just might go again.

I go to Mercy Street Church at Chapelwood every Saturday evening for services. The pastor, Ms. Melissa, is great, she always makes everyone feel welcome & her sermons always make you think, the music is awesome & it's just an all around wonderful church to be a part of! I highly recommend it to everyone!

My son used to attend Neighbor House Community Daycare when he was younger, and he truly enjoyed being there. I never had any issues during our time with them, and I always felt comfortable and confident leaving my child in their care. The director and teachers are very kind, caring, and supportive. I’m truly grateful for everything they did to help me, and I always recommend this daycare to other moms looking for a safe and loving environment for their kids.

I took my child who was 7-8 months old at the time that couldn’t walk yet. I told several staff that because the floors are hard please watch him carefully. The staff in the baby room said they understood but I knew they didn’t care for my instructions plus wasn’t sure if they understood me fully because some only spoke Spanish. I pulled aside the director or manager not sure what the title was but she was a higher position & told her what I said. She said she understood but I wanted her to translate to the people who work with him so they understand before I leave. She translated & they said ok. I ended up getting a photo of my son with a big bruise on his forehead & near his eye stating that he hit his face on the book shelf. I called Gia immediately who did my on boarding. She didn’t see the photo & said she didn’t even know what happened. She asked the worker what happened & she told me that he hit his face on the bookshelf because the staff needed to clean up. I said something around the lines of why would they not watch him if they agreed to make sure he’s watched when standing up. She said to me that kids are kids they will get hurt & bite. It’s kids. Well my child couldn’t walk… talk… that statement is invalid because what do you mean kids are kids when he smacked his head on the shelf because the staff clearly ignored my instructions instead of just strapping him into a chair or something? Gia didn’t care at all & down played the situation. I ask her did you see the photo? She said no & I told her look. She looked at the photo & said something around the lines of wow it looks like he was thrown on the floor based off the photo you were sent It doesn’t look that bad in person but it looks bad….. yeah I know that’s why I called.

Very heartless people. I can’t believe that’s how the staff responded. Invalidating me just to tell me in the end the photo I was sent looked horrible is messed up. The staff did not care about my instructions.

I didn’t want to make a review but I’m still highly upset on how they treated me & my child. My fears before I left was right. They didn’t care about what I said hence why I asked for a higher position to verify they understood so it’s proof they understand!!! I’m more upset at the fact that Gia spoke me as if it wasn’t a big deal & didn’t care. This is a church… I thought church’s preach kindness, understanding, hearing others, & more but that’s not these type of people.

Nabor House was a true blessing when my child was there. They were always so understanding and flexible. Mrs.Rhonda was my child’s teacher/care taker and she did an incredible job with my child. She really cared. I will always be grateful for this place and I would highly recommend it to anyone.

Nabor House has been nothing but a beacon of peace. My experience with the staff has always been amazing, they are empathetic, respectful, and full of integrity. The teachers are dedicated, and loving. My favorite part is how they teach with so much patience and fun!
I truly recommend this Daycare center, especially to those struggling to find affordable care all while receiving the best education.

I feel very blessed that my children are in this daycare because they are a family, they give us emotional support when we need child as parents I overcame a depression thanks to the love and listening of the staff, they take care of our little ones with a lot of love and affection.  my wish was that there were many Nabor house around this world. The whole team is wonderful and overflows with the presence of God! Thank you God for blessed us with nabor house🙏❤️

My kids have been coming to this daycare since my 6 year old was 6 weeks old. I really love the staff. My children are really comfortable with their teachers. Ms.Belen is amazing she treat all the kids like they’re her own.

My son has been apart of this daycare for many years. The staff is always pleasant, always knowing how to talk to my child before the “mom call” which he understands.. he is able to express and communicate with all staff members.

Schola International is wonderful. The teachers are very kind, caring, and attentive with the kids and bilingual is a plus. They create a safe, happy, and welcoming environment where children feel comfortable and loved.

We are so happy to be part of Schola international. Our Son has been here for almost a year and we love it. The teachers are great and you can see they care for the kids. Great school for your kids to learn different languages.

Schola International has been the best school we could have found for our 3-year-old. From day one, we felt completely confident and secure leaving our son here, which says everything. We’ve had such a wonderful experience with my son’s care at Schola International . Miss Maria and all the teachers in his class have been absolutely amazing, so caring, patient, and attentive. Great school for my kid. I love the relationship we have built with the teachers and administrators. Any questions, problems, or situations are always handled in the most professional way. I was so blessed to come across this Head Start program it's free it's awesome its FREE .. Then they teach your child all they need to know before they get into Elementary. review_text: We absolutely love this daycare! Our son has been attending since he was 3.5 months old and it’s been a great experience since then. We are excited for our son to continue learning from AJ and improve even more every day. We couldn’t be more grateful for the positive impact AJ has had on our son, and we highly recommend this gym to anyone looking for the best in both coaching and care!
The best gymnastics ever! Great coaches great staff great vibes! I love this place!
My childs tramp coach was only paying attention to two girls! Which lead my child to just do the same tricks over and over again. Although her floor coach was amazing.

All three of my kids have done at least some amount of pre-K in their Palaestra program. Highly recommend especially if you will be attending Highland Park or other nearby elementary schools.
My daughter and I love the staff. Very welcoming and my baby is always well cared for while she is there

My children have attended Kinder Care since November 2021. My son was early diagnosed with Autism at the age of two. The staff accepted, loved and supported my son. Thank you again for all the hard work put in daily for the care and learning of our babies.

The Goddard School of Jersey Village is absolutely wonderful! The teachers and staff are warm, caring, and truly dedicated to helping children grow and succeed. We are so thankful for the safe, nurturing environment they provide and highly recommend this school to any family looking for the best start for their little one!

Today, I visited Goddard with high hopes that it would be the right place for my 4-year-old son, who is autistic. I left feeling disappointed, unheard, and honestly like my time was wasted.

The first staff member who helped me was kind, and I appreciated that. But when I met with the person who was supposed to tell me about the school, she spent the entire time talking about Goddard in general—its programs, the other students—without once asking about my son, his needs, or what I was looking for. I eventually had to interrupt just so I could explain a few important things about him.

I also shared that my son eats a very limited diet, including peanut products for protein, which we would send in a bottle. I was immediately told peanuts aren’t allowed on the property, with no effort to explore solutions or offer understanding.

Overall, I left feeling deeply let down. I know there are better schools out there that will take the time to truly understand and support my son, and that’s exactly what I intend to find.

I have never heard of this before, why would you take children outside when the city of Houston is infested with mosquitos?!?! Even when providing "Off" or "Cutter" bug spray, he/she still came home covered in bites, due to the lack of using the resources. There are a number of reasons i moved my child, this facility is good for what you pay...but my childs health, happiness, and well begin is more important than a cheap daycare!

Our family has had a truly wonderful experience at The Kipling School. From the very beginning, it was clear that this is a place where children are known, valued, and supported as individuals.

The teachers are phenomenal. They are deeply invested in their students and take the time to understand how each child learns best. Our son has grown not only academically but also in confidence, independence, and self awareness. The level of care and attention he receives is something you simply cannot put a price on.

The administration is equally exceptional. They are approachable, thoughtful, and flexible, and they genuinely partner with families. Any time we have had a question or needed support, the response has been prompt, compassionate, and solutions focused. You truly feel like you are part of a community, not just a number.

Academically, the rigor is impressive. Kipling challenges students in a meaningful way while still meeting them where they are. The curriculum encourages critical thinking, curiosity, and a love of learning rather than rote memorization. At the same time, the school places a strong emphasis on emotional growth, character, and social development. They focus on educating the whole child, not just academic outcomes.

Our son looks forward to going to school, and as a parent, that speaks volumes. We are incredibly grateful for the teachers, leadership, and overall environment at The Kipling School. It has been a blessing for our family, and we could not recommend it more highly.

School administration is unorganized and incompetent when it comes to child care. Food quality is terrible and facilities are unkept and of poor quality compared to other similar schools in the area. Avoid at all costs.

My three year old absolutely loves her classmates and teachers.  She is well taken care of at The Kipling School. The wait list is worth the quality of care my child receives.

OPERATION_NAME: Clay Road Baptist Early Child Care
review_text: Both of my children  have attend CRBS for 3 years now! The Early Childhood Learning Center is wonderful; organized, sanitary & my daughter loves her teachers! All the staff know both my children by name & so do most of all the students regardless of different ages and classes they are in! It's a community, full of love and care for your children! I can't say enough wonderful things about CRBS! I can truly say I have no doubt that my children are receiving an excellent education & are in a safe, loving environment that they ENJOY & LOVE! Thank you CRBS!

OPERATION_NAME: Clay Road Baptist Early Child Care
review_text: We have loved our time at CRBS. Our son started attending at 3 months with their infants program and just finished attending Pre-K4. For his development, we really valued a combination of free-play alongside keeping his mind busy and we really felt like every class at Clay Road balanced those needs really well. We feel like they really put in the work to make sure he is socially adept and kind but he's also now fully sounding out words and very prepared for school (and anyone who has tried to get a rambunctious 4-year-old to focus on letters knows how difficult that can be but he has loved learning how to read with Ms. Ramirez). Lastly, we really valued that they would always try and handle things at school. Obviously, we want to know what is going on in his classes but also know that over the course of a day, there is a lot of course-correction that happens in teaching. In every class, we felt like they would really try and address an item in the classroom before bringing it up to us as a larger issue and it was always done in a caring way. Throughout our time, Ms. Royall and Ms. Straughan in the main office loved on our boy. They looked out for us during school as well as outside of the school (them and their families were our biggest cheering section at Little League this year!). They were a solid, consistently communicative presence during the stress and confusion of COVID and went above and beyond. We were new parents when our son started school and really felt like we grew in our parenting with their support. We are so incredibly grateful for our time with Clay Road.

OPERATION_NAME: Clay Road Baptist Early Child Care
review_text: We could not be happier with Clay Road. We have had 2 boys go through here (one for PreK and the others from when he was 2) and it is great. The hours are good and they offer flexible options (3 day, 5 day, etc.). They also don't take many holidays (Thanksgiving week, Christmas 2 weeks, and 1 or 2 times where they do teacher training). You get great quality education for what you pay for - both our boys have been ready for kindergarten. Communication from the school is excellent. And you can tell all the teachers really love and care! This is a Christian childcare, so they will learn Bible lessons, verses and songs. In the summer, the older children will also attend the church's VBS.

OPERATION_NAME: Clay Road Baptist Early Child Care
review_text: If you live in the Spring Branch area and are looking for affordable private Christian education for your kids, CRBS is as good as it gets! Our family loves CRBS!! My kiddos have been in attendance since my oldest was in MDO at 2 years old. She's now in 2nd grade.  My younger son also started in MDO at 2 and is now in Pre-K. We love the Bible based teaching, the small class sizes, the one-on-one attention, and the family feel of the campus. I love that as my 5 year old Pre-K son walks through the campus, the 7th and 8th graders know his name and give him high fives. There is a close knit bond here. We are also members of the church here...the close family feel extends into the church congregation as well. We love the leadership and the families of both the school and the church. As long as the Lord provides, my kids will be attending CRBS!

OPERATION_NAME: Clay Road Baptist Early Child Care
review_text: If I could give this daycare and preschool 0 stars, I would.  We had our children in this daycare for 6 years, and my older son graduated from the CRBS preschool.  We knew the staff and Director (Courtney Royall) well.  Our family donated over $10,000 worth of upgrades to the building including commercial grade glass doors, wood floors for the entire ECP building, mulch for the playground, etc.  We volunteered at book fairs and attended school and church events.  We are strong Christians, and my husband is also a Sunday school class Director at our church.  The Director and staff knew my family, too, and even came to my dad's funeral last year.  We also have close family friends who attend CRB church (and were appalled at the following incident I'm about to share).  In late summer 2022, my son went to school on a Friday with a small scratch on his eye from the evening before, and my husband told the teacher what happened and explained the circumstances of the accident.  Saturday morning, just before we were leaving to head to the airport for our summer family vacation, we get a knock at the door and it's CPS.  We were shocked that the school director called CPS over this minor accidental incident.  We invited the social worker in, and he was extremely vocal about how ridiculous it was that the school director called CPS over this, but that all calls have to be investigated.  He gave us a lot of insight, and we were blown away that the school director made such a reckless decision.  I called her on her cell after CPS left and all she could say over and over again was "I understand you're frustrated".  We cooperated with CPS and finally received their decision (any abuse outruled, obviously) 2 whole months after this ordeal began.  We received multiple visits from them and our young children were interviewed with inappropriate questions we were uncomfortable with regarding sexual abuse (this is part of their standard interview with kids).  It ruined our family vacation, as we were all stressed the entire time since it started literally the day we left for vacation.  We had just lost my dad  (and last parent) unexpectedly, and had several other BIG stresses going on simultaneously, so this was an overwhelming final straw.  In addition to our specific situation, we also suffered for a couple years prior to this incident at the hands of the preschool Director.  She was constantly shutting down the school for a week or two at a time any time a child was "exposed" to Covid, and notifying us the evening before we had to find alternative child care.  I spoke with many parents about this, and everyone felt her actions were excessive and disruptive to their family/work life.  She even sent my son home with a 99.0 degree "fever" (which is NOT a fever) for a day and half, without prorating my tuition or even as much as an apology.  As a daycare director, I feel the director should use wisdom and judgment at all times; but the Director of this daycare has exhibited poor and reckless judgment on numerous occasions.  In our specific situation, she should have called us to discuss the situation rather than rely upon a second-hand story from a substitute teacher.  The Director relied upon being a "mandatory reporter", however, the statute states you are only required to report something you BELIEVE is actual child abuse or neglect, and there is no way she actually believed that knowing us as she did.  She exhibited totally RECKLESS judgment and our family suffered as a result.  Of course, we removed our child from the program immediately, and we are now SO thankful to be in a MUCH better school program for him that is worlds apart from CRBS daycare; he has shown immense growth and development over what he showed at CRBS.  Many of the pre-school teachers and daycare workers at CRBS who left confided in me and other parents at how poorly the Director ran things and why there was such high turnover, and that children were sitting idly and being ineffectively "taught"/supervised.  I now feel that this may have been a blessing in disguise!

The Learning Experience – Southwest Austin has been fantastic for our family. Our daughter started here just before she turned one, and the staff has been consistently warm, communicative, and genuinely caring. The center is clean, organized, and clearly run by people who take pride in what they do. We feel confident in the care she receives and highly recommend this location.

We’ve had our daughter at this daycare since she was 2 years old, and now at 4+, we can honestly say it’s been one of the best decisions we’ve made for her early years. She absolutely loves being there, and it’s easy to see why - the environment is warm, nurturing, and full of positive energy.

Ms. Snehal has been the kindest, most considerate, and incredibly accommodating person, no matter how busy she might be. Her genuine care for the children and families truly shines through. The teachers are wonderful, a special shoutout to Rueben and Anna, who always go the extra mile to ensure every child feels comfortable, cared for, and encouraged. Their dedication to making sure each child is happy, learning, and thriving is so evident.

We’ve seen our daughter grow in confidence, social skills, and curiosity thanks to the thoughtful activities, creative learning experiences, and the loving guidance from all the staff. The communication from the team is excellent, and we always feel connected to what our daughter is learning and experiencing throughout the day.

It’s rare to find a place that feels like a true second home for your child, but that’s exactly what this daycare has been for us. We’re beyond grateful for everything they’ve done, and we can’t recommend them highly enough.

Strong 5+ stars! Our child was at this facility from the time it opened in mid-2025. Choosing this daycare was definitely the right decision. For sure, there were a couple of minor issues along the way (who doesn't have them?), but they were insignificant compared to the excellent care and service we received."

I cannot say enough wonderful and positive things about TLE Southwest - they are an incredible institution and truly care about every little one that they serve. Leaving your infant in the care of someone else is extremely scary and gut-wrenching, but the staff and teachers at TLE were so calm, kind, trusting, loving, and understanding. The facility and classrooms are spotless (which seems impossible with children running around!), and they implement and follow all of the best-in-class safety standards. Our son thrived there, and seemed genuinely happy. The ONLY reason we left is because of the commute, but had we lived closer we would have gladly kept our son enrolled throughout his childhood until Kindergarten. Thank you to everyone at TLE for everything you do for the littles!

Communication is excellent—the teachers keep us updated with daily notes and photos, which gives us peace of mind while we’re at work. It’s clear that the staff put a lot of thought into creating a nurturing environment where kids can grow socially, emotionally, and academically. There are lots of activities, too.

Thank you Ms. Snehal, Cece, Latoya, Jessica and Milly. ❤️ and other teachers. Appreciate your guidance.

I highly recommend TLE to any parent looking for a loving, and enriching place for their little one!

Unfortunately my visit was due to a funeral mass, however the priest and his staff were very professional and welcoming to everyone. I actually liked the mass service and the entire speech from the priest. I was very impressed with the entire ceremonial service and the cleanliness of the church and the atmosphere of the service and the people in charge. I’m very impressed.

The church was packed with standing room only and there was an overflow room where Mass was being streamed. Hundreds of children and their parents in their Christmas finery waited to celebrate the birth of Christ. Instead, the priest reread the Gospel of Joseph's dream from the previous Sunday and for added "children's entertainment" read the genealogy of Jesus -  all 14 generations. The sermon focused not on the birth of Christ but the covenant of marriage. WOW!!! Worst Children's Mass in the history of the church! (While I am aware that the Gospel reading was an option for Christmas Eve. It most assuredly was not an option for this particular Mass.)

Both of my kids are in scouts thru the church. I haven't oldest in boy scouts and I became a leader to my daughter's girl scout troop. Another favorite of mine is the prayer blanket ministry! We have ladies such as myself who hand crochet, or hand knit, or make no-sew fleece blankets or cotton sewn just lap throws for the sick or people in need of prayer. My whole family enjoys this church with all our hearts and souls. The pictures below are fromour VBS program this year that I personally made and from our blanket ministry that I crocheted.
Great family place for your children and very safe thanks to the staff and Officer Joe!!

OPERATION_NAME: Davenn LLC DBA First Steps Learning Center
review_text:
As a single father and small business owner, finding a place that truly supports both growth and peace of mind is rare — but First Steps Learning Center has been exactly that.

From the very first day, I saw not just a daycare, but a community built on compassion, patience, and genuine care for children. My son Bruce has not only thrived academically but has also grown more confident, curious, and expressive in ways that continue to amaze me. The lessons here go beyond the classroom — they teach kindness, communication, and the foundation for lifelong learning.

The owner, Calvenn, leads with integrity and heart, setting the tone for an incredible team that feels more like family than staff. Each member of his team operates with such dedication that it’s clear they’re doing more than a job — they’re shaping futures.

As a father balancing parenthood and entrepreneurship, the trust I have in this place allows me to focus on my work knowing my child is in the best hands possible. First Steps has not only helped Bruce learn — it’s helped me build stability and purpose.

If you’re looking for a center that values children as individuals and supports families with sincerity and excellence, this is the one.

OPERATION_NAME: Davenn LLC DBA First Steps Learning Center
review_text: My 4 year old daughter has been attending this daycare for almost 3 months. She previously attended another daycare for 1.5 years but had to leave due to many issues. When I first toured this daycare I was welcomed with the smell of Lysol, something that was significantly different from her last daycare. Being a healthcare worker, it is impressive to see how clean this facility is. At her last daycare she used to come home with tons of mucus and always had a cough. Now, she hardly comes home sick. At her last daycare they historically failed to take appropriate disciplinary action in response to aggressive or harmful behavior from other children - this led to my daughter being exposed to this behavior and acting out at home. As soon as she started First Steps Learning Center her behavior significantly changed for the better. The welcoming environment of this daycare has also contributed to the change in my daughter’s behavior. Parents, it matters where your children stay. It was in our family’s best interest to invest in a daycare such at this one versus our last daycare that had lower prices. Thank God for Mrs. Kendra, Mrs. Vania, Ms. Vanessa, Ms. Sandra, Ms. Margie, Ms. Alretta and all the other lovely ladies for your kindness. Everyone here does a super job in taking care of my daughter. It matters more to us how our daughter is being cared for versus a few missing materialistic things. Our children’s lives are irreplaceable and their care matters here.

OPERATION_NAME: Davenn LLC DBA First Steps Learning Center
review_text: We found this daycare after having a not so pleasant experience with our daughter’s previous daycare. First Steps has been very welcoming, and they were able to quickly accommodate us since we were trying to get her moved to a new daycare ASAP. All of the staff has been very reassuring and friendly, always welcoming us to voice any questions or concerns. My daughter smiles in the morning when I drop her off, which speaks for itself. I can tell the caregivers here really care about the children and have their best interest first. The facility is also super clean, and they have a no shoe rule in the classrooms where the children have floor time. I highly recommend for anyone looking for a safe and nurturing environment for your child!

OPERATION_NAME: Davenn LLC DBA First Steps Learning Center
review_text:
We started bringing our baby to First Steps when he was 5 months old. My husband and I both work full-time and I was VERY emotional when it was time to start looking into daycare centers. Mrs. Vania was the first person we met at First Steps and she shared that she had the same concerns that I had when she brought her own children to daycare at another location. I loved her transparency in saying that she didn’t trust the daycare providers and she didn’t like how some things were done. That experience is what led her to a career in childcare so that she could make sure that all children are treated how she would want her own to be treated. We looked at a lot of facilities but she made me feel like this would be a safe and happy place for my baby.

Even though the first few days were hard for me when dropping him off, I felt like I could trust their staff to treat my baby like one of their own. In fact, most of the staff refer to my son as, “their baby.” So sweet! I love that they love him so much!

OPERATION_NAME: Davenn LLC DBA First Steps Learning Center
review_text:
My son loves his teachers! I get updates through their app regularly, and I feel very welcomed there. They treat my baby so compassionately and kind and gentle, and I feel safe having them take good care of him. The teachers there are my village! I appreciate all of you who do so much for my baby boy, to all his teachers from when he was still a tiny baby to now a toddler!

Updated review: This 5 star review is for Miss Alretta! She is the best. We love her!

It's a great, clean place to get a good workout. Lots of options with newer machines and weights, and if you like exercise classes, they have a wide variety to choose from. The staff are very friendly. We have been going there for many, many years. I totally recommend it.

Good facility, good community, and WONDERFUL staff. The childcare staff are so lovely and great with the kids. I trust them completely and they have always been so helpful and friendly. Couldn't ask for a better place to work out and take my kids.

The classes and instructors are awesome.  Although Perry YMCA is a much nicer looking facility and closer to me, I prefer to go this location just for the fact that they have variety of group classes with great instructors.

My children were going to Miller Child Development Center on the southeast side. I came in to pick up my kids and peeked through a window to see how my toddler was doing. I witnessed the daycare teacher grabbing my son roughly digging her nails into his arms, lifting him, and then putting him down roughly (to remove him from a play area). I immediately told head staff and inspected my son. He had a nail mark in his arm from how hard she was gripping him. I reported them to licensing. The owner stated he also reported themselves but they refused to move my son to another room. Licensing viewed the video (which also showed my son holding the injured arm crying and the teacher ignoring the pain she caused him) and the employee was written up along with a safety plan put in place (she's no longer allowed to work alone). The owner told me accidents happen and basically if my family or I'm better at watching my own child then I should watch him myself. I immediately withdrew them from the daycare. I don't know about y'all but I know not to dig my nails into my children's arms. If you know any parents who have kids there tell them to make drop in visits and check their kids for mysterious marks and bruises. My toddler had 4 busted lips in the 8 months he attended. Which is weird because he never gets injured like that at home and he has 6 other siblings.  I believe she should be fired but the daycare cared more about protecting her instead of our children. Originally the owner only wanted to make her go to extra training but the licensing demanded a safety plan put in place which included her not being allowed to work alone. What angered me the most was that the daycare acted like I was the one in the wrong for notifying other parents and that it was just an accident. You don't accidentally dig your nails into a child's arm.

OPERATION_NAME: Celebree School of Dallas Arts District
review_text:
We absolutely LOVE Celebree!

This was my son’s very first daycare experience, and I couldn’t have asked for a better start. The first couple of days he cried when I left him—but now he cries if I’m not moving fast enough to take him in the morning! 😂

I used to feel guilty leaving him, and now I feel guilty if I keep him home because I know he’s missing out on all the fun, love, and learning. Celebree has become such a special place for our family.

What makes it amazing:
💛 The staff: Every single person—from the directors to the teachers—truly cares. You can feel it. I actually have a career I love, but there have been moments where I’ve thought, “Maybe I should just work here!” because the staff culture is that good.

💛 Special shout-outs: Ms. Madi, Ms. Evette, and Ms. Mindy are some of the best humans you’ll ever meet. And my son’s teacher, Ms. Alexis, deserves her own fan club! She’s seriously on Ms. Rachel’s level. So professional, warm, and fun—the kids adore her. My son will literally pout in the corner if she’s not there. That’s how much she means to him.

💛 Safe & nurturing environment: I never worry while I’m at work. I know he’s cared for and safe.

💛 The food: They provide great, healthy meals for the kids—huge plus for working parents.

💛 Communication: My absolute favorite thing! They send daily updates about what the kids are learning, plus adorable pictures of your little one. Those messages make my day every single time.

If you’re looking for a place that feels like a second home, where your child will be loved, learn, and want to go every morning—this is it. You will absolutely love it here! 🌟

I just feel the need to bring attention to the lack of safety and the extreme unprofessionalism within the Hands n Hands daycare group. This specifically happened at the location on WW White, but they also have a location on Hotwells. The Owner, “Cynthia” or Terry Puente, Director, Desiree, and Assistant Director, Cassandra, are extremely negligent in their operations that put the safety of the kids that attend there in jeopardy.

I immediately removed my child from the premise after they had a safety compromise in their building this morning. They expected me to leave the building with peace of mind as they shoved my daughter into a class with no context as to what’s going on. The situation had called for the police to be called because there was a parent that was being a safety issue. Once I tried to address the situation with the Director over the phone, the Owner rudely interrupted and tried to shut my statement down. She had said (at 9:45am) that she was not going to listen to my concerns as she was still not sure what had happened in her building (when the altercation had happened at 8:15am.)  After the situation had somewhat subsided, the Director had informed me at aproximately 8:30am that the Owner was just minutes away and that I could wait to speak with her. How is it that an hour and a half later she was still not informed of a situation that involved her business, the safety of MANY kids, an angry parent on premise that warranted the cops being called, and 2 parents yelling and about to fight?

You’re not wanting to hear my complaints because you aren’t sure what happened 1 1/2 hours ago in your building?  And she refused to provide us service any more. They had already made that an easy decision when I removed my daughter from the premise during the “lock down” incident and told them not to expect us back.

I will be filing a formal complaint with Child Care Regulation through Texas H&HS.

My 5 and 8 year olds love the teachers here for the after school program. The all day summer camp for the 5 and up is absolutely amazing. They are so excited to go everyday as the Center always has some awesome activity or field trip planed

I've been here for over a year. My kids started in the infants and now in toddlers and the staff and management are wonderful. My boys have learned so much. My son has attended Kids Are Angels at Shaenfield since he was 8 months old. The staff is very loving and caring and treats my son as if he was their own. I had to make a last-minute switch for my kids due to issues at their old daycare. It wasn’t in my plans at all, but my kids kept begging me to move them to Big Dreams & Little Wonders because so many of their friends were there. I finally decided to try it—and I’m so glad I did. They been here a good min now, probably almost a year.

The difference in the vibe was immediate. Both daycares we’ve tried are Black-owned and run by older grandmother-type women, but this one *feels like home*. It truly gives “Granny/family” energy. They care for the kids the way family would, and my kids absolutely love it here. I love how they take the kids on field trips during the summertime. And the fact that they have transportation to and from the schools that makes my life so much easier.

We originally started at the Veterans Memorial location and had one little hiccup, but it was resolved quickly. Once we switched to Walters, Ms. Shanette made me feel completely comfortable leaving my children in her care. The center isn’t too big, so they can give every child the attention they need. I also love that they allow parents to come in and actually see what their kids are doing—not all daycares do that.

They are firm but loving, giving positive correction without ever being harsh. Honestly, they can get my kids to listen in ways even I can’t sometimes! They also **feed these kids GOOD**—real meals that feel like something your grandma would make. Not skimpy snacks or little nutrition-only meals, but food that’s good *to* them and good *for* them.

My kids are going through a phase right now, so they act out sometimes, but the staff at Walters are incredibly patient and know exactly how to redirect them. Anytime there’s an issue (which is rare), they address it immediately. Nothing gets brushed off.

This is a place I want my kids to stay long-term—a place I trust for them to learn, grow, and feel safe. They treat us like family. Today they had a Thanksgiving luncheon with amazing food, a beautiful setup, and even a photo station. It was so thoughtful and so well done.

Ms. Joanne is so sweet and soft spoken I love it ! I truly love this daycare, and my kids love it even more. Highly recommend!

Our son King has been attending Big Dreams & Lil Wonders Christian Academy for almost a month, and I’m truly impressed. The staff welcomes him with so much love and positivity every morning. I’ve noticed improvements in his communication, independence, and social skills already. They keep me updated throughout the day, and I appreciate how intentional they are with learning activities and structure. I’m grateful to have found a daycare that feels like family.

The got my little guy who hates to get up in the morning and hates to leave home to get up and be excited about going to daycare. He truly enjoys himself. I personally love the interactions I've witnessed the staff have with my family and the other families. They show their appreciation for their community  and their patrons. I would highly recommend Big Dreams & Lil Wonders to anyone looking for somewhere/someone trustworthy of taking care of your little ones.

I spent a few days looking around for a place to send my little one to , as soon as I discovered big dreams and lil wonders I knew it would be the place for our family. I was so appreciative at the fact they had everything up to date online so it wasn’t hard to find anything , they had videos on Facebook and instagram so I could watch previews of what to look forward to for my little one!!  What stood out to me the most was the hands on learning they provide , the quality of child care and work they put into each child. The field trips and new activities your child would experience day to day!

She comes home excited full of smiles and a full tummy telling me about her day and what she’s learned it takes a village , and I am so grateful and blessed to have big dreams and lil wonders apart of ours 🧡 I highly recommend this place for any parents looking for a good school/child care! They’re in greaaaaaaat hands!!

My daughter really enjoys this daycare. She doesn’t cry when I take her there and she enjoys it. Mrs. Davis and Mrs. Shanette always keep me up to date and respond accordingly with any concerns.

Jennifer Argueta

Child’s Day is consistently the worst part of my day. Not only is it far more expensive than nearly every childcare center in a 50+ mile radius, but the experience has not been positive. We were referred by colleagues, as the center is well known within attorney circles. Unfortunately, our experience suggests a culture of manufactured exclusivity and performative elitism. Rather than functioning as a program designed to support families, it presents itself as something parents must prove themselves worthy of.
There is a strong sense of conditional belonging—families appear to be evaluated rather than supported. The sheer number of rules, many of them unwritten, creates the impression that parents are accountable to the center, rather than the other way around. You would think they were paying us! In hindsight, the tone was clear even during the “interview” process, where we were asked why we chose our line of work. We are attorneys. Why they chose to work in childcare is far more relevant. The dynamic feels petty, judgmental, and elitist toward the very parents they are meant to serve.
If this is how parents are treated, it raises concerns about how children are treated as well. Thankfully, we have come up on the waitlist for another center and are looking forward to moving on from this experience.

I can not rave enough about how amazing my son’s experience at Child’s Day was. Miss Brianna & Miss Cindy in the Little Lambs classroom are truly amazing, one of a kind teachers. My son learned so much during our time here and was always excited to tell me what he did that day. This daycare is very focused on education and learning in a fun way that really engages the kids. There were so many fun activities for the kids like raising their own butterflies, visits from the firefighters, etc. and events for families to join. The kids learn a different letter and theme (such as community service) each week. We were very sad to leave as we moved back home but we’ll never forget how amazing this school was—it truly raised the bar and I don’t know if anywhere else will be able to compare!

A wonderful daycare. The teachers are very kind and loving, and proactive in planning activities to support the children's development. The children are organized into small classes with the same children and teachers everyday, which is a big plus for us. We have been so happy with our choice to send our children to Child's Day.

We’ve LOVED our experience with Childs Day! Our toddler just started his second year and we’re looking forward to sending our soon to be born second next year as well. They put the children together by age, and not within a whole year, but within months of each other so all the milestones and developments are aligned. We had such a tough time using nannys before we started here. I was very apprehensive initially using a daycare vs keeping our child home with a nanny, but truly he’s thrived and been so happy here! He’s become very social and the school does a wonderful job keeping us updated in real time daily with pictures, updates, naps, everything. It gives great peace of mind as a parent. We plan to use Childs Day for all our future children!

We were initially recommended to this daycare by several colleagues and friends who had sent their children here a few years ago and spoke positively about their experiences. That gave us confidence in choosing it for our own child. Unfortunately, our experience has been very different — and not in a good way.

We’ve felt a clear sense of prejudice during our time here, and I personally witnessed teachers ignore my child’s requests multiple times during pickup. It was disheartening to see that kind of inattentiveness, especially in front of a parent.

The facilities are extremely poor, and what alarmed us most was seeing children being transported in large plastic industrial bins — completely inappropriate and unsafe.

Over time, we’ve also heard more and more complaints from other parents, which echoes what we’ve experienced. For the cost, the care and quality simply do not add up. We would not recommend this daycare to others based on our experience.

I must say, Heather, is amazing! They whole crew there is magnificent! My daughter was going through something there and I wasn't able to take off of work and Heather was my little girls angel and saved the day!!!!

I can proudly say my son goes to daycare and leaves daycare with a huge smile on his face, which puts me at ease, because I know he feels safe. I would recommend to anyone!

Communication has been consistent and helpful, whether it’s updates throughout the day or addressing any questions we have as parents. The environment is clean, organized, and feels safe, which is so important to us.

We truly appreciate the love and attention they give to the kids every day.

I truly wish we had found Little Dreamers Preschool sooner! I stopped by one day on a whim almost in tears after my 4 year old autistic son was being kicked out of preschool for the 3rd time. I was transparent about his behavioral issues and was prepared for “sorry, we have no availability”. She was up front with me about her reservations and then I really thought, “this is definitely a NO”. Then she said “I’m just thinking about how we can make this work.” She didn’t give up on my family that day and the hope that she gave me just at that point was deserving enough of these 5 stars! Did my son have outbursts and have to be picked up multiple times, yes. Did I expect them to hand me his belongings and say "This will be his last day" countless times? Also, yes. That never happened though. By the time I got there he was calm or almost calm and they said, "We'll try again tomorrow" and "Tomorrow is going to be a better day".  My son has started school but in the 1st week told me he missed Ms. Kate because "she was so nice" and "she taught [him] rainbow breathing". He uses that technique to help him calm down now. He was invited back to Little Dreamers for breaks and counts down the days until he gets to go there. Ms. Kate has gone above and beyond to make my son feel included, safe, and loved. My anglerfish and birthday loving boy knows he is welcomed. My other son spent the summer at Little Dreamers and they were able to handle sibling rivalry better than me most days! I challenge anyone on the fence to read through the reviews, see through the obviously skewed ones like the vague ones with star that have no details or association with the center, and give Little Dreamers Preschool a try!

Extremely disappointed with the level of professionalism at this preschool. My daughter (now 18 months) has been going to creative care blalock since she was five months old. I hate that we have to change daycares since we moved totally across town. The staff is nothing short of amazing, the way they loved on my daughter always put my mind at ease when I dropped her off. They are amazing with making learning fun. My daughter has been attending CC Blalock since she was six months. It is her second home and she absolutely loves it there. We have been with Stepping Stones @ Southpark since 2023 and have loved everything about it! My kids both have had incredible teachers. Special shout out to Ms. Diane, Ms. Karen, Ms. Sharmin, Ms. Maria, and Ms. Fatima. I know my kids are having fun, learning a ton, and eating nutritious meals. Ms. Megan and all the staff truly care so much for all the kids and it shows.
