Stepping Stone at Southpark Meadows has been a fantastic daycare and provided an exceptional experience for my daughter and our family. The school is clean, food menu is diverse, and planned activities keep the kids busy all day, including a fun outdoor space. What really has made the experience special though are the teachers, specifically Ms. Charmaine, Ms. Angel, Ms. Jade, and Ms. Sabrina. The Salamanders and Geologists classrooms provide a warm atmosphere that made my daughter always excited for school. For anyone who has sent their child here, they also know that Ms. Megan is the glue that holds this entire center together and it is truly amazing how involved she is with the kids, classrooms, and families. Thank you SO much for all of your dedication and the love you bring with you all to work each day - it shows!

We absolutely love Stepping Stone School Southpark Meadows! Ms. Maria and Ms. Sharmin, in the Salamanders room, are fantastic teachers and are always looking out for our son. He loves them so much that we regularly find him in one of their laps when we pick him up! It truly makes our day when we get daily photos of the fun and educational activities he is participating in and the yummy foods he is eating. The school is clean and everyone is incredibly welcoming, especially the campus principal, Ms. Megan, and we couldn’t have asked for a better start for our little guy on his learning journey.

Our daughter has been attending this Stepping Stone School location since she was 10 months old. As we reach the end of our time ahead of Kinder in the Fall, I wanted to take an opportunity to commend the principal, Megan, and her staff for providing a space where my daughter has flourished.  I also appreciate the daily updates through the app for parents and ongoing communication from the school via email for other updates.

While no school will be perfect, I felt that my daughter was safe, loved and taken care of when I dropped her off each day. The friendships she forged with her peers are ones we hope to continue to foster after our time ends.

While we had some amazing teachers along the way, we want to call out Ms. Diane (baby room) and our most recent teachers, Ms. Marissa and Ms. April, for leaving a lasting impression for all of us.

If we do any Summer care once in school, Stepping Stone School will be on our list, and we'd highly recommend this location for child care to anyone seeking recommendations.

Have two small girls who have come up through Stepping Stone South Park Meadows (now 3.5 yo and 7mo).  I would be happy to recommend this location to any friend.  There will always be small issues, but nothing that is unique to this place as opposed to other daycare centers.

The current principle, Megan, is amazing.  We had a few issues under previous principals, and Megan has fixed every last issue.  She communicates very well regarding your children and encourages her team to do so as well.

My youngest daughter (7 months) is now in the baby room with Ms. Laura, she is the best! My daughter has some special feeding requirements and Ms. Laura and her team took these needs head on.  She has knocked my expectations out of the park.

review_text: Our daughter has been at St. Paul since she was 1.5 years old and will soon be leaving for Pre-K 4. OPERATION_NAME: St. Paul's Lutheran Child Development Center
review_text:
Me and my husband were eager for our daughter to start. As the start date approached, there was a lack of communication. The day before her start date a discussion came up about earrings. This discussion did not get brought up in previous conversations nor did I think it was even a concern. The director stated, “if your child wears earrings, she can not come to our daycare”. My response was “you are telling  me this the day before admission”.
Directors response, “that’s why you should have read our handbook and asked questions”. Their handbook states this

Jewelry: the small size of children's jewelry
accessories can be a potential choking hazard.
Rings, bracelets, necklaces, and any pendants
would be considered unsafe if they broke or
became separated from your child. We cannot be responsible for broken or lost jewelry that accompanies your child to school. We will not replace them.
We use an empty 35 mm film container to
determine whether an object can be
swallowed. You can do the same at home.
We will be glad to check your item for
safety. A choke tube will be available in the
office to test any object that might be
questionable.

No where does it state earrings or that my child cannot attend if she wears them. Me and the director ended the conversation with that me and my family would discuss if our child would proceed with enrollment. We never received another phone call again after being on a waitlist for about 3 months. Lack of professionalism and director never was available. Each time I called the director was the only one who could answer questions. If director never seems to be there she should give her responsibilities to others to handle. I’m glad we didn’t proceed with enrollment.

We absolutely adore Garden Blossom Preschool. We've been at the school since day one and the teachers have been professional, loving, creative and kind. It's hard to put into words just how special Garden Blossom Preschool is to us. We were lucky enough to find them when our son turned 2, and he's about to start his 3rd year here!

Garden Blossom is such a special place! The staff creates a safe and nurturing environment for the kids, with their days full of play, creative projects and nature-based activities. My daughter loves going to school and adores her teachers. Thank you, Garden Blossom!

The traditional service I attended was well spoken and earnest. The congregation was helpful and patient.

Our son has been at WMDS for two years and we have loved the experience. The teachers are wonderful and engaged, and truly love the kids. Incredible play-based preschool. This is our third year at WMDS and absolutely love it. The teachers and staff are caring and supportive. My daughters have grown so much there. They love their teachers and friends.

They are amazing. We take our 2 year old here and he absolutely loves it. The teachers are very sweet and always communicate how your kid is doing in class. They also do family events so you can go and see your kid in class in action.

We have had a great experience at Westbury Methodist Day School for many years. I have 3 kids who have all attended for preschool; my youngest is just starting in the twos class. There are not enough glowing words to describe how much we love this school.  We came in as a new family to the 4s Monkey Class this year after moving to the area. We’ve had a wonderful experience with Armenta’s ECD Blackhawk. The entire staff is warm, caring, and truly invested in the children’s well-being. The best, My daughter loves this place!! The staff is amazing, informative loving and caring. They always communicate and are transparent about everything. Absolutely love the service and care we have received at Armenta’s ECD Blackhawk. The facility is well kept and you are always greeted with a welcoming face upon arrival. The environment is clean, structured, and nurturing, and we feel completely comfortable and confident leaving our child in their care every day. Highly recommend to any parent in the Copperfield area!

This by far is a lovely school! All three of my children love this school. It teaches them manners and how to be more independent the Montessori way. Staff is super friendly and trained and the facility is very clean. Love Ms. Carol the director is very polite and professional! Love Ms. Amanda, Ms. Barbara, Ms. Suriya, Ms. Antonette, and Ms. Carrington  they have really helped to comfort and develop my kids to be disciplined and polite. Thanks again for the positive experience!

Our 3-year-old daughter has been attending West Montessori of Copperfield since the toddler class and is now in the primary program. We feel incredibly fortunate to have found this school.

The entire staff is caring, well-organized, and provides excellent structure--both academically and socially. We've seen significant growth in our daughter's development since she started.

Our youngest recently joined the toddler class in November, and we're excited for her journey at the school as well.

The administration is highly organized, communicates regularly with parents, and does an outstanding job maintaining a positive and structured environment.

We're truly grateful to be part of this school community and would highly recommend it to other families.

My daughter started at this school when she was 18 months old. After touring a few options, we chose this school based on the flexible program offerings, unlimited camera access, and very warm environment & staff. Four years later, we are still very happy with our decision, and also recently enrolled our second child. Watching our daughter grow here has been an invaluable experience. We are so impressed with the academic skills she is building in the primary class. I also appreciate the exposure she gets from the different extracurricular activities available at the school. It's not easy leaving your children with people, so we are fortunate to have found trustworthy care here. Our daughter regularly tells us that she loves her teachers (Ms. Surraiya & Barbara).

West Montessori of Copperfield is a warm, well-run school with caring teachers who truly know their students. The Montessori approach is done right here - kids are encouraged to be independent, curious, and confident. You can feel the calm, supportive vibe the moment you walk in.
The school offers a wonderful variety of enrichment activities alongside its strong academic program. Kids can explore Kids Yoga, ballet, culinary classes, soccer, and Spanish, which gives them the chance to discover new interests and build confidence beyond the classroom. It is a great environment for well-rounded growth and curiosity.

My daughter absolutely loves the school. The teachers are awesome! The WHOLE staff is amazing. You can honestly tell that they care about the children and their education. I love that they really try to get the families involved.
My son attended for pre-k3. He loved going to school everyday.
I love it here my Daughter loves it I have no worries or concerns the Teachers are Amazing 🙏🏿

We’ve had a wonderful experience so far with this school. The staff are incredibly caring and welcoming, and you can truly feel the positive environment as soon as you walk in.
Ms. Ruby is absolutely amazing. After just one day, our son wouldn’t stop talking about her, which really speaks to the connection she made with him right away. That kind of warmth and genuine care means everything to us as parents.
The curriculum is fantastic — thoughtful, engaging, and clearly designed with intention. We also really appreciate the regular updates through the app, which give us so much peace of mind throughout the day.
The director, Ms. Tami, has been incredibly responsive and helpful from the very beginning. Communication overall has been excellent, and we always feel heard and supported.
If we lived closer and it were a bit more affordable for our family, this school would truly be God-sent. We’re very grateful for the experience we’ve had here and highly recommend it!

We absolutely love this preschool. The teachers are exceptional—so caring, attentive, and truly dedicated to each child’s growth—and the leadership team is just as impressive. You can feel how well the school is run the moment you walk in. We are incredibly thankful we found this place. While we wish we could have started sooner, we are so grateful to be here now and couldn’t be happier with our experience. Highly recommend to any family looking for a nurturing and supportive environment.

We have two kiddos at this location. My wife and I couldn't be more satisfied with the service they provide. The whole team works well together and that translates to the overall environment of the Center.

Our little boy has made many friends in this KinderCare. He actually looks forward to going to school. Yes, I say school and not just a daycare. They have a structure that's similar to an actual school which gives children a path to learn and grow while keeping it fun.

I think one of the best things that we really appreciate is that the Director and her team take communicating things to parents very seriously. For example, if some sort of sickness if going around the school, it is immediately reported via the KinderCare app and communicated to parents and caregivers.

Overall, this KinderCare is probably one of the best around Houston. We have our one 1 year old here now, and our 5 year old will be graduating soon from here. If you live around this area, I would highly suggest you check this place out and your kid(s) will thank you.

We have been a part of the Pinebrook KinderCare family since August 2021. We had transferred from another nearby provider after having a poor experience so our guards were up and the world was still struggling with COVID. We enrolled our 1 year old daughter with high hopes after a great tour. Since being there, our daughter has been provided amazing care by teachers who are invested in her growth.  We now have two children enrolled there with very different personalities and they are both thriving with the support of great teachers who go the extra mile. The Directors are knowledgeable and helpful as well. Pinebrook KinderCare is an important part of our village as we raise our kiddos.

This place is amazing. We have 2 kids here and recommend this school to all our friends in the area. I toured two other KinderCare facilities close to us and this one was by far the best option for our family. The teachers are open to feedback and the managers are always open to hearing feedback if there is something on our minds. They really really care. The hardest part of dropping my newborns off was not knowing that the teachers would love and take care of them the way I do. Nothing comes close to a mothers love, but they are a close second in my experience. My kids have developed so quickly and in many cases they helped lead the next stepping stone for us, examples like potty training, no pacifier, nap schedules, introducing foods. I have always considered us lucky to be part of the Pinebrook family.

Take a tour, you will be happy you did.

Daniel’s Academic Academy is run by one of the most passionate daycare providers I’ve ever met. My son has been under Ms. Taneka’s care since he was 12 weeks old and I followed her to Daniel’s Academic Academy so that my son could continue to thrive under her care. She’s taught my son so much over the years - from ABC’s in English, Spanish, and ASL; to counting by multiples; to reading - all by the time he was 3 years old.
Needless to say, I have been completely at ease regarding my son’s development under her watch. She is a God-fearing woman who also teaches the children to pray and love the Lord.
The before and after school care, as well as drop off and pick up services are an added bonus to the curriculum and values that the school instills into the children.
Looking for a great place for your child or children to attend Daniel's Academic Academy is the place to be. My children  have learned so academically  and spiritually.

This daycare should be called Guardian Angels because they have been such a blessing to my family. The director and staff love Christ and it shows through their dedication to these children’s growth. I will never forget the impact that they have left in my heart. 10 stars !

I wish I could give this daycare 10 stars. When you bring your child here, they make you feel like family. I am so blessed that god had our paths cross with every teacher I have met here. Love our teacher soo much! There are literally not enough words that describe how much we love Harvest! Our daughter has grown and learned so much there!

My daughter learned so much !

We absolutely loved Bright Stars Academy! Big shout out to Ms. Gwen and Ms. Mary! The entire staff was always so friendly and welcoming! We loved the structure this daycare gave my son, and Ms. Mary also worked with us to help prepare him for pre k, we are so thankful!

I truly can’t say enough good things about Bright Star. My son started when he was 9 months old and had never been away from me. It took some adjusting for him but his teachers were so patient and helpful. He will be 1 in a few weeks and now he’s always happy when I drop him off and pick him up. Everyone here is so friendly and they keep you updated on everything your child does throughout the day. Also, the facility is always clean!

Shout-out to the director, Ms. Gwen and to his teacher, Ms. Mary! My kiddo thanks you so much.

My son was one of the first children to attend and all I can say is thanks.  Gwen and Debra were always amazing.

We couldn't be happier with our experience at edQuisitive Montessori Stone Oak (Spanish Grove Academy). Our almost 4-year-old son has been attending for some time now, and the growth we've seen in him has been remarkable.

The bilingual program is exceptional. As a native Spanish speaker who works full-time, I wasn't able to provide enough Spanish exposure at home. The school has filled this gap beautifully. His vocabulary in both English and Spanish has expanded significantly, and his confidence and independence have grown tremendously.

The teaching staff deserves special recognition. Ms. Alicia, his main teacher, has created a nurturing environment where he thrives. Ms. Sara (Head of School), Ms. Dakota (Admin), and Ms. Eloisa (Office Manager) are always accessible and helpful. His substitute teachers, Ms. Eva, Ms. Elena, and Ms. Nicki, maintain the same high standard of care. When challenges arise, like potty accidents, they handle everything with patience and kindness, making sure he feels comfortable and supported.

Communication is excellent. The daily updates through their app keep us informed, and we can message the teachers and staff anytime. They're responsive and transparent about his day, which gives us tremendous peace of mind.

The Montessori approach here focuses on building independence and confidence, and we see the results every day. Our son genuinely enjoys going to school and interacting with the other children and staff. After an adjustment period of about a week or two, he settled into the routine and now looks forward to his days there.

If you're looking for a bilingual preschool with dedicated staff, strong communication, and a true commitment to child development, I highly recommend edQuisitive Montessori Stone Oak.
Awesome School!

It’s honestly a blessing to find a daycare that truly cares for your child like their own. When my child first started; between the multiple food allergies, severe eczema and potty training. They have handled every situation with love and grace. Now the new transition with starting school; Ahmed, Ms. Samira and staff have made pick up and drop off smooth and safe as well. I normally don’t leave reviews but I am just overwhelmed with gratitude over the years we have been with them. Thank you All!

I absolutely love this daycare! My daughter started when she was 3yrs old and the teachers there are good with getting them prepared for school. I was surprised at first when my daughter would have homework, but it was great because she was actually learning rather than playing all day, however they balanced the day out with many other fun activities too. Ms. Amirah and Ms. Leslie were awesome! Although I my daughter attends the afterschool program now that she is in school, this is still my go to for reliable childcare during the breaks. Staff is friendly and the facility is clean!

This daycare is great, very reasonable price and great staff.  I have 2 toddlers and a 9 year old and they are always well taking care of.  They have many activities through out the year that keeps the children engaged in learning and fun.  They teach them to count, colors, arts and crafts.  They have summer fun activities that my 9 year loves to attend. Im happy that my kids are happy here and they have fun going to a safe daycare.

Daycare is very clean and staff are very nice. My kids love to go to daycare everyday especially when  there is field trip, and price is very cheap than other daycares. review_text: You can do open gym here which is when you go into the gym and play basketball. If you aren’t a member you have to pay. There are sports but they’re recreational. So the best teams are not going to do good in competitive leagues. Also vending machines for food and drinks. So yeah. Four stars.

OPERATION_NAME: West Austin Youth Association  Developmental Mornings
review_text: They seem to have forgotten that what motivates kids is having fun. Lots of pressure and focus on mistakes rather than celebrating along the way. Our kid, and others we know who tried WAYA, wound up burned out and hating the sports they used to enjoy. Add on poor communication, late changes, and high prices. You can do better for your kids than WAYA.

OPERATION_NAME: West Austin Youth Association  Developmental Mornings
review_text: We have 4 kids from the ages of 15 down to 5 and for years (starting with U5 soccer) they have all been involved and continue to be involved with WAYA.  If you're looking for a true neighborhood setting in Central/West Austin for your kids to learn to play basketball, volleyball, soccer, flag football, etc then this is the place.  WAYA is great at instilling the love of sports/play in the kids that will positively impact them for the rest of their lives.  We couldn't be happier with the impact that WAYA has had on our family...

OPERATION_NAME: West Austin Youth Association  Developmental Mornings
review_text:
WAYA is a fantastic place for kids sports. They offer a wide array of options including soccer, basketball, volleyball, lacrosse, flag football and baseball. Kids as young as 4 years old can play and continue to play all the way through junior high school.

If you are looking to participate in youth sports in Austin, then definitely check out WAYA.

OPERATION_NAME: West Austin Youth Association  Developmental Mornings
review_text: As a mom with two children in WAYA recreational programs and a member of the board, I cannot say enough about the array of programs offered and the positive culture of the WAYA community. If you are in the central/west Austin area and looking for a positive, safe community environment for your children to participate in fun recreational activities while learning life long skills, WAYA is the place to go!

Your daycare search stops here, Temple is nothing short of amazing! Throughout the 4years we've been here, there has been a large core of familiar faces which provides a sense of family. I could write a novel with examples showing how much love and care they provide to the children in their care. They are proactive with your child's learning at all stages from baby sign language to learning the months and days of the week. Overall, Temple is a safe environment where children are loved and grow. My children are happy and love going here.

Our child has been at Temple for just over a year and we love it.  The teachers and staff are caring and know the names of all of the children, even if they haven't had them in their class.  Mrs. Gonzales greets the children each morning and gets them settled in with a great breakfast.  My daughter gets so excited to see her friends each morning, and sometimes it's hard to pull her away in the afternoons!  We have been very happy at Temple and have recruited our friends.

Our children have been at Temple for two years now, and we couldn't be happier.  They are actually excited to go to school and look forward to seeing their teachers.  They plan engaging activities and teach them how to get along with others.  It has been such a blessing to our family to see our children happy, safe, and loved.

We love Temple Days Daycare! My 1 year old daughter has only been going there since January and she already feels at home, loves her teachers, and has made friends! This is such a blessing to our little family since we moved from out of the area and we needed a place like this for her. My daughter is excited every day to "go to school" and could not be anymore thankful!

Our daughter has gone to Temple Days for the past 2 years and we just love this school The staff is engaged, involved and very loving to all the students. Temple has exceeded our expectations from allowing our daughter's OT to come in and work with her during the school day, to helping her catch up on her developmental milestones and to watching her grow and blossom into a healthy 2.5 year old who is now learning biblical truth. Definitely take a close look at this little hidden jewel!

We are so impressed with the care at Primrose KWP. Not only is the facility clean and inviting, but the curriculum is fantastic. The teachers and staff are incredibly attentive and provide detailed updates on my daughter's day, which I appreciate so much. Five stars for the amazing staff and the wonderful atmosphere they’ve created!

Primrose KWP is fantastic!! The staff is great, curriculum and schedules are awesome, they do a lot of fun activities too for families, to create a great culture. updated review: After sending both of our daughters to Mustard Seed Academy from 2019–2024, we made the difficult decision to leave. We have many wonderful memories there, and as I mentioned in my prior review, the teachers were absolutely amazing. I never had any concern about their love and care for our girls, and they truly made a lasting impact.

However, as a working mom, the constant changes became difficult to manage. For example, during Thanksgiving break we were informed without warning that the hours would change to 9–4. After major pushback from parents scrambling to adjust, the school revised the schedule—but still closed 30 minutes earlier than before. While that was more manageable, the lack of planning and communication was frustrating. Over time, these changes often felt reactive and not well thought out.

We ultimately moved our daughter to a different preschool where communication and leadership are much more consistent. At her current campus, the administration is visible every day—greeting parents, holding meetings to keep families informed, and being actively present for the children. By comparison, during our years at Mustard Seed, I had very little interaction with the administration, and I’m not sure my daughters even knew who they were.

That said, we truly miss the teachers, who were wonderful with our daughters every single day. Mustard Seed has many positives, and we are grateful for the foundation it gave our girls. I would simply caution parents to be mindful of how administrative decisions and communication might impact your child’s day-to-day care. A business has the right to make adjustments, but clear communication is key.

For the most part, the school is amazing and would highly recommend. In a time where Spanish is still being put down, I love that my child could a attend a school in one of his home languages and not feel othered.

My only two issues were the following:
- We had a bullying issue with other students, and I say bullying because it was consistent and repeated the whole school year. Nothing was really done about it. I tried to get my child not be around these other children, but he’s 5 and really wanted to be friends with them. He was verbally and physically hurt. It really is up to teachers and staff to keep the children safe and provide boundaries to be held. - The black mulch at the playground. It’s really the worst, it ruined shoes and my kiddo came home with stained skin and clothing. I’m not opposed to him being dirty with dirt, paint, etc., but the black from the mulch was another story.

Updated review: It’s important to note that this review is in no way a reflection of the teachers at MSA—they are truly exceptional. Every single one of them has loved and cared for all of my children with genuine warmth and dedication. If this review were based solely on their efforts, it would be five stars without hesitation.

However, after six years and sending all of my children through MSA, we made the difficult decision to leave unexpectedly due to ongoing issues with the owners of the establishment. The core problem lies in a consistent lack of transparency and an unwillingness to communicate effectively or collaborate with parents. Changes to hours, fees, and other important matters were often made without proper notice or explanation, leaving families in the dark.

One particularly concerning incident involved the discovery of lead at the school in February 2025. The way this was handled—without immediate and clear communication or transparency—was deeply disappointing and eroded our trust.

The MSA owners are very difficult to form relationships with, which makes it even harder to feel heard or supported when concerns arise. As a parent, open and honest communication is essential and non-negotiable, especially when it comes to my children’s wellbeing. I sincerely hope the owners begin to take feedback seriously and work toward creating a more transparent, communicative, and approachable environment for all families.

I now have a son who will be 18 months soon and this is the center I will be taking him!

I feel so blessed and happy to take my two kids to HKC. They have worked with me the entire time, very supportive, professional and understanding. My kids love 💕 their daycare and as a mother I’m so grateful for this!

Ms Emily, Ms Lenna, Ms Kristen,  Ms Angie, (Ms Jay, Ms Pat, Ms Arely’s my daughter’s teachers) and the rest of the teachers/staff.. you are amazing and you rock ladies 💪🏼 ! 💕 💐

This was the first daycare that my granddaughter went to. They treated her with open arms like one of their own. The staff was very polite and respectful...then we moved and now she's at the 2nd location still same careful and patient workers I just ❤️ Little Rascals Daycare.

This facility is amazing you can tell that the workers really care about the children. My nephew goes here and he is really advanced for his age he has learned so much just by being around the kids and learning from the staff. I would definitely recommend 10/10

That Daycare is Family Base ! The Owner Love the children's and Definitely Care about Their well Being,He Make sure the teachers does what they are paid to do,also He Makes sure they are Sanitizing,And Clean their Class Room Make sure they Get Their Meals..When they are there ,They are his Responsibility and he Does NOT Tolerate any Rude Talking,are any abuse.so Feel free to put your Children's or child there
My grandson attends Little Rascals since he was 5 months old and now turning 2, he loves it and so do we. He has learned a lot of new things and the center is always clean.

The teachers are amazing. My kids love going here. But...I accidentally paid $30 too much on tuition and when I asked for it back I was told it'd be credit for next month. Imagine going to WalMart paying over not getting change and being told it'd be credit for your next purchase. I paid cash it wouldn't have been hard to return the overage.

Love them! && your kids go into school already knowing there stuff! Took good care of my niece and my daughter. They were ahead of their class every year. They are thriving in 3rd and PK4 now. Just had a baby boy 5 months ago and he’s already there!

I love this daycare! My son is learning a lot and really becoming such a big boy. I see such great Progress and my son always has the biggest smile in the evening when I pick him up. I love the teachers and am glad we chose this friendly and caring center.

I love Gifted Minds Foundation.  It's not just a daycare, it's an educational institution.  The curriculum they have set up for the kids in the summer definitely keeps their minds sharp.  My granddaughter is definitely thriving rather quickly for her age.  She is always engaged and clean. I love it!
Best daycare ever. The owner and her staff which consists of family and friends are the most loving and caring people you’ll ever meet.
Love this daycare!! If I could use one word to describe it... AMAZING!!

OPERATION_NAME: Silver Star Academy at Cypress Creek
review_text: My son loves his teacher and the entire environment at this daycare. Every day he comes home excited about what he learned. The staff truly cares about the kids, and I can see how much he’s growing socially and academically. Highly recommend!

OPERATION_NAME: Silver Star Academy at Cypress Creek
review_text: The staff here are always so nice and friendly! They made us feel welcome from day one, especially when they were able to accept my daughter right away after her first daycare closed without any warning. I’m so grateful for how smoothly they made the transition. They even celebrated my baby on her 1st birthday, which meant so much to our family. I truly appreciate the love and care they show every day!

OPERATION_NAME: Silver Star Academy at Cypress Creek
review_text: Beautiful daycare with the most loving staff! They're very attentive with an excellent curriculum, perfect for any child!

OPERATION_NAME: Silver Star Academy at Cypress Creek
review_text: Silverstar Academy is wonderful! The teachers are kind, and the learning environment is exciting and well-planned. I highly recommend it!

OPERATION_NAME: Silver Star Academy at Cypress Creek
review_text: Friendly and professional staff who care about the children and their families.  Clean facility with a great curriculum.

I am SO grateful to have found Shelley and the Nicholson Center. Shelley is so on top of all aspects of the school and she is incredibly passionate and knowledgeable about early childhood development. My daughter has been going to Nicholson since she was 18 months old and I truly feel like she’s getting an incredible education there.  Every staff member is happy and enjoying their work… the environment is clean and organized and each day is filled with activities catered to the child’s age and interest. I would highly recommend to any fellow parents of young ones.

Nicholson is a very good school.... My kid really loved the school.
Ms Shelley always ensure quality to the parents. My son was there was
for six months and every single day he comes home with activity sheets and art work . They dont force the kids to do things. and they teach some practical life .. CLEANLINESS is always there and I loved that.
They only have school until  3pm ...If they extend the time till 6pm, it would be comfortable for working moms.... Overall its is a great school!

I have to share how wonderful this preschool has been for my family. Both of my children have gone here over the last 9 years. My youngest is starting her final year before kindergarten, and I’m emotional just thinking about leaving. Most of the staff has been there for years, the director/owner has a PhD in early childhood education, and the class sizes are small. My children have made the best of friends, love going to school, and have opportunities to grow with kind, gentle guidance that follows the latest research of how children develop best. I can’t recommend this school enough.

My 2 year old daughter has been at Nicholson for 5 months.  I am continually impressed and delighted by the quality of this preschool.  Everything that Miss Shelley and her teachers do is intentional, well-planned, and seems to have a strong basis in pedagogy.  The education is so sound, and yet, at the same time, it is a FUN school for my little girl!  The environment is cheery and welcoming, and the children get to participate in all sorts of imaginative and cooperative play.  In her classroom, which is for the littlest kids, there is a different activity in the sensory table every morning, and toys set out on the tables that often reflect the theme of the week.  My daughter loves the school, which is so telling.  The student to teacher ratio is lower than any other preschool I've seen in this area.  I can't say enough about Nicholson.  Bravo!

My daughter is a clingy child, very sweet, very loving, but has always been a bit wary of strangers. So trying to find a mother's day out program that would suit her personality as well as give me peace of mind was very difficult for me. Finally, after touring the Nicholson Early Childhood Education Center, I felt at ease. The director of the school is obviously at the top of her game as far as childhood development is concerned, she knows her stuff. They use positive affirmation and avoid negative disciplining techniques that I have seen in other schools. My daughter is in the youngest class, the owls, and she absolutely loves her teacher. She still cries when I drop her off, but she reaches for her teacher and stops as soon as I'm no longer in sight.

Whenever I pick her up, she is happy and almost always has at least one painting or art project to bring home. I also love that they provide a snack and hot lunches! It makes it so much easier for me than having to plan and pack a lunch on the days she goes. Right now she is on a 2 day schedule. I love that they let me choose which days she attends, and I was able to make it work for my part time work schedule.

I highly recommend this school. Of all the places I toured, and there were many, this was the only one that made me feel comfortable enough to leave my daughter here.. and I still feel that way several months into her attending!

OPERATION_NAME: Northwest Hills GMC Mother's Day Out Preschool
review_text: One of the best churches I have ever attended! Everyone is super friendly and will make you feel welcomed. As I have grown in my faith, NWHills has helped Shepherd that growth into something meaningful and lasting! Very humble, very tight knit membership. Tons of opportunities to volunteer and do ministry. I really love pur Sunday School where we learn about God's Word in a bible study. Pastor Barnes has done a wonderful job of leading us after Pastor Trawick retired. This church has so much to offer and I am so thankful that the Holy Spirit lead me to become a member here. It has been such a blessing and I look forward to sharing my life and experiences with this wonderful body of Christ!

OPERATION_NAME: Northwest Hills GMC Mother's Day Out Preschool
review_text: Every fall they put an awesome pumpkin patch ideal for taking photos of the family. We've been going every year for the past 10 years and have made it a family tradition. The people are really nice and the prices for the pumpkins are fair.

OPERATION_NAME: Northwest Hills GMC Mother's Day Out Preschool
review_text: When we first moved to San Antonio in 2017, we were so happy to find a place with the best pumpkin patch, we go every year and this year was extra special with our first born son! 🥰 We loved every moment!

OPERATION_NAME: Northwest Hills GMC Mother's Day Out Preschool
review_text: Absolutely had the best time going to the pumpkin patch with my sister. Had a good variety even if most pumpkins were taking. I found my perfect one and it was only $5.

OPERATION_NAME: Northwest Hills GMC Mother's Day Out Preschool
review_text: Pumpkin patch is so beautiful and they added tons more photo ops which is definitely what the people love. And the decorations are amazing ! This patch is so great, we went for the small pumpkins today to add to our collection , and they were so perfect and round , great for painting , they had many new shaped ones that look like flowers or stars to, but the pumpkins are such great shapes this year and so pretty! Prices are awesome to. My child loved it . We had a great experience and staff was so sweet and friendly. Them adding the antique truck just tops it all . Photos came out so great . will return next year.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We cannot say enough amazing things about Museum District San Jacinto Child Care Center. Our one-year-old daughter, has been attending since she was just 4 months old, and the growth we’ve seen in her development has been incredible.

Ms. Maci has truly changed our daughter’s life. Her care, attention, and intentional approach to early childhood development are unmatched. You can genuinely feel the love she has for the children, and it shows in how confident, curious, and happy she is every single day.

The entire staff is phenomenal—every teacher is loving, patient, and deeply invested in the children. The facility itself is always spotless, organized, and welcoming, which gave us peace of mind from day one.

This center is incredibly family-oriented. Ms. Maci, the director, is always thinking of creative, meaningful ways to engage the students and support families. Our daughter has learned so much here, and we are beyond grateful for the foundation this school is giving her.

This is absolutely a five-star institution. We love everything about it and highly recommend it to any family looking for a nurturing, high-quality childcare environment.

Our child has been in their care for since September and he has learned and grown so much with their wonderful staff especially ms Candace and ms Yamika.

The facility is new and very clean. There are lots of activities for going on daily with clear paths for growth and lesson plans on the windows of the classroom. They go above and beyond to tend to our child and the other children.

We also really enjoy the app they use, with photo updates multiple times a day. It’s also very easy for communication.

The facility is also very safe and secure with doorbells and cameras documenting who is around the building or at the door. We like that they have gates that act as a secondary fence along with the fences around all outdoor areas.

Its location is also extremely convenient located right off the Metro light rail red line. All the children also enjoy watching to train go by during the day including ours.

Highly rate this facility

I have had my two sons in this daycare since they were both infants. We have had the most amazing experience. We were scared to leave our first son as an infant but all of the staff made us feel very comfortable and they have all done a very good job. I definitely recommend this center for all of their hard work and love that they have for each child. We also enjoy all the fun Friday themes that they do as well as the events they put on for the parents to be able to come out and enjoy.

Our baby girl has been enrolled at the San Jacinto location for about a month now & we are so impressed with this daycare. Her teachers are very kind and responsive. We get picture and video updates of how she is doing throughout the day. The location is very clean and well kept. We are very happy with this daycare and the staff!

We want to give a special thank you to Amy, Jasmine, and Tasha for their amazing care and support for our daughter. Moving from North Carolina was a big change, but you made her feel right at home. We’re especially grateful for your help with her potty training and the love you’ve shown every day. We are forever thankful for all you do.

We would highly recommend this daycare to any parent looking for a safe, nurturing, and supportive environment where their child will truly be cared for like family.

My 5 year old has been here for two years and my infant has been taken care of here since she turned 2 months and will be 1 next month ! This is definitely where you want to bring your little ones. They genuinely get to know them , care about them , and teach them so much . With the baby , thanks to them keeping her on schedule, keeping her active , things are going so smoothly  with our daily routine, for us as parents and for them ! It feels good to be able to work, feeling at peace knowing you’re leaving your kids in good hands . They love their teachers/ caregivers so much , their faces lighten up when we drop them off in the mornings . I found this center because we wanted to start socializing our oldest, since she was a baby that was born during COVID. Best decision we ever made and the only place I can sincerely say I would ever trust with my children .

My daughter has been attending Creative Years for around two years. She loves it here. She’s excited to go everyday. I personally love the staff. They are all very friendly and caring and I feel like my daughter is in great hands. I also like that some extracurriculars are offered. My daughter has been doing a gymnastics class that comes in and it’s reasonable priced.  I’d recommend Creative Years to anyone needing a safe, fun place for their kids.

This is the best daycare center in the area, hands down. We have been going here for the past 5 years and its a bitter sweet goodbye now that my kids are in school.
The kids are always excited to go, they learn so much! (So surprised by my 3 year old hand writing!!) I love the parents involvement opportunities and the fun theme days they have.
Summer vacation I will 100% try to get back into this care center!
Financially the prices are amazing. Even when they had to raise prices, it was a very small amount
Extra sports - They hosted soccer shots and all stars Gymnastics and the kids joined ever time they could.

If you are looking for teachers who truly value and support your kids, then this is the place you need to be!

My child and our family had a wonderful experience with Creative Year. This daycare is not only affordable, but their professionalism and care are truly outstanding. I have friends who pay thousands for childcare and still deal with constant issues, but that was never the case here. Creative Year goes above and beyond what they charge.

We never had any problems, and even in the rare case of a small incident, the staff would immediately inform us. Every time I picked up my daughter, she was well-fed, clean, and most importantly, happy.

We’re incredibly grateful to the entire team for the love, support, and care they showed our daughter. She learned so much during her time here — thank you for everything!

We’re truly sad we had to move away, but when the time comes for another child, we would absolutely consider making the drive just to return to Creative Year. That’s how much we trust and value this place.

I have had nothing but absolutely wonderful experiences here! My daughter is in the pre k room and has been going since she was in the infant room. Front staff is wonderful and so are the teachers. She absolutely loves going to school every day. My oldest is school age and goes on days when there’s no school. He loves it also. Always talks about the fun things he does during the day. 10/10 stars!!!

We started at this daycare just a few weeks ago, and honestly, we’re already loving it. Our twins come home happy, clean, and calmer than ever — they actually sit and focus on activities now, which hasn’t happened in a while! Their teacher is amazing with them. And every morning starts with a smile from Adriana and Cassidy  they’re both so kind and always take the time to answer my questions and keep me updated. It really feels like family here, and we’re so grateful we found this place.

Cadence Academy has been absolutely wonderful for our daughter's development.  We've seen such positive growth in her since she started.  The staff are incredibly friendly and create a warm, welcoming environment.  What we appreciate most is their direct and consistent communication with us as parents through the various emails and during evening pickups.  They keep us informed of her progress and are always available to answer any questions.  We highly recommend Cadence Academy to any family looking for a nurturing and supportive preschool experience. We are new to daycare, so this is a good first experience.

This daycare has been a blessing for our family! The staff is kind, welcoming, and truly cares for the kids. Ms. Chris provides meals with love and is so accommodating for food allergies, which gives us great peace of mind. Ms. Ana makes learning fun and well-rounded, and under Ms. Cyndi’s and Ms. Dre’s leadership, the school is better than ever!

They are flexible yet thorough, especially when it comes to allergies, which is so important for us. The environment is family-friendly, Jesus-centered, and full of fun activities. Our children thrive here and are more than ready for kindergarten and elementary school! Highly recommend!

Cadence Academy has been a blessing to our family. We have tried a number of schools since 2018 and really only found two to be great - with Cadence being one. It is a school I have truly trusted with the growth, care and development of my two kids. Starting with young toddler-moving to pre-k and one now on to kindergarten, this school has given me peace of mind with both children. The teachers and staff have been so great in listening and addressing any concern we might have had. The teachers have become a huge part of everyday conversations and with recent change in management - there has been a greater incorporation of Christian values that has really stood out. I greatly appreciate every effort of this school and could not recommend it more.

Our kids have grown up at Cadence - from babies, toddlers, preschool, and even after school elementary. We are truly grateful to have found this school! The facility is secure, clean, and such a warm, friendly environment.  And they have taken care of our kids like they are their own. For example, Ms. Ana was our daughter’s preschool 4 teacher who helped her embrace her curious and energetic personality by giving her classroom jobs and keeping her busy while preparing her for Kindergarten. And now we are lucky our son also has the chance to learn from Ms. Ana too. He has been so excited he has the same sweet teacher as his sister, who is now getting him ready for elementary and still asks about how our daughter is doing in school. She truly cares and brings a lot of comfort to us as parents that our kids are in good hands. We love that our kids not only are learning but also enjoying being at Cadence with their teachers, friends, and all the staff!!!

OPERATION_NAME: Kids R Kids of Houston Heights
review_text:
We’ve had such a wonderful experience with this daycare. The facility is always clean, organized, and welcoming, which immediately gave us peace of mind. The staff is caring, attentive, and professional.

What stands out the most is the level of care and communication. I always feel informed about my kids day, and it’s clear they are in great hands. My children genuinely enjoy being there, which says everything. It’s a relief as a parent to know they’re in a positive environment.

I highly recommend this daycare to anyone looking for a safe, clean, and loving place for their kids.

OPERATION_NAME: Kids R Kids of Houston Heights
review_text: Love it here! Staff are so welcoming!

OPERATION_NAME: Kids R Kids of Houston Heights
review_text: I toured a few schools and very impressed with this  facility and the staff. The staff is so friendly and the classrooms  are so clean and organized. I will definitely consider enrolling my little one.

OPERATION_NAME: Kids R Kids of Houston Heights
review_text: NCI is NOT accepted, unlike other Kids ‘R’ Kids locations but the staff's friendly demeanor was noteworthy.

OPERATION_NAME: Kids R Kids of Houston Heights
review_text:
We’ve had a wonderful experience with this daycare. Our baby started at 6 months old and absolutely loves going—he lights up every morning when he sees his teachers.
The daycare is brand new, so everything is clean and very well organized. The staff is caring, attentive, and always keeps the babies engaged with fun activities. We also really appreciate the daily updates through the app, which give us great peace of mind.
Highly recommend, especially for first-time parents!

My first kid started here at 6months old and is almost 7 and still here now with her 2 younger siblings that both started as infants. I’ve never had issues with any staff or had anything bad happen to my kids throughout their time here. Sharon, the owner, is there almost everyday to receive my kids and is super friendly. All of the staff is friendly and they all really do care about the kids they care for. The owners have become like family to me and my babies which I really appreciate since I have to work to take care of them it gives me a lot of peace of mind knowing they are in good hands every day.

My kids have a lot of fun here and come home a lot of days with age appropriate papers (learning, coloring, etc.) that they worked on that day and the teachers go outside even when it’s hot outside with the kids letting them play under the entrance so I can say they are hands on and definitely don’t just let the kids sit there doing nothing all day.

Security here is top notch as well! The entrance is gated and there’s a lock on the door that requires a teacher to unlock to allow people in and out.

I picked this place years ago because it was the closest place to where I lived and now looking back I’m so glad it was them I chose and couldn’t imagine them anywhere else.

Would not recommend daycare. If your child have special circumstances. Please find a daycare that’s fully staffed to deal with your child. They spitefully terminated my services while I was in the process of getting help for my 3year old who is suffering from some behavioral issues.

10/29/2024

Sharon, this souped up half acknowledgment of yours is 8 months late which is very much not needed at this time. However, it does reflect the inattentive to the needs of the families that you care for at your facility. The lack of compassion and unwillingness was very much disheartening at that time but thankfully we have moved own and found a facility that truly cares for and is inclusive of all kids. Yet, 8 months later I still would not recommend this facility. Also to add, the owner operator of the facility was very well made aware of my child issues before accepting her into her facility and did not offer the “said resources” that was listed under another review. Again, if you’re looking for child care look beyond this facility. If you need assistance with recommendations.

Definitely a NO. My child had no developmental issues. At two years old, they left her in a crib, ALL DAY, and failed to change her dirty diaper. They complained to me for her playing in the poo in her diaper as she was left in a crib alone all day with no activities for enrichment.
This daycare has rude staff. They refuse to listen. They refuse to allow spot checks where I can drop in and visit/check on my child (event though the state allows). Don’t put your child here. There’s another daycare, not much further away at the same price that is actually good.

Very Very critical staff not willing to work with the parent of my Grandbaby. There should have been a discussion between parent and staff before child was totally Dismissed from Daycare. What kind of people are u all.i never seen such in my Entire life.  This should have been handled Better.i think that she Deserves another chance because it was done without the parent being present.

As a 1st time/stay at home mom for my daughter's first 6 months I was especially nervous about putting her in daycare, however I am so pleased. The director is professional and serious about the center. She is actively at the center daily for any questions or concerns and loves the kids. The teachers are also very kind. My daughter loves seeing the familiar faces in the morning and never has an issue with going with her teacher. My daughter was running a fever one day after her nap and I was called promptly to pick her up. They have a very strict but fair standard for sick children and closely abide by the standard. If you can appreciate a healthy environment for your child, you realize that the rules pertain to every child even if yours is the one who happens to be sick. This daycare also serves the purpose of convenience. If you live in the Cypress Station area it's very easily accessible and is always an in and out process. Another bonus is, compared to the price of other daycare centers in the area Kidz K'Nect takes the cake as well. I am very pleased with the service and quality provided with this daycare. Our apartment lease is up in a couple of months but my husband and I  have decided to commute further to work because we want are daughter at Kidz K'Nect. They have made the process especially easy and I can honestly say that I do not worry about the well being of my child while she's there.

We have loved being at Bezos. Our daughter has enjoyed her “big girl” school for almost two years now. We love their communication. The pictures they provided of her doing her work are always a nice update on what she is doing. The focus on multi cultural activities and learning, we absolutely love. She loves going and had very few tears in the beginning because she was excited to have fun and learn with all her friends. We have loved it! We are grateful for such a wonderful 1st school years experience.

We were very grateful when our child got a chance to go to Bezos Academy. They are so nice and respectful, so no complaints on anything. They teach my child things that they wouldn't teach at a normal school and it's better for our children to get those lessons. We love the school so much.
I extend my deepest gratitude to the founder of Bezos Academy (Jeffrey Bezos) providing such an enriching experience. The environment is exceptional, and the teachers are dedicated and patient.

Bezos Academy has exceeded my expectations from the start, and I have no complaints! The staff genuinely cares, and the children learn a great deal. I appreciate receiving pictures of my child engaged in various activities throughout the day.

A funny story: I discovered Bezos Academy by chance while dropping off my older son at school. I noticed a "Now Enrolling" banner for the Bezos North Dallas Campus and decided to inquire. I'm so glad I did! Before attending Bezos, my child was in an expensive daycare. The School Director informed me that Bezos is tuition-free and follows a Montessori curriculum, which convinced me to enroll my child. I'm incredibly grateful for the support and opportunities that Bezos has provided.

We’re thrilled that our child has the opportunity to attend Bezos Academy! So far, we’ve been very happy with the experience and love the social skills and interactions he’s developing within the academy community. The teacher keeps us updated frequently with messages and photos about his time there. We’ll share more details about his progress and growth at the end of the term.

We absolutely love this school! Both of our daughters have been here, and it’s been such a positive experience for our whole family. Director Mr. Timothy is amazing — so caring, professional, and really makes the school feel safe and welcoming.
Our girls’ teachers — Ms. Bhargavi, Ms. Vijiya, and Ms. Makeisha — are just incredible. They’re so patient, attentive, and always come up with fun activities that the kids actually love. You can tell they really care about each child’s growth and happiness.
We also really appreciate that the school has security cameras, so you can check in and see what’s going on anytime — it’s a huge peace of mind. Plus, the school has very few holidays, which is great for working parents.
We’re so happy with this school and would highly recommend it to any family looking for a safe, fun, and caring environment for their kids!

I removed my daughter from a good daycare so she can be close to my work. At first it was all about the convenience. Honestly my expectations were low because I thought I had it good at the former daycare. Imagine my SURPRISE, 3 days into our attendance I can’t STOP myself from singing their PRAISES every time we get home and to my colleagues, I find myself telling my husband how great My Small Wonders 318 truly is, who knew we were moving to an even GREATER PLACE. Truly exceptional staff and great leaders, Director Timothy is always around helping both parents and kids, supporting the staff and making the environment feel safe and full of love. Ms. Maria our home room teacher is very good with the kids. If you are looking for a place that not just keeps your children but teaches them to be more opened, participate in activities and be school ready, LOOK NO FURTHER. This is it. Thank you My Small Wonders 318 Dallas.

Ms. Andrea is an amazing teacher. One of the reasons we stayed at My Small Wonders was strictly because of her, the dedication she has to prepping the children for real school is outstanding. We are truly grateful for her ♥️ she's a gem.

I scheduled a visit here before and the facility was nice. We stepped inside a lady class and the kids called her Miss Tyesha but she seemed very patient. Really thinking about enrolling my son there as I do need the care but I would like for him to be in her class. She was the only teacher that seemed nice and happy. I mean even the director that did my tour was a little off the edge to me. She was rushing and overall lacked no agenda during our intake interview for she asked me no questions about my son. The only thing I'm concerned about though that scares me is the staff. If only 1 teacher was happy, I'm a little concerned for the staff and how they are managed overall.

I can't say enough about how much my husband and I appreciate Rosewood Academy! When our little girl had to attend day care, it was the HARDEST day of my life. The director, staff and teachers were so supportive! They made me feel very comfortable visiting the day care in advance of her first day and have an open door policy. They even hugged me when I cried dropping her off. While I think going back to work was difficult, I feel very strongly that the folks at Rosewood made it as easy as possible for our family. My daughter has been attending Rosewood for about six weeks now and she seems really love it.  She LOVES her teachers (Ms. DD in infant room 3 is the absolute best) and has a big smile every day when she sees them. Being a first time parent, her teachers very supportive and helpful. Her development is advanced; we are often surprised at what she learns each day.

I never write online reviews but I know how hard it is to find a daycare you can trust as a working parent. I would highly recommend Rosewood to any parents out there!

OPERATION_NAME: Cielito Lindo Spanish Immersion Preschool II
review_text:
We have been part of the Cielito community for over two years and couldn’t be more thankful. The staff is incredible, and Ms. Mari works tirelessly to ensure the children receive the best education. My son loves going to school, and the consistency in staff is something we deeply value—many of the same teachers who cared for him as a baby are still with him today. I’ve also noticed that many students stay through preschool, which has allowed my son to form close, lasting friendships.

Our son especially loves the music program, Musica Libre, led by Ms. Karen, and he adores all of his teachers.

The staff genuinely cares for the children and consistently goes above and beyond, whether it’s through hosting wonderful community events or tailoring their care to meet each child’s needs. As a parent, it’s so reassuring to see how invested they are in our son’s well-being. For instance, my son struggles with sleep, and his teachers have been incredibly supportive in working with us to address it.

As parents who work in schools, we are especially appreciative of the exceptional care and support provided to our son every day. Thank you for all that you do!

OPERATION_NAME: Cielito Lindo Spanish Immersion Preschool II
review_text:
We had our little here for almost a year (9 months to 17 months).  I cannot say enough great things about this Preschool!

All his teachers were loving, kind and super communicative! Everything you want in a school. They also did so many wonderful activities with the young children. That said, Challenger may not be the right fit for every child—it’s not a school that focuses heavily on emotional expression or creativity. However, if you're looking for a place that emphasizes traditional values, discipline, and a strong academic foundation, Challenger is the perfect choice. The curriculum is advanced, covering everything from good penmanship at a young age to public speaking. It’s wonderful for gifted learners.

What sets Challenger apart is how it teaches children accountability, discipline, and excellence while still offering fun activities like cooking classes, Spanish lessons, and chess club. My daughter attended Challenger from kindergarten through the first half of second grade (we've since moved out of state and haven't been able to find anything comparable). Edited, 1/2/16

My son adored this school. It was everything to him, and the administrators and teachers knew that. He is EXCEPTIONALLY bright, but they didn’t accept him back for 1st grade. We asked for better communication because often we would find out days after he misbehaved that there was an issue.  At that point it was hard for me to address misbehavior with my son when he acted out so long ago.  We were told we would get weekly communication from the teachers (via calls or notes because teachers can't have email like most schools), and we didn't get any communication after the first week.  I called Ms. Molly, the director, after my son came home very upset one day, and I also mentioned I wasn't receiving the feedback we had asked for previously.  After that parent/teacher/director meeting, we finally started receiving weekly communication about his behavior.  After our experience with my oldest son, we chose not to put our middle child at Challenger.

My oldest is now thriving and in not only an academically wonderful school, but also a loving, caring, and globally focuses school.  He left kinder on a second grade reading level.  He has not had any of the behavioral "issues" that Challenger seemed to think he had (he never had them prior to his second year at Challenger either)

If all you care about is that your child can read early, this is the place for you.  If you care about education and your child's social/emotional development, this may not be the right choice for you.

I’d like to note our experience was very positive up until my child was moved to the Leopardos Classroom.

My child attended this school shortly after turning one. He began in the Pericos class and later moved to Conejos when he turned two. After about six months, he was moved up again to Leopardos without my knowledge or consent. I only discovered this on my own, as the director, Claudia Ponce, failed to inform me. I felt this transition happened far too soon.

My child had a “meet the teacher” in August 2025 and I was very excited about his class. By September 4, 2025, he had already been moved. Shortly after, I was told he was having difficulty staying seated and wanted to run around, which was attributed to the larger classroom environment. I was then advised by Claudia Ponce to have him evaluated by a doctor due to behavioral concerns.

On September 15, 2025, I took my child to his primary doctor, who had no concerns regarding autism or any behavioral diagnosis. I relayed this information to the director, Claudia Ponce, who thanked me for being proactive. A few weeks later, I was told his behavior had improved, and I believed he was adjusting.

Fast forward to January we brought in a therapist to help support my child’s classroom skills. It was during this time that I began to realize my child’s behavior at school did not reflect how he behaves at home. My husband and I observed the classroom and did not see anything alarming from my child. He did move from centers a few times, but he is two years old, and developmentally, children this age are only capable of sitting for very short periods(2 years old=2 minutes sitting). I was concerned that expectations were not age-appropriate.

The incident reports started to become increasingly consistent. Each time, I asked to understand what led up to the behavior, I was only shown the incident itself, never the moments before or after.

On the most recent incident(02/06/26) , I requested to see five minutes before and after the event for context. Shortly after, I received a call from the director stating that my request made the teachers anxious, unsure why that was if they were doing everything correctly. I was told the environment was “no longer educational” and that we needed to discuss my child’s future at the school.

Despite me telling Claudia Ponce about wanting to move my child to a setting with more structure/support and less kids, I was told he needed less structure and should attend a home daycare. Comments were made such as “the structure overwhelms him” and “teacher burnout is a real thing.” Additionally, sensitive incidents were discussed openly in the lobby (on 02/05/26) despite my prior request for privacy during our first interaction.

At one point, I was shown a video of my child screaming. When I stated that “he knows what he is doing”, I was told by Claudia Ponce, “I don’t think he does.” This was deeply concerning. Toddlers communicate through behavior, especially when overwhelmed, or being recorded with a large ipad. They are unable to express themselves verbally. I also observed staff removing an item from my child’s hands without giving him any feedback and then threw it on the table, instantly after this my child acted out. If there was appropriate redirection this may have not happened.

OPERATION_NAME: Open Door Preschool at M Station
review_text:
Both of my children, now 9 and 7, started at Open Door as infants and stayed until they graduated to kindergarten. Entrusting your baby to a childcare facility is one of the most vulnerable moments as a parent -- you just hope and pray that your child will be loved, protected, and truly seen for who they are. Open Door delivered that and so much more.

The teachers and staff are not just caregivers; they are a true community. Every child is celebrated. Babies are always held, toddlers come home covered in glitter and joy, and older kids are encouraged to explore, express, and grow. My children thrived there, not just academically but emotionally and socially.

What makes Open Door so special is that it feels like a family. The teachers know your kids deeply, they cheer for their milestones, and they nurture them through challenges. Even years later, my kids still light up when we talk about their time there and have lasting friendships that stemmed from Open Door.

If you're looking for a preschool where your child will be loved, valued, and embraced for who they are, Open Door is truly one of a kind and one of the true gifts of my life.

OPERATION_NAME: Open Door Preschool at M Station
review_text: Our son has been in Open Door for over a year now and we could not be happier. He started at another preschool before this and we were thrilled when a spot opened up for him here! It is his home away from home. We have recommended them to friends and family and love growing the community of ODP! The teachers and curriculum are the gold standard and it’s evident immediately how much they invest in their staff and the children they serve. Since starting at this location we’ve moved further away and will happily continue to commute here all the way to kindergarten. Our next baby will start here in the new year and we feel great just knowing he already has a wonderful place waiting for him when it’s time. Highly recommend!

OPERATION_NAME: Open Door Preschool at M Station
review_text: Both of my children attend the daycare, and the support we've received—especially for my son, who has severe allergies—has been incredible. The teachers and the current school director, Christal, have gone above and beyond to accommodate his needs. I often spend time nursing my youngest in the baby room, and during those visits, I witness firsthand the dedication and hard work of the longtime teachers. They not only care deeply for the children but also take the time to mentor and guide newer staff. The team is also very open to feedback and genuinely committed to making improvements for the benefit of all the children. Over the years, we’ve built lasting relationships and genuine friendships with other families through the school, making it feel like a true community.

OPERATION_NAME: Open Door Preschool at M Station
review_text: I had many concerns when starting, just like any first-time mom, but the Director and baby room teacher were amazing at answering all our questions and working with us to ensure day one went well.  Years later, every teacher she has had has been nothing short of amazing. They send pictures throughout the day, let me know when they notice something is off, and welcome me to be involved in activities.  I did not want my child to be another number at a crowded chain, but I did not want a setting that only focused on preparing them to sit all day and take tests.  They are the perfect balance of learning while playing for our family, and everyone there has quickly become part of the much-needed “village” that it takes to be a full-time working mom.

Choosing a preschool for your child is a decision filled with hopes and expectations, and for us, Joy Park Montessori School has not only met but far exceeded our expectations. From the moment we first stepped through their doors, we've been consistently impressed, and our child's journey there has been nothing short of transformative.
One of the most striking aspects of Joy Park Montessori is the incredible team of educators. We cannot emphasize enough how kind and loving the teachers are. They possess an almost magical ability to connect with each child, understanding their individual needs and fostering a genuinely nurturing environment. It's clear that teaching for them isn't just a job; it's a passion. Every morning, our child is greeted with warm smiles and genuine enthusiasm, which immediately sets a positive tone for the day. This consistent display of affection and patience has made our child feel secure and cherished, creating a strong foundation for learning and exploration.

The most profound testament to Joy Park Montessori's excellence is the remarkable way our child has grown so confidently. When our child first started, while curious, there was a natural hesitancy that many young children exhibit. Now, we witness a blossoming individual who approaches new challenges with an impressive sense of self-assurance and an eagerness to learn. This confidence is evident in their interactions with peers and adults, their willingness to try new activities (dance class, Karate and Soccer, just to name a few of the after school activities) and their articulate expression of thoughts and ideas.

Beyond the emotional and social development, Joy Park Montessori offers an exceptional academic advantage, particularly in their unique bilingual program. We are absolutely thrilled that our child has gained bilingual skills in Chinese and English. The seamless integration of both languages into the daily curriculum is truly remarkable. The teachers, many of whom are native speakers, introduce concepts and engage in conversations in both languages, making the learning process feel natural and organic rather than forced. Our child now effortlessly switches between languages, understands instructions, and even initiates conversations in both Chinese and English.

In conclusion, Joy Park Montessori School is more than just a preschool; it's a vibrant community where children thrive. The combination of incredibly kind and loving teachers, an environment that fosters immense confidence, and the unique advantage of bilingual education in Chinese and English makes it a remarkable choice. We recommend Joy Park Montessori to any family seeking a truly exceptional early childhood experience for their child. Our child's growth and happiness are the clearest indicators of the extraordinary care and education they receive every single day.

What truly stands out about JoyPark is how well they balance loving care with meaningful learning. I am writing this review because Google reviews played a major role in helping me choose a daycare for my child, and I want to share my experience to help other parents make informed decisions. I selected Gifted and Talented Kids Academy based on their 5-star rating. After reading the reviews, I was eager to visit, and I went the very same day. The staff member I met was warm and welcoming, and I initially felt confident that this would be a great fit for my child.

Unfortunately, my experience was disappointing from the very first day.

I received a call from my child’s school informing me that she had not been picked up—even though I had called the daycare that morning to confirm. This happened twice, with no phone call or notification from the daycare either time. On another occasion, I was standing in the daycare when a parent arrived, only to be casually told by a staff member, “Oh, the school said they are no longer a daycare rider.” There was no urgency or concern shown. The parent had to immediately leave to find their child.

My child also reported being bullied on the daycare van. When I brought this to the staff’s attention, I was told, “They all do the same thing,” instead of seeing the issue addressed.

It became clear very quickly that this was not the right environment for my child, and I could not wait to switch daycares. Thankfully, we have since found a facility that genuinely cares about the children and communicates responsibly. We are much happier with our new choice.

I don’t usually write reviews, but I felt compelled to share my experience so that other parents can make the best possible decision for their families.

It breaks my heart to have to take my kids out of Mercy’s Playhouse, but it was time for my older boys to move on to school. Because of the love, patience, and structure they received here, they were fully prepared and are thriving in their new school environment today.

I will always be thankful for Mrs. Mercy and her wonderful team. This is more than a daycare, it’s a safe haven filled with love and learning.
