Funny enough, my parents told me that I went to Country Home as a child in San Antonio many years ago so I guess its only tradition for my child to go here. Long story short, they know what they are doing and we are glad we have had our child at Country Home

Choosing a daycare is always nerve-wracking, but Country Home Learning Center has been a total blessing! The teachers are absolutely great and actually take the time to share ‘win’ stories about the children’s day! The daily updates and photos give parents such peace of mind while at work, never have to wonder how my little one is doing. The campus is absolutely amazing, from the Hall Art, to the Indoor playground, and let’s not forget about the Waterpark during the hot summer days! Country Home Learning Center has truly been a blessing to us all!

We are so grateful for this daycare and the incredible care they provide for our toddler. From day one, the staff made both us and our little one feel comfortable and welcome. It's never easy leaving your child, but knowing they are in such loving and capable hands gives us complete peace of mind. The teachers are patient, nurturing, and truly attentive to each child's individual needs. They take the time to understand our toddler's personality, routines, and preferences, which has helped with a smooth transition. We love receiving updates and photos throughout the day, it's reassuring to see how much fun they're having!
The environment is clean, safe, and full of engaging activities that encourage learning and development. We've seen so much growth in our toddler's communication skills, confidence, and social interactions since starting here. We couldn't ask for more and highly recommend this daycare to any parents looking for a caring, trustworthy place for their toddler.

My son has attended Country Home Learning Center in Southwest Austin for 4 wonderful years, and my daughter for almost 1 year. The staff at Country Home provide an engaging, loving and fun environment for children every single day. The facilities are incredible with multiple different age appropriate playgrounds, an indoor playground for inclement weather, a water park for older children in the summer, a soda shop for cooking, theater arts room, STEM lab and the halls are lined with adorable artwork and photos of the children. They offer fairly priced tuition, flexible hours, lunch is included in tuition and we look forward to utilizing their after school bus program and summer camps when our son goes to kindergarten. Most importantly, the staff and teachers genuinely care about each child, Every teacher knows student of all ages by name, they teach the children how to manage big feelings and truly love the kids. The management has also worked with us when we’ve had concerns. Developmentally, I feel that my children are learning so much and will be more than prepared for elementary school. My son regularly tells me how much he loves his school and he’s excited to go every morning. We love Country Home and will be sad when we have to leave someday!

Victoria is probably one of the best teachers In that establishment. She is so good with the kids. You can tell she is truly passionate about children and isn’t just there for a paycheck. I’ve seen a lot of teachers come and go at this care center and most of them I couldn’t even be bothered to remember their names. Victoria has even watched my child outside of the daycare and she is loved so much by our family! You can fully trust Victoria to treat your child like her own.

Our son has been thriving at Northaven Coop Preschool. There is such a strong sense of community and everyone has been very welcoming to our family. This is his first time attending school and he immediately settled in and began making new friends.

As a parent, the coop aspect is a huge plus. I’ve enjoyed getting to know his classmates and experiencing what a typical day at school is like. Northaven Coop has exceeded our expectations and we would recommend it to anyone looking for a preschool.

My child who has autism and I were completely ostracized at the tour, Vickie knew ahead of time about my child’s diagnosis and could have told me it wouldn’t be a good fit but instead made me go through an agonizing and judgmental 15 minutes of why my child wasn’t going to be able to attend. The looks I received from her, & the absolute disregard of my feelings were something I’ve never received before. Saying these things through email would’ve been nice. I left in tears. If your child isn’t perfect, don’t try to go tour this place. It will absolutely break your spirit and all hope you had.
The sweetest school with the best teachers! Our son asks to go to school everyday :) we love the play based model and getting to co-op in the classroom is so special!

Both of my children have been blessed to attend this wonderful preschool. Not only are the teachers amazing, they truly care to make each day a new opportunity for growth through hands on, play based learning. I love the opportunity to be involved in our children’s day through the co-op. It is a special time we are able to watch our children explore and learn. I cannot say enough about our experience here and how it has helped shape the way our children learn, play, and prepare for their elementary education.

Our son is currently at Northaven Co-op. I cannot imagine a more loving and beautiful Pre-K school in Dallas. It amazes me to see his growth and love for school and learning. The amount of dedication and devotion that each teacher puts into their classrooms and students is remarkable!! The student to teacher ratio truly allows teachers to facilitate a healthy learning experience where each child can receive individualized attention and find success! I am blown away everyday with this amazing preschool and each one of the teachers that are so dedicated to their students and the families.

OPERATION_NAME: YMCA Tomorrow Academy at Four Points
review_text: We have been part of Tomorrow Academy since they opened in March, and we couldn't be happier with our experience. We loved our prior childcare center and were nervous about the transition. So glad we made the move, as our children, an infant and 3-year-old, have thrived in this nurturing environment.  The classrooms are clean and spacious and filled with natural light, creating a welcoming atmosphere for learning and play. There are plenty of toys and activities to keep the kids engaged and stimulated. Additionally, the meals and snacks they serve are of high quality and great variety, ensuring the children receive delicious and nutritious meals each day.   The teachers at Tomorrow Academy are truly exceptional. They are attentive, caring, and communicative, always going the extra mile to ensure each child feels supported and valued. Our 3-year-old has already learned so much and has become more independent with self-care tasks, thanks to their guidance.  The outdoor space is another highlight, offering a fun and safe area for the children to explore and play. It's clear that Tomorrow Academy is dedicated to providing a well-rounded and enriching experience for all its students.  We highly recommend Tomorrow Academy to any parents looking for a top-notch daycare for their little ones!

OPERATION_NAME: YMCA Tomorrow Academy at Four Points
review_text:
We absolutely love YMCA Tomorrow Academy-Four Points! Our daughter is loving it here and looks forward to school every day. The teachers and staff are so kind, patient, and genuinely dedicated to helping each child grow. You can tell they really care, not just about education, but about nurturing the whole child.

We also really appreciate the school’s approach and teaching methods, and we’re especially grateful for the way the staff partners with families to support each child's individual needs.

It’s such a thoughtful, supportive environment, and we couldn’t be happier with the care she’s receiving. Highly recommend!

OPERATION_NAME: YMCA Tomorrow Academy at Four Points

As a parent who has had two boys go through the program (third son will start next fall) I can without a doubt say this is the best school and most developmentally appropriate school around! Poe Co offers a unique educational experience for young children ages 3-5 years. Not only has this school been a staple in the community for over 50 years, it is the first parent cooperative in the country to receive (and maintain) accreditation by the National Association for the Education of Young Children (N.A.E.Y.C.). The teachers are caring and engaging of all children at all developmental levels.The school community is full of involved and dedicated parents who want to see their children and the school succeed. Poe Co is a child-centered program that aims to foster the love of learning through play! Poe Co offers every child a learning environment designed to foster creativity, confidence, and independence. This environment supports the developing child’s social, emotional, physical, and intellectual growth in a manner specific to the needs of each student. Children are encouraged to select their own activities, express themselves, and explore materials. I'm confident that all children can be successful at Poe Co, which the right involvement from their parents. 5 stars all around!

We couldn’t be happier with our experience at Poe Cooperative Nursery School. Like many parents, I was nervous about sending my child into a new environment. Handing them off to someone else felt overwhelming, but Poe made that transition feel less like a leap and more like joining a big, supportive family. Being welcomed into the classroom and getting to be an active participant in my child’s learning has been such a gift. Parent helper days are a highlight of our month. It’s such a joy to get to know all of the children and see how my child interacts with their friends and teachers in a new setting.

The teachers are warm, nurturing, and deeply engaged. This was my son's first time outside of our home and they were excellent at gently guiding him through a new environment. They somehow manage to balance calm structure with joyful chaos, and they treat each child like a whole person. The play-based curriculum encourages creativity, exploration, and a lot of wonderfully messy learning, which we absolutely love.

We also love the emphasis on outdoor time. The kids are outside climbing, running, digging, and trying to smuggle home their new pet bugs. It has been amazing for their energy, imagination, and general happiness, although our car has become a bit of a mobile nature preserve. The classroom garden has given my son a love of a fresh picked green bean, although I am not sure he left any to be harvested!

The sense of community at Poe is something truly special. Families genuinely get to know each other, and there is a shared feeling of we are in this together. We have loved all of the opportunities for us to engage either through family gatherings at the school, or the welcoming invitations to weekend meet ups and park play dates. We are incredibly grateful to be part of such a thoughtful, fun, and caring environment.

This year at Poe Co has been such a special experience for my 3-year-old son as well as for us as a whole family. The cooperative style, with the school run by the parents, develops a very strong, close-knit community. I am in the classroom with my son once a month or so, where I get to take part in his day and interact with him, his friends, and the teachers. We know every child in his class and have relationship with most of their families. The teachers are nurturing and engaged. Every week has a fun new theme. Overall, the play-based, largely outdoor curriculum has been a wonderful fit for our son. He has grown so much socially and absolutely loves to going to school. We can't imagine sending him anywhere else.

Poe Co is a wonderful place for young children to prepare for Pre-K. As someone new to Houston, I’m especially grateful for the sense of community I’ve found here. Not only is my daughter happy and thriving, but I also feel connected and supported as a parent. Poe Co has truly been a positive experience for our whole family.

I have a very high energy and stubborn son. He turned five in July but we didn’t feel he was socially mature enough to start kindergarten. I enrolled him at Poe Co instead because I was drawn to the play based model and parent involvement/community. While he has had ups and downs at school his teachers have been incredibly patient with him. If there is an issue they come up with an individual plan to help him overcome it. After a year of school here I have found that my son has learned how to express himself better through words instead of hitting/throwing. I attribute that to his teachers. I’m so grateful we delayed kindergarten a year and sent him to Poe Co. I feel very confident that he now has the tools to succeed in kindergarten this fall.

Where can I start, staff is very attentive to the little ones & parents, my little one has started attending a little over 90 days & has learned ALOT since I put my little one there. I’m beyond grateful at the excellent things they are teaching my little one. I greatly appreciate everything that they are doing. Keep up the amazing work. I know all staff have smiling faces, from front desk, every classroom teachers, kitchen staff. Thanks To All

My 18 month little one has been going to there since he was 2 1/2 months old and it has been the best decision I have made choosing them. I absolutely love the staff how they care and love him and they communicate very well. His development skills have been progressing since he has been there and he is learning and growing. I am so grateful to have them apart of our lives and very trusting.

Have taken my little one here for a while and can’t say anything negative on the center. Great communication in person and through their app. Their teachers are very hands on and listen to all concerns and give daily feedback on what is small progress to my little one’s goals. The classrooms are well kept clean and their center overall is a nice pleasant environment. Will definitely continue to recommend to my family and friends.

I have 3 (3,2,1) small kids that attend this center. They absolutely love their school. The staff is friendly. You can really tell they are passionate about their jobs and the roles they play in shaping their young minds. Mercedes has taught my son so much academically and emotionally. She is patient and attentive cause my 3yr old boy can be ALOT! Great structured programs geared towards children’s continued development. I recommend this location hands down!!!!

My child has been attending for approximately a year. Ms Ana has been the most wonderful, accommodating & caring person I’ve ever come across. She has been a huge gift in my life since we’ve been here. Not to mention the amazing progress my child has made since attending in speech & overall development with the curriculum they offer. My daughters teacher has been Absolutely recommend this daycare to anyone in the area looking!

We have had such a wonderful experience with this Montessori school. My daughter has been here since she was just 20 months old, and now at 4 years old, it’s been incredible to watch how much she has grown: academically, socially, and emotionally. As a young, first-time mom, I was very hesitant to place her in just any program. I wanted to be sure she was somewhere safe, nurturing, and truly invested in her development. From the very beginning, this school exceeded my expectations. The teachers are incredibly patient, kind, and attentive, and it’s clear how much they genuinely care about each child.
The small class sizes make such a difference, my daughter receives meaningful one-on-one attention and support, which has helped her build confidence and independence. She has also made so many great friends here, and she truly looks forward to going to school each day.
I am so grateful for the environment they’ve created and for the role they’ve played in shaping these early years of my daughter’s life. I couldn’t recommend this school more highly.

I enrolled my niece (5yrs) in this Montessori school for the summer, and she absolutely loves the place!
The teachers are incredibly patient and attentive. They really understand how to guide children at their own pace. The environment is bright, calm, and thoughtfully organized, and you can tell the staff truly cares about creating a space where kids feel safe and inspired.
What impressed me most was how naturally my niece took to the Montessori approach. She wasn’t just “kept busy”; she was engaged. She explored, asked questions, and developed new skills without ever feeling pressured.
If you’re looking for a nurturing, well-run Montessori program where children can genuinely thrive, I can’t recommend this school enough. My niece is already asking when she can go back, which says everything.

This school has been a great fit for my family! We recommend them to all our friends with young kids. When my son started here, he was very attached to me, and I was so worried about how he would do in a new setting. The toddler teachers were so kind and patient with him; they knew just how to help me at drop-off, since drop-offs were a huge challenge for my son. He was there until starting kindergarten this year. Now, he attends the after school program, which offers a ton of extracurriculars. He is taking Mandarin, yoga, art, and business classes after school.

My daughter also attends here, and started in the infant room. I was so happy with the large area for the babies and toddlers to move around, as well as the teachers who provided the best support and care. I'm a nervous parent, and they never judged me for all of my special requests (cut the food this way, etc.). Plus, she became really advanced with her fine motor skills due to all the fine motor work they provided.

The Montessori approach has been a great fit for my family. The Montessori method for learning reading and math is so amazing - so hands on and visual, and follows the child's interest. Both of my kids have learned independence, confidence, and care for their environment.

The classrooms are bright and organized. Due to the Montessori philosophy, every item has a place, and the kids really take care to place items back where they belong. As a result, the classrooms always appear organized and neat. The playground is very natural-looking with plenty of shade. They also have a covered patio where the smaller kids can play.

On top of all that, this school feels like a tight-knit family community. Every single teacher/staff knows my kids, and greets us warmly. I have close contact with the teachers when needed. When I call with any question or concern, the management takes me seriously. The teachers are calm and patient with the children - there is no yelling happening here, which is important to me. There are plenty of fun special events for the kids, which they really enjoy. In addition, a HUGE plus for this school is that they offer Spanish and Mandarin immersion for the 3+ year olds.

Very quiet and fully staffed.

Air purifiers in all the rooms with very well trained and a patient teachers. We were very blessed to find this school when we did. Our child loves going to school.

I toured 5 local daycares before choosing this one. It’s a caring, warm safe environment and overall has a chill vibe. We appreciate the small classroom sizes and knowledgeable staff and teachers and it makes childcare feel like a community.

Our daughter has been attending IJAK since she was 3 months old and she has been thriving since then. She soars through her milestones with the consistent encouragement at school.
Ms. Rachel was the absolute best first teacher she could have had and I credit my daughters early success to her along with Ms. Vicki and Ms. Ana. They are always available to talk when I have questions and that is so appreciated as a first time mom. There were no other places we toured that offered that kind of communication with the owner and director and that made it an easy decision for us to choose IJAK.

Our child has been here since the age of 9 months and will be 2 years old in a couple months. Every teacher our child has been with has shown nothing but true love and care and it shows to be true based off how much our child loves her teachers. We’ve seen her thrive and grow so much and surprising us every day after school. Whenever issues did come up, nothing too major, the staff was quick to address it and correct it on their end. I’m just a kid made it so much easier to trust our child being at school while we work and knowing she is being well taken care of. I love how extra they go for the kids such as holiday parties and more for the families to be included and involved. Great memories.

My son attended IJAK for a year and I wanted to share our personal experience with the daycare.

Pros: Holiday events, monthly newsletter with instructional focus, flexible hours

Cons:
- There are no cameras

- They do not send updates on how your child is doing throughout the day (not even end of day paper updates or report cards)

- Teachers are encouraged not to share how your child’s day “really” went

- There isn’t any kind of security at the drop off gate when dropping children off or picking them up which is very scary/concerning. Just the owner’s husband walking around

- Sometimes we’d pick our son up and he’d be in a different classroom with teachers we’ve never seen and older kids in there as well

- We would often pick him up and his clothes were filthy

- We used to receive artwork and evidence of learning, but it all suddenly stopped

Last, a big piece of advice would be to make sure any communication to/from the owner/manager is in writing.

This place is amazing teachers and staff are alsome and so genuine. They are so professional and has the structure and organization that parents are looking for to let not only anybody take care of their children, teachers are informative and loving. I love the way they interact with the children, and I love the curriculum and the safety measures they have in place. It's very clean, and the setup for the children is very nice. The curriculum the teachers uses will have your child ready for school! If you looking for care with a safe and Learning environment I'm Just a Kid is the place where your child should be!

I’m just a kid is not a daycare it’s a school and with that being said this facility has helped my daughter with expressing her emotions, potty training and being able to verbally communicate. I love the curriculum and how it’s very in depth informative. She started when she was 17m old and she is now turning 3 next month and everyone says how smart she is. I love this school and the teachers especially Ms. Leah she does a great job engaging with the children and teaching the curriculum.

Blessed Beginnings MOD and Preschool have been such a blessing in our lives. I have 4 children who have been in the program with 1 still currently enrolled and 1 coming up next year. I was looking for a school my kids could love and know they would get the love I would give them. For 8 years this school has delivered. My daughter Ryan developed a deep bond with Ms. Pam who is wonderful and nurturing. My son Luke was so well loved by Ms. Meagan which really helped him come out of his shell. My son Liam took a bit of time to adjust but loved Ms. Kristy from the start. She always would let me know how he was doing and if she'd be out as it would throw him off. I can't speak more highly of the administration either. Mrs. Ana had a daughter at Blessed Beginnings with my oldest so is a perfect person to have running the program as she was a recipient at one time. If you are looking for a loving environment for your family, this is it!

Love, love, love! My son's confidence and his gross/fine motor skills have developed immensely. He comes home singing songs, reciting the Pledge of Allegiance, and is overall very happy to attend. My son is in the Bumblebee class for 3 year olds and regularly mentions how much he loves his teachers. The administration and staff are so welcoming and you can truly see how much they care for each student when they say good morning/bye to each student by name. My son is exposed to a foreign language, bible studies, learning through play, music, and so much more. Communication with the staff is thorough and timely. I cannot give high enough praises. My experience with the Bumblebee class and Blessed Beginnings Preschool has been wonderful!

We have had our children in Blessed Beginnings for the past 3 years and we love it! One of our children even graduated out of their Pre-K program and we were very impressed with how much our son had learned. He was very well prepared for Kindergarten. They do a wonderful job of combining faith with a fun learning environment. Our children visible love their teachers and look forward to going to school. I also love hearing my children coming home singing the songs that they learn in class.

Blessed Beginning has been a great experience for my son! This was his first time attending any preschool care and he has loved it! We love the faith based play/learning environment. They have such a nice playground area that’s covered, safely enclosed, and has plenty for the kids to play with. Definitely recommend!

Blessed Beginnings Preschool is simply put phenomenal. From the staff, curriculum, atmosphere, and tuition price, it is an ideal place for MOD and preschoolers!
Having 2 of my own children attend Blessed Beginnings, I can personally attest to the quality of learning and the fun they experienced.
If you're considering a Catholic or even just a faith-based option for your little one, this program is amazing.
Also, the Bumblebee class has outstanding teachers, Ms. Pam & Ms. Lisa!

We had a wonderful experience at One Stop Montessori with my 1 1/2 year old daughter. Pinky and her teachers were so sweet and kind, and we felt like we were a part of a loving family. We loved the curriculum and learning environment. The school is very clean and well maintained, and communication with parents was excellent!

We are very happy with One Stop Montessori. It was a big decision to find the right place for your child. Our daughter was 16 months old when she joined One Stop Montessori and she loves to go there. They take care of her very well. They are more like a family now. Teachers are hard working. They spend good quality time with kids where they involve them with all different kinds of activities for overall growth of the child. Bonus is if you want to contact the faculty they are just a text and call away.
Thank you, One Stop Montessori!!

Highly recommend One Stop Montessori school. The director of the school Pinky Matalia is an amazing and very experienced Montessori teacher. She and other teachers pay close attention to each and every student and encourage them and makes learning fun for them. It's been more than a year now, my son goes there.  And we have seen tremendous growth and progress in him. Would highly recommend to everyone who is looking to put their kids in a loving and caring environment school.

I would like to give a huge shout out to Pinky Matalia and other teachers at One Stop Montessori for creating a caring, loving and perfect teaching environment for the kids that enables them to thrive in all aspects of their development. My daughter has been going to One Stop Montessori for past one year and we couldn’t be happier. I have seen tremendous improvement in her self confidence and her ability to interact with other kids. Would highly recommend this place.

We have been blessed to found this Montessori school for my son. The environment , teachers and daily routine is so much helpful for the kids to grow , learn and enjoy. There has been no day my son refused to go to school , he looked forward everyday. I am truly grateful to Pinky Matalia the owner/director to make such a safe , joyful yet a great learning environment for the kids.
Keep doing the amazing work !!!

OPERATION_NAME: Jefferson Place Learning and Developmental Center
review_text: Jefferson Place is the best place to send your little one for care.  The staff is professional and caring.  My grandson has been going there for a few months and I have seen a difference in him. He is motivated, and always happy to go to school.  The feedback that I get when I ask him about his day is truly remarkable.  I would highly recommend this center to my friends and family members.

OPERATION_NAME: Jefferson Place Learning and Developmental Center
review_text: I can truly say my son loves this Daycare very nourishing and patient with the children. I highly recommend everyone to this place. My son‘s favorite teacher is Miss Taylor.

OPERATION_NAME: Jefferson Place Learning and Developmental Center
review_text: I absolutely love JPLC. Lords knows I have no worries when it comes to leaving her in the care of her teacher Ms. ReRe. She’s literally like a second mama to my daughter at this point and I love that. And not to forget Ms. Carla who is exceptional at her roll as director . These two as well as the entire staff at JPLC leaves you with a piece of mind that your child will be well taken care of and well fed so long as they’re there. OPERATION_NAME: Jefferson Place Learning and Developmental Center
review_text: I am incredibly impressed with this school! The teachers are dedicated, caring, and create a nurturing environment for the children. The school's emphasis on character development, creativity, and critical thinking truly sets it apart. OPERATION_NAME: Jefferson Place Learning and Developmental Center
review_text: JPLC goes above and beyond to maintain excellence for our children.  Safe and loving learning environment with a home away from home vibe.  My kids love going to school here. They learn so much each day. The entire staff is a true blessing to my family.

I want to take a moment to sincerely thank everyone at Creative Little Minds for everything you have done for my children. Watching them grow, learn, and gain confidence under your care has meant more to me than words can fully express. You have played such an important role in their development, not only academically, but emotionally and socially as well. Your patience, kindness, and understanding in all circumstances have never gone unnoticed. Knowing that my kids are in a safe, supportive, and nurturing environment gives me true peace of mind. You treat them with compassion and care, and that has made a lasting impact on them and on our family. Thank you for your dedication, your flexibility, and for always showing understanding. We are truly grateful to be part of a daycare that cares so deeply about the children and the families it serves.

My children have been with Creative Little Minds for three years now, and we absolutely love it! As a parent, there is no greater peace of mind than being able to say I trust the staff wholeheartedly with my children. They have cared for my family through every stage, from my infant all the way up to my 10-year-old.

Creative Little Minds has been a massive part of our village, helping us navigate and understand each of my children’s unique needs. They are always there to help, support, and provide a nurturing and academic environment. We couldn’t ask for a better support in helping us raise with our kids!

My children have been attending Creative Little Minds Childcare Center for the past four years, and I feel abundantly blessed to have such an amazing group of people caring for and supporting my children. The center is small and very close knit, most of the staff members who work there have been there in excess of 15 years, probably more to be fair, and I appreciate that my children have such consistency with the teachers. It’s not a revolving door of staff and it makes trusting and knowing that my children are cared for that much easier because they have gotten to know my children on an intimate level. My youngest child has some delays and doesn’t speak like other children his age, but they have the ability to recognize what he needs, when he needs it. One of my biggest fears, when putting him into daycare, was that if something were wrong he’d not be able to tell me, but I no longer have that fear. I trust everyone at Creative Little Minds wholeheartedly because they have shown how much they care for, love, and nurture my children through their actions every single day. I cannot say enough good things about this center, they truly have become an integral part of my children’s lives. They’re not just their “daycare teachers,” they are their family. ❤️

I wanted to express how much I love the staff at Little Creative Minds. My son Joseph has been going to their center since he was about a year or so. He is now 3 years old. He was diagnosed with Autism in 2024. They have helped me work with me on an unbelievable level. When I think other people would have given up or would have dismissed him. They have stuck by us and have helped him grow and helped me with resources to better him.  He has grown with them and loves his teachers, to were he is happy to go to school in the morning and doesn't want to leave in the evenings. They are more then a daycare, they became a family to me. Love you all for everything that you do!!!

I want to give a huge thank you to miss Sonia and the entire team they go above and beyond every single day I always notice how they handle difficult mornings, very calmly and happy thank you again for treating my kids like one of your own. My kids have been enrolled for about a year and a half now, at the beginning it was scary looks,can be deceiving never judge a book by its cover. But my kids are very happy here from the moment we walk in the staff greets my kids by name with so much warmth it's such a relief to go to work knowing their in a safe clean fun environment. I especially love the daily photos updates. We are really impressed how much are kids have grown and learned my oldest comes home talking about his friends and activities they do when they're playing dress-ups or when they do story times and things like that the teachers are truly partners in his development. They are very patient with them and communicate with them clearly you can tell they care for the kids individuality we feel very lucky to be part of this community. And honestly I'm very thankful as a parent the hardest part of my day used to be dropping off my kids I didn't have a vehicle for a while but creative little minds offers services to pick up the kids and that was a big help. But anyway at the end of the day they always give us detail report of whatever they had going on that day overall I highly recommend to any family to join this team once again thank you so much creative little minds for being there for my family.

We absolutely love Discovery School! It is a true gem and has already indelibly changed our lives. The impact this school has made on our son has been incredible. The teachers truly care about each student and create an environment where kids feel supported, loved, and nurtured.

We’ve seen tremendous growth not only academically, but also in our son’s confidence, curiosity, and love for learning. The sense of community among families and staff makes it feel like more than just a school — it feels like a family.

We are so grateful to be part of Discovery School and highly recommend it to any family looking for a nurturing, high-quality educational experience.

Our daughter started at Discovery School in the three-year-old program without knowing any English, and the growth we’ve seen over the past two years has been incredible. Not only has she learned a new language, but she’s also made meaningful friendships and gained so much confidence. Her overall learning and development have truly been remarkable.

Discovery School is a rare and special place. Many of the teachers have been there for years, which speaks volumes about the environment and the care they pour into the school. You also meet parents who once attended Discovery School themselves and are now bringing their own children here. Others continue to volunteer long after their kids have moved on. That sense of continuity, love, and community is something you can truly feel.

One of the things I love most is how much the school values culture. Parents are encouraged to come in and share celebrations and traditions that are meaningful to their families. Seeing children exposed to different cultures at such a young age is something truly special.

The school is diverse, non secular, and filled with like minded families. Choosing a school for your child is never easy… But if you are looking for a place where your child will be truly cared for, supported, and encouraged to grow, you really cannot go wrong with Discovery School.

This school is special. My son went through their first grade program, which is unmatched. Mrs. Villareal is genuinely passionate about teaching and her love for her class is infectious.

Now my daughter is here and loves it too. They have play-based learning that makes our kids actually excited to go to school. Every teacher we've had has been amazing.

This is a hidden gem in San Antonio. They organize wonderful activities like bringing in snow and real reindeer. It feels like a community.

Discovery School of San Antonio is one of those rare gems you don’t fully appreciate until you’ve experienced it yourself. Tucked away in the most unexpected little corner of town, this small school carries more history, heart, and magic than places ten times its size. It has been serving young children for over 50 years, and you can feel that legacy the moment you walk through the gate. My daughter started in the 2-year-olds program, and my two sons followed—one even completing their exceptional Kindergarten program. Each of them was met with warmth, patience, and genuine love from teachers who are nothing short of extraordinary. The staff at Discovery School doesn’t just teach; they nurture, guide, and celebrate every child exactly as they are. I used to wonder how the playground sand managed to find its way into every corner of my car after school days… but now, I miss it. It was a sign of play, exploration, and the kind of childhood memories you hope your kids will carry forever. If you’re looking for a school where your child will be known, loved, and encouraged to grow through curiosity and creativity, Discovery School of San Antonio is the place.

Discovery School is an absolute gem of a preschool that embodies the philosophy of "play as we learn, and learn as we play." As a parent, I couldn't be more thrilled with the environment they have created for my child. Our youngest just started following her brother’s footsteps and I could not be more excited.

The teachers are warm, nurturing, and incredibly skilled at making learning feel like an adventure. Every day, my children come home excited to share what they did, whether it's discovering new concepts through hands-on activities, exploring nature, or engaging in creative arts and crafts. The curriculum is thoughtfully designed to blend academic learning with play, ensuring that children develop essential skills without even realizing they are "learning." The classrooms are vibrant and filled with a variety of materials that encourage exploration and curiosity. I particularly appreciate how the teachers allow children the freedom to choose their activities, fostering independence and decision-making skills. The outdoor space is equally amazing, offering plenty of room for imaginative play and physical activity.

What sets Discovery apart is their genuine commitment to each child's growth. The staff takes the time to understand each child's unique personality and interests, tailoring their approach to meet individual needs. The small class sizes ensure that every child receives the attention and support they need to thrive. As a parent, I also value the open communication between the school and families. The teachers regularly update us on our child's progress and are always available to discuss any concerns or questions we may have. Overall, Discovery School is more than just a preschool—it's a community where children are encouraged to be curious, confident, and creative. If you're looking for a place where your child will not only learn but also develop a lifelong love of learning, I highly recommend it.

OPERATION_NAME: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center at Stone Oak
review_text: Cannot say enough wonderful things about our experience at Children’s Lighthouse Stone Oak! Our son has absolutely thrived in so many ways here. As working parents, our biggest hope was finding a place that we felt was not only a superb learning environment, but a place that was loving, nurturing, and felt safe to us and our son. We found just that! Shout out to Ms. Julie for being such a welcoming and kind presence as director and to all the teachers who have loved our son so well. We can’t wait for our second boy to start in January!

OPERATION_NAME: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center at Stone Oak
review_text: Couldn’t recommend this daycare more! As a first time mom they made us feel so welcomed and so comfortable! From everyone at the front office to all the teachers, and them also having access to live cameras where you can check on your child, it will put you at ease!  Ms. Nicole, Ms. Miranda and all the teachers in room 2 are the best! Anytime we pick up our baby girl, she is always so happy! Thankful for them all! Highly recommend.

OPERATION_NAME: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center at Stone Oak
review_text: My daughter was moved to the next class when she was only six months old just to make room for a new child. On top of that, they gave me problems about her continuing to have the bottle she was supposed to have. In the new class, her diaper was not changed on time and she often came home with a very red and irritated bottom. Honestly, I do not recommend this place at all. I complained about the situation, but nothing was really done, so I decided to take her out.

OPERATION_NAME: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center at Stone Oak
review_text:
Children's Lighthouse of Stone Oak was an absolutely wonderful choice for our daughter's first school experience. From the moment we walked through the doors, we knew we had found the perfect environment for her to grow and thrive. The warmth and nurturing atmosphere created by the staff is palpable, making it feel like a second home for our little one.

One of the standout aspects of our experience has been the incredible relationship our daughter developed with her teacher, Ms. Alexis. She has a unique ability to connect with her students, fostering a love for learning that has ignited a spark in our daughter. Ms. Alexis's dedication, patience, and genuine affection have made every day at school a joyful adventure for our child. We have witnessed firsthand how Ms. Alexis goes above and beyond to ensure each child feels valued and encouraged.

The administration at Children's Lighthouse of Stone Oak is equally impressive. Their friendliness and genuine concern for each student create an inviting and supportive environment for families. They are always available to answer questions, address concerns, and provide guidance, making the transition into school life seamless and comfortable. It is clear that they care deeply about the well-being of every child, and this commitment shines through in everything they do.

Overall, we our expectations were exceeded with our decision to enroll our daughter at Children's Lighthouse of Stone Oak. Although our journey has shifted, we are forever grateful for the experiences, friendships, and cherished memories she made there.

OPERATION_NAME: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center at Stone Oak
review_text:
Our family has had a wonderful experience at Children’s Lighthouse Stone Oak from in the classrooms to the front desk staff!
My daughters have been in room 7-10 and the teachers are amazing! Prior to coming to CL my daughters were in an at home daycare where they were 2 of 5 kids from ages 6 weeks to 3 years old. She was like a second mom to them so needless to say I was worried about their transition.
My youngest immediately took to Ms. Alexis and by day 2 she was running and giving her hugs upon arrival. My middle was a little slower to warm up but found comfort and understanding from many teachers who were patient and warm with her. She is now with Mrs. Genesis who she loves and asks to be picked up late to spend more time with her. And when the after school program was full at my oldest daughter’s school Mrs. Brandi was so helpful and accommodating to get my stress down and a quick spot for her.
It is so nice to be somewhere my girls have a special connection with almost every teacher/helper/staff. I am so happy we came to Children’s Lighthouse!

We have sent two children to Arbor, beginning in August 2018, and our youngest will complete their time there in August 2026. We have truly loved every aspect of Arbor and feel so lucky that our children were nurtured in such a magical space.

One of the things that speaks volumes is that many of the same teachers who were there when we started in 2018 are still there today. They supported our family through the challenges of the global pandemic—providing weekly educational kits for us to use at home—and welcomed us back with open arms as soon as we felt safe to return. That level of care, flexibility, and commitment meant so much to us.

Arbor has always prioritized community and outdoor learning. Our children have thrived with the abundant opportunities to explore, play outside, and develop practical life skills—hallmarks of a Montessori education. The teachers genuinely seem happy and deeply invested in each child’s well-being and growth.

Beyond the classroom, Arbor fosters meaningful connections among families. We’ve built friendships that extend well outside of school and will continue long after our time there ends.

If you are looking for a place where your child will feel safe, seen, supported, and encouraged to grow, Arbor is truly special. The Montessori foundation has been exceptional—both of our children will enter kindergarten confident, capable, and well-prepared.

We will be so sad to close this chapter, but we are incredibly grateful for our years here. Ms. Tammy, Ms.Nili, and her entire team are wonderful. Thank you, Arbor, for everything.

Both of our kids went to Arbor Montessori and we absolutely loved it. Very little teacher turnover so you end up with teachers that really know your kids and your family which I loved. All the teachers are so warm and caring and made our kids feel comfortable. They also learned so much and were very well-prepared to go to elementary school form a social and academic standpoint. It's a small school in a great location with a huge outside space, great curriculum and wonderful people. I can't recommend Arbor more!

I truly cannot say enough positive things about Arbor Montessori. My daughter attended from the age of 18 months until she graduated at nearly five years old, and our experience was nothing short of wonderful. Every teacher there is deeply passionate, creating a welcoming environment where every child feels completely at home.
Beyond the impressive academic growth my daughter showed, I was most touched by the school’s character; the children are remarkably respectful and kind toward one another. Most importantly, when our family faced a very stressful time, Tammy and the staff went above and beyond to support my daughter and our family. I will be forever grateful for their care. Arbor Montessori holds a special place in our hearts—so much so that every time we drive by, my daughter still blows kisses to the school through the car window 🥰

We have had three children attend Arbor Montessori for the last few years and they love it! Our eldest child flourished and learned so much that we kept him at Arbor through kindergarten as well. He was more than prepared for his first grade experience in public school and is considered a class leader despite his younger age. His younger brothers are currently still at Arbor and look forward to going every weekday. The teachers and staff are consistent and have been incredibly supportive and sweet with our kids. The other parents and families we’ve met have also been wonderful. Our kids come home with new skills and gained independence that we know were developed through Arbor’s guidance, which we so appreciate.

My family has been part of the Arbor Montessori Community from 2019 through 2025.  Our children attended from ages 1-5, through both the toddler and primary programs.  The school has been a wonderful fit for our family and our daughters absolutely flourished there.  From the beginning, we saw how their Montessori approach nurtured independence, curiosity, and a love of learning.

I appreciated the balance of work and outdoor playtime that is provided.  The children can spend hours outdoors allowing them to connect with the nature, learn about gardening, seasons/weather, science, and bugs in ways that are meaningful and fun.  There’s a dedicated focus on community, service, and learning about different cultures.  Our children explored traditions, languages, and customs from around the globe, helping them appreciate diversity and develop empathy. My kids graduated from Arbor extremely well prepared for Kindergarten- academically, socially, and emotionally.

The school is well managed, with great communication, and teacher turnover is almost non-existent.  Having the same, well-experienced, teachers for several years provided a stable and loving environment.  We’re grateful to have found Arbor Montessori and the experience has been nothing but positive!

I love this daycare I just don’t like how my baby be coming home hurt. First week of my daughter being there she chipped her tooth and no one told me and there has been multiple occasions where she came home with scratches on her. Yall need to lock in and make sure these kids ain’t getting hurt we trusting yall with our babies.
My son has been at Vogel for 3 years. All of hid teachers are amazing. They dont just watch your kids they love them and teach them. Cant say enough good thingd about Vogel.

I owe all of who i am today to this place. I was not only homeless but depressed and very insecure. I was in the program 6 1/2 years until my second son aged out. I completed nursing school, got married and had two additional children whom i wish i could put in the program lol. I loved my counselors and all the teachers my children had…… i keep in touch with my case worker to this day! Holidays and birthdays were always special and remembered. Your children will be SAFE, looked out for and families are extended help and support. Job search, help with clothes food supplies i even had my apartment furnished.

The list is long ! I love you guys and miss coming in every morning and afternoon 💕

Josiah and Noah’s mom.

My son was hurt ,no one told me! I unenrolled my son after a short 2 weeks . When I first enrolled him he was a little hesitant to stay because it's a new environment which is normal. He got used to it, it became easier to leave him. However the last 3 times I tried to leave him he refused to go inside. As soon as we got to the door he would scream cry hit and pull away with all his strength telling me he’s scared. At first I thought he just missed me, it became clear something happened. I saw scratch marks on him. Recently he told me while he was in school a kid kept "hitting me in the face" I was shocked. I asked him for clarification was it a small kid or a big adult. He said kid. I asked him where was the teacher he said "in the room" I said did you tell the teacher he said yes I asked did the kid get in trouble  he said "no" I asked him what did the teacher do he said "she walked out the room" I was livid ! No one told me anything! My child went through that without being comforted , without the other kid having any sort of  redirection. This made me especially mad because they pride themselves on "regulating emotions" I  knew something occurred but couldn't prove it. A few days before I pulled him out an incident happened where I saw a  teachers aid being rough with another kid. She had became irritated because she couldnt finish her food due to my kid and another boy fighting over a toy. She picked the other kid up roughly by his arms & put him on a cot. Begin yelling at the other kids repeatedly while aggressively moving her neck as if she was arguing with an adult on the street. When I brought this concern up my case worker & the woman in charge of handling these incidents had a meeting with me and told me the teacher “did nothing wrong” They were nonchalant & cold. They kept telling me they couldnt "show me the footage" but I didn't ask to see the footage of that specific incident, I saw her mistreating him with my own two eyes .I did however, want to see footage of how she was with MY kid due to him saying he was scared of her. They wouldn't budge. I know she did something they were hiding it! The same day when I went to pick up my kid the same teachers aid stopped to talk to me about how she helped my kid nap. After she walked away my son said he was "scared of the spider" (her braids reminded him of a spider ) He was scared to speak when she was in front of us & waited until she left. He was silent & clung to me. She did something to him & karma will get her 10xs worse! I told them about his reaction in the meeting they brushed it off. The woman in charge said the teachers aid wasn't in there at nap time ,they have “no idea which teachers aid are with the kids at all times” Yet she told me HERSELF she was. Something obviously occurred & they covered it up by not showing me the footage. Also ,one day when I was picking up my kid he ran to me crying and told me he hurt his finger.there was a cut and dried blood His teacher said it “ just happened " but the blood was dried so it obviosuly didnt JUST she wouldn't tell me what caused it. They made it seem like i was welcomed at anytime but when I wanted to stay a little to observe him from the outside through the window my case worker , teachers made little comments like "well I'm sure you have somewhere to go" "ok you can close door" in order to rush me to leave him. What’s the rush?you guys said I can stay & observe but when i try i get rude stares,comments. They don't like kids & lack patience but play nice at first. My son told me he was repeatedly hit IN THE FACE and NO ONE TOLD ME! It had been a month before I even knew only because my kid told me. None of this should have happened. Everyday after school he told me his teachers were mean to him! I had reservations about putting my kid in daycare and it took alot for me to trust strangers with my child. CHECK YOUR KIDS BODY EVERYDAY!TAKE PICTURES!ASK QUESTIONS!PAY ATTENTION TO HOW THEY REACT WITH THE ADULTS AROUND THEM! TRUST YOUR GUT  & YOUR CHILD!

This place is definitely in existence and is AMAZING!

My personal experience here has been as a child who was once homeless (at their old location) and an employee for a couple of years.

The teachers that work here are INCREDIBLE. They are truly only working at Vogel because they love what they do and the children that they are able to love on and teach. I am so blessed and grateful that this place exists. Without Vogel Alcove, I wouldn't be who I am today.

My daughter attended for a few years. We enjoyed it. Everyone was very kind and understanding. My daughter didn’t like going to sleep during the summer break. She was 8 at the time and she mentioned that everyone had to take a nap. I checked on her as much as possible and they reassured me that everything was okay during that time. I wish the had nap time for children at the age of pre-k and under. As most of the kids are restless and want to play. My daughter doesn’t want to return because of the nap time. So unfortunately, I’ll find another place. However, after school care was great. My daughter reassured me that everything was fine just didn’t like to go to sleep. I made sure to ask her all the questions. I would say, everyone is kind. This is a good place for after school care of summer care of you don’t mind them taking a nap for a few hours.

What can I say?  Not only are my sons happy to be a part of Youth Movement, I know that they are safe and having a great time.  Ms. Emy and Mr. Ronnie and the staff of YMC are fun, friendly, and engaging, and I do not worry about my sons when they are in the YMC care.  Ms. Emy and Mr. Ronnie communicate with parents well, and if problems do arise (as they will with children), the problems are immediately solved.  They are professional and very helpful, and I couldn't have made a better decision when enrolling my boys.

I walked into the center on imperial valley and met this really nice Hispanic girl who gave me all the info I needed to enroll. I was super stoked because it didn't smell like a daycare, and she even offered to waive the registration fee!

My daughters have been there for less than two weeks. Within a day, the Owner comes in and terminate my daughter's paper as a student because she was having a bad day without contacting the parent to see what is going on. My daughter is experiencing some challenges, and instead of her trying to understand, she tells my wife to look up a mental daycare center for her. How rude and inconsiderate of her. How dare you say to a parent about their child. Within a week of being there, my daughter is still trying to learn. Instead of calling the parent about the child's concern, you immediately jump to conclusions. A mental daycare is outrageous

Will not be returning. Some pros.. Facility is clean and hours are phenomenal for working parents dealing with 2nd and 3rd shifts.  Staff is kind and my child appeared to have a good relationship with the teachers. Cons: Inability to remove child for vacation without incurring exorbitant fees.  Child frequently exposed to infections that required weekly removal at my cost and time off from job since they were not allowed to come back without clearance from doctor. Child frequently came home with bruises without incident report or explanation from staff.  Staff turnover was high and so there was no consistency with daycare staff at any given time. Informed staff of concern upon registration regarding child's development level and no real care was taken by the staff to ensure that there was a development plan to get my child on track...although to be fair they were probably not prepared for that level of care. Sending child to another facility and wish this place the best. For parents considering this facility, please do your homework before committing.

There are various reasons why my children will not be returning. But lets start with the positive first:
Pros: 1. If they stay long enough they are feed pretty hearty meals (unfortunately they often leave before it's actually served). 2. The center appears clean. 3. Their response time is fairly quick. There hasn't been many times where I have called and not have someone answer. 4. Main office director worked out some things with us in the beginning.
1. Week one School would not release 2/3 children to the driver for whatever reason. She took my oldest to daycare and left my 2 four olds crying at school. I was notified after the fact that she was not able to get them.
2. My son's arm was injured (broken skin). I had to pick him up to find out about the incident. He told me that a boy kept messing with him even after the teacher told him to stop. When I called the school I was told that they were horse playing and it was just an accident. When asked why I was not notified when it happened or why there was not an incident report I just got a shine off "Oh sorry".

3. I've been told twice that my kids were on time out for behavior. Which I agree there should be consequences for poor actions and decisions. However, when I'm told by my child that they are in "time out" for long duration of time (last time being until pickup) I find that to be a excessive and borderline abuse.

4. Payment is due on Tuesday. After this time there is a $25 per DAY charge. You will not be told until at least the first late fee is added. Now I accept for responsibility for late payments. It can be a hassle and being a small business there may be rippling effects. But, I pay for the month and often forget when the next is due. But imagine my surprise that after 7 months... Yes SEVEN MONTHS I was told there is a credit card form that can be filled out for auto-pay!? So after the first time don't you think it would have been nice to inform us of this service!?
5. Oh lastly lets not forget about the two week notice that's needed to remove your child. Huh? I'm sorry do I work for you? Will you be providing a reference to the next location. Don't worry about it.

I wish K3 well in the future endeavors but I also hope that any parent looking for a new daycare choose wisely and differently.

My 2 year old granddaughter often comes to Houston to stay with me for months at a time.  I am a working grandma so I had to find a daycare.  I visited several daycares in the Humble area and decided on K3 Creative Center for 3 reasons.  1 - the location is convenient for my commute to work  2 - the facility is very clean and well maintained and 3 - the facility is very clean and well maintained (did I already say that???).  #2 and 3 were the #1 reasons the decision was made to have K3 as my daycare provider.  Cleanliness is KEY for me because several other daycares I visited smelled horrible!!!  I rather smell bleach and Lysol than dirty diapers.   ijs

I absolutely love the staff at ABC Word Academy! My son has been attending since he was a little over 12 months and the education that he is receiving is exceptional. I can definitely tell learning is taking place, my son comes home just about everyday with something new that he has learned. The teachers and staff are very loving and they make my son comfortable as well as myself. I would recommend ABC Word Academy to any and all parents looking to expand the minds of their little ones as well as shape them in a Christian based atmosphere.

I absolutely love ABC Word Academy. I trust them with my children because I see how much my kids love going to school. My little ones have learned so much and are maturing in a positive way. I couldn't ask for a better school.
ABC Word Academy has been amazing with my children. They are kind, patient & diligent with making sure my kids are learning & growing.
My daughter has been going to ABC Word for 8 months. She ABSOLUTELY loves it! The complete staff is very nice and personable.. I've never had any complaints and the rates are the BEST!  ♥️♥️

My son has been attending the school since about the age of 6 months. I LOVE the school and so does he. He will soon be 5 and our time on the campus will be ending. We will greatly miss the outstanding teachers and nurturing learning environment.

This daycare demonstrates exceptional standards in childcare and early education. The staff are well-trained, compassionate, and highly attentive to each child’s needs. The environment is consistently clean, safe, and thoughtfully designed to support both learning and play. Daily activities are structured to promote cognitive, emotional, and social development in an engaging way. Communication with parents is clear and consistent, reflecting the center’s professionalism and dedication. Overall, this daycare provides a nurturing and educational atmosphere that truly prioritizes children’s well-being and growth.

The staff at Kinder Land Daycare are all exceptional in that they show a great passion in teaching the children. The classrooms definitely are a place of growth, respect and learning.  They see the potential of their students and help them realize it.  The children enjoy learning with their teachers. They are kind and patient and have created an engaging learning environment for the children. I am very grateful my children attend this daycare.

I highly recommend this kindergarten! The teachers are incredibly caring, patient, and professional. They create a warm and safe environment where children feel comfortable and happy. My child has learned so much in a short time — from basic academic skills to social interaction and creativity. The daily activities are fun and educational, and I love how they encourage the kids to explore, ask questions, and express themselves. Communication with parents is also excellent. I truly feel that my child is in good hands here.
It is a good place for your kids, amazing teachers and care providers. I love it♥️
Very nice day care! Masara is an amazing founder! And all the teachers there are so nice to kids! Highly recommended!

This is the sort of place where children can go and be children! There is a wonderful balance between learning the discipline of quiet learning and concentration and also using their full energy outside.
What attracted us to Kido were the massive playgrounds. Kido has several large playgrounds. All fenced in. They have  European inspired and age appropriate play scapes, there are trees and real grass!

They have a large variety of toys, they can pick flowers, find rocks and chase butterflies and our kid comes home tired with lots to tell and grass stains on his knees from all the fun and activities.

The school also boasts having a music room and a coding room. They also learn how to make basic dishes and snacks in a school kitchen!
The class rooms have great toys, crafts and books. The class rooms, like the out door space, are also very large. The kids have so much room to roam and play! They are not cooped up in a small class room. The teachers are dedicated and patient. Our son always comes home and says he misses his teacher. We often hear him practice his numbers and letters on his own at home. He sings songs they just learned. We are very impressed with Kido and our son has absolutely loved his time there and we have felt completely confident that our son is safe and happy.
kido is a phenomenal school for the children development  and it offers an exceptional curriculum where children learn different educational subjects and theme, and the teachers are well trained.
my triplets found a home away from home. The warmth and care is like no place else. Thanks for all you do!
It was a lovely facility and the teachers are caring…the outside facilities are impressive, with multiple playgrounds.
Kido is an amazing  school , with an impressive curriculum.

My son started at The Rock Early Learning Center when he was just 4 months old, and I’ve been consistently impressed with the care and attention he’s received. The infant class teachers were incredibly caring, patient, and attentive to each child’s individual needs, creating a warm and nurturing environment where my child truly thrived. I could go on and on about how wonderful his teachers were during his time in that classroom—I always knew he was in good hands when I dropped him off each morning.

A few days ago, my son transitioned to the next class, and it was such a heartwarming experience. The transition was incredibly smooth, thanks to the new teachers who went out of their way to make him feel comfortable. They even sent me pictures to keep me updated on how well he was adjusting, which meant so much to me as a parent.

I also love that The Rock Early Learning Center provides daily reports through their app, keeping me informed every step of the way. The staff is approachable, responsive, and clearly dedicated to the children’s well-being and development.

Thank you, The Rock Early Learning Center, for being such an incredible part of our lives!

To say that I was blessed to find this daycare would truly be an understatement. From the initial phone call with the interim director at the time (Mrs. Mardana) until now, every interaction with the staff at The R.O.C.K. Early Learning Center has been a delight! All three of my children attend here, and I can’t imagine them being anywhere else. The teachers and staff are all so patient and caring. They truly enjoy what they do and care for the children as their own. I thoroughly enjoy the daily updates, photos and videos I receive. Whenever my children take ill, the leadership doesn’t hesitate to contact me and keep me informed of what’s going on. I’m looking forward to my children’s continuous learning and growth during their time here!

I love all the staff family oriented, my daughter has been thriving for the past 2 years. They are amazing with potty training communication is the absolute best whenever it’s an emergency they always reach out asap meals are provided and my daughter loves to eat at school. 10 out of 10

Although I was skeptical at first because I had never had my children in daycare I was blessed to run into this place and the experience here has been awesome!!my daughter has attended daycare here since she was 6 months she is now days away from 2! She counts 1-10 knows her colors and how to communicate, I am impressed at the amount of time they give my daughter for her to be so advanced! If you’re looking for child care this is the place, if you have older children I believe till the age of 12 they have afterschool programs & transportation! I could sit here and write an essay and go on and on about how grateful I am and the amount of comfort i feel when I am at work knowing my baby is in the best hands! STAFF IS AMAZING 🤍

The R.O.C.K Early Learning Center is amazing! I have had 3 children go to this daycare and am very pleased with all staff. They are attentive and help the kids potty train and learn while they play as well.
They take such good care of my kids! We love it there. If you’re thinking about enrolling your children, do it with no hesitation!

This place will steal from you. I emailed the directors a month ago about taking my child out of daycare and they continued to bill me and haven’t returned my money. DO NOT SEND YOUR CHILD HERE!!!

You rarely get the daily updates and the directors are liars.
Amazing facility and very well trained staff to take care of kids. I would highly recommend this to my family and friends.
