My son is in the next class up (he’s 2) and he has learned to potty train and he absolutely loves his teachers and friends he always ask to see his friends at school. I never have to worry about them when they are there because I know they are safe. They also are the first place I know that offers dinner to take home and are cost effective. I will always recommend this daycare to anyone!

My son has been at the Wynn Academy since March and he loves it! The Wynn Academy takes great care of him and are so family oriented. He loves all his teachers and has learned so much in his time there! He never comes home dirty, hungry or sad. I’m so grateful I found this daycare I would recommend them to anybody.

Wynn Academy is the best affordable daycare. My son enjoys it and looks forward to going everyday! My number 1 favorite thing about Wynn Academy is that the staff is older so it makes me feel that my child is in safe hands. ( Like going to Auntie or Grandma’s house lol ) they teach the kids. They really are genuine and Caring. I absolutely love it and would recommend to everyone with kids 💗

I have three daughters that go here (3 different age groups) and they love it. Teachers are caring and I see how my kids are learning daily, from writing & reading to praise & manners. The atmosphere they provide for the children is outstanding. My first time leaving a review but they definitely deserve the 5 stars.
Very grateful to all the staff, especially Mrs. Elizabeth and the grandmother that all the children called "Grandma," always bringing back good memories. Best regards.
The care they give our children is so wonderful—the patience, the love, and the learning. I recommend it 100%.
I wanted to know when the school will be open. I've been calling for days and they tell me the email is full.

Living Word Academy is home away from home for my baby girl. I am at peace and have  no doubts  that my daughter is well taken care of.  My daughter started at age one and she’s about to be three years old. I can boldly today that  my daughter has improved in all aspects  since she joined the academy. She improved from being a laid back toddler to a very bold and brilliant babygirl.  My daughter is so brilliant that our family friends give good compliments about how well behaved she is. She knows all the colors by heart and many more. They have well experienced teachers. The teachers are amazing and the kids are well nurtured with love. I can go on and on. I am so in love and impressed with their services.

My daughter has been at LWA since she was 3 months old. The pandemic hit when she was 5 months old, so she didn’t return until she was almost 1 year. She’s almost 3 now and she loves it here! She has made best friends and she especially loves Ms. B and Ms. Sandra. I take note of all of the things that she is learning daily. The staff treats her like their own. They also address any concerns or question that I may have. I’d definitely recommend this center.

I absolutely love this daycare, I like that it's an educational and faith based facility,  very clean environment with amazing staff with so much caring mindset. My children have been here for 3 years.

My children feel at home when they come in , the teachers are absolutely wonderful  and my children always come home with new things they have learnt .I also love the fact that they are taught in a Godly environment .
Thank you for putting our children first. Thank you for taking time to help our picky eaters eat something. Thank you for giving our children a clean environment to thrive.

I have taken both of my kids here, and I absolutely love this place! Everyone is extremely friendly! My son loves his teacher Ms. Johnie, even at home he’s always talking about her! I appreciate all that she has done for my son! We also love Ms. Amanda, she is extremely sweet and puts her whole heart into these kids! Personally I love how small it is, & they are curriculum based, my oldest has learned so much from this place! I definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a daycare that is affordable & one that cares deeply about your child’s needs!

My daughter has been going here 5-6 months now and I have nothing but great things to say. They were very helpful in the transition of her starting and having issues wanting to attend school. Also sped up the process for potty training she enjoys to count even if she’s off sometimes we try again, she’s very excited to tell me about her friends and who did what, and for the price I’m paying I believe it is worth it. I would recommend for anyone looking for childcare.

We have been with the center since August. My son has grown so much since being at the center. The teachers and staff make every family and children feel special. They have great communication and events for the students.

My son has been going here for almost 3 years. We love it here.  The staff is amazing and very professional. They keep you updated on every detail about your child. I definitely recommend this place. 😊

The Inspire Me Learning Center was an exemplary choice. My daughter Aaliyah started in December 2024 and Their engagement with children and outstanding curriculum are perfectly synchronized, yielding a discernible improvement in my daughter's academic progress and vocabulary. I highly recommend this center to any parent seeking a supportive and educational environment for their children. My daughter loves being apart of the Inspire me learning family . Thanks for everything !

Project one day was truly a blessing to my family while we were in Houston! They are there to help families who are in need the most. The school is taught by the parents, who in turn get 4 days of free childcare.
They are Christian based, so keep that in mind.
Some things to note is 1 parent is required to work one day during the 5 day week, they provide nutritious meals and snacks, and again since the school is taught by the parents they try their best to stick to a curriculum.
We are so blessed to have been apart of Project one day and we will greatly miss Mrs. Van, and Mrs. Jenni!

I’ve had the privilege of being on the Board of Directors since the start of Project One Day back in 2019. This has been a journey for us all. We’ve had the honor to serve many amazing women and their children. We do this all with the guidance and provision from God and through Jesus Christ. We are prayerful about all decisions.

My husband and I have had the opportunity to support Project One Day financially as well. As a member of the board, I know for certain that we use the money wisely in order to help families in need. Jennifer Johnson has been working nonstop to help build this organization without any financial compensation for herself. Miss Van has worked tirelessly to support these parents as well. I’m so excited about extending our care from 10  families now to 35 at Sharpstown Baptist Church. God has been faithful to provide the opportunity to minister to so many.

POD has been such a blessing in my family’s life. I am a work from home mother and not being able to fully tend to my child while accomplishing work started to feel a little overwhelming. I am forever grateful that my daughter can attend PROJECT ONE DAY where they interact and learn so much as well as making friends and growing together spiritually mentally emotionally all around! Mrs. Van and Mrs. Jenny are awesome! I volunteer 1 day weekly in exchange for care for my daughter and it’s absolutely wonderful for me to see the interaction of the daycare for the days that I am not there.

Project One Day school is one of the best daycares I have experienced. I have 3 kids and all 3 went to POD, my babies learn so much as far as sign language, praying, and so much more. My kids are still attending POD. We all love Ms.Van & Ms.Jenny & Ms.Courtney! We need more people like them in this world! It’s also so much more than just a daycare, it’s a home. They never judge what’s going on with your life and they try in every way to push you to be a better MOTHER & PERSON. I couldn’t ask for a better daycare or better support group!!!

Project One Day is a blessing in disguise! It’s the perfect starter location for you and your little to adjust to being in school. There’s so much love and care at the facility! There’s structure and weekly lesson plans! If you’re interested in childcare for your little please contact them, do a walk through, and gather some information! It will be well worth your time and a great opportunity for your little to begin their journey into exploration of friendships, sharing, daily activities, lessons, creativity, play time, consistency in a schedule (and they’ll help you potty train!) It was an ideal start for my babies!

I was very nervous sending my daughter to daycare for the first time. Mr. Zuniga, Ms. Garcia and the rest of the staff were always in constant communication with us. We would receive pictures of her daily activities & would get notified of any little incidents. My daughter was here for 2 years before we moved cities. I never had an issue with the learning center, I knew my daughter was in good hands because she could not wait to go back the next day. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a family based learning center.

My three children have attended
For the past five years now my son was a baby and has truly going to be respectful little boy with the best mannerism ever I love the way they pay attention to the children and the games that they played with the little ones while my older ones are in school. thank you staff for taking the time to be there for my children and for treating them like if they were your own children.

Good daycare. Although, kids never mentioned playing outside nor came home with crafts. It is a different environment. You bring your own food, they do have a 9 hour rule they follow. When registering, you do sign a thick packet that covers all basis, so there definitely will not be confusion.

Brought my kids to the Beanie learning center and they love it! They love all the activities and talk about how much fun they have when at the center I 100% recommend to anyone looking for a loving and fun center to take your kids

Took my 23 moth baby and the directors took her In and I had payed for the week and the diposit when I came and piked her up they informed me that. They did not had the proper. Traning for her like why take a child if they don’t have the traning  I had to go a bit out of my budget buying snacks and lunch for the weeks because they don’t provide any and then for my baby to be pushed away like that when I got her in the car seat I also notice her pamper was put all wrong it was  going in her …. Just did be in the look out and be prepared with a plan B if you take your kids in specially baby’s because they have to be at their level

At first everything was OK. As a 1st time parent I feel as if I let alot of things slide. 1st problem was I put my child in a new sweater to go to the daycare and that same day he did not return with it. I asked staff and there answer was they didn't know. Came in one morning to asked about my child's sweater again the owner over heard me asking and said she knew what I was talking about and it would be found long story short never got found. 2nd I started seeing scratches on my child was told it was a defense mechanism from other kids when they are being attacked lol ok. Then I was being notified my child was biting another child I didn't really care because my child was coming home with scratches and that was his Defense Mechanism. 3rd he lost his Other jacket he wore almost everyday there hmm was told from the owner she knew who could have taken the jacket. Wow. Long story short never got the jacket back. 4th thing is my child always came home sick always. Like I said I'm a first time parent so somethings where understandable so I never brought it to there attention because this is a daycare full of kids and germs. 5th thing I picked my child up one day and was immediately notified at the door that my child had a fit and scratched his face up really bad. I gasped and was pissed off no phone call was made or incident report was givin to me that day. Got the owners number again had a meeting with her just for her to respond she gave me the incident report the day of the meeting that being the next day. Also said she would reimburse me for the sweater and jacket that was lost. I ended up going to get my child a 20$ jacket and she reimbursed me for that. As for the sweater it's getting hot down here and it wasn't in season so didn't get anything from that. Oh and during the meeting i was told i was going to get a cropped picture of when he scratched up his face never got that. I asked about the picture again when i sent a receipt of the new jacket i bought him she never responded to that part of the message. 6th thing was my child came home with pink eye and that's when I had enough lol I texted the owner asking why it was this white mark in his eye (little did I know at the moment it was pink eye) her response was about a text she sent me last week about redirecting my child about something at the daycare it had nothing to do with wat I asked her. I kept my child home because he had pink eye. When I was bringing him back I was getting questioned by one of the staff was he supposed to be there and what not she was rude about it and her staff started acting funny once I approached situations about MY CHILD! Old ladies! It was getting to be too much losing clothes, coming home sick every week, scratches on my child, never got the footage of my child scratching there self which led me to believe it wasn't true. Cool little place but staff where always clueless. And they started acting funny towards me my last days dropped my child off. It was like if you acting funny towards me idk what you doing to my child and that was the end of that I'm coo. Old lady or not.

The Director and staff are EXCELLENT.  I couldn’t have made a better choice than Loadz of Love for my babies! Both my kids are in school now, but they love going back to daycare every chance they get! The love shown there is amazing and they TEACH!

I just want to say I absolutely love Ms. Jenn and the ladies at loadz of love, the love and care they give my babies is beyond what I could imagine. Anybody who know my kids they don’t attach to just anybody and my babies run in giving hugs to the ladies when they open the door. I almost get jealous because they be so ready to leave me lol but I love it because I know they’re in good hands. Coming from a mama who never used daycare and had to put her infant in daycare, these ladies eased my mind every time with the ease of communication and reassuring me that the girls were good. I absolutely love these ladies and I know my babies are in the best hands possible. I could never thank them enough for taking care and loving on my girls.

So I was definitely the parent who had the fear of daycares and was on a search to find placement ASAP. However I prayed about it and checked out Loadz of Love must I say my baby has been in good hand and safe!!! Excellent daycare and staff ❤️
Great early learning opportunities for kids

"We are so proud of Mrs. Nikki's Childcare & Academic Center! They recently completed their CACFP Administrative Review and came out with no findings. This shows the level of care, organization, and dedication they put into their program every day. Families can feel confident knowing that Mrs. Nikki's Childcare goes above and beyond to meet the highest standards while providing a safe and nurturing environment for children."

review_text: This has been the best daycare service I ever had for my son. We started with them when they first opened and have been so amazing and wonderful to my son. The staff at Texas Jump and splash have been accommodating for my child and also for myself. Thank you to all the staff there !!

review_text: great staff

I cannot brag about this learning center enough! I really wish I have enrolled my son here from the very beginning. I don’t see myself ever reconsidering enrolling my son here. Great, genuine caring staff, professionalism, organization, every A+ feature there is possible is going on at this learning center. My son even rush’s me and his aunt to drop him off at school. That alone shows how much of a great time he’s having, NOTHING compared to his last childcare. Without a doubt I recommend everyone enrolling their children here. Huge shoutout to all of the staff and management you’re all doing a wonderful job!

Today was our boy’s Pre-K graduation at Blooming Daisies, and it was such a proud and emotional moment for his mom and me. He started at just over a year old, and the journey has been nothing short of amazing.

Ms. D has done a phenomenal job building a nurturing environment, from the school itself to her thoughtful selection of staff. The teachers are outstanding....more like family than faculty.

Our daughter is now enrolled as well, and we’re excited for the years ahead, confident she’ll enjoy the same wonderful experience.
Our 3 yr old has been enrolled for a year. He is learning so much and has flourished at this school. We are very grateful for the love and care that they provide our son.

Our children absolutely love going there every day, which speaks volumes about the warm and nurturing environment they provide.The staff are truly exceptional,kind, and caring, and clearly passionate about early childhood education, making us feel so calm and confident about the care our kids receive.
The center itself is always clean and safe, and we're so impressed with the engaging, age-appropriate activities that keep our children learning and growing. Blooming Daisies Learning Center truly feels like an extended family, and we wholeheartedly recommend it to any parent seeking a place where their children will be loved, nurtured, and prepared for a bright future. The Owner is doing a great Job 👍 Ms Dee. Thank you for all you do.

Blooming daisies is such a wonderful learning center! My little brother and sister, who are just two and three years old, have been attending here, and it's been such a wonderful experience for our family. The staff is incredibly caring, patient, and attentive to each child's individual needs. They create a warm, safe, and stimulating environment where my siblings are always excited to go each day.
The activities are engaging and age-appropriate, helping them develop new skills while having fun. I love how the staff keeps us updated with daily reports and photos — it truly gives us peace of mind knowing they are in good hands. Overall, this daycare feels like a second home for my little ones, and I couldn’t be happier with the care they’re receiving. Five stars all the way!

We have honestly had a wonderful experience at Mockingbird. The teachers are amazing — warm, attentive, and clearly dedicated to creating a fun and engaging space for the kids. Communication is great; they keep us informed and are very responsive, which we really appreciate.

It’s clear that our child feels comfortable and happy in the classroom. Seeing the excitement around daily activities and the friendships being built is incredibly reassuring. Overall, the environment and culture the team has created feel very positive and intentional. We’re grateful to be part of such a thoughtful community.

100/5 stars. Everything is so wonderful: teachers care so much about each child, are so well educated, and enthusiastic everyday. The extra community after-hours events make it really feel like home. Our son enrolled at 19 months and after only a few months here, says full sentences, is so outgoing with everyone, and excited to go to school everyday. It's also very convenient that lunch and supplies are provided. You get what you pay for in childcare, and Mockingbird is truly the best of the best.

We love Mockingbird! Our grandson (2y9mo) studies here. Whenever we receive pictures or comments from the school/teachers, and see our grandson happy and playing with his buddies, we realize how fortunate we are to be with them. Like today... it rained 🌧 in Austin and grandson and buddies were having lots, tons of fun in a small water pool. Congratulations for the Lovely and fun place and the children care you provide!!

Mockingbird is such a unique and amazing school. As a speech-language pathologist, my team and I see kiddos in a variety of school settings, and Mockingbird is by far one of our favorites. They have some of the friendliest staff and lowest teacher to student ratios we have seen, and the kiddos are always extremely happy to be there. The teachers are kind and welcoming, and take the time to collaborate with outside providers, such as myself, in order to make sure the students are all successful both socially and academically. I cannot say enough good things about this wonderful school.

This school is the most wholesome child-centered place I’ve ever seen. It’s filled with the most caring staff I’ve ever met at a school. The owner is an amazing person and truly cares about the kids, parents, staff and the school altogether. Kids are treated with kindness and respect and they’re learning so much about critical thinking in a natural flowing way at a young age. Their meals are thoughtfully planned out. The kids are so good at creative thinking and building. It’s not overcrowded with kids and that gives it a better feel to it, better energy and positive feeling all around there. Everything is clean, organized, safe and has well-thought out spaces. If you get in, you’re lucky, because each staff member is carefully selected and they each bring something unique to the school but what they all have in common is that they truly care about kids and are the most kind gentle childcare providers. I definitely would feel safe and have peace of mind having my child there full time. This is one amazing school and I can’t recommend it enough.

Our kids just finished up the year here and absolutely LOVED it. Shannon is such an organized school leader. Our kids were in classes with Ms. Tiana and Ms. Maria. We saw so much growth in their Spanish, independence, reading skills. The afternoon teachers Ms Fran and Ms Hope kept the kids busy and energized in the afternoon. The classes are small and focused. It is one of the calmest preschools we have ever toured. Parents are really engaged. We truly wish this school was closer to us but cannot say enough good things about the leadership and teachers!

My daughter attended lake hills from age 2.5 to age 5. Every teacher there gave her support, love, and understanding but also structure. She had the same teacher the whole time in the under 3 classroom and the same teacher when she moved into the 3-6-year-old classroom. She is now going to elementary school but still wants to visit her teacher on the weekends. We had a wonderful experience and I would recommend to anyone.

Unfortunately, the Westlake & Lakeway area is very limited with Montessori and full-time childcare options. LHMS boasts a great facility and a well-trained staff. The children are mostly happy and that is top priority. Most of the parents have grown increasingly frustrated with the school - particularly the administration staff and owner. The classroom size continues to grow and the quality of education is suffering as a result. 27 children to one lead and an assistant is far more than what any parent signs up for. Lake Hills Montessori would not be my first choice for preschool but, given our family's needs and preference for Montessori, it fits the bill. We will not be returning next year.

We LOVE Lake Hills Montessori!  My five year old has been attending LHM since Fall 2017 and has had a great experience.  We've noticed a very positive change in her attitude about school, her confidence and independence, and her happiness.  She even asks to go to school on the weekends!  The teachers are extremely knowledgeable, kind, and open to working with us on anything that we need.  The school is clean, organized, and well run.  The entrance and playground are AMAZING, with a faerie garden, play houses, swings, vegetable garden, trees for shade and more.  It's just beautiful!  We love all of the after school events that make LHM not just a school, but a wonderful community.
Delete review

5 stars for the actual curriculum and my children’s experience. The Montessori curriculum is fantastic. The facilities are sweet and engaging. The families are diverse and intelligent. However, I am giving 4 stars because the turnover rate for the teachers and staff was outrageous. The common denominator for these departures was the owner. I hope she’s become more generous or that there is a new owner.

We have had a great experience with children’s courtyard of Austin. The center has always demonstrated love and support to me and my child. I am very happy and grateful to this center.  She has learned skills in so many areas. She has also experienced the skills of speaking in different languages. This is from a proud and happy mom . Thank you Children’s Courtyard for everything.

LOVE CHILDRENS COURTYARD! My daughter is currently attending there and has been there for a year now she loves the teachers and management and so do i! They were amazing with her for her first day and making sure she is comfortable and have been amazing with her since! Even on days i ask if she wants to stay home she says NO! She is ready to see her friends and teachers and have fun !

I can’t say enough good things about CCY Metric. My daughter has flourished and grown so much in the 2 years she’s been there. All the teachers are friendly and know all the kids by name, even the ones not in their class. We love Ms. Alexis, the director. She’s super responsive, friendly, and always has a pulse on what’s going on within her school.

Our son has been going to Children's Courtyard on Metric for about six months now since our previous daycare closed.  He loves it, and we're really happy here.  All the teachers in the preschool building seem to know all the kids, even the ones who are officially assigned to another class.  I love the family atmosphere that creates, and all the staff seems to genuinely love the kids.  Ms. Alexis, the director is a big part of that.  She's very warm and friendly, and will stop and talk to me in detail about how my son is doing.  We were nervous when we had to leave our previous daycare, but it's such a relief to have found a place where our son is thriving.

Children's Courtyard on Metric blvd has been and continues to be a wonderful daycare for my son. He started there as an infant and is now a toddler. Ms Clarissa who is his main teacher, is carrying, patient and very kind, my son absolutely loves her! Alexis is the main director, she is very professional and genuine, she shows a sincere interest in my son and seems to really care. The place is clean and safe and the staff seems to be happy to work there, which is a very important key point. My only slight disappointment is that the prices on the brochure do not reflect the actual prices, I was under the impression that they had a part-time option, as it says on the brochure but it seems not to be the case. Other than that confusion, I am very happy there and will be sending my third soon to be born baby there, hoping Mrs Clarissa will be his teacher :) I think they all deserve gratitude and recognition for taking care of our precious babies and making them feel safe and fulfilled. It is not easy to leave your child to "a stranger" yet this daycare is very trustworthy and makes me feel at ease. I recommend it a 100%

We couldn’t be happier with this daycare. Both of my children have been attending since they were just 3 months old, and the care they receive is great. The staff is warm, attentive, and truly caring. Communication is excellent, the curriculum is well thought out, and they do a wonderful job teaching good manners and social skills. We feel very confident and grateful leaving our children here every day. Highly recommend!

My children have been attending RVCC for about 3 years and we have loved our experience. The staff is loving, caring, and responsive to both of our children’s needs. I couldn’t imagine a better place for my children!
We have had a great experience with RVCC.  The teachers are kind and do a great job caring for our son. The team is understanding and very easy to work with!

My child comes home happy everyday from RVCC, and that is everything to me. I know she's receiving a curriculum that expands her knowledge, and I love the picture updates of the constant activities they do throughout the day. Mrs. Natasha does a great job loving on our baby!

We had such a great experience with the RVCC! We used RVCC as backup care for our 8-months old son for about two months and were just in awww by this amazing daycare. All the teachers were very nice and caring. My son was so happy to go to daycare every day and also looked relaxed and happy when we picked him up. We hope we can send him again via backup care or even enroll him in the future. Thank you again to Ms. Natasha and the entire staff 🥰

My daughter has attended Leafspring at Sonterra for 3 years now. They’ve been supportive from bottle feeding through potty training. My toddler loves her class with Ms. Alex who is super kind and helpful!

Our three children spent three years here, ranging from the infant room to after school care. From day one it was always felt like home. It was such a comfort going to work every day knowing our kids were being loved and taught in a safe and educational environment. If you're looking for a great childcare experience in the northern San Antonio area, LeafSpring School has our family's heartiest recommendation!

My 4-year-old daughter attended the Gold Room at LeafSpring School at Sonterra for nearly a year starting in Fall 2024, and we had a truly great experience. She still talks about her friends and misses the school every time we pass by.

What I appreciated most was how comfortable and at home the kids felt. Rather than big events, the school focused on meaningful daily routines where children could learn and build relationships. That really mattered to me.

My daughter even called Ms. Erika, the director, “Mom” because of the warm, loving care she gave to every child. If I have the chance, I would definitely send my children here again.

Can’t express how great this group of teachers are. They make us feel like family and our kids love the classrooms, the huge gymnasium, playgrounds and the fun activities. Our 6 kids have all enjoyed LeafSpring over the years and are excited for our next generation to enjoy this amazing school.

Absolutely Love Miss Rebeka& Miss Jezra for the babies. They adore our daughter & are patient with her as she is learning to walk/express herself. My favorite part is the personalized genuine care they have for our baby. Over 8 months of our daughter spending time with these ladies & we can tell she’s happy.

Pulled my child out this week.  The staff turnover is insane. I liked almost all of the teachers there but they all would end up leaving. 4 teachers quit these past 2 weeks.  That's when I said enough is enough. The owner is awful and mean to the employees. I know because the teachers would tell me. It's sad because most of  the teachers and directors were so nice and caring only to see them leave after a week or couple of months. Such a disappointment.  Be nicer to your employees then you can actually keep staff and maybe you would have more kids or the kids would stay!!! No one wants to drop off their child to new teacher every week or etc. Ridiculous!

Been here for a little over a year. We love it here! Teachers are awesome! My daughter loves Ms Meme and Ms Rona. They care for and love her like she was theirs. She comes home always singing a new song or telling us about shapes and letters. The support staff is great as well and never miss a beat.

My children have been here for a little over a year now and they love it. The staff is awesome, very patient and they keep the center clean. I never have to ask the staff how my child’s day was because they beat me to it every time. They do a very good job at keeping the parents informed, which I appreciate. I know that my children are in good hands when I leave them at SOA!

I've had my son here for a little over a year, and so far he has really enjoyed it. Miss Rona in particular has been a great teacher to my son. The staff is friendly, and the owner seems like a stand up guy. All in all, this is a good childcare facility.

As a resident that backs up to this center, I would be scared to leave my child here.  I can only see what goes on outside on the playground and only imagine the neglect inside.  The staff are never interacting with the children unless they are yelling in an ugly tone from the table that they sit on while playing on their phones. The adults dont seem too approachable and as a parent of 5 children, I would never allow my children to step 50 feet near this place. Parents, these are babysitters not teachers!!!!! These other reviews must be employees or friends of them.
Love this daycare . My kids have been going there for years  , there very friendly and they keep good communicate with you about all incidentes and the stuff is very good with the kids.

Our day-to-day lives here in the parish of St Catherine of Sienna should be his primary and secondary concern.

If just one member of this flock decides to leave the herd and wonder off, that should be his focus. Not Russia or Ukraine. It's not just me that has this concern. I know there are others. We must all lovingly share our concern with Father. He is Shepherd of our flock. He is a man of God. However, we are also children of God and at times we need to course correct and it is our duty to speak truth and humbly address this with the leader of our parish. We are not doing anything wrong by doing so.

This was the message of Christ.   Christ's also lived in a world much larger than his. However he focused on those around him (his flock).  He loved them.  He taught them. And at times, he correct med then.

Christ sit down and slowly weaved a whip to run the money changers out of the temple. Imagine that scene if you will.  Imagine what Christ was thinking as he slowly, methodically, weaved the whip.

He then slowly walked into the temple and began turning over  tables full of spices and other products, chickens frantically scattering and livestock ran, He whipped men and others buying and selling in the temple, it would have been a chaotic, violent and bloody scene.

Jesus felt the need to do so. He was sending a message. The house of the Lord is holy. It is not a place of money changers. It is a place of worship. God has given the authority to the priest to shepherd God's Flock. It is a heavy.

Jesus's ministry focused on those souls around him. He did not speak of troubles in foreign lands. He spoke directly to those in his community. Then he sent his disciples to speak directly to others in cities far away. He didn't stand on a hilltop and deliver the sermon on the Mount by speaking about people living in Egypt or those in Africa. He spoke directly to the congregation directly in front of him.

By doing so  his message spread like wildfire. If we focus on those around us and share how Christ is positively impacted our lives, we will spread Christ's message the same way.

They update it consistently throughout the day, making us feel like we are always in the loop. Whether you are moving to the area or are a local looking for child care, you can't go wrong with Happy Bunnies!

Happy bunnies has been a wonderful, clean and safe environment and learning experience for my daughter. I brought her here for the convenience of my work and schedule a flexibility which, if you are looking for something that is flexible, this is the place you need to check out. Magdalena was incredibly sweet and willing to do what it takes to make sure she helps you the best way she can. She is a hands-on director and is involved in everything when it comes to the center and children. All of the staff and teachers are hands-on and help out around the best way we can for each other this is a community oriented facility. Thank you so much happy bunnies for everything you have done for my daughter!! 10/10

Our daughter attended this school from the time she was just 4 months old until our family had to move to Michigan, and I can say without a doubt that this was the best decision we ever made for her care. The director and staff are more than just caregivers; they are true partners who are deeply invested in the children and their families.

They treated our daughter as a unique individual, not just another child. They knew her favorite things, her little quirks, and always greeted our entire family by name. It was clear that the children there are not just a number or a dollar amount—they are genuinely loved.

This school was a lifeline for us. They were instrumental in helping our daughter reach her milestones and provided incredible support to our family during difficult times. As a parent, safety is the number one priority, and I always had complete peace of mind. The facility is secure with cameras, and the staff is incredibly attentive to both the children's needs and parents' concerns.

Leaving this school was one of the hardest parts of our move. If you are looking for a place where your child will be safe, cherished, and nurtured, I cannot recommend them highly enough.

I would like to warn other parents from having them children be in care of here. I pulled my kids out within 60 days. Would have been a lot less than that but per policy I have to give more notice. With my oldest who I took out with a few weeks. We told all staff that he was autistic and non verbal. We were told that there were trained on the basics of having children on the spectrum. Which was not true so we pulled him immediately. Then our middle child all of a sudden started coming home very angry and hungry. His lunch box and snacks unopened and untouched. They never helped him with his things even when he asked. They gave me ‘there’s too many children for us to help them all’ A parent told me that they don’t refrigerate the kids food. They leave them in their bags for them to grab them during lunch. So all of the fruit and veggies are sitting in a warm bag for hours. My middle child all of sudden started biting and being very aggressive at home. Telling me and his dad that kids would hit him and bite him first and that when he would so the same thing back, only he would get in trouble.

The cleanliness is extremely concerning. The trash is always overflowing, kids walking about with poopy diapers, sticky wet tables and floors.
Attached is how many times we were warned about Hand Foot and Mouth. Three separate dates. If their cleanliness was up to date, kids wouldn’t be getting sick every week. This is my first day care in this state, I’ve never encountered such cleanliness problems until now. My kids are sick every week like clock work. This never happened at other facilities The security is non existent. I can bet you any dollar amount, you can go in at any random day, the front door will be open and both doors to access the kids rooms. Today’s day and age where kids are dying in schools, you would think the director would be more concerned about security. There’s been two teachers in less than 60 days that have left. They will hire someone else and not tell them whose kid is who. I went to go pick up my kids multiple times and not having any clue who the new teachers were. No introduction and didn’t ask me questions when I picked them up. Extremely dangerous, I could have been anyone coming in grabbing a child. Also for security reasons there should be a heads up on new people that’s hired and they should know parents faces and names.

My middle childs teachers are never there so I never got to hear about his day. It’s very rarely documented. Even though when we toured, we were told pictures and videos every day, what they ate exactly, what times and potty changes etc. The first two weeks yes we received that, then they got lazy with it. Only when asked is when things would change for a few days, then they would go back to their original ways.
Our middle child was recently diagnosed with autism and adhd, again none of his teachers, assistant manager or director was ever able to receive it because they’re never there. They never answer the phone, text or email. Lastly, losing property. I’ve had to replace now two pairs of shoes. They ‘lost’ a left croc of my youngest and the left of his adidas shoe. Saying there’s no way it could be there, even though it’s pictured him not wearing it in the middle of the day and a hour earlier with it on. Thankfully, my case worker is refunding me the money from the last payment to this place to replace both pairs. I really hope this place gets it together.

Carolyn is so sweet and is extremely helpful. She made me feel welcome & that I was in a safe place. Also l, she is extremely organized & swift with the entire process. (My apologies if I misspelled her name )
Been able to get sack lunches for me and my son 2 times a week and I am so happy for the help!!! Even have a very nice clothing closet that you can go to once a month.

Here, your kids are in good hands with the whole staff. They have an excellent after-school, summer, and literacy program.  My kids have been with Mr. Ricky and Mrs. Johnetta at the center for 7 years.  They are kind, patient, and caring. They always go above and beyond to make our kids feel safe.
The food they pass out is usually not safe to eat (meat and cheese at room temperature) and the clothes offered is all sadly garbage. Bless them for trying though.
This center has been a Blessing for my client and those in his neighborhood. This is a huge help for our Senior Citizens and families just needing a little help to get through each month.

OPERATION_NAME: St. Mark's Catholic Preschool and Nursery
review_text: The line up for drop off is unnecessary and ridiculous, the director Melanie was helpful in the beginning of signing up our child for school. Once we made the deposit, and I called and emailed numerous times for questions, she never responded back to me. Then on the first day of school I ask the teachers to apply sunscreen to my child along with turning in the over the counter signed paper with directions for applying sunscreen.  Melanie finally decided to give me a call as it was only a burden on her end to have the teachers apply sunscreen. She proceeded to try and give me pointers on caring for my child. She finally allowed the teachers to apply sunscreen only after we said we would escalate it to the priest. There are  two teachers to the class, only 5 hours per day with the kids. Wish we had a better experience but the lack of communication and Melanie trying to teach us how to care for our child was the final straw.

OPERATION_NAME: St. Mark's Catholic Preschool and Nursery
review_text: I was so happy once my son was enrolled in St. Mark’s Catholic Preschool. It was his first time ever in any type of school/daycare setting. I wanted him to grow up around the Catholic religion environment. Now if a child is very active, I would think twice before enrolling them into this program. My son started in September 2024, he was 2 years old, turning 3 years old in October 2024. The school really seems to want every student to come already taught and not need to be taught how to act in a classroom setting. Everyday at pick up his teacher, Ms. Reyes, would bring him out and would tell me “he did good today” or “he did okay today”. She would give me pros and cons of how his day went. It wasn’t until his new assistant started, Mrs.Zak, that we started to notice every time Ms.Reyes was out and it was only Mrs.Zak, we would get told how terrible my son did during the day. Mrs.Zak also suggested to my son’s father that our son should be evaluated by his physician for any underlying reasons he may be acting out and having compulsions. This was around February 2025. Mind you we never got “bad”reports from our son until after that incident with Mrs.Zak. Shortly after that, we were being scheduled for meetings, over the phone and in person, to discuss my son. She did one conference in person, letting us know that our son goes up the slide instead of climbing down and things he does not fully to the fullest in the classroom (things that to us and his pediatrician after we had him evaluated sounded normal for a 3 year old boy). He picks up rocks from the playground, he doesn’t sit for a long time at circle time, he plays bumper cars in line. What kind of 3 year old doesn’t sit still for a long time?! ARE YOU KIDDING ME? Do they expect every child to act like a zombie.? Mrs.Melanie also said my son is always very happy, knows everything he’s being taught, etc. He doesn’t meet the requirements of making a classroom easy for them so they just decided to drop him. We also asked for any kind of proof or footage to be seen from the classroom on our end, to see what our child is as being accused of especially since we had decided to try group therapy (against his pediatrician’s recommendations as well but to try and see if it would help him settle in class). My son, very innocently, would ask to see Ms.Reyes every day and wants to go to school to see his friends. He was very eager and excited to attend every single day. I decided to look at the reviews for the school. I saw that another mother went through a similar experience like I did with my son. There’s also a ratio of 2 teachers per classroom. We pay money for our children to go to this preschool to be taught, not to just give up on every single child who doesn’t fit the easy route. My son wasn’t also given warnings. We were never told if he continues doing this he will get kicked out. We were just finally told he had two weeks left in this school and that’s it at the first in person meeting. I didn’t even feel comfortable with him finishing out the reminder of his two week and we pulled him out sooner. I was concerned about possible retaliation towards him as it seemed he wasn’t wanted as it was. I wonder how many other children have been kicked out of this school because of these types of issues. I’m pretty sure there are more families out there but only two so far have spoken up. They stressed me out as a parent thinking I failed my child, when in reality it was them. They don’t have the patience and compassion to be working with children. Please do your research before sending your child here. Thank you God, for this blessing in disguise. My child won’t be somewhere he isn’t wanted or welcomed.

OPERATION_NAME: St. Mark's Catholic Preschool and Nursery
review_text:
My children had an amazing experience here. I’m so thankful for the teachers and directors. My youngest had a very difficult time adjusting  to school and they were so kind and communicative.

My kids learned so much but more importantly I knew they were safe and happy. They did such an amazing job of instilling a love for God and so many organizational skills and habits.

I am truly thankful and wish they had a kindergarten I would have stayed longer if I could have.

I will continue to recommend this to all my friends if little children.

OPERATION_NAME: St. Mark's Catholic Preschool and Nursery
review_text: I was heartbroken when St. Mark’s Pre-School decided to cease service and teaching to my two year old daughter. This was her first time in a school setting ever. The reasons I was given were that she was unable to stay in line without holding a teachers hand and did not stay sitting down the entire time during circle time. For these instances, my daughter required too much one on one time. The director Melanie was also mortified that my two year old seemed disoriented at her first fire drill. She’s TWO. I was never notified of these actions until I reached out for a parent teacher conference on Friday, October 13th and by Monday, October 23rd she was unable to come back to school. My meetings with Melanie were mainly over the phone, one in person, and neither one of her teachers attended. I never heard any of the feedback from the teachers themselves. My husband and I explained we would practice walking in a line as well as imitate circle time for when we read books at home and we were willing to help in anyway we could to which Melanie responded, “you can’t bring school home and you can’t bring home to school”. She did not care that we were willing to help. No documentation from my daughter’s actions were provided, no true explanation, no warnings that she was going to be ceased service. They completely gave up on my daughter and did not give her time to adjust as she only started school on Friday, August 25th, just turned two in July, and only attended school three days a week. She went to school for 24 and a half days total. That’s how long they gave her to adjust. I’d also like to add there were only 9 children in her classroom and 2 teachers.  We are extremely disappointed and I will not recommend St. Mark’s to anyone moving forward.

OPERATION_NAME: St. Mark's Catholic Preschool and Nursery
review_text: St. Mark's has an excellent preschool program. My grandson is currently in  his third year at St. Mark's. He always looks forward to going to school. The teachers welcome the students every morning enthusiastically. The school is committed to preparing the children for Kindergarten. With half a year to go my grandson is well prepared for Kinder. He knows the primary colors, shapes, letter names/sounds, small words and can count up to 20. All aspects of the school are well organized and run smoothly.

My daughter been attending Lobo Active Learning Center for the past 4 months she just turned tow years old. I get daily handwritten reports on what she ate and what she learned each day,  (this is not just daycare they follow a curriculum). My daughter has progressed in so many areas of development but most excitingly she is talking now. She loves her teacher Ms. Alyssa and absolutely adores Ms.Connie, Ms. Irma, and Ms. Tammy. My daughter and I love this place, it’s a wonderful feeling knowing my daughter is in great hands especially with such small class sizes
My daughter is enrolled in daycare and we love having her there! She’s so happy and everyone truly seems to care for her.

My son has been dis-enrolled for almost 6 months & has not attended since, but I am still billed every week with a late fee. 😅

We dis-enrolled because we were “accidentally charged” an extra $75 for 2 weeks straight and no refund was ever given.  if that gives you any idea of the billing system at Lobo. Emailed and called several times, no answer. The owner is probably the least nice person I have ever dealt with. Maybe they will still bill me even when he goes off to college. Who knows?

They called me once to tell me they were charging me $25 because my son never showed up to after school care…when they were the ones who were supposed to pick him up! Lol after so much stress, we figured out he was actually there all along and no one had accounted for him. How crazy to call a parent to notify them of the extra charge (but not that the child was missing) without confirming first. There are a lot better options for after school care in the Clear Lake area. 🙂

We love Lobo's summer camp. My son is neurodivergent and also have a genetic disorder and has received such great care these last two summers. The coaches and staff are wonderful and we especially love Coach Connie. I am always hesitant to leave my son anywhere because of his disability, but Lobo has been such a safe place for him to go. I highly recommend them!

I have 3 kids, 15yr old, 12 year old, and a 4 year old. Last year I started taking my 4 year old to LOBO when she was 3 years old to get child interaction with children her age. It has made such a difference! The classes are school based with childcare. They always have playtime and school guided style activities to do. She loves school. Her verbal skills and awareness has improved so much. The staff if super flexible and reliable. I've never had an issue with them. They communicate her areas of improvement and also things she may need to work on. The staff are so loving and kind to the kids it's like a second family. I couldn't be more happy to have found them and my daughter is thriving here. I would recommend 100%.

We absolutely love and adore MCC Infant Center on Brookwoods Dr.!!! My son has been attending since he was 5 months old (now 14 months) and we have had the best experience. We recently moved to Katy and were so sad to leave. If we wouldn’t have moved I would have kept him here throughout preschool. MCC was our first daycare experience and I couldn’t have asked for a more warm, welcoming, and caring environment for my son. The teachers and staff truly care about the children and treat them as if they were their own. Everyone at the school is amazing, but I’d like to give a special shoutout and appreciation to Ms. Veronica in the Lavender class! She is truly passionate about her job and loves those sweet children so much. I always loved the fun and creative activities she would do with the kids and really appreciate the great advice she would give, as I am a first time parent and truly respect her. Can’t say enough great things about MCC!

My son started daycare at MCC when he was 2 months old, he is now 14 months, and we absolutely love it here! I can say that just like any first time mom, I was so nervous about leaving my child to be cared for by someone other than me, but that nervousness quickly subsided when I saw how warm, welcoming and accommodating the staff are. The teachers and staff are so friendly, always helpful and I love the activities they do with the students. The staff have always been very accommodating to our son as we transition through his different stages and have been quick to respond to us when we contact them. The classrooms are always clean and I like that the daycare is located in a small setting in a safe location. I cannot thank the entire staff at MCC for providing a safe, caring and excellent experience for our little one. I can see how much he enjoys being with his friends and teachers by the smile on his face when he arrives.

My baby attended MCC since he was a newborn and we are so very thankful for the teachers and directors of MCC. The teachers, specifically Ms. Karina and Ms. Cynthia, have been so wonderful in respecting how I (as a very particular first time mom) wanted things done for our baby. They are professional and respectful of boundaries but also deeply invested in the kids in their class.  Our baby is happy to see Ms. Karina every single day.  I know my child is safe, well-cared for, and that Ms. Karina will always have an open communication with me about my child's day.  Definitely recommend this daycare and encourage all parents to be open about their needs/wants for their children, with MCC and any school, so the teachers can rise to the occasion.
They are kind, follow instructions, and have reasonable prices ($790 for a 14 month old).  My only complaint is that the hours of 7 - 6 are short.
Never answer the phones

As a first time having my daughter away from me, I really love this head start center. Ms. McClendon is very prompt with communication and an available leader. Mrs. Ana is super friendly!
My babies teachers, Mrs. Webster & Ms. Ball are amazing!!! Super informative regarding my daughter… Knowledgeable on children’s early learning and simply caring with the babies. 20 out of 10 I highly recommend here for safety and family feel! Thank you Tidwell Head Start for making families comfortable and such a welcoming environment

I strongly recommend this school. They are professional and student centric. I was very impressed with how they've maintained their mask mandate for the children and staff, and continue to do temperature checks each morning. The center is clean and welcoming. Thank you to Ms. Washington, Ms. Swann, Ms. Robinson, and Ms. LeVeaux, all very wonderful and professional. No complaints at all.

We love our head start. The staff is so friendly and attentive to the children.my daughter loves going to school here where as she didn't like it at here other school.  Thank you Ms. Francis , Ms. Washington, Ms. Mary and staff

My son started out as any other child would, he can definitely be a hand full but all though out the year they have worked with him and I couldn't be happier with his process, I'm so proud that my son attends here.
This place is kind of hidden behind some some trees so be careful when you trying to find this place
My baby go here and he LOVES it! I love the fact they got the cameras and everytime I check on my baby he’s having fun! It makes me so comfortable, it’s a relief! I love everything about them.🤍

I can’t say this daycare is bad. It’s a blessing to have this lady name bre!! She is awesome with the kids! If it wasn’t for her I would not let my niece attend!! Thank you for all you do bre!! If I could give more stars I would!!!

My 5 year old had been going here for almost a year now. Absolutely love it. Have never had any issues. My daughter loves all her teachers and gives them hugs everyday when she has to leave. In the summer they do field trips and activities.

If I could give zero stars, I would. This daycare is extremely negligent and unsafe. They failed to complete a background check on a teacher in the infant class, and my son was being abused — I personally saw it on the cameras. He even ended up with an eye injury due to lack of supervision. To make matters worse, they asked me not to report the incident because they “couldn’t take another hit.”

This experience has made me fearful of ever leaving my child in another daycare’s hands. It has caused my child trauma, and if you pull their incident reports, you’ll see this isn’t the first time something like this has happened. Please investigate and shut this daycare down before another child is harmed.

The pictures are a lie they had moldy bread and they had nasty very unsanitary sheets for the baby's to sleep on... The people was nice but at the same time, I wouldn't be putting child in that place of environment at all. There was also a sippy cup half full of milk that looked like it was sitting for some days and there trash was on over load... Look don't do it it may be cheap.daycare but to what expense. The staff seemed great but the cleanliness was no way for children to be. I will be reporting this place to whatever to whoever.

Recently just attended their Easter event
Let me just rave about how welcoming and nice the volunteers were!
They provided family friendly activities
Love that they encourage everyone to make a jelly bean cookie.
Lovely atmosphere..I'm all here for those trees
They provided hot dogs..cooked perfectly...that was very generous everything they provided for all families.
We would love to visit the church during service this Sunday!
Come to hear and enjoy our new Pastor (August 2025) Will Cotton. He is the epitome of "down to earth"

I believe in God. I believe in a Judeo-Christian God. Born of the Virgin Mary..suffered..dies on the Cross.. after 3 days resurrection happens and Jesus now reigns in Heaven at the right hand of God the Father.  Please see our great church and people.  We wear casual clothing and have fun in worship. Methodist is a very unstructured protestant religion. We would welcome your visit for sure.  Please see us online too.  Thank you.
Pastor Lupina is the best! Welcomed us with open arms.

My husband and I went to Northern Hills United Methodist Church for the first time today. It is such a warm and welcoming church family. The Pastor preached an awesome sermon based out of the bible. We loved it and plan to go back next Sunday. We learned about this church when my husband was in the hospital and they came to visit him and prayed for him. He had never been in the hospital before. It touched his heart that they cared about and for him and they didn't even know him. We are blessed and thankful. We truly felt peace when we went through the church door.

They take great care of my kid and are very commutative about any situations that are coming up. They have a lot of great events for the whole family to come and hang out with my kid. And they even have parents night out events.

Kiddie Academy was not the first daycare my child attended, but I truly wish it had been. We chose to move her to Kiddie Academy because of the impressive curriculum offered, even for young children, as well as the structured environment. Additionally, the turnover rate here is significantly lower than at her previous daycare. Over the past couple of years, we have seen her confidence and academic skills flourish.

In the beginning, I was that mom who would call almost daily for reassurance and to check in, even with camera access. The staff was always more than willing to reassure me that my child was doing wonderfully. There’s also a convenient app that keeps us updated on our child’s day, including details about potty breaks, meals, and fun photos.

I have had very few concerns since my child started here, and whenever I did, the management team promptly addressed and resolved them. The owner has even reached out to follow up with me, which I greatly appreciate. I always feel heard and respected as a parent at Kiddie Academy, and the teachers are transparent and honest regarding our children’s progress.

I can confidently say that the 3A teachers treat each child in their class as if they were their own. They go above and beyond, using gentle learning techniques and redirection, which I consider a significant advantage. I also want to highlight the engaging summer activities offered, such as hands-on gardening, bubble wands, chalk art, and splash pads.

In summary, I wholeheartedly recommend Kiddie Academy to any parent seeking a diverse, curriculum-based, and safe environment, complete with camera access.

From Wife: We absolutely LOVE Kiddie Academy! Our 4-year-old son has been attending for over 3 years now, and it’s been such a wonderful journey. One of the things we value most is the camera access—it gives us so much peace of mind to check in and see him learning, playing, and interacting with his friends throughout the day. The care and attention he receives is truly exceptional. Even after moving further away, we continue to make the drive because the quality of care and education is absolutely worth it. The leadership team is amazing, and the teachers are caring, professional, and genuinely dedicated to the kids’ growth and happiness. We completely trust this school and feel so grateful to be part of the Kiddie Academy family

My 6 year-old has been going to Kiddie Academy since he was 6 weeks old, and my youngest followed in his footsteps. Even though he’s now in kindergarten at Brookwood, we still use the before and after school program to help with our strict work schedule. We are able to drop both our kids off at 6am sharp while having peace-of-mind that my child will be shuttled safely and on-time to school. Ms. Melissa and Ms. Ashley always welcome us with warm smiles in the morning. The kids love all their teachers, the youngest even plays pretend at home and calls me “Ms. Dinora, Ms. Alyssa or Ms. Bri”. My oldest asks to go say bye to Ms. Stephanie if she had to float to a different classroom. It takes a village to raise a child, and I couldn’t do it without Kiddie Academy being a part of my village.

My child has been attending Kiddie Academy of Clear Lake for a couple of years now and we love this facility! The rooms are clean, we can view the classroom on their private camera, and the splash pad in the summer is a huge bonus! My child has learned so much while at Kiddie Academy! Teachers like Miss Meagan and Miss Emily have helped my child blossom. I know we'll be ready when kindergarten begins, and that gives me a ton of peace of mind. I cannot recommend Kiddie Academy of Clear Lake enough!

This place was amazing!
For context.  I don't feel like there are very many places for indoor volleyball where you can just show up and play and work on your own without a coach/team.  I showed up with my daughter yesterday (our first time there, but I heard they had volleyball open gym and I was hoping to run some drills with her).  I talked to the man at the front desk and asked if they had volleyball open gym because at the time everyone was playing basketball, and he replied "sure we'll get a net down for you".  They had a suspended net system, so within seconds they had a court ready to go. I was really impressed with the  net system with the ref stand attached as I have only seen that at 2 other places. We will definitely be coming back!
We had a great time at Light the Night by Power of Love church

MI3 Center is a well organized and professional facility offering a positive experience for visitors. The space is clean, modern, and thoughtfully maintained. Staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful, making everything run smoothly. Convenient location, efficient service, and a welcoming atmosphere make it a reliable place for programs, events, or appointments.
Good place to, watch some good basketball games
Love this place. We come here every January and it's a great facility

WHPP is a really special preschool. My three kids have always been so loved and well taken care of. The staff wonderful and the play based curriculum had my daughter so well prepared for kindergarten after Kinder-Bridge at WHPP

I’ve had children at this preschool for 8 years, I’ve felt gratitude every day to have them in such a loving, safe preschool with a caring and attentive staff. My children have been nurtured, celebrated, and loved at WHPP. They have learned all they need to learn to be ready for kindergarten, and the teaching happens in such a fun, developmentally appropriate way with a tremendous emphasis on play-based learning. In my experience, the teachers and staff are warm, accessible, easy to communicate with, and willing to help troubleshoot issues. There are many wonderful families at the school, and along with my children, I’ve formed cherished friendships through the years, due in part to the school’s sponsored events such as Family Fun Night and the annual Moms’ Night Out. I would highly recommend this program to others as it has been such a great spot for our family.

I have put two kids through Westlake Hills preschool and it’s been such a joy. The team of educators and supporting staff is truly amazing. They are so passionate about creating a nurturing and enriching environment for the children. Both my kids thrived in the Kinder-bridge program and were so ready and excited about starting elementary school.

WHPP is such a special place to me and my whole family. The years I have had my child enrolled at WHPP (4) have created memories I will treasure for the rest of my life. I am grateful for the school, teachers and all of our families at our sweet school. This is truly a school I can say with all my heart, God has built.

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Crest Academy of Camino Bandera
review_text: My child has been attending for a few years now and excelling at this center. Ivy Crest has provided a safe, nurturing, and enjoyable place with busy activities throughout the day for my child. Having camera access brings sense of security allowing me to view my child’s wellbeing at my convenience. The curriculum has prepared my child to master his basic skills and more. We love the centers monthly themes and activities for the families to join in. Also, Ivy Crest feeds the kids more than other centers I’ve seen which includes breakfast, AM snack, lunch, PM snack and then again fruit at 5pm. Lastly, although staff has changed frequently similar to many other centers, this has not affected the focus of my child’s care. Ivy Crest continuous to meet the standards I seek in a school for my child.

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Crest Academy of Camino Bandera
review_text: I just signed my twins up to this daycare and already looking for another one. Where should I start. The communication is horrible here between the whole staff. When we got there the director had us in the office talking about payment, and late charges. Yesterday was my first day. The teacher sent me a message in the portal about change of clothes and pull up. When everything was already in the backpack, but the front office didn't tell her yesterday. Again we just started it havent even been a whole day. The other reviews warned us about this place. When I called to get more information was told one thing and turns out it was a lie. The director told me about how they are still same as kids r kids. Even the hours are the same just longer breakfast. Turns out everything was lie to get me to enroll.They shouldn't had never change from kids r kids to ivy biggest mistake. Please take this as a warning and go somewhere else. You will be regretting it like I am right now. I wish this will let you do zero stars because they don't deserve one star. They will keep charging your card for every issue even if the mistake is on them. Please go somewhere else.

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Crest Academy of Camino Bandera
review_text:
We couldn't be happier with Ivy Crest Academy for our 3-month-old  From the moment we first toured, we felt a sense of warmth, professionalism, and genuine care that has only grown stronger with time.

For our infant, the peace of mind knowing she is in such nurturing and attentive hands is invaluable. The caregivers are incredibly gentle, responsive, and clearly adore the babies. We receive regular updates and photos, which truly makes us feel connected throughout the day. It's clear they prioritize her comfort, safety, and early developmental needs.

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Crest Academy of Camino Bandera
review_text: We have had nothing but a great experience with Ivy Crest. As a first time parent finding a place that you feel can trust with your child is such a big comfort. We can tell that our child's teachers enjoy and care for our child. Highly recommend looking into Ivy crest. 😊

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Crest Academy of Camino Bandera
review_text: If you are a parent (especially a new parent) and are looking for a daycare that you can trust, you should truly consider this one. As a parent of 4 this daycare has been a life saver. I have trusted this daycare with my four kids for over 3 years, I have an older one who comes for summer camp, the other 3 are all in diapers and are here full time. I have a 3 year old and two babies in the baby room. The babyroom teachers (samantha and evelyn) are amazing, and send me pictures and updates of my babies all day long. My 3 year olds teacher (Crysten) has helped pottytrain him and he loves her. When your kid runs to their teacher happily each morning it makes your days so much easier. I can just tell the teachers really do love and care for my babies. I also have the choice to have access to the cameras here, so I can check on my kiddos all day long. The director Kelsey is amazing and so is Amber. I am so thankful to have a place that I can trust with my kids. It has helped me relax as a post partum mother knowing they are safe and being watched by those who truly care, its not just their job. They actually care. Just cant imagine my kids anywhere else.

My son attended NAMS for almost two years and we had an overall very positive experience. He joined their young toddler group at the age of 15 months and thrived during his time there. His teachers were kind and caring, and he was always happy to be there. As a parent I also had a great experience with the school admin, they were accessible, responsive, and very helpful.

Our son attended North Austin Montessori School for 2+ years. The teachers and staff were exceptionally kind and wonderful. They made our family feel welcome. We felt confident that our son was in a safe and loving environment that fostered learning and curiosity. We would recommend NAMS to any family considering enrolling their child in a preschool.

Our son went to NAMS for 2 years and he loved it. He liked his classmates, teachers, and the montessori style learning as it offered freedom to learn and discover what he enjoyed. Every week our son gets to take home and show us the artwork they did for that week and talk about what they learned. There's also plenty of volunteer opportunities for parents, and the excitement our son has when we visit the school during the day is priceless.

As parents, we were happy that he liked his school so we didn't have to worry too much, but it would be nice if they had a way to update parents throughout the day. I would say that was the only downside. And lunch/snacks are not provided by the school.

My daughter started attending NAMS when she was 3.  We saw immediate improvement in her communication, manners, and behavior.  She is now 5 and loves her school, her environment and her teachers.  My son just started attending last month, he is now 15 months old and we saw similar results.  He is using more words, already holding a spoon correctly, and doing great socially.  We looked at many school before choosing NAMS.  We have been pleased with the education, and caring that both of my children receive.  The children gain independent thinking and their creative habits are encouraged.  I plan to keep both of my children here through first grade.  I love knowing that my children are getting the education, and love they need while I am at work.

I highly recommend Montessori and especially North Austin Montessori School.  My only feedback for full time working parents is the amount of time they have off during the year.

NAMS has been great to work with. The teachers are wonderful and really care about the kids. This was the first place that my child has been in childcare, and they patiently helped him adjust to being away from home. I feel safe and happy trustIng my child to their care. The school is also conveniently located near the library and a park, which is a nice bonus. The classrooms were recently renovated, and are beautiful and child-friendly. I’m looking forward to spending several more years with them.

This school is absolutely amazing.

You know your child is at the right place when they smile and are excited to be left at school. The Children’s Place at St. Andrews constantly went above and beyond. The director is top notch, our child’s teachers were fantastic, really the whole staff was always superb and very friendly.

If anything was particular with our kid, the teachers were excellent and professional and would tell us about a preferred toy (drums!) or that he might be getting a touch of a sickness. They made it easy to leave our child in their care, confident that he would be safe, happy, & stimulated all day.

Our child attended schools that use apps like Tadpoles; however, getting texts from teacher where you can have a substantive conversation is much preferred. The school’s daily reports worked well to keep us current on our child’s progress.

The school staff really knew our child well and were genuinely concerned with academic and social development progress.

My wife & I have to give The Children’s Place credit for helping our child develop into a curious, thoughtful, fun-loving toddler.

We have our 3 month old son here are the Day School and feel so secure and safe leaving him everyday, it's a dream come true. His teachers love on him and spoil him as if they were us! I admit I have snuck a peak in the window when they thought I had left and I saw it for myself. They "oohed and ahhhed" and smiled and talked to him and snuggled him like a family member would. I know he is in good, loving, safe hands every day, and will be for many years to come! Love this church and this school and everything about it!

We have been working with St. Andrew's Children's Place for a number of years, and can't say enough about the friendly staff and administration! A lovely place for children to learn and grow. We highly recommend a visit!

I have amazing experience with building blocks with Ms.Rachel and Mr.Cameron and their team in summer camp !!!
They really did awesome job for us
My 6 y.o son really loves them
And highly recommended this place

An amazing center for your children! Such compassionate and trustworthy care, we are grateful for to have you here in our community.

Would recommend calling to schedule a tour before all spots are filled.

Love Ms. Lisa, Ms. Nell, and Ms. Delouis! They are great with the kids and dependable! They've helped so many families. Love this daycare

This place is a real hidden gem!

It’s long overdue to give this review to one of the best experiences I had with daycares. This place is amazing to say the least. The staff from the directors (Mrs Terzah and Mrs Shannon) to the teachers Ms Jessica and Ms Maria are all amaaazing. I never felt anxious to leave them there for the whole day. Most importantly, my kids loved going there. Although my kids brought their own meals due to food allergies, their menu is by far the best nutritious meals I have seen and I am a very picky mom when it comes to food with my kids. The environment at Hope Day School has helped our daughter build confidence, advance her social skills, and succeed with potty training thanks to their amazing support.

I found this school based on the experiences shared by other Google reviewers, and I want to add my voice so that whoever reads this can feel even more confident about sending their children here. They’re truly wonderful.

When my son began his journey at this daycare two months ago, it was a thrilling new chapter for both of us! I have been truly amazed at how much my son has blossomed since starting here! It's heartwarming to see him learn and grow in such a nurturing environment. We couldn’t be happier with St. Michael’s — it’s a very special place.

Both of my girls adored their teachers and the director. They came home confident, joyful, and proud of who they were. I couldn’t have asked for a better start to their learning journey.

I spent a long time searching for a day school that felt like the right fit for my daughter - and then we found St. Michael’s! We absolutely love it. The small student-to-teacher ratio allows for such personal attention, and every single teacher and staff member knows my daughter by name. The environment is incredibly warm and joyful - the kids always look genuinely happy, and most importantly, my daughter is thriving.

Since starting at St. Michael’s, she’s come out of her shell, grown in confidence, and learned so much. As a parent, I also appreciate how involved we’re allowed to be — there are plenty of volunteer opportunities if you want to engage more closely with the school community. Couldn’t recommend it enough!

Pros:
