2)Mrs. Susana’s open communication was something I really valued—she was always available and willing to connect whenever needed.

Cons:
1)The main reason we left was due to the school’s closure schedule. Unfortunately, we no longer have the flexibility to accommodate the number of weeks the school is closed. We would have loved to stay otherwise!

2)Since Atelier is a smaller school, there are also some limitations when it comes to resources.

Despite these factors, we had a wonderful experience at Atelier, and I highly recommend it to families looking for a loving and supportive preschool environment!

OPERATION_NAME: Sun Moon And Stars LLC Learning Center
review_text:
Sun Moon & Stars has a beautiful campus and the caregivers all seem very nice. My child started here at 6 months and we switched daycares after 3 months of her being there. From an outside perspective the older kid classrooms seem great, but I do not recommend sending your infant here.
As a parent, age appropriate wake windows/nap times are very important to me. Their infant classrooms do not pay attention to wake windows. My child was often kept up 2-3hrs past her wake window. When she did nap, it was super short. This caused her to have more night wakings which then impacted my ability to show up to work ready to give 100%.
Also, the caregivers in their infant rooms speak very little to no English. As a first time mom I didn’t think that was a big deal, but then I realized not being able to communicate how the morning/night went when I dropped my child off or discuss how the day went when I picked her up was very difficult.
The caregivers are very very sweet and I could see how much they cared for the babies, it’s just a shame they don’t have the proper structure setup there.

We have since switch to another daycare, and it’s night and day difference! So much better.

OPERATION_NAME: Sun Moon And Stars LLC Learning Center
review_text:
We feel incredibly fortunate to be part of the community at SMS. Over the past several years, this has been a second home for our three children, all of whom have been enrolled since they were just four months old. They really do help raise your kids! Our oldest son just "graduated" after spending four and a half amazing years here, and we're so grateful for the journey he's had.

From the very beginning, the teachers have been exceptionally caring and attentive, providing a nurturing and safe environment for our little ones. We've been continuously impressed by their ability to foster a sense of security and belonging.

As our children have gotten older, we've watched the teachers seamlessly transition from a focus on comfort and care to a rich and engaging academic curriculum. They truly step up their game when the kids turn three or four, and the results are undeniable. My oldest two had a great potty training experience when they were ~2.5 as well. Our oldest just started at a new elementary school, and his new teacher commented on how far ahead he was in his vocabulary, reading, and writing compared to most kids his age. This is a direct testament to the fantastic academic foundation he received here.

We couldn't recommend this daycare enough. The staff's dedication to both the social-emotional and academic development of every child is simply outstanding. They've seen it all - and will help you be a better parent!

OPERATION_NAME: Sun Moon And Stars LLC Learning Center
review_text:

I am extremely disappointed in this facility. First off, I had such a high impression of this place because Its beautiful, I had spoken to the director and asked if she had worked with children on the Autism spectrum disorder, which is the case for my 2.8yr old son. She told me that they had the experience and they successfully helped these children, that they allowed the therapists to come and see them at the center, and that they had the curriculum of a preschool. I was immediately sold, until I was told about the price. I was so disappointed because it was out of my range, but she guaranteed me that this facility offered “quality care.” Even though I knew this place would hurt my budget so much I didn’t care, I wanted peace of mind that my child was going to be learning and taken care of properly. On the first day I was so excited to pick him up and see how he had done that day. And I got the news from the director who said “you know what, I’m sorry but we are not going to be able to take care of him here. We had a rough day with him.” I was so shocked, my mind thought that he was crying all day long and not complying. But the complaint was that he was grabbing papers from the wall, and walking around the facility and not sitting down, so basically my child was being curious. And if she had known, this behavior Is normal for a child on the spectrum, and honestly not bad my son Is very well behaved, quiet, keeps to himself. So It took one day, ONE DAY for my child to attend and for her to give up on him so quickly, not even give him a chance to get used to the place and an opportunity to improve, when all I wanted was for him to get preschool skills that they offered. She said “we will watch him this week, but not after that” because I had already paid ahead along with the deposit. If I’ve had known that this was going to be a “lets see if we can handle him” situation because that’s what It felt like I would have not let him stay. I was devastated because my child was ONCE AGAIN looked down upon because he is a little different, and I get plenty of that EVERY DAY. So please Alpha Academy, make a disclosure to the parents with my situation that your philosophy only applies to certain children, and not to the children with disabilities.

We began with behavior therapy, working closely with their dedicated therapists to set both short-term and long-term goals, develop effective strategies, create visual stories, and implement these plans across different environments. Every therapist we've worked with is energetic, enthusiastic, and always eager to embrace new goals. They welcome suggestions, collaborate openly, and consistently go above and beyond expectations. OPERATION_NAME: Clear Lake United  Methodist Church Preschool and MDO
review_text:
For those looking for a great, affordable childcare program the MDO/School is great. I have put both my children through this program and are still there. All the teachers are committed to helping them learn new skills and as they get older they have science lessons and learn so much! I love to hear all the new things they learn from beaver dams to planets and so much more. The infant class has helped both my babies from eating skills to crawling and walking and talking. I genuinely wished my youngest could have stayed in there longer, because they are such loving teachers. They have been such a blessing to my family, and I whole heartedly trust them with anything. Every teacher I’ve worked with have been great communicators to let me know if my child is struggling with something or are sick or having issues with another child in school. The teachers also schedule phone meetings to discuss your child’s progress. Just make sure to sign up for them! We have been through every class (almost) and I have yet to have a bad experience. It is a great little community, and we are thankful for them and their leadership.

I will say the homeless issue is a thing. Maybe I show up too late to really notice anyone, but I do see one specific woman camping out on the other side of the church. But being a homeless woman is incredibly hard to find a place where you feel safe. The church needs to focus more efforts on security for the kids to make parents feel safer. Having lived in downtown for a long time before moving down here, I have actually seen one man in the area that used to be on the streets near us 10 years ago! The city of Houston or the police I assume are bringing them over city line, and they seem to want to stay here… we should serve and help the homeless 100%. The church needs to hire a security guard at least for while school is in session to give the parents extra assurance for safety. I need to learn more about the church’s reach out program before I say anything else, but this is a new concern as of this year. It was not like this before. Will be happy to give an update in the future.

OPERATION_NAME: Clear Lake United  Methodist Church Preschool and MDO
review_text:
This review is directed toward the MDO and preschool program.

The church allows homeless people to hang out on campus which is a direct conflict to the MDO and preschool program. I have personally witnessed altercations between staff and the homeless, many of them set up "camps" on church grounds and some of them actually have dogs and I have seen them smoking.

I felt uncomfortable dropping my infant off at school and felt I had to watch my back walking to and from my car. I have nothing against ministering to the homeless community, but again, you can't have individuals that are statistically more susceptible to substance abuse and mental illness interfacing with children. If they want to have this go on, they need to have law enforcement on campus as they would at a school.

Additionally, it took several months for us to be notified by the teachers that our infant had been miserable every day in the classroom. It was upsetting that they did not try to partner with us to make her days better.

We ended up unenrolling her and finding new care. Follow your gut and do your research.

We feel so lucky to have found this incredible place. Highly recommended to any parent looking for a daycare that feels like home!

Coach Alden is very good to interact with, but a majority of interactions we've had here has just not been good. My kid, who started out eager to learn gymnastics has felt discouraged because a couple of the coaches she's dealt with, don't seem to know how to properly teach and motivate a child. Most recently, she had a makeup class during evaluations week (which I hadn't realized was happening) and after about 10~15 mins, came out crying, confidence a little shattered, and didn't want to go back in, because the coach showed her something new she hadn't been taught in her usual class yet, asked her to do it and then proceeded to repeatedly tell her she did it wrong when she attempted to do it. No gentle guidance that would allow my kid to learn and succeed and feel good about herself. I understand you don't have the time to do it during evaluations week, but the alternative of just telling a child she's wrong is so demoralizing and not what a good coach should be doing.

When I brought up this issue to the girl sitting in the front office, Michella or something like that, she was cold and completely devoid of compassion for the distress my kid and I were in and merely stated this was evaluations week, like that was justification enough. After I pressed her on the lack of support, she offered to pass on my contact to the head coach. This lack of warmth and capacity to truly see and encourage people seems to permeate this space and neither my daughter nor I have experienced a lot of positive interactions at this place. We'll try to find a better place/people to encourage my kid in learning gymnastics.

UPDATE:  I have lowered my review to 1 star based on the owner's response. I suggest that NEG address the issues raised below with the coach re: the water bottles rather than calling my child and others campers who were there liars. My daughter did not make up the story about Coach Angel's behavior. I find her behavior and the owner's response to be unprofessional.  And as for the open gym situation, the coaches were standing around talking to one another and I didn't see anyone helping the campers with any skills. If that is an option, it wasn't relayed to the kiddos. Do better.

I agree with other reviews that communication isn’t great with NEG coaches or staff, but my daughter does enjoy the gymnastics. That’s why we decided to sign up for summer camp drop-in days. I’m extremely disappointed in the way the camp is run, esp for the amount of money it costs to attend. Coach counselors speak unnecessarily sternly to the children in an effort to keep everyone quiet and behaved. There were only 28 kids in total - the same as in an elementary classroom - so we’re not talking large numbers. Furthermore, there isn’t any gymnastics going on - no learning fun skills - just open gym time where the kids run around. After a long hot field trip day where they didn’t have access to their water bottles for a couple of hours, Coach Angel threw the water bottles of those that weren’t labeled onto the ground beside the bus/van… in front of the kiddos. I teach my daughter to be a good steward of her things, but she can’t really do that when an adult throws it on the ground and dents it. It would be easy to pass it off as a bad day, but my daughter and I both had uncomfortable interactions during the week. None of this is a recipe for fun summer camp vibes. I do not plan to ever book an NEG camp again.

We recently started tumbling classes for my daughter for her cheer team. We have been very impressed with the coaches who are working with her. They are knowledgeable and very encouraging.  We like how they divide out the girls with those that know more than others in the class. The facility is clean and well-equipped, and the class sizes are small enough to ensure every student gets personal attention. What I appreciate most is how the instructors balance structure with fun—they push the kids to improve, but always in a supportive way that builds confidence.  My daughter always leaves in a great mood and is smiling throughout the class.

We decided to register our daughter for a different after school and summer program next year and we won’t be back. We really wanted to do NEG because she loves gymnastics but the people here really took the joy out of it for her. She was crying daily when we picked her up. She was always “in trouble” simply for being a kid. She and her friends would say things like “camp is supposed to be fun” and sharing how they get yelled at constantly by Coaches Angel and Lexi. Everyone we know has stopped attending for the same reason and she doesn’t have any friends here anymore. I hope they fix the culture and climate so this can someday again be an engaging, fun and appropriate gymnastics facility for kids.

The coaches here are incredible—not only are they skilled and supportive, but they also build genuine connections with the kids.

We recently had her birthday party at NEG, and it was fantastic! They had everything we needed for a stress-free, fun-filled celebration, and having the entire gym for the party made it even more special. The kids had an absolute blast!

If you’re looking for a top-notch gymnastics gym that fosters growth, confidence, and fun, this is the place. I highly, highly recommend NEG—it’s full of great people who truly care about young athletes!

I have read some of the other negative reviews from years ago and that has definitely not been my experience here. My children have always been safe and loved well here and are excited to come to school.

In my experience in the years my children have been here, this has been a healthy and safe space for them.

There has been one occasion where I had a small concern come up but I respectfully had a conversation with the teachers and changes were immediately made for my child's specific needs. I can attest to this as I checked the cameras to make sure those needs were met after our conversation and I saw a clear improvement as it was no longer an issue.

If you are considering enrolling your children at this location I would recommend coming for a tour-observe how the teachers interact with the children, and how the children respond to them. It's also always a good sign when the director knows where every child is, knows every child well, and spends time with the caregivers.

Our daughter has attended CCY-Alliance since she was just shy of her 3rd birthday. We were super nervous placing her in Daycare, as her entire care was previously with us at home. When we went for our tour, it was immediate the vibe I picked up on. The Director, Nikki knew where every child's class was whether inside "soft play" or on the playground and who their parents were. It made us feel assured we were choosing the correct facility. The teachers are also very caring and attentive. They treat her and others as if they are their own. We as a family can only say great things! Our Daughter is now in their Pre-K class and all I can say, is THANK YOU for every single teacher who has been on her early education journey - she will be going to Kindergarten with an abundance of knowledge beyond Kindergarten level!! Its definitely a family feel facility when you enter. WE LOVE OUR CHILDRENS COURTYARD ALLIANCE

OPERATION_NAME: Grace Christian Academy Early Learning Center
review_text: This place has been such a blessing! My children have learned so much from the teachers here; way more than I had ever expected. I love that this is a godly environment and that all the staff have been so great to work with. If I ever need anything or have a question, Miss Carissa is always available and is quick to respond. I know my children are in great hands here. If you’re looking for a high quality school for your infants and toddlers, Grace Christian Academy Early Learning Center is your best bet!

OPERATION_NAME: Grace Christian Academy Early Learning Center
review_text:
My child was in the infant and 12 mo+ rooms during the time enrolled. I loved the daycare at first but started noticing tension and there seemed to be staffing issues (teacher to student ratio).

I felt that parents were not notified of issues in a timely manner if at all (ex: wasp infestation in the classrooms). When I called to request more information, the assistant to the upper school's director left me a voicemail stating 'They were aware and looking into the issue." No notification and the issue continued ongoing and I only found out through other parents who saw them in the classrooms.

I started noticing my child would cry and cling to me when I would drop my child off (an outgoing baby, has been in daycare since 3 mo old). I started looking into other daycare centers as there are no cameras and I was concerned for my baby.

I felt like my child was a number. When I called to verify my child's last day the director still did not act concerned we decided to pull her and instead asked if we would like to pay the balance on our account (for those two weeks).

I have heard many issues from other parents. I would never trust again to leave my baby here due to neglect of the director.

OPERATION_NAME: Grace Christian Academy Early Learning Center
review_text: This place is not a daycare it is a babysitters club. I started taking my child when she was 3 months old and pulled her out at 11 months. There is no structure or schedule. They were feeding her lunch at 3 PM and letting her sleep whenever she wanted to. They did not read books, sing songs or teach the children anything! They have to push the swings in the infant room manually b/c they are too lazy to put batteries in them. The director Dolly should not be in charge of running this place. She does not care about the children or the employees. The employees refer to her as the "dragon".  When I decided it was time to move my child to a real daycare she didn't even ask for a reason or mention she was going to miss us. We are now enrolled in Bell's Little Angel's and it is the best choice we have ever made! She is learning sing language, Spanish and has a schedule they follow every single day. PLEASE do not waste your money and take your child to Kids World Academy.

OPERATION_NAME: Grace Christian Academy Early Learning Center
review_text: We love GCA ELC! We started sending our youngest (2yo) there in October 2020 and love the staff/director/teachers. He loves going to his "big boy school" every day . They are an accredited early learning center and have different schedule/payment options for PT vs FT to work with the parent's schedules unlike some of the bigger daycares in the area. Very happy with our decision to send him here.

OPERATION_NAME: Grace Christian Academy Early Learning Center
review_text: This is a great facility. My daughter is 20 months, she loves going to see her teacher and her friends at KWA everyday. Everyday she gets to do reading time, coloring time, music time, bible reading and eat good food and snacks and much more. They work on her daily project, learn good moral values. Me and my family we highly recommend KWA for anyone looking for learning environment.

Hello parents, visitors, and prospects. This is Mr. Andre, one of the directors with 2nd Step Daycare and Learning Center, a place where your child truly can grow. First, we would like to thank you for taking the time to stop by and provide an honest review related to your experience. Speaking of honest reviews, we have noticed a user account under the name "wanda smith" frequenting our page and leaving bogus reviews. This individual has had no business dealings or affiliation with our services. Should you come across a review from this individual we ask that you ignore it as it is not authentic in nature. Thank you.

Family. Community. Love. And Passion.

Since my son has attended 2nd step I have felt at ease knowing as a first time mother I was leaving him with people who would not only make sure he was cared for, but also that he was safe. Everyone at 2nd step has always supported me and helped me get assistance when I was in need. The teachers communicate with me regarding anything concerning my son and everyone is very attentive to each child’s specific needs. The facility is always clean and neat. My son is excelling at two years old I’m always so proud of his progress, I know he’s learning and well cared for. If you are thinking of placing your child here at 2nd step always know your child is in great hands!

My name is Vanessa and my daughter Analia attends 2nd Step Day Care center.  When we moved into South Dallas in May 2018 I really wanted to find a good daycare center for my daughter. I was very iffy bout moving her from Desoto .I began to tour most of the 5 star daycare centers in South Dallas and was not convinced. I drove off of I35 noticed 2nd Step Daycare scheduled a tour.  I then looked into the reviews and figured they had a 3.7 review but I cared less bout the review. Because the minute I stepped a foot in that Door Ms. Williams made me feel comfortable and welcoming. I then got to meet the other two directors. Ms. Shionarie(Hope I spelled it correct) is one who has that bubbly talkitive and full of Joy personality she assured me my baby would be well taken care of they answers my 1000 questions with no hesitation. They are all awsome and about Mr.  ANDRE definitely not rude he's just more serious and quite and throws the smile in when needed but always welcoming. Talk about the CARE it's AWsOme. They always have staff to cover all the kiddos and the Directors are always a part of the care as well. I can go on and on about how good this place is.  My daughter has only been there for 4 months and she has learned how to sing  her ABC count past 10. Can point out most of her body areas, sing, nap,  manners, potty training etc.... Best place ever for anyone's Kiddo to be at. Ms. Sharon who is the immediate person to care for the Toddlers she's one of the best Child care providers ever.  My daughter even calls her Mommy. AWsOme Care, indiduals and Team....💞 ❤️👍❤️💞

Spoke with a supervisor by the name of Mr. Andre, he had to be one of the rudest men I have ever spoken to in my life. Extremely unprofessional and actually told me he was too busy to assist me with my questions about the facility and hung up in my face. In my opinion if I were going to do business, conduct business, or if I want to bring in business, its a REQUIREMENT to show the upmost respect to prospects and business people. I give 3 stars because I know ladies who work here and they themselves have always been pleasant, so I will not hold them responsible for their managers horrible conduct. Mr. Andre, sir, you should definitely work on your customer service skills.

I LOOOOOOVVVEEEEE THIS PLACE! COMMUNICATION IS EXCELLENT! Staff keeps you highly informed about the needs and care of your child (ren). The new facility is absolutely BEAUTIFUL! VERY CLEAN! Staff is very loving and nurturing!! I could go on and on and on about how much I love this place! But I'll keep it short, sweet and simple! This is truly a place where your child (ren) can grow and learn! I've even grown myself being able to utilize the entities of the church! I highly recommend 2nd Step to any parent! You've tried the rest, now try the BEST!

My daughter has been going to this daycare for over 7 years, and while I miss some of the staff from Linder and was initially uncomfortable with the change Maggie and Debra have helped me with my decision to stay.  Maggie is always available and honest and definitely cares about the children at Growing Together. If the director is not there,  then I want to talk to Maggie. She immediately addresses any concerns and is always available for questions. I appreciate her years of experience at this location and would be lost without her.  I know that she loves my daughter and definitely addresses parent concerns. Yes, there is new management and yes, there are new teachers, but the priority is still the kids and to me that's what matters.

For Halloween, they did an activity at the facility and they are always doing something fun for the kids. They even brought in Santa! The after-school kids have the best summer with plenty of fun activities DAILY! I am grateful for the calendar of events because it's hard to keep up.

My son gos to this school and he got bit by a kid twice in the same day and they lost the shorts and underwear to this outfit and  this is not the first time he got hurt at this school since he been there he comes home saying I got hit bit scratch by one kid that bit me whenever I ask what happened the teacher says i don’t know

My daughter has gone to Linder for about 3 years and it’s been wonderful. Academically she is very advanced and emotionally she is learning important life skills like sharing etc. The staff is very caring and responsive and observant. They will tell me immediately about any concerns and I am grateful to all of the staff for the excellent care they provide for my child.

As a first mom everything is being noted. As I did my tour this morning And enrolled my 7 month old daughter everything was great. First and for most the school is clean and bright with colors. The staff are all excited to meet your little one.  The infant room teachers are so far so great ! My daughter is mixed and we are looking for someone who can instill Spanish into her on the daily bases. I asked her teacher if she could only speak to her in Spanish and she was excited to do so. The best thing about the morning tour is being able to see how the teachers react to a child who is having a troubled morning. One of the infants were crying and she calmly spoke with her, reassured her she was okay and the baby continued to play. Also the little ones were crawling all over the other teacher on the floor with them which demonstrates so much love. By the time I walked out Ms.Deborah showed me the camera screens and there is my daughter right there with the teacher on the floor. I love the fact they also have an app for camera access throughout the entire day, finger printing and pins for security purposes. I can not wait to see how she loves it a month from now!

This daycare is the best! My daughter has been attending the daycare for before and after school care and summer care since June 2018. I have not experienced any issues with the staff or services provided. If you're on the market for a great place to care for your kids - look no further. Your kids will be in great hands at Linder Young Learners Academy!

I can’t say enough great things about C2C! I have three children who have been attending for the last two years, and from the very beginning, I’ve felt completely at ease knowing they’re in such caring, capable hands. Ms. Lanny, Ms. Deon, and Ms. Sophia are absolute gems—they’re not just professional, but also incredibly loving and always so attentive to each child’s individual needs. It’s clear they genuinely care about my kids’ growth, happiness, and well-being.

The summer camp experience is amazing! My kids look forward to the weekly field trips to places they absolutely love. It’s such a great way for them to learn, explore, and have fun outside the classroom, and they come home every week with so many exciting stories and new experiences.

I also want to mention how wonderful the Pre-K graduation was. It was such a heartwarming event, and you could really feel the love and pride from the teachers and staff for all the kids. It was a moment I’ll never forget.

What I appreciate most is how this daycare truly treats my children like family. It’s a warm, nurturing environment where they feel safe, loved, and valued every day. I couldn’t ask for a better place for them to grow, learn, and thrive. I highly recommend this daycare to any parent looking for a top-notch, family-oriented center!

My baby has been attending C2C for about a month now and we love it! As a first time mom, sending my baby to daycare was a very scary thought but the updates every couple of hours + the staff’s warm spirits have made it a smooth transition. My baby is loved, well-fed and happy while my husband and I are at work. The daycare is about mid-range as far as costs goes but there’s no amount I wouldn’t pay to have peace of mind that my baby is alright.

I have 3 children that have been going to C2C for over a year now. I absolutely love them! They are extremely family oriented and each employee is dedicated and polite. I have always been so picky when it comes to daycares and my anxiety is very bad when my children aren’t around me.. but I can honestly say I feel good knowing that they are in the care of such amazing people 🩷

My daughter loves this school so much! She wakes up every day excited to go. As a single parent, I couldn’t have chosen a better school for my 4 year old. C2C truly makes you feel like family. This is her second year and we’re having a ball in pre-K or should I say “JR KINDER”….. she’s learning so much while also making wonderful friends. The teachers create such a caring, fun, and safe environment, and it really shows in how much she enjoys being there. We couldn’t be happier with the experience!

My son started going here when he was 9 months old and soon he will be switching to the pre-k 4 classroom! Our experience at C2C has been nothing short of extraordinary. As a first time parent, I was terrified to send my child to daycare after hearing countless “horror stories”. However, enrolling my child in this facility is a decision I will never regret. The environment is loving, diverse, clean & up lifting. All of the staff are very hands on and attentive to the children and I never have to worry about my child’s safety. I recommend this daycare to anyone and everyone!

I recently enrolled my son, who has Trisomy 21 (Down Syndrome) and is non-verbal, at Primrose School at Ridge Park Drive, and I cannot express how grateful I am for this amazing team. As a parent, I was very hesitant at first, but from day one the entire staff — Miss Melissa, Miss Brittany, Miss Kianna, Miss Michelle, Miss Rivas, and Miss Kaitlyn — have shown incredible care, patience, and attentiveness toward my son.

He settled into his new environment within a week, which says so much about the genuine love and dedication the teachers pour into their classrooms. The school is also extremely communicative about his health, daily progress, and how he’s doing overall. I always feel informed and reassured.

I highly recommend this school, especially for families with children of different abilities. Primrose at Ridge Park Drive has created a safe, nurturing, and inclusive environment, and I’m truly thankful for the way they support my son.

My 1st born son started Primrose of Copperfield at the age 15 months back in August this year because I was pregnant with number 2 due in November and I wanted a place that would help him be able to learn, be active and be better attended to since It was getting harder for me to be able to tend to him. Primrose is amazing. They took in my little one with much care, knowing it was his 1st experience in a daycare around teachers and other kids that he’s never met before. It took a couple weeks for my son to get used to me dropping him off but during that transition time the staff was very supportive especially when it came to allowing him to have his blanket and pacifier when needed. Primrose also is wonderful with communication. I love what the kids learn here and how everyone is treated. My son unfortunately has to move to another daycare because of distance but I really wish we could stay.

Just moved our daughter to the Copperfield location for private pre-k. I also have my four month old daughter in the infant classroom. The infant teachers have long tenure at Primrose and are so great with the babies.
The faculty is wonderful, too. The director Ms Brittany is so sweet and helpful and my kiddos (and i!) LOVE Ms Carter. So glad we found them

My child attended Primrose of Copperfield from about 1 year through preschool. It’s a safe and clean place with really kind staff and people! They also hosted also holiday events and programs and invited us parents to watch and attend.
Would definitely recommend this facility for child care.

I am very happy and proud to be apart of the Copperfield Primrose family! I was nervous to move my 3 year old daughter to a new school, but she seems so much happier at the end of the day! My daughter LOVES the director Ms. Brittany, and both of her teachers Mrs. Diana and Ms. Semien. I love the pictures I receive throughout the day of what they are working on in class. She has already learned so much with the curriculum they offer. Overall, we are EXTREMELY happy with Primrose and highly recommend. Also, if you're questioning if Primrose is the right school for your kids, LOOK AT THE OUTSIDE PLAY AREAS! So beautiful, soccer is my daughters new favorite thing to do!

I cannot say enough good things about Heaven Lottle Angels! As a parent, finding a safe, nurturing, and stimulating environment for my children was my top priority, and this center has exceeded my expectations. The staff is incredibly caring and attentive, making my kids feel comfortable and loved from day one.
My child has had such a positive experience at this daycare; the staff are patient and kind, and they really focus on each child's individual needs.
My child absolutely loves this daycare; the staff are wonderful, and the activities keep them engaged and learning, it's a fantastic environment.
This daycare has been amazing for my child’s growth and happiness; the teachers are wonderful and create a fun, loving environment.
This daycare has a wonderful and friendly atmosphere; my kids love going there every day, and I can see how much they grow and learn here.

Mrs. Eboni and The Learners Nest Academy are truly in a league of their own. From the moment you step inside, it is clear that this is not just a childcare center, it is a place of excellence, intentionality, and heart. Mrs. Eboni goes above and beyond in every way imaginable. Her leadership sets the tone for an environment where children are not only cared for, but genuinely nurtured and prepared for success. The entire team reflects her high standards. They are warm, attentive, and exceptionally well trained. You can feel how much they care in the way they engage with the children, creating a safe, loving, and structured environment ... even as soon as you walk in the door to TOUR! It is rare to see this level of professionalism paired with such genuine passion. The center feels LIGHT and not heavy like some of the others around the way. I have never seen a childcare setting operate at this caliber. The Learners Nest Academy does not just meet expectations, it surpasses them at every turn. I am beyond grateful for the peace of mind and confidence I feel knowing children are in the hands of such dedicated professionals. If you are looking for excellence in early childhood education, look no further. The Learners Nest Academy not just a Texas Rising Star's 4-star school but they are the gold standard, and Mrs. Eboni and her team are the ones making it all possible.

The BEST around!! I cannot begin to explain how wonderful this daycare has been. We found out right before school was set to start that my son's previous daycare would be closing and we had roughly about a week to find a new one that would be able to do pick up and drop off to his elementary school. We freaked out at first but we got right into looking and touring. The director, Eboni was so welcoming and showed us around and explained everything to us. We chose them because they made us feel the most secure. Since then, they have exceeded expectations and always are welcoming at morning drop offs and evening pick ups. Communication is always on time and every staff member is amazing! There are some days where my son doesn't want to let go in the mornings of me or his dad but he is told verbal affirmations by staff and always welcomed with hugs! Plus they are certified 4 star Texas Rising Star program!!

My son went here for a little over a year before starting elementary school recently  and always came home happy. I was very pleased with the staff. They remembered us personally and kept me updated. The teachers love their kids and don’t just watch but actually play and interact with them. Mrs Eboni (owner) goes above and beyond to make holidays special and holds events for the kids and parents at the school. She bought all the kids christmas gifts and you can tell she enjoys what she does.

This daycare will always be a 100/10 for me. I love that they dont hire just anyone watching my kid. My baby learns so much everyday, it amazes me. I work from home in upper management, and i can work and attend my 1000 meetings a day without having to worry about if my baby is ok.

I have been working in early childhood education for over eight years and have seen the ins and outs of different cultures within centers. Now that I am a mother to a handsome boy finding a forever home was importance to me. I’ve had my ups and downs with trying to find where I know for a fact that I can grow as a individual and where my son can have a foundation where he can be in an environment where he can meet all milestones. October 2024. God lead me to The learners nest Academy. Where I am a preschool teacher and my son is in the toddler class. We have been here for a year now. And will stay until my son ages out! TLNA is more then just a “daycare” The structure. The cleanliness. The core values. The professionalism. The compassion. The foundation. Meets everything I was looking for AND MORE. Hands down. If you are in the north Houston area. And you’re looking for a home away from home. TLNA is immaculate.
And I am beyond honored to be working for a mom approved black owned business.💗

OPERATION_NAME: The Fellowship Kids Day Out and Preschool
review_text: Such a welcoming, diverse, humble place. Walking the property, seeing the deer feeders, the trees, the iron kiosk,   the simple but intentional architecture, brings me peace, as soon as I get here.This is the type of congregation that is the perfect size, not too big to isolate you and not so small that there aren't enough activities to choose from.  Pastor Royce is without a doubt a gift and a blessing to all. Under his direction,  Ministries help locally and internationally.  Volunteers are consistent, disciplined, they truly give it their best effort. Many of them even bring happiness to do chores playfully.  I personally attend a couple of places for spiritual reasons because I  travel for work. I can honestly say this is one of my favorite spots to recharge mentally, spiritually and to gain a humble perspective to face life's challenges as a blessing.  Thank you FOSA

OPERATION_NAME: The Fellowship Kids Day Out and Preschool
review_text: The Fellowship of San Antonio is by far the kindest, most caring, and loving church. Pastor Royce and O’Brien are amazing. Pastor Royce welcomed my family and I the first time we visited. It is such a privilege to hear and learn more about the Word of God taught by these pastors. They are humble, honest, and teach straight from the Bible. I absolutely fell in love with everything about this church.

OPERATION_NAME: The Fellowship Kids Day Out and Preschool
review_text:
This is a great place to be on Sunday and meet people and share.
I would recommend anyone to come and feel at home. Pastor Royce is one of the best who talks and explains the word of God and Jesus. This is a simple and joyous way of sharing. The choir does a great job of working together to praise the Lord.

OPERATION_NAME: The Fellowship Kids Day Out and Preschool
review_text: Wonderful church my family has been coming to for years best kids program that actually teaches the bible

OPERATION_NAME: The Fellowship Kids Day Out and Preschool
review_text: I love the Fellowship Church. It is just what I feel like the Church of the New Testament was meant to be. Pastor Royce preaches the written Word of God. He takes the time to personally meet & greet all the members of the congregation every Sunday. The people are warm & friendly. Our Sunday school teacher is outstanding. It is truly like being a part of a community of Faith.

As a parent one of the most nerve wracking things you can do is trust someone to care for your child. I am a first time mom and constantly anxious when leaving my daughter with anyone. The Playspace made me feel calm and confident leaving my daughter. Every time I come and pick her up she is happy and engaged. The level of care and thoughtfulness the owner has instilled in her staff and the space is apparent in everything. We are so happy to have this as a childcare option.

Very clean space and just the right size for a drop in play center. The staff called me when my son (he's 2) was inconsolable and made me feel like they really tried to comfort him while he was there. He did fine after the reassurance they gave him.  I appreciated the staff listened to my instructions for my sons nap time and also I noticed they made sure the older kids were careful when younger children were in their same play area. That really worried me when I chose this drop in center but seeing that first hand really made me feel more comfortable with dropping my son off here in the future.

Highly recommend The PlaySpace for your next kid birthday party! I ended up booking the space last minute due to cold/rainy weather. Lindsey was very easy to work with and accommodating. Marsha was the person who helped with the party on the day of and she was all hands on deck  to help out wherever we needed her. Great with the kids and just all around sweet lady! My son's party was awesome and everyone had a great time!

I bring my son here maybe once a week when I need to teach a last minute class or run errands. I love the girls here and how they treat my son. He has trouble speaking, and is extremely shy around other kids. He’s 2 but still only says a few words, he had very severe tongue ties and he had surgery on to correct.

I wanted him to learn to socialize and open up more, so that was my main reason for bringing him here. There are times when he’s overwhelmed with noise and they take the time to comfort him, put headphones on him, etc.

All the ladies working here are super nice and they are so great with kids. My son used to cry when I would leave and now he runs right in. 🥲 It’s nice to see him becoming more social and it’s all thanks to the ladies that work here. 🫶

I feel so lucky to have found this place. I am a hairstylist in DFW and this is probably THE MOST convenient daycare situation in Fort Worth. I dropped in last night for my son’s first experience (19months old) with other kids and being left alone without mommy and daddy and all I can say about how it went was -FLAWLESS. he had a hard time and I picked him up within the hour but the employees there made me feel like we could do this. They didn’t make it seem like a big deal and they were more than willing to work with him through his struggles. They made us feel so comfortable and welcome and I’m just feeling so lucky to have found this place. Today was day 2 and he lasted a little bit longer, but my own anxiety made me go pick him up. Everyone there today was a different set of employees & AGAIN I felt so welcome and encouraged.

Rose and buds is such a special space. Our son had never been away from home and really struggled with this transition and they were so creative, supportive, and knowledgeable on how to ease this for our whole family. Rose is truly a special human who cares so much about each child and she has built a team of like minded individuals who make Rose and buds truly set apart from any other space. The school house is adorable, clean, and always has creative activities planned to keep the kids learning and engaged. We would highly recommend rose and buds to anyone looking to start school for their little ones!

My daughter went to Rose and Buds and we all loved the whole experience there. She loved it so much we signed her up for summer camp as well. Rose and all the staff are lovely and take such good care of our kid and kept us up to date. It was such a joyful environment and community we are still in touch with the families that we met there! Thank you Rose for caring for our little one!

Rose and Buds is such a wonderful, caring environment that it’s hard to find the right words. We have grown with Rose and Buds from the start and have had nothing but an incredible experience. Our beloved teacher Rose has been a caring, committed, and incredibly understanding figure for our daughter during major periods of growth and development. If you’re looking for a low teacher:child ratio, beautifully and thoughtfully designed space, emphasis on care and love and emotional learning - this is it.
We love Rose and Buds! Rose creates such a warm and caring atmosphere for all the kiddos. As the name would imply, there’s a large emphasis on play and open ended learning, which my kid thrives on.
Rose and Buds is a warm, close-knit preschool.   Their focus on play and outdoor learning, while fostering a nurturing atmosphere has been the ideal first school for my son.

I am beyond grateful to have been able to enroll my son here. This is his first year there and even though it’s been a few months. I cannot tell you how happy I am with how great things are going. He loves to go to “school”. He has learned new words in his vocabulary. I receive pictures of his activities during the day. Communication is key and the staff communicate great with me at all times.

The director Bianca should not be working with children. She man handled my son under her care and edits footage when it’s convenient to her. I was 6 months pregnant when I tried to talk to her about my son, and she got aggressive with me. My husband had to tell her to back off, because she wanted to use force on me just like she did on my 4 year old at the time. In no way should any daycare staff member, much less the director should be putting their hands on a child. Please do not send your kids here, she treats it as a prison and only lets you see what she wants you to see. Parents cannot even walk in, nor can you make sure your child is safe for the day in her care.

Love this place! I was nervous about leaving my baby to go back to work but Bianca helped me through the process by giving my husband and I a tour and answering all my questions. Ms Daisy has been amazing with my baby! My son looks forward to going everyday.

Our son has been going to this daycare since sept. The first week was hard for our son but it got easier each day he went. Ms. Daisy is such a sweet, soft spoken Director and Ms. Diana is also very sweet. Our son went from being home with us and only knowing mom and dad to running into daycare now. We couldn't have asked for a better, family oriented, bilingual daycare. Everyone there made the transition smoothly for our son as well as for us. I love how they pay attention to our child and call us if he just isn't himself. That shows us that they are very attentive and our son isn't just a number or another child. We literally visited at least 5 daycares and didn't get that home, pleasant feeling like we did when we visited here.

10/10 definitely recommend
What makes me feel most comfortable having my children at Light Of houston bilingual Academy is how Secure the pick up and drop off processes is .
Nobody has access to enter the building.
The owner Bianca is very hands-on ,she’s always a phone call away. Her teachers are amazing . overall It’s a very great welcoming, friendly, care like family environment. Ms.Bianca goes over and beyond to help accommodate her parents needs and I truly appreciate her and all her staff.

My daughter started attending Kiddie Academy six months ago. This is my first child that I'm sending to daycare and I found myself very apprehensive. The staff at Kiddie Academy has been patient and kind with both me, my husband and our daughter as we went through this transition. We have found our daughter enjoys the stimulation and experiences. Additionally, I genuinely believe the staff cares deeply for our daughter, as they are always smiling at her and encouraging her independence.

Words cannot describe my gratitude for our experience with Praveen, Ashley and the whole staff at KA. I have had two children there over 4 years (including after school program from Specht and summer camps) and have seen significant improvement in both my childrens’ social, moral and educational development. We’ve had probably 12 different teachers over the years and each one has effectively communicated via the app, sending pics and overview of the days curriculum. The school does a great job celebrating appreciation days, events and special guest visitors (firefighters, dentists, Bluey,etc). They put on an awesome Christmas program too.

I’ve seen some negative comments about Praveen. While he may have a shorter communication style, I know that him, his wife Sairah and Dr.Goshi are a great Christian family who run KA as a family business and poured their heart into their staff development and family relations. Their daughter was in my sons class.

As for Ashley, sure sometimes she may not respond for a day but give the woman a break! She is the director of a school with 100+ littles and their parents, the staff AND she is a mom of two herself.

As for “too long of nap time” comments, the teachers need a break too! You try corraling 20 preschoolers all day.

Myself and other mom friends have only great things to say about our experience with kiddie academy and their devotion to developing our children. Worth every penny.

I can’t praise Kiddie Academy of Canyon Springs enough! Teachers and Administrators prioritize the safety and wellbeing of our kids as well as communicate professionally and promptly. They go above and beyond for all holidays, special occasions and events so that we have amazing memories to look back on. Prior to Canyon Springs, our kids went to a different Kiddie Academy and I can confidently share that Canyon Springs should be the standard for all Kiddie Academies. We are so incredibly grateful for them!

We appreciated the caretakers and most of the admin staff at this location, and would have left our children enrolled here if it weren’t for the behavior of the managing director.
I’ll preface by saying that the inciting incident was, indeed, our mistake. Albeit a mistake that we had made previously due to the fact that we were unaware or had forgotten about the rule. We had a grandparent on the list for authorized individuals to pick up our children. She had picked them up previously, and had used our code to enter the facility. Apparently, we were supposed to set up a separate code for her. Completely our oversight. The incident occurred when the managing director noticed that the grandparent didn’t have her own code. She had left her ID at home (we live about a mile away from the facility), and she had to return to get her ID so she could pick up the children. Absolutely not a big deal. We appreciate that the front desk enforces such standards. Upon returning, my wife had come with the grandparent to assist in the pickup. At this time the managing director confronted my wife about allowing the grandparent to use her code. She was apologetic for the mistake, and stated she understood and that the situation would be remedied moving forward. However, the directing manager continued, to an uncomfortable degree, to scold and belittle her about the incident. He also made her physically uncomfortable as he stepped into her personal space while scolding her…which was the point that he officially crossed the line. Reminder: the grandparent is an AUTHORIZED individual on the children’s documentation. The code was not given to some random friend or acquaintance. While we completely understand the need to follow protocol, there’s no need to dress down someone over such a thing in such an unprofessional manner. Let’s also recognize that this grandparent had picked up the children multiple times without this ever coming up. She’d show her ID to the front desk staff, they’d verify, and everything would move on amicably. So perhaps the special code protocol isn’t followed as closely as his behavior would have one believe. The managing director then sent us a PowerPoint which had the specific rule he was referencing. Conveniently, I have no such PowerPoint or reference to said rule anywhere in the documentation completed when we enrolled the children. That being said, we wouldn’t have had any problem complying. It was the highly unprofessional and inappropriate behavior of the managing director that prompted us to remove our children from the facility.

We have had our daughter at Kiddie Acedemy for over a year now and it is one of the best decisions we have made. Everything from the care provided, to the impressive curriculum have fostered growth in our child. I would recommend any parent consider Kiddie Academy of Canyon Golf for their child.

My 19 month old has been attending little people's creative academy for almost a month and has learned so much. I was afraid, since he's a momma's boy, that he would have trouble adjusting but Ms. Hillard has made my son feel comfortable, confident, safe and loved. He is more verbal at home and plays more nicely with his big brother. I am glad I found this gem of a daycare and I'm positive my son is too.

I love LPCA! It’s a new center and everything is new. I love that my girls are getting introduced to academics at 6 months old. Ms. Gina is in constant communication and sends updates through out the day. It’s been a great experience!

We love LPCA with Ms. Gina! I really like that it's a new facility with all brand new equipment and materials. It's very clean, well equipped, and cutely decorated. We really like the open communication between the staff members and parents. We constantly get updates throughout the day about our child. The owner is in direct communication with us parents to ensure that we are happy, which we are! Our child thoroughly enjoys their time here and I can tell they are very well taken care of.

All three of my children attended and still attends this facility. La petite on Rayburn is just very attentive to detail on each child’s need. I enjoy how each teacher/staff grows a relationship with the children. My kiddos love the new playground and the large classrooms filled with pictures and color. Below I added a recent picture of the classes’ visit with Santa! Happy holidays 🎄

We have put our daughter in other daycares but nothing beats how rayburn dr is. The staff, security, lessen plans are simple nothing short but amazing. Our daughter is excelling and excited to go every morning and loves to talk about it after. The price is completely reasonable for the service we are receiving. I will be sending my other daughter her when she is old enough for sure.

I would recommend this place to anyone for there little ones.❤️

My daughter has been attending 2 months now and I can honestly say I absolutely love the choice I made to bring her to La Petite. In the beginning it took my 2yr old a bit to transition but the staff was super helpful and loving. Mary is super warm when coming in the morning always ready to greet. Rose is super nice and very helpful in any class room. Ms Julie and Ms Dalia have been super patient w my little one I can go on and on definitely come by and check it out, even for a tour.. Also the daycare has cameras and I can check on my little one throughout the day and have that peace of mind 😌

My daughter started up in April and at first yes I was very scared to start here. But once we did our tour we felt a little more at ease meeting the teachers and feeling the environment.  Since then she has learned quite a bit as well! So she isn’t just shoved in a play area and left. More than half the time when I go to get my daughter I see a teacher being active with all the baby’s. Either singing or doing activities! (Loved that!) Ms. Lisa has always been more than welcoming! Ms.Julie always smiles and loves to interact with my daughter. Ms.Maria is so kind and loving to all the kids !! Ms. Rosemary always greets me as I walk out from drop off ! Ms. Mary has always been super understanding and helpful when I had a few tough situations. Ms. Dalia all though new she has always shown patience and kindness to my daughter when she cried because she didn’t know her.

Truly can say I’m glad I picked this location because my daughter LOVES IT ! She claps and walks in excited to go to her class. And as she leaves she waves goodbye to every one! Definitely recommend getting a tour and feeling for yourself 💚

My daughter has been attending for roughly 3-weeks and as a first time mom who was nervous to put her daughter in daycare - the staff has been so helpful in putting my thoughts at ease. They also tend and care for my daughter when she cries and when I check in on her she always looks like she is having so much fun!

Our family has been sending our son to Children’s Lighthouse for over two years now. He started out in their infant room and has had an amazing experience! Every adult in the building knows our son by name and he is excited to see them everyday. We have felt supported in all of our personal decisions throughout the years such as preparing his bottles, administering medications, potty training, and nap schedules. We are quickly informed of any incidents that involve him directly or indirectly, and all staff members have had his best interests in mind. We are constantly surprised by the new things he learns at school that he shows off at home. We love Children’s Lighthouse!

This is the absolute best daycare in the Keller/FW area! We visited many before we finally settled on Children’s Lighthouse of Woodland Springs when he was a baby! They were nothing but welcoming when we started, and now almost 3 years later nothing has changed! There is a family atmosphere and he has already learned his ABC’s! My son truly looks forward to going to daycare everyday! And I love that! ❤️

This daycare is the absolute best with my child. They teach her things that are advanced for her age and treat her with great kindness and empathy. I would recommend anyone to this school because of how the environment is so welcoming and made her feel like home

If there was a way to give 0 stars to this place I absolutely would. The one redeeming person here was Casey who made registration seamless and actually seemed to care.

The director Sarah and the teacher for my daughter seemed 100000000% negligent and had absolutely no care or regard for my daughter.

Not fit for toddlers in my opinion or being proactive about issues
First week here I picked her up it was 51 degrees or less and  they had outside with her shirt soaked.
First day I get camera access my daughter is drinking from everyone’s cups and the teacher is sweeping the floor and using that same broom to sweep the table the kids eat at.
Third day Casey notifies me off a diaper rash, we notify the teacher, come up with a plan of action, talk to the teacher the next day to talk about more frequent diaper changes.
When I pick her up that afternoon she’s soiled Procare shows it was 5 hours before a previous diaper change.
My daughter is visibly and audible in pain trying to clean her and the rash is significantly worse.

To the director, you did not take it seriously when I showed up to grab her stuff. Nor did you take it seriously when you were notified Thursday evening, or all day Friday, or half of the day Monday.
