My child has been attending for almost 5 years and I couldn’t ask for a better place to love and care for my child. Great staff and teachers, clean and the staff is always great about communicating with you. They always go out of their way to plan fun activities for the kids. We feel a part of the lighthouse family.  We are graduating to kindergarten in the fall and feel sad leaving our lighthouse family that has been such an important part of my son’s life the past 5 years.

This Montessori school stands out for its exceptional communication, top-tier safety and security measures, and beautifully designed classrooms. The staff's calm and patient demeanor, combined with a favorable teacher to student ratio, ensures individualized attention for each child. It's an ideal environment for fostering independence and a love for learning in toddlers. Overall, an excellent choice for parents seeking a nurturing and enriching educational setting for their children.
Excellent help
It was so good here!I When I went I was little .everyone was so nice and it was fun to be here!

We’ve been part of the Davenport Montessori family for nearly a decade, and I can’t say enough about the incredible care and education our children have received. The owner is truly one of a kind—loving, dedicated, and deeply invested in every child’s growth.

Our two boys, now 12 and 10, attended Davenport and entered kindergarten not only academically ahead, but also confident, kind, and curious—traits that continue to serve them well. Now our 4-year-old daughter is thriving there too. She comes home happy, loved, and engaged in learning every day.

The nurturing environment, thoughtful curriculum, and genuine care shown by the owner have made Davenport a second home for our family. We’re so grateful for the foundation she’s helped build in each of our children’s lives.

Our son has been going to Davenport since he was three months old. I was very nervous about sending him to childcare so young, but I needed to get back to work. The staff at Davenport are detailed oriented, caring, and knowledgeable. This has made my husband and I confident that our baby boy is in a safe, caring, and educational environment!!

My kids love it at Davenport. Recently at Church a worker asked us if we practice tracing at home because he did such a good job on the artwork at Church. That’s totally attributed it Soni and her team for teaching him! We are big fans of this place!

We have been so blessed to have our twins at this daycare for the past year and a half. From day one, we felt welcomed, supported, and truly cared for. Mrs. Soni, the director, is absolutely amazing—her warmth, kindness, and dedication shine through in everything she does. The teachers are equally incredible: loving, attentive, and genuinely invested in each child’s happiness and growth. Our twins have thrived here, learning and growing in such a safe, nurturing environment. We couldn’t have asked for a better place for them to spend these early years, and we will always be grateful for the love and care they’ve received. This isn’t just a daycare—it’s a family. Highly recommend!

The best daycare! We took our daughter as an infant first to a large franchise daycare in the area and had a terrible experience.  After being recommended Davenport by a friend, we couldn’t say more great things about this place.  The teachers and director are the absolute best! My daughter loves them so much and you can tell how much they genuinely love all of the kids.  The director is communicative, responsive and extremely hands on.  The teachers are absolutely amazing.  They cater individually to every child’s needs and keep parents informed.  You won’t ever have to worry about your children being in great hands at Davenport.

If I could give this place more than five stars I would.

I enrolled my daughter here from 3 - 9 months and it was an amazing experience. Her teachers, especially Ms. Catherine and Ms. Naserine were AMAZING with my daughter. Starting daycare was a scary experience (mostly for me) and they helped me feel so comfortable knowing that my daughter was loved and cared for.

By the end of our time there, my daughter was literally clapping her hands in the parking lot and wanting to stay at pickup to keep playing.

The director staff is also awesome at keeping parents informed, and I really liked the app with updates.

I was definitely spoiled having this as my first daycare experience, I am so sad about having to leave (we moved) and I will hold every program to this standard (which is a HIGH STANDARD).

We absolutely love this school and community!
My son has been enrolled since he was 7 months old, and now at 2.5 years old, he still looks forward to coming every day. He adores his teachers, his friends, and the warm, supportive environment they’ve created. The staff truly knows each child and meets them where they are, which is all a parent can hope for. Highly recommend!

We couldn’t be happier with our experience at The Goddard School! From the very beginning, the staff made us feel welcome and cared for. Our son has been attending for 2 years now and he absolutely loves it—he asks every day if he can stay longer and never wants to leave when we come to pick him up!

He’s made so many friends and learned an incredible amount in such a short time. The environment is nurturing, fun, and full of energy. They do a lot of things and great events. We’ve seen so much growth in his confidence and independence.

A very special thank you to Ms. Mary, Ms. Bekah, and Ms. Jasmine—they have truly made our son feel so special and loved. Ms. Jasmine, especially, always greets everyone with a big smile and such positive energy. We are so grateful for all the love and dedication they put into each day. We trust them completely, and that’s something that, as parents, is the most important thing.

We can’t recommend Goddard enough.

I’m so grateful I found Goddard at Steiner. You can tell how invested Jennifer is in the community; she maintains the school beautifully and hires and retains the best humans you could hope to have around your kiddo. They also have awesome extra events throughout the year- always a hit. They go beyond just working with your kiddo; they keep them busy and engaged all day. The teachers are fantastic, they gave me really good insights on what seemed to help my son focus in the classroom. The staff is always helpful. It was a huge relief to find such a safe, welcoming environment.

Read a story on FaceTime with 3 year old’s, although it would have been better in person my grandson was pleased that I joined in and the staff were great, the kids seemed to enjoy the story.  So good that Goddard makes it easy to be involved when I am so far away.

It’s not the fanciest daycare around but can’t beat the price! I know my kids were taken care of, the owners treat the kids like their own grandchildren and I love that. There’s always field trips/fun activities during breaks, that was my kids favorite part. If we didn’t move, we would have definitely stayed with them.

We love Happy Days! My daughter loves all her teachers and looks forward to her daily greeting from Mr. Joe every morning! She started in the toddler room and is now in their preschool program. The preschool program is awesome! She comes home and talks about what she learns and shows me her work. They also do field trips every month (which is a dream for a 4 year old). They always go the extra mile for the kiddos with decorations and fun activities all the time!

My 2 grand kids are at Happy Days and all I can say is we are so lucky to have them in our neighborhood.  They are so nice and my 4 y/o as well as my 6 y/o )part time) learned so much!  My 3rd one is almost here too.  Thank you for your kindness, compassion and Christian teachings. Highly recommended.

My daughter has been going here since she was 4. Every single person there feels like family. They greet you as soon as you come in the door and they notice when your child isn't there. They are amazing!

My son just started at Happy Days on Monday and he loves this school!!! He truly comes home happy just like the name "Happy Days." The owners and teachers are wonderful. Everyone is very nice, loving and truly caring!! My husband and I are so excited our son loves his new daycare and we love it as well!!

They have a rotating door and low staff retention. The curriculum Frog Street is not being used as promised. Which was confirmed by the director of the Mesquite location. A teacher took my child in the bathroom and hit her legs, while she left the classroom unattended. There was no investigation as promised by Mr. Jones. The director took two days to transfer my child at my request to the Lake June location. Once at the Lake June location. I repeatedly received phone calls my child was crying and to pick her up. I never announced my pick up. Once I did arrive to get my child THREE staff members were upfront and the children were unattended. They were crying and coming out of classrooms unsupervised. I received unauthorized recordings of my child crying underneath a table without my permission. They do need to retrain staff to handle children crying and a perceived tantrum. Both locations need better training and parents need to always ask questions because those children watch tv all day. The director at Lake June did try to rectify the problem. However, after many instances that could’ve been handled differently it was not in my best interest nor my child to continue to attend.

I switched my kids from a great facility to this one because I needed later hours and Saturday care. I immediately noticed a decline in their care. Their noses weren’t being wiped. My kids were at this facility 6 months and I probably received 4 pages of art or work they’d done at school.  To top everything off they changed management and hired new staff. They clearly had no experience caring for small children. If you don’t mind receiving calls at work because your 18 month old isn’t sleeping during nap time. Then bring your kids here. This is not an environment for your kids to learn and thrive. It’s more like if it’s your only option.

The best childcare in the Pleasant Grove area nice staff the best Director the children love it and I will recommend for my kids to go to that daycare. Actually my kids was raised up in that daycare and now they’re grown.
Love this daycare and their teachers. My girls really love coming here and that just makes me have peace of mind knowing that my girls are comfortable here.

Understaffed and didn’t give my child more than 3 days to get to know them or him. He has ADD so this tells me your daycare doesn’t work well with children at all. Very disappointed in your care system.

OPERATION_NAME: Little Folks Nursery and Bilingual Day Care Center
review_text:
We've had 2 kids and 7 years with Little Folks.

You won’t find a harder working staff caring for such happy and loved children.

We've been through many life events with Little Folks as a partner to keep our kids development moving forward.

We will miss them terribly and will always be grateful for how they have empowered our children.

OPERATION_NAME: Little Folks Nursery and Bilingual Day Care Center
review_text:
Our son has been attending Little Folks since he was 6 months old, and we feel incredibly lucky to be part of this amazing community. We were on the waitlist for nearly a year, and now that we've experienced the school firsthand, we can confidently say—it was absolutely worth the wait.

Now 16 months old, our son has already been in two classrooms, and the care, attention, and love he’s received at every stage has been nothing short of exceptional. The number one thing we love about Little Folks is the nature of the teachers. As a former educator myself with 10 years of experience, I know how important it is to have teachers who are not only skilled but who genuinely care about your child. At Little Folks, that care is evident in every interaction.

From the moment you’re greeted at the Little House, Ms. Silvia sets the tone. She is warm, welcoming, and truly knows every child in the school by name. She’s not just the face at the front desk—she steps into classrooms to help with hands-on projects, keeps families organized with important paperwork, and even checks in with parents during stressful times. When our son was going through some testing at the doctor, she reached out just to see how everything went. That level of care means the world.

In the classroom, we’ve had the pleasure of having Ms. Gloria as one of our son’s first teachers. She is kind, calm, funny, and full of wisdom. She never pushed, but always supported. When we had questions, she offered thoughtful advice and always took the time to share sweet stories at pick-up—something we deeply appreciated when our son was still too little to tell us himself. And beyond the love and nurturing, the teachers plan engaging, meaningful activities each day. It's incredible to see the little skills and interests our son has picked up since starting school.

Now he’s in class with Ms. Cassi, who is a total sweetheart. I honestly don’t know how she manages a room full of toddlers with such patience and joy, but she does—and the kids thrive under her care. From painting and sprinkler play to reading and circle time, every day is full of creativity and connection. When we drop him off in the morning, he runs to give big hugs to his teachers, and it's clear how much he loves being there.

This morning, as I watched his little friends greet him at the door, his face lit up with the biggest smile. Then he spotted one of his former teachers subbing in his new room and ran to her for a hug, melting into her arms. In that moment, I was reminded that even though it’s hard to be away from him during the day, he is in the best possible place—happy, safe, loved, and truly known.

Another wonderful thing about Little Folks is the exposure to so many new activities and experiences. From sensory play and creative projects to outdoor adventures and early Spanish instruction, the school does such a fantastic job at helping little ones explore the world and build confidence.

We couldn’t imagine a better place for our child. Little Folks is more than just a daycare—it’s a nurturing, inspiring environment where children are celebrated and supported every single day. We are so grateful to have found it.

OPERATION_NAME: Little Folks Nursery and Bilingual Day Care Center
review_text: We have loved the 4+ years at Little Folks, staff is amazing and my kids are happy and excited each day when they go to school- what more could I ask for :)

OPERATION_NAME: Little Folks Nursery and Bilingual Day Care Center
review_text: My 2-year-old has been at Little Folks for a year and we’re about to put our baby into an infant class there. As someone with experience with a couple of other childcare centers, I can’t recommend the teachers and environment at Little Folks highly enough. Several of the teachers and admin have worked at the center for well over a decade and this continuity and high quality of care for both kids and staff absolutely shows. My toddler has loved every one of his teachers so much that he asks to visit them on days off and will tell you that they’re his favorite people. They’ve been patient with him during some difficult times in his attitude development and have been great partners in finding ways to support him. Communication has been solid throughout our time there, too. If you’re on the fence about a childcare center, I really don’t think you can go wrong with Little Folks!

OPERATION_NAME: Little Folks Nursery and Bilingual Day Care Center
review_text: Five stars is no question for us, Little Folks has been a part of our life and family for 5 years and if we could stay longer, we would. From the director, teachers, assistants and other support staff, each person there has loved our children more than we could have asked or expected. They provided support to us with our child who struggled at drop off and had excellent communication. Their COVID policies were exactly what our family needed to feel safe and comfortable. You’ll find a wonderful community of parents and families there as well! We have LOVED our experience at Little Folks and highly recommended.

We can’t say enough good things about Primrose Alliance! Our son has absolutely thrived here. The teachers and staff are so warm and patient, they truly treat him like one of their own. It gives us such peace of mind knowing he’s surrounded by people who genuinely care about him and support his learning and development in the sweetest ways. The communication is always great, and we feel really connected to what he’s doing and how he’s growing. We’re so grateful for the amazing teachers and staff at Primrose!

We absolutely love our son’s school. From day one, it’s been clear how much care, attention, and love they pour into each child. The staff truly takes the time to know our son, support his growth, and help him learn in ways that feel both fun and meaningful. We’re consistently impressed with the communication and updates. We always feel informed and connected to his day. Knowing he’s in such a safe, nurturing, and engaging environment gives us so much peace of mind. We’re incredibly grateful for everything they do for our family.

My son has been attending primrose since October 2025 and he loves it. His teachers are consistent and provide a nurturing environment for all the kids. The class sizes are small and the curriculum is teaching my toddler so much! We recommend primrose alliance if you’re looking for a good daycare/preschool for your kiddo.

When we were looking for a daycare for our LO, we toured many places in the area, and Primrose was the only one that as soon as we walked into the building, we knew immediately we were going to make the right choice. The staff and teachers have so much compassion and care for the children in their care and you can feel the love they have for all the children enrolled. The teachers and admin are all so attentive, enthusiastic and patient, I know every morning when I drop off my baby, he's going to have a great day with great people.

Our family has had an incredible experience with this school. The staff is attentive, caring, and truly invested in each child’s growth. Not only does my son feel supported and safe, but he is also learning so much every day. The educational foundation they provide is outstanding, and it’s clear the teachers are passionate about what they do. We couldn’t be happier with our choice and highly recommend this school to any parent looking for a nurturing, high-quality learning environment.

We absolutely love Bright Ideas! Our youngest daughter has been here since she was 6 months old, and the care and attention she has received has been incredible. She’s now 5 and has truly flourished during her time here—socially, emotionally, and academically.

What makes this daycare even more special is that all three of our children have attended over the years, and each one received the same consistent love, support, and quality care. It’s such a comforting feeling knowing your kids are in a place where they’re genuinely cared for and nurtured.

We’re so grateful for the amazing staff and everything they’ve done for our family. Highly recommend to any parent looking for a safe, loving, and enriching environment!

Prior to bright ideas we struggled so much trying to find a loving and caring daycare but we eventually hit the jackpot! My daughter started here around 2 years old and she grew so much confidence when she left at 5! She created bonds and relationships that I know she will always feel and remember. It’s a place with wonderful people who helped shaped her life and we will always come back for visits and hugs.

I absolutely love Bright Ideas for my son Jaxon, and he loves it too! From day one, everyone has been so warm and welcoming, especially Miss Anne Marie, Miss Dee Dee, Miss Lena, and His incredible teacher Miss Lily. She has truly worked wonders with him. He’s now speaking in full sentences! Her patience, care, and dedication haven’t gone unnoticed. It’s also special knowing my son’s father and uncle, attended Bright Ideas when they were little. The fact that some of the same staff and teachers are still here speaks volumes about the heart and legacy of this place. It truly feels like one big, happy family.
I rarely write reviews, but the amazing owner, staff, and teachers here deserve all the recognition. They go above and beyond with every child, and it's truly inspiring. If you’re considering enrolling your child here, do it! Even if there’s a waitlist, it’s well worth it.
Thank you, Bright Ideas, for everything you’ve done for my son Jaxon. Your care and knowledge, mean the world to Us!

It's hard to put into words how grateful I am for this incredible daycare. Both of my sons attended and the experience was just as amazing the second time as it was the first. That kind of consistency, care, and excellence speaks volumes.

From the moment you walk in, you feel the warmth and attentiveness of the staff. They are not only highly qualified and nurturing, but truly invested in each child's development and well being. The environment is safe, engaging, and full of thoughtful activities that promote learning and social growth.
What touched me most is how the staff made an effort to truly know my children as individuals. They celebrated their strengths, gently guided them through challenges, and always made them feel seen, heard, and valued.
It's rare to find a place that can stand the test of time like this one. Knowing I could trust the same team with both of my boys, years apart, gave me peace of mind and a deep appreciation for their unwavering dedication.

If you're looking for a daycare that feels like an extension of your family, this is the place.

We have loved Bright Ideas! My 18-month-old daughter has such a fun time playing with her teachers and friends and is always super happy when we pick her up! All the staff are so kind and I was impressed when everyone knew her name after only a couple of days. I have felt so comfortable taking my daughter here because it is such a welcoming and safe environment!

This is the first daycare my son has been to and he absolutely loves it. His creativity is challenged, his gear recall of his day and the  classroom let me know he really enjoys being present while there, and best of all I see the teachers and directors growing and improving all the time! It’s always felt like a safe place but these past few months there has been more communication  to parents, tidier environments, and continued smiling faced that make me feel like my son is cared for and cherished. I really appreciate the openness of this daycare, and I always feel like I can check in or ask questions even through their parent portal. Overall our family is so grateful to have Mi Casa Bandera in our lives.

I've had an outstanding experience with the Mi Casa Child Center. The staff is not only incredibly kind and patient, but they also show genuine care and attention to each child. They listen attentively to both parents and children, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The center itself is neat, clean, and though a bit smaller than some other centers, it feels very cozy and well-maintained. You can tell they take a lot of pride in what they do. My kids have thrived here, developing quickly and feeling comfortable almost immediately. It's been a fantastic experience, and I couldn't be happier with the care they provide!

We've had our son enrolled for the past four years, and we couldn't be happier with our experience.

The environment at the daycare is fantastic. The staff and teachers provide a structured, caring atmosphere that has really helped our son grow.

Mi Casa also does a great job with their events, especially during Christmas time—they're always well-organized and a lot of fun for the kids and families. It's clear they put a lot of thought into everything they do.

Mi casa is a good daycare, I like that the rooms are clean,  I love the pictures they share of our children, also Miss Sheyla was really helpful with my son the time that he was here, I recommend this little school for kids.

We have 2 toddlers enrolled at the Bandera location for full time care, and we've been very pleased with our experience so far. Our youngest is normally very clingy, but after just 2 weeks he's walking us to the door and saying goodbye with a smile on his face. We've also already noticed a big improvement in their speech and social skills. Thank you for taking such good care of our babies.

We’re truly excited to have enrolled our two children at The Learning Experience – Museum District. From the very beginning, the experience has been welcoming and reassuring.

Lesley has been amazing—so kind, patient, and genuinely helpful at every step. She answered all our questions, guided us through the enrollment process, and made what can be a stressful decision feel easy and comfortable.

We’re really looking forward to becoming part of the TLE Museum District community and watching our kids learn, grow, and thrive in such a caring environment.

My daughter was in a nanny pod for the first 18 months due to a special medical condition. I was very nervous to put her in a school where she could be exposed to many more student. I visited 5 schools in the area and this school was the best. Lesley and Thewana, the leadership at this TLE location, did a wonderful job reassuring me that my daughter would be cared for and they guided me through the steps to ensure her wellbeing. Her teacher Linda is fantastic. She asks questions to better understand my daughter’s condition and plan accordingly.

They provide pictures and updates on an app that makes it easy to follow her daily schedule.

I couldn’t have picked a better place to start her education journey. And it’s just a few short blocks to the children’s museum! 😁

We looked obsessively for a school for our 19 month old. A daycare would not do for my precious little one.

We were looking for a place who's ethos is grounded in education rather than someone passing time with our child while we're working.

It also needed a staff open to partnering with us on what we deemed important. They needed to be as invested in our child's outcomes as we are and only one place met these needs, The Learning Experience.

After meeting leadership and staff, touring the facilities, and asking a million questions (sorry about that!) we chose TLE and we (including our little one) couldn't be happier.

It's a brand new facility where they've designed every space with the child in mind. Dedicated teachers who are patient and kind, and a curriculum and strategy tying everything together. I feel lucky we're able to send our little one knowing they're in great hands.
Excellent place. Lesly was super friendly and helpful. We felt very well supported.
I have tried to get in touch and just get the run around on when they will be opening and enrolling

Would certainly recommend Lakecreek. My elder daughter was in the Casa programme for over two years. She really adores her teachers, Ms Pavithra and Ms Rebecca. They are very kind, patient, approachable and nurturing. Having been on several field trips with the class, I saw first hand both teachers' care and love for their students. Ms Pavithra, as the lead guide, is very responsive and willing to address any concerns or clarifications parents had. I find that she has a keen sense of her students' individual learning styles and social-emotional developmental needs and provided good advice on how we can also help our child at home. Other staff, including Ms Sharon and Ms Natalie, are very helpful and effective as well. Other things I really appreciate about Lakecreek: (1) the school creates channels for parents to get to know each other and help each other out; (2) the teachers provide photos and/or updates of the children on a regular basis; (3) there is a good range of extra curricular activities after school that we can sign our children up for, if desired; and (4) the school building is new, well maintained and bright.

We've had both of our boys here for the past 4-5 years, now age 6 and 3.5, and it has been such a sweet special place for them. The toddler teachers including Ms. Lily and Ms Chiuyi created such a nurturing environment for the 3's and under, and Ms. Amanda and Ms. Zhang really helped the boys build confidence and emotional intelligence on top of all the other skills of independence and academics. These are truly teachers who make an impact.

Ms. Natalie and Ms. Sharon at the front desk keep things humming smoothly, and Ms. Candice has been a fantastic owner, constantly looking for ways to make it an amazing experience for kids and parents. We highly, highly recommend this magical place. They have great lunches, activities and aftercare programs. My kids love art, riding balance bikes in their large shaded playscape, Groovy school bus and the field trips. We signed up primarily for their Mandarin program, and realized all additional, intangible value this school and the classrooms have provided over the years!

We have been at the school for almost 3 years, and we love it. I have seen great development in my kids, they have both been learning so much while truly enjoying the experience. We really appreciate all the work the staff does.

Both of my children have been with Miss Lily, and they absolutely love her. Her passion and love for the kids is amazing. She's is a wonderful teacher who connects beautifully with her students. Because of her support, my child has gained confidence and is excited to take on new learning opportunities.
It’s easy to see how much the children love her and feel comfortable in her classroom. We are very grateful for the positive impact she has had.

My oldest one is now with Ms. Jing. She has been an incredible influence on our child. She creates a warm and engaging environment where students feel motivated to learn. She constantly pushes them to think beyond their comfort zone in a way that feels fun and encouraging.
The kids truly enjoy being in her class, and it shows in their enthusiasm every day. We deeply appreciate everything she does for her student.

This is our third year at  this school, our daughter has grown from a three year old toddler to an independent, confident and self- driving young lady. She just has such a love and enthusiasm on learning, super comfortable socializing with all sorts of people, very responsible and shows leadership qualities, and has great passion for others and her environment. For all of these, I know I have a lot to thank the school and her teachers for. They just created such a comfortable and supportive environment where kids are allowed to follow their own nature and passion, and where happily learning can truly happen. My daughter absolutely loves her school and adores her teachers. She considers ms.Amanda and Ms. Zhang her best friends at school and genuinely misses them when school is closed for holidays. She really enjoys now being the oldest kid in the casa program and proudly taking on all the jobs and opportunities being given by the teachers to assist and guide others.

The teachers are very experienced Montessori guides with endless patience and love for the kids. You can tell Ms. Amanda and ms. Zhang really love the kids and their jobs, and they and the kids are having fun at the school too. My daughter always tells me how much work she has done and how much fun she had at the school when I pick her up:)

We are a bilingual family, I speak Mandarin to my daughter at home. But she learns Chinese reading and writing with the teachers. She's almost 6 now, she reads and writes in English like a 1st grader, and reads and writes in Chinese like a 5 year old in China. I would say she is fluent in both. We do consider ourselves lucky that this school is bilingual and also authentic Montessori, which are equally important to us. We plan to enroll their elementary school program after my daughter graduates from the casa program next summer.

Our experience with the school staff is very friendly and super responsive. You can communicate with them easily and quickly through messages. School has many events for parents and socializing each term as well.

So if you are looking for an authentic Montessori school and would like your kid to pick up some Chinese, I would say Lakecreek is the best option in the great Austin area.

We started sending both of our kids here at 18 months, and I was nervous at first because it’s such a critical stage in a child’s life. Ms Cindy and Ms Lu quickly put our minds at ease with their incredible care, thoughtful updates, and partnership through key milestones like potty training and social development.

The staff is also very attentive to feedback, and truly care about the values of the families they serve. The whole environment feels safe, positive, nurturing, and filled with joy.

The school is bilingual, making Chinese and English a natural part of daily life, and offers a wide range of extracurriculars—like dance, sports, and art—that give our kids the chance to explore new interests, build skills, and grow in confidence.

Being part of Lake Creek has been such a meaningful journey and a true blessing for our family. We’re deeply grateful to have found a school that supports our children’s growth in every way.

I LOVE this place of worship! If I could give it extra stars, I’d give it as much as allowed. The worship team is anointed, and I love the sermons, always on target to what I need to hear. Pastors Crain’s messages are Bible based, strong and to the point, no sugar coating. There’s a lot going on here, something for everyone. They have conferences, food bank, small group meetings , classes, and so much more!

I have 2 children at Temple of Praise and the staff is amazing !!! The director is amazing and works with you every step of the way!! Mrs.Terry, Mrs.Sophia, Mrs.Nelly,Isabella in the front desk, Raquel, Bella they all are amazing and love my kids like thier own!

if I could give -4 stars, I actually would. This review is not so much to bring correction to the leader ship, but it should. Patsy Torres was advertised to be there, giving her testimony and it was nothing more than her promoting her Christmas album, she actually sang Chiquitita by ABBA in Spanish during church, it’s a great song, but it’s not appraising worship song. Messages are STRONG, TO THE POINT, with love... AND ENCOURAGING.. JUST WHAT WE NEED.

This is a profound misrepresentation of Jesus.  I hope this is not how everyone who attends your church behaves in public.

What an incredible place! Not only does it spur creative imagination play for children of all ages and abilities but it was clean, had lots of ranges of activities and was accessible for strollers, wheelchairs, and other ranges of ability. Things were marked appropriately and lots to help imagining lots of things.
As a out of towner this is definitely a place I would add to list of places to see again and again. Thanks for a delightful time.
A place for all ages and a whole lot of fun-learning activities! My kids had a blast! You need at least 2 days to go through the whole place to experience and soak it all in!

Vicente was such an amazing host and did such a great job taking care of us. I would definitely have a party here again. Good size party room for 25 people. Definitely recommend the deluxe party package! Picture with and without people to show size of room.

⸻

Very disappointed with our recent visit to this kids play museum. It has really gone downhill. Everything felt old, dirty, and outdated. Several exhibits were broken or barely functioning, and nothing looked like it had been properly maintained in a long time.

For almost $40 for just one adult and one 10-year-old, I expected a much better experience. The admission price is way too high for what you actually get. Most of the exhibits were just screens, with very few hands-on, interactive activities. For a children’s museum, that’s unacceptable. Kids should be able to explore, build, touch, and create — not just stare at monitors.

The overall atmosphere felt neglected and poorly managed. When families are paying premium prices, the space should feel clean, updated, and thoughtfully curated. Unfortunately, that was not our experience at all.

I absolutely do not recommend this place. There are far better options for the money.

The DoSeum offers a vibrant, hands-on experience that engages visitors of all ages. With friendly staff and a clean, well-organized environment, the museum provides a welcoming and enjoyable space for families to explore and learn together.
Though admission may seem a bit high, the variety and quality of exhibits make it worthwhile. From sensory play, music, and bubbles to construction zones and STEM activities, there's something for everyone. A standout is the Disney-inspired “Inside Out” exhibit, which captivates both children and adults.
While the water area has low pressure and the air vacuum play lacks strong suction, they remain fun and engaging. These minor issues don’t take away from the overall value. The DoSeum is a place where learning comes alive through play—an enriching destination for anyone visiting San Antonio with family or friends.

OPERATION_NAME: St. Louis Early Childhood Development Center
review_text: St Louis ecdc is an excellent daycare. I visited numerous daycares in the immediate area and was drawn to st Louis because of the cleanliness and safety of the facilities, the low student teacher ratios, the convenience of the location, reasonable price, and above all, how personable the staff was. This place has been great for my daughter's development. Also, they are very helpful with potty training.

OPERATION_NAME: St. Louis Early Childhood Development Center
review_text: We love this place and I have a peace of mind that our 2 year old daughter is well taken care and loved. She is always happy telling us about what they did in school and how she loves her teachers. The place is nice with a big and clean playground. The place feels safe and the teachers always pay attention to the kid’s needs and situation.

I LOVE THIS DAYCARE!!! I moved here 3 years ago and was new to the area so when I found this daycare I knew as soon as I toured it,it was the BEST !  My daughter never went to daycare  so I was nervous but as soon as I went in the people made me feel at ease, welcome and caring. I then  had my son and he has went here since he was a newborn and he is 2 now. I feel like family. My kids LOVE IT and have fun! Mrs Neal is a big help since I’m not from here and loves my kids.Ms Brooks has helped me with getting my daughter in the best school, and gives me the best guidance along with helps my kids on a daily and  listens to any concerns. Ms Latoya is so sweet my kids RUN TO HER, she makes my kids feel beyond loved!! Ms Cousar has helped my daughter learn to write her name, and learn so many things from her numbers to colors and she is school ready ! Ms Tish is always cheerful and welcoming to my kids! My son’s teacher is teaching him to go to the potty, learn songs and does lots of fun hands on activities. They communicate everyday and are always on the same page!! Also a bonus they always do fun activities with the kids! BY FAR THE BEST DAYCARE!!!

The owner of Treasure Chest Learning Center Monicha Neal is a very professional, loving and caring person, she’s very giving to her teachers and families.  If I had young children I would definitely choose this Center, Mrs. Neal and the Director Mrs. Ashley are very involved in giving back to the community, they both are passionate about Early Childhood Education and I truly admire what they do for the children and families they care for.

This place was good at first. My daughter would always cry when I left but overtime her body language reaction to having to go there changed dramatically. If your child is non verbal and had a disability this place isn’t a good fit. The director is inpatient and I love walked in on her telling my daughter “I don’t have time for this” so are the staff. My daughter had terrible behavior at home going here and I would wonder where it came from. My daughter has moved on to another daycare and is thriving after only a month. She is doing way better at the new daycare after just a month of her attending and she attended tiny treasures for over a year and I can tell the staff were being mean to my daughter. My mommy instincts would always tell me but I had to find a new place before removing which I’m so glad I did. Wouldn’t recommend this place at all. My daughter may not be able to talk but I can tell by her body language each time we got close to that place that something was wrong. This place is money hungry and doesn’t care about kids if they have differences. Definitely happy I took my baby out of this place. I attached a photo to show how my baby would react when we got close. Please don’t take your kids here. I also had to call the place where you report daycares to and have someone come out there to see what was going on.
They treat us like family. They take very good care of my granddaughter, she loves it here . They are amazing. They have went above and beyond for us and we are so grateful to have them💜

We LOVE Treasure Cheat Learning Center! Mrs. Monicha , Mrs.Cousar and Mrs. Ashley have cared for our boys all 3 of them over the last 7 years! I don’t know what I would have done without this daycare. They treat your kids like their own . I never have to worry if they are being taken care of or loved or learning because all 3 happen every single day! They have a wonderful well rounded program and all of my boys have headed to kindergarten more than prepared compared to their classmates. When my youngest test was hospitalized last year ,Mrs. Neal and Mrs. Ashley came to the hospital and Mrs. Cousar and Mrs. Morton called and send a prayer . Mrs. Cousar is a literal angel with Pre-k and your baby will be fully ready for school! The center is super affordable and as mentioned they’ve cared for all 3 of my sons with the youngest starting at only 8 weeks old . We are at the point where he is now ready to head off to school and we will truly miss Treasure Chest and all of the wonderful people who work here and have cared for and nurtured our babies.
Ms. Thelma the Director is super nice. The staffs are amazing they treat you like family. My daughter is always happy to attend daycare.

I have the best experience here all my three kids are here from all age group from infant to kinder and i have nothing bad to day. They assure me. Inform me and my oldest has always the best experience here. I am that helicopter mom very picky and we been here 2 years and will continue till they go to school
Staff treats you like family. Kids love staff and attending. Healthy food served.
Small Steps has been a great school for us for the past years. My family loves the school and has help us a lot economically on everything. My kids love going here and loves it.
Small steps is answer to many parents with kids under 6 years old!! They have great teacher, they are friendly etc….  Can’t wait my 3 months to turn 2 years old to join his siblings!!!

Small steps is one of the few schools you can trust with your kids. They provide the best education out there.
I highly recommend!
Love it very much recommend for your little ones.
Very nice and entertaining place. Definitely love this place and my kids love it too

Me & my daughter LOVE this place!! Previous negative review is a one off. Here is your proof. 1.  Teachers are in short supply everywhere! 2. I'm a first time single mom. They were so patient & accommodating. The use an app to post pictures of their activities of the day. 3. Holidays!! They go all out when it comes to decorations & crafts for ex. Most recently fathers day, perfectly punned handmade cards. 4. We had to leave town for my job. I trusted the teachers here so much when I returned this was the only place I called. 5. The move back has messed up my daughter's routine, but the teachers are patient & keep me in the loop on how to best work TOGETHER to help her feel better & she's happy now back with her favorite teachers.

This place is like those great hidden food dives. The inside is clean, organized, set up like a Montessori education wise the teachers are caring as well.

If I could rate 10 stars I would !! Both my kids has been at this location since they were little . My daughter since she was 10 months and my son since he was 2 years old . They are now starting elementary. I have never had any issues or bad experiences. The teachers and director are the best and I will recommend this daycare to anyone that is looking for child care ! You won’t regret it ! Thank you all so much for taking care of my babies as your own ! 😃

I put my 9 month old baby in this daycare like two months ago and he was only there for less than two weeks since i noticed its just young ladoes taking care of him and most of the times they didnt know what they were doing. The teachers here have been wonderful to our kids. The center is always clean and they always send us daily updates and pictures of them. I like that because I get to see how they are doing throughout the day. Great job Ms. Jennifer!

My wife and I took time off work to visit this location for a scheduled tour. As soon as we walk in we're told there is no room for our kid. Then a supervisor approached and the first thing tht comes out of her mouth is "I want informed of any appointment". My 2 and 4 year old currently enrolled and absolutely LOVE their teachers! Caring and thoughtful educators, could not ask for more.
Great preschool with the best teachers! 20+ years of preparing kids for Kindergarten or 1st grade!
This place is just the best. They care for the children & the families like they are their own. So thankful 🤍

As parents, we always look for a place where our child will not only be safe but also loved, encouraged, and happy. Nabor House has truly been a blessing for our family. From day one, the staff has shown genuine care and dedication, giving us peace of mind every time we drop off our daughter. We've seen amazing growth in her – emotionally, socially, and even spiritually. She comes home every day with a big smile and something new she learned. We also appreciate the strong Christian values they incorporate into everything they do. We wholeheartedly recommend Nabor House to any family looking for a nurturing and uplifting environment for their little ones.

My experience with Nabor House Community has been nothing but life changing. Not only have they cared for and helped my children grow in many aspects of their lives but they have shown my children an abundance of love that I couldn’t even dream of! The staff is kind, loving, helpful and work as a team to show the love of Christ in everything they do. My children start school this upcoming August and I know for a fact that they are ready because of Nabor House. They have prayed with me on my situations in my life. I am able to work full time with my children in a safe environment. My children’s love of the Lord has surpassed anything I could imagine. I thank God for Nabor House and the work they do! I can’t wait to see them grow so that other families in other parts of town can be a part of a FAMILY, that prays together and root for each other!

I took my child who was 7-8 months old at the time that couldn’t walk yet. I told several staff that because the floors are hard please watch him carefully. Finding this daycare was such a blessing. Nabor House Community has changed our lives for the best. The staff is so loving and attentive to every child, always greeting them by their name and with a smile. I love how they have implemented strong loving Christian faith onto our children, such an importance in the world we live in today. You can tell that the teachers really care about the kids, informing parents when they’ve noticed something, big or small so we can always have a piece of mind. I love receiving photos and videos throughout the day on the activities so that I’m up to date with my child’s schedule. Highly recommend Nabor House, one of the best decisions I made for my daughter!

Nabor House has been an incredible blessing for our family. After experiencing three different schools since moving to the U.S. in 2020, this one truly stands out for its excellence in every area. The directors care deeply about every detail—cleanliness, safety, and above all, love. They lead with professionalism and a mother’s heart for each child. I couldn’t imagine moving my daughter to another school. Thank you, Nabor House

OPERATION_NAME: Lionheart Children's Academy at Eagles View
review_text: I'm so grateful that my daughter is enrolled in the childcare program here.    I believe she's exactly where the Lord wants her to be! It's so awesome to have updates of my child throughout the day, plus my daughter loves the teachers and feels very comfortable with the loving and caring staff here.  Thank you and God Bless you!

OPERATION_NAME: Lionheart Children's Academy at Eagles View
review_text: Amazing place! I send my two month old little guy and work here myself. I’ve worked at and viewed several centers across the area and I can confidently say I would not completely trust any other childcare facility to care for my baby. I have full peace of mind he’s being cared for and moved to the fullest. I love the communication and intentionality these teachers give to these little ones in all the age groups.

OPERATION_NAME: Lionheart Children's Academy at Eagles View
review_text:
We could not be happier with the care our daughter has received over the past weeks at this amazing daycare! From the moment we walked in, we felt welcomed, reassured, and confident that our daughter would be in loving hands—and we were absolutely right.

Every day she comes home smiling, content, and full of positive energy. It’s clear that she feels safe, nurtured, and happy, and that means everything to us as parents. We’ve noticed such a beautiful sense of calm and joy in her, and we know that’s a reflection of the environment and people around her during the day.

A heartfelt thank you to Kristy, Holly, Andrea and Linda, who have been truly exceptional. They are so kind, gentle, and attentive. You can tell they love what they do and genuinely care for each child. They take the time to update us, share sweet moments, and make us feel like we’re part of our daughter’s daily journey.

Choosing a daycare can be such a nerve-wracking decision, but we feel so grateful to have found a place that treats our little one like family. We’re looking forward to watching her grow and thrive here. Highly recommend to any parent looking for a safe, caring, and joyful place for their child!

OPERATION_NAME: Lionheart Children's Academy at Eagles View
review_text: Our son just finished his first week here and we could not be any happier. We started attending Eagles View Church in January and heard about Lionheart through them. As first-time parents we were very nervous about leaving our child at a daycare. The people here are truly amazing. Every person we have interacted with has been so kind and helpful. We had a ton of questions, and they always graciously answered them. Our son's teachers are very sweet, and we love seeing the daily pictures of him on the app. Our son seems to truly enjoy Lionheart. Both Eagles View Church and Lionheart are incredibly special, and their partnership has helped our family tremendously. We love them both and would highly recommend them to everyone!

OPERATION_NAME: Lionheart Children's Academy at Eagles View
review_text: My daughter is in the Trailblazers (elementary school age) program. She loves it! So many fun activities and field trips to keep the kids engaged. Every teacher and staff member are so sweet and helpful.  We will back next summer.

Wonderful experience with Liz showing me the entire Facility!!
Very clean and inviting!! Many helpful people working there for Great environment to workout 💪!!

I had a very disappointing experience with this fitness center due to a complete lack of transparency and poor communication.

I was charged for children’s swimming lessons that my daughter never attended. We were invited to schedule what was presented as a trial class. When I went in person to schedule it, I was told I needed to sign a waiver for my daughter because she is a minor. I signed it believing it was only a liability waiver for a trial lesson. My daughter did not enjoy the class, so we never returned.

Months later, I discovered I had been charged a total of $500 for classes my daughter never took. I repeatedly tried to contact the staff throughout the year via email and phone to understand what was happening, but no one ever responded.

When I finally managed to speak to someone this year, I was told that the document I signed had enrolled my daughter in ongoing classes, and for that reason they would only return part of the money — $300 as credit, not a refund. This is unacceptable, especially considering my daughter never attended a single class and no one ever contacted me to ask why she was not showing up.

I genuinely believed we were signing up for a trial class, not a full enrollment. Being charged for a service that was never used, combined with months of unanswered communication, made me feel taken advantage of and poorly treated as a customer.

I would strongly advise other parents to be extremely cautious and to carefully read every document before signing anything here.

Life Time’s South Austin location feels meaningfully under-invested relative to other clubs at the same membership tier, while still carrying matching full-price expectations.

To be clear, this is not a criticism of the instructors, staff, or member community. The classes are strong and the people are a big reason many members stay.

The issue is how the product is maintained and evolved. Compared with other Life Time locations in major markets, South Austin lags in maintenance consistency, amenities, and enhanced offerings. The result is an experience that feels managed for stability and retention rather than ongoing improvement or parity with similarly priced clubs elsewhere.

That approach may make business sense internally, but from a member perspective it creates a large disconnect. Comparable pricing and membership tier implies a comparable level of investment and attention. If clubs within the same tier are intended to offer materially different experiences, that distinction should be reflected more transparently and reflected by pricing.

As it stands, South Austin delivers a solid community experience, but not a fully realized premium one. For a brand rooted in the Twin Cities and known for “Minnesota nice,” this level of uneven treatment at a premium price point is disappointing. Canceling and heading to Kollective instead.

Lifetime Austin South is a physically and emotionally unsafe, volatile environment. Don’t be fooled by the facilities (trust me, there’s plenty of mold growing here which is an ongoing issue they avoid solving). There is much more to this place than meets the eye. Lifetime is NOT an upscale gym.

I urge you not to enter into a contract with Lifetime Austin South for your own safety and protection. My safety is my utmost priority and I had to prioritize myself by leaving, as Lifetime does not protect its members by choice.

The worst part about this unelevated gym is that staff and the Lifetime company itself are completely aware of issues happening here, yet do nothing to resolve them. Instead, they avoid taking any action which is simply unethical negligence.

As a long time member here for years, Lifetime’s lack of integrity revealed itself to me over time. This place is classless and a huge mess. Not a hot mess. A gross mess. Money can buy many things. Class, however, is not one of them.

I never could have imagined the tasteless, unproductive, unsafe drama that goes on at the South location in my wildest dreams. Most members are hesitant to speak out, but it’s important to be honest.

Beth L is an incredible yoga instructor. Her classes at LifeTime South are so much more than just physical guidance. My daughter spent two and a half years at the Learning Experience: infant care through preppers. She started just as they opened and we were there as their facility matured.

Infants: Ratios are great for infants. They have fridges for breast milk or formula and deliver feedings on the schedule you specify. They’re very thorough with diaper changes and also can help with diaper rash if you fill the forms and provide the cream. Baby containers are not used much and they have activities, naps, outdoor time, and tummy time planned. There isn’t storage for carriers. Once they’re transitioning to solid foods, you can either use prepackaged or homemade (so long as you abide by their no nuts policy). Sign language is taught and helps tremendously at home. The teachers in general were attentive, gentle, and kind.

Toddlers: The toddler class allows for more play and more learning, as the kids develop. The center provides healthy food services so you won’t need to prep snacks or lunch. They have a smaller playground the kids love and teach more than numbers and letters, but also emotional expression and regulation and cultural concepts. We had issues with a serial biter in our toddler class that was swiftly managed by the director and teachers. I was impressed.

Twaddlers: The twaddler class is when they start introducing potty training concepts. The kids are a bit older and are growing fast! We had potty training issues in twaddlers that we didn’t see at home. Our director and teachers helped develop a plan that got our kid back on track as they transitioned towards preppers.

Preppers: The preppers class is all about getting the kids ready for preschool. Whether that’s mastering potty training, emotional development, or something else, the needs of the kids varies by the individual. Our prepper teachers were adaptable and flexible to handle each kid’s individual needs. We felt prepared for preschool as we approached 3yo.

In general: It’s been a positive experience. There are many long term staff which provided stability of care. The center regularly hosts extracurricular and celebratory events. The staff are kind and professional and communication is top notch. If I had to choose again, I would choose TLE for my daughter’s care.

I’ve held off on writing this review in hopes that the issues we experienced would be addressed internally, but after recent events, I feel it’s important to share our experience. First, I want to acknowledge that the facility is clean, organized, and visually welcoming. The classrooms appear well equipped, and the teachers my child interacts with have always been friendly, warm, and nurturing on the surface.

However, despite these positives, I have serious concerns about the level of supervision and overall safety protocols at this daycare. Within less than one week (my daughters attended only 2 times a week)  my daughter was bitten by another child on two separate occasions WITHIN THE SAME WEEK. While I understand that biting can sometimes happen with young children (I have 3 and neither have ever bitten each other), it becomes a much more serious issue when it occurs repeatedly in such a short timeframe.

What is most troubling is that both incidents suggest a potential lack of adequate supervision and response. As a parent, I place my trust in the daycare staff to not only educate and care for my child but also to keep her safe. When that trust is broken, it becomes very difficult to feel comfortable continuing care without real reassurances and meaningful changes.

In both cases, we were notified after the fact, but I was left with more questions than answers. How did this happen? Who was supervising? What actions were taken with the other child involved for the SECOND time? And most importantly, what steps are being taken to prevent this from happening again?

I expect any daycare, especially one that promotes a safe and nurturing environment, to have firm procedures in place for monitoring children, addressing aggressive behavior quickly, and protecting others from being harmed. At this point, it feels like there was a breakdown somewhere in those processes, and that borders on negligence. Two bites in a week is not just an unfortunate coincidence; it's a pattern that needs serious attention.

I sincerely hope the staff and owner takes this feedback seriously and makes the necessary changes to ensure a higher standard of care moving forward. All children deserve to feel safe and protected while they learn and grow, and all parents deserve peace of mind when entrusting their children to your care.

Our children have attended St. Paul’s Episcopal Montessori School for the past three years. Our children genuinely look forward to attending school each day. We, both parents and children, could not be happier.

The Montessori philosophy and Episcopalian tradition of education peacefully provide a welcoming, safe, and comfortable environment for children to learn, grow, and thrive. Children are encouraged to pursue work that they find interesting. Teachers then offer related extensions of the subject matter.

The teachers do everything within their reach and beyond for each child. St. Paul’s Montessori teachers specialize in understanding stages of child development and recognizing a child’s period of interest in subject matter. We have noticed that this approach has the effect of promoting independence and confidence.

We have recommended St. Paul’s to family and friends who have been very thankful to become part of this beautiful community.

We would, without hesitation, entrust St. Paul’s to educate our children through high school, given the option.

St. Paul’s Episcopal Montessori School is an incredible place that develops the whole child not only fully implementing the Montessori Method but also allowing student voice and choice.  The commitment of the administration and teachers to providing a high quality education is evident every year, and I have personally seen this growth over 8 years.  St. Paul’s Montessori School is one of the highest if not the highest recommended school to send children because their success is widely known in the community.  They consistently produce results, and have received a 10 year accreditation because of their great success.  St. Paul’s Episcopal and Montessori School puts ALL children first as they care about the safety, development, preparedness, and success of their students.  This is also evident by the waiting list they have every year because parents want their children to attend this excellent school.

All three of my children have attended St. Paul's, and I have nothing but positive things to say about the teachers, staff, and school board. The teachers, in particular, are what make this school so special. The combination of the Montessori method and the Episcopal school tradition are a beautiful match for one another.

The negative reviews here are from anti-vaccine groups targeting the school after the school board made the decision to require vaccinations for the safety of our children. This was done in consultation with medical experts and researching the policies of Catholic schools. From a faith perspective, the Episcopal Church does not believe science and religion to be at odds, but different languages to express truth. The decision was made for the safety of the children in our school community.

Definitely recommended for any parents looking for a school that combines a diverse student body, the student-centered approach of Montessori, and the inclusive Christian ethos of the Episcopal Church. The fine arts programs are excellent.

The negative reviews here seem to be exclusively from an anti-vaccination stand-point, but I'm sure most parents want their children to attend a school where they will be as safe as possible. Requiring that all children be vaccinated against dangerous and potentially fatal diseases is part of ensuring student safety.

We recently tried Bright Horizons Braker Lane for our 6 months old, and I just want to share what we went through in case it helps another family.

Within the first week, our baby came home sick multiple times. It didn’t surprise me, because I saw how toys went straight from one baby’s mouth to another without being cleaned....multiple times in two weeks.
Hygiene felt like an afterthought. As even members were going in the class with uncovered shoes on.

What really broke us, though, was how little comfort our daughter got when she cried. She cried so hard at daycare that by the time we picked her up, she was still sobbing, and it continued for hours at home. Teachers didn’t seem to soothe her, and instead sometimes tried to force feed her while she was crying, which felt unsafe and honestly heartbreaking.

I know every childcare center has germs and tough adjustment periods, but this felt like neglect of the basics: clean toys, gentle care, and comfort for babies. We pulled her out within days.

As a dedicated healthcare professional and mother, selecting a childcare center that fosters a safe, nurturing, and emotionally supportive environment is of utmost importance. Unfortunately, my experience with this specific place of Bright Horizons network, raised significant concerns that ultimately led me to remove my child from their care.

One of the first red flags was the noticeable decline in my child’s health. My child experienced frequent illnesses and an unexplained loss of weight, which alarmed me as a parent and as a nurse. The lack of consistent communication regarding my child’s well-being, coupled with delays in transferring to another center, added unnecessary stress to an already concerning situation.

Additionally, my interactions with certain staff members left much to be desired. A specific encounter with a caregiver who approached me confrontationally regarding their role and responsibilities raised serious concerns about professionalism and their ability to provide compassionate care. This interaction, along with difficulty securing a meeting with the director, Devin, to address teacher-related concerns, made me question the overall management and commitment to parental communication.

Cleanliness and hygiene were another area of concern. On multiple occasions, I observed unsanitary conditions, particularly in the refrigerator where I stored my child’s milk. While these issues were addressed after being reported, the fact that such conditions existed in the first place was troubling. More importantly, while physical spaces can be cleaned, the overall attitude and care provided to children—critical for their emotional well-being—cannot be so easily remedied.

Ultimately, my mother’s intuition could not ignore the changes I witnessed in my child. Increased distress, anxiety, and emotional withdrawal indicated that something was not right. No matter how much I wanted to trust the process, my child’s well-being took precedence. The emotional toll this experience took on me as both a parent and a nurse made it clear that the environment at was not conducive to my child’s growth and happiness.

For parents seeking childcare, I strongly encourage thorough research, open communication, and trusting your instincts when evaluating a center. No job, convenience, or reputation is worth compromising your child’s safety and emotional health.
