This unexpected reunion led us to reconnect with several of his past caregivers. Each one was as kind and dedicated as I remembered, and it resurfaced warm feelings in my son as he reconnected to the place. We were both so touched by the memories and warmth of the staff.

The fact that these wonderful staff members are still part of the daycare speaks volumes about the leadership and the loving, consistent environment they've maintained over the years. It's truly remarkable.

We've had such a good experience at Avalon Academy! I like that it's a smaller group of kids (about 100), and all of the teachers know and greet all of the kiddos. Many of the teachers have a long tenure at the school and are so sweet with the children! This daycare was competitively priced versus other places we looked at, and they also had fewer holidays where the daycare was closed, which was a big benefit for us, since we both work. We've seen our daughter learn and grow so much since joining Avalon, and she seems to really enjoy it!

Avalon Academy exceeded all of my expectations when it comes to childcare. My daughter started attending here as an infant, and I can remember how nerve-racking it was looking for a place that she would be loved, cared for, and thrive in. She continued attending Avalon until she was four, and my son attended here as a baby as well. Quite literally every teacher, administrator, etc., at Avalon showed my family love and care, and we had a positive experience with every classroom my children attended. Not only do they treat the children with so much love but also one another. Positivity radiates throughout Avalon because kindness is consistently modeled for the children, and it shows! I am forever grateful for Avalon Academy and the foundation they laid for my children that will last them a lifetime! We will remember all of these women and this school fondly forever! I HIGHLY recommend enrolling your child at Avalon.

Avalon has been a great blessing! I absolutely love the entire staff they are all so loving & caring. I know my child is in great hands.
The only reason we are leaving is due to us moving out of the state but it makes me extremely sad taking my daughter out of Avalon Academy.
I highly recommend this school to any parents wanting to make sure their kids are in environment where they will grow and thrive.  I've seen tremendous progress in her education and she's always excited to share all the things shes learned!

We love it !! My daughter loves coming to “school”. Ms. Meka brings so much peace and security, my daughter loves her.  Ms. Hill is the new director and while change can be hard, the changes are positive and from an admin standpoint, she is making checkin and communication a lot easier.

I have ONLY been to Harvest Christian Academy for the past 15 years. I enrolled my first child in 2008 and have had 4 others attend plus a grandson and grand nephew. I trust the staff and it's always a welcoming place. The staff cares about my child's safety and takes time to focus on his learning. I can tell they are dedicated to him and I know he loves them just by his acceptance of everyone.

I absolutely love HCA ! I honestly would not take my kids anywhere else other then family. But here they are just like family! I love that they treat my kids as if they are their own, with kindness and compassion but also structure. HCA is not just a “play” care daycare, they teach the kids lessons and incorporate field trips and extra curricular activities as well. The director is continuously trying to find new ways to improve the experience for the children as well as the parents. This daycare is truly a Blessing.
The staff was very rude and treated me like they were too busy

This ladies are amazing. The daycare truly cares for the children as their own. My children are 7 & 9 and have had the blessing of growing with Zulema, Adriana and Mrs. Pico since they were 3-6 months old. This beautiful ladies are wonderful and always have great activities for the children. 100% recommend it!!

The teachers at the daycare are AMAZING!! They are so hands on with the kids, genuinely pour into the kids, and teach them so many things. They’re extremely passionate about what they do, and that’s extremely comforting to us parents.

OPERATION_NAME: Miss Pattycake Childcare,LLC d/b/a Miss Pattycake Montessori
review_text: Ms Kesa Gigi Ale are great teachers! They are kind and caring! My two kids study in here. They are both very happy every day!

OPERATION_NAME: Miss Pattycake Childcare,LLC d/b/a Miss Pattycake Montessori
review_text: This business was sold last year, new owners bring a traditional institutional feel to the location.  The previous owner Anne was always willing to be flexible on drop ins etc and was always in the front door greeting all the parents every day.  No more of that with the new owners, prices have also increased since the ownership changed and staff has also changed.  New owners seem nice, however, in the past we always dealt with the owner Anne,  today it seems harder to reach the owner and almost everything is taken care of by the children caregivers. The only reason I did not give 5 stars is because of the lack of security and the lack of flexibility for current children. We will try and give this place another chance... Will update my review in a few months to let you all know how things are going.

Mary Immaculate Preschool is very much more than a preschool, It’s like family!! The Sisters are like moms to the kids... The school is full of infinite joy and laughter. They are passionate and it show through there professionalism. To top that off there curriculums are amazing. The classes are clean, well equipped with appropriate toys and activities. Thank you to all the Sisters for all your love, caring and patience to the children. The children are certainly gonna grow to love learning thank to you.

A few days ago my daughter turned two years of going to my children's choice academy, I got the photo that Erika sent me while she was taking care of her the first time, my baby was barely two months old.
Each photo and the knowledge that she was in good hands calmed my anxiety as a new mother after leaving her baby to go to work. I don't know if all the people at my children's choice academy know what each one of them means to me. As an independent mother, knowing that my daughter is happy to go, and see each of them like Erika, Rissa and all the people who work there calms my heart.
when my baby started going she was a only breas fed  baby and they made sure it stayed that way, I also loved that they very much respected the feeding plan that I had for Luna since she had her transition from breastfeeding to food  made at home.
There are not enough good things that can be said about my childrens Choice Academy.
Thank you.

If I could leave more than 5 stars I would! The owner is so kind and runs an amazing facility. The staff is so great with the children. My son is so happy everyday to wake up and get ready to go to his daycare. Their hours and accommodation's are so great for anyone who works long hours or even on weekends. I could go on and on about how amazing this place is. But I definitely recommend it to everyone! They give you daily updates and pictures and so much about your child throughout the day which is so comforting to be able to see him and check on him while at work.

This daycare has gone above and beyond to make me and my son comfortable! It’s hard to leave your baby with anyone, but it makes me feel good to know he is in good hands. They always keep me in the loop with everything. I definitely recommend!

Amazing place. Our daughter loves going to daycare which we were not expecting but are definitely happy about. All the teachers are beyond nice and keep us informed of everything throughout the day. The owner was very reassuring when we signed her up and even other parents told us how much their kids loved the place. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a place where they take good care of your children.

This daycare is truly exceptional! The owner has created such a warm and welcoming environment, and the staff are some of the most caring and attentive people I’ve ever met. My kids come home every day full of joy and excitement about the things they learned and the fun activities they participated in. It’s clear that the children’s happiness and well-being are the top priority here. the daily updates and photos they provide are such a thoughtful touch ,it really makes you feel connected to your child’s day. I’m so grateful to have found this amazing place and would recommend it to anyone searching for quality childcare!❤️❤️ Fares, Massa, and us are so lucky 💕

We are so grateful for the time our children spent at Guidepost Montessori at Galleria. We recently had to change schools due to a move, and while the transition is still very recent, it’s already clear how meaningful this experience was for both of our kids (ages 4 and 2).

Our 2-year-old was with Ms. Katelyn, who was wonderful. He loved going to school each day, and it was clear how attentive and engaged she was. She celebrated his milestones with real enthusiasm, from toilet learning to trying new foods (a big deal for a picky eater), and kept us well-informed along the way. She is truly a gem!

Our 4-year-old was in Ms. Marjorie and Ms. Verusska’s classroom, and we could not have asked for more thoughtful teachers. They are everything you hope for in Montessori guides - kind, patient, deeply observant, and truly invested in each child as an individual. They fostered self-driven learning while providing a calm, loving structure. What stood out most was how genuine their care was. As a parent, that level of attentiveness and warmth means everything.

We are also incredibly appreciative of the leadership at the school. Ms. Erin (Head of School) and Ms. Jordyn (Assistant Head of School) run everything smoothly and thoughtfully. They know our children - their personalities, their friendships, and what makes them feel safe and supported. During our transition out of the school, they were exceptionally kind and supportive to us as parents, which made a meaningful difference.

This is a warm, nurturing Montessori community grounded in respect for children and intentional learning. We would highly recommend this school to any family looking for a thoughtful, caring early childhood environment.

We’ve been sending our oldest child here since 2022 and recently enrolled our youngest. We’ve always appreciated what the school offers from a Montessori perspective — the materials, lesson plans, and overall approach — along with the convenient location. Over the past year, it has truly started to shine even more, and it’s clear a lot of care has gone into building the staff.

Both of our children have teachers they love, feel safe with, and genuinely learn from. The Head of School deserves credit for maintaining such a strong team, and the front desk is always friendly, welcoming, and helpful.

We’re very grateful to have such a wonderful place for our children!

We feel so lucky to have Ms. Aafiya and Ms. Katelyn as our daughter’s teachers in the toddler classroom. They are truly amazing! Every morning, our daughter is so excited to go to school she literally runs to the classroom.

Both teachers create such a warm, loving, and structured environment where the kids thrive. Our daughter has learned so many new things since being in their class, and we can see her confidence and curiosity grow every day. Ms. Aafiya and Ms. Katelyn are incredibly patient, gentle, and hardworking, and it’s clear how much they care about each child.

Lastly, we want to give a big shout-out to the leadership team, Ms. Erin and Ms. Jordyn. They truly set the tone for the amazing culture at this school. They know every parent by name and have a genuine understanding of how each child is doing. It’s clear that the school has thrived under their thoughtful and caring management.

We’re so grateful for everything this wonderful team does it means the world to know our daughter is surrounded by such dedicated, kind, and passionate people every day.

We just started at Guidepost about 2 months ago with our 3 year old joining the Children’s House classroom with Ms. Cherrish.
The whole school team is so loving to our little guy, and he LOVES, I mean loooooves his guide, Ms. Cherrish.  He invites her to our house everyday and has started saying she’s his best friend.  Having such a warm, joyful, and loving teacher makes his day everyday.  We see clear signs of his learning at home, practicing different lessons he’s learned and even pretending to teach us lessons too.  I’ve seen a noticeable difference in his ability to stay focused on a work task for longer than I ever thought was possible for a toddler, and it’s most definitely because of his experience at Guidepost and with Cherrish.  We couldn’t be happier with this decision and highly recommend this sweet school!

Language development is such a critical part of learning for a four-year-old, and we’ve been so impressed with how thoughtfully Ms. Marjorie supports that growth. She works with Ethan every day with patience, creativity, and genuine care. We can already see how much his vocabulary, confidence, and communication have expanded in such a short time. It’s clear that the progress we see at home comes directly from what he learns in her classroom. We’re very grateful for her dedication and the positive impact she’s made on Ethan’s early learning journey. A special thank-you to Ms. Veruska for her kindness and patience—especially for staying late with Ethan every day. We also want to recognize Principal Erin, who has been consistently making thoughtful improvements to the school. Her leadership and the positive changes she’s implemented are clearly reflected in the supportive and engaging environment the children experience every day.

This daycare is my kiddos second home, not because she's there all the time, but because it is a home away from home for her. She is so loved, well taken care of, and has grown leaps and bounds educationally. I am so very grateful for all the wonderful humans that keep it going and for all that they've done for my daughter and I. There is absolutely no where like it and we'll miss it when kindergarten starts. She loves it so much though, we'll be back for all the school breaks. This place is definitely 10/10 and I recommend it to everyone.

The Footprint Foundation was recommended to me by a family member who's child attended as well. After going through having a child during covid, I was afraid to send my son off to daycare when I returned to work in 2021. This team of amazing teachers has been an extension to our family since September 2021 and my second son joined in 2023. My boys absolutely love their school and their teachers. I am beyond grateful to have such caring, understanding and helpful people in our lives. The staff are all so loving and care for my children like they are family. They have all reached out during hard times whether it was personal matters or weather related and checked on my family. My kids have learned so much and have surprised me at times with things they have learned. Mr. Joe, Mrs. Maria, Mrs. Nini, Mrs. Nidia as well as Mrs. Michelle and Mr. Adrian, I am forever thankful for you all! I highly recommend The Footprint Foundation, they are absolutely 5 star!

My son has been part of the Footprint family for two years. I say family because that’s exactly what it feels like when I take him there. They treat him so well and he’s learned so much since he’s been attending The Footprint Foundation. As a first time mom, Joe and Maria made drop offs easy for us both and I cannot say enough about how amazing all the staff and owners are! During a terrible storm, they checked on our family and offered their home so we could bathe and eat when we didn’t have power! We are truly grateful for Adrian, Michelle and the entire team at TFF! Y’all are doing incredible things there/

Wonderful place to trust with the care of the ones you love most. The people that work here genuinely care. My 2 year old is so excited to go to *school* every morning. They have helped him exceed milestones and attributed to the amazing little guy he is today.

In beginning my review of The Footprint Foundation preschool, I feel it's important to express my deep gratitude. This school stands out with its exceptional staff, who display a remarkable level of care for their students. As a mother, the guilt of leaving my child in someone else's care was overwhelming, but the staff's support and understanding made this transition much easier. The peace of mind I've experienced here is truly beyond words.

Despite visiting many larger and newer facilities, none could match the dedication and thoughtfulness that The Footprint Foundation provides. The teacher-to-child ratio is ideal, aligning perfectly with my preferences. This ensures personalized attention – I can ask any staff member about my child, and they always know exactly what I’m talking about. The fact that the school isn’t overcrowded is another significant plus.

Initially, I was heartbroken at the thought of parting with my son, but seeing his joy each morning at drop-off reassured me that we made the right choice. My advice to other parents is to take the time to really connect with the teachers. Once you do, you'll understand why this preschool is the best choice for your child.

My kids love coming here. My daughter attends daily and she's always smiling when I drop her off and pick her up. The teachers and directors are very nice. They call immediately when they have any concerns no matter how small. The classrooms are inviting and there are cameras throughout. They host parents night out once a month or so which is great, and my son loves to join his little sister on these nights. Overall a great child care experience.

I highly recommend this daycare! I have both school-aged kids and a baby enrolled, and I’ve been so impressed with the care and attention each of them receives. One thing that really stood out to me is that the kids are learning ASL. The staff is always friendly, patient, and helpful, they truly go above and beyond. They make sure the kids stay active, play outside regularly, and even take the babies out for strolls. As a parent, having peace of mind while I’m away is everything, and I definitely feel that here.

My kids absolutely love Kiddie Academy Cypresswood! They learn a lot each day and the facility is absolutely clean and sanitized for their safety! Also, I couldn’t believe how affordable it was to get a full time school/daycare for both my 5 year son and my 3 year old daughter! They are brand new and that’s why they didn’t have a lot of reviews yet! I highly recommend you take your kids here if you want the very best for them. Also, they have cameras I can watch my kids as well!! This is the best Kiddie Academy location by far.

My two boys Graduated from Academy and now my third Son has been going there for more than a month now and he loves coming everyday. Activities are fun. Director is so kind.Great people that work there. We love Kiddie Academy!❤️

My daughter (4) never attended any type of child care and when she turned 4 I wanted her to be prepared for kindergarten. I was looking for a preschool that was curriculum based but also fun for her. At first my daughter was having a difficult time at drop offs but later she was more than happy to go to school and tell me about everything she had done. The school and staff are amazing people that truly want your child to succeed. They also have many opportunities for parents to connect/participate with the school. They also provide many schedules to parents who might not want full time.

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Development Center
review_text:
Our family went through one of the most stressful experiences of our lives because of a report UT-CDC made to CPS (child protection services)  in May 2025. A teacher noticed a small bruise on our daughter’s hip at drop-off — a completely ordinary mark that doctors later confirmed was a typical playground injury — and instead of calling us to ask what happened, the centre filed a CPS report claiming it could have been caused by a hammer.

This led to two weeks of investigations, home visits, a forensic exam at Dell Children’s Hospital (for which we were billed $490), multiple interviews, and even our older daughter being questioned at her school — all while my wife suffered panic attacks and we lost days of work. After everything, CPS and the Austin Police Department closed the case as unfounded and found absolutely no evidence of abuse.

We fully respect mandated-reporting laws, but the lack of basic judgment and communication here caused serious trauma for our family. The centre still has not apologized or taken accountability for how this was handled.

If you are a parent considering this school, please be aware: they appear to over-report to CPS, sometimes without first contacting parents. A single bruise — even in an obvious play area — can result in a full abuse investigation.

Parents deserve transparency, common sense, and empathy, none of which we experienced.

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Development Center
review_text:
I am a parent of a three year old with food allergies, energy and curiosity! He has been in care since around 2 ½. At first in a home care setting, then in a larger setting that marketed itself as being similar to this one. That center had too many kids and inexperienced teachers without the support to implement appropriate pedagogy to develop well-rounded little ones.

The difference in this center compared to the last is 100% better. The teachers are excellent! The administration and staff are top-notch! They create a community where you know your child is fully cared about and supported. UTCDC meets the 5-star mark in my book. We should have known that a childcare center that’s part of UT would be the perfect spot.

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Development Center
review_text: This is one of the best childcare facilities in the city of Austin. It definitely has a long wait list (we waited 19 months before our child had a spot in the toddler program) so I advise you sign up as soon as you can. My child has loved his teachers at this school, and their meal program makes my life easy! If you are affiliated with the University of Texas, I cannot recommend this place enough. Run to sign up!

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Development Center
review_text: We've had two children at UTCDC - Comal and have had a wonderful experience.  Our oldest started shortly before turning three and our second has been in the program since the infant room.  The teachers are loving and kind, little turnover in staff (which I love), and the facility is always well-kept.  We had cycled through a couple of daycares before and knew that this school was the perfect one for our family.  Could not be more happy!

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Development Center
review_text: The Comal CDC has the most caring teachers, administrators, and staff. They treat my kids like their own. They are highly trained, exceedingly experienced and some of the best professional care givers I know. This place is like family.

Both of our children have always enjoyed their time here, and flourished over the years.

The assistant director, Ms. Theosha, has been with the La Petite Academy for at least ten years. She is personable and caring towards children and parents alike.

The devoted teachers and childcare workers (Ms. Roiyl, Julie, and Esther) brings so much joy and laughter. Whenever my children were in a bad mood, they would uplift their spirits and make each day a fun, learning experience.

We are very fortunate to have been a part of the LPA family for over three years!

My daughter has been with this daycare for almost a year. She has so much fun with everyone. Julie is her number one favorite person. My daughter will go right to her and gets upset if Julie leaves for the day or even for lunch.
Esther helped teach my daughter how to walk and made sure she got a recording of my daughter taking her first steps. Not too long ago, I was picking up my daughter and while I was trying to put her coat on, she walked away from me and went straight to Esther. It was safe to say my daughter was not done playing with Esther.
We’ve been slowly trying to transition my baby to the next classroom up from where she is now, but they are very considerate of how she responds and never wants her to feel stressed or scared. So, if that means letting my baby sit in their lap for however long, they do just that. Of course, you can’t forget about Roiyl and Sandra. They too help take great care of my daughter and learn her likes and dislikes.
Theosha is proactive, quick at responding to issues and has never shrugged her shoulders at me when I addressed an issue unlike the previous director. Just the other day, she said to me that the children come first. Which is very important because my daughter will always come before me. Anyone will run into an issue that may need to be addressed. It is how you resolve that issue and what steps are taken to prevent it from happening again.
Everyone plays a part in helping my daughter reach all her milestones, keeping her happy, and of course dealing with a first-time mommy like me

We’ve had a great experience at La Petite over the past year. Our son started at three months old, and Ms. Julie has been amazing -  caring, attentive, and supportive. We’re so grateful for the nurturing environment and highly recommend it!

My granddaughter just recently started attending La Petite Academy, so far I’m pleased with some of the staff however I would love to see more teaching education where she is learning more to be school ready. I love the fact that I am able to watch her on camera throughout the day, it soothes my heart mind and anxieties of knowing she’s okay and in safe hands.

Just watched a la petite  bus driver almost hit a car, dropping off kids at school and then mean mug them as they passed when the other car was the one that had the right away. Male driver, do better. Wouldn’t want me kid in the bus with them.

They are very caring like a family really. My daughter and son are extremely happy to be there, they are always smiling and emotionally attached to their teachers! It is so wonderful knowing while we are at work we don't have to worry about my kids. We get texts and pictures showing all of the fun they have. Their facility is clean and has safety measures in place. The staff communicates effectively with parents and encourages them to be involved in their children's well-being. The center is a welcoming environment for both kids and parents. Overall, they are professionally organized, and I trust them with my kids. They do a really great job!

Locomotion Early Learning Center #1 W. Little York my children has the best care. This center surely must get 5 star's 🌟
Experience, Great experience for your children.  Lesson plans are planned for each child appropriate class. Great price for your child care program

I like the school because of it’s location to where we live. My biggest issue with the school is that the cost is about the highest in our area for daycares but they offer No Extracurricular activities. Such as soccer or dance. For the money being spent I feel more should be provided for the children. And then I feel that when you express your concerns as a paying parent you get attitude from the director Miss Tish. Everyone is nice until you begin to express yourself. My 2 son’s have attended the school from two years old (they are now 3 & 5). Overall my kids do enjoy the school, as they are kids and love to play.  I am still 60/40 on the school... Miss Alexis (a teacher @ the school) has been a huge help to us with our schedules.

This place was hands down the best experience my boys (18 months & 3yr) have ever experienced. I was so sad and even cried when our family had to relocate. The staff is awesome and the director is absolutely the best! The place is kept neat and tidy and clean all the time. The daily prayer is so awesome and the curriculum ( yes, the educate your children, not just sit there and watch them play) is great, my kids were constantly being stimulated by their daily activities. The price slightly above average but that's what your paying for! Better teachers makes for better care. Thank you Locomotion ( Ms. Tish and team) Jack and Roro miss you terribly.

I really like this daycare. The staff really works with the parents and the kids. The director Tish is the sweetest person ever and they are very caring people. Only improvement they need to make is the learning curriculum could be a little more challenging, even for the toddlers.
These People Are 100% For The people. They Will Help You In Anyway Possible! Love Them To Death. I Can See Why They Are With Red Cross!

I randomly met someone who worked at Forge for Families & they told me how I could complete community service hour there (I got a ticket). The following Monday I called to get more information after I could not complete volunteer form online. Spoke with Beverly and she was very kind and willing to help, before call was finished we got disconnected and by the time I called back she was out of her office. I called back the next day to finish my conversation with Beverly & things had completely changed. She was questioning why I got a ticket and ultimately told me she could not help me. She basically told me that I could not complete hours within her department because I was a new person & if I had volunteered prior she would be happy to help, they would prefer someone generally "interested" & not just trying to get hours. I informed her I originally thought about animal shelter but since the person I originally met said they specialized with community service hours and helping UH/TSU students, I though this would be a better fit. She continued to blow me off, treat me like a random completely unqualified person, and  tell me she couldn't help me (without knowing anything about me except my name and sound of my voice).  I tried calling original person I met multiple times and left messages but no response. I'm very disgusted that a "Christ" based organization whose mission is to help Inner City Communities would act this way towards someone trying to volunteer and help. Yes, I discovered this organization because of something I needed but I was really looking forward to being a frequent volunteer and even suggesting this place to my friends, not anymore. Hopefully their actions are more welcoming to others who come for help.
After school program is wonderful. Ms. Mac cares about our kids

A Christian based facility, where you can take you kids to be a kid, while playing basketball, soccer and other various activities. I have seen FCA from Rice University there and the staff from the Forge they are all very pleasant.
Wonderful family oriented place. The staff is great and they offer a wide range of programs that meet your personal needs.

I came here to drop off a few items for donation. Beautiful building and wonderful, friendly staff. They have a heart for this community and are truly making a difference. I will be making regular contributions to this organization.

I’ve had both my daughters here since they were 18 months. I can always trust they are going to be well taken care of. They always have nice activities for the children throughout the whole year and always helping parents out in their time of need. 100% recommend!

Both my daughters attend HNS and they have truly thrived there. With having parents who only speak Spanish I really appreciate the bilingual teachings. Everyone is so nice and you can tell they really care about the children and want what’s best for them.
Wonderful teachers! Mrs. Rosanna and Mrs. Ada are the best and communicate great with parents! I’ve had 2 children enrolled along nieces and nephews!
Both my daughters attended HNS and have for a couple of years, I’ve seen so much growth and success with the learning they receive at the school. Thank you for everything you do for the community

The sweetest preschool in town. If you are looking for a place for your young child, this is truly the program. They emphasize all the important things in life — nature, music, friendship, kindness, and helping others.
The teachers are exceptional, and the director is beyond amazing. Every single person there has a genuine heart for children and a true passion for teaching.
If you are searching for a nurturing, joyful place for your little one, this is it.

We love Kinderplatz! The school is very caring and loving to all three children. The school focuses on learning through the various forms of art. This let's the kids have time to be creative in painting, plays, music and much more.

Children can start at 2 years old, but depending on the year, it can be hard to get in to the school. I highly recommend signing up for the program 1-2 years in advance to get in.

We have been so thrilled with Kinderplatz of Fine Arts! On our tour of the school with Paula McMillen, the director at Kinderplatz, we were impressed with the facility, the dedication to early childhood development and the research behind the curriculum employed at the school. Now that both of our children have been at Kinderplatz for over two years, we are very confident with our choice. We have watched them grow and develop their creative minds and personalities with joy, and they don't even realize that they have been "learning" the entire time! We love seeing the smiles on their faces every day after school and hearing about their adventures with friends. They have stories about "experiments," painting masterpieces on easels in the art room, acting out plays in full costume, playing instruments in the band, writing letters, counting, and countless other fun learning experiences. We have become good friends with many of the other parents through the frequent school activities as well. We love Kinderplatz!

A true blessing in childcare and education. The teachers are always enthusiastic and cheerful and my children LOVE to be there. The summer camps are weekly and you can pick and choose per week.  The art, music and life play are unmatched by any other facility in my opinion. It is hard to leave your children; Kinderplatz places my heart at rest, I know my children are enjoying themselves while they learn & that is a priceless feeling.
A premier learning center for preschoolers with all aspect of child development covered from science to art, from math to dance performance and music skills.

We are very happy we chose this childcare center. It has a warm, home-like atmosphere and caring, attentive teachers. Our child enjoys coming here and feels safe and comfortable. The activities are engaging and varied, and the Russian-speaking environment was very important for our family. We highly recommend this center!

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Kids at Summer Lake Ranch
review_text:
Ivy Kids of Summer Lake Ranch has been an abundant blessing to my son and I. My son recently turned 4 years old and has a speech disorder that affects how well he can express himself. He excels in academics, but I was nervous that educators may overlook that due to his journey with speech.

Ace was previously at another early education center, but the program was not satisfactory for us. He was regressing with simple things he was doing well at home (potty etiquette, handwriting, etc) and so I placed him at Ivy after a couple tours. The cleanliness, curriculum, extracurricular activities offered, and staff made this an easy choice.

Ace has truly blossomed since enrolling full time in their Pre-K program. He is speaking MUCH more! The children are ecstatic to see him every morning and always tell him “Ace, mom’s here!” when it’s time to go. He’s had difficult emotional moments and Mr. & Mrs. Kapur always allow him to sit with them to calm down before returning to class. They are so kind, so helpful, and so accessible.

My son is excited to learn everyday (weekends included)! School has only emphasized his love of reading, math, and science. The routine has dramatically helped my son develop. Ms. Angela told me “we do real work in here,” the first day Ace joined. And that, they do!

I’m sad Ace will be ending his time at Ivy Kids (for now) to begin Pre-K4 in Humble ISD, but I am blessed to have experienced this with him.

Thank you!

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Kids at Summer Lake Ranch
review_text:
Ivy Kids of Summer Lake Ranch is conveniently located close to many subdivions. Summerwood, beside Summer Lake Ranch, across the street from Still Water on Lake Houston, Lakewood Pines as well as Balmoral, with The Groves right there too.
They open at 06:00 (6:00AM) and close at 18:30 (6:30PM) which offers such a great value for parents who work late or early. The institution has a rigorous HACCP Program for the cleanliness of the school and their food preparation, there is an on site chef (Augustine) who is very professional, amicable and helpful. The school updates patents through email and post the monthly meal. Plan online, if your child has a special diet you can send your child with food, just no foods that contain allergens, such as Peanuts and Tree Nuts due to the seriousness of said allergy.
I y Kids has cameras throughout the facility, inside and out. You ate able to log in and peek at your loved ones, what a relief for many parents, especially that first child.

The staff are loving and cheerful, MS. Lluvia was put on this earth to LOVE children, she shows genuine heartfelt love and comes to work everyday with such a positive and upbeat attitude, seeing her with all the children just warms the heart because of her unselfish free flowing love to every child, no favorites! Ms. Jaimee and Veronica are tender souls that understand the wats/needs of their little tribe.

A staff is a representative of leadership and the owners of Ivy Kids are phenomenal, they have a deep connection with the school and it's everyday operations. Thwy care about your concerns and are available to address, inform or assist with matters related to your loved ones.

We appreciate this school and all that they have done for us and our children, the relationships that have been forged ove the time we have been here is lovely, great facility for the growth of young minds.

Park Cities Baptist Church in University Park, Texas, is a true gem in the community, offering a warm, welcoming environment and a deep sense of fellowship. From the moment you walk through the doors, you are greeted with genuine kindness and a spirit of inclusivity. Even by the wonderful and kind security team. The church’s architecture is beautiful, combining tradition with modern touches, creating a serene space for worship.

One of the standout features of Park Cities Baptist is the powerful and inspiring worship services. The music ministry is exceptional, blending contemporary and traditional hymns in a way that resonates with people of all ages. The sermons are deeply rooted in scripture, yet relevant to everyday life, offering both spiritual depth and practical wisdom. The pastors speak with sincerity, always delivering messages that challenge and uplift.

Beyond Sunday services, the church is deeply committed to community outreach and missions. There are numerous programs for children, youth, adults, and seniors, ensuring that everyone has a place to grow in their faith. Small groups and Bible studies provide an intimate setting for building relationships and spiritual development.

The congregation at Park Cities Baptist Church is diverse, reflecting the community’s values of unity and compassion. Whether you’re a lifelong member or a first-time visitor, the church makes you feel like part of a family. It’s a place where people come to connect with God, serve others, and find meaningful relationships.

In summary, Park Cities Baptist Church is a safe, vibrant, faith-filled community that offers rich spiritual nourishment and a welcoming atmosphere for anyone seeking a place to grow in their Christian walk.

We had a positive experience with this daycare. The program supported my child’s social development, speech, and fine motor skills. The staff is caring, attentive, and consistently informative. I would highly recommend this daycare.

Mazi absolutely adores her. I can see his confidence and curiosity bloom more every week. He comes home talking about what he learned, and it’s clear he feels seen, valued, and loved. That kind of impact is rare, and it speaks volumes about Ms. Maria’s heart and dedication.

The Academy of Young Scholars isn’t just a daycare — it’s a community that truly cares. I’m beyond grateful for Ms. Maria and everyone who plays a part in creating such a warm, safe, and inspiring place for my child to learn and grow

Our experience so far has exceeded our expectations.

My toddler has been going here since he was a newborn and we both love it. The staff is so nurturing and that gave me peace of mind that no matter what my son would always be attending this daycare. The staff also communicates exceptionally when they have questions/concerns or when you need to reach out to them throughout the day. My favorite part is the update of pictures and videos throughout the day to show how my son is doing. That’s what helped me most in the beginning when first starting him in daycare. My son is also being supported with his developmental milestones while in their care as I do at home. If you are looking for a great and safe daycare, this place is amazing!

First off I don’t even know where to start. They are so unprofessional I wouldn’t recommend to anyone. They have family members coming in and out it’s definitely a lot going on there, again I don’t recommend.

My kids have gone here for about 4 years and everyone on staff is amazing. I love them and would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great child care. Your child will be in a great learning environment and will be well taken care of.

I am so thankful that we found Beehive for our daughter! This is her third year attending Beehive and she absolutely loves spending every single day with her friends and teachers. She has a blast, gets messy, creates something new every day, problem solves with her friends, and plays, plays, plays - all while learning invaluable social and emotional skills, communication and collaboration skills, and positive characteristic traits that will last a lifetime!

Beehive’s student-led, play based model centered around an incorporated curriculum was exactly what we wanted for our third kiddo.

Our teachers and director are the best! They are knowledgeable, positive, fun, creative, and dedicated to supporting all of the children.

I love spending a couple of days per month helping out at the school and playing with our daughter and the other children. It builds a strong sense of community and fosters our co-op philosophy.

Our family highly recommends Beehive and the community will always hold a special place in my heart.

We couldn’t be happier to have found Beehive for our daughter. From the very beginning, it’s been clear that this is so much more than just a preschool- it’s a welcoming, supportive community. The play-based, child-led approach has been incredible for her development, inspiring her curiosity and love for creating, while also giving her the space to explore and grow at her own pace.

The teachers are truly outstanding- knowledgeable, compassionate, and incredibly dedicated. They take the time to really get to know each child, designing experiences that nurture their interests while gently encouraging new skills and independence. The director is equally wonderful, always approachable and deeply involved in the day-to-day life of the school, which creates such a strong sense of connection.

The co-op model has been such a gift to our family, allowing us to actively participate in her education and get a meaningful glimpse into her school experience. It’s also helped us form lasting relationships with other families, which has been an unexpected joy.

Our daughter absolutely loves the before-school Spanish program and the after-school Sparkle Studio — they’ve been such fun extensions of her day. As we look ahead to kindergarten, we feel incredibly confident and grateful knowing she’s had such a thoughtful, nurturing foundation here. Beehive is a truly special place, and we can’t recommend it highly enough.

Our family loves Beehive!! I love how the play based model that feels like hidden veggies in a yummy pasta! They think their just playing but also learning so much in a gentle and fun environment! The teachers are sweet, responsive, and really get to know your kid. And I love the parent involvement. In a world that gets so busy, Beehive feels like a village where we get to be together raising our children with a common goal.

We actually went to a different preschool before switching to Beehive and we will say that Beehive is hands-down the best preschool in the area, the teachers are gentle with the kids and really teach them how to self regulate as well as learn how they can be kind to others, which is so important at this age. It is a preschool that is run like a co-op but different than what I thought, they have full-time teachers but then the parents will take turns being the teacher assistant. This way you get to know all of your childs friend circle and you are deeply involved in The school community. They make it so easy, and I couldn’t imagine a better school system I also get to be involved. Also the teachers are super attentive to the needs Individually and have given us great advice on how to help Them succeed. They encourage creative play and include a healthy dose of outside play as well.

We have had an incredible experience a Beehive Co-op. We were looking for a play based school program with lots of outdoor time, strong social emotional learning skills, and research based. It's surpassed our expectations. Our son adores his teachers, and we are so grateful to be a part of such a warm and supportive community.

review_text: We started our son here as his first ever daycare experience. I was gutted to be away from him everyday but am having a full 180 on the situation thanks to the team at Springdale. OPERATION_NAME: Dahlia Montessori and Spanish Immersion School
review_text: We moved our son to Springdale from a different daycare when he was eight months old. It’s always nerve-wracking to leave your kiddo in a new place, but we have now been at Springdale for a year and I cannot say enough wonderful things about this place. The teachers are absolutely amazing, the director, Eva, is so kind communicative and thorough. Our 18 month old is excited to walk into his classroom every morning, and has a big smile on his face when we pick him up. We receive tons of updates throughout the day (with cute pics!) on what the kids are doing. We feel so lucky to have found such a great school for our little guy and can’t recommend Springdale more highly.

Nana and her staff are amazing. They deserve more than 5 stars ⭐️ My babies have been attending Nana's since 2019. Nana and her staff engage with all kids meeting their needs, making sure they are safe and learning while enjoying themselves. They have the coolest dance parties. Something is always going on to keep the kids busy. I love the Spanish Immersion program. With that program, my daughter was able to test and got accepted into dual language program in Kinder.

My son was here for 2 years. When we had a 2nd birthday party, the kids from Nana's were easily the most respectful and kind. It was clear that Nana's was a great choice. We moved to Dallas and immediately we felt the changes in the kids around ours. Nana's kept a really good handle on the kids and they always came home happy.

My daughter was here for 3 years and now my son for a year and a half. This has been the best place for our family. It is spanish-immersion, and my daughter left speaking well enough to be in a dual-language kinder. Maria has been so kind and flexible with our scheduling needs. So grateful for Nana’s! We have been there since 2021 and have had a great experience. They teach all of the skills that they would learn throughout pre-K but most importantly they love the kids and make their time fun! They host special activities and have theme days from time to time.  I would highly recommend Nana’s to anyone needing care for their little ones.

Our daughter is so happy here.  She’s picking up Spanish at school while learning English at home.  All the staff are loving and attentive really feels like a big family.  The schedule is wonderful for working parents, long days for our baby but she’s happy and exhausted by the end of the day, sleeps very well since attending daycare.  Nana you da real mvp

The director Ms.Caitlin is absolutely amazing and made our transition so smooth from the very beginning. The staff and admin team always check in with us, and it truly means so much. We genuinely love everyone here.

As a teacher myself, I have very high expectations and know exactly what to look for, and this team has exceeded them.  My son no longer feels anxious and doesn’t mind staying longer, which speaks volumes. We are so grateful for this program and the entire team!

From day one till now I have sent both my kids here. And they love it especially my daughter Maia she loves all her teachers and friends that she meets. And I love the administration of Primrose Lakeshore a wonderful group of people working hard together to keep our children safe and have fun. Ms Brenda has been doing a fantastic job with the help of her ladies beside her. Thank you Primrose Lakeshore love you all guys and thank you again

We’ve had an incredible experience at Primrose School at Heritage and are so glad we chose them a year ago. The communication with parents is excellent and we always feel informed and connected to what’s happening day to day.

We’ve had a wonderful experience at Primrose of Heritage over the past two years. Both of our boys attend, and we couldn’t be happier with the care and education they receive.

The teachers and staff are warm, attentive, and truly invested in the children’s growth. We’ve seen so much development in our boys, and we’re grateful to be part of such a supportive community. We highly recommend it!

We enrolled our girls (4yo and 1yo) in Primrose in June 2025 and we’ve been so impressed. The facility is clean, the staff is friendly and communicative, and our kids are extremely happy. Our children have been enrolled at Primrose School at Heritage for 5 years now, and our experience with the school has been exceptional. We are truly grateful with our experience at The Primrose School in Heritage. Staff, teachers and the community is amazing!

OPERATION_NAME: Celebree School of Dallas North Park
review_text:
This school has been an outstanding experience for our family. The management team, led by Ashlie and Marti, is organized, responsive, and genuinely committed to creating a safe, nurturing, and well-run environment for the children. Communication is clear and consistent, and it’s obvious they put thought into both staff quality and daily operations. The leadership team understands working parents, and even during the ice storm this year, they decided to open to take care of working families.

The teachers are incredibly warm and caring. Ms. Hannah, Kelsey, Jade, and Jasmine are truly exceptional, warm, patient, and highly engaged with the kids. They take the time to understand each child’s personality and learning style, and they create a positive, structured atmosphere that helps children feel comfortable and confident. You can see the care and professionalism in everything they do, from classroom activities to how they interact with parents at pickup and drop-off.

It’s reassuring to know our child is in a place where they are supported, encouraged, and cared for by people who clearly love what they do. I highly recommend it to any parent looking for strong leadership and dedicated teachers.

OPERATION_NAME: Celebree School of Dallas North Park
review_text:
Finding a nurturing and inclusive educational environment can truly transform a family’s experience, especially when a child faces unique challenges. Our family has been fortunate to discover such a place in this school, which has become a genuine blessing for us all. From the very beginning, the warmth and openness extended by the entire leadership and teaching staff have made a significant difference.

The directors, Ashlie and Marti, set a welcoming tone that resonates throughout the school. Their leadership fosters a culture of care and attentiveness that is reflected in every interaction. Among the many dedicated educators, Ms. Jade and Ms. Harris stand out for their extraordinary commitment to our son’s development.

Our child has a speech delay and difficulties with eating, which is not easy to manage. We have unfortunately been and schools that have lacked empathy, understand and patience that led to him withdrawing socially. However, thanks to the teachers’ at Celebree he feels supported rather than pressured. Their understanding approach not only helps him progress but also nurtures his confidence and well-being. This kind of nurture and care is invaluable and speaks volumes about the school’s dedication to each child’s individual needs.

We are deeply grateful for the kindness and professionalism that define this environment, confident that it lays a strong foundation for our son’s growth and happiness.

OPERATION_NAME: Celebree School of Dallas North Park
review_text:
The director Ashlie is very professional
She loves her staff and all the children under her care. She goes above and beyond to give families the child care experience they desire. Your children are in good hands with Ashlie and her staff. This school will be the best choice for you and your family.

OPERATION_NAME: Celebree School of Dallas North Park
review_text: Our 2 kids have been here for a little over a month and we have had an amazing experience at Celebree NorthPark so far! The directors, Alex and Ashlie, are the best. They made us feel comfortable from the moment we toured and they were able to accommodate some special requests that our family had with no hesitation. The teachers have been wonderful as well, classrooms are clean and adorable and everything seems very well organized. We have switched daycares a couple of times for various reasons so we've seen some different approaches and Celebree is high on our list. Our kids are learning a lot, making friends and they come home happy!

OPERATION_NAME: Celebree School of Dallas North Park
review_text:
We moved our daughter to Celebree from another daycare when she was 6 months old, and we have been absolutely thrilled with the decision! They follow an age-appropriate curriculum and take pictures of our daughter experiencing new things, so I know she is in good hands and learning every day.

All of the teachers have been wonderful and they truly care about each child’s individual needs. Alex and Ashlie the director and assistant director are such a pleasure to interact with each day. They keep parents up to date and informed through the mobile app.

As a first time mom, choosing the right daycare was one of the more stressful and important decisions for our family. We are so glad we found Celebree!
Attendance was low and people act slow

My 1 year old daughter is there since a year now and we love the place. Great service with wonderful staff. The owner is very nice and supportive with last minute change. Very great place to keep your child.

My 2 yr old loves it here! My 5 yr old went last year and they gave her a good start for Kindergarten. She learned to write and spell her name among other things.  Staff is wonderful!! I would recommend this daycare. By the way my 2yr old is being potty trained thanks to Komal’s Love and Care Academy!

Love this place my kids been going here for a long time and they love it . Owners are really nice and always try to help in anything they can wit the child they also have a great curriculum for the Pre-K great food n snacks they always make sure your kid eats if they don't like wat is made they make sure they make what you child likes ...

Great service, wonderful staff, wonderful learning opportunities. The owner is very nice and understanding. Even in the infant room there’s an ABC wall so it’s endless learning from infantry to grade school.

This is one of the best zoos I've been too, even being under construction. Lots of cool animals to see and a great way to get your steps in! Unfortunately they don't open until 10am, but it was also the most crowded zoo I've been to. People pushing into you and stepping on front of you to see the exhibit. But other than that not bad. Also you can bring your own drinks and snacks in. So you don't have to buy a $5 bottle of water.

It made our day. Kids loved the zoo. Must visit.
It’s big zoo, so you need whole day to cover. It’s quite clean and many animals to view and you can feed like giraffe. It’s safe and close to animals. Free parking. Inside has food and cafeteria.

The best zoo we've visited in Texas. The animals look well cared for and the staff have multiple shows and exhibits throughout the day that are entertaing and informative. Everything is lush and green and there is shade everywhere from all the well cared for trees providing shade at every part of the zoo. There are a wide variety of animals to see and several critically endagered specimens like gharials, orangutans, clouded leapard, and red wolves. Expect typical food and drink pricing, but this doesn't mar the zoo's overall beauty and educational value.

I have been to zoos across America and this by far is the best I’ve been to. Clean, thoughtfully laid out with misting and covered areas that blend in with the environment for you to view the animals.

The food was really good and not expensive. So many options also.

Now let’s talk animals. Other zoos I’ve been to have their animals in small spaces and you can tell they’re under distress. The animals here are vibrant and healthy! They are so fun to watch. The babies are adorable 🥰

My son and I had the best time here yesterday. I live 2 hours away but am going to get a membership because it’s just that great of a place. Well done to the owners!

The teachers have given me the peace of mind every mother needs knowing their kids are being well taken care off. I truly appreciate & am Grateful for this help after the rough year I’ve had. I appreciate all of the teachers help with my kids. Especially because during school year, they pick up my 7.y.o from her school and take her to the daycare. 🙌🏻🙌🏻🙌🏻🙌🏻 that is why I love it, so I can work later than 4pm, Because both of my kids are safe and well taken care off when I can’t pick up daughter at school.  THANK YOU HKA!!!! My daughter is having a blast in summer camp with the cool trips and fun arts and crafts. ❤️❤️❤️ being new to Texas has been amazing.

My daughter has been going to His Kidz Academy since November of last year and we have had a positive experience. When an issue does arise the director Taleena and the teachers take immediate action. OPERATION_NAME: Kids Arena Inc. DBA Kids Arena Academy
review_text:
My daughter been in this daycare since December.
I just want to give a compliment to Mr. Brown for the friendly short interactions and doing things as such when they complained about my daughter doing things outside that were not “normal” for them, but other kids did the same actions.
0/10; don’t recommend. It was not a accommodating school. If you have an autistic child or a child on the spectrum who's hyperactive or dealing with any type of special needs, run. Teachers are not properly trained in that area most of them are young and have a high school education some are older and have health problems. Some teachers actually seemed on the spectrum themselves. When I first got to this school, the first three weeks seemed smooth. Before I signed her up, I gave Mrs. Brown the rundown because I had problems with the director of a different daycare (regarding a incident against my daughter and attuide against me I’m a first-time mom, what can I say?). Their response is, "Oh, mommy, she is fine. We have kids like that. We can work with her.” When I told you I received a call almost every other day regarding my daughter, Thank God I don’t have a job because I would be fired! My daughter picked up behaviors from other students that we do not tolerate at home. And even her teacher agreed she picked up behaviors from other kids, but when she displayed them, it was more over the top, and her teacher couldn’t handle it. Yes, she is a handful and when I tried to accommodate this school. Even when I started school they still called me. I finally took the shades off today; it was my last straw. I received enough calls to know my daughter didn't want to be at that school, she started eloping scaring the teachers(she was starting ABA therapy in two weeks). I saw things as such with her teacher Ms.Ty’isha interacting with other kids that I didn’t like, but I stuck it out because I wanted my daughter to be around other students and find structure due to her diagnosis.Everybody around me was telling me to take her out, but I just had to see it through. When I say I went over and beyond because I’m that mother, I made sure my daughter had everything. I participated in every parent activity, accommodated times to pick her up early, and communicated with everyone regarding my daughter dropping her off or picking her up on time without any problems on my end. I wanted to do so much for the teachers because I know they rarely get appreciated, but the things they do regarding kids are unspoken, and I see why they get the bare minimum from parents. I started setting boundaries and being cordial, I felt my daughter was overstaying her welcome. I received unwanted questions, even though they knew the answers made me seem like I was going crazy. I had meetings to figure out what the problem was. We went to endless doctor appointments to see if we could do anything about the complaints. And they all told me the same thing: she is a toddler. Every kid is different; what are they expecting her to do? There was a incident where her doctor wanted to call CPS on the school to see why an incident occurred that they had no knowledge about, and wondered why they called me for everything else. I noticed a bruise on my daughters face, and they couldn’t tell me how she got it(her teacher reported it because I made them aware of it). I spotted it a mile away when I picked her up. I stopped her doctor because I just wanted to not over think or be problematic. And even her doctor suggested to remove her from the school and to find another school for my daughter. PS: Just because you own a place doesn’t mean anything. In order to properly run a place, rules need to be followed, and they broke many rules but got it together when “visits” occurred from State or programs that did scheduled “visits” that children are part of and receive money from because they need them to keep their business running. Please, I know parents do not have a choice. Listen to the little voice in your head.
Parents I could go on I rather not just beware.
Update:Parents please research
