When people say oh he’s in daycare I say no he’s in school cause they have structure of an actual school!

OPERATION_NAME: The Ivy League Child Development Center & Outreach, INC
review_text: This is not a regular "daycare center" this is honestly the best place for children! The staff is so loving and care about their little scholars. The children are actually learning and not just being "watched". There is a bond with the teachers that is genuine. Its like we have additional family! I love the programs they do for parents, they are too cute! I noticed that the kids are excited to come to school and learn, they all love the teachers! Some didn't want to go home! I will continue to support this business and I hope you give them an opportunity to love your child(ren) too!

I love this center!! My son has been going here for about 2 years now and wouldn't want him anywhere else. Staff is amazing!!! Especially Ms. Michelle and Ms. Nitta they are awesome and very helpful. During the school year the center provides transportation to and from school, which is a plus for me!!! They also have a summer program, that I describe as 'never-ending fun'. Summer definitely feels like summer for the children who still have to be in daycare.

My experience at Building Blocks the staffing are good, they have awesome and amazing teachers that will care for your kids as if they where they own kids and give them all the love. The kids have fun and learn something new everyday. They do a lot for the kids it's just amazing.

I like the field trips they have available for the kids during summer. Most of the teachers are great with the kids and parents. They’re incredibly flexible and understanding about the parents schedule.
Love the staff here! They are always so helpful and friendly. Not to mention the incredible teachers with an insane amount of patience and love towards my kids 🩷

I love this daycare! I went here as a child and my daughter has been there for 10 years now and she also loves it. She unfortunately has now aged out of daycare so I wanted to say THANK YOU to the staff for being so awesome..My daughter has epilepsy and when she had her first seizure at daycare they jumped into action and did everything they were supposed to do to keep my baby safe. The teachers are amazing, the director is very professional. I have never had a bad experience at this facility. Please keep doing everything you are doing to keep our children safe, happy and healthy!

I truly love this daycare with all our hearts. From the directors to the teachers, every single person treats the children with so much love, patience, and care. You can genuinely feel how much they love the kids, and that means everything as a parent. They do an amazing job keeping me updated through the app and always notify me of any changes, which makes me feel so involved and reassured throughout the day. Every time I pick my son up, he is clean, happy, and  well cared for. Leaving your child is never easy, but knowing he is loved, safe, and truly cared for here gives me so much peace of mind. I am beyond grateful for this daycare and the incredible people who treat my son like their own.

My daughter has been at this daycare since she was a baby and is now 3½. One thing that really stands out is the consistency, many of the same teachers have been here for years. The teachers are always engaged with the children and the routine and learning environment have been great!  We’ve had a wonderful experience and highly recommend it!

This daycare has literally been my saving grace! My kids came in with a little bit of behavioral issues and Mrs. Diana made sure to stay in contact help me out give recommendations to help out my babies! My kids have improved so much since joining their daycare! Also if Mrs. Diana is not there Mrs. Winnie steps up and steps in very loving staff! ❤️ highly recommend!

We were fortunate to be recommended to this phenomenal daycare. Luv N Care staff genuinely care about their students. They do not have a high turnover in teachers, so the kids become comfortable with the staff. My kids loved going there because of the great care they received. This a generational business with supportive administration. You will not regret having your children here. As an educator myself, I can not recommend them enough!

We couldn't be happier with Luv N Care! The staff is incredibly warm, caring, and professional. Both of my children have great memories from their time there. They truly treat every child like their own. My children learned so much and grown in confidence, communication, and creativity since attending. The facility is always clean, safe, and filled with fun, engaging activities. We’re grateful to have found a place where our kids one is not only well cared for, but also genuinely happy every day. Highly recommend!

LMM has truly been a blessing for our family! Their kindness and inclusivity mean the world to us, especially for our son, who has autism. Seeing him so engaged and included has been heartwarming. My daughter also thrives with her amazing teachers, who make learning fun every day. We’re beyond grateful to be part of this wonderful community!

My daughter (19 months now) has been going there since she was 5 months old and we couldn’t be more thankful that we found this place! The owners are great communicators, which was and continues to be very important for me especially as a first time parent. They share timely updates, and are diligent about noting anything out of the norm from the mildest health issues to bowel movement patterns, sleep patterns, preference for foods etc…The teachers have been amazing at accommodating our baby’s needs including food, sleeping schedule, milk type/method of drinking as it changed from infant to toddlerhood, or any necessary mediation. The school is my daughter’s second home and the layout and size of it surely felt like a home for me from the first day I visited. It has great caretaker-to-student ratios, fun and versatile programs for kids including Montessori-based learning. They have the cutest events organized for our babies and toddlers throughout the year including field day with games and prizes, and in the summer: weekly snow cone days (all natural ingredients) and splash days. They also have an opportunity to take part in weekly sports sessions catered to specific age groups and on board the traveling Stars On Wheelz activity bus which my kid is just crazy about (so far, she was introduced to soccer and gymnastics). The staff are great, so easy to communicate with, flexible, and they have so much experience working with kids over the years. We love this place and we are so thankful for the crew!
Highly recommend LMM! Miss Perla is wonderful, and my son feels safe, loved, and excited to be there.
Very caring teachers!

OFA is a wonderful school! My children attended it from 2020 until 2025, when we had to move. Everyone was so very kind and passionate about their job and children. Emma, Lisa, Mia, Kim, all the teachers are amazing and made this place special. I can't thank them enough for a wonderful experience my children had growing up. My children loved all the activities and always went to school with the smile. They also learned a lot, including Spanish. (I was surprised that at the age of 3 my daughter already knew colors and how to count in Spanish.) OFA provides a nurturing environment and a strong educational base for children.

It's hard to put into words how much this school meant to us as a family, but I will try.
Our daughter attended this school since she was 7 months old until she was almost 5 years old (2021-2025). Our son attended for a little less than a year until we had to move outside of Houston. In the four years we spent a this daycare, our experience was nothing short of exceptional. No place is perfect, but Oak Forest Academy really tries to get it right. Our children were loved and cared for. Our daughter was writing her name and  knew all her letters at 4 years old. She was excited for the various activities, her friends, and her teachers. The various activities provided at the school really fostered a fun and playful learning environment.
This school fosters a sense of community like no other. Parent groups helped keep open communication with the school and the school handled feedback from parents really well. As new parents, we were able to make great friends and really feel a part of a community here. This was so important since our first born was born during COVID.
Both of our kids dealt with various allergies and this school was able to accommodate and provide alternatives. The meals were nutritious and our kids loved them. The Chef is wonderful and open communication with the classrooms, admin, and kitchen helped keep our kids safe despite dealing with various allergies.
From the minute you park, you are greeted by the school security that helps keep our kids safe. This provides so much peace of mind. The teachers are wonderful and genuinely care for your kiddos.
Both of our kiddos grew and learned so much here, especially our daughter. She talks about OFA often and how much she misses it. I know the waitlist can be frustrating, but this is truly  a wonderful place to send your kids and worth the wait. I have searched high and low for a similar place in our new city and have yet to find something that compares.
Thank you OFA for four wonderful years! We miss you dearly!

We could not be happier with our children’s experience at OFA over the past 2+ years. The teachers and staff put everything they have into taking care of the kids and aiding in their development. I would encourage any parent looking for childcare to take a look at OFA. Thanks for all your hard work!
We have had two kids enrolled for about 6 months. Everything has been great. The staff are all lovely and my children are excited for school everyday.
We love this academy, my son experience has been wonderful. All the personnel is excellent, humble, kind and professional.  The director is very loving and understanding.

Einsten cared for our daughter Lila like family. We have been with Einstein for 3 years and have had an amazing experience, Mrs. P is her favorite teacher. Our daughter loves the going here and always says she had a great day. The staff is very involved and the owner Mrs. Theresa  is very hands on. They are a caring and compassionate daycare that provides both educational and recreational activities for the kids. The building is very clean and offers a productive learning environment. It's one of the better priced and structured learning centers/daycare in this area and they will look after your children like their own. Highly recommend for anyone looking for after-school care as they do pick-ups!

-The Smith Family

This daycare is outstanding. The name Einstein Learning Center is a great fit.  They have been a blessing to my family. They work with me and my daughter during a ruff time in our life loosing my father. It was hard my daughter to adjust but with help of Einstein staff during this time for was so grateful. My daughter behavior has approve since being at Einstein. There group projects are so fun my daughter talk and talks so much for having fun.. i believe with the care this daycare gives to the community deserves a award.  For my daughter who has IDD it hard to stay focus but the staff with patience in handle my daughter perfectly. That was my green light this is the right daycare.

An amazing learning center. My four kids attended this center including my son that has Autism. And the staff and owner treat my kids with love and respect. They are so caring. My kids always cry to go to daycare. Because they treat them well and treat all the parents as family. I am even scared to move far away from the new center right now because I can't afford to take my kids any other place right now. Thanks Ms Teresa And your husband for making your center home for my babies. God bless you all 🙏

Words cannot express the thanks that my family has for each and every   teacher and staff that has been a part of our family for almost three years. This is trully a "home away frrom home"
As a parent, I entrust my greatest blessing to the staff at Einstine every day, and I am grateful for the loving care and guidance my children receive. The teachers and director look at each child as an individual, with their own strengths and needs. My Daughter Brooklynn  has been blessed with awesome teachers who  handle her with grace. My child has learned so much and continues to share with me the great activities that go on each day at "school!" Thank you to the staff for the organization of an  incredible early childhood curriculum that engages and teaches at all steps of the day.
The staff is so sweet. They love those children like they are their own. I feel very safe leaving my babies here. The facility is clean. The kids have clean noses and clean diapers!

My daughter and I's experience has been extraordinary! The teachers and admin are happy, welcoming and love on all the kids as their own, which gives me peace of mind throughout the day. She loves this school and actively talks about it daily while at home. The Bridge Class is the best and has such a supportive environment for toddlers to grow. The facility is kept clean and vibrant by the staff daily and it is a pleasure to see! The school communicates so good and is so very helpful all year round.

I am so happy that we have found this place for my daughter to be happy and grow. Their style of teaching is appreciated and my daughter is learning so much! It is peaceful and playful and is a great environment for any child who loves learning!

A special thank you to Ms. Nikki, Ms. Sheree, Ms. Bee, Ms. Phoebe, and Ms. Valerie (Ms. Francis & Ms. Krystal too). You ladies are the best!!! Thank you for everything!

When it was time to look for a daycare for my 2.5 y.o., it was my mother who recommended Five Star Montessori School to me. She reminded me that my youngest brother (there is an 18 year age gap between us) had spent 3 years with the school. I had completely forgotten until she mentioned it, but now remembered how much he loved it there and how well prepared he was for kindergarten.

When we went to the school for a tour, we were delighted to discover that Ms. Nikki Berry was not only still at the school, but was now the Center Director. She was incredibly helpful in answering our questions and provided guidance on which options would be the best fit for us. Our first impression of the school was 1) the staff was helpful and friendly and 2) the facility was clean, organized and had a calm and welcoming atmosphere.

My son has been at the school for about 6 months now and is thriving. His teaches, Ms. Nyasia and Ms. Alyssa, are wonderful. They are so patient, kind and take such good care of the children. My son absolutely loves his teachers and is learning so much. I’ve noticed a significant growth in his knowledge and skills. I’m particularly amazed at how much his verbal skills and vocabulary have grown since he’s started and how more independent he’s become. I also really appreciate the weekly progress reports that are sent home to us. It helps us reinforce all the skills taught at school and focus on what needs improvement. I plan to enroll my daughter next year and feel secure and confident that my children are in excellent hands. My family has had such a great experience with Five Star and I can’t recommend them enough.

Five Star is one of the best decisions we have ever made, and our toddler looks forward to going to school every day.

We enrolled her 1.5 years ago because we noticed some regressed or delayed developments and wanted to give her some structure but still allowed her to be independent. Her sister, who is 13 years older, had attended Five Star for four years, and it was great to see that the current director was a teacher from back then.

It has been amazing to see how much she has blossomed, as one teacher called it. She loves learning new things and is so excited and proud about doing things herself.

Since then, she's qualified for early education, and Five Star has been so supportive of her. And I'm so grateful how flexible Five Star has been with us in accommodating her schedule and in supplementing her development before and after school.

Five Star has truly been a great experience - for both girls - and I look forward to seeing how much more our toddler will blossom.

We highly recommended Five Star Montessori-Katy to anyone! Both of my children go here starting at 3 months old and they are now 5 and soon to be 3yo. All the teachers are very accommodating to my kids and the kids have been super happy here. We used to live close by and had moved about 30 minutes away, but still take them here every day.
Mrs. Kennie from Primary 2 class is always so good with my older child. She started with her at 3 and wasn’t able to write her name then, but now she is able to write and read so well.
Ms. Kayla from toddler class is so sweet and is always so patience with my younger child, who can be very hard. Her hair and clothes is always tidy whenever we picked her up and she seems to progress very well with her guidance.
We love all the teachers and administrators here.

Five stars school has been a fantastic experience for my kids! The staff is caring, attentive and creating a fun learning environment. They always come home happy to share their day's activities. Its a very clean and safe place.Highly recommend!
Kid fit learning Academy is a very clean, supervised and educational environment for your child. You should most definitely give them a chance at serving your childcare needs. You will be satisfied.
Great daycare! I would definitely recommend them the owner is awesome and my baby girl loves going to daycare! She learns so much great things I love it!
Best Daycare ! Staff really loves the children. Christian based. The school teaches to kids how to pray.
Great place to send your kids! The owner/staff are loving and trustworthy. They are dedicated to the well being of the children!!! Love this place!!!!
Did not go there

My son attended Jewels Learning Center from age 6 months to 3 years old. He was well taken care of and learned so much! This daycare is 10 out of 10 with an amazing and caring staff. I highly recommend Jewels Learning Center to anyone that is looking for great care for their child.

As a new mom I was nervous and hesitant to bring my baby to a daycare. I visited the daycare a few times before I actually enrolled my son and each time the staff made me feel comfortable. My son has now been attending 2 months and he feels the love and nurturing from not only his teacher Ms. Lakeisha, but all of the others as well. It is a plus that this family own daycare still has the founder there every morning, Ms. Jewel is such a sweet and welcoming woman and she gives that feeling that you are dropping your child off to his own grandmother instead of a daycare center. I am glad that I decided on this center not only does it have a family feel, but also affordable.

I cannot say enough about Jewel’s. My children were taught and received strong foundational concepts and values at Jewel’s. They were at the school for around 2 years and loved it! They are now 12 yrs old and attend Pin Oak Middle School, but still enjoy going back to Jewel’s to visit. My twins are A/B students and I credit that to the time they spent at Jewel’s. No place is perfect and yes my kids cried in the beginning, but after a little while, they would jump out of the car and run into the building. Years later, we are very pleased with the decision we made to place our boys at Jewel’s.

My daughter has been attending the day care for 6 months now.  Ms. Charlotte is the director of the learning center, with a BA in Civil Eng, but what sold me was the Masters in education. The staff is always courteous and eager to see the growth and development of my little one.  It's a blessing having this place close by and at an affordable price. The only downside to coming here is having to pass up the delicious breakfast they are making for the little ones and I forgot to grab a bite.. The original lady who started the business (Ms. Jewel) is still there, I know she is literally a grandma, but gives that same grandma feelings to the parents of the little ones.

I absolutely love jewels learning center!!!! They have been such a blessing to me and my family! My son who is 3 absolutely loves it there. He is excited and happy to go to school every single day!!! Thank you to all the staff for all you do!! I definitely recommend Jewels learning center!!!

If you’ve recently relocated like I did and aren’t sure where to take your little one, Little Learners Lighthouse is absolutely the place to be. Their rates are reasonable and, most importantly, they genuinely love and care for your child.

When my son started, he was just 14 months old. Our main concern at the time was his speech. Since then, the progress has been incredible. He now identifies and recites his numbers, colors, shapes, and more at just 18 months.

I cannot express how nervous I was at first, but the love and attention they showed my baby quickly eased all my fears.

The staff is attentive, honest, and communicates consistently. Whether he had a great day or a tough one, they kept us informed every step of the way. My route to his daycare has changed, since I recently moved.  However, because I love it so much here, I don’t even care that my commute is in the opposite direction.  Good people are hard to find!

This daycare is excellent if you're looking for a safe and well-cared-for place for your little ones. My son currently attends, and they've provided him with the support he needs to adapt to daycare. Sometimes he cries, and they give him the support he needs at that moment. They are excellent and very professional. The only downside I have is that they are closed on holidays, which makes childcare a little more complicated. Aside from that, I highly recommend it.
My son loves this daycare. The staff is so kind and gentle with the children. I can always tell that he has had a great day when he comes home. They are very communicative and helpful

Clean throughly and Great staff, great efforts for our daughter as a new born she started at this daycare, they treat her and all the babies as family so many kids have grew up at this location. She will be 1yrs old this month and we are very appreciative of you all we really miss Ms.Maria but in exchange Ms.Lydia Ms. Angeles and I’m missing a few are all really making drop off and pick up easy as well as a calm conscious while at work.
My son has been apart of that daycare for 3 going on 4 years and he absolutely loves going to “school” and seeing all his friends ! Awesome teachers awesome atmosphere for the kids to grow

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Glen Oaks From the moment we walked in, we felt welcomed and at ease. The staff is caring, attentive, and truly dedicated to the children’s growth and happiness. They create a safe and nurturing environment where my child not only feels comfortable but also excited to come every day.

The daily activities are thoughtfully planned, balancing learning with play. I’ve noticed so much growth in my child’s social skills, creativity, and independence since starting here. Communication with parents is excellent, and I always feel informed and included in my child’s day.

It’s such a relief to know that my child is in great hands, surrounded by people who genuinely care. I highly recommend  to any parent looking for a place where their child will be loved, supported, and encouraged to thrive.

Our two girls attend Glen Oaks and we love it-everyone knows them by name and we feel very comfortable leaving them in the care of their teachers for the day. Our toddler often wants to return to school just after driving off to go home for the day! Everyone seems happy to be there, students and employees alike. Picking and dropping the kids off is a joy because it’s so fun to visit with the kids and staff. 😊

We found Glen Oaks after moving and having to scramble for day cares. I started my infant there while my toddler was at another school. I ended up bringing my toddler over to Glen oaks after a few months because we fell in love with the school. The teachers are so kind and love my kiddos so much. They also provide food so not making lunches is a huge win for a working mom. I can’t say enough great things about this school. I’m so glad we found it!

Giving your child to anyone for majority of the day is very tough! But Glen Oaks helped me a lot. I can always go about my day knowing my daughter is in good hands whenever I drop her off. Never had any issues and my daughter is well taken care of every day. She started at 6 months and is close to turning 2 and she has loved every single one of her teachers! Not only does my daughter enjoy going to Glen Oaks but I enjoy taking her knowing she’s in great hands and they’ll do more than enough to help her grow each and every day! Staff is amazing all around & very caring! 10/10

Me and my daughter Brooklyn have been team📣 GLEN OAKS for 3 1/2 yrs now every since she was 6 weeks old. I've never experienced child care to this level.  Every morning I drop Brooklyn off with family. I'm so grateful for them going out the way for their glen oak babies and upgrading and enhancing the well-being and safety of our children !!! Thank you GLEN OAKS!!!!!!!

I like The layout of our facility, the whirlpool, steam and dry sauna and pool area. I also like having the rooms for individual workouts. Our steam room is one of the feet’s that have it. Also, having the daycare, restaurant and security make it like our own little country club with a variety of amenities. There is a new app out that I will download but I did like the previous app.

We joined after being told multiple times that a year membership included one free month as part of the promotion. Because we were mid-month, staff advised us to pay the first month and get the next month free, and we were told we qualified before and during sign-up.

Five months later, we’ve been charged every month. I followed up monthly, and when we finally emailed the director, Tiffany, the email was ignored and we were then told we never qualified because the promo was only for Impact-to-regular members—something never disclosed.

Had this been communicated honestly, we wouldn’t have committed to a full year. Poor communication and lack of accountability were very disappointing.

Great place to workout. They have 2-3 people walking around always cleaning the used machines.

Reading the reviews I have to say that they wipe down the mats after every use. You must wear a mask unless you are doing cardio. If you want to wear you can.  There are bottles of cleaner and paper towels thru out the gym.

Gym has full equipment. Every bike and treadmill has cable and screens with aps.

No join fee and 55 a month is a steal when you compare it to other places.  Saturday is half day so it gets busy and most machines are full.

I’ll start off by saying nice things about it. The equipment is top notch & the facility is fairly clean on the wellness floor and through most of the place. Most staff are very kind. Pool area is solid and the steam room works wonderfully.

My issue stems with the enforcement of rules and non-rules. The trainers are great and very accommodating of other patrons’s space. However, kids can run amuck & people can throw dumbbells around. However when I deadlift on the Olympic platform well within the rules, leave it to two wellness floor employees to single me out & interrupt me mid-set every single time.

Please for the love of God, upgrade the lighting in this facility. It feels like a stuffy prison more than a gym. All the other YMCAs I’ve been to are well lit. Especially the Gymnasium. Good for mole people, bad for sports.

Abugida has a pre-k class through DISD with great programming and teachers. My niece goes to their free pre-k and then the after-school program. If she has to stay late, they even serve dinner! If you are looking for a great daycare with extended day program, look no further.

Not the best experience with this daycare. My daughter was in Ms.Gloria’s class. My daughter never bonded well with any of the teachers because the teachers were more partial to their culture and not “American” kids. That went for ALL of the teachers there. What was more worse than that, was seeing complete violation of state regulations - walked in quite a few times surprisingly to see my daughter sleeping in bouncers with her head positioned in a very uncomfortable way. It was very uncomfortable for me to see that. Had a confrontation with the owner who threatened to call CPS on me and abuse her power of authority because she wasn’t getting her way with a discussion her and I were having as I was verbally threatened by the toddler teacher there, who you could tell was an ex crack smoker. Owner didn’t do nothing to intervene.  Owner might have competitive prices compared to other daycares, but you get what you pay. Definitely recommend looking elsewhere. This daycare is not what it appears to be if your child is not foreign.

My kids have never been put in daycare so I was very  skeptical of any little thing . My kids have been there almost 2 months and they love it, all of the staff are always so welcoming. One thing for sure is that they have shown me they truly care about my kids education. It’s a really great experience for them and for me , I can feel safe when I’m at work. Everyday they come come with a great attitude. Thank you ladies keep up the good work

-Desiree

We're thrilled with the amazing learning environment at Abugida-Academy. From day one, it was clear this place was special. The teachers are incredibly dedicated and skilled, going above and beyond for the students. The staff are professional and kind, communication is clear, and the campus is well-kept. Thanks for your commitment to high-quality education. Keep it up!

Despite a few incidents with explanations. This daycare has been awesome so far for my son. All of the staff are respectful and my son loves going everyday. I'm glad I have found something close to home and reasonably priced! I would highly recommend this childcare.

The experience at CTOA from start to finish is great! The team there really cares for you and we’ve made some lifelong friends there. Both of my brothers and I went to CTOA from birth well into our 20’s and it was super helpful to learn how our bodies function and how to work with it instead of against.

Gabi, Megan and all the staff will treat you like family.

CTOA has been a lifeline for our family since 2019. Both of our nonverbal autistic sons have made remarkable progress through their Speech Therapy, Feeding Therapy, Occupational/Physical Therapy sessions. What truly sets CTOA apart is the therapists' deep understanding and skillful application of strategies like sensory play/pairing and vestibular/proprioceptive input, always prioritizing our boys' regulation. They create a safe and engaging environment where our children can thrive and have fun. We've had the opportunity to work with many of their therapists over the years, and each has been consistently excellent. The entire team, from the admin staff to the assistants, is incredibly kind and supportive. We are so grateful for CTOA.

Children’s Therapeutics of Austin provides care at a level that is unmatched to other providers in Austin. The care and commitment of the therapists and techs is amazing. The willingness to think “outside the box” provided avenues for my son to walk, speak and learn at levels that were never expected for him. My gratitude cannot be described. If you are a special needs parent feeling stuck, at a loss, needing to overcome a seemingly insurmountable obstacle, this is the team you want behind you. Thank you.

We had a frustrating experience with this practice. They confirmed they were in-network with our insurance (which we preferred thinking it will be priced better and involves less paperwork) but didn’t provide a clear out-of-pocket estimate despite follow-ups. Just two hours before our first appointment (evaluation), they emailed an estimate of $205, which we missed. At the clinic, we were told this was the maximum amount but could be lower based on insurance — a misleading statement. They charged our insurance for evaluation but also charged us this $205 amount as a "non-billable/non-coverable" fee, along with a $29 admin fee on top of the $60 co-pay, effectively double-charging. Our total came to around $300 (versus the expected $60 co-pay), far exceeding the out-of-network quotes elsewhere. We’ve switched practices and wouldn’t recommend this one.

Save yourself time and money and go somewhere else. This clinic has shady and dishonest billing practices and offers mediocre service. For just an evaluation, they charge both your insurance and you directly. No matter what your insurance covers, you’ll still be on the hook for a non-billable, non-covered fee of $205 on top of what they bill your insurance. In our case, they charged our insurance $445, with a $60 copay for us, but we also received an additional bill for $205, plus a $29 administrative fee. After discussing these unacceptable charges with them, they reduced it to $205, even though we should have only paid the $60 copay. Just minutes before the evaluation session, we were rushed to sign paperwork for this $205 fee while being told by the staff that this was the maximum if insurance didn’t cover the cost. The service itself was mediocre, with incomplete evaluations and generic exercises that didn’t meet our needs.

OPERATION_NAME: The Goddard School in Austin Avery Ranch
review_text:
We have a 4-year-old and a 2-year-old at The Goddard School in Avery Ranch. Our family relocated from another state, and English is not our first language.
We were initially hesitant to place our child in a fully English-speaking environment, but we realized our child needed structure and classroom routines before entering elementary school.

What stands out most is how patient and attentive the teachers here are. Our 4-year-old struggles with English and can lose focus easily, but they never give up on him. They take the time to understand him and work closely with us to support his development.

The teachers offered a thoughtful perspective on what our child needed at this stage. They encouraged us to build small, consistent habits at home that support his growth, and we’ve already seen meaningful changes in his confidence and independence.

Our 2-year-old tends to be very attached to me, so we expected drop-offs to be difficult at first. She cried during the first couple of days, but after about three days she stopped crying completely. Now she happily walks into class and even looks forward to going to school. She’s also eating better there than at home, which gives us great reassurance.

For families who are non-native English speakers, we understand how challenging this transition can feel. Although we haven’t been here long, we are already seeing positive growth in both of our children.

We are especially grateful to Ms. Sudi, Ms. Sylvia, Ms. Makayla, and Ms. Dharani for their care and dedication.

review_text:

All praises! Would recommend 100%

review_text: A school filled with caring and loving teachers especially Mrs Rajae and Mrs Amy .They both are creativity, calm classroom management, and attention to each child’s safety and emotional needs give us complete peace of mind. As a director, she is very knowledgeable about child development and strongly believes in helping children learn through songs, movement, and hands-on activities that make learning fun and engaging.

She is patient, nurturing, and always brings a joyful and positive energy. Her background from Spain also brings a wonderful cultural perspective to the learning environment. I recently visited the school for a tour and came away with a really positive impression. The space itself is beautiful, bright, and thoughtfully designed for young children. It feels calm, welcoming, and very intentional in how the environment supports learning and exploration.

One of the things I appreciated most was the variety of Montessori-style toys and materials available for the children. Everything seemed purposefully chosen to encourage creativity, independence, and hands-on learning.

The program also offers Spanish immersion, which is such a wonderful opportunity for young children to develop language skills naturally through daily play and interaction. I also really liked that their approach is play-based, allowing kids to learn through curiosity, imagination, and movement rather than rigid structure.

Another standout feature is the low teacher-to-student ratios, which helps ensure each child receives individual attention and support. That level of care and presence from teachers makes a big difference in early childhood education.

The location in the north-central neighborhood is great, and the outdoor space is a huge plus. They have a nice open play area with a playground and garden, which creates a beautiful environment for children to spend time outside, explore nature, and stay active.

Overall, the school left a really strong impression. It feels like a nurturing, engaging place where young children can learn, grow, and feel supported. I’m glad I found the perfect school for my daughter!

They also have many community outreach programs for youth, families and seniors, with volunteer positions. review_text:

review_text:

I want to start by acknowledging that The Pillars Christian Learning Center at the Bandera location has had excellent leadership in the past. Amber was the director when my daughter attended from 2019 to 2022, and Heather was the director when my son returned in June 2024. Both Amber and Heather were wonderful directors who truly upheld the Pillars mission to deliver a high-quality early childhood education program, helping students successfully reach important developmental, emotional, and academic milestones — all while instilling strong character and a lasting foundation of Christian faith.
Unfortunately, my more recent experience at The Pillars Christian Learning Center at the Bandera location was not the same. The teachers often seemed overwhelmed and understaffed, and it appeared they were not receiving the support they needed from management. My son was enrolled from June 2024 until his last day on August 29, 2025, and during that time he went through seven different teachers. When I looked at the Health and Human Services website for this location, I saw that 27 employees left alone in the calendar year, 2024 even though the center doesn’t even employ that many at a time. This level of turnover speaks for itself.
I want to be clear— The Pillars Christian Learning Center brand overall is great, and other locations probably do provide both support for teachers and a caring environment for the children. Sadly, I didn’t feel that at The Pillars Christian Learning Center at the Bandera location. I did share my concerns with the regional manager; Janet and I will say her call is the main reason I am leaving a two-star review instead of lower. I believe she truly wants to restore The Pillars Christian Learning Center at the Bandera location to what it once was, aligned with the Pillars mission.
I remain very grateful to the teachers who cared for my daughter years ago, and to the one dedicated teacher who made a difference for my son.

As a mom, choosing the right daycare for our 2-year-old felt like such a big decision—and I can truly say that Clear Lake Academy has exceeded every expectation. Before starting, he wasn’t speaking much—but since joining, his communication has grown so much. He’s starting to say new words, express himself more, and he’s even learning to share and participate in group activities. He’s also discovered a love for art and surprises us with the creative things he brings home!

One of the biggest changes we’ve seen is how much Clear Lake Academy has helped with his separation anxiety. Drop-offs used to be really tough, but thanks to the consistency and compassion of the teachers, he now walks in much more confidently and with far less stress.

It’s clear that he’s learning, growing, and—most importantly—feeling safe and loved. We’re so grateful for everything the staff does each day to make this such a special place for him.

This is the first daycare I’ve ever put my 1yr old and 3 yr in and I must say it was the best decision I made. You can feel the love when they welcome the kids in the morning and also when it’s time to go home. My kids love it there and I’m very PLEASED to have the teachers they have there, definitely have an AMAZING staff😊

We love the Wesley school! As a first time mom it was hard finding a place that I was comfortable with, where the staff felt like our own and the turnover was low. Wesley School is exactly that. The staff is warm and loving, and my kids are learning a lot along the way. Happy to have found such a great facility closeby and would highly recommend this to anyone with little ones who need reliable, attentive care. Huge plus that the staff is great at communication and always keeping us updated on their progress throughout the day. Thank you!

We have had our four-year-old daughter at Wesley School since she was two, and we love having her there! The teachers love the kids so much, it is a great, positive environment that fosters lots of playtime and also gets the kids school-ready. Highly recommend to anyone considering.

My 6 month old has been attending Wesley School since the start of January and we are so happy with our experience. Her teachers clearly enjoy their jobs, and it shows by how they interact with the kids in her infant classroom. Always very playful and excited! Not only do her teachers know her, but when I walk down the halls with her all the other teachers also know her and are so excited to say hi. Overall the staff is so friendly and engaged. We are kept up to date with what is going on via an app and the teacher are super responsive. We can’t wait to see her learn and grow at Wesley!

We’ve loved our time at Wesley. Our daughter started there when she was six months and is now over one. The staff is so kind and welcoming, and everyone knows who she is and greets her when we arrive. We know she is in great hands and it feels like a family. The teachers are fabulous and treat all the kids as if they were their own. They work hard on developmental milestones with the kids and do a wonderful job of sharing progress with parents. Wesley is truly a gem and we feel so lucky it was recommended to us by friends.

Our daughter has been attending Wesley school since she was 3 months old and she is currently 15 months. She started in the infant room and from the first day I dropped her off, I knew she was going to receive love and care each and everyday. She loves going to school and basically runs into her classroom each day to give her teachers a hug. The attention she receives and all of the skills she has learned have been invaluable. We are so happy she is there!

My son has been attending to FLA for about a year and a half, and we are incredibly grateful for the care he receives. From the very beginning, the staff has shown so much love, patience, and dedication.
What truly stands out is the family atmosphere. Even teachers who are not in his current classroom know him by name and greet him warmly. That says so much about the kind of environment they have created.
At one point, I had some concerns about his development, and the support I received from the director, the front desk team, and his teachers meant so much to me. They were compassionate, empathetic, and reassuring. I never felt dismissed — I felt heard and supported.
C.C. has grown so much socially and emotionally during his time here, and as a parent, that peace of mind is priceless. I truly recommend this daycare to any family looking for a safe, nurturing, and supportive environment for their children.

We love FLA, we don’t have words to express our gratitude for the amazing staff. They go above and beyond in ensuring that our little ones are safe and loved. Our son was 3 and a half years old when he started going here and he loves it. Initially he had some separation anxiety but the teachers and the front desk staff were very cooperative. His teachers Ms. Maria and Ms. Giselle are very patient, kind and loving. Ms. Henna is super knowledgeable and we appreciate her expertise in making our kid feel comfortable. The kitchen staff is also very friendly and helpful. Thank you FLA we are happy parents and our son enjoys being here.

Staff at foundations learning are amazing and truly value the work they put into the children they serve. My children have been attending this facility for over 5years and have always expressed interest in wanting to continue care there. The communication is top tier as I’m always abreast on the changes and progression of my children.  I strongly recommend this facility for childcare.

Words can not express how grateful I am for the Foundation Learning Academy . All of the staff,from the cooks, to the teachers to administrators are incredibly loving and attentive, always going above and beyond to ensure our little ones feel safe and nurtured.  Our first started attending at 15 months and is now a schooler. He made the transition from daycare to elementary school with ease because of the exemplary preparation, lesson plans, and schedules they had in place. Also, the bus to and from school is so convenient. We were entirely at peace when the time came to send our 3 month old there. Thank you, Foundation, for the way you pour into our little lambs and the next generation. We absolutely adore each and every one of you!

There's no other place I would take my kids! My son has been attending since he was 15 months. He is now in kindergarten and is so advanced thanks to the teachers at Foundation Learning Academy. I just had a baby in November and there was never any doubt in my mind that she would also go here when it was time for me to return to work. The facility is always clean and all the staff are wonderful. I can't recommend this place enough.

I hope I’m able to express how much my husband and I love this place. As a former educator, my priorities were safety first and then to make sure every student felt loved when they first walked through the door until they left for the day. That’s exactly the experience we have with Stepping Stones.

Both of our children started at just a couple months old in the Infant Room with Ms. Anna. She is absolutely amazing! She greets the babies with the biggest smile and an excited hello (in her charming and friendly New York accent). You never have to worry about your babies with her because she keeps communication open and is a pro. The babies are safe, loved, fed, cuddled, and taught basic skills to meet their milestones. As a first time mom with my son, Ms. Anna was very helpful with switching him from breastmilk to formula, then formula to whole milk. She worked with us to get him to hold his own bottles then drink from a straw cup. The afternoon teachers, Sra. Yetsy and Ms. Genevieve, are just as friendly and great! Our babies are always happy with their teachers, and my husband and I are happy knowing that they are loved and we are being updated everyday. I am so excited my daughter is in their care now!

Our son is now in the Walker Room with Ms. Miranda. She is super positive with this bunch of 12-18 month olds, and we’ve seen her redirect their attention to avoid tantrums with ease and grace. She teaches the kids many things including how to eat at the table, wash their hands, be gentle with others, and I personally love that they are already making crafts and using markers to work on those fine motor skills. Our son’s language has exploded as well! Ms. Miranda is a toddler whisperer. There's almost always a dance party that we're interrupting when we pick up our son for the day. So fun!

Oh, and Ms. Dee, the chef, sometimes visits the rooms, which is a crowd pleaser with the littles. She always has the nicest things to say and makes them smile even when she’s not bringing them a meal.

I can’t report on the other classrooms yet, but hopefully I remember to come back and update this review as our family gets there. Overall, the facility is small, and the way it is managed and cleaned is impeccable. We personally love that there aren’t any streamed cameras for parents to view, but the director has her monitors to view from the office. And as far as tuition goes, it is extremely reasonable for what is received - meals, snacks, formula, and incredible childcare. After going on a couple different daycare tours, we chose Stepping Stones because it was the only one that didn’t smell funky (which is pretty amazing), and when we entered the building and each classroom, we were greeted with smiles. The children are happy and engaged.

It’s going to be bittersweet when our children graduate from Stepping Stones and move onto public school because this place definitely runs like a family. We love every single teacher we’ve met here and are immensely grateful for the love and care they show our kids.

Side note - the older reviews about the director and assistant director are not wrong... BUT the management has thankfully changed as of June 2024. Ms. Tiffany, the current director, is very welcoming and does an amazing job of keeping parents informed of the events and day-to-day operations of the daycare, and Ms. Amethyst is so kind! You can tell everyone really cares for all of the kids.
My daughter LOVES this daycare. She is autistic and is always asking to go! Ms Amethyst is amazing and the rest of the staff seems great as well!

My son has been going to Stepping Stones fro six months now and our experince thus far has been excellent. The teachers and management are caring and had attention to details. My son started with the infant class and have now transitioned to the walker class now, in both classes our expericne has been great with the care provided.

Not sure what all of the negative comments about the daycare or Ms Nancy are coming from. My son has been attending this daycare for just over a year. Ms Lois is great. She's a great teacher and has taught my son so much. All of the other instructors/staff I've encountered has been fantastic as well. Super polite and kind. I can tell they all love my son. Any time my son has had so much as a scratch I've either been notified immediately by phone, or receive a detailed note and explanation from the teacher when I pick him up. My son even came home praying over our meals, which I've never taught him.

I highly recommend Stepping Stones Children's Academy to anyone in search of an excellent day care service. The management and staff are truly dedicated and disciplined. Since joining this academy, my 3 year old as well as my 18 months-old are always excited to go to school. At 18months she has developed a love for writing and scribbling as a hobby. The facility is clean and provides a conducive environment for learning.
The location as well as value for price are additional attractions.

OPERATION_NAME: Kidventure After School @ Oak Forest Elementary
review_text:
As a proud parent of a student at Oak Forest Elementary, I wanted to share my enthusiastic recommendation for the KiDCENTURE after-school program. It has been a truly positive and enriching experience for our child and an absolute game-changer for our family's schedule.
The program excels at keeping the children highly engaged. Whether it’s through creative learning activities, exciting group games, or just a fun space to decompress after school, the kids are always busy and happy—they genuinely look forward to going!
What really sets KiDCENTURE apart is the phenomenal staff. Penelope and Mr. Jay are exceptional leaders—their energy, patience, and dedication shine through every day. They create a supportive, positive, and safe environment where every child feels known and valued.
We also have to praise the convenience and efficiency of the pickup process thanks to their "text ahead" feature. It makes the end-of-day transition incredibly smooth; a quick text when we're arriving, and the staff promptly brings our child out to the vehicle. It's an efficient, thoughtful system, and I truly wish more camps and programs would adopt this feature to improve their own processes!
Finally, the added option to utilize KiDCENTURE during seasonal breaks—including Thanksgiving, Winter, and Spring break—provides crucial, reliable care and continuity for the children when school is closed.
Highly recommended for any Oak Forest family!

OPERATION_NAME: Kidventure After School @ Oak Forest Elementary
review_text: We are parents of a Kindergartener so it's our first experience KV and we have loved it so far!  Pickup process is always very smooth and all the staff are so friendly.  Each day is a new theme which keeps things fun and exciting - our daughter has asked us to pick her up later so she doesn't miss out on all the activities 🤣

OPERATION_NAME: Kidventure After School @ Oak Forest Elementary
review_text: My kids love attending Kidventure after school each day. They even help my older daughter with her homework with makes time at home much easier! Ms. Ea’lasia is very nice and my daughter loves having her as a counselor. My other daughter raves about Ms Sydney and how much fun they have together each day.

OPERATION_NAME: Kidventure After School @ Oak Forest Elementary
review_text: Everyone at Oak Forest elementary has been professional, personable and good smile on their face. The extra caution taken for each incident has been appreciated. Tessa says Ms. Jae is kind and Archer enjoys Ms. Rajanae being his teacher. Sorry if I'm misspelling their names! Definitely appreciate the time spent with the kiddos and would like a detailed schedule for the time there so easier for us to chat with our kids about their 3 hours with the counselors. Thank you so much for all you do and many blessings upon each of you as you guide our children.

OPERATION_NAME: Kidventure After School @ Oak Forest Elementary
review_text: Our school has used Kidventure for 2 years now and we could not be happier! Their staff’s rapport with the students is unmatchable. As a school, we have to trust an after school program to not only be good with students but also have a respectful relationship with our faculties and our staff, and they check all the boxes! We love Shaniece and KP so much we even hired them for our own staff. Thank you KV for taking care of our Bobcats AND our building!

OPERATION_NAME: Happy Hugs Daycare and Preschool LLC
review_text: It is a safe place. I love it 💛 With new owners, the space and the treatment have changed completely. The children are happy and I recommend 100% you enroll your children here. They also have very good prices and they are very friendly with everybody!!!

OPERATION_NAME: Happy Hugs Daycare and Preschool LLC
review_text: I absolutely love this daycare! The staff are so caring and attentive, and they create a warm, safe environment for the kids. I highly recommend this daycare to any parent looking for a nurturing place for their little one!

OPERATION_NAME: Happy Hugs Daycare and Preschool LLC
review_text: My son and I love this place. He is in the infant class and Ms Flora takes such good care of him and is very attentive. We love all of his teachers❤️ 5 stars across the boards

OPERATION_NAME: Happy Hugs Daycare and Preschool LLC
review_text:
My youngest went to this daycare for 6 months before he started school. The teachers were great with him and the management is very nice.
Edit: dropped my rating to one star after finding out that the new owners and management allow employees to bully other employees without consequences. If they allow that amongst employees, what will they allow amongst the children?

You knew there was a problem, failed to fix the problem, allowed her to be bullied into a "suspension until further notice", and nobody has even bothered to call or message her in over a week. If you can't handle grown adults, you have no business dealing with kids.

OPERATION_NAME: Happy Hugs Daycare and Preschool LLC
review_text: I started leaving my kids since they opened here. I Completely trust them and they have always kept me updated on everything that happens and my kids are happy to come. Very kind personel they treat them with love.

We feel incredibly fortunate to have found this daycare — it truly is a hidden gem. The staff are exceptionally caring and patient with the children. It’s a small, warm environment where every teacher knows each child, even if they’re not in their class.
The director, Angela, is outstanding. She is attentive, hands-on, and closely involved with the children every day. She’s always available and quickly follows up on any questions or concerns.

Absolutely love HCC!  Teachers and administration are amazing and responsive.  Our 5 year old has been in two classes since he started a couple years ago.  Both classes were/are run by incredible teachers and assistants.  Our 7 year old attends after school care and absolutely loves it.  With the playground and indoor gym, my boys always have plenty of physical activity, regardless of the weather.  They also do a lot of art projects and academics as well. They are great at communicating updates. Handwashing on arrival is emphasized to keep kids healthy!   Highly recommend!

The Hope staff is professional, caring, and welcoming.  They implement best practices in developmentally appropriate approaches.  Hope has a long-standing reputation as an excellent child development center.  They have been responsive to my grandson's and the communities needs.  As a retired educator, I highly recommend Hope Children's Center.

We love Home Children's Center. We have child with very sensitive skin and health issues. Not one she had diaper rashes under their watch. They were very attentive and well communicating with us on everything. They potty trained my child so well with all the issues we had. The teachers are very loving, caring, and attentive. They all have huge heart for kids. They have wonderdul play grounds- multiple ones. They also have indoor gym and playrooms. They teach music, science, math, art and many more! their ours are very generous! Teacher to student ratio is also very low. Come by and tour the place. you will love it too!

Our experience with Hope childcare has been all positive. They have dedicated staff who truly serve a greater role than just childcare. They are empathetic to each child’s individual needs. Their curriculum keeps the children engaged so their time is well spent leading them into elementary school.

BE CAREFUL and protect your children at all costs. Do not take your kids to this place. Our child was there for just one month, and it has been heartbreaking to see the trauma they endured.

Our child returned home multiple times with bruises, and when we asked what happened, she told us the cleaning lady hit her just because she didn't want to sleep. It’s devastating to think that a place meant to care for children could be so harmful.

We only went there because the school recommended it, but it has proven to be nothing but a nightmare. The children are bullied, mistreated, and their mental health is being destroyed.

If this happened during the day!!!! I wonder how much worse it is at night? I bet they are using a sleeping aid on them.

We are now seeking professional help to heal our child's wounds—both physical and emotional. Please, protect your children from this place. Their safety and well-being are worth more than anything.
Disrespectful and rude, no professionalism, it seems like they have never been educated.
We should all file a complaint about this daycare and have it closed.

My daughter went for about a week (13 months old) and I do not recommend. Not enough staff for the capacity of children there. They say they give updates but you have to go in and ask for any updates and they weren’t feeding or changing my child. And when asked why they weren’t and just let her cry she said she didn’t know what to do with her. They gave my child another child’s pacifier. And this was my first experience with putting my child in daycare. I do not feel that that they can adequately care for anyone’s child.

Beware!!! They have nothing to do with kids care, just a name without any professional or expertise in the field. My child came back many times with bruises, one time she had a red mark on her lower eyelid and when asked her what happened, she said a child hit her with the pencil which almost poked her eye. When I questioned the teacher about it, rather than stating facts, she showed her toxic and manipulative attitude by saying my child doesnt listen to instructions. Things gotten worse later when I discovered a bruise on my child’s back and when asked about it, she said one of the people works there did pinch her because she didn’t wanna take a nap. Next day my child was able to identify the person who’s responsible and they assured me they will handle it.This is literally child abuse and the director promised to take serious action against the person who did that. Few days later, that staff member was still there and nothing was done, then I showed up few days later to pick up my child and been told the daycare will no longer accept my child due to her behavior. CPS  and TEXAS HUMAN AND HEALTH COMMISSION will need to INVESTIGATE this facility ASAP. Corrupt and abusive environment!!

My toddlers have been going here since August, and this place has been nothing short of amazing. I am a single mom and have to be at work early in the mornings and this place has been a godsend. My 2 year old's talking has exploded since being here. They feed them really hearty, nutritious meals each day. All of the staff treats my babies like their own, with love and care, and I never ever feel like they aren't taken care of. The door is always locked, there are cameras too, so I know my kids are safe. I am so glad my kids go here, and would recommend this place to anyone considering putting their kids in daycare.

Two of my three children ages, five and four have been going to this center since March 2023. They both have had great experiences. The Director, Miss Vera, has been wonderful as well as the teachers, especially Ms. Mary and Ms. Dale.  They are a very busy center, and I am grateful for their flexibility with my not always routine schedule, and that my children always have consistent friendly faces in their staff. Most of all, I am thankful my children are safe when they are at Whiz Kids.

My son went to this daycare since he was 4 months old. He is now 16 months and I unenrolled him because I am not working anymore..but I just want to give my experience with them. The teachers are so loving to the babies and grow a relationship with your baby. My son loved his teacher alma in the infant room. The daily rate is more than reasonable for a great daycare like this one. They send hourly updates on brightwheel and are so understanding and accommodating.They helped my son with some important milestones. I will always recommend Life’s Little Blessing. We miss you guys!

We had a wonderful experience at Life’s Little Blessings under the leadership of Ms. Mary and her dedicated staff. It is a warm, welcoming environment where you truly feel like part of a family rather than just another client.

The Pros
There is so much to love about this center, but a few things really stand out:

Family-Oriented & Patient: Ms. Mary and her team treat the children with incredible patience and care. You can tell they genuinely love what they do.

Consistency: One of the biggest wins here is the low staff turnover. It provided my child with a stable environment where they could form real bonds with their teachers.

Qualified Staff: It’s reassuring to know that most of the teachers hold their CDAs (Child Development Associate credentials), which shows in their professional approach to care.

Fun & Engaging: The summer activities and field trips are top-tier! They do a fantastic job of keeping the kids active and excited throughout the break.

Affordability & Communication: Their pricing is very reasonable for the quality of care provided. Additionally, Ms. Mary is always open to feedback and suggestions, making it a true partnership between parents and providers.

The Cons
The only reason we decided to move on for the school year is that we were looking for a true bilingual program and a slightly more rigorous academic curriculum to prepare for the upcoming grades. While the care is exceptional, the educational component is more play-based and relaxed than what we currently require.

Final Verdict
Even though we have transitioned for the regular school year, we aren't saying goodbye for good! Because of the amazing atmosphere and the fun they provide, my child will likely still attend their summer and afterschool programs in the future.

If you are looking for a loving, stable, and affordable place for your child to grow, I highly recommend Ms. Mary and her team.

I would recommend this daycare to everyone.
I would like to thank all of the ladies who work at life’s little blessings for their patience and all of the love they show to the children. We recently moved and this is the only reason I’m changing the girls daycare, this is also by far the hardest part. I wish we could take the teachers with us to the new daycare because you do not come across these type of people often. You all have been so kind  and are genuinely such loving and caring people. If you are a momma and you are struggling to finding a daycare, I was once in your shoes and life’s little blessings was definitely a blessing to us! Thank you all so much. ❤️

My kids went here for 2 years and they absolutely loved it! The teachers here actually get to know your kids and love them like they are their own. This is by far the best daycare my kids have ever been in and they have gone through multiple daycares that I have had to pull them out of because of bad treatment. I never had an issue with this daycare because they truly care about the well being of our kids and love them. I’m so sad that I had to move my kids recently due to moving jobs and my oldest daughter schools. I will truly miss this daycare and the teachers who have been nothing but sweet and caring to my babies. Thank you so much for everything you have done for my kids and all the attention and love you have given them! I highly recommend this daycare to all parents and especially parents who are like me, very nervous and worried about leaving there kids in daycare because I promise you will definitely feel at ease knowing that the wonderful teachers here are looking after your children💕

My 2.5 yr old son has been going to life’s little blessings since the latter part of November of last year. They have been AMAZING! They have gone above and beyond for us. I remember just a few months ago my son had to go to the emergency room because his asthma had flared up and he was having trouble breathing. The next day, on a weekend might I add, Dinora went out of her way to call me to check in my son to see how he was doing and seeing if there was anything she could do for us. That really meant a lot to me that she would go out of her way on her own free time might I add ,just to see how my boy was doing and how he was feeling. That really does speak volumes. My son has been thriving since he started attending life’s little blessings.  When he first started, he was only saying very few words. Now, he’s constantly talking. He knows his colors, he sings songs and he can count from 1-20 in English and Spanish. He’s really come a long way since he first started.  I also love the fact that they are faith based and that they are constantly communicating with the staff and patients.so if you’re looking for a place that offers good quality care and where you feel confident that your child is safe and well taken care of, and getting a good educational foundation for life. Please send your child here. You will not regret it.

WonderWell has been such a special part of our daughter’s early years. She truly loves her teachers and talks about them every day with so much excitement and affection. It’s clear how much the teachers care for the children and how intentionally they create a warm, nurturing environment where each child feels seen and supported.

We’ve also really appreciated the Reggio Emilia–inspired philosophy. The way the teachers encourage curiosity, creativity, and exploration allows the children to develop confidence in their own ideas and love of learning.

What stands out most is the strong sense of community. WonderWell feels like a place where families and teachers genuinely support one another. As parents, there is nothing more reassuring than seeing your child walk into school feeling safe, secure, and excited to be there. We feel very grateful to be part of the WonderWell community!

We have spent 6 wonderful school years at Wonderwell, between my 2 children (now 10 and 5), and couldn’t imagine a more ideal early childhood educational setting/experience for them!

The Wonderwell teachers and staff truly go above and beyond to cultivate an environment in which children are able to learn and grow, where they are encouraged to build on their strengths, and be given support where they need it.

I hope that everyone could have the same opportunity to be surrounded by a family like Wonderwell, because it has always felt like a family. Wonderwell truly cares about our children and encourages a genuine love of learning, preparing them for the demands of their future educational journey.

My family is so beyond grateful for Wonderwell and the amazing memories we’ve made over the years!

It was evident to my husband and I the moment we walked into WonderWell that this was an excellent environment for our 4 year old son. Our son is thriving daily and they fostered his abilities and encouraged his growth through exploration, wonder and play.

What I love most, the relationships: seeing the students really care for each other, being kind to one another. As a mom, that is all you want: For your child to remain a curious learner and to be kind.

Parents, children and staff are all truly treated with dignity, respect and kindness which will reflect how my son will treat people as he grows. I love that parents have various opportunities to be involved and build our community of young learners.

The staff loves teaching at this school. It shows. Great ambiance and energy. We are so fortunate to have found them. My son’s occupational therapist visits the school and commented to me that she has never seen a school like this, so many engaged happy kids.

I love the founder, not only is she an absolute sweetheart and runs an exceptional school, she is truly understanding and patient with all of the parents and children, she's the rock of the school. Bonus: she is totally into design (as am I) so everything is beautifully presented and carefully thought out. From the architecture of the building, the interior design, color scheme, lighting, the landscape and play-area design, every single detail of the school is beyond inspiring. It gives me chills thinking of how they poured their souls building this school.

My son’s teachers are the kindest, calming and loving teachers ever. The founder and her administrative team vets all staff and I am impressed by their keen skills in screening teachers that are passionate, kind and truly want to inspire curious learners. The teachers were handpicked out of many to offer up the best!

The teachers are also very patient and understanding of the developmental stages of the children and are able to use individual approach for each child. The staff are continuously studying which enhances their love for learning as they pass this along to our young learners.

The low class sizes really allow the teachers to get to know each child and his/her interests and abilities. The quality of the art material and instruction is extremely rare to find in a preschool setting.

Their method - Reggio Emilia is age appropriate and inspiring, probably the only true Reggio preschool in all of Austin. This preschool is all about letting children grow and become comfortable in their own skin while instilling a lifetime of curious learning.

WE LOVE WONDERWELL!

There could never be words to describe how incredible Wonderwell is. Before having children, I used to think people who cared so much about preschool were silly. But now having two young kids, and knowing the importance of education at this important developmental stage, I know that there really is so much young children need to thrive. Wonderwell is not only the best preschool in Austin, but in the country in my opinion. My son went there for three years and my daughter for a year before we had to move out of state. Leaving this school was the hardest part.
My son started when he was 2, he could barely speak and was SO shy.
When we left, he was so confident, a true leader, and LOVED school.
The teachers, the staff, the other families, are all above and beyond.
I couldn’t love or recommend Wonderwell more!

Our son has been at Wonderwell the past two years and has had an incredible experience. The teachers and staff are warm and loving, and they've created a really inspirational learning environment for young kiddos. We've really loved the Reggio Emilia approach to learning.WW does an excellent job at fostering individuality and creativity.

I’m so grateful we found this school for my 18m old daughter. After a long search and being waitlisted elsewhere, I was surprised and incredibly relieved to get a spot right away. What’s even more amazing is the care and love her teachers show every day. My girl’s been welcomed so gently and it truly feels like they see her for who she is. As a mom, there’s nothing more comforting than knowing your child is safe, cared for, and genuinely happy at school. We’re so lucky to be here.

I absolutely love CALS! As a first time parent, I was nervous about sending my 18-month-old daughter to school, but after her first day, I immediately knew this program was really special. The teachers here are SO amazing and treat all the kids as if they were their own. I feel very thankful to have found CALS. We can’t wait for the fall semester to start!

We looked for a daycare in Spring Branch and also in the Galleria area and came across this amazing school for our 2 year old son. We visited many well known daycares but none compared to CALS when it came to quality of teachers, cleanliness of the facility, and most importantly how caring / loving the teachers are for the children. It was very apparent from our first meeting that the director was fully committed to raising little stars with kindness & love and after 6 months, we can say with 100% confidence that this was the best decision we made for our little son. He's learned and grown so much in the past six months and we are looking forward to the next semester starting soon.

We are truly grateful for this school and what the teachers have been doing for our children.

CALS has been such a blessing for our little girl and our whole family. They go above and beyond to provide a safe and loving environment where kids can learn about Jesus and skills to prepare them for elementary school. The teachers are amazing and always attentive to each child’s needs! They always openly communicate with parents and take time to address any concerns with their child’s development. They even sent us lesson plans/activities each week to help us at home during the pandemic! Thank you CALS for having such a big impact on our family! We appreciate all of you!

The teachers from CALS have so much passion and love for their students which I love most about this school. My daughter is three and half and a very shy girl. She usually takes quite long time to accept and understand a new environment. But, not only her class teachers, but all of the teachers from CALS have helped her enjoy coming to school by recognizing her when she’s dropped off which as a parent I couldn’t ask for more!

Would not recommend this place if my life depended on it. They believe it is ok to allow children to run around WILD!
