If you love your children please find a different daycare because you get what you pay for with these people.
Little hands preschool has the nicest teachers ,they are so sweet with my child. They keep you informed on what's going on.  It is also very colorful and clean.
My toddler loves her teacher she has the best teacher always keeping me up to date, my after school kid's love the fact they are able to play outside for a long period of time , good daycare
The staff is great and friendly! They've worked with us when we've had financial issues and have been attentive with our kids
New staff rude and unprofessional, 5 star reviews were asked for in lieu of credit off tuition (notice timeframe). wouldn't trust.

New mom here!! I was super nervous about my daughter being in daycare but this place has been truly amazing with every drop off and pick up. The director, teachers, and staffs are all caring and helping. My daughter is in the toddler classroom with Ms. Paige and Ms. Felicia and they are very active her. They are amazing teachers and I appreciate them so much!! I like how they have a schedule for each learning activity and the live cameras for peace of mind. I also like how they take a lot of pictures to update us on what they are doing. Overall I would highly recommend Ivy Kids! If you are looking for a safe, clean and high-quality care for their little ones! Ivy kids heights is the way to go!!

Our daughter is in the Toddler class at Ivy Kids Heights and we have had a great experience. Our teachers, Ms. Dee and Ms. Jessica, treat our daughter so kindly and are so friendly. She is always excited to go to school in the morning! I love that they provide a healthy lunch, AM snacks, and PM snacks - it makes my life so much easier!  We have really loved all the staff as well, they are all extremely kind and helpful. I also have enjoyed the live cameras to check on my what my daughter is up to throughout the day. In addition, she comes home every day in a great mood and I feel like her language skills have really developed just in a few short weeks at Ivy Kids!

My son has been at Ivy Kids since he was 5 months old. We are moving out to the suburbs now, and I'm so sad to leave this amazing school. Kelly, Beatrice, and Allison are all AMAZING caregivers and people. They genuinely seem to love my son. And they are clearly very experienced with babies. They made going back to work very easy, because I really never worried about whether my baby was okay. I highly recommend Ivy Kids and we are so sad to leave this wonderful school. The administration has been super easy to work with too. They're very accommodating, thoughtful, and always seem happy to see me and my baby.

We were nervous about sending our son to daycare, but Ivy Kids of the Heights made the transition so easy. They have great communication with the parents, provide nutritious daily meals, plan lots of fun and enriching activities, and have excellent staff that really care for the children. We are so happy we chose this daycare :)

Our son recently joined Ivy Kids of the Heights and at first I was nervous since 1) this is the first time that he's was going to daycare and 2) the opening kept being delayed, (which understandably was due to the Derecho and Hurricane Beryl).

However, since the daycare has opened, I have been very pleased.

Teachers/Admin. The second day at daycare, he ran up and hugged one of the admin there, which was a positive sign for me. His morning teacher Ms. Paige new his name within a day of him starting and is always welcoming.

His afternoon teacher Ms. Felicia has been very proactive in sharing with us how he is doing, giving us updates, and has been warm and nurturing with our son.

Both teachers have been engaged with the kids, which I appreciate (since that is what I want from a daycare).

Food. Ivy has morning snacks, lunch, and afternoon snacks as part of its Brain Bites program. The food is healthy and made at the daycare so I'm very happy since I know he's getting a nutritious meal (and I don't have to stress about meal prepping).

Transparency. Ivy kids has cameras in the classroom (which I love), so I can check on my son throughout the day and see what mischief he's up to. Everytime I have checked up on him, he looks like he's having a good time. Add to that,  I receive daily updates and photos through their parenting app sharing all the activities (art, math, etc.) that he's doing throughout the day which I love.

Behavior. While we've had the usual transition phase (e.g., more tired than usual, more emotional) that comes with a home to daycare switch, my son seems to enjoy going to daycare.  He has no problem with us dropping him off and immediately runs for the toys. For me, that's a positive sign that he is being treated well and enjoying himself.

Overall, since they have opened, we've had a great experience and I look forward to watching Ivy Kids grow.

My son loves Child Craft School. He stayed with me until he was 2.5 and at 3 now he has had a great first school experience at Child Craft. He regularly tells me that he loves the food and the toys--I love the staff and the environment. One of my favorite homey Austin places. Down-to-earth, friendly, genuine. Child Craft is a great place.

This is a historic place in Austin. Our 1-year old daughter attended ChildCraft for about a year and a half and we loved everything about them. The staff members are caring and always informed about each kid, willing to chat and help. The teachers are very supportive of the kids. The place is big, cozy, with a big playground. Celebrating Halloween and Easter was always great! Thank you Child Craft family for all you do!

We have been at Child Craft for over 2 years now. My daughter started there and has not had a single complaint since. She gets up looking forward to school! My son started there at 5 months and I have also seen him flourish under their care. Ms. Rachel, the director has a wealth of experience and knowledge and you can tell she is still very involved in the day to day of the school, it's her baby. We love all of the teachers there! They regularly involve the families in events and I have gotten to know some of the other parents that way. The playground and outdoor space is unmatched. Your kids will play in a large shaded area with plenty to do and tucked away in a quiet neighborhood. I can't recommend it enough!

Child Craft has been a phenomenal experience. Both my son and daughter attended, and I feel so fortunate to have found them. The teachers are loving and child centered. I love the school, in a beautiful, homey central Austin neighborhood. The first time we met with Child Craft Director Rachel was to enroll my 2 year old son, after a bad experience at another childcare place. Rachel put us at ease, and our experience only got better. The next time we enrolled, was when I could not get my daughter into PreK through ISD. I'm glad she didn't get in honestly. She's enjoyed structured learning in her preK class at Childcraft, and lots of social and outside time too. Plus they serve nutritious lunch for the kids. Also, many of the staff have been there for years. The teachers genuinely seem happy and at ease too. Lots of communication for the parents, and good experience for the kids. We'll miss ChildCraft, as my last kiddo to attend is onto Kindergarten.
A place for a child to develop and learn through quality care, curriculum,nurturing, and fun activities for children to learn through play.

The best! I am Benjamin and Johnny’s mom and my boys loved their teachers! My oldest told me “mom, this is a good daycare” and I believed him. The other parents are great too. Good bless all the staff. Johnny still asks to come back 😢.

Just came on here to say how i love this daycare my son has been going here for almost 3yrs now and he’s been learning so much the teachers are awesome and so caring also they have and app where there’re able to communicate with you and send you pictures of your child doing different activities 👏🏾❤️

Ok, here I go... I want to start saying that I normally don't do reviews unless it is for very good or bad reasons.  Today, I'm writing this one for a good one. Amazing Staff! I have a toddler who attends this child care center and I absolutely love it. the staff takes such good care of the kids  and you can truly tell they care. they communicate so well with the children and treat them with patience and respect. It’s clear that Ms.Ariel genuinely loves teaching and puts so much thought and energy into every lesson and activity. I truly appreciate the patience, kindness, and enthusiasm Ms.Ariel brings every day. Thank you for creating such a positive and nurturing environment for my child to learn and grow in!

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Care Center
review_text:
The UT Child Development Center is an outstanding daycare and preschool program. The teachers are experienced, caring, and truly invested in each child’s growth — many have been there for years, which speaks volumes about the quality and consistency of the center. My son is actually learning in a structured, nurturing environment, not just being kept busy.

The administrative staff are always easy to reach and communicate regularly through their childcare app, where they post photos, videos, and daily updates. The facilities are extremely clean and well-organized, with a big emphasis on hygiene. I love that the sinks are at kid-level and that handwashing is one of the first things children are taught when they start.

The play yards are large, safe, and thoughtfully designed for different age groups, and the food is fresh, healthy, and balanced — not the usual daycare fare. Compared to other centers we’ve used, UT CDC stands out for its professionalism, structure, and genuine care. My child is thriving here, and I couldn’t recommend it more highly!

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Care Center
review_text: We love UTCDC-Leona and can wholeheartedly say it was worth the wait, there's a reason the waitlists are long! The staff are highly trained and there's low turnover, so it has been great seeing my younger kid have teachers that my older kid had or knew from the playground. The admin team is so communicative and supportive, and I love that they are open to feedback through parent surveys - there's not much to improve upon, but they're always asking! Also, we appreciate that it's a nut-free school because we have kids with peanut allergies. The admin and the teachers have so many indicators and protocols in place to keep our child safe at school.

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Care Center
review_text: I am convinced this may be the most wonderful daycare in Austin. We were on the waitlist for a while, but it was 100% worth it. My son, who had never been at daycare before, absolutely loves it and is so excited to go to school every day. The teachers are wonderful and engaged, the facilities are new and spotlessly clean, and it is fully evident every day that my son is learning new things. I am absolutely devastated that we have to leave this daycare because I'm graduating at the end of the school year. There's a reason this daycare is in high demand, and that's because UTCDC will become an extension of your family. Absolutely take advantage of this daycare if you are eligible for it - they even offer scholarships for those in financial need.

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Care Center
review_text:
My child has been attending UTCDC Leona since nine months old, and the experience has been nothing short of wonderful. As a first-time parent, I was initially nervous about daycare, especially with allergies and asthma to manage, but the staff and community have truly exceeded every expectation.

From the very first day, my child has flourished developmentally and continues to thrive. The teachers and staff go above and beyond to provide a nurturing, safe, and engaging environment. What stands out most is the genuine sense of community, whether it’s a teacher, staff member, or neighbor, everyone greets my child warmly each morning.

Miss Carolina at the front desk deserves special recognition for her attentiveness and care. She ensures everything is handled properly, from day-to-day logistics to medical needs. With this being a nut-free facility and clear allergy protocols in place, I’ve always felt confident that my child’s health is taken seriously. Alternative meals are provided when needed, medications are administered correctly, and asthma treatments are given with patience and kindness. Over time, my child has even grown comfortable and independent with treatments thanks to the staff’s support.

The school also goes the extra mile with communication. Through Lilio, I receive daily updates, photos, and reminders, which bring so much peace of mind. The team is incredibly responsive, whether it’s about supplies, dietary preferences like Ripple milk, or special health considerations.

Beyond safety and care, the environment at Leona is full of joy. Events, classroom activities, and everyday interactions show how engaged the staff is with each child. Even extended family members have noticed—when my child’s grandparent came to pick up, they were impressed by the security protocols, friendliness, and warmth of everyone in the building.

As a parent, I feel secure, supported, and grateful every time I drop off my child. UTCDC Leona has not only helped my child grow but also helped me grow as a parent, allowing both of us to become more independent. I would highly recommend this school to any family seeking a daycare where children are truly seen, cared for, and celebrated.

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Care Center
review_text:
We love UT CDC! The teachers and staff are so communicative with families—I always know what’s going on with my daughters and feel really included in their day. Every time I pick them up, they’re smiling and happy.

I also really appreciate how intentional they are about matching teachers with kids based on their personalities and temperaments—it’s made such a positive difference for my girls. And having an on-site OT is such an amazing perk that we didn’t even know we’d value so much until we experienced it.

We feel so lucky to be part of this community and couldn’t recommend UT CDC more highly!

I enjoyed the sermon Sunday and felt very welcome. The play bags at the back of the sanctuary were wonderful for my grandson. I also attended the ladies Bible study on Tuesday. I don't live in Austin but visit frequently. When I am in town I will come again.

We had an incredible experience with this daycare and cannot recommend it enough. One of the things that stood out the most to us was how genuinely happy our son was every single day. The teachers are truly special. They are incredibly loving, patient, and attentive, and it was clear from the beginning that they genuinely care about each child. Our son formed such sweet relationships with his teachers, and it meant the world to us knowing he was being cared for by people who treated him with so much warmth and kindness.

Beyond just providing care, they really focus on the children's development and well being. They created an environment that felt safe, structured, and full of encouragement where our son could learn, grow, and build confidence. We always felt like the staff took a personal interest in helping him thrive.

This place left a lasting impression on our family. The level of care, communication, and genuine love they show the kids is something every parent hopes to find. We are incredibly grateful for the role they played in our son's early years and would wholeheartedly recommend them to any family looking for a place where their child will be loved, supported, and excited to go each day.

We have been so grateful to have found GLMA when we’re were searching for a daycare for our first baby nearly 8 years ago. Our second baby has grown up there as well and is now in their pre-k program. We are deeply thankful for the teachers and staff who show so much love and compassion towards the kids. My girls have always been excited to go to school and happy to share all that they did that day at pickup. We love the dual language. It’s truly incredible to watch your babies grow and learn in such a patient, supportive, loving environment. Thank you GLMA family! We will forever be grateful.

We love this preschool. The teachers great, and really care about the kids. The Spanish immersion is amazing; our child started using words and songs in Spanish after just a few weeks. The classes are fun, the cost feels fair and our child is happy.

Our children have been coming here for years, and we couldn’t be happier! Meals are provided, which helps so much, and learning a second language is such a wonderful bonus. The teachers are incredibly kind and truly care for the kids as if they were their own. We’re so thankful we found GLMA!

Our kids went here for 4 years. Our oldest was there from 6 mos to 4.5 yrs old and our youngest was there from 3 mos old to 1.5 yrs old. We loved it. It is a great, small daycare, with teachers that absolutely adore the kids. It is fully Spanish speaking, so if you want your kids to be primed for being bilingual as English speakers, its incredible. Our 4.5 year old can switch between Spanish and English very easily and our youngest understands both really well. His new daycare is impressed he knows so much.

We loved our time at GLMA and we will miss them all greatly. Big thumbs up from me and my wife.

We’ve had such a great experience with Ms. Ari and Ms. Amie! My daughter loves going each day, and they always make her feel loved, supported, and excited to learn. We’re so thankful for the care they provide.

I wish we would’ve sent our daughters here sooner.  The teachers are kind, fun, and caring; further, the teacher turnover appears to be pretty low, which is great in comparison to our past experience at a different early learning center with our older daughter.  Our younger daughter was enrolled here in the 3’s program and I couldn’t be more happy and satisfied with her teacher, along with the curriculum and basically the school itself.  Her teacher made her feel so welcome on her first day; the students in class are so sweet and my daughter’s transition here was seamless.  It is very apparent that there’s a lot of thought, love, and pride that goes into every aspect of this school.  We also sent our older daughter here for summer camp, and I remain impressed at all that she experienced and learned!  Truly, I cannot recommend this place enough.
We love it,,my four year old loved going to school... definitely recommend it.

Amazing school! My son has been there for years and wouldn't want him at any other school! From curriculum all the way to the food!! They care about every detail of my child's development and learning :) AND they put on fun (Weekend) events outside of regular school (Weekday) hours!
The teachers are great! Unfortunately, there is a lot of turnover due to poor management.

My son attends Pinnacle Montessori at Bulverde and we’ve had such a wonderful experience. His teacher, Mrs. Anna, is so kind, gentle, and attentive. She communicates with me consistently, and I can truly see how much my son has grown since joining her class, both in his confidence and in how he expresses himself.

I also love that the school has cameras in the classroom and that they share photos of him doing activities through their communication app. It gives me a lot of peace of mind and helps me feel connected to his day.

The school has a warm, positive atmosphere, and the entire staff is friendly and welcoming. We’re very happy here and highly recommend Pinnacle Montessori at Bulverde.

As a first time mom, I was very hesitant to have to leave my son with strangers while I went back to work. But from the moment I walked I, we felt welcomed. The teachers were constantly updating me on moments throughout the day and sending pictures of my boy. We have been there for over two years now, and I am so glad we are at Pinnacle Montessori Bulverde. The teachers and director are very caring!

At the beginning, it was a little rough for my son to understand that he wasn’t at home anymore and that he needed to follow instructions in a new environment. As first-time parents with a very energetic child, it was also hard for us to give things time and trust the process of such a big change.
From the very beginning, his teachers — including the director — always found a way to be understanding, patient, and loving toward our child. They truly saw him for who he is and never gave up on him. That made all the difference for our family.
Now, I honestly can’t bring myself to think about the day we will have to leave this place. This school has made such a huge impact on our lives, and we will always be grateful for the care, support, and love they showed our son.

My son has been here since he was a year old and he is now is 4 ! As a mom I feel so safe and secure leaving my baby in their care. My son has accelerated academically and socially being here. Ms Reagan and Ms Vanessa run the school amazingly and always communicate with us parents. I love this school and would recommend highly to anyone.

Our experience at this daycare has been wonderful. Reagan (director) and Vanessa (assistant director) are so attentive, organized, and caring—they always make sure communication is clear and that the kids’ needs come first. Ms Ana has been incredible with my children, showing them so much patience, love, and support. I’m truly grateful for the team here!

After 3 months of my son being at this daycare we finally got a call saying he wasn’t transitioning well. After the call I pulled my son out the program immediately… not enough transparency for me
I spent a big part of my childhood at this daycare, and it holds so many great memories for me.

I am deeply concerned about the treatment children receive at this daycare. My niece's experience was distressing, and no child should have to go through such trauma. Parents should consider alternative options for their children's care.

The lack of professionalism and integrity here is truly shocking. To handle children and parents with so much disrespect and lack of care is truly disgusting. To have cameras that only show in real time with no recording or playback feature is unheard of and unacceptable at a childcare facility where anything can happen. Children coming home with marks on their body with no explanation from any staff member was truly the last straw.

It’s pretty unheard of for a daycare to not have active recording cameras & the ability to playback recordings.  Active, recording cameras help to ensure the safety of not only the children but the staff as well, so hopefully this gets resolved sooner rather than later.

I have known Angie the owner and director for 10 years. She is a very professional and caring person. Her world in this child care industry has been top tier. Never have I witnessed her do anything that jeopardizes the health or safety of a child. Your children will be blessed beyond measure with the care and learning experience they will receive. Keep up the good work Angie.

Mrs. Angie is a wonderful person. You can tell by her methods and passion that she and her staff truly love caring for children. Mrs.Angie's learning center is very enriching for young kids and I am happy that my toddler is thriving in his environment. Mrs. Tam, Mrs. Mary are so nurturing and caring and the atmosphere is filled with good energy, a faith based organization, and I too love the app that allows you to check on your child(ren) throughout the day!

I love this Childcare Center . My 2 yr old daughter has learned so much since she been enrolled from learning her shapes to learning how to spell her name . I also love that I can check how she doing through the app they provide 10/10 I recommend . Also the Director Mrs. Angie is a one of kind special person when it comes to cha and I love her for that.

Mrs. Angie and her staff are such loving and caring people. I can be relaxed and focus on work while my child is in their care, knowing that my child is safe and well taken care of. Thank you all for your dedication.

Kreative Kids Preparatory Academy has been an absolute blessing for our family! The staff is truly amazing, warm, professional, and genuinely caring. From the moment you walk in, you can feel how much love and attention they give to every child.

Mrs. Q deserves a special shoutout, she is the kindest and sweetest person ever. Her dedication, patience, and compassion make such a positive difference, and it’s clear she truly cares about each child’s growth and happiness.

My child attends this daycare, and I couldn’t be more confident in our choice. Knowing my child is safe, nurtured, and learning in such a supportive environment gives me complete peace of mind. I would absolutely recommend Kreative Kids Preparatory Academy to anyone looking for a daycare that feels like family. They are simply the best!

We have been with Kreative Kids Preparatory Academy since my son was 3 years old, and I can honestly say they have been such a blessing in our lives. From the very first day, Mrs. Queenetta and her staff showed genuine care, patience, and understanding, especially as my son is on the autism spectrum. They are incredibly knowledgeable about working with children with special needs, and their approach is both compassionate and professional.

Over the years, I’ve watched my son grow, thrive, become more verbal and more confident, and I know so much of that is because of the safe, nurturing environment they provide every single day. The teachers take the time to learn each child’s unique personality, and they celebrate every milestone, big or small. It truly feels like a family here, and I always feel at ease knowing he is in such capable hands.

I wholeheartedly recommend Kreative Kids Preparatory Academy to any parent, especially those searching for a place where children on the spectrum can feel understood, supported, and loved. They have made such a positive impact on my son’s life, and I am forever grateful for their dedication and care.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Kreative Kids– A Lifesaver for This Single Mama!

I don’t usually post reviews, but I had to take a moment to shout out Kreative  Kids, where my children have been going since 2024. From day one, the experience has been nothing short of amazing. The staff is incredibly warm and welcoming they truly treat every child like their own. You can tell they genuinely care, and that means the world to me as a mom. The center is always clean and well organized, which instantly put me at ease. But what really makes them stand out is their constant effort to keep the kids engaged with fun, hands on learning activities every single day. My kids come home happy, learning, and excited to go back the next morning.
And here’s the cherry on top: they offer school pickup, which has been such a blessing for me as a single mother juggling work and life. That extra support makes a huge difference. If you’re looking for a daycare that goes above and beyond, I can’t recommend Kreative Kids enough. They’re not just a daycare they’re family. 💛

My child had a wonderful experience at Kreative Kids Preparatory Academy’s summer camp! Designed for children from kindergarten to 5th grade, the program offered a great balance of fun and education. The weekly field trips were a big highlight, giving the kids hands-on learning experiences outside the classroom.

The director is truly outstanding—engaged, organized, and clearly passionate about providing a safe and enriching environment. The teachers were warm, professional, and attentive to each child's needs. It’s clear that the staff genuinely cares about the kids and works hard to make the program both educational and enjoyable.

Highly recommend Kreative Kids for any parent looking for a summer camp that keeps children active, learning, and happy! 😁

Honestly, Kreative Kids is absolutely phenomenal! What a wonderful facility- always clean & always smelling good. I can’t give the teachers enough credit. They are beyond amazing! My kids have attended other daycares that don’t even compare to this one! The teachers here are so caring, attentive, and keep my kids engaged. They have wonderful, creative learning activities for the kids year round. I am so happy to have found this place; we love it! So thankful for Ms. Quenetta for making such a lovely second home.

I am grateful that we found Alianza. We previously went to a different school and did not have a great experience.  We were hesitant about enrolling our daughter into another school, but after touring and meeting the teachers, we felt we should try, and I am so grateful that we did.

Our daughter loves the school, her friends, teachers, and all the extracurricular activities that she is able to participate in.

The teachers treat each child with love just like they are family. With hugs and kind words.

Alianza Preschool Spring Valley has been an exceptional experience for our family, it feels like a second home. The staff here truly feels like an extension of our family. The teachers are responsible, caring and well-prepared.

What sets this daycare apart is their approach to learning, including the value of Spanish immersion. Children are encouraged to explore and engage in sensory activities that stimulate their growth and development while being exposed to the richness of Spanish language. Children learn through hands-on experiences and experiments, and not traditional toys or screens.

They go above and beyond by offering a variety of after-school activities and events, such as assemblies, ballet, soccer, book clubs, birthday celebrations, etc... This not only enriches the educational experience but also makes it a fun and exciting place for kids.

One unique feature of Alianza is its commitment to intercultural education. It's a place where children from diverse backgrounds come together to learn and grow, fostering appreciation for different cultures.

Most importantly, our daughter looks forward to going to school every day. Her enthusiasm is a testament of the nurturing and engaging environment provided by the daycare. We couldn't be happier with our choice, and we highly recommend Alianza Spring Valley to other parents seeking a caring and enriching childcare experience.

At Alianza we found a second home. Teachers are lovely, caring and very professional. They are focused on developing kids skills for kinder. By teaching them   letters, songs,  to write their names and to  become more independent and social. My daughters strength their spanish, which was the main reason I chose Alianza. All teachers are very good and show their love for their work and the kids.  My family have a special place in our hearts for Arelys, Yanis, Mili, and Stephanie.

We have had our 2-year-old daughter at Alianza Spring Valley for just over 6 months and we are so happy we made the switch to them. I can honestly say my heart is full when I see how much the staff cares for my little girl. It feels like they are part of our family.
Communication at first was difficult because we both work long hours, so it was hard to catch that time to speak to her teacher. However, after a couple of months, I can say it improved significantly.
I am so proud of my daughter and all she has blossomed and learned with these amazing instructors.

I am so happy my coworker suggested I look into the Alianza schools - I wanted my daughter to learn spanish and to be able to socialize with other kids. She started when she was about 15 months (I worked from home to be with her up until this time) and I was so worried about how she would adapt to being away from me and being around others.

When I visited to give myself a heads up on what to expect I just felt instantly at ease. Her teacher Ms Ania was the perfect person to help her adjust. You can tell she loves every one of her students, and they love her too, she has kids in other classes come into her room just to say good morning to her.

The first couple of days were a little rough, with tears in the morning and when she saw me at pick up. But it only took about a week for that to no longer be an issue. After then she would walk in herself and into the room. She runs up to the room now, sometimes she cries when I come to pick her up because she DOESN'T want to leave! That just makes my heart so happy to know that she is happy and comfortable at the school. I know she's well taken care of and loved by everyone there.

Communication is great, we're given a schedule so we know what they're doing during the day. If there are any upcoming events we get a monthly newsletter letting us know and reminders a week in advance. All the teachers are so friendly and I love that the kids interact with other classes so that everyone seems to know each other there.

They occasionally have little dance parties that I've been lucky enough to catch the end of when picking her up - when she first started she would sit in Ms Ania's lap just watching everyone, sometimes doing some clapping. A few months later, she's clapping and dancing in her teacher's lap. And now - she's out on the dance floor spinning and bopping around with all the other kids. Watching her become more comfortable and independent has been such a treat. I cannot wait to see what's in store as she grows with her Alianza family.

OPERATION_NAME: Pinnacle Montessori Academy of Alamo Ranch
review_text:
My two boys have gone to Pinnacle (toddler and primary) for about 7 months now, they are so happy and love their teachers! We have never had any problems. My wife and I both love everything about the school from the teachers to the directors and admin. Walking into the building you are greeted right away by the outstanding administrators. They are always so helpful and very knowledgeable when we have any questions.
We also LOVE that this school has camera access for parents to view. My wife was so happy about this option.
Ms Patricia and Ms Karolina are both amazing and welcoming to my toddler. We were so worried about how our toddler would transition as my wife was staying with him previously but they were great at comforting him. Ms Tanya is a wonderful teacher and we love how independent our 3 year old has become and how much progress has been made.
If you want a safe and loving environment where your children will also learn I would 100% recommend this school for your child. We definitely plan to keep our children here for as long as possible.

OPERATION_NAME: Pinnacle Montessori Academy of Alamo Ranch
review_text: We switched from Ivy and had a really bad experience there, so we were nervous at first. But this school has been amazing! The school is very clean, organized, and welcoming. Ms. Tanya is an incredible teacher, and our child absolutely loves her. Ms. Danielle at the front is always so helpful and friendly. Since starting the Montessori program here, our child has shown so much progress and growth. We feel so happy and confident knowing our child is in such a positive and caring environment.

OPERATION_NAME: Pinnacle Montessori Academy of Alamo Ranch
review_text: Pinnacle was my son's first school, he attended 3 years before graduating to Kinder. He was absolutely over the moon for his teacher, Mrs. Jackie. She created such a warm and caring environment that my son would be excited to go back everyday! Even now, he still talks about his first teacher! I wish we could have taken her to kinder with us. Wonderful school! Highly recommend!

OPERATION_NAME: Pinnacle Montessori Academy of Alamo Ranch
review_text: I highly recommend this school! My nieces attend Pinnacle Montessori, and whenever I pick them up, they are always engaged in fun and enriching after-school activities. Ms. Sophia is incredibly helpful and always greets everyone with a warm smile. I’m truly impressed by how wonderful this school is. I love knowing my nieces are in a place that is safe, clean, and well-organized. Thank you, Pinnacle Montessori!

OPERATION_NAME: Pinnacle Montessori Academy of Alamo Ranch
review_text: My nephews attend this school and I was blown away! We are beyond grateful for Mrs. Jackie Mansour. She is an incredible PreK teacher—kind, patient, and truly gifted with young children. Her classroom is a place where kids feel safe, supported, and excited to learn. My nephew has absolutely thrived under her care, both academically and socially. It’s clear that Mrs. Jackie Mansour genuinely loves what she does, and that love shows in how the children grow, gain confidence, and flourish. We couldn’t have asked for a better start to our nephew's educational journey.

I can't say enough wonderful things about creative corner! it is clear that this school is more than just a place to learn. it's a nurturing environment where children thrive. The teachers are warm, kind, and incredibly attentive, always making sure each child feels safe, valued, and encouraged. The curriculum is thoughtfully designed, blending play with educational experiences. My child has made amazing progress in just a short time.

My grandson, Brady, graduated almost a year ago from Texas A & M University, & it all started at Creative Corner on Audrey Lane. I was a teacher/administrator at a nearby elementary school, so it was a top priority for my daughter & me to find the BEST pre-school for Brady. We didn’t want just a babysitter but a school which actually TAUGHT & would help prepare him for kindergarten. We found just that in Creative Corner!!! Being an educator myself, I was pretty picky about what I was looking for, but everything at Creative Corner went above and beyond my expectations…..the leadership, teachers, curriculum, activities, organization, atmosphere, etc. Today, Brady is in outside sales at a wonderful company. Thank you, Creative Corner, for giving a Nana peace of mind many years ago! It’s wonderful to see that y’all are still making a difference in so many lives!
Cindy Stephens

Where to begin with this place. My daughter had a terrible experience here. The “caregivers” were NOT caring at all. Sad to see that that has not changed. The owner allowed her untrained staff to try to tell me that my daughter had a learning disability AT THREE YEARS OLD. She was just a quiet child who was dealing with separation anxiety. The curriculum was not developmentally appropriate and they were taking kids outside on days where it was too cold with no option for them to stay inside if they didn’t like the cold. My daughter cried every day for the short time she was here. I took her back to her old day care where she was loved. My experience was some time ago but my daughter’s recent accomplishments have reminded me that people don’t define your success. I get that some have had a good experience here.  We did not. Do your research before you enroll your child here. Not everyone is impressed.

My son went to CCW since he was 2.5 years old through Kinder. The staff was absolutely amazing and my son was well advanced and ready for 1st. His 1st grade teacher was IMPRESSED to have a student start school on a 2nd grade reading level!!! They have structure in which most students thrive on.

Creative Corner has been a staple in East Harris County since I was a little boy.  I am 44 now, and even I attended CC when I was in Elementary.  The owners have done an exceptional job year in and year out with this daycare.  I am so happy, now my niece has been going here for 3 years and she has loved every minute of it.  It is very uncommon, that a 4-5 yr old after a Dr. appt wants to go back to school...but she did.  This says Creative Corner is very caring about each and every one of there kiddos.  The staff there (everyone) is so caring and treats each kid like their own.  I have been able to attend a few events their with my niece, and the building is always so active and fun!  Heck, even I didn't want to leave.  My niece is now heading to 1st grade (tears), but if it was up to her...she would not move one.  Creative Corner is one of the oldest and established daycares/schools around and it says so much that every year, they are at capacity.  I wouldn't even think twice, if my kids were still this young.  A wonderful owner, a great staff and each kid that comes out is so prepared!!

Second year at summer camp and both of my kids had an absolute blast! Every week is a different theme, and the kids really enjoyed the activities prepared for them. Also had splash/bouncy days, snack parties, Friday movies and much more.
The kids really liked the food provided (and this has been improved considerably over the years).

Have been a DDA parent since 2021 and highly recommend as daycare and summer camp! Your kids will be truly loved by all the teachers and will have a great experience.

My son attended summer camps here for the entire summer, and I can't say enough good things about the experience. Each week was thoughtfully themed, with daily lessons, books, and activities that kept him engaged and learning. They practiced writing every day, introduced the kids to different cultures and foods, and made learning fun.

He's heading into kindergarten this year, and I truly believe these camps gave him a little head start—not just academically, but also by keeping him in a consistent routine. His confidence with reading and writing has grown, and he truly looked forward to going every day. This place is amazing and I highly recommend.

After three years (and many more to go) at Dallas Daycare Academy (DDA), I can confidently say it has been one of the greatest blessings for our family. What sets DDA apart is the combination of the most caring teachers/staff, education, and community.

The teachers at DDA truly pour their hearts into nurturing each child. They go above and beyond to celebrate every holiday, milestone, and birthday in ways that create lasting memories for both children and parents. As a family with two full-time working parents, it's incredibly comforting to know that our children are with people who genuinely care about them. These caring educators make DDA feel like a second home, providing peace of mind during our workday that our kids are not just safe, but truly thriving.

DDA offers a curriculum that transforms what could be just "daycare" into a true educational experience. My 4-year-old has flourished academically and socially through their thoughtfully designed programs that thoroughly prepare children for kindergarten. The balance of learning and play creates well-rounded students ready for their next academic step.

Perhaps what makes DDA truly special is the strong community of families. As a member of the Parent Advisory Board for two years, I've witnessed firsthand how much effort goes into creating opportunities for families to connect beyond the classroom. My husband and I have developed what feel like lifelong friendships with other DDA parents through school events and parent activities.

No school/daycare is perfect, but DDA comes remarkably close. Our family will forever be grateful for the formative years our children spent at Dallas Daycare Academy and the incredible community we found there.

I am so thankful for DDA! They take such great care of our children. The teachers are patient and kind, and they do so many fun and educational activities to keep the children engaged. This place is a hidden gem! They’ve also done such a wonderful job building a community between the parents, so we’ve made so many sweet friends.

My son has been a part of DDA since he was 5 months old and will be leaving in August to go to PreK at DISD and we will be so sad to leave this incredible daycare.

I cannot say enough great things about our experience here! Not only are the teachers and staff so wonderful, but the school constantly goes above and beyond with a variety of different activities and events. You can tell a lot of hard work and care goes into the planning and training. My son has learned so much and I feel confident he will move into elementary school already in a great spot.

DDA also supports a super strong parent community that made being a part of this school a wonderful experience for me as a parent as well.

After having my son here full time for over 4 years, I strongly recommend Dallas Daycare Academy!

My son with special needs has been at La Petite since 3 and attends during school breaks now. My daughter has attended since 4.5 months old. There aren’t a lot of daycares out there that have programs for children with special needs. They took the time and spent a day with him to make sure they had the accommodation needed. My daughter enjoys her class and has transitioned well with new teachers. I have had a great experience with the staff and there is built in trust. They do have cameras in the classrooms to check on the kids throughout my day and a safe, large enclosed playground that they love.

I can’t say enough great things about my baby’s daycare! From day one, Ms. Bree has been absolutely amazing. I had so much anxiety about leaving my baby at just 6 weeks old to go back to work, but Ms. Bree made the whole process so much easier. She truly cares about the babies and is always looking for ways to improve and make things even better. You can definitely tell she pours her heart into what she does always going above and beyond for the babies.
One thing that really stood out to me during my tour was how organized they are. They keep detailed notes of each baby’s last feeding and diaper change, and they stay on top of their schedule. It gives me so much peace of mind knowing my baby is in good hands.
The baby room is always spotless and welcoming, and the live cameras are such a comfort throughout the day.

This is my first time using daycare and was apprehensive on leaving my baby girl but Ms Bree gave great love and care for my baby that I was able to focus on my workday without a worry. She's fun and crafty and loves making the classroom feel like a second home for the babies. We are so sad she has left the infant room!
It has been awesome to watch my grandchild enjoy himself at daycare and be around new friends. Staff has been good at helping with our transition into potty training as well. Fun times. lol

Toured the facility, floors were dirty, furniture was old and worn. Staff was outside of the building smoking. The room where my son would have been is not partitioned off meaning everyone has to walk through the middle of their classroom to get where they are going, at all times. My twins went here in 2021 and my youngest started in 2022. They got a new director and she is truly a God send. She has cultivated a family orionated community for everyone that attends this facility. The love and community translated into the staff, my daughter asks to see her teachers and administration staff overthe weekend because of how much she has grown to love them. The facility is very clean, they have amazing safety measures and everyone knows each other. I would go back again a d again, a number of our neighbors attend this daycare with no complaints

My son started at St. Andrews when he was 4 months old and from the first day I left him I was reassured he was in great hands. All the staff is compassionate and caring. The activities done by the staff are age appropriate and assist with various developmental skills. St. Andrews has a welcoming atmosphere, almost like you are leaving your child with family. Christian values are incorporated in the curriculum as well as demonstrated by staff. Staff pays close attention to the kids and are keen on any changes as well as communicating concerns/observations with parents. All the kids at the center are showered with love and given the best care possible. The food served is a nutritious balanced diet.Daily notes and pictures are updated on an App downloaded by parents as well as parents are able to communicate to staff through the app. Staff and administrators respond to emails in a timely manner. My son is now 16 months and I am so grateful for St. Andrews and all that they do for him.

This school is amazing. The new director Mrs. James is so kind and loving towards all the children and parents. They’re organized, involved and always communicating what happens at school with updates and photos throughout the day. I have a two year old and a 4 year old here and they LOVE their teachers.

I recently returned to the workforce and needed full time care for my child. After searching high and low with no availability anywhere, a neighbor recommended St. Andrew ECC. Turns out we have many neigbors whose children attend St. Andrew. Mrs. James, the new director, had been making big changes over the last few months and parents were thrilled at the classroom and building improvements. Staff changes were also made and attendance has risen. Curriculums have been put into place and the kids are very well taken care of. My preschooler has done very well at St. Andrew. She has learned her alphabet including recognizing the letters, counting past 30, can write her name and is now potty trained with their help. It was a hard transition for this mom but the staff have been warm and welcoming. I appreciate the new website, updates on the app and walking into a warm, safe school with happy babies and toddlers. The school smells like fresh breakfast each morning and during pick up my child is thrilled to see me but hates to say goodbye to friends and teachers.
Very great daycare, the workers are super nice and patient!

We love Kiddie Academy of Bee Cave. They go above and beyond taking care of our son, every day! They treat each child as the individual that they are, and find exciting and engaging ways to make learning fun. Our kiddo started in the baby room and has now worked his way up through multiple other classes. Almost all the teachers and admin in the entire school know our son by name, even though he hasn’t had all the teachers yet. KA is thoughtful about transitions, communicates clearly with parents, and is always willing to work with us to address any challenges that come with raising a toddler. We drive out of our way to take our son to this daycare because we truly believe they are a step above the rest.

The curriculum is perfect and well balanced for the development of the children, and they help with potty training! The teachers send pictures and updates through their app which is a nice touch and they also have live cameras in each classroom. We know our son is in good hands. I highly recommend Kiddie Academy of Bee Cave!

My son is graduating PreK tomorrow and his journey started here at 11 weeks old in the middle of a pandemic shutdown. I can’t express enough the gratitude and love our family has for the staff and teachers. They guided us through everything from sleep regressions, table foods, and potty training, to reading and writing, math, astrology, and even sports.

We’ve seen some families and teachers come and go and the one thing I’m most thankful for is keeping my son at Kiddie Academy. We’ve all developed lifelong friendships and strengthened our relationships through creating this community which still feels like a small Texas town.

If you are considering KA Bee Cave for your child’s preschool education, count yourself blessed. We’ve never once doubted the administration and staff’s intentions of always doing what’s best for our son, keeping him safe, and growing his mind, body, and spirit in the most amazing ways.

The teachers and directors at the Academy are so kind and take the best care of my two boys! They keep the whole school clean, and the kids are well-behaved/respectful/happy. My two year olds development has been awesome since coming to Kiddie Academy of Bee Cave, he will come home singing songs and saying new words weekly. They are working with him on skills like potty training and sharing. My 4 month old loves Ms. Gina in the infant room. She takes awesome care of him and knows his schedule extremely well. We’ve been at Kiddie Academy since August 2021 and are very happy thus far.

We love Kiddie Academy at Bee Cave! The teachers are wonderful and so are the rest of the staff. My daughter always has a big smile on her face when I pick her up in the afternoons. You always see the director and assistant director helping out in all the classrooms, they are very involved! It is a very warm and welcoming place and we highly recommend it.
Can’t say enough wonderful things about this school. My kids have learned so much and made so many precious memories. The teachers and facility are truly top notch
Most amazing little preschool.  Excellent caring staff.  Great place for children.
Great preschool!

Clean, friendly, lots of parking,  food and drinks around , all thr things .
As a single mom. having a place to drop and go and feel safe is a must. I did a tour and drop same day and cried.

I’m so happy I found a place I feel comfortable for him to go to when I need to break or focus on my newborn.

My husband and I are so blessed that our baby boy is loved and cared for at Eagles Child Care Center! Ever since we enrolled our baby boy, we notice he is excited to go every morning to the center and when we pick him up, he’s not always happy to leave. I also enjoy the appreciation they have for everyday freshly made food since I want my baby to always have homemade meals. I’m so excited to watch him grow and to watch him learn so much more!

I absolutely love Eagle Child Care Center! The staff is so professional and talented, and it shows in everything they do. My daughter is always excited to go, and as a parent, that means the world to me.

We truly adore the teachers, and the owners are so loving and genuinely care about every single child. It’s such a warm, nurturing environment. I highly recommend Eagle Child Care Center to any parent looking for a place where their child will thrive!

I write this review with great pleasure and admiration for Claudia. Her presence at the school is truly a blessing for every parent, teacher, and child in the community.
Our son has LOVED this daycare! The teachers are attentive and very accommodating! The space is amazing for learning and exploring.

OPERATION_NAME: El Kinder - Bilingual Early Childhood Education
review_text: I was looking for a bilingual in English and Spanish, Christian based daycare/preschool and I found this place. I fell in love with it immediately after my daughter starting attending. review_text: My daughter attended this school when she was three years old in the mid 90s. She now has a successful corporate job at AT&T. Great early childhood education is a difference maker.

I’ve had 5 kids get great love and attention from this child care provider. Plus my kids always come home with something new to talk about . They have great teachers . Best daycare my kids ever attended

OPERATION_NAME: Primrose School of Dallas at Kessler Park
review_text: We are SO VERY THANKFUL for Primrose at Kessler Park! My daughter has attended since she was 1.5 years old, and she is now 3.5, and our 8 month old has attended since he was 2 months old. The love that the teachers and staff show my kids every single day, truly brings joy to my heart and (happy) tears to my eyes. My daughter has thrived at Primrose, and even asks to go to school on the weekends 😂 I was so nervous to send my newborn to daycare, but he is so loved by his teachers, and the updates and pics I get throughout the day are evidence are that. We have considered moving houses, and one our requirements is that we have stay near the kids daycare, it is the only place we feel comfortable sending them. Thank you so much to the staff and teachers for the love and care you have shown not only our kids, but us - the parents - as well!

OPERATION_NAME: Primrose School of Dallas at Kessler Park
review_text:
We absolutely love Primrose and cannot say enough wonderful things about the care our 2-year-old son receives. From the moment we drop him off each morning, we feel completely confident that he is safe, loved, and well cared for. He is genuinely happy to go to school, which says everything.

Since starting at Primrose, we have seen such positive growth in him, especially in his talking and social skills. The progress he has made has been amazing to watch.

The teachers are always happy, patient, and clearly love each child they care for. That warmth extends beyond the classroom. Everyone you encounter in the building is welcoming, kind, and genuinely joyful. From the front door to the classrooms, the environment feels warm and positive.

We are so grateful to be part of the Primrose family and highly recommend it to any parent looking for a place where their child will truly be cared for and supported.

OPERATION_NAME: Primrose School of Dallas at Kessler Park
review_text: We love the staff, from leadership to teachers and kitchen staff. The place is super clean and well maintained. We like how close it is from downtown (which makes it close from almost everywhere, since it’s in the center of Dallas). My son is well taken care of and he hit so many of his milestones while we start sending him to Primrose Kessler Park, he also made so many friends :) we love this daycare.

OPERATION_NAME: Primrose School of Dallas at Kessler Park
review_text: They make us feel like family! All the communication and updates all day long are amazing. I love all the theme days and events too like splash days and critter days make it so fun. We love the curriculum and our 4 month old daughter loves going everyday! She’s already learned so much over the past 2 months. You can tell they love what they do.

OPERATION_NAME: Primrose School of Dallas at Kessler Park
review_text: At Primrose School of Dallas at Kessler Park, the best thing is hands down the incredible staff! They shower our little one with boundless care, kindness, and genuine enthusiasm every day. What truly excites us the most is seeing our little one's sheer joy and excitement every time she heads to school. Let's just say, we know who the cool ones are here—hint, it's definitely not us! Primrose staff rocks!

Daycare is an amazing place, very clean.  Ms.Chrissy is such a loving and understanding teacher.  She is focused and makes sure all the children are included and engaged in all of her classroom activities.  Her classroom is awesome.  I’m very pleased with the growth my child has shown this past year.  Thank you Ms. Chrissy for being an inspiration to all the kids at the center.
My son had been here since he was 6months old and he is now 2! He’s learned so much for his teacher mrs chrissy!! He absolutely adores her and i do too! Wouldn’t want my son to be with anyone else!

The staff inform on how my 2 year old son day was and the activity of the day. Class Dojo helps me stay on top of events at the Learning center. The staff are amazing. They’re always on top of things, whether it’s events or anything going on with my son. They’re super flexible too, which has been a lifesaver for me as a single parent.

Since starting here, I’ve seen such a huge difference in my son. He’s learned so much—from basic routines to social skills, and even things like counting and recognizing colors. His confidence has grown, and he’s become more curious and expressive every day. Watching him hit milestones and come home excited to share what he did is the best feeling.

He started speech therapy around June or July, and the fact that they let his therapist come in during the day is such a huge help. It’s made things so much easier, and I really appreciate how supportive they’ve been.

I highly recommend this facility to anyone who wants their child to feel individually loved & supported for who they are!

I have nothing but amazing things to say about Ms Lenora & Ms Jasmine. It’s a very family like atmosphere at the daycare and the best part was this was the cheapest daycare I found while on the quest and honestly just what my son needed. My son goes here for the afterschool program and absolutely loves it! The staff is so nice, accommodating, responsive,  and all around awesome.
