It’s wonderful because they pick him up from his elementary school and ensure he gets to Little Sprouts safely. I highly recommend this daycare, especially if you are needing afterschool care!

My 2.5 year old daughter LOVES this place!! She gets up every day happy because she is going to school and when I pick her up she always has a drawing in her hands and a big smile. The staff is very friendly and nice all the time. It is an incredible place to leave your little one while you have to work because they are well cared for, they are learning and they are happy

I can’t say enough good things about little sprouts and the staff. From the moment we enrolled out two kids, we felt confident that they were in caring and capable hands. The staff is incredibly warm, attentive, and friendly.

The daily activities are not only fun but so great for the little ones for their everyday learning. Our kids learned so much socially and academically. We also love the regular updates that keep us informed about their day which was a plus for me since it kept me at peace because I know what their day was all about.

The facility is always clean, organized, and safe. I definitely recommend little sprouts and I want to thank Ms. Victoria, Ms. Annie and Ms. Norma for being so great to our kids.

This Daycare is awesome. I wanna give my feedback to all parents if you planning to enroll your kids 6 weeks and up, please try this amazing Daycare.
I had the best experience ever & I never regretted to enroll my kids there. The owner is Amazing, who really cares about his services provided to the parent. Can’t tell you about the teachers they are incredible awesome, they really want the kids to learn and they work hard to teach them and take a good care of them like their own kids.
I’m totally amazed of this place.
Thanks to the owner for all the efforts you doing to keep this Daycare outstanding and how you treat the teachers and support them to give us the best experience.
I highly recommend this place..

My 6 month old daughter was with Didáctica for 6 months. We absolutely loved this daycare. The staff are all super friendly and nice and the director Gabby is very kind and super responsive. I love how for the infant class there were cameras so we could watch her at anytime! I also love the brightwheel app they used to share with us her schedule, multiple pictures throughout the day, and we could communicate with them on there. The only reason we left was because we moved out of state and this was the hardest part of the move was pulling her out of this amazing daycare. 10/10 would recommend to anyone!

At first, the decision to put my son in daycare was so hard. I knew he would love the social interaction, but I felt guilty not being the one with my son the majority of the time. I’m sure many parents feel this way when picking a new day care. But let me ease your mind.

Every single teacher and staff member here genuinely cares. I had no clue they would pay such close attention to detail, and be so responsive with any questions I have or changes I make to my son’s routine.

I don’t know how Gaby the director does it, but she’s got the most amazing memory and always has time to spend with me when I need to speak with her.

I feel like I’m leaving my son with family every morning when I drop him off with Miss Gladys and Miss Nelly.

That right there is enough to love this place, but on top of that, my son is learning Spanish at an incredible rate. Something that I would never have been able to provide for him at this time.

I’m truly so grateful for everyone here.

Didáctica has been a great preschool for our kids. We got our first enrolled since she was 9 months old and seeing how great she did we knew that’s where we wanted to enroll our second even earlier.

We are in love with the curriculum. Having them learn a second language since they were babies has really helped them develop and it’s been fun trying to practice with them.

The whole staff is caring, lovely and is always on the lookout for our needs. The director, Miss Gaby, always answers our concerns and reassures us about how our kids are doing. Her costumer service is always personal and she makes sure to answer everything herself, which we’ve never seen before and makes this the best experience we have had.

We highly recommend Didactica for your kids. We kept looking for a while around the whole south after moving to Austin and we are sure we found the best.

Thank you Didactica Preschool and Miss Gaby for everything!

We have been very happy here! The director Gabby is very responsive, unlike some schools that we interviewed. We received lots of communication from the school on the upcoming curriculum, what our kids are doing, and extracurricular opportunities like soccer or tennis. Most importantly our son has been very happy and is thriving! He knows his school, hugs his teachers, and is speaking both English and Spanish consistently, as well as mastering the basic curriculum that is right for his age.

This place is adorable , Gabby the Director is very attentive with everyone. The teachers are very happy and Loveling with the children.  I love Didactica very clean, their security is also great.  I highly recommend this place to everyone who is looking a great environment for a child.

We have had our daughter in daycare for a little over a month now and we really like it. The teachers are all so nice and clearly care about all the kids. Administration is easy to deal with and you get daily app updates for everything to do with your child.

We couldn’t be happier with the care and education our daughter receives from Lil Friends Day School! From the moment we enrolled, the staff has been warm, attentive, and genuinely invested in our child’s growth. The classrooms are clean, safe, and structured in a way that encourages both learning an independent exploration.
My daughter comes home excited about something she’s learned every day she’s at school. And the communication between the staff and the parents is excellent! They’re constantly posting photos and updates on what’s going on daily. If you’re looking for a place where your kids will be cared for supported and encouraged to grow, we highly recommend this daycare! They’ve exceeded our expectations and every way!!

My son Cole is 3 and has been going here since he was 8 months old. They have been absolutely wonderful. As a single sole custody father, they have been essential in keeping my son up to date with learning milestones and motor skills. God bless them for the help in potty training…! My son adores his teachers even though from time to time he can be a handful. They have been absolutely amazing with him.

We adopted our sweet baby boy at the beginning of the summer and felt nervous as we scrambled for a daycare. We LOVE Little Friends! They send pictures and updates throughout the day, and his teachers love and care for him as if he's their own. I'm so happy we found this daycare and would recommend it to anyone who might be nervous about leaving your baby all day.

It was such a hard decision trying to pick the right daycare for our baby, we must definitely made the right one picking this one. Great atmosphere, feels like family and great communication between parents and teachers, so you always know what is going on with your little one.

These guys are great!  They're out there serving free coffee and donuts to bus riders every Wednesday morning, praying with folks who are going through a hard time, worship services on Saturdays and Sundays, helping teach kids to read, school supply drives, you name it.  It's great to see a church putting their money where their mouth is and really connecting with the community.

I have never been denied using the restroom, it's a place of worship that helps the neighborhood,clean restrooms, that are open to all, bus drivers use them often you can sit inside to escape the heat. Our Lord God the Father's house his spirit dwells there as he does in all churches the places where we can feel his presence. Jesus loves you remember that always.

Dear AnnaMae, I am sorry you had a bad experience.  The problem you had could have been during a time when there were school children there.
That is when the church is closed for their protection.  There is an agreement they have with the organization Project Transformation, the summer and after school reading program.  Me and my family are members there and we are Black.  Even when I go there during those times I am restricted access to the restroom until the children are all out of there and an adult goes to check before I am allowed in. The pastors are Hispanic.  We have been welcomed at the Ministry Center from the very beginning a few years ago, and at the larger church on 1604.  We joined there 15 years ago.  Many of the members at both locations are friends for life and would give you the clothes off their back.  One family even gave us their car!   I hope you come back one day and have a better experience.
Loving caring pastors and staff. Always welcoming of all races, ages, abilities and backgrounds no matter what.  Everyone is equal.  Me and my family have been there since it was built 5 yrs ago.

Thank you NH Ministry Ctr!
I appreciate all your help Nurse Contrera. It's great to have someone that actually cares about the community, but especially, someone that listens. Thank you! And thank you Northern Hills Ministry Center, Methodist Healthcare Ministries and your wonderful Wesley Nurses.

Ms. Harris is great with my two toddlers. They love going school. And I can see the improvement in their speech. I appreciate that they are actually learning something rather than just sitting in front of a tv all day.
My children loved this daycare and I could tell they was learning.
Great place for your child's early start education.
This is such a great academy for all kids!

I can’t say enough about Mrs.Cynthia and her staff they are awesome my baby is no angel and they do phenomenal work with him he been there since a newborn they potty trained him/cared for him like they own child when he got to school because they taught him he was one of the top students in prek every holiday/birthday/even starting school Mrs. Cynthia sent my child with everything I can’t say how much she has done but I recommend her daycare 1000 percent and I thank her because she worked with me and my child through hard times and all
I've had 2 children at R and R learning center and it has been a good experience... Mrs. Cynthia and her staff are always welcoming...
Mrs. David is wonderful. Always attentive and really care for your children.

When our daughter was younger, we were fortunate to have one of us working from home, so she was able to stay with us. But as she grew and needed more social interaction and stimulation, we began the search for the right preschool—and we’re so glad we found CF Kids!

She started off attending part-time, but it wasn’t long before we transitioned to full-time because of how much she loved it—and how much we loved the environment. Now, a year and a half later, we’ve just signed up for another year without hesitation.

The teachers and staff are incredible—so warm, attentive, and genuinely invested in each child’s growth. Even the other parents have been wonderful to get to know. The program is the perfect balance of hands-on learning and imaginative play, giving the kids space to explore, discover, and grow naturally while navigating toddlerhood.

We can’t recommend CF Kids enough—it’s truly been a nurturing and joyful place for our daughter and for us as a family.

Blossom Heights has been the best school for my family! We are on our third year here and our second daughter started this year. There is no more joyful campus in Houston- the kids spend SO MUCH time outside which I love and the faculty is the most loving group of grownups I’ve ever met. Love love love this school. Can’t wait to see how they grow with their new elementary school!!

I lead a unique charity preschool nearby for very young, underprivileged children called Project One Day. In doing research for creating our school I toured many, many others. Blossom Heights stuck with me. My own children are grown now, but if I had it to do over again Blossom Heights would likely be top of that list. The owner has a deep understanding of the needs of children and their longing to explore their environment. The children appeared happy and engaged and the space was truly unique.

Blossom Heights is my home away from home. Linda has created a magical place for kids to be kids. The staff is so well trained and they truly love the kids. If you’re looking for a place for your preschooler to get dirty, learn to take care of each other and the earth, learn lifelong social-emotional skills, and have the best time outside, THIS IS IT. The magic and love at Blossom Heights are all around campus. 🌸 🥕 🍅 🌻🌱💙

Amazing school! It is like no other. They spend over half the day outside and even eat lunch outside. They play, have fun, and get messy! They've recently expanded with a new building and added kindergarten. What a wonderful home away from home!
We actually started our child at a different school this past fall (for personal convenience reasons) and decided we liked Blossom so much better that we pulled her out and moved her back to Blossom Heights. She's 4 and has been there since 20mo. I was a former Montessori teacher, but I knew I didn't want that for my toddler because of the lack of creative exploration. I chose Blossom because of the play based focus, extended outdoor time, and environmental awareness. They are very respectful of the children and use deliberate language to enforce the philosophies they believe in.

I discovered Blossom Heights in 2019, and upon touring, I immediately knew that I wanted to send my son to this magical place. Fast forward 5 years, and my two younger children are still enrolled.
This school truly understands childhood, and how to best preserve it. Children get to spend their time outdoors and exploring, learning organically. I loved the environment so much, that I became a teacher at the school! 10/10, highly recommend to everyone in the area.

OPERATION_NAME: La Escuelita Spanish Immersion Preschool at 10th Street Hist
review_text: I couldn’t be happier with the experience we are receiving at this school for littles! My daughter has learned so much in just the few months she’s gone, she loves her teachers like family. Thankful to have found a great place for my daughter to learn Spanish and learn a curriculum. Amazing small business and the community is lucky to have them!

I love KinderCare and the care they give my child. It’s more than just a place for my son to go when I’m at work. They love my child and have taught him so much. When times have been hard I just made one call and Ms.Jessica has always been there no matter what.

My family and I have had such a great experience with this daycare! From day one, the staff has been incredibly welcoming, caring, and attentive. As a first time mom, that’s very comforting. My child genuinely looks excited every time they walk into the center, which says a lot to me as a parent. It’s clear that the team creates a fun, safe, and nurturing environment where kids can thrive. It gives me peace of mind knowing they’re in  good hands.

I especially want to highlight the director. She is truly exceptional. From our very first visit, she made us feel welcomed, heard, and supported. She’s not only professional and organized, but also warm, approachable, and genuinely passionate about the children and the families she serves. She takes time to connect with each child and parent, and it’s clear how much heart she puts into running the daycare. Her leadership sets the tone for such a positive, respectful and uplifting environment. She is the kind of director you want running a daycare where your child attends. Couldn’t be happier with our choice!!

KinderCare Nacogdoches was absolutely amazing! My child learned in just under a year, to speak full sentences, all his numbers, colors, and etc. Staff is amazing! They were so kind and treated all of the children with care! Absolutely loved this daycare! Ms Jessica was exceptional! Always so kind and understanding! Truly always had a smile on her face and made us feel so welcomed! I always received updates on my child learning and activities he was participating in! This place was nothing but OUTSTANDING!

I LOVE Nacogdoches KinderCare!!! Ms. Jessica and the staff are great with the kids! Everyday  after I pick up my daughter she tells me,  "I love daycare". If my daughter loves going EVERYDAY even if I try to keep her home, you know the place is awesome. Thank You to the staff for all you do!! ❤️

The staff and director have been so amazing to my son! He has learned so much and is super advanced and I can thank the teachers for that. I love the daily updates/reports given along with photos. I highly recommend this daycare for your kiddos!

This facility is really amazing, the teachers AND directors are top tier the best. They ease your mind by making sure your child is safe, they make sure your child is having fun all while having a fun learning education experience.

I honestly  can't say enough good things about Oxford Academy. My little one has been going there since she was 4 months old and now she is almost 2. Everyday she is so excited to see all of her teachers and friends. The staff is so nice and it is so reassuring to know that she is loved. They are always warm and welcoming and she runs to give them hugs. The facility is always clean and they do a great job communicating with parents. The structure and curriculum is wonderful and they always have special activities for the kids to do. Seriously the best daycare in Fort Worth hands down!

We are so grateful to have found Oxford Academy. The service is truly exceptional—always responsive, friendly, and professional. They go above and beyond to ensure parents feel informed and supported.

The teachers are wonderful—caring, dedicated, and clearly passionate about early childhood development. Our child absolutely loves going to Oxford Academy and has made incredible progress thanks to the nurturing and engaging environment the teachers create.

One thing that immediately impressed us is the cleanliness of the facility. Every area is kept spotless, and hygiene is clearly a top priority, which is so important for peace of mind as a parent

One of the standout features of Oxford Academy is how involved and helpful the owners are. They are approachable, and genuinely care about the well-being of the children and families. Their commitment to running a top-notch daycare is evident in every aspect.

We highly recommend Oxford Academy to any parent looking for a safe, clean, and loving environment for their kids

My 3-year-old has been attending this daycare for a year, and we love it! Her teachers are phenomenal—caring, patient, and dedicated. The directors are also professional and approachable. They really work hard at making the environment welcoming for families.

The curriculum is engaging, and my daughter has learned so much while having fun- which is very important for us. They also have lots of activities and events for families throughout the year which is a great bonus.  It’s a wonderful place that truly goes above and beyond! We love it here!

The biggest thing that a parent hopes for when putting their child in someone’s care is peace of mind and trust. That is what Oxford Academy and their management delivers. We absolutely love the facility, the entire staff and the nurturing environment here. The facility’s cleanliness, menu options and curriculum offered at Oxford are top notch. My child loves going there everyday. We are thankful for the high quality care provided to the children.

It was my sons first time going to daycare, so of course he was nervous and scared at first. In less than a week he was expressing how excited he was to be there! He is a very shy boy but the staff and other kids helped him break through it. The staff is very professional and friendly. They keep great communication with everything pertaining to my son. Highly recommend.

My child has been attending this daycare for almost 3 years now. My daughter loves it, and not once has she complained or told me of being treated unfairly. She loves the staff there, they treat her as if their own. And they get fed at least 3 times a day. Breakfast, Lunch and snack before being picked up by parents.. Love it! I def recommend this daycare to anyone.. :)
I love this place for my son, everyone is so nice and respectful. My son enjoys playing, having fun with others and learning to get ready for Kinder ☺️
Very good daycare personal working with Mrs. Melissa being the director!! My son was there from 2010-2014 (3 months old to finish pre kinder). When he started school he wanted go back to the daycare.

Unorganized. My son would always be in a different class and one time I had to go to three different rooms before I found my son. Teachers I met with were nice, however the owner has a bad temper and can be unprofessional. I knocked on her office door one time when I came unannounced and got a very loud and rude "WHAT?!" Once she opened the door and found it was a parent she did apologize, but I still think that was uncalled for.

This daycare has been wonderful for our little one. She was always excited to wake up and go each day. The staff does a great job keeping things fun and engaging with activities like spirit week and special parties and celebrations. Everyone is incredibly friendly and communicative, keeping us informed about how her day went. From daily routines to curriculum, we always felt our child was in excellent hands. It never felt like we were dropping her off with strangers.

Amazing school on every metric! Our family is truly grateful to be apart of it!!!
- Dr. C

I have my 1yo and my 4yo there for over 6 months now. They have both improved on their communication skills; they are way more disciplined now and they love attending every day.  Mrs. Parker is very attentive and helpful. Mrs Tammy has a huge heart and took care of my 1yo like if it was hers. Mrs Pam is an amazing teacher and human being. I have been blessed for finding this place for my children. I rate it 5 starts cause there are no more! But I recommend it 100%.
My son started this daycare when he was a toddler and still attends for the summer. Mrs. Parker makes sure her staff are doing their job. I have never had any problems .

If you are looking for a daycare that teaches this is definitely the place . Mrs. Parker and staff did an amazing job with my daughter in the short time she was there. I enrolled her a couple of months before she started pre-K4 and because of them she was beyond ready. The staff was friendly and on time when I was ready to drop off. I mean there are so many great things I could say let’s just say this place dotted every eye and crossed every T for me.

He was fully prepared for a kindergarten or 1st grade curriculum as a four year old. I can confirm that Precious Stones gave him the academic foundation he needed to transition into a school setting.  Precious Stones provides a wonderful academic curriculum that helps children succeed. The Read by Five Program offered helps young students excel in the classroom.   I would recommend this school as they have prepared my son for a bright future. - C.D

It has been a while since my girls were attending but i left on bad terms from here my daughters came to me and told me that ms parker was hitting my baby and other lil kids on the head so they would listen i was so upset 😡and completely stop attending there beware who people pretend to be

Such a great church home. Everyone is friendly and welcoming. The service is traditional but the message is always current, something useable in life. There are multiple opportunities for involvement in classes/studies, outreach, or just socializing. It’s a great place!
As always, Aldi has amazingly low prices. Cashiers are quick and friendly.

This is the sweetest place and our daughter absolutely loves it! She adores all of the teachers and Miss Diana and Miss Z! The love, care and attention they give the children gives you so much peace and comfort as a parent. You know your child is truly loved at TLCC!

TLCC is wonderful.  The first day I walked in and hung out with the ladies in the crawling room..it felt like my grandmother's house.  I was almost in tears when I left because I was in the middle of a bad situation in another daycare.  My daughter started a few days later and she loves it!! She squeals when she sees her teachers in the morning and is so happy.  They shower them with love and affection.

You wont find a better place.

Continuity of Care meeting was wonderful and our guest speaker Sunny was dynamic!
Thanks to the church we have an awesome venue to host this great meeting place for advocate of aging communities like ours!
Fantastic teachers and staff, a great program and lots of love.  This school is a cut above the rest.

What we love about Primrose of Bent Trail is how small and close-knit the school is, which means the administrators and teachers really get to know each family and put effort into ensuring your child's experience at school is the best it can be.

The teachers are dedicated and, in many cases, have been with the school for years. The daily updates through their app offer consistent peace of mind, and the staff take care to act as partners with each family to meet the needs of each child as an individual. They ask for feedback regularly and act on what they hear. We're so happy we chose Primrose of Bent Trail for our son!

Leaving your baby at daycare for the first time can be extremely difficult for a new mom, but the staff of Primrose Bent Trail made me feel so at ease - they were communicative, kind and so clearly loved my little one.

In the year since that first drop off, we've seen our little baby thrive and grow into a busy, curious and happy toddler under the incredible care of Primrose Bent Trail.

Fundamentally clean, caring, communicative. I'm so pleased with our decision to send our child here and I'm thankful for Primrose every day!

Our kids have been going to the school since each were under 8 months old and we couldn't recommend them enough.  Not only are they learning but they have made some great friendships, explored a lot of activities and are always excited to go to school.  We just had our oldest graduate and it's great to see it all come full circle.  Lastly, the staff is amazing and you can tell they truly care.

Primrose of Bent Trail was an amazing experience for my children. The teachers and staff are extremely caring and thoughtful. The curriculum is top notch. My children absolutely loved all of the fun learning activities

Primrose of Bent Trail is phenomenal. This was my first "daycare" experience and the staff has been extremely welcoming, accommodating and all around friendly. As a mom - it is so comforting to know that my daughter's teachers and ancillary Primrose staff take a personal interest in her progress.
You can feel the warmth and love as you enter the building.
Also, the campus is small which makes it feel more intimate and homely.

review_text: This shelter is dear to my heart. I went in with a plan and goals and my case manager Lydiana was a rockstar! It is the first place that I donate gently used items as well as refer women or women with children to get on their feet.

review_text: As I read the reviews I'm just like in awe because when I was going through the shelter I did not experienced any of this stuff I never seen any of this stuff happen and if it ever did for instance if they kick somebody out or something I believe there might have been more to the story because I don't think that's how it works. You got Roxanne in the morning she's ready Rock That's why they call her Roxanne..LOL.. pop and son Duo they're pretty cool and I hate to say it but there's another lady in the kitchen that works with Roxanne I'm embarrassed to say I don't remember her name but she knows who she is I know she lives somewhere here by me but I haven't had the time to go out and find her but she's very cut out for her job and very respectful lady and also Junior the son of the dad in the kitchen he takes a lot of pride in his cooking he loves to cook and he cooks very good food and my kids were always so excited to see him and they still ask about him every once in a while like as if I'm supposed to go and ask him to come out and hang out with these kids LOL...  not happening... Our daughter has blossomed and flourished in every way imaginable. From day one, it was clear this wasn’t just a childcare center—it was a nurturing, intentional community devoted to the growth and development of each child.

KRK’s has played a profound role in shaping our daughter’s early learning journey. The foundation they’ve helped build—academically, socially, and emotionally—will stay with her for life.

And now, as we begin the same journey with our son, we feel nothing but peace and excitement—because we already know we made the right decision. Here’s to the next four years, and to the people who have truly helped raise our children with love, intention, and heart.

Now, nearly a year later as a member, I can honestly say I’ve never been part of a more hospitable and Christ-centered church. The community is rich and encouraging, and each Sunday’s gathering—through the preaching of the Word, prayer, the Lord’s Supper, and worship—consistently brings glory to God and refreshes His people.

Whether you’re searching for a new church home or attending church for the first time, you’ll find something truly special at LHBC.

LHBC has been a blessing to my Fiancé and I . If you’re new to the Dallas area, or are looking for a great church community LHBC is great. People from all walks of life attend, both young and old (well seasoned). While LHBC is strong in the area of hospitality, what made me decide to continue to come was the messages that were preached. The pastors here don’t sugar coat the Word.

Come experience God's love in a liturgically worshipful and family friendly atmosphere! A spiritual light that illumines East Dallas and surrounding areas, LHBC is a church where Jesus Christ is glorified, his Gospel is shared, his grace abounds, and his Resurrection is celebrated; where the ordinary means of grace nourish and sustain us; where God’s Word is cherished, preached, prayed, read, taught, discussed, and shared; where sin is confessed and forgiveness found; where children are welcomed, loved, and nurtured, and families supported; where every believer is encouraged to grow in Christian faith and love, and where any unbelievers are compellingly invited into freedom from sin, death, and the devil through repentance and faith in Christ.

Lake Highlands is what has truly made Dallas feel like home! My husband and I have been members of LHBC for 2 1/2 years. LHBC won our hearts by focusing on the ordinary means of grace (Scripture, Prayer, Fellowship) and by being a hospitable congregation. We have felt so loved and know at LHBC. The Lord has used LHBC to grow my understanding of the word by blessing this church with so many amazing Teachers/Preachers.

I love this church! I’ve been going here for 6 years now. It’s a great place to be surrounded by people who are passionate about learning the Word of God and living well and to be encouraged by godly examples.
Excellent!!! I love it!!!

Wheelsforkids has been a life saver for me and my grandson, she has taken care of him from
birth intil now. We love the caregivers at Wheelsforkids. Ms.Cynthia has shown our family kindness and patience in my time of need. Thank you! I highly recommend!

This is a great daycare, my child has been attending since he was a baby. I could not have asked for better place to leave my child. The staff is great and the owner treats every child like her own. Such a homely environment!!!!

Both my kids loved attending this daycare. They care about the children’s well being and learning. They also ensure the kids have a fun time during Spring Break and summer, with fun field trips. Any time we had questions or concerns they were addressed quickly.

This is no fancy look daycare it looks like a house but if you go inside it’s a Home!  My wife is a former classroom Teacher and she knows that this place is good as the Teachers are there for years so the Management must be great because no much turnover.
We enrolled our son 2 years ago and loved it! Of course there are no perfect daycares and kids are kids but the care and concern of the Directress are just awesome as she caters to everybody like us who works weekends. They even get their hours longer for those who needs it.
My children have been attending this daycare for some time & I would 10/10 recommend. They treat your child like their own & are very caring.

As parents of three children, we’ve had all of our kids enrolled at Primrose School, and we can confidently say we have zero regrets. From day one, the experience has been exceptional.
What sets Primrose apart is the personalized care they provide. Every child’s needs are met with attention and compassion, making it clear that this isn’t just a daycare, it’s a true early education environment. The teachers (yes, we call them teachers because they truly are!) go above and beyond to nurture and educate.
One of the biggest things we appreciate is the low staff turnover. It’s rare to find a childcare center where the same smiling faces greet your kids every day. This consistency builds trust and comfort for both children and parents.
Primrose has also taught our kids great manners, social skills, and a love for learning. The staff genuinely cares for our children as if they were their own, creating a safe, loving, and structured environment.
If you’re searching for a high-quality daycare or preschool that combines education, care, and character development, Primrose School is the place to be. We couldn’t recommend them more!

Our oldest has been attending Primrose Shady Hollow for 1 year and our youngest for  4 months. Both of them have advanced academically and socially since attending there regularly. They enjoy going every day and sometimes aren’t ready to leave at the end of the day. Staff members are bright, smiling, kind, and patient, when we know the job is challenging. The administrative staff plans organized and well thought out events. We are really thankful to be a part of the Primrose family.

We love it at Primrose. We have a good comparison having been with other private preschools for the last 10 years. They difference is noticeable. It feels like my child is in a school setting, learning at the forefront, versus a day care. I love the centers, cleanliness, teacher to student ratio. The amount of work we get to see brought home. The size of classrooms. Every administrator and teacher is so friendly and it just feels so full of love and care all the time.

Our son has been at Primrose for over 3 years from young toddler up through kindergarten. We have loved Primrose. The teachers, admins, and chefs have all been great with both our son and us. We appreciate the communication we get from the school. Now that my son is in kindergarten, I can see how much and how quickly he is learning and I'm grateful for his time there!

We have two sons, a 3-year-old and a 1-year-old, attending the Primrose School of Shady Hollow, and we couldn't be happier with our experience! Both sons have been here since they were 6 months of age. The teachers are incredibly welcoming and create a nurturing environment that makes both our children feel comfortable. The school's commitment to early education is evident in their well-structured programs and the positive impact it has on our kids' social and intellectual development. We highly recommend Primrose School of Shady Hollow for any parent looking for a trustworthy and enriching daycare and preschool 😊

We been going here every year for their annual pumpkin patch. It’s always fun coming here. Plenty of variety pumpkins to chose from and plenty of picture scenes. They have wagons free to use to move around with your pumpkins and kids. The pumpkins are priced great considering the mini adventure.
Great little pumpkin spot! And for a great cause as well!

We have been members of St. James for about 15 years and it is the perfect church home. The community within the church is welcoming and tight-knit and we have many opportunities throughout the year to serve our broader community, including our annual pumpkin patch, which is a Lake Highlands tradition! We'd love to have you visit and see what's special about St. James.

Wonderful church for worship, fellowship and spiritual formation.  The rector, Father Hurst and associate rector, Father DJ and Deacon Phil are extremely friendly and accessible as well as excellent teachers and spiritual leaders.  The entire staff including youth ministers, director of music, organist and church administrator are superb, kind and caring.  The congregation is very friendly and accepting.  Nice mixture of young families and older worshippers.  Excellent Sunday services and multiple opportunities for Bible study.  Great worship space and facilities.

review_text:
We have been extremely pleased with our experience at Twinkle Wonders School at Rice Ave. The staffs are warm, attentive, and genuinely care about the well-being and development of the children.
What stands out the most is the excellent communication. They keep us informed about daily activities, upcoming events, and any concerns. The facility itself is clean, safe, and filled with engaging activities for kids of all ages.
Our child has flourished here, developing new skills, making friends, and looking forward to every day spent at the daycare. We truly appreciate the efforts of the team at Twinkle Wonders and highly recommend their services to other families!

review_text:

Most importantly, my child absolutely loves going to Twinkle Wonders! every day! Seeing their excitement and growth has been such a joy. I highly recommend this childcare center to any parent looking for a safe, loving, and enriching environment for their little one.

OPERATION_NAME: Twinkle Wonders School At Rice Ave
review_text: I’ve been so impressed with Twinkle Wonders School. From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel welcome and reassured. review_text: Twinkle wonder school of learning at Rice has been a God sent. Our daughter has flourished here, gaining confidence and skills in a nurturing environment. Big thanks to the whole crew for making her early years so enriching and joyful!

Both our kiddos have been with CDC since they were 3-months-old. We have found a great community here with the teachers, directors, and other parents. The social/emotional learning and focus on outdoors/nature is exactly what we wanted for our kids at this age. Our son (now 2-y-o) is adept at using his words to describe his feelings and our daughter (now 4-y-o) is in the "Explorer class" at the NW location where she hikes every day in the fall/winter/spring and swims everyday in the summer. The teachers are each phenomenal - including the saints in the infant class that make the impossible job of dropping off your baby with someone new much easier with their kindness and abundant affection for the babies in their care.

My experience here at Kids ‘R’ Kids Copperfield has been remarkable. My daughter Bella’s teachers, Mrs. Inger and her assistant, Mrs. Dimond, have been an absolute pleasure. Canyon Creek Preschool is an absolute gem! This precious school has been a part of our family's life since 2019 after a chance conversation with a neighbor. My 3YO (at the time) was a late to fully potty train, so I had resigned that we would have to wait another year to start preschool. Our neighbor mentioned that CCP had been willing to work with their 3YO who was also later to potty train. I called, toured, and registered at the school within the week, and we never looked back. Not only were my kids incredibly well-prepared for kindergarten academically, but they were also loved and treasured by the teachers and staff as if they were their own. The teachers (many of them retired past-teachers and many of whom have worked at the school for over a decade) are passionate, loving, and so incredibly knowledgeable and seasoned about what preschoolers need developmentally. My kids were encouraged in their spiritual growth and character development in such a meaningful way. Canyon Creek Preschool really does focus on the development of the whole child, and I cannot emphasize enough what a truly precious, special community exists at this school. I'm endlessly grateful for the love, intention, and care that exists at Canyon Creek throughout the halls.

From the administration through all the teachers and aides, everyone is dedicated to creating a joyful and safe environment for the children. Our sweet girl had several tearful starts to her days at the beginning of the year as this was her first time away from her family. But her teachers loved on her constantly and quickly recognized her natural tendency to be a helper. They nurtured this trait and helped her transition beautifully. My toddler has thrived this past year and now looks forward to school thanks to the dedicated teachers that went above and beyond. Couldn’t be happier with our decision!

My daughter attended Canyon Creek Preschool during the 2016-17 academic year. She is the youngest of my five children, and I've had experience with a number of other preschools in other communities. I've also formerly worked as an educator. Canyon Creek is exceptional. The staff is professional and obviously well-trained in early childhood development. The curriculum and style of instruction are age-appropriate. The class sizes are ideal. The instructional materials are inviting and varied. The building atmosphere is warm and cheerful. Walking through the art-filled hallway to deliver my daughter to class was often a highlight of my day. The staff is friendly, and they are usually at the front door greeting the students and parents as they enter and leave each day. The religious instruction is Christian, but the school is welcoming to families from other religious and non-religious traditions. (Our family is agnostic.) My daughter felt loved at Canyon Creek, and she is now well-prepared to begin kindergarten (letter/sound recognition, writing letters and numbers, social interaction, following instruction and routines, and self-confidence). This school is built on a strong instructional foundation, and yet, despite its professionalism, it has a very warm, neighborly environment that is free from the commercialism of some other preschools. The price is very reasonable and well-worth the investment in your child. I'm grateful that I heard about this gem of a school through word-of-mouth because our experience has been entirely positive. (FWIW: I did not receive any benefits or discounts for posting this review, and I am not personal friends with any of the teachers or staff members.)

**Terrible Experience – Would Not Recommend**

As someone with prior daycare experience, I know what proper childcare should look like. I brought my son here to address an issue, but instead of resolving it, they dismissed my concerns, insisting it didn’t happen at their facility. I paid for a full week but withdrew him after just two days—a complete waste of time and money.

I understand that accidents happen, but honesty and accountability are essential. Instead, I was repeatedly told, *“It didn’t happen here,”* and was denied access to the security cameras. When I expressed my discomfort, I was bluntly told to find another daycare.

To make matters worse, while speaking Spanish with the lady speaking and my husband, a staff member interrupted, insisting we speak English. Already frustrated, I continued speaking Spanish, only for an elderly lady to say, *“ENGLISH please.”* This felt incredibly disrespectful, especially as my husband was nearby and listening.

Beyond this, the facility had an unpleasant odor when I first arrived. I even asked another parent if that was normal, and they confirmed it wasn’t. Cleanliness and organization were clear issues—when I received my child’s “daily sheet,” I saw the lady just casually picking it up off the floor, with no folder or binder in sight.

When I picked up my son for the first time, I was excited to see him but disappointed to find him covered in food, with a dirty face and a full diaper. While that particular staff member seemed kind, this level of neglect was unacceptable.

What alarmed me most was how they handled my crying child in the morning. Rather than offering comfort or engagement—basic expectations in a daycare—they simply told him “No no no no”. This was a major red flag that I wish I had noticed sooner.

To top it off, when I returned to retrieve my diaper bag, I expected everything to be inside. Instead, I had to ask separately for the diapers, which felt like unnecessary disorganization and frustration on top of an already disappointing experience.

Now, I’m left frustrated and unsure if I should take further action. As a mother, I cannot overlook the lack of care, poor communication, and absence of empathy. I strongly advise other parents to look elsewhere for childcare.

My niece attended this daycare for a couple years, and I appreciate the level of care and attention she received. The staff is warm, welcoming, and truly invested in the well-being of every child. They create a fun, safe, and nurturing environment where she feels comfortable.
She’s even returned a couple of times to help with the classes.

I love it here my grand daughter was super happy. The staff are amazing,they treat them as they are them kids. The facility is very clean and perfect, amount of children I would strongly recommend there to any one seeking quality child care for their children.

As a first time mom, A to Z has been good to my son and I. They are very understanding and caring. To have a place and people that actually care for your child is amazing and a blessing at the same time. It makes me feel relax that I can focus at work without having to worry about my son’s safety. They take care of him like their own. A to Z is more like family.

This daycare was a life saver for my son and my family, my son used to go there for 2 yers ,It’s so hard finding childcare that genuinely care about the children and I’m glad I found it . It’s been everything that my family wished for. My son used to go to speech therapy,  struggling with speech delay,  but the teacher and ms. Astar helped him alot , we saw the difference with in few months,  he now first grade and doing very well,  Staff are amazing and gives their best effort. the food is very good , the place is always clean and organized, I well diffnatly recommend this place.

Don’t send your child here unless you want a school that is fun, engaging, and loves your child like family. Absolutely everyone here is so kind and friendly. They love working with kids and it overflows to every aspect of this school. They fill each day with creative and engaging activities for each age group. Sensory, art, fine/gross motor, outside play and lots of reading, singing and dancing. Also they feed kids snack and lunch. Meals are kid-friendly latin american dishes! So many fun special days - water play day each week during summer, special days for holidays, National Pineapple day, and week of the child. Also each year they host a Dia de los Muertos carnival for students and their families! Especially love that they divide infants into mobile and non-mobile so that walkers/crawlers are in different room from the little ones. Older kids do fun projects like running a postal service to collect and deliver valentines and creating art exhibits. Check their social media for other projects! Don’t worry if you as the parent don’t speak Spanish - that is never an issue with communication. And you will find you learn alongside your child!
Our child has had an incredible experience here and we have loved watching her grow and thrive. It has been an honor to be a part of the North Central Pineapple family.

I was fortunate to get to send my son to The Pineapple School and I only have good things to say about the staff and curriculum. The facilities were always clean, all the teachers and staff were always smiling and were always so sweet and helpful. My son was always excited to go to The Pineapple School. One of my favorite memories was when my son was in one of the infant rooms and I could see through the window outside that his teacher was holding him and dancing. They both had big smiles on their faces. My son was very engaged and excited to learn Spanish. I was very blessed to have been able to send my son to this great daycare and would recommend to anyone.

We chose the Pineapple School after a horrible experience at a nearby daycare. There's not one day that goes by that I am not ecstatic and grateful that my daughter can attend the Stone Oak school. Since her first day she has been more social and full of energy. The teacher's there truly love children and it doesn't feel like a daycare facility. It genuinely feels like I'm dropping my child off with a family member, which I know all of my working mother's can appreciate! I have no worries since my daughter started at their campus in Stone Oak, I know my daughter is being taken care of and given the utmost attention that she and every child deserve. It also doesn't hurt they speak in Spanish all day to the little ones. My daughter only speaks English at home and has flourished in her Spanish in just a couple of months. Not only do the teacher's go above and beyond but so do the staff/administrator. I left my phone in my daughter's classroom one afternoon at pick up and the administrator met me near my house so I could pick it up from her! I thought that was incredibly generous. I obviously have nothing but good things to say about this school, I could go on and on. Just know if you pick this school for your little one, you will NOT be disappointed.

Before my husband and I even were married, we talked about how we would send our kids to The Pineapple School when we had them. I knew it would be tough to get in because an early pre-school Spanish immersion program in San Antonio is a hot commodity!

Almost as soon as I found out I was pregnant with our first child, I got on the waiting list. I had a couple of back up centers that we had toured in addition to The Pineapple School lined up just in case. I went to leave the first week's tuition at the first back up place and turned right back around without leaving payment because I just knew that wasn't going to be the right place for my baby. Thankfully, a family member was able to step in as a backup AND a spot opened up at the Stone Oak location just in time.

When we walked in for our first family meeting, I was overwhelmed with confidence that this was definitely the right place for our daughter. Our daughter is now 3, and we also have an infant son enrolled in the program now. They are both thriving!

Friends and family are always impressed with our daughter's vocabulary, annunciation, and overall intelligence, which we know is directly attributable to the immersion program.

I can't say enough about the teachers (maestras) and staff. We all (children included) have loved every single one of them. They make you feel like they are caring for their own children in how they treat your children.

Thank you, Pineapple School! We are so grateful to have access to such an amazing child development program.

For anyone considering this school for your children, I can offer a review and hopefully help you make a decision.  My 5 star review is not only an emotional hurrah, but upon reflection, I realize that the value this school provided will be missed.

*My daughter attended for 3.5 years and my son for 2 years. There is nothing more important to a parent than PEACE OF MIND (emphasis!), and this is what Pineapple gave me.

*The teachers are nothing short of family for your children. There is so much love and nurturing for your child, it must be a cultural thing like another post stated, but I am thankful for it. While the school does follow the required curriculum for Pre-K, it also focuses on creativity and play. This, to me personally, was more important at this formative age. Most of the maestras have degrees in child care, and some with advanced degrees as well. These are the people raising your children when you are not.  I can truly say Pineapple was our second home.

*One of my goals was having them learn Spanish. This can occur better if they are exposed to it daily with conversation and day to day activities, not through tutoring alone. There are full time Spanish immersion programs near my home, but I made a commitment to drive 40 minutes round trip 2x a day for this school.

*The cost of the school was reasonable to me for the service they provide, which includes nutritious snacks and meals cooked fresh daily from a fully staffed kitchen.

*The school is well-maintained, and very clean.  Children are also taught good hygiene habits. This matters come flu season.

Every establishment will have something that you may not agree with, but my experience was that Pineapple's admin made efforts to communicate with parents, hold meetings, even impromptu, and try and resolve any concerns that may have come up. The owners are on site every day, and care about their business very much.

In closing, I can say that if you are fortunate enough to get a spot, grab it! You will find a loving, caring and safe environment for your child to explore and grow! I hope this review has helped you!

We have two kids at KCA (for 3.5 years now) and it's great. We love all the teachers our kids have had and our kids have a great time learning and bonding with their friends. The KCA always feels welcoming, safe and clean. The events KCA puts on are always a great opportunity to meet parents and see the daycare friends our kids tell us so many stories about.

I could not recommend this place more!

I've had both of my kids in CKA from babies to Pre-K and we haver been very impressed with the attention & the education they have been able to provide for our little ones.

They are READING before Kindergarten & my son is 1 of 4 in his kinder class that was accepted into the GT Program. We attribute much to his success from the CKA curriculum and the wonderful teachers there.

This family run academy is so personal and caring. I really love their year around actives that go above and beyond other care centers. Visits from the Fire department, Helicopter tour, Halloween & Christmas parties & Parents-Night-Out! This place is so fun!

Rest assured that your children will be taken good care of here. We have our three year old James who has been here for over the past year, and we had shopped and looked around for various places that we knew were clean, safe, and academically challenging for our pre-kindergarten age child. This is the place and are lucky to obtained a spot here when we did.

I can't express enough how thrilled I am with Country Kids Academy. From the moment we walked in, it was clear that this is a place where children are nurtured and valued. The staff are incredibly warm, attentive, and genuinely invested in the well-being and development of each child. My daughter's teachers were incredibly professional and nice with her.

The facilities are clean, safe, and thoughtfully designed to support various stages of growth. My daughter comes home every day excited to share what she's learned and the fun activities she’s participated in. The communication between the staff and parents is excellent, providing regular updates and creating a strong partnership in my daughter’s early education.

Country Kids Academy has been a fantastic choice for our family, and I highly recommend it to any parent looking for a supportive and enriching environment for their child.

Absolutely love CKA. They love on our children like they were their own. My oldest loves the Director, Mandi, so much! She is so patient with him! We have absolute faith in them to care for our kids. My older son was beyond ready for kindergarten due to their program. He ran mental laps around his peers! They are also working with us to a super high degree with my youngest son’s medical and food needs. They are as close to family as we can get with childcare and education!

I am truly grateful for this daycare center. From day one, the staff has shown nothing but kindness, professionalism, and genuine care for my child. The classrooms are clean, organized, and filled with engaging activities that support learning and creativity. My child looks forward to going every morning and comes home excited to share what they learned.

Communication is excellent—Ms.Victoria in(EPS B) keeps me updated throughout the day and always takes her time to answer any questions. I’ve seen such positive growth in my child socially, emotionally, and academically. It’s clear that the staff loves what they do, and it shows in the way they support each child. I highly recommend this daycare to any parent looking for a safe, nurturing, and enriching environment.

We had both of our children enrolled here over seven years and had a great experience. Ms. Rebecca, the director, runs the center with genuine care and knows every child and family. Mr. Coen was an incredible pre-K teacher—our kids adore him. Many other teachers and staff members made a meaningful impact on our children. It’s clear that the entire team genuinely cares about the kids.

We are so grateful for the love, stability, and support our family received here!

Our family had an excellent experience with La Petite Academy over the course of nearly seven years. From the very beginning, the staff consistently showed genuine care, patience, and love toward our children. Knowing that our kids were in a safe, nurturing environment gave us tremendous peace of mind as working parents.

The teachers and staff go above and beyond to make every child feel supported and seen, while maintaining a strong focus on safety and structure. We are incredibly grateful for the relationships built and the foundation La Petite helped provide for our children during their early years. I would highly recommend this center to any family looking for a caring, dependable, run well by the Director, Rebecca.

I love this daycare, everytime I walk in I'm greeted positively and warmly from different staff members. I watch the cameras daily, and see my child's teacher comfort my child and do different activities with them throughout the day. I cannot speak more highly of this center. I'm not sure what these other reviews are about, but I don't feel like it accurately comes close to describing this center or the staff. Coming from a family that has been with this La Petite for 3 years, I can tell you this is a wonderful location with great management!! We will also be bringing our second child there in the spring, we love being a La Petite Family!

I have had positive experiences at this location. The infant teachers were always attentive to my son and he always had a smile on his face when seeing them. Before my  daughter went to school she was in the prek room and she was always excited to go! She loved being in there and looked forward to going to care

Finding this day care has been such a blessing to us. We have tried multiple day cares in the area and have been very impressed and satisfied since our daughter has started here. They teach her many things and make sure she is advancing well with her age group. No complaints and hands down best daycare in the area!!
Staff are very kind and kids have grown tremendously since being enrolled. Exceptional

It’s unfortunate to read the poor reviews by people who are focused on retaliation for cost. If the place is too much that is okay to try elsewhere without these hurtful comments to a small business. This place is modest and doesn’t have the bells and whistles but they have been in business for a while and my daughter feels at ease there when she started attending 2 months ago. I will also add my daughter was living at home only her first 1.5 years and since attending has not gotten sick which many parents deal with at other schools.

This is an outstanding daycare! Our little one loves attending this location daily; whenever we get her a new toy, she gets excited about the idea of bringing it to show-and-tell (every Friday). The teachers are excellent at their job and the school is always clean and organized. Expect beautiful little crafts on holidays (we recently got a Mother's Day gift). We highly recommend this place! My 3yo daughter has been attending this daycare for almost a year now and we are both happy and grateful for the service we are receiving. Since joining, my little one has improved her vocabulary, learned to share and take turns, participated in a play while dressed like an angel, created multiple crafts, and celebrated her birthday. Amazing daycare!

My daughter and I toured all the daycares near the Medical Center.  We found many facilities, ranging from small to very large, and many were quite expensive. We initially enrolled our daughter in a large center, but we were heartbroken to see her crying every morning. The problem stemmed from the constantly changing teachers and the large class sizes (12 or more children).

Sheridan Montessori is different. It's a small facility with a home-like atmosphere and small class sizes. The teachers, Ms. Eunice, Ms. GiGi, and Ms. Rodriguez, have years of experience and truly know each child. We are so happy to have found this school!

We also appreciate that our daughter can bring food from home. This allows us to ensure she enjoys her meals and eats healthy food.

I wholeheartedly recommend Sheridan Montessori. My perspective comes from the experience of being a parent with a child enrolled at the school, not just from a one-time visit. Five stars!

I wish I could give them zero star for making my baby (6 months old) cry all day.. one of the teacher (Ms. Gige) there is so rude and lazy that she told me “I am not going to exhaust myself for your baby’s requirements.” She wanted to take personal decisions for my baby and asked me to change the paediatrician.. they don’t have cameras so you never know how your baby is doing and in the end they can say whatever they want.. they flipped from their words every time.. they agreed to reimburse the rest of the money and next day refused to do so.. on the top of that they cooked up a new rate chart overnight without any prior notice and dared to ask for more money even if we are not sending our baby to them. My grandson has attended Tiger Lily for 3 years. I pick him up at school and I get to see the kids happily engaged with Marie and Lulu guiding and supporting them. Tiger Lily is a place of joyful camaraderie. The school building and the outdoor play area are magical. Marie and Lulu have so many imaginative and creative activities and the kids learn to be independent and to be part of the Tiger Lily community.

Tigerlily is everything I could have hoped for in a preschool. Marie & Lulu put so much thought and care into every aspect of the school. I wholeheartedly recommend Tigerlily to anyone looking for a creative, nurturing, outdoorsy school for their little one.

Both my kids love it there, my son been going since he was 1 they helped me with potty training and he's also gets speech therapy as well  and my daughter since 1 month, they help them so much with learning and teaching them many things and they just make them feel so loved! My kids always have a great day there.

Amazing staff with so much heart and caring mindset. It’s wonderful seeing my children get excited about going to daycare here. I really recommend them to any family looking for childcare.

My oldest son is now 14, and started Ragratz when he was 4. I absolutely love the staff, and every single one of these employees, have my trust. My niece was going to this daycare not even 2 weeks and miss Rodriguez scratched and bruised her where you can tell she was picking up my niece by one arm grabbing her with force causing an Indian burn on her forarm and under her armpit. Miss Rodriguez is still working there and management does not care of the situation or when cops were called you can definitely tell by all the works attitudes that’s I’m most likely not the first parent to complain about and issue like this. If I can give no stars I would. This place needs to be shut down

The check in process was mostly seamless, except I had her immunization records by email but they wouldn't accept it that way and also didn't have printer capabilities, so I had to leave and go to the print store then bring it back. There is a $45 annual fee that has to be paid on the first visit, then about $10 an hour. The facility itself was just okay.

I dropped off at 09:30 and picked up early by 11. My daughter was actively playing with a toy and kept doing so, I asked if she wanted to stay longer or go now, she wanted to go - which is rare if she is truly enjoying herself. Once in the car I asked how it was (she is only 4 1/2 but we have an established communication and she very often shares about her day anywhere - school, church, friends visits, etc) She said they were yelling too much, at her and the other kids, and that one of the teachers grabbed something out of her hand. She is used to gentle environments and more nurturing care. I'll give the benefit of the doubt because I did not go back in and speak to them, but it was a moot point to because I know my child is very truthful and vocal to me about safety and comfort. She did communicate that she was safe overall.
The women seemed nice towards me, but the parent watching vs. not is always different. Everyone, please talk to your kids especially after an unfamiliar environment.

Ultimately it was an expensive failed trial visit, I paid nearly $60 for an hour 1/2 essentially,  as my daughter said she does not want to come back ever.

This review is not to bash the establishment, but to inform other parents. Hopefully the owners understand the importance of properly trained staff suitable to care for children.
We had an appointment at the USCIS center nearby and decided to leave our son here for a few hours. He enjoyed his time there and didn't miss us at all! Great facility with friendly folks

Enrolled like two months ago because I need to have a back up in case of an emergency. The girls who work there were very polite, and overall the space is more than adequate for a drop in

It took me a while to write this review because I wanted to make sure what I had to say was true. First every time I call or spoke to someone they do not speak English. I also noticed she would come home with random cuts and scratches which they apparently knew nothing about. My last straw was her last day. My daughter has been going here for a month now, just a few days a week. We haven't had a single problem with them. The teachers are very nice and good with her. We’ve had a great experience at Kids R People 2 Academy. The staff is caring and you can tell they really take the time to get to know the kids and families.

This daycare has been great for me and my child. He enjoys going and is learning from the teachers and activities they participate in. I enjoy the staff. They are all super friendly and helpful. We’ve had a wonderful experience at Kids R People 2 Academy. The teachers are caring and attentive, and Director Mrs. Felicia leads with genuine passion and structure. My child had been attending this daycare since August 2021 till now. My child had special accommodations and the daycare went far and beyond to meet them. I love this place, my children who are 12 and 8 now have been going here for the last 3 years since we moved to Houston and I have never had an issue with them. I’ve been using this particular AKP location for 3+ years now, and my child loves going to there. We have only had one minor  incident, and I was notified immediately. I highly recommend taking advantage of this establishment of you want a safe, fun and nurturing environment for your precious little ones while you are away from them.

My son absolutely loves Adventure Kids Playcare! He goes during school breaks and some Saturdays, and every time he comes home talking about how much fun he had. The staff are so kind, welcoming, and attentive , it’s clear they really enjoy what they do. I appreciate having a safe, fun place for him to go where he can play, make friends, and look forward to coming back. Highly recommend for any parent needing reliable and engaging childcare

With four kids, we’re constantly trying to find babysitters and dealing with last-minute childcare needs. Adventure Kids Play Care  has become a consistent and dependable  childcare option for our family and my kids of all ages really love going!

OPERATION_NAME: Wells Branch YMCA of Central Texas
review_text:
My son began at Wells Branch three years ago in Pre-K, and at that time, the experience was fantastic. The teachers, staff, and overall environment were supportive, and I felt confident in the school's ability to provide my child with the education and care he needed. Unfortunately, the experience has changed significantly since then.

In the following year, there was a noticeable lack of stability among the staff, including the office staff and the principal. This instability has continued to affect the school environment, and it seems to have worsened over time. This year, for example, my child’s classroom teacher resigned at the end of August, and the position has remained unfilled since then. As a result, my child has had multiple substitute teachers with no consistent leadership in the classroom. There has been zero communication with families about the ongoing situation.

As a parent of a child with special needs, I reached out to the school principal with my concerns, but it took a week to receive a response, which was merely an apology for the inconvenience. While I appreciate the acknowledgment, the lack of follow-up or any substantive action is deeply concerning.

More recently, I learned of a serious incident involving a Special Education employee. When I picked my child up from after-school care—provided by a third-party organization on school premises—the after-school program leader shared a troubling report. She had witnessed a school Special Education staff member speaking to my child in a demeaning and disrespectful manner, even physically forcing him as a form of punishment. According to the leader, the SPED employee instructed the after-school staff to "make him do things, not ask him," and to isolate him so he could "learn." This behavior is unacceptable and deeply concerning, especially in an environment that should prioritize the safety and dignity of every child.

I emailed the principal immediately about this alarming situation, and while I did receive a response stating that an investigation would take place, I have not heard anything further since then. The lack of transparency and follow-through on such a serious issue is simply not acceptable.

As a result of these ongoing concerns for my child's safety and well-being, I made the difficult decision to withdraw him from the school. It is heartbreaking that we have come to this point, but I cannot, in good conscience, continue to send my child to a school where I no longer feel his needs are being met or that his safety is guaranteed.

I am sharing this experience with the community because I believe it is important for others to be aware of the challenges our school is facing. As a mother and as a member of this community, I am deeply worried about the future of this school and the impact it is having on the children who attend.
