My only negative comments are that they watch a little more TV than I would like. Also, I think the curriculum could be a little more dynamic. (It's more coloring and worksheet based.) Our child actually loves these activities because they involve coloring, cutting and pasting, and other find motor skills. It's a lot like arts and crafts. However, I do wish there were a couple more activities that integrated other forms of education like water based learning, show and tell, and other sensory play.

That being said, I would highly recommend DKA to any parent who wants their child to grow, thrive, and play all day long. There is an easiness at the school, amongst the staff, and in the halls. The classrooms are diverse. The staff is always willing to hear my feedback and most important of all our child is HAPPY, CURIOUS, and HAVING FUN. Thanks DKA for taking care our our baby!

OPERATION_NAME: Discovery Kids Academy of Greater Houston
review_text: My DD and DS enrolled this daycare from the primary of 2022. They love to go to daycare and have a great time there. Even though its tiny but The children also have enough outside time.And the staff are very nice and they love the children. My DD has enrolled in Pre-K last year, Last summer, we sent her there and had a great time every day. In my opinion, its a good choice to sent children here if you have tight time and wallet.

OPERATION_NAME: King of Kings Child Care Center
review_text: I was married at King of Kings 24 years ago.  We blended our families that day, five daughters.  Two of those daughters were baptized at KOK and one was married there as well.  I officially joined the church in November of 2023, right at the end of COVID.  What made me take the plunge and convert to LCMS at KOK?  Like a great deal of returning Christians, it was due to a personal trauma in my life, but really it was due to the Holy Spirit bringing me back to the church. Through Pastor Schmidt, I felt the calling to come back.  KOK is a Gospel based church where we study the Bible and live by the words.  The emphasis is on faith and belief.  KOK  has recently celebrated 50 years. Our church offers bible studies, Sunday school, kids' church, youth groups, day care, and many more opportunities to practice our faith.  Our church maintains a large food bank for the community.  There are opportunities at KOK to participate in church activities daily.  So, if you are looking for a home to practice liturgy-based faith, give our church a try.  KOK offers both traditional and contemporary services on Sundays.

OPERATION_NAME: King of Kings Child Care Center
review_text:
Honestly sad I have to write this review but I feel like it’s needed.
DO NOT become a member here unless you plan on coming to church EVERY SINGLE SUNDAY.
I was a member here for 27yrs…. I was here before the pastor ever was. & they KICKED ME OUT OF THE CHURCH.
They claimed it’s bc I “missed to many services” but in reality I know it’s because I have multiple kids out of wedlock. So if you got that , also STAY CLEAR bc they absolutely WILL judge you. Matter of fact I have physical proof it was an “issue” for them in a message from the pastor himself. Which is insane to for a church to judge & kick someone out over when they allow people who are currently on drugs, have STALKING charges & some absolutely INSANE charges against them into the church. But hey you’re a dollar sign to them. That’s all they care about here.
If you want your kids to be in a good children’s program (on Sundays) yeahhh um this ISNT THE PLACE. There is no Sunday school for kids, there’s almost no effort put into the children at this church.
I grew up in this church, even had 5 kids baptized here. But I’m glad we’ve found a church that accepts ALLof us & has a very involved area for children!
This church sank when pastor Doria left. & unfortunately I don’t think it will ever get back to being that way unless they bring younger people in for the kids & younger people who need to plan things & do things for the church.

Sad to see this is what it came to, but so glad it opened my eyes to see how judgmental this church could be,
There are some amazing members here, but that’s about it.

OPERATION_NAME: King of Kings Child Care Center
review_text:
What can I say about this church? The upgraded Sanctuary is beautiful and accommodates my mobility scooter.

My son recently attended the National Youth Gathering and had a blast. The Youth leaders have been wonderful and it is exciting to see the youth group growing.

OPERATION_NAME: King of Kings Child Care Center
review_text: A warm, welcoming church that worships God by strong teaching of the Word of God, Christian centered worship and loving fellowship. Also a Texas Rising Star superior rated daycare and child development center located on site.

OPERATION_NAME: King of Kings Child Care Center
review_text: My experience is with the early childhood development center. I have both friends and family who referred this place to me and was so grateful that there was an opening around the time I was returning to work. They have worked with me through It all :-) each member of the staff has shown me a high level of professionalism and genuine care. This is my first child so we have started him in the infant/"guppies" classroom and fully intend to keep him with their services as long as possible! I feel that he is safe, well looked after, and loved. The team cares about his milestones from a very young age and work with him. The team is available to answer any questions I may have, at any time, and they communicate exceptionally well. There are charts used to document when he gets fed, when he has his diaper changed, and any other special notices. They send pictures, and do little arts and crafts to include the parents. Overall I could not be more content with this faith-based organization!! With all my love.

I highly recommend Space City Child Care to any parent looking for a safe and caring place for their child which is also 24 hours. From the moment we started, the staff made us feel welcome and comfortable. The teachers are patient, kind, and truly care about the children and their development. It’s clear that they take the time to get to know each child and make sure they feel supported and happy even through behavioral issues.

The environment is always clean, organized, and safe, which gives me peace of mind as a parent especially coming from the reviews the reviews are a complete false look for the business because my child and I have never experienced any of those behaviors or accusations from the center or staff. I also appreciate how they focus on both learning and play, helping the kids grow socially, emotionally, and academically. My child enjoys going every day and often talks about the fun activities, and friends he has made.

Communication with parents is also great. The owner Ms.Tiara Smith keeps us updated and is always willing to answer questions or address any concerns. Knowing that my child is in a positive and nurturing environment means so much to me. I’m very grateful for the care and dedication the team shows every day. This daycare truly feels like a second home for my child. So please give them a chance you won't regret it⭐😊

it’s a amazing 24hr daycare , we should appreciate the teachers because the majority of the parents know exactly  it’s not easy. half of these negative reviews are parents who left without paying the amount they owed or would be pressed once the daycare would no longer be available due to balance due. half of these negative comments are parents who bring they kids monday -sunday but we all know space city childcare does and will forever do our best to keep the kids comfortable with us .

This daycare is heaven sent! It is difficult to find a daycare that is trustworthy and opened beyond the traditional 6am - 6pm, and I am so fortunate to have found Space City. I switched my girls to this daycare after my work schedule changed to evenings.

My girls have been attending Space City for almost a year, and I have no complaints. I saw other reviews stating that staff changes every day, and it is incorrect. I see the same ladies all the time, and yes, they know my girls. The daycare is always clean and very secure. I see the Director several times a week, and I don't see why it matters if she is not in the office everyday. I am not a needy parent, and when I submit questions via the online portal, she responds promptly.

Absolutely disgusting! My lil cousin went there and the oversized worker Ms.H had him sleeping on the cold BARE floor with tiny black bugs and roaches and food crumbs that has been accumulated over time. This teacher is aggressive and has touched him not once but twice by dragging him by the shirt like a rag doll. If you don’t want you kid being treated like a grown man DO NOTTT send them here.

Also they starve the kids and have the sleep for practically the whole time. This horrid service is not worth the money you’d pay for.

Space City Childcare offers a much needed service to those of us who need childcare at non-traditional hours. I have seen a lot of growth in my child in the 8 months he has attended. Mrs.T (owner) is very kind, considerate and personable. Over the summer she offered a lot of fun experiences and activities for the kids that I thought was awesome. Ms.Tina has been so helpful and caring. When I have any concerns they are open to hearing me out, and have truly offered reassurance. I really admire the whole team, childcare isn’t easy. Not only is it hard work, but it takes an unlimited amount of patience, empathy, and understanding. I truly believe that they care about the safety and well being of the children.

I recommend Tanglewood academy to parent who are looking for great academy as well as social skills. Both of my kids went to Tanglewood Academy, it is the best school.
My kids have progress very well in their academy but the best of all they are having fun. They love to go their school their teachers are helpful not just to kids but me as well.
Great before and after school care options, very flexible wanting to help the kids as well as working parents.
I like this academy and the staff is very nice and helpful. My son and daughter in this academy.

The teachers are nice. My kiddo loves them. Her 1st day she was scared, 2nd not a tear and by the 3rd day she was asking if I was ready to go because she wanted to go to school. My little one has learned so much. Great job Teachers.
Good daycare with plenty of great teachers. A good mix of fun and learning for the little ones. A little dominated by Indian population.
One of the best private school I have ever encountered. A must believe me. Get on the waiting list very difficult to get into this school. One of a kind.

Kidz Unlimited provides a family oriented experience that leaves you at ease. You get updates as the day progresses with cute little pictures to fill up your storage. They provide a curriculum catered to all ages. Please be prepared for all the crafts going home.You can guarantee your child will be leaving here learning something.

My baby was a little over 1 so he was14 months once he start here and my baby teacher is doing a wonderful job he turning 2 and June and can already talk and also sign language!!!!!! I love the staff so professional

If you are interested in a daycare with a curriculum for your children that is evidence based, this is the daycare you should be sending your children to. If you need resources or therapy for your child, this is the daycare for you. If you are lost and need a daycare home, a daycare that will love and mentally pour into your child, this is the daycare for you. If you are looking for professional and family oriented engagements, this is the daycare for you.

O my gosh ppl this daycare is the BEST in Ft Worth . I don’t care if u are on the East side ,south, SW , side this is a daycare that gives there all to the kids and parents . When u walk though the door you will get greeted you may not know where the voice is coming from but you and your kids will feel welcome . I TOTAL RECOMMEND you try this daycare for your kids if you really love them like I love mines. They go over and beyond all types of behavior and attitude they will work with your kids .  They have worked really great with my kids and all there attitude.  This daycare do evens a whole with the kids and families try them you will not be disappointed. I am very blessed, happy and excited and my kids are to .

I don't think if I went anywhere else I would be happy with the level of childcare because Kidz Unlimited have been amazing. They show so much love to our baby girl. My baby has been there since she was 6 months old and she loves going to daycare. She has an amazing teacher and she learns so much every day. If you want high quality care for your children please inquire.

OPERATION_NAME: Future Stars operated by La Petite Academy
review_text:
We have had such a wonderful experience with this daycare! One of the first things that stood out to us was how secure the facility is — from the controlled entry to the clear safety procedures, we  feel confident that our daughter is safe and well cared for.

The teachers and administrative staff are truly exceptional. They are warm, attentive, and genuinely invested in the kids' well-being and development. The picture updates I receive throughout the day always put a smile on my face.

Our daughter’s transition into daycare was much smoother than we expected, thanks to the patience and reassurance from the staff. They made both her and us feel comfortable from day one.

We are so grateful to have found such a nurturing, safe, and supportive environment for our little one!

OPERATION_NAME: Future Stars operated by La Petite Academy
review_text: It’s not always easy to leave your child in the care of others but I can truly say that Future stars made it very easy for me and my little one to adjust. From administration all the way down to the teachers. Everyone is truly amazing and shows patience with the children! The real time updates throughout the day are so reassuring and allows you to see how your baby is doing. The teachers are so engaging. They not only supervise the children but are very hands on with them in activities. The director Tameka is very thorough and has done a great Job building her team. Vanessa Hernandez is truly an angel and meets the children exactly where they are. My son is a picky eater and she’s always encouraging him to try new things. we can’t thank this center enough for taking care of our precious toddler.

OPERATION_NAME: Future Stars operated by La Petite Academy
review_text:
I love this facility. They are situated in a very tightly secured environment, I always feel at ease whenever I drop off my son there.   The children have very spacious indoor and outdoor playgrounds.
The classrooms and hallways are perpetually  clean and very beautifully decorated.
The director and  teachers are very friendly and welcoming. They bond very well with all the children even the infants.
I am quite impressed by the efforts the director and her team are putting in to ensure consistency in the management, communication and cleanliness of the facility.
The children are always looking very healthy, happy and excited, everytime i see them..
I can confidently say that they have made a great impact on  my son's learning curve for the two yeas plus, we have been with the school.🤩😍

OPERATION_NAME: Future Stars operated by La Petite Academy
review_text:
The security at this location is such a peace of mind and is like no other. After passing through the security guard tower there is a secure pin for the main door as well.
The moment you walk in you are greeted with a smile and a family style “how are you doing today”? A smooth check in and you’re able to walk your child to their class. Not the usually drop off at front desk and then you must leave.
We had a rough start at the beginning as would any child that has never been to daycare at the age of two. The staff have developed a personal relationship with my child. Vanessa Walton and Vanessa Hernandez are amazing with our two year old. The daycare itself can use updating according to some opinions but why fix something that’s not broken? The curriculum is stimulating and the indoor out door play is very beneficial. They even have different varieties of foods especially vegetables, so your child isn’t eating the same thing over and over. If you want strong security and caring staff I would recommend Future Stars that is operated by La Petit Academy.

OPERATION_NAME: Future Stars operated by La Petite Academy
review_text:
My son has been going here for almost two years now. I could not say anything bad about this center. We have loved it since the day he started and we love Mrs.Sherrie, THE BEST teacher ever. She has helped me with my son so much. As far as, potty training,  reading , overall learning & etc.
The staff are always friendly and always show my son & other kids as well so much love and the best part about this center I get updated pictures throughout the day , what he eats , when he uses the restroom and when he goes to sleep ! couldn’t be more thankful for this center and the memories we have made along the way.

I sent my grandchild to Heavenly Hands Day Care and she was so happy and felt so welcome. She would ask on weekends could she go back. She definitely will be school ready when it's time to go because she's learning so much. Thank you so much HEAVENLY HANDS!!!

I love heavenly hands sooo much. My son have been here for two years and the growth in him is noticeable. He love going. This is the only place I can leave him without him crying behind me as I leave. We will not be going anywhere else
Heavenly hands is filled with great learning activities, smiling faces, and little friends. My children love going they have made new friends and learned so many new things along the way.

This is a very friendly and nice facility my daughter really enjoys going here the staff is awesome The children learn so much and enjoy it what 2 year olds know they whole birthday they do so what are you waiting for

You know when you have a good day when it's time to pick your child up everyday he  doesn't want  to leave and on weekends  he ask I'm  going to school today.... Thank you for  having time and patience  with our kids  they love their daydaycare....
I have no problems with my daycare Thank you Heavenly 👐

Our experience with Montessori School on Camp Bowie has been nothing short of extraordinary. From the moment we enrolled our daughters, we knew we had found a nurturing and inspiring environment for their education and personal growth.

Academically, the progress our daughters have made is remarkable. The Montessori approach fosters independence, curiosity, and a love for learning, and we've seen these qualities flourish in our children. They've developed a deep understanding of various subjects, thanks to the hands-on learning experiences provided by the dedicated teachers.

Equally important is the emotional growth we've witnessed. The supportive atmosphere at MSCB has allowed our daughters to build confidence, resilience, and empathy. They've learned to express themselves creatively and communicate effectively, skills that will serve them well throughout their lives.

One of the most rewarding aspects has been seeing our daughters' enthusiasm for school. They genuinely look forward to each day, eager to explore new ideas and engage with their peers. The friendships they've formed extend far beyond the classroom, creating a sense of community that enriches their overall experience.

In short, Montessori School on Camp Bowie has played a pivotal role in shaping our daughters into lifelong learners and compassionate individuals. We couldn't be happier with our decision to entrust their education to such a remarkable institution.

My son started attending MSCB when he was 18 months old. I have watched him grow not only intellectually but emotionally and socially as well. The teachers at this school are kind and patient and take time to know your child.

The teachers here were an integral part in helping us potty training our toddler. They were patient with him while he was learning and always provided helpful feedback and things we could be doing at home to help him be more successful.

He has learned so much in a short period of time. I've noticed things he does at home that I know came from this school. He is learning to become an independent and responsible child. And I can't wait to watch him to continue to thrive here.

We are excited to have our younger child start school here in the fall.

We can’t tell you enough how much we love MSCB. Our close friends suggested MSCB so we decided to give it a shot. I was a little bit skeptical of the Montessori method at first.

All my doubts and speculations were literally out the window on day 2 of picking up our son from his second day of school 1 year ago.

Our son has learned so much in such a short amount of time. The transformation happened so fast! It was almost unreal! The teachers and staff at MSCB have become family. They love our children so much.

Our son doesn’t leaving us like most toddlers don't, so it makes morning drop-offs a little difficult sometimes, but the moment he sees his teachers, everything changes. When we pick him up from school, he doesn’t want to leave.

Our son is 2.5 years old now; he learned to count to 20 on his own by 20 months. He is so much more advanced than our friend’s children in normal daycare programs.

His teachers have taught him about animals I don’t even know the names of 🤣.

This kid is outsmarting us and it’s all because of our MSCB family.

Thank you, Ms. Emily, Ms. Nancy, Ms. Rachel, Ms. Nora, and Ms. Judy and MSCB for all that you guys do for our children!

We have had the wonderful opportunity to enroll both our children at MSCB. The staff are loving, attentive, and care deeply about the well-being of the kiddos in their care. The director is no exception. We love Ms Rachel and are so thankful for her presence in our children's growth.

MSCB is a top-notch preschool program that enriches the whole child.  Not only do they provide a tailored education to each student, but their attentive teachers also create a loving family environment that is a home away from home.  I am sad that my daughter will be graduating from their program this May, but the three years she has spent here have been integral to her education, social skills, physicality, and independence.  The school offers lessons in Spanish, French, Yoga, and Music in addition to the classic Montessori work where the children learn to learn by discovering a love of language, math, art, and science, all while striving for independence and gaining the confidence to be big kids.  My daughter’s favorite class days are when she is assigned snack day and gets to pass out the snack.  She looks forward to monthly pizza Fridays and show and tell.  Birthdays are a special event at MSCB.  The Birthday Boy or Girl gets to pass out a special birthday snack and they are celebrated by the entire class.  But the event that makes my heart swell the most every year is the holiday bizarre where the children make Christmas ornaments and crafts.  The parents are invited to come and buy the gifts from the children who sell them.  The money is divided up and sent home with each family so the child can buy a gift that is donated to the fire department to be given to a child in need.

MSCB encourages classroom involvement from parents.  This school holds class observations for the parents to come and see the Montessori magic.  It is so amazing to see so many very young children concentrating on something they are working on intently on the floor.  Because Montessori education does not offer typical letter grades, the school provides conferences for the parents to understand their child’s progress with milestones and education.  They also offer a summer school semester that is helpful for working parents in addition to after and before care.  My daughter loves Mrs. Rabiya so much that one summer when Mrs. Rabiya went on vacation, my daughter asked if we could bake her cookies to try to convince her not to leave again.

The school has creative and fun events the kids look forward to every year.  They have two picnics at Sanguinet Park and the children absolutely love seeing their friends outside of a normal school day.  They do a Spring Performance every year and my daughter does not like to get up in front of people.  Her first performance she got scared and ran to me in the audience.  The second one, she dutifully did her part.  The third one was very special because her teacher knows she can read and creatively found a way to let her be a part of the performance in a way that wouldn’t give her so much stage fright.  She gave her the part of the narrator.  She didn’t have to act, she just had to read the nursery rhyme.  With her nose in the book, she was able to perform without being nervous and still be a part of the play.  For a teacher to come up with a creative solution to include her required knowledge of the student, patience, love, understanding, and ingenuity.

I will never forget the first time I went to the school for the initial meet before filling out the application.  My daughter ran and hid behind the curtains because she was so shy.  The director just smiled and said, “If she comes to this school, I guess we will need to buy extra curtains.”  That’s when I know we had finally found the right pre-school.  Since then, my daughter has learned to read, has learned counting and writing numbers to 100, can say phrases in Spanish and French, has learned about other countries, teaches me yoga dragon breath and airplane pose, has learned dozens of songs, has learned to make friends, and has opened up in a way I never thought possible for my child who hid behind curtains.  It has been a privilege for her to learn from the teachers at this school during the most crucial part of her brain development.  This is an excellent school and I’m proud my family is a part of it.

Both my boys have enjoyed their time here. The teachers have always been accommodating and welcoming to my children. I have always felt safe leaving my kids in their hands, and the Christian  environment is a plus.
As a working mom in medical, their hours fit my schedule perfectly, and they offer after-school, summer daycare programs, and holiday break daycare hours.

I read some of the other reviews and my family has had a completely different experience. This Learning Center was recommended by a friend and I chose it because of its location, the price, operation times, and the staff.

We sent all three of our kids there last year (infant, 3 y/o, and 4 y/o) and they loved it. In fact my 4 y/o would pout if he was picked up early because he wanted to play with friends.

In my experience, the staff communicates effectively. They always call and if they can’t reach me they call my husband. They are also thoughtful. When my daughter transitioned to a different class her teacher gave her a gift and when my kids were out due to illness they still received seasonal gifts and pictures from friends. Every morning my kids are greeted and the drop off/ pick up isn’t difficult.

I have unfortunately had terrible experiences at other Learning Centers (my daughter was physically abused) and our experience here has been nothing but positive and completely different.

My daughter has attended WHLC since she was 1, she’s now 5 & getting ready to start kinder. Our family is so thankful for the WHLC staff for all they’ve done for our daughter. From potty training (early), teaching her social and development skills and especially growing her faith in Christ. The summer program was especially wonderful, all the fun activities they planned for her class made it exciting & our daughter always looked forward to going. We can’t thank this daycare enough. THANK YOU THANK YOU! This learning center is HIGHLY recommended.

We have had all our 3 boys there for 14 years now from babies/toddlers -- daycare and summer camp.  Directors and staff are always so nice, attentive, caring, organized, clean and accommodating.  We cherish the years and look forward to some more.  Rebecca and Samantha run the place great :) !!

I am appalled at the director here, Ms. Darla. I can’t even begin to tell you how rude and unprofessional she is! My kid is 5 years old and has been going to this daycare for almost a year. She got in trouble TWICE and they kicked her out! After discussing with her that she was diagnosed ADHD, she seemed to just shrug it off and say “we can’t have her here any longer for safety reasons.” Mind you my child is FIVE. She was not hurting anyone simply having an outburst because a teacher upset her (which is completely normal for a FIVE year old). When I told Darla that I felt my kid was not receiving support, she said “we tried lots of things” which I find hard to believe as she couldn’t provide examples. Then when we discussed her coming back next year I was told “oh absolutely we could try again once you STRAIGHTEN HER OUT” this had my jaw on the floor! Who says that about a CHILD?! What kind of professional ADULT speaks like that regarding a child with an active behavioral diagnosis?!
I wish I had known earlier how many people had issues with this facility but if you can find somewhere else for your child to go…PLEASE do that!
Zero stars, please do not leave your children there. I went to look for information and they were mistreating a child, they were hitting him and many children were crying...
Excellent

We ADORE Elements! Both of my kids have gone there for several years, my youngest from 18 months up to pre-K. The director Jessica, and all the teachers are so patient, kind and really strive to SEE your kids, meet them where they are and help them flourish. It's a really peaceful environment and I really have appreciated their flexibility with us doing part time and sometimes needing to add extra days, etc. They focus on kindness and inclusion which is exactly want for our kiddos at this tender age.  This school is a true little gem and I am forever thankful for them!!

We have had only great experiences at Elements. The Director Jessica is really lovely and kindly took in my twins when another school suddenly closed. The space is very clean and cute with a wonderful outdoor play area. My kids have lots of fun there, which makes everything easier as a parent, and they have been coming home talking about their art projects and the things they learn about nature and science. There was even a teacher who did Mandarin Chinese story time with them!

They are off to kindergarten now, but if they were not, we would keep them at element another year. Highly recommend!

What a gem in the neighborhood!  Our son went to Elements for a year prior to enrolling him in PreK-4 at AISD and we couldn't have been happier!   He had already been at another preschool prior to enrolling him at Elements and he really blossomed and came out of his shell while at Elements.  He really enjoyed his time there.  The staff were very friendly and accommodating.  Our son has a nut allergy and they accommodated it with utmost care and professionalism.  We were kept up-to-date with what they were doing (like what art projects they were working on, or science topics, etc.) each day via the Tadpoles app.  Overall, it was a great experience for us and our son!

My daughter is now a kindergartener,  but we still couldn't miss Elements preschool open house,  when we heard about it. The school is founded by the people whom I trusted with my child's preschool education,  and it greatly paid off. The whole team is exceptional. They're experienced,  passionate about what they do,  very knowledgeable,  and loving educators. We couldn't miss the event. The school is very conveniently located in Central Austin. The building itself is very clean,  bright from all the sunlight coming through the windows,  and catered to low teacher to students ratio. The outside area is essentially a very big backyard with many trees that provide shade,  toys and other fun things to do. It is all surrounded by a fence, and gated so kids will be nice and safe during their outdoors play time.
School will offer a science based curriculum,  which is very exciting.  I know my daughter always loved hands on learning, and fun experiments that introduced her to the fun of doing science,  challenged her inquisitive mind,  and taught her to ask the right questions.
The school looks great, my daughter wishes she could go there,  but it's elementary school for us, now.

We loved our experience at HTPDS. The teachers and director showed so much love from the teachings to the planned out monthly calendar of how to celebrate each day. The food was so creative and we loved the stories our daughter would come home to share. She still brings up her friends and her teachers! Thank you for all you have done for our kids.

My family started at HTPDS 3 years ago and it has been nothing short of a God send! Many of the staff have become like family and I know without a doubt that my children are in good hands when left in their care. Countless times I've seen the staff go above and beyond not only for my children, but others as well. I would absolutely recommend this daycare center to anyone looking for a safe, fun and easy going place for their children to go.

My son has been going to HTPDS since he was 18 months old and he just graduated Pre-K today! He is always excited to go to school and almost runs into the classroom. The teachers at HTPDS have been wonderful and very patient with my wild child. They definitely know that kids are kids but also set good boundaries that have allowed my son to thrive. They also have small class sizes resulting in much more one on one attention. We will surely miss the day school next year when my son starts kindergarten but he is now well prepared.

OMG GUYS This is an Amazing day school center  the Staff is so nice and attentive to all the children’s needs. Very communicative we have ages from infants to 5 year olds. We are very hands on with the children. Classes always have small group sizes. We also do chapel with the children. Omg and the playground is amazing they have 4 different areas for children's ages. Come take a look at this hidden gem.

We absolutely LOVE HTPDS. Our kiddo is so loved and cared for. We came after a not great experience at a different facility, and we were welcomed with arms wide open! Our baby has made so much progress and we are forever grateful for HTPDS!

Little did we know that when we brought our son to Let It Shine 3 years ago that it would become an integral part of our family and community. Our little 3 year old could not walk when he first started and Teresa and her team were always there for creative solutions to integrate him into the class. They are always creative, sensitive, and inclusive to each child's needs. Our son has thrived at this school! He went in with a smile and came out laughing and loving his school. The team goes above and beyond to make this school so special for these kids and I can't say enough wonderful things about our journey there.

Let It Shine sees every child as incredibly valuable and uniquely designed and gifted.  The staff and teachers work to find what could be causing difficult behaviors and provide supports to help the child be successful.  It is truly an individualized program where the teachers support each child’s needs.  The staff cared for our son and family in one of the most difficult seasons we have had.  During a year that my son was beginning to internalize being “bad” at a previous preschool program, Let It Shine helped collaborate and guide us to resources and patiently helped us work through his needs.  He ended the year with a confidence in his ability to make helpful choices for himself and others.  It truly was remarkable to see the progress he made! We feel that we understand his needs now in a way that will help us be better advocates for him moving forward, and we are hopeful about what he will be able to accomplish.  We know that this year where he was loved and supported at school in the ways he is at home, always given a fresh start each day, was a gift from God.

My son attended Let it Shine for two years, and I can't rave about him enough. He's been diagnosed with severe ADHD, sensory processing disorder and he also has a speech delay. After things didn't work out in his former preschool, I waited months to take him to a place that really understood him. Let it Shine hit all the marks. I love the place, and the vision the director has for the place. My kid's challenges are understood, dealt with in a positive manner. I can't tell you how many times they went OUT of their way to help me and my son. Ms. Theresa & Ms. Rebecca are amazing.  I highly recommend!

I could spend hours going on and on about how amazing this program is for children with sensory issues, but all you have to do is see for yourself. All of the staff are amazing, kind and dedicated to our kiddos. With each day and week that passes we are seeing our son thrive in ways we worried he might not. He LOVES school. Adores his friends. It is truly this hidden gem in South Austin and we will forever be grateful we lucked into a spot in their program. 💗💗

I cannot express how much this school helped my son!
