Our 5-year-old graduated with a strong academic foundation—counting to 100, doing simple addition and subtraction, knowing all letters and numbers in both English and Spanish, and showing impressive fine motor skills. The staff genuinely knows and cares about each child, and the small community allows for strong relationships between students and teachers. The outdoor time and enrichment activities are a huge bonus, and the low teacher turnover speaks volumes. We couldn’t be happier!

We love The Little Learning Place! Everyone is so friendly and the teachers do great lessons everyday. If you really want a daycare and preschool that prepare students for kindergarten this is the place.
Great daycare, even better staff!! My little one learned and developed so much here! Always amazed at the different topics they taught even at her age!

We loved our time at TLLP! The teachers are incredible and really care about the kids. It always feels like a calm and safe atmosphere, and the kids get extremely prepared for school in the future - my 2.5 year old learned to count to 20 in English and Spanish and knows her planets!

My daughter has been at TLLP for about a year & a half and we've had nothing but an excellent experience. It feels intimate, the owners/teachers are wonderful and responsive, and they are very learning-focused. There is a low turnover rate with the staff. It's safe & secure. Also, I love their app (they post photos & videos for parents throughout the day). We'd highly recommend!

This place is definitely 100/10! my daughter love it here!! she loves her teacher, she calls all the kids her friends and always have a cute story to tell everyday. and the owner goes above and beyond and she’s so genuine! That’s the type of person we all want as the owner of any daycare! definitely the biggest hidden gem!

My babies have been going here for almost 2 months now. They both love it a lot. They both come home everyday full of joy telling stories about their day. The teachers here are very nice and respectful. Treat all the kids well. I highly recommend for your little ones

My kids recently started attending this facility and I already love it. Compared to the old school they used to go to, the food is amazing, my child who can sometimes be a picky eater agrees. They send alerts and sometimes pictures all day long informing you about what your child is doing. Every time I pick or drop them off, the place is super clean and even smells clean. I would recommend this facility. The teachers/director are amazing and very friendly. I rarely leave ratings but I know how hard it is to find a good daycare. This one is perfect.

My son has attended this daycare for a year now and I love it. I have no complaints whatsoever. The teachers are nice, the facility is clean, my son is learning a lot, and they work with my schedule as needed. I work 11hrs a day and miss my baby so much when I’m working so it’s nice to have the daily updates, pictures, and videos, throughout the day to see what he’s doing. I would highly recommend PkLA to anyone seeking daycare for their little ones.

I would highly recommend PKLA for your children to attend. The staff are really nice. They are organized and clean! They work with your kids with school work and everything. My children learn a lot. When my son first attended they helped potty train him. They keep you updated with everything your child does throughout the day, so you don’t have to worry.  Overall this daycare is just the best!!!! I love it.

I personally love champions , the ladies are extremely nice . We have open and great communication . If I have any questions or concerns they are always answered right away . My son has been in champions for about 3 years and I love it . I love this so much better than a daycare . Thank you Alyssa for all you have done . You have been amazing !
We love our Champions teachers Ms. Alyssa and Ms.Natalia they have been taking care of all 3 of my kids for years. I know they are in great hands I don’t have to worry.

OPERATION_NAME: The Goddard School of Fort Worth
review_text:
We’ve been part of The Goddard School family for over two years, and it’s been a wonderful experience! The teachers are incredibly thoughtful, caring, and truly invested in each child’s growth and success — they care about our child’s achievements just as much as we do.

The administrative staff is always attentive and responsive, going above and beyond to support parents’ needs and maintain a safe, happy environment for the kids. Our child has thrived both academically and socially thanks to the nurturing atmosphere and dedicated team at The Goddard School. We couldn’t be more grateful!

OPERATION_NAME: The Goddard School of Fort Worth
review_text:
I could write an essay with all the reasons and examples why I’d never enroll my child anywhere else. I’ll try to be concise.
My 28-weeker, with developmental delays and a speech delay has attended Goddard since July 2023. The amount of love, patience, attention, and care put into him has changed the trajectory of his life (in a positive way). He received speech services from an outside therapist in his classroom and his teachers (from two different level classrooms) were able to easily adjust to this. He has gone from having delays in development and speech, to being ahead of the typical expectations for a child his age.

He has learned so much about friendship, communication, activities of daily living, community, nature, the list goes on. The curriculum is wonderful. He eats the best at school. He’s a very selective eater and the most diverse food he’ll eat is at lunch that Goddard provides.

As a special education teacher, all of these components were extremely important to me when deciding the best fit for my son. We love participating in the school’s events, forming friendships with his classmates and their families, and bonding with his teachers over their shared love of the kids. I have ZERO regrets and in fact thank God every day that we have the ability to send our son there every day. Thank you Jennifer, teachers, and staff for loving our son as much as you do.

OPERATION_NAME: The Goddard School of Fort Worth
review_text: My son went here and absolutely soared in academics, so naturally when we found out about my daughter we signed her up as well. She has been going and truly loves it! They do such a great job, and Jennifer the owner is AMAZING❤️❤️

OPERATION_NAME: The Goddard School of Fort Worth
review_text:
This place is hands down the BEST!!! They have people who actually love and care about your child. They have become more like family over the past 2+ years. My child just started Kinder at a public school, and my heart broke knowing I have to put my trust in others all over again. That is how much I trust this place and everyone in it with my child. They are AMAZING teachers and my child learned so much from them. Everything was always handled with TLC while my child was in the clumsy stages. This place was just a hidden blessing to us and glad we found them!

You know you are in the right place when your child runs to be in class and wants to stay to finish activities!

OPERATION_NAME: The Goddard School of Fort Worth
review_text: We love Goddard. The teachers are so loving and caring, responsiveness is excellent. I’ve never called where they haven’t answered and I’ve never had a question or concern go unaddressed within hours. My very shy, separation anxiety having 3 year old THRIVES here, running to her teachers. When presented with an opportunity to move to another city, we simply couldn’t leave Goddard and decided against it.

I am so grateful to have found Francois Academy! Just as the name implies, it is more than just a daycare. The entire staff genuinely cares for the children and it shows. From the nutritious real food they provide, to the engaging lesson plans they develop each week, and all the fun events the kids from the community get to participate in. They go above and beyond when caring for my children. I am confident my kids are safe and secure here and that type of peace of mind is priceless!
My little one thrives here! He absolutely loves his teachers and all the staff. I'm so grateful to have found a place where my child is comfortable and genuinely enjoys both learning and playing.

My autistic daughter has been attending Francois Academy since late September of last year; the amount of patience and understanding that Mrs. Roxy, Winter, and the other wonderful ladies has shown me and my daughter places a special amount of peace and comfortability that most daycares do not provide. My mother was diagnosed with brain cancer, and from February to April my daughter couldn’t attend because we was with her. They put my account on hold so that I wouldn’t be charged tuition, and kept her spot (as long as I was keeping them updated on the situation). I’m very grateful especially being a single mother that Mrs. Roxy, Winter, Quen, and all the other ladies have shown me grace. I love that they accept kids that most daycares will deny. I love that my 5 year old (who was 4 when she started) is being equipped with the same criteria of the school system. Even with being a super anxious parent who has been paranoid because of past daycare’s situation, they still worked with and my attitude (not to be confused with just flat out being disrespectful or intolerable). They have periodic events for the parents (whether at the daycare or an overnight stay for the kids). Mrs. Roxy does not play about having a team that cares to the development, safety, and care of the children there. Me and my daughter love Mrs. Roxy and the rest of the staff dearly. Take my word for it and go tour this amazing facility!

First off, some of the people at this center are more like family to me. Ms Roxy goes above and beyond for any and everyone. She’s definitely a wonderful person inside and out! It’s been a little over 2 years since I’ve enrolled my kiddos here. Unfortunately I’ve had to move my two eldest to a different center due to us moving to a different area for school purposes, but my youngest two are here and I don’t mind making that drive every morning because there’s no other place I’d rather have them! Their curriculum is amazing as well! The kiddos actually learn and retain what’s being taught to them.

My daughter has been attending here for almost 3 months now & we really enjoy it! I love how they actually teach the kids & do fun activities. Most daycares leave kids in a room with no interaction. this one does not, they are all about sensory& motor skills. My daughter loves Fridays bc it is splash day!!! I highly recommend this daycare. Ms. Roxanne is amazing & my daughter's teacher Ms. Esmeralda is very sweet 🫶🏼❤️ thank you all for providing great care for these children, we know this job is not easy!!!

Saw one of the vans dropping off kids speeding through a school zone going 45 a 30. You could see the kids were playing around, not seated while the seatbelt buckles  were visible and none were being used. One of the doors for the  to kids enter was slightly also a jar.
I called the daycare to let them know and was greeted by "just a teacher" that kept questioning me about the driver, my attention was not the driver's, it was the kids! Again, said she was not the manager and when I tried to provide my number so I can get a call back she hung up on me. No accountability whatsoever feel sorry for these kids.

If I could give zero stars, I would. I not only do not recommend this daycare—I strongly urge other parents: take your child and run.

This place is not safe. They told children to sit quietly in front of the TV and not ask for anything—or they’d “call the police.” My child was terrified. He was even told not to tell his parents what happened, or he’d “get in trouble.”

My son came home crying uncontrollably for days and couldn’t sleep at night because of the fear and emotional distress caused by this daycare. How can you continue working in childcare after doing this to a child?

To the parents who still leave positive reviews: please be aware that not everything is as it seems. You might not know what your child has truly experienced.

And to the staff: instead of reflecting and improving, you argue back on negative reviews. Maybe because that’s the only skill you have—arguing and trying to convince others.

You seriously need to learn how to treat people with respect—especially the children you’re meant to care for.
Miss Yaya and her staff are wonderful. They are very upfront about what my son does during the day, and keeps him clean, learning and happy.

I love Star Kiddos! It’s super convenient for transport from my home to work, but moreover, my children love it there. Everyday they come home with high energy excited to go back the next day. Communication is open and Ms. Yaya is always available to answer an my questions or concerns. I trust them with my children to care for them the way that I would, and that’s what means the most to me. Thank you Star Kiddos for taking great care of my babies.

My daughter has been coming here for a couple months and she loves it. She is always talking about how nice her teacher is. I get many updates on what she is doing throughout the day via photos. Staff is super friendly and nice!

My two kiddos ages 5 & 1 has been attending  Starting Point since October 2024 and I’m so impressed with their level of care! Ms.Sam is so kind and plans such fun things for the kids. It’s an all inclusive environment with lots of engagement for my 5 year old who is on the spectrum. Ms.Annie makes the kids the best meals! Everyone in the baby room loves on my little baby like he’s theirs! And I can’t forget LaDonna who always has a smiling face and helping hand with the kiddos. All of the staff are friendly! The facility is clean and up to date! You won’t be disappointed if you enroll your kids!

I started my first daughter here when she was just a year old, Ms Barbara did a wonderful job with helping her transition from being with me all day to me being at work. They begin teaching curriculum as early as possible which was very helpful for my daughter who likes to be challenged. When she was old enough to start potty training, Ms Genevieve was amazing with my then 2 year old and really helped the process. My daughter went through a biting phase and they were very communicative with me and helped as she grew out if it..
My second daughter started there as early as 6-8 weeks and she bonded immensely with Ms Khatam and the infant teachers.
Now my third daughter is there as well and I have never had any major complaints.
I think all work places have a few less than enthusiastic employees but since the 3 years my kids have been there, I think Management has done a decent job of keeping people on staff who really like kids and keep it professional around the kiddos.
I definitely would recommend this daycare to friends and family.

My baby girl has been coming here for almost 2 years ! Since she was 1 ! For a mother very hard to choose the right day care ! They loved on my baby girl like she was her own ! Now my son has been coming here every year for the summer and the field trips he goes on are so amazing ! Definitely recommend for any parents looking around in the Jersey Village area ! 🩷

Starting point is amazing! They provide all the meals (breakfast, snacks,lunch,and dinner)and they recently have started parents night out once a month, which is fantastic and our kiddo loves it! They are open for most holidays and have always been really flexible, kind, and accommodating. They are also really affordable for all they offer and also offer extra activies such as dance and gymnastics during school hours for a really reasonable price. I can't recommend them enough!

Gotta tell you I was so skeptical about putting my grandson in childcare because of the trauma my own kids went through when they were little; however, putting my grandson at Starting Point was the greatest decision I have made. My grandson always comes home happy, and the activities they do with the kids are beyond amazing, from live reptiles to cooking in homemade ovens, splash day on Fridays, having Princes Arial come read to the children, and all of the learning activities it is just a great place. The staff send pictures of your child doing their daily activities and I must say they feed them very well, I wish I were a kid again, lol!

My name is Enita, and I’ve experienced exceptional child care and education at All Star Kids Academy — from the moment you walk through the door to the warmth of the staff and the dedication of the management team.

If you want to see your children grow, learn, and thrive just as you’ve always dreamed, choose All Star Kids Academy and watch them flourish every single day. 🌟

We had a great experience with All Star Kids Academy. The staff are professional and always communicate well with parents. My daughter Papinya enjoyed going every day — she grew both academically and socially.

All star Academy is Award winning 🏆 Daycare. My child started going there at age of 4 months old. Everyone who works there is  very kind, and respectful! They know their work! Great communication and great service. Ms Ramona is owner and she is very knowledgeable and patient with new family. Mr Sam given the extra ordinary orientation on first day and always greeted with positive attitude. Ms Bitty,Ms Humira ,Ms Rukshana- can’t thanks enough for all your love and care to my child. She always look forward to going to daycare. Other PRN staffs I may have forgotten the names but all staff are awesome!
If anyone looking for daycare choose this as they get 5 stars from the kids and parents. They are running this Acadamy almost over 15 yrs.
5 stars ⭐️ highly recommended!!

Saying I love this place is an understatement! Everything is perfect here. My baby has been here since she's a 5 months and now going on 2. If your looking for a TRUST worthy place for your baby or kids come HERE! Very kind and loving teachers and staff. The kids are even sweet which is a reflection of the love they share and show here!!

My Son has been attending All Star Kid’s Academy for the past 8 months, and I couldn’t be happier with our experience. From the very first day, the staff made us feel welcome and comfortable, which eased the transition for both me and my child. The caregivers at All Star Kids Academy are incredibly nurturing. Every morning, the teachers greet each child with enthusiasm, and I love how much my son has bonded with them. The variety of activities they offer is fantastic. My son participates in arts and crafts, storytime, and interactive learning games. They also get plenty of outdoor time in the playground, which is a huge bonus. I’ve noticed significant improvements in her social and motor skills since he started here, and he’s constantly coming home excited about something new he learned.
The facility is always clean and well-maintained, and the safety protocols are excellent. They keep everything sanitized, and I feel secure knowing that the staff is vigilant about keeping the kids safe. The daycare also does a great job communicating with parents, using an app to send pictures and updates throughout the day. Overall, All Star Kids Academy Daycare has been a wonderful choice for my family. The staff is caring, the environment is stimulating, and I know my son is in good hands every day. I highly recommend this daycare to any parent looking for a safe, engaging, and supportive place.

This is a bittersweet review to write bc we love Little Blooms Academy so much! My son attended school here for about 2 years and we have truly loved it here. All the teachers & staff go above and beyond for the kids. Our son has flourished so much since starting here. He was shy & reserved and left confident with so many new skills & knowledge. The director Ms. Luz is fantastic. He had a few different teachers here and they all were so loving, patient & kind. They also offer lots of extracurricular activities you can enroll your kids in. The only reason we are leaving is bc we are moving. I would recommend this school to anyone that lives/works in the Galleria area. We are so sad to leave & will miss Little Blooms Academy dearly.

My oldest son was at LBA for 4 years, and my youngest for 2 years. We only left because we moved, or we would never leave. We joined just before their big annual family event, and when we went I was shocked at how many teachers knew my son’s name and seemed so excited to see him, even though he’s there 5 days a week. I thought “wow they really love my kid”. I quickly learned that’s the culture there, that’s how they treat every child. The teachers are loving and always coming up with fun & educational activities. No matter what class the kids are in, all the teachers know them by name. It really makes the school feel like a community. We love & trust Ms Luz and all the teachers.
We started at our new school and my kids are set up well to succeed with what they’ve learned at LBA. My 2 yr old’s teachers are impressed with how far along he is potty trained (thanks Ms Sandra & team).
The food they feed the kids is high quality and the menu isn’t just corn dogs & quesadillas. I appreciated the nutrition & variety they provide.
I’d highly recommend Little Blooms.

LBA was a blessing for my family in the first 8 months we took our son there, teachers were professional and seemed to loved their job. Unfortunately in the last 5 months all the teachers that were there for years left the school, I would say 95% for their current staff is working part time and there are only 2 great teachers. We left LBA one month ago I was thinking about not leaving a review but I know some moms that still have their kiddos there and I just want them to be aware…

1. Teacher Sandra is not the right person to be working with children. First day at pandas class for my son she was yelling a boy while the door was closed. After two really hard weeks of my son trying to adapt to that class her report was that we was having less “rabietas” and mentioned that she will just let my son cry until he stopped crying on his own.

2. The management keeps changing stuff some days you don’t even know who’s going to be taking care of your child.

3. One day I arrived early for pick up and two kids were standing on a chair trying to check the other classroom and the teacher wasn’t aware and was cleaning. They make teachers clean the classrooms while they take care of the kids.. so if you get a report it’s hard to trust if the child got hurt by accident of they were negligent.

As a mom the safety of my child it’s important if you are considering this place even with the good reviews I will consider a different place.
From leadership to the teachers, LBA has been amazing to work with for over 3 years now. The highest quality of care for the kiddos nestled in a perfect location. We highly recommend a visit!!

Our daughter attended Little Blooms from infant to PreK, and it has been one of the best decisions to have her attend here!  The entire staff is wonderful, and she’s learned so much in a loving environment. They also offer extracurricular activities, fun holiday parades for the kids, and hold community events.  We will miss this place, but are so grateful to have spent time here!

My daughter attended school here for about 4 years. There were a few teachers we genuinely loved, and who loved our daughter, but those teachers left the school. There is high turnover with the good teachers, from what I saw personally. Once my daughter could talk and articulate what was happening in the classroom, when she was in the 3-4yo class, my daughter would come home saying the teacher hit her on the head with a "stick with a finger on it" (pointer stick), which other students saw happen, she came home saying the F word in English and in Spanish (said she heard it from the teacher), and that the teacher bribed the students with M&M's, and my daughter didn't get any, and it made her feel bad. Anytime I brought concerns to the director, she gaslighted us, told us our daughter was lying, trying to make it seem like it was the child's fault, or she would tell nonsensical stories, seemingly trying to confuse us, which didn't work with us. Coincidentally, when we started raising concerns, and would not accept the director's lack of ownership and accountability, the school started sending "incident reports" home for our daughter, which we felt was retaliation. I called a conference due to these issues, and then they in turn called a conference, as if they were trying to create a case against us. We removed both of our kids from the school. They asked us to find somewhere else for our daughter, saying it 'wasn't the right place for her', which we feel was due to us raising concerns and those concerns not being acknowledged. We heard this happened to other students as well that were asked to find other schools, likely students or parents they didn’t want to deal with - instead of dealing with the real problem. The director also spoke condescendingly to her teachers in my presence, and they deserve better. I would not recommend this school at all. We were so glad to move on from First Class Child Development Center. Our daughter thrived immediately upon moving to a school where she felt loved, welcomed, and valued.

Very very alarming and displeased!! As a human and a single mom with a 5yr old that was diagnosed with ADHD it’s been very difficult while it has been seen over time now that my son is getting older. Anyways I enrolled my son in the center with awareness of such with my son and that we was in process of him getting testing and that if it was something he wouldn’t be on any meds but gummies to calm him down because he is hyper they was aware and took him in my son didn’t even stay in there for a whole six months they kick him out and the way things was handled it was down right low and I’m very disappointed and distraught. So if your kid have any condition don’t even bother taking them there because it’s just a waste and it wasn’t shown integrity due to them being understaffed but that shouldn’t be another reason on why a child isn’t able to be there!!!!! I really feel like my son was single out in a type of way of them getting rid of him with no remorse!! And please daycare please don’t bother to call me to talk about it, you all was quick to kick him out so please!!

My son went to First Class and blossomed into a more than ready Kinder Kid! Teachers are awesome! Management is very involved and treat the families as if they’re their own. My son asks to go back and see his teachers and the director. I feel blessed to have such great influencers that impacted his life so positively! I will definitely place my next child here ❤️

My son has attended FCCDC since 2016 as an infant and is about to be in the 4’s class soon. My experience with the school has been truly amazing! The staff in each class is so loving and patient. The management is very caring and understanding and does everything they can to work with you as a family! I love everything about this school and would recommend it to all!

This facility feels more like a private school for my kids with them being in a well structured environment for them to learn and grow rather than some daycare I drop my kids off at. I have know the owner for a number of years and have had the opportunity to see first hand how she has brought the buisness up from one location to multiple locations now. The educational structure she provides for the children in her care is excellent when compared to some of the other options out there. My wife and I have been bring our children here for the last several months, and in these few months my children have shown great improvements with both behavior and speech. My 18 month old can sing her alphabet and is starting to let us know when she has to potty. My 3 1/2 year old is bringing home crafts on a fairly regular basis and tells my wife and I about all the fun he has with his friends throughout the day. I am impressed with activities they have on special days such as splash day where the kids get to enjoy the outside weather with some fun water toys and games. The daily sheets are also an added bonus into letting my wife and I know what our children have eaten and what activities they have done for the day.

My 18 month old has been at LAD since he was 3 months old and we have zero complaints. The staff has been the same since we started there. They love and care deeply for the kids and it shows. If staff is arriving to work and they see one of their kiddos arriving at the same time they will go to the car and help parent's get the kiddo inside. If a kiddo is having a rough morning staff will go to the kiddo and talk to them and walk with them, or carry them to class. That is just a couple of examples of how caring they are. The staff is amazing The Director is amazing! She's easy to communicate with, understanding, caring, passionate and loves the kids. The staff all know the kiddos by name. My baby can't get to his class fast enough when he gets to daycare! He walks in with a big smile and doesn't even look back to tell me bye! It eases my anxious mama heart seeing that because I know he's in good hands. I could go on and on! We highly recommend Little America Daycare!

My family love this daycare! Ms Laurie, the director is amazing! Every one of the teachers/staff truly care about the kids and their families. I’ve had family members bring their children here, as well as my own children. Would definitely recommend to anyone needing quality care for their kids infant to pre-k.

Our family LOVES little America! Two of my Grand Daughters each have one child attending this Christian, Faith based, Loving, caring  daycare center! One of my two Great Grandchildren is two years old and the other is four years old both have been taught, loved and cared for since they were each six weeks old! They( the children) love all the teachers and their friends. No fuss at drop off or pick up! All of the staff from the director to teachers know each child, parents and siblings by name! As a parent of seven, Grandparent of sixteen and Great Grandparent of nine and a half (the half is due in July & will at six weeks attend also) I would recommend Little America to anyone who wants outstanding learning, love and care for their little ones!

My babies have been going here for over a year now. It was definitely one of the best decisions daycare wise my family has ever made. We were new to the area and had some rough center experiences starting out . On my first day touring I was able to meet one of the pastors(owner)  and she was so welcoming and friendly. There has been CONSISTENT staff the entire time. My kids absolutely love it and look forward to seeing their friends and teachers each day. It’s such a family friendly environment . Communication with the staff is amazing and I highly recommend  this daycare to anyone who may be on the fence .

Our new director Laurie Hunt has been a gift to us! What a peaceful and kind person. She has a true relationship with the families! Superb care! Amazing location! Great price too. Check it out! My grandkids go there!

ACCC is a great daycare! They are clean and great with the kids! They are great at communicating with you about your little one because they know how important it is. ACCC is not only a daycare but a place where your child can go every week and learn, have fun, and grow and play with their peers. Give them a try if your looking for a good place to take your little one, they offer tours to make sure it's right for you!

My son has been here for a little over a year now in the after school class/summer. We adore Mrs.Kim, Mrs. Rebecca and Mrs. Sierra. ALL of the staff are amazing and so patient with my son. So grateful to have these amazing group of women who have watched over my baby like their own. They certainly make it easy to leave him in their care. ❤️

My daughters (age 7) attend this daycare and the experience so far has been great! I really appreciate the fact that they help drop my daughters at school in the mornings and also pick them up when school is over and they stay for the after school program. My daughters also enjoy attending this daycare which is a huge plus for me. Ms. Gulzar has been extremely helpful and attentive since day one, because of her I know my daughters are in good hands while at daycare. If asked I would definitely recommend Americas Choice Childcare Center!!!!

My daughter is 3 months & has been going to America’s choice daycare for a couple months now  & we love it! The staff is so warm,  sweet & caring! We absolutely love and adore her teachers Mrs. Aisha & Ms. Mahim! The director, Ms. Gulzar is AMAZING! She’s very hands on, she actually interacts with the children & knows my daughter’s day to day activities & dealings! She is very hands on & makes me feel comfortable leaving my daughter in her care.  I highly recommend this daycare!

My kids and I really love this daycare. America’s Choice daycare have very pleasant and down to earth teachers. The staff treats us like family with the utmost respect! The director Ms. Kia is very professional and I always see her interacting with all the children. My kids never want to leave their teachers and friend due to the fun activities they have. If you are looking for a friendly trust worthy daycare this is the right place to choose. This is the best daycare I’ve ever encountered. It’s a blessing to have a daycare to be comfortable with. I would recommend America’s Choice on Dairy Ashford to everyone!!

We had a rough start with the previous office staff, but things have gotten so much better. Definitely see the improvement!

The teachers have been amazing throughout. Heather, Hannah & Jennifer always go above and beyond, and we appreciate them so much.

My children have gone to this La Petite for quite some time. We have been with this center through countless directors and teachers who were not the best in my opinion. Since Mrs. Shaquairee took over, I have seen nothing but improvements. From the very first day, she took any and all concerns to heart to make sure I felt heard. Since then, she has constantly followed up, is extremely communicative, and more than willing to help out wherever she can.
Aside from that, Mrs. Heather has been nothing short of AMAZING. My child is extremely nervous around new people, so going to daycare has never been easy, but my child is now constantly asking for Mrs. Heather and to go play with her in her classroom. She is extremely communicative as well and very helpful in making sure her kids in her classroom all feel like part of her own little family.
The changes I have seen in the past year or two have been extremely positive changes. The staff, including Mr Isaiah, Mrs Liza, Mrs Monica, (and I’m sure I forgot someone) are all working together to implement some great changes all while keeping lines of communication open and honest.

Ms. Heather is truly the best! She has been with my son since he was an infant, and I’m so grateful she’s been able to move up with him as he transitioned through different age groups. It’s never easy leaving your child, but Ms. Heather has always made me feel safe and confident that he’s in good hands. She’s kind, attentive, and genuinely cares about the kids. What means the most to me is that even when my son isn’t at daycare, he sometimes asks if he can go to school to see Ms. Heather. That tells me he loves being there, and that’s all a parent can hope for. We’re so lucky to have her!
We are also lucky to have Ms Anna. she is so sweet, gentle, and nurturing with the kids. Her calm and loving nature brings such a warm energy to the classroom, and it’s clear how much she truly cares about each child. She creates a safe, happy, and supportive environment the kids!

Ms. Heather has been with my son since he was an infant, he is now almost 3. She has always provided him with the highest quality care. She goes above and beyond with the kids, always keeping them engaged with fun and educational activities. My son has always been a little ahead developmentally, and I truly believe a big part of that is because of Ms. Heather’s hands-on teaching. She’s patient, attentive, and genuinely passionate about helping the children learn and grow. We’re so thankful for everything she’s done for our son!

Ms. Anna is also such a kind and caring teacher! From the moment we met her, she made us feel welcomed and at ease. She has a calm and gentle way with the children that creates such a peaceful and loving environment. My son adores her, and it’s clear that she truly loves what she does. She’s always so patient and attentive, and I know my son feels safe and cared for when he’s with her. We are so thankful for the warmth and love she brings to the classroom every day!

My children have been with La Petite for 3 years, there's been some up and down changes that have been questionable. I can say the building does need a lot of updates and makeover to make it look more appealing.  I have seen the shift in management and how the place has done a complete 180 with the right people such as Mrs Sharie and Mr. Isaiah.  They are very hands on with assisting in the classrooms and there's never a day that I dont see them assisting their teachers.  I know staffing is a issue and they operate with transparency about it, they do try their best.  I commend them for being those type of managements that jumps in during the time of need for their teachers.

The teachers are one of a kind, my kids can be a handful, well one is a terror to be quite honest. I like to call Mrs. Heather the baby girl whisper, my little momma can be a little handful but I love how Mrs Heather doesnt play that. She will calmly redirect her and let me know all the time how shes improving or back tracking so I can take care of it.  Shes a very loving teacher that really plays and takes times to attend to each of the students even when there's a child like mine, that requires more discipline than others. My girl love Mrs Heather and is always going straight to her every morning just to get a warm hug, shes been doing really good with her development and preparing for school all because of Mrs Heather and the curriculum the center has set up.  She's been here since my kids started and I love how shes able to transition with my daughter to keep her feeling safe and not always having a new face.

My sons teacher, I believe is Mrs. Anna with the 3 years old in the main room. Shes a very sweet person.  I commend her for doing morning duty with all the crying and sleep kids- she has a lllottt of patience to be dealing with it so early in the mornings.  She's very soft with the  children and keeps them on track with direction. My sons speech has improved while being in her class and his learning has improved also, hes always coming home with a new coloring assignment or a new letter hes learned.

These ladies are amazing with my children, I hope they are shown appreciation throughout their day and told how great of a job they are doing on a daily.

Mrs. Monica in the back room is also sweet, shes with the older children and I often pick my son up from her room in the evening and she has all the big kids sitting there listening to her. She must of been a sergeant because man looks like she keeps the older ones in line, and they give her the most respect back.  What she does comes from the heart for these little ones.  She's instilling discipline in them that they can take to elementary once they leave the daycare setting.

Theres other lady's that are there who are very helpful also I just dont know their names to add them to this comment.  I have not had a bad experience with any of the teachers.  They are all very nice teachers.

Mama Melli's is such a sweet daycare. Our daughter (3) spent an awesome 6 months here and we really appreciated the play, communication and care of the owner and teachers. She will miss her Mama Melli family.
Mama Mellie’s is fantastic! My toddler loves playing outside and learning from his teachers. I love the small class sizes and that he gets to play with other kids in a good age range.

Mama Mellis had been a fantastic addition to enriching my kiddos childhood. He loves his teachers and all his friends he has met there. He comes home after spending the day playing outside, doing yoga, and arts and crafts happy and tired ❤️

We toured every child care center in the area, you won’t find a more caring, loving and nurturing place than Mama Melli’s. Our kid was shy, quiet and reserved, and after almost a year here, he is now much more outgoing, chatty, and full of excitement every day he gets to go see his friends at Mama Melli’s. It’s exactly what our kiddo needed, outdoor time, with animals, yoga, singalongs, and loads of wonderful toys to play with. The teachers are so incredible and kind. We could not be happier with our experience here, and we highly suggest you check it out!

We highly recommend Mama Melli’s - especially if you’re looking for a lower adult/child ratio which is so important. Our little guy has so much fun there with yoga, guitar songs, lots of outdoor and nature play. Melissa is one of the best early childhood directors I’ve encountered - she is loving, trustworthy, responsive, and cares for each child and cares for her staff too. Thank you, Melissa and teachers! ❤️

My son absolutely loves going to daycare every day, and that is all thanks to his amazing teacher. From the moment he started, she has made him feel safe, welcomed, and excited to learn. He talks about her all the time at home and is always happy to go to class, which means the world to me.

It’s clear she truly cares about the children and puts so much effort into creating a positive, fun environment for them. Knowing my son is in such caring and capable hands gives me so much peace of mind. I am incredibly grateful for everything she does! We love you Aiea !

Choosing this daycare has been one of the best decisions for our family. My daughter has blossomed into such a confident, smart, and energetic child. She’s learned academically, socially, and emotionally in ways that have truly impressed us.

The teachers and staff create a nurturing environment while also encouraging her to challenge herself and strive for more. Their patience, support, and genuine care make all the difference. We feel so lucky to have found this place.

We’ve been with Early Ivy for almost three years, and we couldn’t be happier with our experience. The staff has always been incredibly accommodating and supportive, and most importantly, our child truly feels safe there.

Ms. Kim and Ms. Lauryn deserve special recognition. They are kind, patient, and genuinely caring, and they’ve built such a trusting relationship with our child over the years. Knowing that our child feels comfortable, secure, and loved every day gives us so much peace of mind as parents. We’re very grateful to them and highly recommend Early Ivy to any family looking for a nurturing daycare environment.

Early Ivy is the BEST place to send your children! I have 2 about to send my 3rd one there when he is born! My son has been there 4 years and my daughter almost 2 years. Ms Elaine, Marrissa, Shams, Angelica, and Nathalia have all been taking caring of and loving my kids like their own for years. Ms Kim and all the other teachers are always so welcoming. My kids look forward to going and are always happy to see their teachers! It helps so much to see your child happy and safe when you have to leave them to go to work. I couldn’t ask for a better place for my children to grow and learn surrounded by teachers that love them as much as I do!

I have nothing but good things to say, very happy with all staff members who are very friendly and always communicate anything to us parents. They are very patient and take the kiddos care as if it were their own. We recently moved out 20 mins further and I make the drive because they are worth it!

We live in the neighborhood and have been sending our daughter to Covenant UMC Preschool since she was 1 (now 3), and she loves it just as much as we do! The teachers are amazing, and you can really tell they care. They always come up with such fun and creative activities that keep the kids engaged. The director, Jan, is the kindest, most welcoming person, and we’re so fortunate to have such a wonderful preschool so close to home!

Over the past few years, we have tried several preschools in the neighborhood and while they are all great in their own ways, CUMC Preschool takes the cake for it's excellent staff (many are previous school teachers), wonderful facilities (with an awesome playground), and a thoughtful curriculum for the kiddos. I've had kids at every grade level at this school and each teacher has been wonderful and engaging. The director, Jan Glosser, is so welcoming, warm, kind and knows each family personally which makes you feel right at home.  We love it!

We love this school so much!
Our first boy went there since he was 2y/o, and he loved it so much that he kept saying he wanted to go back when he started kindergarten. Now our second boy goes there as well and I have seen such an improvement in his personality. All the teachers are amazing, Ms. Jan (Director) is amazing. They all truly care about our kids, and you can see how much they all love being there. They also work very hard on having a good community with all the families. It honestly feels like a huge family.

Both my boys have attended this preschool.  The teachers are all wonderful, caring, and knowledgable about educating preschoolers!  The community is amazing, and it is actively fostered by a great director and staff!

CMCU is an absolute treasure of a preschool, and I cannot recommend it enough. The school itself is a lovely building with lots of wood and large classrooms. The playground is as idyllic as you can get, with large trees for shade and ample play frames. But the best part of CMCU is the teaching staff; it's always a good sign in the education world when the staff stay on year after year, and most of the lead teachers at CMCU have been there for many years. They clearly enjoy this as a workplace and it shows in the care, love, and effort they make with all the children.

I really can't speak highly enough of this school. Send your kiddos here!

OPERATION_NAME: River Ridge YMCA of Central Texas
review_text: Austin YMCA is a great place for programs for kids, adults, learning to exercise (swimming, boxing, basketball, team sports, etc.)  Relying heavily on donations, this is also a great place to make charitable donations.  No one is turned away for financial inability.

OPERATION_NAME: River Ridge YMCA of Central Texas
review_text: Next to impossible to contact this agency ...emails not returned...voice mails not returned...very unprofessional

My 6yo son was having so much trouble in daycare before we found this place, but the teachers and the smaller quieter environment have worked wonders for him. They were so patient and firm with him, I don't know how we would have gotten through the summer without their support.

*editing to add*

My son's MAP scores went up over summer instead of having the "summer slide" as they call it, and I think it is due to the homework ms Morgan had my son doing all summer. Thank you for keeping my little guy sharp!

My daughter is a very difficult child to deal with it she was terminated from other daycares twice so I had really lost all hope but when I found this daycare they were so understanding! They didn’t make my child feel like a monster and they didn’t make me feel like a bad parent. It was so refreshing heart warming. I highly recommend you check them out . My child will be returning for the summer!

I recently enrolled my 3 year old here, everybody that you encounter is so nice and friendly. I love the fact that my baby gets so excited at drop off . Shout out to Mrs. Pat, my son is very fond of her. Definitely check them out if you’re in need of childcare. Friendly people and good pricing!

This daycare is definitely a great daycare! Both of my kids went there from 16 months until school age! Mrs.Betts and her staff did a great job taking care of and getting my kids school ready. Would recommend to anyone ✊🏾

I absolutely love Gabby in the baby room! My baby started there 2 months ago. I was nervous because my baby and I had never been separated, but Gabby and Mrs Betts just love on her. Gabby makes sure to capture milestone moments im missing. At 7 months, she's always coming home with activities they've done. Super clean. Great staff

I was skeptical at first after reading the reviews, but I decided to take a chance on jumping kangaroos and I have to say miss. Tanja And her staff are amazing with my kids. When My son first started he had a sensory issue. which means he doesn’t like to eat or touch certain things. He has had therapy and I’ve tried my hardest, but it wouldn’t stick. I don’t know what her staff did, but now he’s willing to try anything and everything, and as a busy mother that helped greatly. My son is beyond smart for his age because they are very consistent in helping them learn. My daughter is an After school student And they always Helped with homework and things like that. Overall 10 out of 10 would recommend hands-down best Daycare best staff always greeted always up-to-date on information about my kids. I just can’t thank them enough. They were a blessing in disguise. Thank you guys for all you do. ♥️

I can’t express the Gratitude I have towards this Place and the People who work here. My baby love this place and he’s been going only for 3 weeks. The way they care for him and treat him with such love and respect is something you would not find anywhere else. I have definitely found a place where he can be himself and would definitely not change it for nothing! Also I want to thank Ms. Dee and Ms. Tanja for always being understandable and supportive 🫶❤️

Writing this review just to Thank Jumping Kangaroo Daycare for taking such good care of my children. My oldest spent years at the Potranco location and learned so much, was always well taken care of, and loved going. My youngest is now enrolled at the Adams Hill location with Miss Tanja Ebony who runs it and it’s been such a smooth and easy transition for our little one going there. Ms. Ebony is always very welcoming with our baby, and our baby was a premmie and can be complicated at times but the daycare handles it with such grace and we appreciate it. Our 2 year old has made such progress since going to this daycare and I would highly recommend for anyone in the area looking for a reliable daycare to contact them.

Greatest experience ever! My son has gone here from 7months -17 months old and he absolutely has loved it!  It was his first daycare ever and with him being a preemie I was very nervous but it’s been a great experience having him here. I’m so sad to be moving away and having to switch daycares. He literally smiles cheek to cheek at every drop off and most days wants to stay at pickup time. He loves the women here, they are absolutely incredible and have been the entire time he’s attended here. Great staff, great communication!

Highly recommended daycare/learning center!!
My set of boy girl twins have been with Kangaroos since they were 2 years old- they are now going on 4 years old. They have grown and learned SOOOO MUCH while being in their care. I never have any concerns about safety, mistreatment, and if they are well fed. We get updates throughout the day and daily end of day reports for them. It reassures me that they are behaving and having fun and learning. Mrs. Tanja and Mrs. D are AWESOME and very interactive with the children. Our twins have favorite teachers Tiffany and Genesis who is also always so excited to have them attend daily! Do not hesitate to enroll your children!!

We inquired with kindercare and decided not to move forward. Our son never enrolled but they decided to send us to collections for $553. Never once did he enroll or step foot in there. Disappointing! No emails no phone calls about a debt. Did not say if you sign the dotted line we will charge you. I am appalled and will be disputing and taking action against this. Taking advantage of parents

The children’s courtyard is where anyone looking needs to be. $1 less per week for two days and courtyard does weekly field trips. Much cleaner facility and no weed smell is the other plus. Oh wait one more your kid can actually play and have fun… vs kindercare where they made my kiddo clean up after other children….. so basically kindercare you pay them and your child is forced to clean up the classrooms.
Love this daycare so much, it gives me a peace of mind knowing my kids are safe, loved and well taken care of every single day. And miss cheryl, jaime & Taylor  are the BEST

My kids really enjoy being here. The teachers are awesome and the staff really cares about what the children are learning and doing on a daily basis. Awesome director! She makes you feel welcome and that your child is being taken care of by knowledgeable staff who feel like family.

The initial walkthrough and application process was good and I did not observe anything concerning when I visited prior to enrolling my daughter. The front desk staff was very friendly and welcoming and made you feel confident in their program. The director was also very welcoming and informative. However, my daughter attended this daycare for one week before we pulled her out. My husband witnessed one of the teachers forcefully grabbing a child by the arm and dragging him across the room right in front of him. We reported the incident to the director and were assured the incident would be investigated. We are unsure whether or not that teacher was dismissed because we withdrew our daughter immediately. At every drop off there would be nobody at the front desk. They always seemed to understaffed. I witnessed teachers outside of the classroom chatting. My daughter told me that the same teacher that my husband witnessed dragging another child would pinch her chest to get her to sit down at circle time—instead of telling her where to sit. My daughter is 4 years old and is always well behaved while at daycare. She never had any behavior complaints from her previous daycare. We only had to switch daycares because we moved. I do not understand how this childcare facility has such high reviews. Please beware when considering this facility for your childcare needs.

Both of my daughters attended this learning center, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! The teachers are so patient, caring, and truly invested in helping each child grow at their own pace. My girls looked forward to going every day — which says so much about how fun and engaging the environment is.

The staff communicates well, keeps parents updated, and creates such a safe, positive atmosphere. I’ve noticed such a boost in my daughters’ confidence and learning skills since starting here.

Highly recommend this center to any parent looking for a place where their kids will not only learn, but feel loved and supported!
Great school! The staff is very understanding and personalized care for my son. Highly recommend!

This daycare is great.  But the classes have become overcrowded.  The “teachers” are also ill equipped to handle small children when they need assistants with proper coping skills.  I don’t blame the teachers.  But I think it’s due to either lack of Directors initiative or possible down right laziness.  I am very glad I was able to move my little to a new day care with properly trained staff and also staff that had management support.

We couldn't be happier with Country Home Learning Center, my grandson has gone to Country Home since he was 3 months old (he's now 4 years old).  I have to admit I was a little hesitant about him going to daycare, but the teachers and staff make it so easy to leave him, they do so many fun activities that he doesn't want to miss a day!  I highly recommend Country Home!!

Country Home Is the Best. I have two beautiful daughters (4 years and 6 months) that attend Country home.  We attend the center on Galleria Fair and I have to point out that the staff from the Executive Director, to the teachers are very caring and treat my daughters like family!! They are proactive on everything and every time you walk in, they greet you with smiles on their faces and the atmosphere is wonderful.  We have never had a problem here and my 4 year daughter loves her teachers and all of the field trips and activities that they do on a weekly basis.  When she comes home, she is so excited to tell us what she learned today in class.  They say it takes a village to raise a child and I can say that we consider Country home part of our village and family!!!  I highly recommend this center for your child care needs!!
I loved this school, it’s the best! my daughter learned so much. I hate I had to take her out. It’s most definitely a family. We love you save our children.
I love Fort Worth Save Our Children. Its the best daycare and private school.
Great school and great teachers, it is more of a family than a school.  They love the children and it shows.
Great place to take your kids for good care.
Awesome school!

Wiggles is an outstanding daycare program that truly puts children first. The staff is warm, caring, and attentive, creating a safe and nurturing environment where kids feel at home. Their activities are both fun and educational, encouraging creativity, social skills, and early learning in a playful way. Parents can feel confident knowing their little ones are not only well cared for but also thriving. Wiggles goes above and beyond to make every day exciting and enriching.

My kids had been at this daycare for years when Julie was the owner and it used to be amazing. Ever since Debbie and Isaac took over, things have gone completely downhill. The center is not clean, the staff turnover is constant, and the quality of care is nowhere near what it used to be. I finally pulled my kids out because I no longer felt comfortable leaving them there. If you’re looking for a safe, clean, and consistent environment for your children, this is not the place.

The new owners have done a tremendous job at making the day care more vibrant and fun for the kiddos! So fun to see the kids having the option to play in a giant play house and have sports themed chairs. Such a cute, lively place to send your kid to. :)

Child care is tough, especially today and Wiggles is a fantastic example of child care done right. Debbie and Isaac have vastly improved the concept since taking over and have done a great job creating a safe environment for kids and a worry-free one for parents. Highly recommend to any parent looking for day care services. You'll wish you'd heard about it sooner!

My wife and I toured this daycare a few years ago and recently again since moving back into the area. The new owners have really done a great job in revamping the center! I could not believe it was the same place. Not sure who had this previously, but they did a great job handing this off to the new management. I just had to leave this review as my wife and I could not believe the transformation. Staff are warm and friendly and environment is inviting. Needless to say we signed up!!

My daughter has been going here for a little over a year now. We love everyone! She has a relationship with every single staff member. My husband and I love that this daycare is owned by family, ran by family, and they love everyone as if they’re family. You can’t possibly go wrong here. They’re so attentive, friendly, and you know it isn’t an act! This is how they are with the children all day. My newborn will be going here as well once she’s old enough. This has been the best decision ever for us!

I've been sending my babies to Reaching High since 2017, and I couldn't have found a better place for my kids! God sent Ms. Neka and her staff into our lives and we've been truly blessed by it. My kids have made leaps and bounds with their vocabulary, spelling, reading but also socially as well. Thank you to all the teachers, staff, etc. who take care of kiddos!

Mrs. Neka is an awesome educator.  Just watching her work with children is a joy!!   All of Mrs. Neka's children will excel because of the delightful way she works with them.  They have thematic lessons, field trips, water safety (summer), guest speakers, etc.  I wish my children could have benefited from that kind of foundation but she wasn't around all those years ago.  However, when my granddaughter was in town for a week, I took advantage of Mrs. Neka's fine work.  She worked with her every day and we received daily reports - and homework.  Then, at the end of the week, she met with my son and I to let us know some things they could do to help her after they arrived home.  I love Reaching High Learning Center and Mrs. Neka!!!  :+)

Ms. Neka runs an incredible daycare full of love, instruction and mentoring. I have met many of the parents that send their children to Reaching High Learning Center and we all share one common denominator......Ms. Neka!  I highly recommend any parent looking for a daycare in the N. Houston area with a Christian background to consider Reaching High Learning Center.

NG

Absolutely love mrs. nekka and mrs.tomorrow!! They treat my daughter as their own. My baby is not a people person but mrs.Tomorrow is her day care mom. She gets so excited and happy to see her, like she knows her day is about to be great! This was my first time putting her in day care and hands down the best place to have chosen. She’s not only being watched and loved, she’s learning new things and I can’t thank them enough for helping her shine like the little star she is.

An absolute gem! My little was homeschooled before beginning her attendance at International Montessori, and the transition was so smooth. The teachers are top tier and so loving and caring with the kids. They teach them fundamentals, but also life skills. Everyday my little one comes home happy and excited to show me what she has learned. I highly recommend!

We’ve been providing cleaning services at this location for several years, and the professionalism of the staff makes all the difference. Both the Director, Ms. Alina, and Jennifer, the owner, are easy to reach and quick to resolve any issues that arise. There have been multiple times where their support directly helped our team overcome challenges smoothly. It’s been a pleasure to work with them, and I would gladly recommend this Montessori to parents and other vendors alike.

My daughter that is 2 started IMHOC in the beginning of this year for her very first time in a school setting. The amount of love, compassion, and learning material that she has experienced is more than I can have expected. When my wife and I were looking for a Montessori School we contacted the school within a short period of time the owner Jennifer Weerasuria contacted us and made us feel so welcomed, all of our questions were answered in such a way where we felt like this place was the one for our baby girl. What made this decision easy for us and what caught our eye was how long the Teachers have been there ranging from 3-13 yrs and how peaceful they were. After a short few months Covid-19’ hit, our daughter was offered virtual classes to keep in contact with her teachers and Jennifer went above and beyond to keep a safe environment and clean environment for her IMHOC family. In that time We could see how much IMHOC meant to our daughter always asking to go to school and asking about her friends. I definitely recommend everyone to experience what our daughter has experienced. There’s no better feeling to receive daily pictures on Brightwheel to know what  she is doing and how she is progressing. We thank her teachers for having the heart and patience they do to make our day easy.

My daughter attended this school for 4 years, starting at 18 months. The teachers, director and owner are warm and nurturing, and there is very little turnover. They have a large, shaded playground and the kids get plenty of outdoor playtime. We signed my daughter up for some of the extracurricular activities like art and soccer. She enjoyed the classes and it was very convenient to have everything all under one roof. We are sad to be leaving IMHOC for Kindergarten in the fall, but know that my daughter is well prepared socially and academically!

We love IMHOC and recommend it to all of our friends. The teachers are extremely loving and knowledgeable.  My daughter's teacher has been teaching for over 30 years! My 4.5 yr old has been attending this school since she was 2 and looks forward to school every day. We pick her up with a big smile on her face and hugs for all of her teachers. We are always amazed at the lessons and skills she's learning and think this school has truly prepared her for kindergarten next year.

Honestly, I cannot think of a better place to take my son. The teachers are so friendly as well as all of the directors and staff. Every single time we walk into the building we are greeted. Everyone knows our child's name, even teachers from other classes. The building is very clean. I love that they send updates and photos everyday. They have wonderful structure and lesson plans (that they share weekly) and I know our son absolutely loves it. My husband and I do not speak Spanish but it was very important to me that our children be bilingual. How lucky are we that this school exists and can provide a fully immersive environment?! I highly recommend The Pineapple School, 5 stars!
We love the Pineapple school-camp bullis.

My son has been going here for 9 months and it was the best decision. He’s learned so much and he’s so well taken care of. They are very attentive, they communicate well, and the teachers are the best! The facility is beautiful, clean, and they have many events that support child learning, social skills, and development. I can’t say enough positive things about them. They’re worth the wait.
Simply lovely
They don't cansider parents or employees. Don't let this continúe, go somewhere eles where they Will considera you

OPERATION_NAME: The Preschool at Christ the King
review_text:
I went in for a visit, the Summr of 2024.
It felt like a BiG Family Gathering. It was Super Crowded. I left before the service started bc I was taking up Their Space.
Seems Like A Good community of people to be around.

OPERATION_NAME: The Preschool at Christ the King
review_text: Staff is all so friendly and welcoming. Spacious parking lot. Very clean facility. Kids area is so big and entertaining for a wide are range. The playground is open some weekdays to the public. The outdoor area is huge. Plenty of seating areas for eating and drinking too. Highly recommend.

OPERATION_NAME: The Preschool at Christ the King
review_text:
No church is perfect. Christ the King embraces this by preaching and teaching that we are messy, imperfect people who need a Savior, which we believe is Jesus Christ.

My wife and I have been attending Christ the King since 2013. Our sons are a part of a fantastic Children's Ministry (the teachers and lessons are fantastic and the indoor playground is awesome!). My wife and I have been a part of numerous Sunday school classes, community groups, and Bible studies, all of which have broadened our understanding of the Christian faith and brought us closer to our brothers and sisters in the church as well as Christ. We enjoy coming to worship in which we praise God through prayer and song, confess to God, hear from God through the reading of His Word and preaching, and celebrate communion every Sunday.

I'm not entirely sure where some of the negative reviews came from, but I will re-instate the fact that no church is perfect. Christ the King is filled with sinners (including me) who think too highly of themselves, don't put God first and we suffer consequences of living in a broken world. However, that shouldn't deter anyone from attending this church.

God is at work at CTK. Anyone who is interested in going to a church where you can come and learn about what Christ has done and is doing in their lives should visit CTK.

OPERATION_NAME: The Preschool at Christ the King
review_text:
I'm sorry some of the reviewers have not felt welcomed and have had specific complaints. I know it can be intimidating attending a new and large church. I'm also sorry some have felt that the services haven't met their want or need.

I've been part of this church since 2009, been involved in most of the ministries at some point, and was married here. It's church. We worship the living, loving God and glorify the sacrifice of the Son Jesus Christ that shows we are His, and we are loved. We try to love one another as best we can, and seek to help the hurting. I've never been confused here about my need for salvation. I've always appreciated that the sermons and Sunday School classes don't tell you what to think, but give frameworks for how to consider situations in your life Biblically and follow Him.

Is it a perfect church? They'll have to kick me out if that's the goal. Can we do it better? Sure. But we'll keep being here, doing what we can, and trusting the Lord to help us do more, and better. I hope you'll join us.

OPERATION_NAME: The Preschool at Christ the King
review_text: I've been attending Christ the King for six years, and I've found it to be a warm and welcoming church.  The Women's Bible Study has been a wonderful place to learn, grow and develop new friendships, and the worship service consistently helps me to orient my heart toward Christ.  I'm thankful for Christ the King!

I enjoy sending my son here! He has learned so much and they close the gap that I can't cover as a parent that being in a classroom can.

It's kind of hard to separate the center from the school during holidays and events but I am happy they prioritize children and their growth.

All staff is very friendly with parents and srudent I love the confidence they give to us parents knowing our children are in good hands and learning so much every single day and not just the teacher im also talking about their lunch personal their security personal and the nurse im greatful to have found such a great school for my kids

My child has been on the waitlist for this school and this program since March 2024. It has been 1.5 years and I can’t get anyone to help me get him into school. I am disabled with a rare autoimmune disease, so I can’t work and I can’t afford $1000 a month for pre school. He wants to learn. Why doesn’t my child deserve to go to school? Why won’t anyone help me?

I only recommend this place if you just need something like a day care. My son went there 22-23 and 23-24 for the pk3 and pk4 program. Now this year he is in a real school and they want to recommend him for SPED. This is a complete shock as his Teacher at PK4SA East never said anything that even suggested that he was or might be SPED do to behavior. I honestly think that his behavior issues in his new school is due to him not learning how to properly walk in a line, sit in your assigned seat or how to behave in the cafeteria. To be honest this place is set up and structured very much like a daycare and the learning system is as well. This place does not prepare your child for the structure of regular school!

My son loved this school. By the time he enrolled into kindergarten, he was already reading!  This school engages children in meaningful play. That means they make teaching fun and the children learn new concepts quickly.
We sure do miss Prek4Sa(East), and His teachers Mrs Arce & Mrs Muniz.

I brought my son here for a few days and he was truly well fed, cared for, and treated like family. The staff is incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional. The entire daycare is clean, organized, and run with real care. I’m very picky about where I send my son, and this place is easily my top choice. If I ever need childcare while I’m at work again, this will be my go to location hands down 👍🏼
I love Miss Luna and so my children, her staff are amazing. Mrs.Luna her self goes above and beyond to make sure my children needs are meet. The atmosphere is more like family than anything.

You can feel confident about the place and the staff from your first visit to the place. They work with the children as a family more than a teacher and students. My daughter 3 years old learns a new good stuff with them, and when we arrive everyday there, she always says I’m so happy 🥹🤩. The price is affordable.

A loving and safe environment! The teachers and staff are incredibly warm, patient, and attentive. My little one absolutely lights up when I mention going to "school," and seeing their excitement every morning reassures me that I made the right choice.

I can’t say enough great things about Luna daycare, from the moment we walked through the door, we felt at ease. The owner is really kind, the facility is clean, safe, and welcoming. Communication with parents is excellent~

My kids have been going here for over 6 years and I honestly don't see them going anywhere. This is the best daycare I have ever had the pleasure of putting my kids at. Each one of my kids has gone here. Would recommend to anyone needing a daycare to come to Klever Kids. The daycare owner Mrs. Nolan is amazing and you can tell she truly cares for the kids as well as their guardians. The teachers here are also amazing and treat the kids so well. Ive seen with my own eyes the connections they've made with each and every kid there.

Klever kids is an awesome daycare very family oriented all the teachers are very loving an caring prices are very reasonable an affordable thank yall for everything yall do if you looking for teachers to treat your kids like there own this is the place Klever kids is amazing my babies are so advanced from the learning they don’t just go outside to play or play with toys all day they teach them very well keep up the good work Klever kids academy me an my family really appreciate yall my kids love it here….

Don't know the facility personally but I saw this truck with a african american older lady driving like a maniac through the streets, almost crashed into us cutting us off, she was also swerving through every car fast cutting everyone else off exceeding the speed limit for sure. Wouldnt trust them giving my kids a ride AT ALL.

This is the best daycare! It really feels like home. My children having been coming here since 3 months old. It is hard to find a daycare you can trust at such a young age, but the teachers here really treat the children like they are their own. The Montessori aspect is the cherry on top! Special shout-out to Kiara for treating my baby girl like her own ❤️ Ms Dana and Ms Sara are the best!

My daughter Emiliia attended this preschool for about a year and a half, and we absolutely loved it! She was always excited to go, and she adored her teachers. The atmosphere was so warm and caring, and as parents we felt completely confident and happy. Our whole family is very grateful for the wonderful experience Emiliia had here! 🌟

Great value for childcare! Our toddler has learned so much through their educational programs. Such as Spanish and patern recognition. They also have optional physical programs for coordination and sports as well. He is also happy to be there and loves talking about his friends there. The staff are really nice and care about his well being!

I just want to say how grateful I am for the two directors at my grandchildren’s school. My oldest grandchild had the privilege of learning under their guidance, and now my granddaughter is enjoying the same wonderful experience. It’s amazing to see how well these two work together — five years and still such a strong team! The improvements and updates they’ve made to the school are truly impressive. Everything looks beautiful, and it’s clear how much care and dedication they put into creating a great environment for the children.

We love this school!  The classrooms are full of engaging, hands-on activities.   There is a sense of community that feels supportive and encouraging.  My granddaughter loves her teachers and looks forward to going to school everyday.
I love the nurturing environment and highly recommend!

We have had our two children going here since they were each 3 months old…and they are now 2 and 4.  Their infant program is probably the best you will find anywhere…and while there has been some turnaround over the years it has worked out for the better 90% of the time.  Since the recent management changeover…the new Director Michelle is incredible and we talk almost every day.  Also the new teachers they have brought in have been much more engaging with the kiddos and you can tell that they genuinely care about each and every one of them.  Shout out to Ms. Robin in Pre-K!  She is the best.  Every time I drop my daughter off she is teaching the kiddos something in an organized circle where all of the kids are focused and listening.  She does experiments and “Question of the Day”, which makes them think about the outside world and how things work.  These photos of my daughter are literally from this morning…and just this week she put large chunks of ice from our recent freeze in a drum and had the kids guess how long they thought it would take to freeze.  It was a great learning experience for them.  Ella knows her ABC’s, is potty trained, and can count all the way to 100 (with one or two glitches).  The best part IMO…is that our kids have become very close friends with some of the other kiddos, because most of the children have stayed there from infant to Pre-K.  It truly has become a healthy small community for us…and we even attend each other’s birthday parties.  You wont be disappointed.

We absolutely love my son’s daycare. The staff is so warm and welcoming every day, and it truly means a lot that they know the kids by name. I really appreciate the camera feature that allows me to check in on my son throughout the day, along with the pictures they share of his learning and development.
The app is amazing — being able to track diaper changes, bottle feedings, and receive a daily summary helps me keep his routine consistent at home. The classrooms are well-structured, and you can tell there’s a thoughtful approach to learning and care.
As a first-time mom who had to start daycare when my son was only 2 months old, I was extremely nervous and scared. Choosing this daycare has been the best decision, and I couldn’t recommend it more to first-time moms who are worried about leaving their child.

My daughter has attend Children’s Courtyard since before she could walk. The core group of teachers there have helped her grow to wonderful toddler. She knows her alphabet, how to count to 20, and every color under the sun!! We had a few wonderful teachers that have left but it seems they always find great ones to fill their roles. We plan on keeping her enrolled even after she starts kindergarten with their after school programs. Thank you for all that you do and for taking great care of our little bear.

What a great place to have your child grow up in! It’s been 7months since we started with the children court yard and we never been happy like this!
