We also like the sproutabout app that keeps us updated with live camera and photos. the place is well cleaned and safe also they serve breakfast, lunch and 2 snacks! They provide diapers and wipes so u don’t have to worry about anything.. so glad we chose this day care for our little guy :) thank you the children court yard

The Spicewood location has undergone new leadership recently. And I have witnessed a significant change in the school. Ms. Michelle the new Director is wonderful and ensures the safety and well being of the kids are put first. The environment is now welcoming and warm. Unfortunately I had to move my son’s daycare so it was closer to his school district. But this daycare is in good hands and your children will be as well. Thank you team for spear heading every situation thrown at your way and being kind to my child ❤️

To say this is the best child care facility on the south side, and possibly the entire city is an understatement. The staff here are phenomenal, loving, caring and very professional. I brought my son here from 2 yrs old until he went into pre-k and my daughter from 10 months until now. My little girl is always as clean if not cleaner than when she is dropped off in the mornings. She loves all the care takers here and always hugs them on her way out. We have had zero issues or any hiccups the entire time both of my kids have been here.  To find this kind of child care is a major blessing to myself and their mother and of course to both my kids. Highly, highly recommended. If you are in need of child care on the south side look no further than teeter totter child care.

The BEST daycare by far! I HIGHLY recommend it!! Well kept, organized, clean & friendly staff. They treat our kid's like family most Importantly with LOVE! home cooked meals and the staff are so generous, every day my daughter Avreet comes home with a different hairstyle(: The directors and staff are very welcoming & AMAZING! if you are looking for a good quality daycare rest assure this is the place to go to.. you will NOT Regret it I give this place 5 stars!!

Very well clean daycare and loving staff. Both my son (16) & daughter (14) attended from 3 months - 11 years old. They loved the activities throughout the day and home cooked meals. My nieces (3) & nephew attended this daycare recommended by one of our sisters. The owners are very nice and occasionally we bring our kids back to visit them and staff. We love them!

We have been so thankful for Teeter Totter Childcare. The owners, Mr. Eddie and Mrs. Joann truly care about each child and what they do. My child has been going since she was 6 months old, she is now 4 years old and off to school soon. She has learned so much and grown up in this daycare. The best part is the staff has not changed in years, when I say years I mean it. My now 15 years old niece attended this daycare when she was little. The menu is great home cooked meals cooked on site and yummy snacks. When I would pick up my child, she was always happy and her hair was always well groomed and she was never dirty. If your trying to find a clean, well ran reliable daycare, Teeter Totter is the place to be.

My little one attended this daycare from 9 months til she was ready to enter pre k. Which was a sad day because it was the last day of daycare. Mrs Joann & Mr Eddie are great and the staff... All the kiddos were always happy. This wonderful place gave me piece of mind knowing my child was well taken care of. Great people and worth every penny.

Escuelita del Alma has been a large part of our family for over 8 years. As parents, we have felt secure each day having our children at Escuelita. The entire teaching staff is warm, giving excellent care to our children. One of our daughters started at 3 months old, and I knew each day she was being cared for by the best. Both of our children easily speak conversational Spanish now with fluency, far surpassing their dual language classmates from other daycares. Escuelita provided wonderful meals every day  and our carb loving kids gladly eat veggies! The environment shows how well loved the children are.

This Spanish Immersion daycare is truly a special place. The staff’s low turnover and the way so many teachers know my child by name—even those who aren’t in her class—make it stand out. They provide high-quality education and care, along with two snacks and a hot lunch each day. Most importantly, the children learn and grow so much during their time here.

Our daughter has been at Escualita coming on 5 years. We love it so much. The administration is so helpful,  attentive, informative, supportive, civically minded, and most importantly loving and nurturing with the children. As our daughter moved into preK and now afterschool from kinder I have been happy with the curriculum and impressed with the strides our daughter has made in things like literacy but also her Spanish language skills. I am so grateful for the strong Spanish foundation  the school has given her. Most of all I adore the community that the school fosters and feel so lucky to have found such a gem of a school for our sweet daughter to grow in! The school also goes the extra mile to organize fun gatherings, like the fall carnival and the end of the year dance performance/graduation which are among the highlights of the year.

Escuelita is certainly a special place! We've had our 3 year old there since he was 3 months old. We love it especially for committed teachers (we have had no teacher turn over in any of his classes in the 3 years we have been there) in fact his current teacher who has the most amazing classroom management with 2-3 year olds has taught there for more than 15 years. We also love that he knows Spanish fluently, a skill he will carry with him through his life. Also, we love the community of families we have met. Pretty much our entire social network is made up of some kind of Escuelita connection. Finally, the food! Our picky eater eats about 3 things at home but I feel ok about it because at least I know he's eating at school. Thank you Escuelita!

Escuelita Del Alma is an amazing school to send your little ones. My 2 year old has attended since about 6 months of age, and he is so well versed in Spanish it is truly motivating. He’s learned so much from his teachers and loves them like family. He cheers every day we pull into the parking lot. Everyone here is so inviting and warm, is a special place. The wait list is worth it!

My daughter has been at this daycare since she was 6 months old. The staff, especially the directors, are so responsive. The teachers are so compassionate and strive to ensure the children learn. They are also culturally sensitive. They celebrate all cultures and provide education to the children to promote cultural  diversity. Precious Kargo Academy is by far the best daycare in the DFW. This daycare has also become family. Please, if you are looking to for a daycare for your child, look no further, PKA is the one!!!

I absolutely love Precious Kargo Academy. The owners and directors are respectful and responsive to parent needs. The facility is always clean and well organized. The staff are kind and courteous. My child has been attending the school for 3 years. She well taken care of and treated like family.

It's been several years since my kids attended this daycare, but when they were there they loved it. They were there when Miss Tara was still running it out of her home and then transitioned into the facility that she is in now. She was always very nice and always showed genuine care and concern for the children.

Love my kids daycare the best so far they have been going here for five years !! The whole staff is amazing and fun my kids love it!! Definitely recommend anyone that wants a loving and supportive daycare facility. Also your children do actually learn here. The best hands down 🙌🏽

I debated whether or not to write this review, but ultimately, I decided to share my experience to prevent others from going through what I did with this childcare facility. My child attended this daycare for just over three months before I finally withdrew them.

First and foremost, the professionalism of the "directors" is non-existent. The way they communicate with parents is entirely unprofessional, particularly Tamara and her sister Tara. They could greatly benefit from etiquette classes. My child was in the infant 2 class, not even 18 months old, and I felt they called me for every minor issue, forcing me to leave work repeatedly. When I arrived at the daycare, there was often nothing wrong with my child. This constant disruption put my job at risk, and Tamara's only explanation was that the teacher in that class was "old school."

Dropping off my child each morning filled me with guilt because it was clear he didn’t like it there. The atmosphere was toxic and negative, and I know my child sensed that energy. Despite my attempts to remain hopeful, things never improved. Tamara's tactics and attitude, combined with Tara's sarcastic comments about my child, were incredibly frustrating.

The only positive aspect of this center was the teacher Jessica. She was amazing with the kids, and my baby adored her. She deserves a better work environment, and I hope she finds one soon.

My school ager has been asked to leave a couple of other programs due to behavioral issues and his ADHD. I was open about this when enrolling him here a couple of years ago. He’s been going for a while now and is absolutely thriving! We had some issues but they have been patient with him and we worked through them. You can tell the staff truly cares about the kids. Special shoutout to Ms Rudi!

Transportation to and from school helps me keep a full work schedule as well as their availability on school holidays. And my son really enjoys all the activities and field trips during the summer program. I don’t know what I’d do without this place.
So far everything has been going nicely. Everyone that works there has been welcoming to me an my family. I get to see what my children are doing throughout the day

I absolutely love love the new director Ms.Rosa  she is so sweet and loving she listens and cares about you. If you have a problem she is there for you and your baby, she took my daughter in and made me feel at home. My family is all in New York and have no one here. I m thankful for Bear creek and the teachers . I would definitely recommend this daycare, thank you so much for making us feel at home.

This is a very great daycare. They have helped my autistic child improve so much. I would highly recommend. I love the Director Ms.Rosa is awesome and sweet she is just the best to care director ever.

I just saw the kindercare van full of children, with some children standing up, pull across 2 lanes of traffic with oncoming vehicles coming towards them. It was so dangerous, the driver should not be allowed to drive these children around if they're not going to be safe. This just happened about 10 minutes ago. Please be aware of who is transporting your children.

A truly wonderful place for our 2 kiddos! The staff is caring and trustworthy and we've been with them for years. Each classroom has its own shaded outdoor play area, which is so rare. Our kids enjoy coming to school, are happy, and well cared for every day. Highly recommend!

We are born and raised Austinites who are now raising our first little one in South Austin. After reaping the benefit of familial care for the first year of their life, it was time to find a new routine with more social interaction. We toured many different daycares and felt a consistent struggle to "choose" some kind of pathway - e.g. getting Spanish immersion but having no real outdoor space, or the like. In the end, we followed a word of mouth recco to CDC South and are so glad we did. It was the only place we toured where we felt fully safe and at ease, as if it were family, and represented the kind of childhood we ourselves had. Plus, as they get older, they'll have the benefit of the greenbelt trails just behind the school and the enclosed pool for water comfort and swim safety. While our specific class is experiencing a change of hands with teachers lately, we've found the communication very proactive. And are finding a growing sense of community in the families that attend alongside.

We changed day cares to find a place where our son could be outside in nature more and we couldn't be happier. This is not a fancy place but it is just right for us. Our son is happy to go to "nature school" every day and comes home looking like he went on sand and mud adventures. We are very happy we made the switch as it is what our son needs.

My 2 year old son goes to CDC, been going there since he was an infant and we absolutely love it! Jaya and all of the teachers are very kind, caring and have always done their best to make my child feel at home and honestly, this makes me very very happy as a mother. The concept of the school- free play- is something I love. Every classroom has its own outdoor playground- my son comes back covered in colors, mud, water- he always has an interesting day.
All in all, I highly recommend CDC!

We absolutely love this place. Both my kids went to CDC and my youngest is at the South location on Convict Hill. My kids love it so much--they come home happy and always in a good mood. They play so much outside and get to swim in the back pool. It's always supervised! Their whole philosophy at CDC is a little different than other day care places, but the kids learn so much and play so well together. Teachers are kind and great with the kids. I highly recommend this place.

On January 14, 2026, my son, a friend, her kiddo, and I stopped by on a day when it was cold and windy. It was my friend's idea.

Admission is free if your little one is 0-2 years old. If you're a member, depending on your membership, you're able to have 2 or more people go in with you for free. Which I feel is definitely worth it, especially if you have kiddos.

I love that it's an interactive museum with many exhibits. You can take your kiddo/s here, and they can be entertained for hours. It's perfect for rainy days, or unfavorable weather days instead of just bring at home with your little one/s. This is a great spot to take them, and they will definitely let all their energy out.

My little one enjoyed the Marvel section, especially since he got to wear a cape, the grocery store they have for the kiddos, as well as other interactive play areas within the museum.

They have a café inside, and I'll have pictures of their menu. Oh, and you have to pay for parking, but if you're a member you're able to get a discount. My son had a good night's sleep after all the walking around. I highly recommend it to anyone who had little ones. They can run around or crawl for hours here.

Tons of interactive displays for children of all ages and lots of unique displays of dinosaurs, oil field equipment, and ranch life. Plus special exhibits for super heros and the barbie world. Grand finally was the omni theater movie Animal Kingdom which was well done.

“I had a fun time at the Fort Worth Museum of Science and History! There’s a good mix of science and history exhibits, from dinos and cowboys to interactive hands-on areas that keep kids busy. The planetarium was also a cool experience that added something different to the visit. It feels great for families and kids especially, though some parts are more geared toward younger visitors and can be a bit dated in spots. Still, it’s a neat place to explore, learn, and spend a couple of hours if you’re in the Fort Worth Cultural District.”  ￼

Super fun and interactive my fire chief had a great time. We are absolutely thrilled with our son's experience at MOLO over the past three years. We've always felt a strong partnership with the staff, receiving regular, insightful feedback on our son's progress and feeling fully confident in their care and expertise.

Molo Bilingual Montessori School has truly transformed our family’s life. From day one, we have received a level of care, support, and dedication that has exceeded all our expectations.

The emotional and social development of the children is a priority, and we’ve seen that reflected in the way our son communicates, expresses himself, and builds relationships.

Now, with the new initiatives such as international travel and cultural exchange experiences with Montessori schools in China, we are even more impressed by the school’s growth and vision. These opportunities are truly extraordinary and reaffirm that Molo is a place with a global outlook, committed to raising citizens of the world.

Molo is not just a school—it is a community that embraces, supports, and transforms. We are profoundly grateful for everything it has meant to us and our son.

We wholeheartedly recommend Molo Bilingual Montessori School with all the confidence and gratitude in our hearts.

This daycare is heaven sent and everything we needed when it came to the care of our little one . All of the staff are amazing & it’s such a blessing to have experienced women who truly pour into your you child in the most loving ways. Thank you for all that you have been to this family!

My boys enrolled at Beautiful Beginners Christian Academy at the ages of 1 and 2 in September 2021 and it has been a true blessing.  My boys have learned such much within a short period. Our daughter’s daycare is truly her second home. From the director to every single staff member, they treat the children with so much compassion, kindness, and genuine care. We are absolutely thrilled with the positive changes since Charnessia Carpenter became the director of our daycare. She truly goes above and beyond in every aspect of her role. Update — I am beyond disappointed with the management at my small wonders. Since the recent changes at My Small Wonders Fort Worth, the difference has been nothing short of amazing. The atmosphere is now incredibly warm, positive, and welcoming every single day. I couldn’t be happier with the experience and highly recommend this daycare to any parent looking for a safe, nurturing, and growth-driven environment.

It is not a safe place for your children. I can assure you. My daughter was only there for a week and I decided to take her out. I made her feel anxious and stressed. I can’t say enough wonderful things about this daycare! My daughter started here at 12 weeks old and stayed all the way through Pre K. From the beginning, the staff treated her with so much love and care.

I don’t think I will find another daycare with teachers that love my son as this place! My toddler is so happy to be here, and always have a smile when we pick him up. They provide real food. I love kids' campus! I moved my son here from another daycare that wasn't run properly and it's like day and night. The staff here is so nice and professional. I sincerely appreciate all the love they have given my son every single day throughout his time here. THANK YOU KID’S CAMPUS 🤍

There was pros and cons for this daycare. When my boys came here several years ago.

Pros:
Some teachers do care about the kids from the few I met at the time.
It's affordable
They do work with you on scheduling
Cons:
Organization was bad in keeping age groups separate.(Babies w/older toddlers.) Possibly due to lack of staff.
Poor/No communication when incidents happen.
Felt the tension in the air between some employees & how the owner ran things.

Then there was my experience and red flags I took from the owner. She was nice but definitely unprofessional and brushed off concerns.
So heres my experience.

I Had 2 kids a 6 month old & a 4 yr old attend here.
I noticed that the owners rambunctious and temperamental grandchild was passed around from class to class in different age groups.
But when he was moved to the babies room with 1 teacher to 3 or 4 babies he stomped around threw toys around and took toys from the babies playing in the mats. The teacher looked stressed but did her best to calm him.
I asked when dropping off my son why was he there. She just mentioned it was the owners grandson. I stuck around for about 5 mins until she finally got him calm with treats. She said he'll be moved by lunch time. Which was soon.
So I said ok, I was running late so I left but made sure I told the front desk that the baby room teacher needed at least 1 more person with the toddler there. They said ok so I left.

Each time I came I observed this toddler goes from class to class and throws off the curriculum from the teachers with the other kids in their age group. Sometimes throwing tantrums and yelling at the teachers. The owner and grandma sometimes stepped in but not sure because a parent was there watching but saw she never corrected his behavior. Just spoiled him with toys and snacks while baby talking when she put him in her office. Then continued doing what she was doing. The boy ended up back in the babies room a different day but around the time I picked my kiddos up. This was a red flag to me. Because the lack of support the teachers had & how much they seem to walk on egg shells to keep their jobs & just deal. But was hoping this was only temp like she said.

There were 3 incidents with my older son with a bully kid his age.

1st incident was the boy broke my son's necklace by pulling it off his neck and laughed. The teacher did act on it appropriately but I was never told by the daycare instead by my son. Then it was confirmed the next day after i found out.

2nd incidents the boy bit my son. Again i didn't hear about this by them but the teacher put the boy in time out & he lost his recess time on the next outing time. From what my son told me & again I confirmed with the teacher the next visit. I tried speaking to the owner then but she was out.

3rd incident and definitely the last. Same boy choked my son. I asked him to show me how by doing role play. He was the other boy and I was him. He showed me and it was definitely on purpose. My son is my eldest & at this point has never rough played with other kids because for the longest he was an only child. Even today he still more of a lover & not a fighter. At this time at the age of 4 he never attempted to lie. He'd even tell on himself.
So I trust my sons words when he said they were inline ready to go out & play. That boy kept teasing him & saying mean words to
my son (in his words). So my son told him to stop or he'll tell & that's when the boy grabbed him by the neck & choked him.

So of course I did not hear about this incident. Until my son told me the next day. Since my mom picks him up while I'm in school for nursing.
So now im livid and show up asking to speak to both teacher and owner. Unfortunately teacher was not there for me to ask. But I was able to speak with the owner.

Basically her response was telling me and my son that our concerns weren't important and I was overreacting.
Because instead her words to the choking and biting.

"Boys will be boys. That's how they play."
Never went back & I had to dropped out of school. I no longer trust daycares.

The lady Lisa at the front desk didn't hear the door open or see me standing at the window, when I interrupted her conversation with another employee she was short with me. When she opened the door I was amazed when I walked in during nap to find the front classroom unattended and older kids laying in the walkways as a form of punishment while the others where watching a movie! You would think nap time is quiet time, wrong! This place had no control over the children. There was food still on the kitchen counter from lunch and I could hear dogs barking in the office. When I asked to view the restrooms, she told me the boys was out of order but would be fixed soon. The place had boxes on either side of the walkways which made them narrow, this is a fire hazard and should not be allowed. When we walked outside to the infant room there was a lot of stuff stacked under the patio which left no shaded are for the children to rest while outside playing. The outdoor play area had absolutely no shade! We are in Houston and it is too hot for anyone to be outside for extended  amounts of time without any shaded areas to rest. The water fountain outside doesn't work either! Overall my experience here was horrible. Needless to say I have found another center that meets my needs and expectations to ensure my children are in good hands and safe while I am at work.

Only 1 star because I had to, otherwise I would have gave 0!

review_text: Love, Love Love! Everyone here is caring and amazing. My son is 4 and loves coming and wants to come on weekends. He has learned so much! I am a mom who has been extremely picky about daycares and I highly recommend Smile of A Child Learning Center.

Let me begin by saying that my child has had an amazing experience at Green Sprout (GS) and I would highly recommend this school. GS is a very special place. The school provides some of the highest quality care and education I’ve seen or heard of occurring at any daycare (and I'm an education researcher). I’m impressed with the school across aspects. The school leaders do a great job recruiting, training, and retaining amazing teachers (no easy task) and the montessori, play-based with guidance philosophy of education is consistent across teachers in the school. Unlike many early childhood centers, every teacher is terrific and there is a low level of turnover in the teachers. The school administrators and teachers are very thoughtful about the physical environment (without going overboard). Most basically, the school is very clean and safe. But, beyond that, all the toys and activities are carefully curated and frequently rotated to give students new, stimulating learning experiences and the outdoors space is very nice. The sense of community is strong (but not burdensome). The administration is organized, clear, and kind, with excellent communication skills. The teachers are also great about keeping parents informed about what is going on at school. My 1 year old child sincerely loves the people at Green Sprout. When I bring her there in the morning, it's like bringing her to hang with extended family. My only regret is that I'm having to leave this school too soon due to a move out of Austin.

I describe this place as “if Miss Honey from Matilda had a school it would be this one.”

We’ve been coming for almost a year and it’s been the best decision we’ve made. Warm, creative, and full of genuine care and with an incredible community too. We feel so lucky to have found it.

Mi Casa Child Center (Timber path location) has been my choice in daycare to take 3 of my kids over the years. They have always provided care and attention to my kids. My kids have all learned so much because they actually have a curriculum they work on in each class. Once out of daycare and onto elementary my kids have always been kinder ready because they learn so much at Mi Casa. Teachers and staff all are welcoming, caring and give attention to the kids. I love the app for our phones , teachers post pictures and updates throughout the day, makes me feel good knowing what their day has been consisting of. I also Love the extra attention they put into special occasions and holidays for the kids and families.

When we moved to Texas our daughter was only three and she had never been in daycare. Mi Casa made the transition very smooth for her. Her classroom was structured even though she was only in the 3’s. They encouraged her to learn all the basics (ABCs, Numbers, and good values). She was still in diapers at the time and they even encouraged potty training with a full potty training contract. It was really great to be supported with something we were working on at home. The teachers are very communicative and will let you know if there are any issues throughout the day and how best to address it at home so everyone is on the same page. She is now in the preschool class and we get photo updates daily of all the little activities they’re doing throughout the day. They offer different activities during the day through outside companies that you can sign your child up for so weekends aren’t taken up by extra curricular activities. Our daughter really enjoys soccer and music. They have different spirit weeks throughout the year and communicate consistently through an app. It’s been a really great experience. Even though she’s no longer with her first teacher (from the 3s class), every time she sees her, the teacher acknowledges her and gives her high fives and hugs (shout out to Ms. Cindy!) and our daughter still talks about how much she loves her. Overall we feel like our daughter will be well prepared for kindergarten and the staff at Mi Casa Timberpath has taken amazing care of our daughter and taught her so much. We definitely recommend this location if you’re looking for child care.

Our granddaughter has attended Mi Casa at Timberpath for over a year. Now at 2yrs old she excels in knowing shapes, colors, the alphabet & more. I applaud them for the curriculum & activities they do on a daily.  Our granddaughter has learned so much in their care & the best part is she enjoys going to school there. I do not recommend enrolling your child at Cityscape Early Childhood Center. I had to withdraw my daughter because of ongoing safety concerns and lack of communication from the school. During the first week of school, my daughter was moved to multiple classrooms without my knowledge. The first couple of days when I picked her up, she was with a different teacher. When she was moved again, I met the new teacher, and after school my daughter told me that the new teacher she was moved in with had hit her. I met with the principal the next morning to explain what happened. He said he would look into it, and I asked for her to be switched to a different class. I never got a clear answer or any follow-up of what happened. I met a different teacher again, but later that day I called to check on her, I was told she had been switched to another class and that I could come back to meet yet another teacher after school. The next day I asked the principal if he had figured out what happened or spoken to the teacher that hit her maybe it was a misunderstanding? either way she shouldn’t have put her hands on my daughter. He basically just said that my daughter had already been moved to a different class. It felt like my concerns were brushed off. As far as I know she was not held accountable and she is still working there. Once my daughter was finally settled, and doing well in her new class, her afternoon teacher left the school. Once again, I was not informed that it was her class that was moved to a different teacher for her afternoon class. I found out from another parent that even her class size had gone from 16 students to 25. The next day my daughter came home and told me that a boy classmate had asked her a very inappropriate question about her. With that many kids in one classroom, I truly don’t believe the teachers can watch everyone closely enough. I went to the school extremely upset and spoke with her teacher, then contacted the principal about the student also about the class size being to many kids in her class, He said he would update me about what happened with the student and figure out what happened, but I never heard anything back. He also told me the number of students was appropriate and that they would not be hiring another teacher. This made me very uncomfortable, as I did not feel my daughter was being properly supervised or kept safe. After repeatedly not getting updates and continuing to feel uneasy about my daughter’s safety, I made the decision to withdraw my daughter. When I went up to the school to unenroll her the principal didn’t even come out of his office and he told the front desk worker to write me down a number to call to unenroll her.  Overall, I did not feel that my daughter’s safety was taken seriously at this school. I believe the principal communication was poor and needs to better his communication with parents, because concerns were dismissed, and I did not feel at ease leaving my child in their care.

Coming from recent events with family that attends this church:

I’m writing this review out of genuine concern, not bitterness. Scripture warns believers to be discerning, as “false prophets come in sheep’s clothing” (Matthew 7:15) and “Satan disguises himself as an angel of light” (2 Corinthians 11:14). Unfortunately, the teaching at this church reflects those warnings rather than the freedom of the Gospel. Messages often emphasize control, fear, and unquestioning obedience instead of humility, grace, and personal accountability before God. Forgiveness is taught without healthy boundaries, and Scripture is selectively used in ways that pressure rather than heal. Questioning leadership or doctrine is discouraged instead of being tested against the full counsel of Scripture. Galatians 1:6–8 strongly warns against preaching a distorted gospel, even when it comes from those claiming spiritual authority. Jesus never taught blind trust or spiritual coercion. A church should lead people closer to Christ, not into dependency on leadership. I encourage anyone considering this church to read the Bible for themselves and carefully discern what is being taught.

OPERATION_NAME: Bright Horizons at Plaza of Americas
review_text:
We couldn’t be happier with Bright Horizon at Plaza of the Americas! From the moment we walked in, we felt welcomed and supported. The teachers are incredibly caring, patient, and attentive. Not only do they provide a safe environment, but they also go above and beyond to nurture each child’s development.

My son absolutely loves going every day. He’s learning so much through play, art, and structured activities, and it’s clear the staff truly care about his growth and happiness. The communication with parents is excellent too. They keep us updated and make us feel like real partners in his learning journey.

If you’re looking for a place where your child will be safe, loved, and encouraged to thrive, I highly recommend it. It feels like a second home for our family, and I’m so grateful we found them!

OPERATION_NAME: Bright Horizons at Plaza of Americas
review_text: Absolutely love this location. Best choice we ever made for our son. He’s been there almost two years now and finishing up with one more year to go. Nicole and Tracy have been so impactful in both his learning as well as nurturing him to be a better human. The director is also amazing (knows every child and parents by name) and goes out of her way to make your child the most comfortable they can be away from home.

OPERATION_NAME: Bright Horizons at Plaza of Americas
review_text: I wouldn’t want to go to any other daycare. They are so incredibly loving and meet each child where they are. The meals, education and learning aspect is TOP tier! We are so grateful.

OPERATION_NAME: Bright Horizons at Plaza of Americas
review_text:
Deciding who to trust for childcare is a major decision for any working parent. Our experience with Bright Horizons from 6 mo to 2 years age range has been outstanding so far. Very consistent, sensitive, communicative, flexible, and thoughtful from management to the front desk to the classroom. Great value with easy to use app. Our kiddo is excited to go every day. I imagine that experiences come down mostly to who you have as teachers and for us Pablo, Adria, and Michelle, to name a few, have been such a pleasure to work with.

We had been on the waitlists at multiple other high-end childcare spots but declined them all after visiting as they could not match the thoughtfulness and enthusiasm present in our Bright Horizons classrooms.

Being inside Plaza of the Americas made drop off a bit confusing at first as you park (free for drop off) in the garage on the 4th floor and take an elevator down to the ground level (LL, not L) but now I find it very simple. Our kiddo loves the glass elevators and we get a short beautiful walk together in and out every day. Check-in is very simple and I have never waited in a long line of cars for drop off or parking as is common with free-standing locations.

This place is a hidden gem and I suspect that the somewhat atypical location stops it from having a waitlist a mile long — lucky us!

OPERATION_NAME: Bright Horizons at Plaza of Americas
review_text: My kids have been going to BH Plaza of the Americas for almost two years after an extremely poor experience at another center nearby. The teachers are amazing. My kids talk about their friends and teachers at home. They are thriving in their learning environment and the teachers and staff are extremely supportive.

Unfortunately, we had a terrible experience with Esperanza. We did not feel that our daughter received proper care. Ultimately, she developed a serious infection as a result and it lead to months of doctors appointments to get things under control.

I would recommend another daycare.

Esperanza school provided a fun and safe learning environment. My son was able to thrive socially and academically as a result of the lessons and constant introduction to new things. There are great outdoor learning and play areas. All of the teachers knew us by name and as he moved through the school were constantly providing him encouragement.   The school also provided many opportunities for family involvement and parent interaction leading to outside friendships for families and a strong support network. I would recommend.

My children have been attending Esperanza for several years and we love it. All of the teachers are so caring and the kids love going to school. There is a strong sense of community at the school and the staff does a good job to engage all families with the monthly play dates, children’s performances, fall festival, special parent events for some holidays and events to showcase their children’s work/art. I highly recommend Esperanza.

We have been attending Esperanza for 7 years and we have been very happy with the quality of education our kids have received. The teachers have all been very caring and warm, which creates a safe and supportive environment. The school creates a strong community with other parents through organized play dates, festivals, parades, and other activities. My wife says when you step on the campus you can feel that it is a “happy place.”

We have had such a positive experience at Esperanza! The teachers are so kind and many of them have been there for years and years. The school goes above and beyond to create a community for parents to connect with other families. I love that kids get ample time to be outside each day. The campus is large and kids move to different rooms and playgrounds throughout the day to keep things interesting. I would absolutely recommend Esperanza to other families looking for a high quality daycare.

I highly recommend Soaring Eagles Academy Daycare! My daughter is 2 years old and has been enrolled for a year or so . The staff is incredibly caring, patient, and truly dedicated to the children. From the moment you walk in, you can feel the warm and welcoming environment they’ve created. The teachers do a wonderful job balancing learning and play, helping the kids grow both academically and socially.

The facility is clean, organized, and safe, which gives me peace of mind knowing my child is in good hands every day. Communication with parents is also great—they keep us updated and are always willing to answer questions or address concerns.

It’s clear that the team genuinely loves what they do, and it shows in the way they interact with the kids. My child looks forward to going every day, which says a lot. I’m very grateful for the care and attention they provide. Thank you to everyone at Soaring Eagles Academy for creating such a positive and nurturing place for children!

Soaring Eagles Academy is amazing! My children, ages 3 and 7, are always happy, well-fed, and their homework is done when I pick them up. They love it so much they don’t even want to leave. I truly appreciate the care and love the staff give them. Highly recommend!

We have loved the experience thus far. My two go all day and one goes after school!!! They are always clean, well fed, and happy when we pick them up! Both boys have a little separation anxiety and they make drop offs so easy for them! We love this school
This place is clean and safe the teachers and the owner is so sweet! This place is good place to send your child.I recommend great communication!

This daycare has truly been a blessing for my family. As a first-time mom, it was so important for me to find a place with trustworthy, caring people and this daycare exceeded all my expectations. The staff is loving, patient, and genuinely cares about each child as if they were their own. My kids feel safe, happy, and excited to come every day and that peace of mind means everything to me. They are also incredibly understanding and willing to work with you when life happens, which is rare and so appreciated. Communication is great, the environment is clean and nurturing, and you can tell they put their heart into what they do. I’m beyond grateful for the care, trust, and support they’ve shown my family. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a compassionate and dependable daycare.

I remember coming here with a day pass my buddy sent in through the app.

I did not know he had to be present. I understood I couldn’t get in without him, so I texted my friend to see if he could make it.

I was there waiting for about 30 min.

Every 5 min the people at the front kept saying are you buying the day pass.

I said I’m waiting to see if my friend would come.

Susan and I came to Oak Hill UMC 32 years ago after trying several Methodist churches in the West and Southwest parts of Austin. OHUMC Christian Services are excellent with caring, knowledgeable pastors and an absolutely outstanding choir and music program. However, what truly puts our church in an elite domain is the FELLOWSHIP and community SERVICE. Come see the hands, feet, heart and love of Christ at work in Oak Hill.

I don’t consider myself a “churchy” person yet my husband and I came to this church because of their committed, front-lines involvement supporting the most vulnerable population of folks in our community: the homeless. Upon visiting our first Sunday worship service two years ago, I immediately knew we had found something special. The homeless mission is just the tippy top of the iceberg here. ALL are welcome and we live into that statement! As we say each Sunday, “All means all. And that’s all.” Come be a part of the All as God intended it to be.

I grew up going to OHUMC and explored other churches around Austin once I had a family of my own. After COVID, when things started becoming in-person again, we decided to try it out. We are now members, actively involved in Sunday School, and volunteer within other ministries throughout the church. Our Sunday School has become a close community of families that are enjoying sharing life and watching our kids grow up together. Everyone is very welcoming and friendly and eager to get to know you more. A common message is, "All means all -- and that's all" and it couldn't be more true. They truly are just so happy for you to be there, no matter your background.

Last year, I started looking for a new church home. I made a list of places to visit with OHUMC at the top. I experienced such a warm welcome that I never visited any of the other churches on my list. I've been attending since that day and will be celebrating my 1 year membership anniversary next week. Some things that attracted me and kept me going back are the many small groups, the amazing choir and sermons, and the warm welcoming community. This congregation also believes in being the hands and feet of Jesus. They host many opportunities to help our neighbors and provide needed relief for those who are struggling with food insecurity, homelessness, and spirituality. To me, this church community really leans into putting Jesus’ teachings into action in everyday life.
Oak Hill United Methodist Church in Austin welcomes all and is enormously supportive through volunteer work with community at large, especially those in need.

We absolutely love Explore Montessori! From the moment we enrolled, the staff has been so warm, caring, and attentive to our children's needs. The teachers create a safe, nurturing environment where the kids can learn, play, and grow every day.

Clean facility, good administrator.

The school’s communication is outstanding—they keep me updated throughout the day with messages, pictures, and videos. The staff is always warm and welcoming, and my daughter is so happy here that some days she doesn’t even want to leave! We couldn’t be happier with our experience—this school is truly wonderful!
When I say my son loves this school it’s unbelievable! theses teachers really love theses kids and teach them new things everyday. I recommend this school to everyone

I highly recommend this academy preschool to any family looking for a nurturing and engaging environment.

Mrs. Ramirez is an exceptional Head of School whose leadership, dedication, and heart truly set her apart. She leads with integrity, compassion, and a clear vision that inspires both staff and students to be their very best. Her presence on campus is felt in the most positive way—she is approachable, supportive, and deeply invested in the success and well-being of everyone in the school community.

Mrs. Ramirez has an incredible ability to balance high expectations with genuine care. She empowers her team, listens thoughtfully, and leads by example, creating a culture of trust, respect, and excellence. Under her leadership, the campus continues to grow not only academically, but also as a welcoming, inclusive, and uplifting environment.

It is clear that Mrs. Ramirez does not simply manage a school—she nurtures a community. Her passion for education and commitment to students shine through in everything she does. Our campus is truly better because of her leadership, and we are incredibly fortunate to have Mrs. Ramirez guiding us.

We feel incredibly grateful to be part of Bezos Academy, wonderful Montessori school.
Director Xochitl is the best and has an amazing team from the warm welcome each morning by Lily to the teachers that are caring, patient, and truly dedicated to each child’s growth and well-being. it’s a nurturing environment where children grow in confidence, independence, and happiness.

I am absolutely thrilled with our experience at Bezos Academy! It is rare to find a program that so deeply aligns its actions with its mission to put children first. From the moment you walk through the doors, it is clear that this school is built to provide a high-quality, nurturing environment that helps children thrive.

The educators at Bezos Academy are truly special. They are passionate, patient, and deeply attentive to the individual needs of each child. I’ve found the teachers to be, not only well-trained in the Montessori-inspired curriculum but truly invested in fostering a love of learning. With multiple staff members in each classroom, the children receive wonderful one-on-one attention, helping them feel secure and supported throughout the day.

The leadership is top-notch. The Head of School is both experienced and deeply caring, maintaining high standards while creating a warm, inclusive, and welcoming culture for families. It is clear that the leadership team focuses on open communication and ensures that every decision keeps the child’s best interests in mind.

Another great aspect is the focus on healthy, nutritious meals. Bezos Academy provides delicious breakfasts, lunches, and snacks, allowing me to rest easy knowing my child is properly nourished and energized to learn throughout the day. It is a wonderful peace of mind knowing they are eating high-quality meals rather than just empty snacks.

It is evident that the "child-first" philosophy is not just a marketing phrase, but the daily reality. The curriculum is intentionally designed to encourage independence and critical thinking, helping children develop, not just academically, but socially and emotionally. The school environment feels safe, stimulating, and perfectly tailored to spark curiosity and confidence in young learners.

Enrolling my child at Bezos Academy was the best decision I could have made. The combination of expert staff, fantastic leadership, healthy nutrition, and a genuine, nurturing environment makes this, in my opinion, one of the best early childhood education options available.
We’ve had a wonderful experience at this school! The teachers are caring, attentive, and truly dedicated to the kids. The director is always so friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend!!!

The KINDERCARE at Judson at Stahl is the absolute BEST!! Our daughter has been thriving and meeting milestones she hadn’t been meeting at other daycares/nannies). Her teachers and the center director/assistant director are knowledgeable, professional, caring, and supportive! I love them!

This facility always goes the extra mile to support student growth and a positive atmosphere. They have students create the cutest artwork and make it a point to make every family feel special and welcome.
I recently had to switch daycares to improve the time of my commute. My only complaint is that I wish I had found this facility sooner and enrolled my other children.

The staff is great. This is a family centered facility. They treat the children as if they are own. Children and parents/Guardians are acknowledged by name every time they enter an exit the facility. I highly  recommend the facility. I love that you can log on seeing daily photos and updates. They focus on fun and education. Kids love it.

I can't say enough wonderful things about the school.  They're producing 'graduates' that will be the thinkers and leaders of tomorrow.

Amazing teachers and staff, I love that they serve healthy food to the kids and treat each kid with so much love and care.

This daycare has been AMAZING the past year my son has been there. The teachers are always so loving, patient and truly invest in my son’s life. We have no worries dropping him off every day. Highly recommend to anyone considering!

I’m so thankful we made kindercare bunker hill our daycare for our daughter. They have made our transition to daycare seamless! This center is the best Kindercare center hands down!!! Love you all and all the wonder teachers and kids god bless this place always!!!

I absolutely adore this daycare. When you think about child care you want a place you can trust, somewhere your child can thrive and here you’ll find that for certain. Ms Marshonda has been nothing but helpful since my first day when I came to tour the place.

My child been enrolled for 3.5 years now and I love how interactive they are with the kids and always fun holiday events. Hands down best daycare in San Antonio they really care for the kids. We tried several others daycares prior and were unhappy until we switched her to primrose I highly recommend!

If I could give Primrose 1 million beautiful stars I truly would!!!!! The best school for our 3 year old! As a mother of 2 under 3 years old, let me rephrase; a true mama bear I am always overly critical of the care thats provided for both of our babies but with Primrose I have truly never worried. The kindest, most patient, passionate staff who I have always felt truly love my baby. Every single person in their staff is always welcoming when we come to school everyday!  Our 3 year old has a very strong personality but even with her personality everyone is always so kind to her. At 3 years old we have seen so many beautiful changes in her with their help. This suggests that the teachers are happy with the environment, and it translates to them being happy as they work with the kids and treating the kids very well.
