Mrs. Lori and the entire team of teachers are nothing short of a godsend. The love, patience, and grace they pour into every child are beyond words. They don’t just teach—they cherish, encourage, and uplift these little ones in a way that makes every single day feel magical. My kiddos absolutely adore being here; they never want to leave at the end of the day!

The thought of my last little one moving on to elementary school is enough to bring me to tears because leaving this incredible preschool will feel like leaving family. If you are searching for the best preschool in the area—stop right now. You’ve found it. All Stars Academy is pure gold. They will make your child feel safe, special, and so very loved. We are forever grateful for the beautiful foundation they have given our children.

The BEST Preschool! The teachers are genuinely loving and care for each one of their students. They do a great job teaching them and helping them grow. The classroom is full of learning activities that help them play and learn at the same time which is what young children need.
I had children at All Stars for 4 years and they enjoyed every minute of it. Mrs. Lori is the sweetest, most patient woman and she made my kids feel welcomed and loved with her everyday.
Highly recommend All Stars Academy!

Ms. Lori and her team are amazing! My son was with them for 2 years and I am completely confident in his preparedness for kindergarten. My son loved going to her school and begged every day to not go home. Ms. Lori loves each child as her own, but doesn't coddle, and helps preschoolers learn correct school behavior. All Stars Academy is a great place for kids to learn.

A wonderful Pre-K program that fully prepared my daughter for school in SW Austin.    Mrs. Lori is one of those great teachers that kids and parents alike instantly resonate with.  All of the staff here love their jobs and it shows.  We are so lucky that both of our girls got to experience such a successful, loving and nurturing introduction to the world of learning.
The best preschool! Mrs Lori and her team are real gems!! So incredibly grateful for them!

I can not express how happy I am with this place ! They are truly amazing ! All the teachers love the little ones and everyone is always so happy. When my son started daycare here it was like a completely new kid ! The teachers have teach him to express himself more . He’s slowly starting to make words and he loves to play with he’s friends . Every morning he’s happy to be here.  I don’t have to worry about food because they notify me of EVERYTHING and provide lots of pictures with meals included and activities. This place truly deserves some attention. I’ve never been so happy with a daycare before. ❤️

We recently enrolled our 16 month old daughter. Firstly they were so accommodating of our schedules where they did a tour with my husband and then with me later in the week. Secondly, we are so impressed with how all the staff members work together to create a safe and wonderful environment for all the children. You can really tell they genuinely do what’s best for all the kids to meet their individual needs and goals. They’re very organized and very clean so the facility is well maintained. Thirdly and most importantly, our baby loves it! We keep up with her day through Brightwheel and she always looks so happy and calm. She’s always smiling when looking and talking to her teachers. As a working parent, it eases my mind knowing she’s at a really great place! I highly recommend this facility 😊

Absolutely a hidden gem! I am so fortunate to have found Better Beginnings llc on 529. I have had my 10 month old in attendance since mid-December, and I could not imagine sending her anywhere else. I love the staff here. They treat my daughter like family, and I know she is well cared for.  The classroom ratios are small, so my baby gets the attention she should. She has advanced so much since she started there and is always happy at drop off, which gives me a huge peace of mind during the day.  She’s made friends in her age group and has gained social skills as well as developmental skills. I love that I am able to see her schedule through their parent app, and I can call anytime to check in on her. The staff are genuine and welcoming. I would strongly recommend them to anyone seeking quality child care for their children.

This review is long due. My baby has been going there for more than 6 months now. And honestly I can't complain about anything yet. The whole stuff members are so friendly towards kids and parents that, I feel like it's my baby's second home. The campus is very clean and organized. Me and my husband get updates of my baby through their app including activity pics, time for nap, food, potty etc. My baby loves the food they serve there. I can't thank them enough for all the care and affection they have been giving to my baby. A huge shout out to Ms Lorena, Ms. Juana, Ms Lamia , Ms. Luvia and all the other staffs for all their efforts to keep the children safe and happy. The best daycare any parent can ask for !!!

I am very grateful for finding Better Beginnings Academy on 529.  My 15 month old is very well taken care of by the staff.  I struggled to find a place where he would be genuinely cared for and happy, until I brought him here.  After about 3 weeks, he went from having separation anxiety from me, to wanting to go to “school” every morning to be with Ms. Maria and his friends.  Ms. Maria is wonderful with the little ones.  Ms. Lorena is excellent at communicating how my son is doing and providing me updates. All the staff are amazing and care for the kids like they were their own family.  Words cannot express how content I am. After I drop him off, I know he is safe and I don’t have to worry about him while I work.  When I pick him up, he is happy.  All the positive reviews before mine were true.  If you want a place you can trust that will provide a safe, fun, and educational environment, take a tour and try Better Beginnings.
We have loved our experience at CDC.  Caring teachers and good families make all of the difference.

The teachers absolutely love on our little girl. She lights up when we drop her off in the morning and is just as excited to see us in the afternoon. It's been a great place! The director, Laura, and assistant director, Dana, go out of their way to make sure the children are loved, looked after, and safe. The teachers are very engaged with the children and our daughter's breadth of knowledge has exploded since she has been at CDC. I will say that the the woman who posted the one-star review below has not had her child in attendance for over a year now. Please give this place a look-- you and your family will be so happy.

I am proud to be a current parent at Preston Hollow.  The past "issues" have been long resolved and the New Directors are amazing.  It's unfortunate that the ex-parent leaving the negative reviews can't see what the new and improved CDC has to offer and appreciate that the school made a tremendous effort to be what it is today!!  My Daughter has been here since she was an infant and we are now well into the Toddler years and I love watching her amazing growth within this school and how happy she is every single day!!  The children are safe and well loved, I promise!

We had our 2 children in a wonderful daycare downtown (Young Stars CDC) for over 3 years but when we moved to northwest Dallas and when my wife no longer worked downtown we needed to find another daycare closer to home.  We chose Preston Hollow CDC and they had big shoes to fill but my goodness, have they filled those shoes and then some!  Dana and Laura are the 2 managers/administrators of the school and they are so kind, will listen to any concerns parents have, and run a safe, thriving and fun child development center.

The teachers are absolutely amazing as well!  From Miss Rubina, Miss Angie, Miss Emily and Miss Ashley, they all love and teach our children with patience, kindness and discipline which is such a balancing act to do well.  Yet they all handle the balancing act of teaching very professionally and our kids truly enjoy and love their teachers.  They teach the curriculum exceptionally and every week our kids surprise us with how much they're learning!  We are so thankful for our teachers and probably don't tell them enough how much we appreciate the people they are and how they pour into our son and daughter.

In conclusion, the cleanliness of Preston Hollow CDC is top notch and the pickup and drop-off protocol is seamless and safe for the kids.  The tuition is very fair for a CDC of this caliber and in fact, it's a few hundred dollars/month less than several other "name brand" daycares in the area.  If you are looking for a wonderful place for your kiddos I can't recommend Preston Hollow CDC enough!

We've had our daughter here for over a year now and we've all loved the experience. All of her teachers have been exceptional and she talks about them at home very affectionately. Laura and Dayna in the main office run things very smoothly and are always on top of parent notifications. I can't say enough good things! We're changing schools in the Fall to start a PK-12 program and will be sad to say goodbye.

We loved it here so much ❤️ I had my two littles here and they still ask where Ms Kelle is 😭❤️

I care a lot about what my kids eat and they do not disappoint, they ate better than I did for sure 🫣 they were basically family. My kids learned so much and they broke out of their shells. My boy was learning to talk so fast too!

They give back to the community and I absolutely love that ❤️

Butterfly Academy will always have a special place in our family

To the person reading this... I can only tell you that your little one can not ever be in better hands! My kids  and I were blessed enough to have run into Mrs Kelle when I was desperate looking for a daycare because the previous one was a very horrible experience. They not only cared for my kids, but also my piece of mind.  Here your kids will thrive and grow in every way while making true loving connections. My kids are now older and we still come over to visit because Butterfly academy became part of our life!  Thank you so much Mrs Kelle and all of you!  Please do yourself and your kids a favor... call Mrs Kelle and trust them, you will be lucky to have them in your life!

Absolutely Love Butterfly Academy! They are patient, kind and caring to my little ones. We consider Butterfly Academy a 2nd home. The staff here go above and beyond everyday. I also love how the owner Mrs.Kelle keeps in touch with me about my little ones. I would recommend them 10/10! One of the BEST childcare facilities I've seen so far!

I moved my daughter here bc her last daycare was a nightmare! Kelle and the staff are amazing! She is so observant with the kids and their individual needs! I 100 percent recommend this place!!!! They will literally bend over backwards to ensure you and your child feel welcomed, loved, and at home!!!  I just can’t say enough about this place!!!!

The most amazing daycare! My daughter has been here since she was 3 months old, I am so happy I found Mrs. Kelle. I can tell she truly love what she does, she is very hands on with teaching the children as well as their care. I bring my daughter here and can leave peacefully knowing that she will be receiving the upmost care from Mrs. Kelle and her staff. My daughter loves going to daycare, she has so much fun and also learns very important skills for her age group.

This is a great daycare.  Two of my kids have gone here.  My almost 1 year old daughter currently attend CRA and loves it.  She gets so excited when I drop her off in the mornings.  She likes her teachers who give her excellent care and attention.  All the teachers are caring, attenentive, and keep her engaged.  They keep me updated throughout the day on her feedings, naps, milestones, etc.

I’ve brought my son to the daycare since I had to go back to work at 6 weeks. He’s 18 months now, and we plan on keeping him until he’s old enough to attend the PreK in the district I teach in.

I love the daycare teachers here, especially Grace, Athena, and Ciara. All three show love for all their students, as well as kindness and gentle correction as appropriate for the age. Definitely recommend.

I enrolled my daughter back in February during an emergency, and from the very first tour, she felt loved and cared for. Ms. Kassandra, her teacher, has been absolutely wonderful with her, and the entire staff has always been so helpful and supportive. We are truly grateful for the care she receives every day.

CRCA was such a great learning center for my daughter. She has passed her friends in all academics. Kindergarten was a success, looking forward to all she will learn in 1st grade! My daughter has attended Crossroads since she was 11 months old. She has had the best experiences.

Crossroads Christian Academy is a great academy to trust and have your kids where they’ll learn about Jesus at an early age. Mrs Lisa(Director) and staff are the best, always checking on their kids and keeping parents notified of daily activities via their app where you can also reach out with any concerns with fast response back.

I leave my girls with peace of mind knowing that they are in great hands, had taken them since 4 mnths old and I see them growing there. Thank you Mrs Lisa & staff for all you do with love and passion 💞
Hands down one of the best facilities I've ever had my child attend. Staff so amazing! They do so much for the kids and community. The support they provide is phenomenal!

If yall ever looking for a daycare I highly recommend Little Hoppers Learning Center 10/10✨ they treat each and every baby just like they own🫶🏾 they love my babies and my babies love them❤️ best daycare ever…when I say no child left behind!!!! They actually mean that!!! We love and appreciate this Daycare/School🥰
The best learning center a parent could ask for thank you to the amazing staff for taking care of the babies and helping them reach their learning goals

When you walk in the door it is friendly faces welcoming smell good. And the mother of the center is always happy and keeping the families laughing. The FA is friendly and helpful with resources and the food is awesome!
All 4 of my boys have attended this learning center from infancy until they were school age. The staff is so loving and caring with the kids and like family. Thank you for all you do with my babies.

Both my kids have attended they have learned so much and enjoyed all the love from all the staff very clean and welcoming environment! My son is in the two year old class and his teacher Ms. Josie is great she truly loves my son and is very passionate. Ms Kay is a wonderful Director and Avelina always makes us feel welcomed would highly recommend. Great communication and lots of family engagement!

The staff here is amazing! Mr Guerra, Amanda, and Miranda are all great wonderful people. My kids have been going here almost 2 years now and the staff has just been phenomenal! I’ve had issues with my son there lately due to environmental changes within our home, but the staff at Guardian Angel are so considerate and have worked with me thru the issues. I believe the staff really has their best interest in the children that attend there. They even have great learning activities within the classrooms. I have noticed much growth within my children over the past 2 years. They really enforce gentle teaching. I have had nothing but great experiences here and would definitely recommend them to my friends and family!

On the contrary my daughter has been at Guardian Angel since she was 6 months old and they have taken very good care of her. I have dealt with both Miranda and Amanda and they both have communicated with me with my daughters  progress. My daughter was having trouble going down for her nap time (Laura) and Mr. Guerra would  be hangs on with her including Miranda. Then I started having issues with her behavior, but I addressed the issue on her on where it was coming from , and we work together as team to resolve the issue. I work full time and yes they called us one time not to take in our child due to being short staff. I have talk to other centers who are short staffed as well and follow the same protocol. Not sure what went one with the other parent who wrote the  previous comment and the extend of the situation,  but again my daughter is a hand full and they have worked with me. I have seen it first hand myself that Miranda doesn't favor any kids and she has been very patient with me and my Aunt. The entire staff has been very helpful :)

We have been taking our children to Guardian Angel Daycare since 2014, and the experience we've had has always been positive. Our kids love it there...The owners and teachers are wonderful!!! They have a great heart and want the best for all the children who have been trusted to their care. They make us feel welcomed whenever we drop off our kids and pick them up. I can tell that most of the teachers love what they do, you cannot be successful as a daycare worker if you do not love children....they care and we appreciate all that they do for our kids and all the children at the center. This daycare has been serving the south side of San Antonio for decades now, and I must say, they are doing a great job and definitely doing something right!!!...All I know is, there is no PERFECT daycare out there...you can only work with what you have, provided you know that your children are safe, loved and cared for... everything else I believe would fall into place...it is a collaborative effort!

To Mr. & Mrs. Guerra and the Guardian Angel staff, please keep up the good work, and may God continue to bless you as you serve our precious little angels...I absolutely recommend this daycare to anyone looking for a place where their children can feel safe and cared for. We appreciate all that you do! Thank you....

I love Guardian Angel Child Development Center Mrs. Guerra always made me feel apart of her family. I have worked here for a year and daughter has attended since she was 6 weeks. I would not trust her with anyone other than Ms. Amanda in the infant room. They do great art work and give the children they deserve and need. We do have a few negative reviews from some disgruntled parents however we’re only shared after they were released from our center. Come in and give us a chance. 😁

My kid went to Dorson. You send your kid here you are desperate or just don’t care about your child. I will never encourage anyone to take their child here. My grandson had an accident (poop) and was poor cleaned then when the young lady seen I was livid the little came out with gloves and wipes. I told her no thanks I got it and that was the last time I allowed him to attend A-2-Z. Can’t go inside to pick up your baby and see the condition of the school.

We have been part of the AzZ family for several years and I cannot say enough amazing things about this center! My child loved/loves going there, and I feel safe leaving my child there because I know the children are cared for like family.  The communication was great from both directors and staff, and by the time my child was of age for public Pre-k, he was *more than prepared,* recognizing all his letters/sounds, counting, recognizing numbers…. I could go on and on. A2z is far more than a daycare, it’s a loving school, and has set the strongest foundation for my child’s continuing academic career.

I loved the big place but then again how well can a child be treated when there’s so much going on ? I can’t say that they were holding my 1 yr old when he was crying or caring for my child as he was changing . There was no way to check on my baby You can’t enter the day care or check on your kid like my new day care . This one doesn’t have cameras . This one seems like they didn’t care if my baby was crying or having a bad day. My baby was always sick and coming home so dirty . And wearing clothes that was not even his

It was a last minute thing, so my son was a little shocked. Once he found out about water days and field trips he was ok with going back, as am I. Staff was great in answering all my questions. Yhey are actually moving about a few businesses down my work so I am thrilled to have chosen this learning center.
My 2 year old and 8 year old started daycare last month and they both love it.

My son has been attending MultiIntelligence Kids College since August 2024, and now my daughter goes as well. We couldn’t be happier!
Dr. Sharon is incredibly caring and professional — she truly loves children and treats them like her own. She always communicates with us, gives helpful advice, and makes sure the activities at daycare match what we’re practicing at home.
She keeps a close eye on their feeding, routines, and development, and we’ve seen so much improvement in both kids. Highly recommend this daycare!

Dr. Sharon and her team are such a delight to have working with our youth in San Antonio. Their attention to detail and willingness to educate our youth is impeccable. I highly recommend them for your child's education

From the very first day of my child’s admission at Multi-Intelligence Kids College, LLC, I was deeply impressed by the warmth and professionalism of the staff. They were not only welcoming but also attentive to my son’s unique needs. My child has a speech delay, and the caregiver assigned to him was exceptionally patient and supportive. In just one week, she helped him start identifying colors, engaging with music, and expressing his preferences for food and toys—all without any frustration. This teacher's dedication and gentle guidance made an incredible difference in his progress, and I am truly grateful.

I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to the entire team at Multi-Intelligence, especially the teacher who worked so closely with my son. Your kindness, care, and commitment to each child’s growth are genuinely outstanding. Thank you for creating such a positive impact on our family’s journey

This place and their incredible team has been a God send. My child is very hyper and opinionated, and here he has the space to get out his energy while also getting an education. Everyone on staff is patient, kind, and well educated in all things childcare. There are so many different awesome features like the kitchen, outdoor play area, garden, and inside gyms. We’ve tried multiple other daycares, but this one is by far the best.
Great Center, Dr. Sharon and her staff are so caring. The individual care is unbelievable.  Xxo

This daycare will truly be missed. My son really enjoyed his time at Westend. His teachers are kind and patient. Brittany the director is always professional easy to contact and reach for any concerns. They send me pictures of him learning and playing daily. He comes home singing all kinds of learning songs (so cute) they take the kids out to there beautifully remodeled playground daily my son is always exhausted after daycare just like I like it lol great food cooked daily! I definitely recommend.

I cannot speak more highly of this daycare. I’ve been bringing my daughter here for over 3 years. This facility is one of the rare places with a Texas Rising Star rating of 4 out of 4. In other words, they are the top for quality early childhood services. The staff and teachers are kind, knowledgeable, and attentive. And, their staff retention is impressive - most of the teachers have been there as long as we have or longer. They are very affordable (because they are subsidized by the city). They provide breakfast, lunch, and snack every day. As a baby, my daughter never came home with a diaper rash, and as a preschooler she now receives daily lessons using state approved curriculum, with an emphasis on hands on experiences. All this to say, if you want video feeds, daily/weekly reports, fancy toys, or autopay, this is NOT place for you. West End is low tech and definitely not fancy (although they did just get an app this week), but for us, the quality and care we receive far outweighs any of the bells and whistles of other places.

I am so I dissatisfied with this organization, the only reason I gave this daycare a chance was because they were the only place within my budget and close to our home after our move from San Antonio. Needless to say you get what you pay for. It was my daughters first time ever attending a daycare and every time I dropped her off she cried, on many occasions when I picked her up she was still crying. I do believe the staff do not connect with the children and are simply there for a paycheck. I’m sorry, but when you are caring for children there is more to it. Also, the whole month my daughter attended the facility I only had to buy her 1 pack (of 12) pull- ups and we still brought home most of them. They weren’t changing her, there was a time I picked her up and by the time I got home her car seat and pants were wet from it leaking out of her pull up. On the last incident (her last day, my last straw) I checked her when I got to the car and had to change her pull up in the parking lot of the daycare bc she was so soaked. This was a horrible experience and was everything I was worried about. I tried to form relationships with the staff and there was always different teachers in my daughters room no one cared to make conversation. I do not recommend this place to anyone unless your child can talk. Now I’m pleased to say my daughter now attends another daycare and she/we love it!

If I could give a negative star I would. Management has no regard for the stability of the children and they are extraordinarily unorganized, unprofessional and unethical. If your children are important to you, this is not the daycare for you. My child attended this daycare since he was 8 months and when Ms. Pat was the director I had no problems. Then management began terminating teachers and making changes with profound effects on our children without communicating to parents. I called corporate to complain and the CEO Juanita Harang hung up in my face. She won't ever have to worry about me, my child or my money again. They need to shut this place down. Wonderful teachers, horrible management, incompetent board of directors. I've found a different daycare for my child after 3 years.

My daughter has been going for over a year since she was 7 months old. We love that her care providers and loving, interested in her developmental growth. The new director has made a positive difference in the environment. My daughter continues to share new vocabulary growth and her joy and love for the world is celebrated here.

I recently visited Growing Greatness Academy and it’s such a beautiful new daycare in Houston! The classrooms are bright, colorful, and very clean. You can tell they put a lot of thought into creating a space where kids can learn and feel comfortable. It feels very welcoming and family-friendly. I’m excited to see them grow and I definitely recommend Houston parents check them out!

I love this child facility, it is clean and professionally ran., Mrs.T has a heart for the children. The staff is amazing. This place is the perfect example of how a childcare school, academy and daycare should be across the state of Texas.

The face behind Growing Greatness Academy speaks a lot for the business but for those who don't know the founder/owner has had a long journey in childcare her love and strive to see better with the children in her community is amazing !! GGA is no normal organization it was founded with love and heart for children I see  great  fit for Your child  guaranteeing you want be disappointed choosing GGA for your child's education ,WELCOME TO GROWING GREATNESS Academy ! Where we focus on Proper Growth an and Development for our kids !

This new daycare center is really impressive! The owner and staff are friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about caring for children. The facility is clean, safe, and well-organized. They offer structured activities that balance learning and play, and communication is always clear and consistent. I highly recommend it to any parent looking for reliable, high-quality care!

What an amazing school! My daughter attended the 2s class with Ms. Lassala from 2023–2024 and absolutely loved it. She adored her teacher and was always excited to go to class. Before TAPS, we had a brief but terrible experience at another daycare in the area, and we were so grateful that TAPS had an opening when we called. The difference was clear right away—our toddler came home happy and singing every day.

She was truly cared for by every teacher, from morning care through after-school care, and we always felt the warmth of the entire staff. The extra community activities were also wonderful—our favorites were the Halloween Trunk-or-Treat and Snow Day!

One of the most meaningful moments was at the end of the year when Ms. Lassala gifted us a handmade, personalized memory book filled with photos and a heartfelt message. It’s something we will treasure forever.

We are so thankful for the love, kindness, and dedication the TAPS team showed our daughter. It was very hard to say goodbye when we relocated. Thank you, TAPS, for giving our daughter such a joyful and special first school experience ❤️

I can't say enough wonderful things about the Adventure Preschool Program. Both of my children attended from age two through four, and every teacher they had was incredibly kind, loving, and supportive. The administration is just as amazing—organized, communicative, and genuinely invested in each child’s experience. My kids looked forward to going each day, always had a great time, and learned so much along the way. The amount of care and planning that goes into the fun parties and extra activities is truly impressive and deeply appreciated. I wholeheartedly recommend this preschool to anyone—it’s a special place that made a lasting impact on our family.

We have been attending for over four years and now my last little is in the twos program. The curriculum and activities are thoughtfully planned, ensuring that the kids are always engaged, learning, and having fun. Some of the best things about TAPS is the music programs Mrs. Shelly puts on and fit and fun with Ms. King. TAPS has over the top extras for kids during the year-foam and glow parties, snow day and splash days. I highly recommend TAPS to all parents. Thank you TAPS for helping my littles grow!

Absolutely LOVE this preschool! My kids have always felt a sense of belonging here and always look forward to coming to school! They do a great job of teaching the kids about God’s love and how to treat others with kindness and grace. Every teacher they have had has been absolutely amazing! I highly recommend this school!

You can not ask for anything more than the Adventure Preschool. We just completed our first school year here and I have been meaning to write a review for a while. Our daughter went from 14 months to 2 years old this year. Everyone on the staff, teachers and administrative, are exceptional. I am so at ease when I know my daughter is being cared here because they are all so great. I look forward to our many years at Adventure Preschool. If they are an option for you, don't hesitate! : )

Amazing. They watched my newborn for a year and my other son who was 4 when he started. They communicated pretty well and my kids both seem to enjoy it.

My only issue would be there seems to be a high turnover for the infant room. I wish it was communicated when they got a new teacher.

My child has been at Primrose for three years and was welcomed from day one. The staff- Mrs. Jordan, Ms. Abrea, Ms. Jessica, and Ms. Zoe have all made a lasting impact, and the Director Ms. Price and Assistant Director Mr. Jorge are incredibly attentive to both parents and children. The curriculum is top notch. It's thoughtfully designed to engage children at every level and has helped my son thrive both academically and socially. What truly sets Primrose apart is its commitment to excellence- it is both nationally and state accredited which speaks volumes about the quality of care, education, and safety standards upheld every day. I highly recommend it to any parent seeking a nurturing, enriching environment.

I have been in the San Antonio area now for the past 5 months, this is the first place I have him in since being at an at home daycare for 3 years prior. After doing research I found Primrose. My son absolutely loves and enjoys coming here, they keep me updated all through out the day which gives me a sense of peace for my 4 year old. Their protocols to protect the children are strictly followed and I know that my son is safe. As far as lunches its always a well balanced meal. I really like the fact that my son is learning through being hands on and has found a deeper love for reading. The staff is super caring and some of the teachers I would love to recognize is Mr. Carlos, Ms. Ana and the Director Ms. Price for handling us with such great care. I highly recommend this place!!

Our daughter has been a student at Primrose since she was 7 months old. We absolutely love this school and all her teachers and personnel! She is 15 months now and is able to communicate with sign language and speak new words daily! Dr. Jordane, in Young Toddlers, is incredible to work with. She is patient and excellent at involving us in sharing tips to better communicate and maintain schedules at home. Thank you for taking such excellent care of our sweet baby!

I love watching my kids grow and learn.  Every day my toddler is excited to go to school and play with his friends.   As a working mom it is important to know that not only your kids are being well looked after, but that they are having fun and learning.  The Primrose staff is amazing and keeps me well informed on the happenings through the day!  We love this place and can’t recommend it enough!!!

OPERATION_NAME: The Goddard School of Dallas Lake Highlands
review_text: Our first few months have been really successful at Goddard lake highlands! We have very small class sizes right now since it’s new, but I like that they have lower ratios than the state requirements in general. The staff has been very attentive and my daughter felt close to the teachers right away. They have a good schedule with lots of different learning activities.

OPERATION_NAME: The Goddard School of Dallas Lake Highlands
review_text:
Absolutely fantastic people and facility. If I could rate higher than five stars, I would. Well worth the money.

My child was at a different, cheaper facility prior to Goddard. Switching to Goddard was a night and day difference. I can tell my infant significantly enjoys his time here and is in no rush to go home upon my arrival to pick up. This is a stark contrast to the previous facility they were at.

I was skeptical of the structured curriculum having any impact on an infant, but again, I was wrong. My child is now rapidly developing at a much faster pace. I can tell a difference on a daily basis.

Totally happy and satisfied.

It's taken me two years to write this review, and I'm still processing the devastation that occurred in consequence to how the school mismanaged my child and his classroom. My child was accepted into the program from a waitlist a month late. I made the naive mistake of sharing the blow by blow of their previous preschool experiences with the teacher. I knew my child had experienced toxic stress since infancy, and suspected they were neuro diverse. I also knew they had extreme anxiety. We now know my child fits the P.D.A. profile, a subset of Autism spectrum. There were three children in the class who fit the neuro divergent mold-- 1 was barely verbal and matched the profile for ADHD, the other was almost completely nonverbal. I feel like from the beginning, the teacher singled my child out as a "behavioral concern". After a lot of pushback, I was allowed to survey the class. It was immediately clear that the less verbal neuro divergent children were largely ignored-- one being all but forgotten as they lagged behind the group throughout my survey. Meanwhile, my child, who is highly verbal, was met with nervous hyper vigilance. Because they are extremely sensitive, they picked up on this from the beginning, and it resulted in highly reactive and erratic behavior. I was even shamed by the teacher for my child's lack of pro social skills, something understandable at 4 and certainly we now know understandable with a PDA child. Still, my child is capable of great concern, empathy and tenderness when in a supportive environment. This tense dynamic with the "teacher" crescendo'd into another child being injured during an overactive stress response from my child, who is a fight responder and feared the repercussion of his noncompliance. The child healed, but the aftermath was painful for both families, as my child chose to respond to the incident again with an overactive stress and fight response. Instead of admitting that the teacher and school were unequipped to help families with neuro divergent pathways, the teacher chose to politicize the situation in a truly inaccurate and disgusting way that was not reflective of neither my child, my family, our values nor our life experience. It caused deep harm. I chose to remove my child from the school. The last day, he played with the child who had been injured, because they were friends and neither he nor the other child involved could've fully grasped the heavy and hateful implication the teacher had made about the incident. Please reconsider this school if you suspect your child is neurodivergent. Unless something drastic has changed in their policy and training, they are not at all equipped to approach this challenge in a way that's helpful to families.

Our son started at 3 months, and I was so sad to leave him. The staff reassured me, and sent me many updates throughout the day. The teachers are engaged and teach the babies, even at a young age. Mrs. Belkis and the rest of the staff are incredible, and you can tell they truly love their jobs. We are so thankful we found Alianza, and as non-Spanish speakers, we are excited about our son being exposed to the Spanish language early in his development.

OPERATION_NAME: Alianza Eco International School PCA 3 LLC
review_text: I couldn't be happier with Alianza Energy Corridor!  I was initially anxious about starting my daughter in daycare at 18 months old, but the staff here made the transition so much easier than I could have imagined. The teachers are incredibly hardworking, caring, and genuinely loving toward the children. It gives me such peace of mind to know that my daughter is not only being well cared for but also surrounded by wonderful people who truly care about her well-being. She adjusted in a matter of weeks, and every day she comes home excited and happy. I'm so grateful for Alianza and the wonderful team that makes all the difference in my daughter's life!

We have had a wonderful experience at the Goddard School in Circle C. Our son (20 month old) started in Dec 2025, and the transition was smooth and positive for our family. His teachers, Mrs. Dani and Ashly, are amazing. We see how much they care about the children. The rooms are always clean and well organized. Kids have fun, creative, and educational activities. The management team, Stephani, Jessica, and Natali, are professional, and very responsive. They do care about the kids and the families. We are grateful to be part of this community.

Staff is just the best! They truly care for my kids and are amazing super approachable people.
I had my two kids for about 8 years total at Goddard, 3 of those at Circle C and I’m very grateful for all they’ve done for my kids, a lot of learning, growth and fun.
Also, the fact that they include a good (mostly healthy) lunch at Circle C location is amazing, super convenient to save time every morning.

Update: they’ve refunded a week after.

This is a typical franchised Goddard school with no empathy to parents in grief. Below is the reply I received after requesting application fee refund because my pregnancy was terminated during the 2nd trimester.

“I am so sorry to hear that. 😞
Unfortunately the waitlist fee is non-refundable. But we can make sure that fee goes towards a future waitlist opportunity. I would just change the dates.”

Our journey with The Goddard School goes back over a decade, starting when our oldest son enrolled at just 1.5 years old. He’s now 12, and through the years, both of his younger sisters have also had the privilege of being part of this wonderful community. Our middle daughter has since graduated, and our youngest daughter, now 3 years old, is currently attending.

What makes this school truly exceptional is the consistency of care, dedication, and love from the teachers and staff. Many of the same teachers who cared for our son are still here today, and their positive influence has touched all three of our children in meaningful ways. They’ve provided not just education, but also encouragement, guidance, and values that have helped shape who our children are becoming.

We are forever grateful for the safe, nurturing, and supportive environment that Goddard has provided for our family throughout these many years. Knowing that our youngest is surrounded by the same care and values that shaped her older siblings brings us great comfort. The Goddard School has truly been an extension of our family, and we couldn’t imagine our children’s early years anywhere else.

The Goddard School of Austin (Circle C Ranch) offers a warm, engaging environment where children thrive through hands-on learning and thoughtful curriculum. Classrooms are clean, bright, and well-organized, with caring teachers who communicate well with families. The school emphasizes safety, creativity, and personal growth, making it a trusted choice for early education.

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Crest Academy of Early Learning
review_text: Ivy Crest Academy is an incredible school. It is has been the perfect environment for both of our kids. All of the staff from the friendly front desk staff to the amazing teachers are all top notch. They offer great care for our infant and have great communication. Our older son loves all of the activities that the school brings in for the kids. Would highly recommend for a great school that will give you peace of mind knowing your child is in great hands.

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Crest Academy of Early Learning
review_text: I cannot express how amazing Ivy Crest has been for my children. My 3 year old has been attending since she was 1 and my 1 year old since she was 4 months. Ivy crest keeps me up to date with everything they are doing through the day including pictures/videos along with detailed descriptions of what they do throughout the day including activities snacks and lunch . My kids have excelled and have hit all their milestones and I can confidently say that Ivy Crest has been a huge part of that. The staff is amazing from Mrs. Bianca Ms. Carmen and Ms. Lori  keeping us up to date with any changes going on and always being greeted with a happy face in the mornings. Mrs. Tina always preparing the yummy food my kids love and the teacher that go above and beyond to ensure the kids are not only learning but having fun. I cannot recommend this school enough.

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Crest Academy of Early Learning
review_text: This place was an absolute nightmare for my daughter. Staff was constantly seen on camera wearing the same pair of gloves to change multiple kid’s diapers. Not washing hands or using basic hygiene. My daughter constantly got sick. She would come home with super dirty clothes as if staff did not help keep her clean through out the day. The last straw was witnessing a staff member on camera grab my daughter by the arm and leg while moving her to the nap mat. When I called to immediately address the situation, the front office seemed concerned. But quickly changed their tone to play it down as if it was ok to grab a child in that manner. I called the police to file a report and the staff mentioned to the police officer that my child had eczema. As to use this condition as a cover up in the event she might bruise. Eczema does not cause bruising. The staff is not trained to follow basic hygiene rules and the health department was called. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone and if your child is there I highly recommend you pay to watch the surveillance cameras because that is how I caught them mishandling my child. The teacher was dismissive and even laughed and recorded me in the parking lot when I was waiting for the police to arrive.

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Crest Academy of Early Learning
review_text: Ivy Crest is a great school! They do a lot of planning and work hard to provide a safe and fun learning environment for the kids. They plan outside events and always have something going on to build the community. Our son loves it!

OPERATION_NAME: Ivy Crest Academy of Early Learning
review_text: Ivy Crest Academy (ICA) has been a God-send! Both of our kids attended this school prior to entering elementary school and look forward to attending every summer. The teachers are engaged and care about the kids having fun as well as learning. The curriculum is fresh, creative and covers a broad range of learning areas! The staff are flexible and understanding with summer schedules and incredibly welcoming every time we walk through the door. We are looking forward to our kids attending ICA for many more summers!

I am extremely satisfied with the care and education my child receives at Creating Little Scholars Academy daycare/school. The staff is warm, patient, and genuinely dedicated to the kids’ well-being. Every day, my child comes home excited to share what they learned, whether it’s a new skill, a fun activity, or something about their friends.
The environment is clean, safe, and thoughtfully organized to encourage learning and creativity. Communication is great as I am kept updated on everything. I love the new owners. Thank you Creating Little Scholars!!!🙏🏽❤️

Creating Little Scholars is an Amazing Daycare/ School. I was so excited when my daughter mentioned she had found a daycare for my granddaughter. They have an Awesome Staff and the teachers take pride in the care and curriculum for the children. If you are looking for a safe, clean  place with Great Staff please check out CLSA. I had the opportunity to meet the owners who were very warm and welcoming to our family. Very Appreciative for this Daycare in my daughter's community.

Creating Little Scholars Academy is such a wonderful place to bring your kids! My daughter has been attending since she was 6 weeks old, and now she’s 3. Even with the change in management, the center has only continued to improve. I couldn’t be happier with the care and growth she’s received here!
I can’t say enough wonderful things about Creating Little Scholars Academy! The teachers truly care about each child, and it shows in the way they interact with them every day.
Creating Little Scholars Academy is a very good school to bring your children to.The teachers are wonderful teaching n caring for your children.

We’ve had the most wonderful experience with the Children’s Center of Austin. My son has been there for almost a year and is thriving. It was nerve wracking returning to work after maternity leave, especially because he’s my first child, but my son has been so well taken care of from day one. His teachers love him; he gets to learn and play all day. I feel peace knowing he’s well loved, well supported, and safe at daycare. Erika, the director, is wonderful and knows all families by name. We will be at CCOA for years to come!

I can't say enough positive things about the Children's Center of Austin - Jester.  We have two children that have attended there (one for 4+ years and one for 2+ years).  The leadership and staff are incredible and truly care about your children.  CCOA offers an excellent curriculum and provides breakfast, lunch and snacks, which is a nice perk.  They also offer a variety of extra-curricular programs for children, such as Soccer Shots, gymnastics, dance and on-site swimming.

We love CCOA! the teachers and director are so loving and treat the children as their own. they are communicative with parents, engaging with the children, and our son just loves it there. We started him at about 6 months and he is thriving at almost 18 months. would recommend! ❤️

Both of my girls attend CCOA at Jester.  My oldest has been going for 2 years now and my youngest (18 months) has been in since she was 8 weeks old.  We absolutely adore them. They are an extension of our family and I have been very pleased with our experience over the past 2 years.

I love how my girls have access to sports, music, dance/gymnastics, and swimming without ever having to leave the school.  I highly recommend CCOA to anyone who is looking for a childcare center.

Children's Center of Austin - Jester has been absolutely excellent for our family. The staff is amazing, always going above & beyond, every day I drop my child off here I know she's happy and well taken care of.

The facility is always clean, the operation itself runs so smoothly, our child loves pool/water days, and she has learned so much during her time here.

I highly recommend Children's Center of Austin - Jester

We transitioned to this school in May and it has been a positive experience. I watch my kiddo be excited to see her teachers and the teachers happy to see the kids. We were not purposefully looking for an immersion school but our 2 year old will correct the little bit of Spanish I know which is fun to experience! Highly recommend. Thank you guys for taking care of our child while we are at work!

This is a wonderful school! The teachers are so attentive. Miss Nina knows every child and every parent and holds her teachers to a standard of exceptional care and excellence!

The facility is monitored constantly and maintains a safe atmosphere for the children while remaining fun and entertaining.

The kids have a great bond with the teachers and with each other, you can tell they feel safe and happy!

I loved visiting Immersion Montessori Academy and learning about it! No doubt, an amazing place for little ones to learn, play, and thrive!

This was our first experience transitioning to daycare, and we are really grateful that the staff at Immersion Montessori Academy were so supportive and nurturing. My daughter has some social anxiety but still bonded quickly with the teachers there. We really have peace of mind leaving her there even for long hours each day due to our work schedules. She loves all the fun and thoughtful activities they do there including crafts, science projects, and recently yoga as well. She is constantly learning through joy and exploration. We are so happy to have a great daycare/preschool so close by and it is a bonus that it is bilingual!

We absolutely love Immersion Montessori Academy and couldn't be happier with the experience so far. From day one, the staff has made our family feel welcomed, supported, and confident in the choice we made for our child's early education.

The environment is calm, clean, and thoughtfully prepared. The staff is incredibly patient and caring often accommodating our child with her meals and shyness coming into class. I would highly recommend this school to anyone. Thank you Mrs. Nina and Mrs. Anna and your staff for all you do and your level of professionalism.

We absolutely love Immersion Montessori Academy! From the very beginning, we’ve felt so welcomed and supported by the entire team. Our daughter looks forward to going to school every day and talks nonstop about how much she loves her teachers and friends. It brings us so much peace of mind knowing she is in such a loving and nurturing environment. Our daughter is thriving here and her language and bilingualism is flourishing.

The teachers are incredibly communicative, patient, and genuinely care about each child. The director, Nina, especially goes above and beyond to make sure we are informed, supported, and heard. We’ve had nothing but positive experiences and feel so grateful to be part of this community. Highly recommend to any family looking for a safe, kind, and enriching space for their little one!

OPERATION_NAME: Castle Hills Learning Center and Day Care #6
review_text: My son went here for 2 weeks and would not want to go everytime.The teacher in the toddler class older lady would comment she wasn't ready for my son and grabbed him ugly on day because he cried when I would leave that same day when I picked him up he had a mark on his arm they said it was a child bite.I took him out that day it isnt a good place at all.

Our child has been at Yoga Peace School for a few years, and we LOVE this school. They teach these babies about mindfulness, emotions, and all the things we'd be well-served as adults to learn.

The "little red house" campus on Woodrow is closing this year, but the other location (MLK) has been open for a while now. An (one of the founders), Meg (head teacher), and so many other amazing teachers there. We couldn't be more pleased with our experience at YPS, and we are sad to be leaving for 'big kid ' school this fall.
Great community with 7-colored hearts (and spines) in every staff person.  Both of my daughters graduated with gratitude for the service of the teachers, founders, and fellow children.
Wonderful group of teachers. We feel lucky to have found this gem.
Most adorable school in the world

We had our son here for 4 months. It was a horrible experience to say the least.

Our son was put in a “sensory jacket” multiple times without ever asking us for consent or informing us of this decision the school chose to make on his behalf.

We only found out this practice was taking place because a photo was posted in the app with this vest/jacket shown on him.

When we first noticed this, we confronted the teacher asking to understand what it was and why our son was wearing it. The teacher said our son was having “big feelings” and the owner asked her to have him wear it during these moments.

He didn’t like having to wear this jacket, who told his teacher, who then informed the owner he didn’t like how it felt wearing it. She disregarded his feedback and instructed the teacher to have him continue wearing it.

I told the teacher they cannot continue to put enforce putting this physical restraint on him.

Not only was this practice ineffective at teaching our toddler coping skills through moments of big feelings, but they crossed the line with his physical boundaries.

They don’t support potty training which is wild for this age group. In fact, they don’t support any learning whatsoever. During the time we had entrusted the with his care at school during the workday, we managed to teach our child to ride a bike, all his letters, to put on clothes and multiple other things after work and on weekends. Yet saw 0 learning from the school. Our perspective on the care he received at the time he spent at this school was basically glorified babysitting and severely overpriced with no enrichment.

To top it all off, the director for the school reached out to us to inform us that our child had special challenges and we would have to either pay more to have special counseling or he would have to leave. They also did this out of the blue without any warning in person of issues they were seeing. This left us having to quickly scramble to find another school which parents know is really hard. Further, this made no sense to us as his prior preschool teachers loved him so much they asked regularly to come see him. And his new preschool loves him also. He’s a three year old boy, obviously he has big feelings and acts out but that’s the expectation and I never have big issues with him. I’d expect adults to be able to handle a 3 year old. Additionally, I’ve seen a much improved behavior since going to his new preschool and if anything his behavior worsened in the 4 months he was at this school.

In my time there just as a few other callouts, I also saw teachers giving very poor instructions to children, leaving children crying off in the corner and many more things that really made me scratch my head.

There were physical safety concerns as well. There was a haphazard playscape that the children were told they could play on “until they were 3”. This playscape also had a broken slide that was severely cracked/detached. The “safety measures” in place to prevent use of this were a cardboard box or piece of foam that were leaning partly against the entrance that the children could easily remove. The entire time our son was enrolled here, that playscape remained in this state.

There was a shade awning that had partly collapsed after a severe storm, resulting in one of the poles being completely uprooted from the ground, leaving a large empty hole that the children could easily trip into. The repairs for this were not swift and the precautions were minimal in the interim if at all.

I wouldn’t recommend any parent send their kid to this school.

Our experience with Tomorrow’s future and empire Academy was unfortunately very disappointing. Our daughter was moved from Empire Academy childcare center at the discretion of Ms. Morris, who initially told us the facility was undergoing repairs due to a visit from a fire inspector. We later discovered this wasn’t the case, and when questioned further, Ms. Morris changed her explanation and became defensive when we raised concerns about low enrollment at the center.

When we asked to withdraw our daughter without penalty, Ms. Morris refused. Instead, she offered a discounted rate for us to withdraw her on paper while she continued not to attend — a completely unacceptable and unprofessional solution. We submitted our daughter’s two week withdrawal, unfortunately our daughter got sick on her last week and didn’t attend. I then called Ms. Morris to request a partial refund, which her response was “was this the situation where I tried to offer a discount before? Yea, no the account was closed as of today so we can’t do anything else with it.”

The only positive aspect of our time at Empire Academy was the wonderful administration team and our daughter’s two previous teachers, (Ms. R and Ms. L) who were both caring and attentive. However, the overall handling by the director was unprofessional and misleading. This was by far the worst daycare experience we've encountered, and I would not recommend it to other families.
Every single time that I have been around the daycare, it has been very clean, professional and a place that I would take my children to without hesitation

Tomorrow Future is an excellent and safe learning environment  for your child/ children to have fun, I love the staff  they are very helpful and professional. The Director Ms. Morris has been providing services for over 29 years in the community helping children to reach there goals as they grow and learn. Ms. Morris loves what she do and that's providing an excellent childcare services for working parents and children's in need for childcare. Words can’t express how grateful I am for Tomorrow’s Future Development Center. My child is 3 years old and has attended the center for approximately 11 months now. My children have been there since they were born . My oldest 7 yrs and my youngest 10 months . I love the staff and the environment .My favorite thing is they teach both English and Spanish . Ms.Morris the director  has always resolve any question's . Very professional and nice . I would highly recommend this daycare

We are blessed to find a place where our child learned and was so happy to go to school everyday . God bless every person who works at this place .
The Blancos

OPERATION_NAME: SW YMCA Texas Medical Center C
review_text:
The Staff at YMCA have been incredibly kind and loving to our daughter. Since she started going there in 2023, we have seen nothing but staff who are deeply invested in her growth and learning. They know each kid by name, the children look so happy there and never want to go home when you go to get them at the end of the day. When our daughter was moving to another school, the teachers gave her several gifts, so many hugs, we could tell they genuinely care about her.
I highly recommend this day care

OPERATION_NAME: SW YMCA Texas Medical Center C
review_text: The YMCA children’s academy has been a boon for our family. The location is accessible, the staff are genuinely kind and well-informed, and they always provide activities to look forward to. Communication is clear and consistent, and tuition is affordable. We love this place and happily recommend it to friends and family at every opportunity.

OPERATION_NAME: SW YMCA Texas Medical Center C
review_text: My 2 year old goes the daycare at this Y , and really like the way they take care of the kids, the programs , the teachers, all staff are really good. They know each child by their name and when I drop my son off or pick him, I can notice that he had a good time. He learned so much in only 6 months. I feel like he is at home and the Y staff  are part of our family. Other thing, they have a very good facility with a lot of space, so kids can play, run comfortably.  Thank you so much Y.

OPERATION_NAME: SW YMCA Texas Medical Center C
review_text:
Dropping your kids off in daycare is hard... the staff at the Y make it so much easier. I recently put my 12 week old baby girl into the infant class, and I was impressed with how much the infant class staff wanted to work with me to make me happy with the care of my baby. They are very flexible. They also love the kids - Miss Chrissy's motto is "You can't spoil a baby, only love them". There are always difficulties handing the care of your child over to someone else, at the Y they will help you with them.

My 3 year old has been coming to the center for over a year and is now in the preschool. I am very impressed by the amount of learning that goes on - it seems every week has a new art project, and every day a new song. He loves it so much, he often asks to go on the weekend (!) His teacher is very caring.

Although this is not the most fancy / frilly daycare, the staff are caring, and want to keep you happy. They will become like family. I know a lot of fellow nurses and pediatricians who drop their kids here. My kids are happy - that is the most important thing.

OPERATION_NAME: SW YMCA Texas Medical Center C
review_text: My son was repeatedly berated and injured from the time I trusted this daycare to protect him last July. I received verbal notification of the injuries that my child received but no incident report. However, I was contacted on occasion if he caused an incident. I have always had a pleasant experience with the YMCA of Arlington and Fort Worth, TX. However, the experience that I have received since moving here is more than disappointing. In addition to being threatened with being "dropped" monthly due to miscommunication between staff and the central office, the director threatened to call CPS when they were forced to close due to the water main break and no one was there at the time they told us they would be closing. All in all this location does not reflect the core values of the YMCA. I got the impression that low income single parent households are not valued members of the YMCA. This facility is all around unprofessional and ill equipped to represent the YMCA.

This review is actually well overdue but It’s been a year since my son started attending this daycare at age 2, and I couldn’t be more grateful. Finding quality childcare in Texas has been a challenge, I literally interviewed 7 different daycare facilities, but this center has truly been a blessing. The entire staff has been incredibly kind, supportive, and attentive to my son’s growth and well-being.

A special thank you to Miss Juana Bell, she has gone above and beyond. Her loving, nurturing, and communicative nature has made a lasting impact on my son and especially me because I am not easy impressed. She brings so much heart into her work and has played a key role in making my son feel safe, supported, and excited to learn.

The team has even helped with important milestones like potty training and continues to provide thoughtful strategies to support his development. Miss Bell is truly a gem, and I can’t thank her and the team enough for the love and care they’ve consistently shown.

My daughter loves this daycare, she literally gets excited to go. Ms. Bell is amazing with both the kids and parents, and she keeps us all in loop. They have fun, creative activities that actually interests the kids and keeps them engaged. I’m so thankful we found this place!
I got my child enrolled today and the process was very easy. I couldn’t be more grateful for the staff. Ms.Bell was so sweet

I love this preschool for my daughter. I’ve had nothing but good experiences here. The director Ms.Bell and all of the staff are so sweet and really care about the children. My daughter is always so happy when I pick her up and sometimes doesn’t want to leave. Knowing she’s being well taken care of and in a safe and clean  environment makes it a lot easier for me to leave her each day.

Where do I start.. the teachers here are amazing. They aren’t just teachers, they become part of your village. My daughter has transitioned into full time public school, however she still loves and wants to see her Gingerbread family. I pray that all day cares can be blessed with a loving staff and every daycare center deserves a Mrs Bell. She’s the best. Thank you gingerbread Academy for teaching and loving on my kids. Forever grateful

I absolutely love this daycare! Both my son and daughter attended this daycare starting at the age of 2. Thanks to Alphabet club, when my son started kindergarten, he already knew so much and was more than prepared. The center is always super clean, organized, and welcoming. The teachers truly care for the children as if they were their own, and it shows in everything they do. I’m so grateful to have found a place where both of my kids can learn, feel safe, and be loved. Highly recommend!

2011 we were brand new to the Houston area with a 1 year old. Both parents had to work and we had no clue where or who would watch our little girl with safety, love, and compassion. A friend brought her kids to Alphabet Club and so we thought we’d give it a try. I will never forget Immediately how welcoming, kind, and loving the entire staff was. They were understanding and patient with my million questions. My daughter was treated as if she was one of their own. The comfort and safety I felt with this daycare is unlike any other. My daughter attended there 5 days a week for almost 3 years - until we left Houston. Still today I am so thankful for everything the Alphabet Club did for my daughter and for me.
I will never forget watching my daughter in the mirror at 2 years old with her hand over her heart saying The Pledge of Allegiance. At just 2 years old they were able to teach her this. I will forever be grateful for the staff.

We’ve sent all three of our kids to The Alphabet Club, and it has been an amazing experience every time. The teachers and staff are so kind, loving, and honest — you can truly feel how much they care about the children. Our oldest 2 were thoroughly prepared for kindergarten thanks to the wonderful foundation they received here.

The classrooms are big, bright, and full of joy, and the center does such a great job making learning fun with special events throughout the year — from splash days in the summer to celebrations for all the major holidays. They also have fewer closures than any daycare I’ve ever heard of, which is a huge plus for working parents. We’re so grateful for The Alphabet Club and can’t recommend them highly enough!

We had a wonderful experience with The Alphabet Club. Both of my children truly thrived — not only academically, but emotionally as well. My eldest was exceptionally well prepared for kindergarten, and I am still grateful for the love, attention, and support the staff has shown our family over the years. The teachers and team genuinely care about the kids, and it shows in everything they do. Highly recommend!

**⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Highly Recommended!**
I would absolutely recommend this preschool to anyone looking for a safe, loving, and educational environment for their child! My daughter has learned so much here, and the teachers truly take amazing care of her.

Ms. Chetna and Ms. Maria Nieto are wonderful — always so kind, attentive, and genuinely caring toward all the children. They consistently plan engaging weekly curricular activities that make learning fun and exciting. I love that they prioritize reading and hands-on learning, which really keeps the kids involved and curious.

My daughter comes home every day singing new songs, reciting her ABCs and numbers, and proudly showing what she’s learned. She’s advanced in so many areas for her age, and I truly believe that’s because of the thoughtful programs and care provided here.

I also love how they create the most memorable and adorable projects for special occasions like Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, and other holidays. They always include our kids’ pictures and personal touches — it’s so thoughtful and heartwarming to receive those keepsakes!

As a parent with a demanding work schedule, it brings me so much peace of mind knowing she’s in such good hands. She comes home happy every day, and I can tell she’s both learning and loved here. I’m so grateful to have found this preschool and she will definitely be here for the pre-k program as well.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Fundamental Learning Center! The teachers are truly awesome caring, dedicated, and highly professional. The curriculum is engaging and structured, providing the perfect balance of learning and fun for my children. It’s clear that the team here is passionate about early childhood education, and it shows in everything they do.

One of the things I love most is the family-oriented atmosphere. The staff genuinely cares about the children and their families, making everyone feel welcome and valued. It’s such a comforting feeling to know that my kids are in a nurturing environment every day.

But perhaps the best endorsement of all is that my children absolutely love going to daycare! Every morning, they are excited and ready to learn, play, and grow. Fundamental Learning Center has been an amazing place for my family, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a top-notch daycare.

review_text:
