We have two here, and we have seen SO much progress in our 9month old since she began, from a better structure, to sleeping, to learning to use sign language, to self soothing, to crawling, standing, they work with these babies so much! We got told by the doctor recently that our baby is advanced, and I 10000% contribute so much of her growth to the amazing women who work here.

I’ll add even outside of the kiddos they have at this amazing place, they genuinely just have a heart for children in general, and are literally so ready to help with anything.

They’re incredible.

Thank you so much each and every single one of you!

OPERATION_NAME: Choo Choo Train Early Learning Center LLC
review_text:
Coming from another state and never having to use childcare services for my older son, Mrs. J was a breath ofnfresh air! She is loving and down to earth, she communicates very well, and is flexible. She provides health and delicious meals/snacks and her center is immaculately clean. My 1 year old was coming home singing alphabets within a week. I have nothing but raving reviews for Mrs. J and her center!

Thank you for everything Mrs. J!
From me & Adonis

OPERATION_NAME: Choo Choo Train Early Learning Center LLC
review_text: We have been taking our 2 year old here since January 2024. 10/10 experience so far. Small class sizes means our baby gets less sick. Our kid comes home everyday super happy and saying all kinds of wonderful, new things. The workers really seem to care about the wellbeing of the children here.

We have a FUMP graduate and a current FUMP student and just love this school. The staff is patient, engaging and creative. Our children love going to school here and made friends in both students and teachers. We have been especially impressed by the pre-k year, our eldest just flourished in this class.  He learned a lot of great social emotional skills that have allowed him to tackle kinder and really learn because he’s not caught up in peer conflicts.

We've had two kiddos at FUMP and it's been such a great experience. Ms. Lizbeth, Ms. Erin, Ms. Stacy, and Ms. Erica (and their assistants) were all amazing! We also had a lot of confidence in (Preschool Director) Sandy, who is perfect for this role - professional, caring, and always friendly and welcoming. It's beyond me how she is able to remember all the parents and their names.
There were only two challenges we faced with this location: sometimes parking was challenging (mostly related to construction crews) and I would feel better with someone monitoring the parking lot to help manage the occasional homeless moving through the area.

FUMP is a truly special place. We moved from the east coast to TX last summer and, after a tour and meeting with FUMP's amazing director Sandy, I made a leap of faith enrolling my 2 kiddos here. We have been so incredibly happy with our experience with both ages and classrooms. They have such nurturing and kind teachers and staff, and it's a welcoming and happy space. My kids never want to leave! They have flexible scheduling, offering before school care (8:15-9), 4 hours of preschool (9-1), and after school care (1-2:30), with options of 2, 3, or 5 days per week. I couldn't be happier with FUMP and its community of parents, teachers and staff.

All three of our girls have attended FUMP and we've loved every minute of our time as a FUMP family.  The educational approach is exactly what we wanted and the consistent love and care for our kiddos was evident each and every day.  Our youngest has two years more years at FUMP and joyfully walks into class each day.
Our young son loves every day he gets to spend here.  The teachers have been engaging, the administration has been helpful, and the location is extremely convenient for us. Glad to be a part of FUMP.

OPERATION_NAME: CG Kids, LLC DBA The Goddard School
review_text: This is the best school. I highly recommend The Goddard School. After numerous daycares, and bad experiences, Candice was a breath of fresh air! The staff is so professional, and greet you warmly every day. They make your kids feel so cared for and loved. I have had the pleasure of having my child here full time and was thankful we did. Our son grew in confidence and personality. The Goddard School is always hosting events for the kids, and the family. THANK YOU GODDARD!

OPERATION_NAME: CG Kids, LLC DBA The Goddard School
review_text:
The facility was clean and presentable during the tour. Afterward, I received multiple follow-up calls encouraging enrollment, despite clearly communicating my intended registration timeline.

When I later contacted the facility to proceed and requested accommodations, the director, Desiree, stated she would consult with the owner and provide a response by Monday. No follow-up was received. I called again on Tuesday, allowing additional time, and was informed that Desiree had already spoken with the owner but did not provide me with any update. I was told I would receive a callback, which did not occur.

Communication stopped entirely after the accommodation request, despite earlier persistence in securing my enrollment. The lack of follow-through, transparency, and basic customer service was unprofessional and disappointing. Based on this experience, this facility appears more focused on enrollment and money than on supporting families. I would not recommend this facility to families seeking reliable communication and support.

OPERATION_NAME: CG Kids, LLC DBA The Goddard School
review_text: The staff here is amazing! My daughter and I moved to San Antonio because as a first time mom I was so worried about her delay and unfortunately didn’t have much resources around us. Within a year at Goddard, my daughter was excelling in all levels and was cared for at a level that I am grateful for beyond measure every day! Her teachers and administrators took special care of her and always provided me progress updates or even concerns. Thank you so much Goddard! My daughter is now in prek and is doing so amazing!! - Nitza Gonzalez (Nevaeh’s mom)

OPERATION_NAME: CG Kids, LLC DBA The Goddard School
review_text: Our daughter just finished her first week at The Goddard School and we feel so lucky to have found this childcare center. Every teacher and staff member is so kind and attentive and we feel at ease knowing our infant is in a safe and loving classroom.

OPERATION_NAME: CG Kids, LLC DBA The Goddard School
review_text: The Goddard School of San Antonio has been an absolute blessing for our family. When we moved here last year, we visited many schools and daycares, but this one truly stood out. The facilities, the staff, the activities — everything is so intentional to ensure children feel safe, cared for, loved, and inspired to learn. They have given us true peace of mind as parents. I wish they could offer a complete K-12 education because we would stay forever! Thank you to every single teacher for welcoming Miranda with so much love and care. Thank you for being our family in San Antonio! We need more schools like this one!
BEST DAYCARE EVER ! They always help so much with my kids & very workable . They deserve more credit & big raise for what these people do for our kids

I chose this daycare because of how close it is to home... My son is 3 with a speech delay but within his first three days he started using 2 to 3 word phrases. He's always happy to go in the morning and comes back home happy. We have had no problems while attending this day care.

The staff are very friendly greet you in the morning and greet you when you're leaving. My 2 daughters love going to daycare sadly school starting so their will be no day-care till the holidays except Thanksgiving day Christmas day and New year's day

My daughter and son go here and the staff is wonderful my daughter loves Ms Claudia I like the daycare I would recommend to anyone looking for daycare for their kids they're in safe caring loving hands.

I've had my 2 children at this daycare since June 2019. They are very interactive with the children. This director and teachers communicate well and give feedback about my children. I have never had an issue with them.

If you want your children to be safe, well fed and taken care of during your work ours, this is the daycare they need. I highly recommend Armentas to any parent that would ask. Both my baby girls went there for over 5 years, and they thrived, never even doubted their safety every time they went there. I love their pick up and drop off set up, I love how their doors always remained locked, love how there is always a front staff to assist with any questions, whether by phone or email. I could communicate with the teachers all through out the day, The teachers are amazing, low staff turn over rate. The director is kind, friendly, by the book and keeps strict rules in every classroom. I always compare any new daycare that my kids attend to Armentas and so far, none could take their place.

Absolutely love this daycare! After a bad experience with a local daycare we found Armenta’s and I am so glad we did. Everyone is so welcoming, my daughter wakes up and is excited to go see her teachers and friends. Loving teachers and staff , I know when I drop my daughter off she is in great hands !

I can't believe I've never left a Google review! I know I made a Facebook review, but sadly forgot Google! My daughter attended here about four years ago. That was the Best two year experience with them! They really prepared my daughter for Elementary school! Not only was she extremely smart, but she also learned Spanish! She felt extremely loved here, she always looked forward to go to daycare! I love how safe the process is to check in and out your child! Freshly cooked meals everyday! I did end up moving further from this area. Butt now that I have a toddler, I'm looking into bringing him to this amazing daycare! This is seriously the best and secure place to take your child!

Ok so this place is well organized and seems nice. But if your raising free thinking children,this is not the day care for your child. My daughter attended this daycare for 30 days. I was not impressed with how she was treated or there behavior towards her. She was not happy when she attended this daycare and with pricing be higher than most of the other schools in the area it was a waste. I wanted my daughter whom is mixed race to have more Spanish speaking kids around her to improve her skills. Instead she was treated unfairly and was singled out and treated unfairly for her behavior. When she would speak up or defend herself against other kids. I took her back to her loving daycare she previously attended! And got her a tutor for her Spanish language. I was told when we no longer wanted to attend that she should not be pulled out as it bad for her development! And being singled out and treated unfairly isn’t this Daycare was not a good fit for our family.

As a parent you always worry when you put your child in childcare for the first time after being home with you for almost 2 years. Armentas reassured me that my son would take time to adjust but never failed to let me know his improvement. I knew I didn't have to worry. My son is also learning more Spanish which is very important to me. There's no place like armentas!! Thank you for taking great care of my baby!

OPERATION_NAME: Great Beginnings Child Development Center Inc.
review_text: I would recommend this facility for your child or any child. I love how my daughter is well take care of. She enjoys herself and she learns a lot among other children and teachers. My other two children aged out of daycare and also was under Great Beginnings Care since back in 2014/2015. Mr Nicholas and other teachers do a great job. Thank you for everything.

OPERATION_NAME: Great Beginnings Child Development Center Inc.
review_text: Great place! My boys are so happy! They look forward to "school" everyday. Their social skills have improved so much since they began here. And my after schooler loves it. Not to mention all the field trips that they take during the summer. I feel totally comfortable with my boys here.  They love Mrs. Becky, Angie, Maria and Vianny! And Mr. Nicolas!

OPERATION_NAME: Great Beginnings Child Development Center Inc.
review_text:
DO NOT LEAVE YOUR KIDS HERE, AND IF YOU USE THIS DAYCARE PULL THEM OUT !!!

Last month I was looking for a Day care for my new born son. I work across the street from this daycare and figured id go in for some pricing. It was mid morning when I went in, and to my complete shock there was a bunch of children running around and NO ADULT!!!!! I was inside this daycare for 5-10 minutes walking around, looking for anyone over the age of 5!!! To my complete shock I was greeted by a little girl at the front door, when I asked where the adult was she shrugged her shoulders then went to go draw on a table in the back room. I was able to walk all the  way to the back play area, the bathrooms, even an office located to the right as soon as you walk in. Not once did i ever see an adult and on top of that, THERE IS NO SECURITY CAMERAS!!!

As a complete stranger i was able to walk into this daycare and be there for 5 minutes alone and unsupervised with all of these children. I left and called back and spoke with an employee about what happened and i was told "Well there is USUALLY someone at the front) I asked for a manager and there wasn't one available. I have since contacted this place over 10 times, left countless voicemails and have never heard back. They clearly don't care. THIS IS A HUGE SECURITY RISK FOR YOUR CHILDREN, PLEASE REMOVE YOUR KIDS FROM THIS PLACE. As a stranger with no children in this daycare i was able to walk in, undetected, and walk around the whole daycare before I left without once seeing and adult, the DOORS AREN'T EVEN LOCKED. As a new parent this is completely shocking and as a business owner myself this is unacceptable. They should be shut down for having this kids in such an unsecured environment.

OPERATION_NAME: Great Beginnings Child Development Center Inc.
review_text: Great staff!  nice , friendly , clean environment for your kids!. My kids love Ms. Becky and Ms Maria, all ladies are sweet. I have noticed a huge difference in their social skills and are learning so much through play.

OPERATION_NAME: Great Beginnings Child Development Center Inc.
review_text: Awesome daycare, my 5 year old learns so much, and always have field trips and projects to bring home. My 2 year old has developed so much in his speech and social skills. Great staff, and always communicates with me.

My son has gone to ACC 10th street for the past several years. He was in the toddler and prek3 classes from the time he was 16 months old and he's gone to the afterschool program for the past three years. We've also done drop in for full days when schools are closed as needed.

We very much appreciate how experienced and knowledgeable the teachers and staff are.  There's not a problem or issue Ms. Mildred hasn't seen or handled before, and she's quick to reassure you that she's had plenty of kids X or Y in the past and it's all worked out fine. Ms. Lyons has a million strategies to try when someone needs a little extra support and Ms. L can make any van ride fun and safe.  I've never thought for a minute that my son wasn't well taken care of and treated well when he's been up there.  He's always felt incredibly loved and cared for when he's there and always talks about the teachers/staff and the fun/interesting things they did when he gets home.

When he went full time to ACC we found the curriculum to be very age appropriate with a strong focus on fundamental skills, and they were willing to supplement and move forward or backward as needed.  We really appreciated that there was a lot of tactile and hands on work as many early childhood programs have moved to screen based learning, which we didn't love.  When he started DISD he was in the top percentiles for all subjects, I think due in large part to the strong foundation he received in early childhood education at ACC.

Compared to other facilities the price is phenomenal for what you get. When we priced and visited other facilities I legitimately thought ACC had misquoted us given all that is included in the price. I've heard people be a little skeptical of the level of care and curriculum given the price, but I don't think we could have found a better place for our son at a facility 3x the price.

We also really appreciate how dedicated ACC and the foundation is to the local community.  From big events, to providing meals at holidays, to the daily assurance that every child leaves incredibly well fed we love that they are not just a business in the community but are a business doing good in the community.

I can't recommend ACC enough for whatever age child you have. I'm going to be very sad when my son ages out, but luckily we have several more years of ACC for our family.

My 2 boys go to this daycare! They have come such a long way in their social lives. Potty trained! Great job at teaching children respect and responsibilities such as cleaning up and responsible behavior. My children are so far ahead and ready and eager to start school.

I love American Care Academy! My two youngest boys go there and they get excited when we pull up to the parking lot. All the stuff is very caring, loving and attentive. Thank you for taking good care of my babies 🫶🏻

My daughter attended this school for one whole year. This was our first daycare and like other first time parents we were very nervous to leave our little one and go back to work. Any concerns were addressed immediately and with proper care.  Thank you for your patience and for helping my daughter and us get past the transition.
The only reason I withdrew her is because we moved far. I've recommended this day care to family and friends.

All the teachers, staff, and students knew us, and would greet us every morning with great joy. My daughter started walking after 4 weeks of attending. She knows many children's songs, can speak at an age- appropriate level, and is on her way to being fully potty trained, all thanks to American Care Academy. They have a schedule and lesson plan that they follow.

My daughter absolutely love this place, she literally lights up in the parking lot and is ready to go in! When u first walk in u can feel the good energy from Mrs.Lyons. Everyone is absolutely caring and u can tell they actually care for the kids!! I am so glad I found this place due to me struggling to find good care for my baby. Mrs. Taylor is my daughter teacher and my baby loves her it’s all love when my baby girl see her! My baby has learned to crawl, pull up on things use words and just about ready to walk at 7 months. I give 5 stars and definitely recommend American Care Academy Dallas!.

Our experience with Angels on Earth Daycare has been nothing shy of amazing. They are the most loving and tender caregivers I’ve ever experienced. They are so attentive and responsive to our needs and I feel so safe sending our baby there every day. We feel so lucky to have found them!
We are so lucky to have found Angels on Earth. Mrs. Letty, along with the other teachers, are amazing. Thank you for all you do, we love you!
Excellent daycare for our children

10 STARS!!! Wild Hearts has been the most amazing experience for our family! Our daughter started going to the Aubrey location full-time just before she turned 2 years old and she went up until she started kindergarten. She is now 6 years old and in first grade, but she cannot wait to go to Wild Hearts Community School next summer. Wild Hearts lets kids be kids by enjoying the outdoors and teaching them a love for nature, art, and animals.
Shannon, Jordan, and the teachers do a fantastic job. Not only does our daughter love nature and animals, but she absolutely loves learning. Among the many lessons taught, our favorite was when she learned how to count in Spanish and recite the ABC’s in French. We just love Wild Hearts so much!

I can't say enough great things about our family's experience with this school! My daughter attended Wild Hearts Nature Preschool in Aubrey from ages 2 to 6.  She even spent one last "twilight summer" there with her old friends after kindergarten! Each day was filled with adventure as they focus on themes in nature, community, kindness, art, and fun. Jordan and Shannon are great educators. They hire only the best teachers and run the business side of things smoothly as well. We loved it so much; we drove out of town from Denton each day for 4 years just to ensure our child was spending her days playing outside and getting dirty! We absolutely love that they do not use screens. Thanks to this sweet, little school our daughter will forever have a "wild heart" and a love for learning.  We still talk about our pre-school experience fondly and will never forget how grateful we are for those magical four years.

We have had the pleasure of sending our two kids to Wild Hearts for the last two years. We were looking for a place that emphasized outdoor learning, embraced fun and joy, while also relying on research based practices; Wild Hearts does all of these things PLUS they love your child. The care and individualized attention they have received has been like no other setting. I can't begin to emphasize what a wonderful school this is with great teachers, and amazing directors. My kids looked forward to every day that they were there. As a parent, there's nothing better than knowing that your kid loves school, and that they are well cared for and safe. Thank you Wild Hearts!
Wild Hearts Community School in Denton.  Amazing school with kindness and creativity abounding daily.  My 4 year old grandson looks forward to every day he gets to attend.

I absolutely loved our experience at Angel Care! The staff truly makes you feel like family. They’re so caring, attentive, and patient with both the kids and parents. Paty was such a great director, warm, organized, and genuinely invested in the children’s growth. I also really appreciate the bilingual teaching environment. After just one week, my daughter was already counting to five in Spanish, which blew me away! It’s such a nurturing and educational space. We hated to leave, but if you’re considering Angel Care for your little one, don’t hesitate. It’s a wonderful place!

I have been with Angel's care since 2019 with my two oldest children. It has been the best daycare I could have ever picked. When I had my two youngest ones in 2023 and 2024, I knew exactly where they were going for daycare. I have always admired and loved every staff, management and owners. It's truly an amazing place for my children and all children for their future care. ❤️

My oldest has attended Angel’s since he was 8 months old and he is almost 4 and my second since he was 8 months old (he is now 1.5) and our experience has been great. The teachers are kind and patient, they get almost 2 hours of outdoor daily play time, and home cooked meals. They learn about managing their emotions, they socialize, and have nap time. My oldest is also learning letters and numbers- today he recognized “100”. It’s a great place with a strong community feel. Highly recommend Angel’s.

My 3-year-old daughter has been enrolled in daycare for a year and a half, and I have to admit it’s one of the best decisions I’ve made. She has learned so much, from counting and the alphabet to managing her emotions. The team at Angels Care is amazing and very professional. Let me not forget to mention they provide home-cooked meals for the children. I would definitely recommend this to any parent looking for a caring and loving daycare for their children.

Our 3 year old daughter has been attending school at Angels Care since she was 6 months old and we are so grateful for the level of care and schooling she receives there. We have a boy on the way and look forward to enrolling him next year as well.

When the level of care giving is so critical for young children to lead successful lives, as parents you really want to trust who is watching over your children for potentially 50+ hours per week. My wife and I are pleased with how our daughter has been treated and continues to grow by going to Angels Care, and how much the staff takes pride in the role they play with developing young children!

Wonderful school!
My daughter is about start her 3rd year of grade school here and I have been very pleased. The school not only provides a great education, but also operates on Christian values and encourages the children to do the same. They don't cram religion down the students' throats, but they are sure of what they believe and don't waiver. The administration shows faith by works. The student body is diverse and there is no elitism. To find a few of these qualities in any one school is not hard, but to find them all is an absolute blessing!!

Memorial Lutheran School is an warm and welcoming environment where students are challenged and nurtured  at every level. It is a school that is set up to create future leaders, as there is a heavy emphasis on learning how to communicate! Early grade school students spend a healthy amount of time learning grammar, and the middle school children are involved in writing meaningful assignments, debating each other, and reading at a higher level on a weekly basis. The Latin curriculum compliments the emphasis on communication, as students come away with an even greater understanding of language through this subject.

This years advanced Latin class had a great time reading the Latin edition of the Hobbit, and the debate team did a fantastic job at their tournaments.

Memorial is not only a place for nourishing academic young minds, it is also wonderful place where children at any level can participate in the growing sports program, and excel in music (especially strings) to a far greater level than one could do at most other schools in the Houston area!

Everyone we have worked with at Memorial Lutheran School has been extremely kind and welcoming! Very accommodating and eager to help. The grounds are beautiful and you can tell the students are very well taken care of! We highly recommend a visit/tour!

This church reads from the Bible and studies the word. The sheep here are following Jesus Christ. They pray to the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. I read a comment about the children here being future leaders and I totally agree with that.
Focuses more on reading scriptures than teaching children math science and history

Both of my kids have gone here since they were 6 weeks old - they're 6 and 7 now. They have always felt love and kindness from all of their teachers since day one. We unfortunately are moving so they will no longer attend, but everyone here will hold such a dear place in my heart.

My daughter has been going there for about a month. She is in the toddler section and not 2 yet, but almost there; their work with her has helped get her out of her shell. She is expressive in her way and is learning every day something new. She loves her teacher, Mrs. Juanita. I have no issues so far. I'll update if anything changes. The director is very quick to solve my concerns.

Thank you for reading.

My daughter loved this place. All of the teachers that I met were very nice and upfront. My daughter took a liking to everyone and that's saying a lot because my baby normally doesn't like people. Now the only downfall is that the tuition is expensive, over $1000/m, but you get what you pay for. I'd rather be safe than sorry when it comes to childcare.

Everything about the teachers and the facility here is wonderful. I know my child is safe with them, and not only is my child safe, but my child is also THRIVING! My child went from just being watched to learning and making friends. We went from being afraid to sit on the potty to using it on a regular basis. I cannot say enough good things about this center. Everyone is always welcoming, kind, and make my child feel safe and loved.

If i can give this center no Stars i would. This is the worst over ratted place ever! My kids have been emotionality dramatized and treated inhumane. The director allows the staff to run all over her. MY kids have witnessed kids getting Physically attacked by staff, and these teachers are still there till this day. Teachers walk around saying i hate my job i need to quit, they need to get fired ETC...I have Video proof!!! i feel really sorry for the kids who are Disabled and cant speak for them self! this place needs new staff all around!!

Heavenly Sent Daycare was a heavenly sent place for me. As a new mother it was hard for me to trust anybody with my child. After speaking with the owner I felt comfortable about leaving my child in her childcare facility. My child was hesitant and dealt with separation anxiety, the owner reassured my daughter and myself daily/monthly it would be get better. Over time the separation anxiety subsided and she could not wait to attend the center. My daughter loves interacting with the other children. Heavenly Sent offers a drop-in care which is great if you don't need the entire week. The rates are reasonable.

I was referred to Heavenly Sent Daycare by another parent, and it was truly one of the best decisions I’ve made for my children. Before enrolling, my 3-year-old struggled with separation and would cry every morning at drop-off. From the very first day we met Ms. Shay, everything changed. She immediately felt familiar and comforting, and my son didn’t cry at all.
Within about two months, both of my boys were fully potty trained , something I had been struggling with before. Even more impressive, my 4-year-old started kindergarten already able to read and identify words.
Ms. Shay is patient, nurturing, and genuinely loves the children in her care. She doesn’t just “watch” them.....she teaches them, cares for them, and pours into them. My boys truly became her babies.
I highly recommend Heavenly Sent Daycare to any parent looking for a safe, loving, and educational environment for their children.

We are absolutely happy and satisfied with our provider, she has cared for my boys since they were very young, and now they’re about to leave to start school. She truly cares about each child, and my boys even miss her when they’re away. She’s incredibly professional, and we’ve been so happy that we’ve joked about having another baby just to keep attending. Also she is highly involved with the kids and they learn so much, they’re definitely ready for school. Highly recommended!

I never trust my kids with anyone but Heavenly Sent Daycare was AMAZING!! They were professional and you can tell they truly care about the children. My kids loved it and so did I! Best daycare hands down!

My child goes to this daycare and he has been going there since he was about 2 months and he is six months now and I feel so comfortable with my baby there. She takes her time with him and he is thriving here at Heavenly Sent I would recommend this daycare to anyone. She is very loving and kind towards my son. This is a five star facility!

My kiddo has gone here for the last five years. I am extremely grateful for the exceptional care and love he has been given by every class he has been in. Lea is the greatest. She is passionate about what she does and it shows. We’ve been lucky to have her in two classes and if I could steal her to go to elementary, I would. Monique is another teacher that I’m so glad we had along the way. She handles toddlers so well. Such a hard age group and she does it with grace and love. Estella is an angel from heaven meant to work with babies. She made the transition to daycare so easy for me and helped me so much as a new mom during Covid. I love this place and all of the people that have made my life easier.

We moved to Benbrook and after touring a few daycares, we decided to go with this one. The tour was around 9:30 and I noticed that all the rooms were clean and organized. They have a well structured curriculum that my daughter wasn’t used to and I was worried about her adapting well to it.
Thanks God, it work out perfectly, she loves it! At her previous daycare, she would cry everyday. But not here. Everyone has been very patient and nurturing with her and that made this transition very smooth and easy for us. She loves Ms. Lea and her PK-2 classmates. The director is also great and easy to talk to about any concerns.

We are very thankful for the teachers at this daycare. My toddler can be a little needy, so I truly appreciate how Ms. Alma and Ms. Shina approached him with so much care and kindness. She made him feel safe and comfortable, which helped him stop crying and adjust much more easily.

I really like the environment they provide. The teachers have a daily agenda with activities planned each day, which helps the kids learn and grow. They also have time to go outside or use the playroom for exploration. My child definitely benefits from the structured schedule—he has improved so much since starting daycare. He is socializing more and making friends.

Thank you for being so patient, caring, and welcoming. You made the transition much easier for our family. We truly appreciate everything you do!

This place has the most wonderful staff . Especially their director that wonderful amazing woman goes above and beyond for everybody. This school they are absolutely amazing I couldn't say enough good things about this place there are so many places out there you can't trust but I can tell you with 100% with honesty and Truth this is the best place you could put your child and watch them grow into a wonderful human being. Elder struggling their teachers will do whatever they can to help your child and their needs. Wherever I go I sing this place's praises non stop . The director and staff are true blessing.

Love the attention and care that our girls have gotten over the last 5 years! Ms. Lea & Ms Ashley in PK2 have done such a great job helping our daughter in her learning and growth! And Ms Estella and Ms Alma in the Infant classroom have left us without worry with our youngest. CCY truly has been a great place for our family!

We started our daughter at Itzcali at 10 months old and she is now almost 18 months - we love it! We were very nervous at first but Daniela made us feel welcomed and assured that our daughter would be okay. There was an adjustment period at first (to be expected) but now our daughter runs to her teachers as soon as she sees them! & at pickup, we always notice the teachers sneaking in extra hugs as they are saying goodbye.

Itzcali might not have all the "frills" of a larger more corporate daycare, but we feel strongly that our daughter is not only safe and cared for but thriving in this environment!

OPERATION_NAME: The PREP School of Kinder Ranch
review_text:
We made the difficult decision to withdraw our five-year-old child from The Prep at Kinder Ranch due to serious safety concerns and how they were handled by administration.

Another student made two explicit threats to kill our child, both directed specifically at him. After the first threat, the child was not removed from the classroom, and parents were not notified until after the second threat occurred. When the situation was discussed with administration, the threats were minimized as typical attention-seeking behavior for a five-year-old.

We immediately removed our child from the classroom. Days later, we were informed that the child who made the threats would remain enrolled, with the reasoning that removal would be “unfair” due to the child’s age. We were also told that notifying parents about the threats was questioned, which was extremely concerning from a transparency and safety standpoint.

Proper authorities were not notified by the school, and we were left to seek guidance on our own. After following direction from Child Protective Services and filing a police report, administration characterized us as a threat rather than acknowledging a parent’s legitimate concern for child safety.

We no longer felt confident that student safety and well-being were being prioritized, and for that reason, we withdrew our child.

Parents deserve clear communication, appropriate safety protocols, and leadership that takes violent language seriously—regardless of a child’s age. Unfortunately, that was not our experience here.

review_text:
Parents, please read this before enrolling your child here.

I trusted this daycare with my son since he was 4 months old, and I stayed quiet far too long out of grace and loyalty. But what I’ve witnessed recently made it clear — this place is not safe or professionally run.

I’ve picked my baby up with a soaked diaper more times than I can count, even though I send plenty of clean ones every morning. His backpack would come home full of unused diapers. When I tried to address it, the staff brushed it off and made me out to be the problem.

Then they called saying my son had been “sick for days,” which was completely false. His doctor confirmed he was fine aside from mild allergies. When I confronted them, I was berated and told it wasn’t their responsibility to communicate anything about his health — and even told that “other parents had been complaining about him.” That’s a total violation of confidentiality.

To make things worse, they kept referring to their director, who is never actually present because she lives in India. In her absence, unlicensed and untrained staff are left to run the center and care for children. That explains the lack of consistency, professionalism, and basic care.

I’ve since withdrawn my son and reported them to the state. Parents deserve to know who’s really watching their kids — and it’s not who you think.

If you care about your child’s safety, find another daycare.

My son started attending Little Munchkins Daycare on Monday, May 5th. Right away, I had an uneasy feeling. As we walked into his classroom on his first day, I overheard one of his classmates say that my son and another African American child “looked the same.” Although we all know children are children, I noticed immediately they were the only two children of color in the class. As a mother of a Black child, that moment stuck with me.

The very next day, Tuesday, May 6th, after picking up my son from daycare, I noticed he had ringworm. I was taken back and kind of disgusted but not quite surprised. The daycare doesn’t feel or look clean. It has a lingering musty smell, and although I’d often see a staff member vacuuming when I arrived for pickup, it didn’t give me much confidence in their sanitation practices. I called my son's doctor, who couldn't see him in person until May 15th but confirmed it was ringworm and advised he stay home for 48 hours while starting antibiotics. His first week of school, and he’s already coming home with an infection.

Out of concern, I began looking into the facility’s health records and found a violation from February 24, 2023 specifically, 746.3401(a)  for failing to complete their annual sanitation inspection. The last one on record was from December 15, 2021. That speaks volumes. This isn’t just an old problem it’s an ongoing one.

THAT WAS JUST WEEK 1

On Friday, May 9th, when my son returned to school, he handed me a Mother’s Day card  and I was genuinely excited. I always look forward to the sweet crafts my children make, I keep them forever. But when I looked at the card, my heart dropped. The handprint holding the flowers on the card was clearly from a child with much lighter skin. It didn’t reflect my child or our family at all. It made me emotional because representation matters especially at this age when kids are just beginning to understand themselves and how they show up in the world.

I sent a message about it through the Procare app but never received a response. The following Monday, after Mother’s Day, I did receive an in-person apology from his teacher. And while that may seem small to some, it wasn’t small to me. Things like this carry weight  especially for young children learning to navigate identity and self-worth. That moment only confirmed for me what I was already feeling: my child wasn’t in a space where he was truly seen, valued, or welcomed.

Sanitation and inclusion are two of my highest priorities when it comes to child care. After everything we had experienced, I gave my two-week notice on Monday, May 12th. His last day would be yesterday May 26th but since it was a holiday it would be Friday, May 23rd.

But unfortunately, the issues didn’t stop there.

The following week, I picked my son up and noticed he was sitting alone while the other kids played on the other side of the carpet. As I approached, I heard the teacher say, “How would you guys like it if someone said they didn’t want to be your friend?” I didn’t say much in that moment, but on the ride home, my son opened up to me telling me how no one wanted to read with him and how it made him feel. He’s not disruptive or a behavior issue. He’s just a kid trying to connect.

I gave him a little life talk about friendships that not everyone will be your friend, and that’s okay, just as we won’t always choose to be friends with everyone. But it broke my heart that he felt the need to explain that to me, at four years old.

CONTINUED ....

review_text: First time mom here, and when I tell you that this daycare is a blessing,…Please believe me! They treat my son like he is family and he is learning so much! It was hard for me to find the balance between working and being a mom, but I feel so secure knowing my son is safe.

My son attended Little Learners Academy in San Antonio for 8 months, starting at around 18 months old. This was his first daycare experience, and the center made the transition incredibly smooth and stress-free.

Convenience & Daily Operations

•  Prime location: Just 5 minutes from home, making drop-off and pickup quick and hassle-free.

•  Brightwheel app: Real-time updates on diaper changes, meals, naps, and incidents – a game-changer for first-time daycare parents.

•  Daily arts & crafts: My son came home with adorable projects every single day.

Safety, Care & Comfort

•  Rare minor incidents: Only typical toddler clumsiness; staff handled everything with care and immediate communication.

•  Support stuffy allowed: They welcomed his comfort item, which eased separation anxiety.
•  Outdoor play: Two structured sessions daily, weather permitting.

•  Ms. Benavides (Director): Actively involved in supervision, approachable, and responsive to every question or concern.

Nutrition & Curriculum

•  Balanced meals: Included all food groups with good variety – my son loved the options.

•  Snacks provided: Parents can send specific items if needed.

•  Strong curriculum: At 2 years old, my son is now praised for advanced speech and knowledge – I credit much of this to the center’s engaging program.

Staff & Environment

•  Teacher turnover: Higher than expected, but all staff were experienced, kind, and consistently smiling.

•  Happy kids: Photos showed joyful children; pickups/drop-offs were always calm and positive.

•  Family engagement: Fun off-site activities that welcomed parents and siblings.

Final Verdict

We loved Little Learners Academy and would reenroll in a heartbeat if we hadn’t relocated. If you’re in San Antonio, tour this center – your child will be cared for, educated, and genuinely loved. Highly recommended! 🌟

My 9-month-old was enrolled at Kid University Prep inside Friendship West for one month. While the facility itself is relatively small and the classrooms are spacious, I believe there are some serious areas that need immediate attention—particularly in health, safety, and communication.

Shortly after enrolling, my child became sick with diarrhea and then contracted Hand, Foot, and Mouth disease. While I understand that illnesses happen in childcare settings, what concerned me the most was the lack of transparency and communication. There were babies with 104-degree fevers being sent home from the infant room, yet no formal communication went out to parents until a full week later—after the virus had spread across multiple classrooms.

In fact, I only learned what was going around thanks to another parent. The very next day, my child became ill. I informed the center on Monday, but parents weren't officially notified until Thursday evening. Unfortunately, it gave the impression that communication was delayed intentionally, possibly to avoid a drop in attendance (and revenue) for the week. As both a business owner and an educator, I hold high standards for health and safety—and above all, I would never risk a child’s well-being for financial reasons. That delay in communication was deeply disappointing.

To be clear, this review isn’t meant to bash the center. I actually waited to share my thoughts, but after my child was out for a week and no one followed up with me—or acknowledged my concerns—I felt compelled to speak up. I care about the well-being of all children, not just my own.

The center has potential, but they need: Stronger protocols for cleanliness, More staff in the infant room (too many babies), Clear and immediate communication when health concerns arise

Overall, it’s not a bad place. But if you’re a parent who values transparency, timely updates, and a strong emphasis on hygiene—this is something to be aware of. I sincerely hope they take this feedback to heart and make the necessary improvements.

The best decision we ever made was enrolling our kids here. Our 5 year old is doing kindergarten/first grade work and is absolutely excelling. The love and kindness that Jessica and her team put into these kids is truly unmatched. ❤️

To everyone at The Kindness Academy thank you so very much for making our first daycare, the only daycare!

We love The Kindness Academy! My soon to be 2 year old loves going. The teachers, the staff, they're all so sweet and kind. They're communicative and send updates/pictures throughout the day and respond quickly if needed, they're amazing. We could not recommend them enough!

The kindness academy is the kind of daycare every parent wishes they could find. The staff is dedicated and sincere. Your child’s wellbeing and happiness is their priority. My son loved his teachers and was so happy to see them every morning.

We receive regular daily updates on feeding and nutrition as well as photos of our baby.

The staff is quick to respond to questions, and they pay close attention to your child’s milestones and share details with you at pickup.

I feel confident that my child is in safe hands.
The kindness academy lives up to its name

There is no better feeling as a parent to be able to trust others with your child. The Kindness Academy goes above and beyond for the children and their employees. The atmosphere they create for a learning environment/experience for learning shows! Our son loves going to “school” and socializing with his friends. A Place Filled with Love, Care, and Godly Values

I want to give a special thank you to the owner and the staff of LBJ Creative Ideas Learning Academy. There is an atmosphere of family. They truly love their jobs and it shows through the exceptional service provided everyday!

OPERATION_NAME: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center at Alamo Ranch
review_text:
Children’s Lighthouse of Alamo Ranch has been a fabulous daycare for my son. Soon as we walked in, my wife and I knew this was the place. It’s been at least 6 months now that my kid has been going here and he absolutely loves it!

He loves his friends, his teachers and all of the staff. They are all super nice and friendly! The teachers (classroom as well as staff management) know the kids by their first names.

I highly recommend them to any parents looking for daycare around the Alamo ranch area. They also have a very good selection of extracurricular activities for the kids to participate in to help them learn and grow!

OPERATION_NAME: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center at Alamo Ranch
review_text: My daughter loves to come here. She attended their summer camp and anytime school is out and we have to work it’s so convenient to drop her off for a day of care. Every single person is kind and greets you. It’s a great feeling to be able to drop your child off and feel at ease.

OPERATION_NAME: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center at Alamo Ranch
review_text: It’s a good day care. The turn around rate for teachers seems to be not too bad to what we’ve seen elsewhere. It *is* quite expensive (about $350-$380 a week for an infant) and I also don’t like that they practically bribe their parents with good reviews. Every now and then they’ll offer a free week of tuition if you leave a Google review. Obviously they’re not going to give someone who left a 1 star review the free week, hence all the 5 stars from around the same time frame.

OPERATION_NAME: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center at Alamo Ranch
review_text: This is by far the best daycare we have come across (and we have seen some things). The staff and teachers are amazing and really take the time to know your child. The quality of the playground equipment, food, student/teacher ratio, curriculum, and parent communication are all exactly what we want in a daycare.

OPERATION_NAME: Childrens Lighthouse Learning Center at Alamo Ranch
review_text: I can’t say enough amazing things about Children’s Lighthouse. My daughter started September 2024 at about 3 months old and has been thriving. You can tell she genuinely enjoys going to daycare the teachers and staff have been exceptional. We love hearing about our daughter’s day everyday from the teachers and we love the livestream feature. Being able to see our little one throughout the day is a huge plus. You can truly see how much daycare is helping with her development and the teachers really care. I would recommend this daycare to all my friends and family.
The growth in my child has been amazing! Love the staff! The owner is amazing as well!

OPERATION_NAME: Kiddie Koop Day Care Center Inc
review_text: We are beyond blessed to be able to have our boys at Kiddie Koop.  The entire staff is friendly and always welcoming!  My boys LOVE going to school and were not this excited about their last school-  so as a momma, that’s a blessing in its own.

My daughter went to this location from 2yrs - 10 years old. We had a great experience there with the loving teachers and how they truly make things personable as possible. I then had my nephew there also in the infant room where I tell you those ladies love on those babies as their own. The cutest art with their foot and handprints and even the small outside area for them to play. He would get so excited to see Ms. Divya in the am. They take pictures of the kids also throughout the week which is comforting especially with an infant child. I highly recommend Country Home Learning Center in Leon Springs.

This facility is in a great area. The teachers are always so welcoming & friendly whenever I drop off or pick up my son. The indoor playground is such a great option for the kids when it’s not a good weather day outside. The splash pad is an awesome opportunity for the kids to stay cool during the summer.

Country Home Learning Center has been an incredible experience for my 2-year-old! The staff always welcomes us with a warm smile, and the teachers are excellent. My child has bonded well with them and is always excited to go to school. The activities keep my little one engaged and learning while having fun. The best part has been seeing my child so happy and thriving here. I highly recommend it!

My niece and nephew had a fantastic experience at Country Home Learning Center during their summer camp! After having a tough time at other centers, we were thrilled to see how much they thrived here. The environment was exactly what they needed to flourish. I first noticed how vibrant and welcoming the entire center was. The classrooms and hallways were clean and beautifully decorated with colorful, child-made artwork. It created a happy and energetic atmosphere that made the kids feel at home. Every corner of the center radiated positivity and creativity!

The field trips were a huge hit! The center put much thought into planning enriching and fun experiences for the kids. The in-house activities, especially the STEM projects, were top-notch and kept them learning and engaged throughout the summer!

What also stood out was the staff, who are incredibly kind, upbeat, and professional. The team at Country Home Learning Center shows genuine care and respect for every child, and it made a world of difference. My niece and nephew always came home happy, excited, and looking forward to the next day. They can’t wait for next summer!

We are grateful for their wonderful summer and highly recommend Country Home Learning Center to any family!

Country home is the best!! I am a mother of four and every single one of my kids has attended Country Home. My youngest has been on the slower side when it comes to eating solid food, and wanting to walk, but his teachers have been so helpful and patient with him! My boys start tomorrow so I will update after a few weeks but the entire enrollment process has been amazing. Ms. Felicia, Jessica at the front and all of the teachers I met (for the 2 year old class & 3-4 year old class) were absolutely sweet. I asked 1 million questions because I’ve never left my babies with anyone but I felt a sense of peace when I walked in. Our tour was later in the evening and the place smelled so clean, each room was picked up and neat. Jessica gave us a thorough tour where she answered each question with care while also checking on kiddos if needed. This helped me see that the baby’s come first- as they should. As we were getting ready to leave from the tour, our 3 year old son kept gravitating towards this kind woman walking around the front of the building, going from class to class, I thought she was a parent. She gave snacks to my sons, helped them stay calm while we talked to Jessica. It was amazing to see, I had hoped she was a teacher or something so I asked Jessica “who is she? Like another teacher?” Jessica said that’s actually our director! I was SHOCKED! I couldn’t believe the director would be quietly playing with our babies and just be so amazing with the kids. She was welcoming, kind, warm and caring. As we were walking out the front door I saw her in the front saying bye to kids as they left (it was right around 6pm) I stopped to speak with her and she again answered more questions, assured me that we could call her directly and made sure we had that number and listened to our worries and concerns as new daycare parents. She never pressured me to sign up right then and there, never forced me to quickly decide, and instead supported me through this decision that took days for me to make. She said she would follow up with us in a couple of days AND SHE DID. She called us as we were leaving another tour and I took that as a sign that this was the right place to go with. They have camera access, meals included, code required to enter the building and are open from 6:30am-6pm! Talk with Ms.Felicia directly about any issues or concerns you have and I promise you will not leave that conversation feeling the same. I’m so happy to be a part of this new family and I pray blessings over the director, the staff members and each child/parent that walks through those doors daily. ❤️❤️❤️❤️ May your hearts continue to be soft for the children you are serving daily, may your patience always grow and continue to shine through the care you provide over these babies and may your cups overflow the way you have made mine 🫶🏼

The director Felicia, my goodness she is so amazing and communication is on point. Ms BreAnna, has been so patient with my son and it shows, he loves her class. OPERATION_NAME: Respite Care of San Antonio Incorported
review_text:
My son did not finish winter break at this center due to the nature of the program, very small classroom space, and limited ability of caregivers to reasonably accommodate my autistic son’s mild behaviors related to his sensory processing challenges.

I appreciate the opportunity to try the program but it’s just not the right environment for an autistic little boy that needs a little more space. The first thing I said day one was “he’s going to be in this tiny room all day?” I could clearly see it wasn’t a recipe for success.

His “classroom” was very small for 5 large special needs children and an adult. I would estimate it to be no larger than a 12x12 room. The table they use for lunch is also too small. I’d be surprised and also sad if the room meets requirements for space.

Also, I’m not sure what outdoor requirements are but a little more outdoor time might be good. He said they didn’t go outside at all because it was "too cold"…it was at least 65 degrees. I’ve also heard them say it was too wet. I feel like every attempt should be made to get children outside for a good chunk of time every day, especially when inside quarters are so cramped.

Nap time, they seemed to struggle to help him to settle into a quiet activity even though I provided an iPad and headphones with downloaded content. My son hasn’t napped since he was 4. He’s 7. Perhaps nap time would be a great opportunity for older kids to go outside after lunch.

The caregivers were very friendly and kind and I have no complaints or concerns at all regarding the people working there, minus their lack of necessary skill sets.

review_text: I am so blessed that my mother and I found this facility for both of my kids. Ms Melissa is so patient and caring to my son. The staff in the babyroom is so loving to my daughter. This school, has brought me so much peace & calmness with the Amazing, friendly staff that work here which makes drop off easy and fast knowing that my children are well taking care of, Learning and safe. The director here is super incredible and knowledgeable about the school and it's history, she's full of joy that lights up a room and she's always happy.
This school is a very enriched learning environment with alot of resources for young children to grow. Smells great,looks aesthetically pleasing and always clean which is a Big Plus. Highly recommend Children's Center of Austin Bee Cave.

It makes me sad to have to write this review but I’m hoping what happened to us at the Children’s Center of Austin, Westlake doesn’t happen to another family. My son attended the Children Center of Austin, Westlake location from mid January to mid April, 2024. He was 6-9 months old while there. Our top priority has always been the safety and well-being of our son, yet incidents underscored our concerns regarding his safety while under the care of CCOA. Our son was diagnosed with severe food allergies and had a few occasions of anaphylactic shock. Luckily never while at daycare but for the third time in a month, our son was placed in a different classroom without us knowing, the substitute teacher was NOT aware of his anaphylactic allergies and did NOT know the location of his Epi-pen. Senior management’s response was to keep changing policies with the latest one being that they wanted his Epi-pen to be located outside the classroom, such as at the front desk or office, but there were many occasions when we've arrived and found no one at the front desk or office — this left us deeply troubled and indicated a sever lack of understanding about the urgency of anaphylactic allergies.

Furthermore, the continued misidentification of our son as another kids name by staff members added to our concerns. This oversight continued to reflect a lack of attention to detail. Senior leaderships response was ‘we can understand the teachers continued mistake as your son and the other kid do look similar.’ The similarities are that our kids both have the same eye color and hair color.

There were MANY other smaller issues: sent home wearing other kids diapers and clothes, terrible diaper rash on multiple occasions (even after raising concerns from our doctor to Senior Management), using other kids diaper cream on our kid, photos loaded to the app that were not our child, misrepresentation of what our kid ate listed on the app… the list goes on.
We exhausted all avenues in attempting to resolve these issues with Senior Management but unfortunately, issues continued to arise, leaving us with no choice but to prioritize our son’s safety above all else and leave.

We cannot recommend this school as a safe environment for children. The evident deficiencies in leadership undermine their ability to create a secure and nurturing setting. Until meaningful changes are made at the leadership level, we fear these issues will persist, ultimately impacting the well-being of the children under their care.

We have been with The Learning Center – Jersey Village for over a year now, and I truly cannot say enough good things about this place. As a parent who moved to Houston from out of town, navigating childcare with little community or guidance was honestly one of the scariest parts of relocating. Finding a place I could trust with my children meant everything, and I am so grateful we found this center.

I have three children enrolled here, and from day one, the care, patience, and intentionality have been evident. Sakina and Ali are incredibly understanding, supportive, and genuinely invested in both the children and their families. They are amazing role models, and it’s clear that what they do is more than a job,  it’s a calling.

review_text: It's pretty good, but there are numerous things that could be far better than they are. Overall, you get out of it what you put into it. review_text:

They have a well balanced learning curriculum for the kids - where it doesn’t feel TOO regimented, but it’s far more than a glorified babysitting service. Our son is always excited to go back after holiday breaks. When we ask what his favorite part of Kido is he always says “I love getting to learn new things at school” - they have truly turned him onto the joy of learning.

I would recommend Kido to anyone searching for the right daycare, but especially if being bilingual in Spanish is a priority. We are a bilingual household, but had leaned too far into English and needed to course correct. While our son has always understood Spanish, with Kido’s additional support he’s finally becoming more confident in speaking it.

We feel so lucky to have found Kido International School in Bouldin Creek. The teachers are truly exceptional: warm and so attentive . Our daughter has blossomed since starting here. Her speech has developed so much, she’s picking up sign language, doing yoga, and proudly showing off everything she learns. She’s also genuinely excited every morning. Drop-off is a breeze because she’s so happy to be with her teachers and classmates. It’s such a joy to see her thriving in a space that’s both nurturing and enriching. We’re incredibly grateful to be part of the Kido community.

We’ve had a wonderful experience at Kido on South 1st! The teachers are incredibly thoughtful and genuinely care about each child—they consistently keep us in the loop with clear and meaningful communication. It’s been amazing to see how much more confident our son has become, especially in using Spanish, which is such a joy to witness. The facilities are always clean and well maintained, and the school is clearly run by a strong leadership team with dedicated staff. I would wholeheartedly recommend Kido to any family looking for a nurturing, engaging, and well-run environment for their child.

Our 1 year old daughter has been at Kido for the past year, and we have truly loved our experience. The leadership, staff and team of teachers are top notch and have done an incredible job building a wonderful environment that fosters socialization, development & community. The teachers are loving and attentive (special shoutouts to Ms Marcella, Ms Jessica and Ms Mirna) and the school does an amazing job creating community building activities and events for the parents and community.

If you need a luxurious daycare in Austin, Kido is the place to be. The Team at Kido is simply amazing and is a part of our family. It truly takes a village to raise a child and everyone at this daycare takes care of each other and hosts events like book club and parties. Our child routinely says she loves her teachers and staff.

The app for parents is so easy to use and communicate with staff and teachers. They are incredibly responsive and send pictures of your child throughout the day. The facilities are gorgeous, safe, and clean. All the teachers know your child’s name even if your child isn’t in their classroom, that’s how tight knit this community is. The full Spanish immersion is awesome, our child is picking up Spanish so easily and routinely uses it at home and outside.

Kido is very military family friendly as well and participates in the Department of Defense childcare subsidy program!

The menu for food is healthy and nutritious. Accommodations can easily be made and there is a catering service for lunch if you want that for your child.

Kido also offers dance and gymnastics at the school so another superior program you can take advantage at Kido.

As a military family, we have moved all over the place and our kid has been in 4 different daycares. I can easily say that Kido has been the premier and best daycare yet!

I’m going to be honest. Even though I researched the daycare reviews, and reports and  found nothing wrong I was really worried about enrolling my nephew. My heart was scared the daycare might not be patient with him due to medical needs. I wish I can go back and calm myself down because I love the kindercare staff. My nephew loves going and playing with his friends. The teachers here are always encourage him and help him achieve his goals for therapy, while making sure he is included and has fun. I want to specifically thank ms.silvia who has been with him since the beginning she has helped us with his health and growth. She is his biggest advocate. My nephew adores her ! She has made a huge impact on his life as well as Julia, Sophia, Tina, and Malinda .Thank you for always keeping my nephew clean, safe,& loved .Yall have become part of our family and I’m so blessed to have yall on his corner.

I’ve been involved with Kindercare now for 5 years, both of my boys have went here. My oldest started when he was 3 up until school age. I highly recommend this center to anyone looking to enroll their kids in a childcare.

Hillside is an amazing school with teachers that go above and beyond for the babies and kids! We have little ones in our family that go there and it’s been a wonderful experience! We have been at Hillside the last 8 years. The staff is professional, educated, and kind. The kids have so much fun learning, both inside and outside. Hillside has a gorgeous outside area with lots of play space. I highly recommend them!

They only care about licensing and following protocol, not about the kids. Teachers have spanked kiddos as young as the clover classroom. Staff is also extremely discriminatory towards low income families and discuss their private lives, paraphernalia, use curse words, etc in-front of the kids. It was a pleasure working with Suzanne today. Glad we were able to help in the process of cleanup for the kiddos.

We are so lucky to have Hillside ECC in our neighborhood. They go above and beyond to provide an experience that fun, nurturing, and educational. They have created a well thought out curriculum and give me daily updates on my child's development and interests. I feel like I get a wonderful glimpse into his day when I can't be there. My son attended Pre-K here and I'm so glad that he did.  He looked forward to going to school every day and didn't want to leave when it was time to go home. This year he started Kindergarten and had his assessment yesterday and let me say his teacher was AMAZED at how much he already knew!  I thank Ms. Zutella, Ms. Nicole, and Ms.  Deborah for doing a phenomenal job in making sure he was well prepared for Kindergarten.  We are truly appreciative of Hillside and only wish they had a kindergarten class as well.

We absolutely love Stepping Stones School, especially the baby room. My baby has been attending here, and she has been doing so well. The teachers are incredibly caring, loving, and attentive—they truly treat each baby with so much patience and warmth. The management team is also wonderful—very supportive, organized, and always approachable, which makes a big difference for parents. I always feel confident and at peace knowing my child is in such good hands. The environment is safe, nurturing, and supportive, and it’s clear that everyone genuinely cares about the children. I’m so grateful for everything they do and highly recommend Stepping Stones School to any parent looking for a loving place for their children

Our family couldn’t be happier with our experience at this school. From the very first day, we’ve felt welcomed, supported, and valued it truly feels like a community that cares deeply about every child and family.

We couldn’t be more happy with the care for our little girl at Stepping Stone McNeil. Greenwood Preschool is truly exceptional, thanks to its outstanding teachers and stellar communication. The educators here go above and beyond, creating a positive and engaging atmosphere for the children. Personally, I love how my kid is always busy with enriching activities, and the updates on the Brightwheel app provide a window into their exciting learning journey. Greenwood Preschool excels in creating a supportive and dynamic environment for both kids and parents.

Greenwood Preschool is a haven for young minds, adorned with a beautiful facility and an expansive outdoor playing area. The well-designed spaces cater to both education and play, offering a holistic learning experience. The teachers here not only excel in fostering creativity and growth but also demonstrate outstanding communication with parents. Greenwood stands out as a nurturing environment where the combination of a stunning facility, ample outdoor space, and exceptional teacher-parent communication make it a top choice for families seeking a well-rounded early education for their children.

Greenwood Preschool sets the bar high with its excellent facility, seamlessly integrating a vibrant learning space with a nurturing environment.
