The well-designed curriculum ensures that every child gets the best of both worlds, making Greenwood Preschool a standout choice for parents seeking a comprehensive and enjoyable early education experience.

We really wanted to love this facility. Unfortunately, we only lasted a few weeks because we started noticing that our son would come home with a sad demeanor every day. I'm not convinced he was being properly cared for because the staff wasn't very friendly overall. On various occasions, I wouldn't get a "Hello", even if there were staff at the front desk. For me, that's a red flag. It just wasn't for us.

Having experienced both before and after school programs at Greenwood Preschool, it's been a consistently excellent choice for my family. Now, watching my younger brothers thrive there is heartening. They really enjoy the breakfast that they get served every morning and the snack that they receive when they come from school .The teachers, especially Miss Nadia, are outstanding—creating a positive and engaging environment. The use of the Brightwheel app adds an extra layer of reassurance, as I receive pictures and updates showcasing the fun activities they're immersed in. Greenwood Preschool continues to be a reliable and enriching choice for families seeking a nurturing before and after school experience.

My son's first experience with daycare. He was there as a baby and all of the ladies spoiled him like he was theirs. We loved it!! We took him out when a  biter/scratcher came on the scene and nothing was done about it. I think he was somebody on staff's grandchild that had been asked to leave other daycares and it was the last stop for him. Hopefully the one in charge who let the biter stay is long gone now. That was awhile back though, so check it out. It was convenient, the price was right, it was safe and the workers loved the kids.  I'd still recommend it.

This would be a 5-star review if it wasn’t for their Covid-19 policy.
The administrators and teachers are amazing. Everything about this place is amazing EXCEPT their COVID-19 policies.
If you want to pay full price for daycare that your child can only attend 75% of the school year, this is the place for you.

With each positive case they are quarantining the whole class for up to a week. This happens often. On top of that they are mixing classes, so 1 positive case ends up causing multiple classes to have to quarantine.
This creates a hard financial burden on all these parents that have to pay for a daycare they can’t attend, and then pay for babysitters.

Again the staff here is Amazing. We love this place. We are sad to go, but their Covid-19 policy is not sustainable.

This was my daughter’s first experience with daycare. We started her just before her 2nd birthday and could honestly, not be more impressed. Her teachers are so loving and patient! She has learned so much and is always doing music, gym, art, etc. We honestly love it here and are so grateful to be a part of this institution.

I’ve been so impressed with this place. My son has been here for 3 years. The staff and teachers are incredibly friendly and professional. They host a variety of community events for families and private events for the families of child care center. Just the other morning I was able to enjoy “muffins with Mom” for Mother’s day. The event was from 7-9am so I was able to enjoy a muffin with my son before heading off to work. They also provide the children with  cereal for breakfast each morning, although you are welcome to bring your own and on Fridays, they offer a pizza and fruit meal for $5. Ms. Lauren the director is friendly and accommodating and always eager to answer any questions or concerns. If you’ve got a toddler, Ms. Maria is the teacher you want. She’s great with children and does well to understand the needs and personality of each child. Mrs Brenda, Ms. Rochell, Ms. Aurelia, and Ms. Roshanda are all all well experienced and loving teachers. I’m so glad to have found this place. They offer chapel once a week, a special new curriculum, indoor gym, music, art, and outdoor playground. If you aren’t big on religion it’s still a really great school. They aren’t pushy or overbearing in any way with their teaching. We’ve been to OCBF, Casa de Paz, and a few home care centers and this is by far the best childcare I’ve found in Oak Cliff

I pulled my son out of this facility because teachers had been pulling ears of children as punishment in a 3’s classroom. There was nothing communicated about this internal investigation but it was reported when parents found out. Since I had witnessed my son not happy here we left. Others have had great experience but my child wasn’t happy - he had this scared look on his face so I knew it was not the right place for him. The director was new and didn’t seem like she had a good handle on things but that was two years ago. I would just be aware and make sure your child is happy. Their communication was not good and the teachers did not seem happy. Not the right place for us.  But again, others have had great experiences.

I’m so grateful to have found this daycare! The staff is caring, warm, and truly passionate about what they do. The owner is exceptional — always attentive and deeply invested in the well-being of the children. The environment is welcoming, clean, and safe. My child is thriving every day, and I absolutely love that they are learning both French and Spanish from such a young age. I highly recommend this place with all my heart!

Great daycare. The staff is friendly and really cares about the kids. My son loves it there. They do a great job teaching both French and Spanish, which I find awesome. Clean place, good people. Highly recommend.

Such a wonderful place! My child loves going every morning. The staff is kind, the owner is professional, and the atmosphere is always positive. I really appreciate the French and Spanish learning. Couldn’t be happier with our choice!

Absolutely pleased with how the owner as well as the staff were welcoming. I love how the center is setup, and how well they interact and teach with the students. I was very skeptical on leaving my son with it being his first time in daycare but I’ve been extremely impressed on what I have seen so far. 🙏🏽 I highly recommend this center.

I just moved to the area and I was so worried about finding a good daycare for my children and thankfully, we found Golden Star Learning Academy.
I love their curriculum and both of my children have learned so many new skills since starting there.
I have truly been so impressed!

A great thanks to Ms. Star & her staff.

We sent our daughter at 20months to KidSpring and it was her first daycare ever. She had a rough first month with getting adjusted (as most kids do) but the entire staff was so patient with my little one and really helped her adapt to the change. After the first month she was in love with going and we truly felt like everyone loved her. She made so many friends, we received constant updates on her and after 1 month she would come home counting numbers in Spanish. We also loved that the classes weren’t overcrowded so our little one was rarely ever sick which was a huge plus. KidSpring is amazing and I recommend this daycare for anyone looking to find a place with reliable and friendly staff 💕

We have enjoyed our time at kid spring for our 3 year old daughter. Sadly, she now goes into Pre-K this school year, joining her big brother. Leaving Kid spring.

The staff/teachers are amazing with the kids. Treat them as they were your own. The director is very communicative and always replies timely. The center is always clean, smells clean and looks clean. My daughter hardly ever got sick at her time there. That's saying something. If anything if she did get sick once it wasn't at the center. Love their strict sick policies and need for Lysol wipes 😅

Our daughter will miss all her friends and teachers, we are sad to be leaving but this is a great daycare to recommend to other local families in the area.

Our daughter went to Kidspring Bilingual Learning Center from ages 2 to 5, and she absolutely thrived there. She was engaged every single day, always learning something new, and would come home excited to share it with us. I loved how they weave education into everything--they make learning fun, but also really build those important skills that kids need.

It's hard to trust someone else to care for your child, but Kidspring truly checked all the boxes for us. Communication was always 100%--everything went through Brightwheel, and we loved getting photo updates throughout the day.

Ms. Macarena and all the teachers are so caring and involved. You can tell they genuinely want the kids to succeed. She made so many friends and left feeling so prepared for kindergarten, as did we.

We are forever grateful for the fantastic experience Kidspring provided and highly recommend them to any family looking for a nurturing and enriching environment for their child!

My daughter went to KidSpring from the time she was about 20 months til three years old. They were patient, kind, and thoughtful in easing her into daycare--especially Mrs. Maca. Over time, she became excited to go to daycare each morning because she had made friends and knew she would have a fun time. My daughter will be starting Pre-K3 this Fall and we are honestly sad to be leaving KidSpring because of how great our experience has been. However, I know that her time at KidSpring has prepared her well for Pre-K3 and public school. We will absolutely be sending our son to KidSpring once he is ready!

We truly enjoyed our time at KidSpring! All of the teachers are incredibly loving and caring—they treated my baby as if she were their own. I was initially nervous about sending my 4-month-old to daycare, but they made the transition so smooth and comforting.

The staff is very communicative, and the environment is always clean, safe, and welcoming. We’re so grateful for the care and attention our little one received during her time there.

Professional, Very Secure for your children and very safe. Love children ❤.  Work with parents. Come see for yourself.   Love 💘 everywhere.

My kids loved this daycare and it was awesome they give the kids Christmas presents and Easter baskets my kids would come home every day talking about how much  fun they had they said they don’t ever wanna leave the daycare.0
All around NO! Dont take your precious babies there

This day school is a co-op, so parents are actively involved and spend a few days a year serving as teaching parents. The atmosphere is very welcoming and encouraging, and the school takes great care to inform parents about kindergarten readiness and the milestones that their children have reached. The kids are very well behaved and receive a great education.

We’ve had such a wonderful experience at The Learning Experience (TLE) Heritage Trace! As a parent of a very active and curious little one, finding a center that balances structure, care, and genuine connection has been a journey—but we finally found it here.

The teachers and staff have taken the time to truly get to know my daughter and our family. She’s incredibly bright, ambitious, and energetic—sometimes all at once—and they’ve done an amazing job providing both the educational rigor she thrives on and the nurturing attention she needs. They’ve embraced every part of who she is, from her love of learning to her cuddly, spirited side.

I also appreciate how the TLE Heritage Trace team partners with parents. It really feels like they’ve become part of our village, and that sense of trust and teamwork means so much.

Ultimately, we're happy with our childcare decision and so grateful for the love, patience, and intentionality the staff shows every day!

The enrolling specialist Erica is TOP TIER. TLE FW Heritage location is beyond blessed to have her. Enrolling our girl this month because of her superb tour, explanation of their program, and going above and beyond (making my husband and I feel like family). She truly loves her job and it shows. Excited and blessed to be joining the TLE family at this location.

My daughter has been attending daycare at the learning experience since she was just 4 months old. She is now turning two next month. My son also attended preschool before starting kindergarten.. I just want to say how amazing this place is and how truly caring they really are.
My daughter has auditory struggles since she was born  and has to wear hearing aids and Erica and Nora have been there for me through the entire journey. These ladies truly love each and every child in building as if they were their very own. They really make you feel like family and are very professional and take their jobs very seriously when it comes to these babies! I would recommend this place to absolutely anyone! I couldn’t imagine taking my daughter anywhere else.

TLE is a wonderful center where all 3 of my little ones go. They truly care about the growth and development of your young ones and take the time to understand their specific needs to help prepare them for school. My four-year-old twins are thriving and getting the opportunity to learn in an environment that replicates school, and my 16 month old can count to 10 in English and Spanish, knows her ABC’s, and Has started saying complete sentences. You can tell education is definitely at the forefront of their establishment, and We can’t thank them enough!

My son has been going here since he was 4 month old. The teachers are great in each class. They are kind and caring towards the kids. This facility is clean and very diverse among the teachers and kids. we are happy to be part of this school
My toddler has been at this center since July and loves it! The staff are friendly and the director is amazing. The center is reasonable priced and I never have any complaints. 10/10 would recommend!

I have 3 great grandbabies that are currently enrolled in this facility, it has been a blessing to be able to  drop them off knowing that not only are they been properly taken care of , but they are learning as well, so hats off to the staff, my babies are twins age 2 and brother age 1.  thank you Mrs. Allie and staff.
My baby has been at this daycare for a few months and I’m very happy I chose this daycare! She’s about to be 8 months and gets so excited when she recognizes her teachers!! ❤️
Kids love it here staff are super nice and the prices are reasonable. If you are looking for a good daycare in the area this one is it

DEFINITELY! The best daycare for my children forever! Ms. Diana will be the best nursery director that my children could have had, I know that my children are safe there! Ms. Rosa, Cristina, Shawna, Karina and Ms. Brown are the best! I will always be grateful for the security you give me when I leave my children in their care.

If I could give them a zero star rating I would definitely do it. If cleanliness is a priority and a big factor to you this is not the facility that you need to enroll your child in. My child contracted Boca virus adenovirus and three other viruses all at one time due to the lack of their staffs due diligence. Pictured below you see a filthy eating bib with crumbs and hair left in it included pictures of a sippy cup that hadn't been cleaned in over a week. My child had been out of daycare for almost 2 weeks and I decided to go pick up his belongings because I just felt like they weren't being clean properly for him to be as sick as he was sure enough I go to pick up his stuff and they're literally filthy as you can see in the pictures there is a yolk type substance which is milk but that cup had a smell that I cannot get out of my nose I had to throw it away I threw away both the cup and and the eating bib whenever I went to pick up his items the teacher realized the cup was dirty was like oh let me rinse this out so my head I'm like rents when she gave me the cup I'm like this needs to be more than just rinsed out but I didn't say anything I asked for the rest of his stuff and I walked up out of there with no intent to return him or his items two weeks after that the owner calls and goes oh I just realized ryland had been unenrolled oh it took you two weeks to realize that one of your students was no longer enrolled okay I could care less about that but for her to have the nerve to say well if you decide to change your mind we're here this place is filthy their attitudes are nasty and I wouldn't recommend them to my worst enemy from my child's father walking in and dropping off our child to them just taking him out of his arms and he can't even properly kiss him hug him or say goodbye like he wanted to or to picking him up in the afternoon and the owner sitting back over there in the corner acting like she don't see nobody signing out their kids at the sign out sheet If you are big on customer service and cleanliness and just genuine nice people This is not the place for you I don't care how cheap it is. And another red flag was while I was picking up his stuff to never bring him back again one of the staffs was asking oh are you taking my baby and I told her yeah and I showed her pictures and shared with her why and she said out of her mouth that she didn't blame me and that I should look into a daycare that has cameras because it's a lot going on there And honestly when a staff member speaks I listen because they're the ones who really know what's going on behind closed doors they would sit at the door watching you through the camera but take forever to let you in the door I know you see me. Parents Don't even waste your time.

We recently enrolled my 3 year old daughter at Mary’s Little Lamb Academy. My daughter had been at her previous daycare since she was six months, mostly because it was in route to our jobs, we loved a few teachers, and my husband didn’t want to switch daycares regardless of price increases. Deciding to look for another daycare near our home was something we needed to do since she will soon be in pre-k and we wanted her to be in school with children she might know. We were driving by and noticed the new daycare. I stopped by and Ms. Rhonda was very nice, welcomed me in, and answered all my questions. I scheduled a tour for me and my husband a few days after. Our tour went great, we felt welcomed, met one of her teachers and she discussed their daily routine. Mary’s Little Lamb Academy is very family oriented, all the teachers and staff I have met are very nice/friendly and remember my child’s name from day one. The app is very helpful, you can easily message the staff/admin with any questions and they also send pics and updates of their activities throughout the day. I thought my daughter was going to take a good while to warm up and talk to her new teachers and classmates since she’s very shy and was also seeing a speech therapist at her previous daycare. Ms. Rhonda and her teachers have told me she talks to them just fine, they understand her, and she’s engaging more with classmates. She does cry when I drop her off, but she also cried at her previous daycare. We have noticed her saying her colors out loud more often, counting, and even singing . We are grateful for this daycare being close to our home,  being patient with our child, and affordable tuition. Ms. Mary and Ms. Rhonda have also supported my husband’s pressure washing business.

I am very pleased with the care the Academy provides. The check in process is easy and secure. The staff always provides update and pictures. My kid loves walking into daycare and has learned many things. For Mother’s Day I received a once in a lifetime gift from them. I appreciate the love and care they provide to my family and I.

I cannot speak to the child care itself as I literally didn't make it much past the front door.  I am writing this review to share my brief experience and vent my disappointment. I went hopeful as it's within a relatively short distance compared to other daycares I'd recently toured and the reviews (although outdated) were all fantastic and warm. When I arrived at the facility, I was greeted (I use that word loosely) by a gal who'm half way propped the door open, looking at me as though I was a salesman she was obliging to give their pitch before sending them on their way. When I told her I was hoping I may be able to tour, she responded "I mean, I can give you the registration forms but can you go move your car?!" I get back thinking she's expecting me (it took 2 seconds) but the door remained locked. I press the 2 doorbells not knowing which to use (no signage) and she answers again to say "yeah, you push the button, THEN the door opens (insert audible eye roll)". She goes in and I follow and she hands me some papers and states, the director's not here, she'll be back in maybe an hour". I asked if they had any spots in the 18 month class, she confirmed they did. I went on to explain my baby just turned 2 but is not standing or walking yet. Not bothering or caring to inquire why, she matter of fact stated "well it goes by age so she'd be in with the 2 year olds. She then put her hands up and said, I mean, you can talk to the director but ... I left feeling pretty frustrated and above all else dismissed. The next day after I'd cooled off I thought, let me give them another shot. I called the director Rhonda and again explained I was hoping to see about getting into the 18 month class. I could hear in her voice she knew who I was and she hesitantly said "let me ask that teacher if we even have any room in that class and Ill call you back". I asked her if my number had shown up (as she didn't ask for it in order to call me back)  and she kinda stuttered "ughh, yeah". I never received a call back. Now every time I drive by I get a yuck feeling in my stomach. I don't so much care that they couldn't accommodate my daughter with special needs (I'd rather they not try if not willing just say so, that would have been OK 🙌🏻), but the way they negated the situation and honestly the very poor 1st impression I recieved at the 1st opening of the door has really left quite an impression on me. Even if business is BOOMING, the fact that they would treat a potential customer/client with such disregard and  callous just baffles me. 🤯😞
Love love love marys little lamb Academy would recommend this place is wonderful 😊😊😊☺😊☺😊

I’m extremely happy with this daycare. From the first day, the staff made my child feel welcome and comfortable,ms.denise ms.blanca ms.Patricia always greets us with a smile and takes the time to explain how the day went. I really appreciate how they focus on learning through play — my child comes home talking about colors, numbers, and new songs every week.

The classroom is always clean and well-organized, and they follow safety procedures carefully. They also send pictures and updates throughout the day, which gives me peace of mind while I’m at work. I can see how much my child has grown socially and academically since starting here.

I truly trust this daycare and would recommend it to any parent looking for a safe, loving, and educational environment.

ABC Children Learning Center is truly an amazing place. My family has loved and trusted this center for years. Starting with my little sister, who still remembers the wonderful teachers and great experiences there.Now my 3 year old daughter attends, and has learned so much, made friends, and grown more confident every day. I truly appreciate everything the teachers and staff have done for my child. They create a safe, welcoming, and positive environment that makes dropping her off each day so much easier. I couldn’t be more grateful for the love and effort they put!!

Extremely grateful with all of the staff. This being our first experience with daycare for our two year old, they have been nothing short from amazing with our boy. They have been welcoming, compassionate and caring making this experience so much easier on us. We truly appreciate their care for our son and couldn’t have found a better place. Definitely recommend this daycare.

Love this place for my two boys! They are so loving and caring, and the boys are happy to go to daycare! They sometimes don’t even want to come home! My kids love Ms. loredo, Silvia, Rosa and Paullette.
My grand baby has been here since 6 months ago. Nothing but good things since day one. The teachers are super, they serve nutritious food and he is well taken care of.

Both our children went to Liberated--our oldest graduated summer 2025, and our youngest would have graduated from there, too, had we not moved out of state. Liberated was the most nurturing environment, always with smiling faces, and we got to know so many parents through school events, drop-offs, and pickups. Liberated will always hold a special place in my family's heart, because it was the center of our universe for so many years, in a wonderful neighborhood that we so adore and miss.

We couldn’t be happier with Liberated! Our oldest graduated from here (formerly Springhill, but with some of the same beloved staff) and thrived, and now our second child is having the same wonderful experience. The guides are warm, attentive, and truly understand how to spark curiosity and independence. Our child has a new found love of learning Spanish and absolutely adores their teacher Ms. Paola, which makes arriving at school each day such a joy—and such a comfort for us as parents. The community is welcoming and supportive, and we’ve seen our children grow in confidence and love of learning. Highly recommend to any parent looking for a nurturing, thoughtful school environment!

After 3 years at home with me, our pandemic kiddo was beyond hungry for social interactions and I’m so happy that Liberated opened in Oak Cliff when it did. If all we got was an inquisitive, self-assured, confident smarty pants - I’d give Liberated 5 stars handily - but we got so much more than that. Community, kindness, cheer leaders, friendship. I wish they were K-12, we love and miss Liberated.

We enrolled both of our children at Liberated as soon as it opened. Despite it being a new school, our experience was excellent. The teachers are kind, patient and dedicated. Our children were always happy to go to "school," and often weren't ready to come home when we picked them up. There's also a great community of families with plenty of ways to volunteer and get involved. We recently moved out of state and were so sad to leave. Highly recommend LMOC!

I truly love this place! Both of my sons have been here since they were 1, and we’ve had such a wonderful experience. The staff is amazing—always caring and supportive—and they go above and beyond by organizing so many fun activities, cultural events, and holiday celebrations. It really feels like a strong community has been built here, and my kids enjoy every moment. I’m so grateful for everything the staff does to make this such a special place.

I’m very happy with the daycare. As a first time parent I was anxious to leave my child but I can tell he truly enjoys his time there, and that gives me so much peace of mind as a parent. Ms. Sandy is absolutely wonderful. She is caring, attentive, and creates such a nurturing environment for the children.
The facility itself is clean, organized, and welcoming. The leadership team is always helpful and transparent, and they keep us informed right away if anything comes up. I really appreciate their communication and the genuine care they show for the kids.
Overall, we’ve had a great experience, and I highly recommend this daycare!

The Children's Courtyard off of Trinity is a very nice and professional place. I always get greeted with a smile every time I bring or pickup my grandkids. The staff keep the kids physically active while enhancing  their cognitive thinking skills with numerous daily activities. They handle concerns promptly which are resolved immediately with feedback of corrective actions taken. Ms. Tish, Ms. Shun, and Ms. Felicia are great leaders. The meal prep staff and many teachers, they always speak. If you are looking for a daycare for your child, then look no further.  This is it.

I am extremely happy with the care and services this daycare provides for my children. I have felt confident leaving my kids in their hands. The environment is warm, safe, and nurturing, and it truly feels like a second home for my children.

A very special thank you to Miss Jennifer and Miss Felicia. They treat my kids with so much kindness, patience, and genuine love. It gives me so much peace of mind knowing my children are cared for by teachers who truly care about their growth and well-being.

I am also very impressed with the management team, especially Miss Shan and Miss Tish. Their leadership, professionalism, and dedication to maintaining high standards really show in everything they do. The communication is excellent, and they are always supportive and attentive to families.

I’m very grateful for this daycare and highly recommend it to any parent looking for a loving and reliable place for their children.

We’ve had a great experience with the reggis location My daughter London has been attending for about a month now, and the staff has been amazing kind, attentive, and very caring. I really appreciate how communicative they are and how much they prioritize the children’s health and well-being She’s made new friends and absolutely loves going each day, and she always comes home happy. I would definitely recommend this daycare to other parents also they allow you to be at work having peace of mind knowing you can check on your kiddo with the app 10/10

I recommend CC on Reggis Court to everyone! I have two children that attend, which my oldest started at 3 months and we have loved every minute of it. The teachers are so loving and kind to my children that it feels like I am leaving them with family. They have many many teachers who have been there for years. I was amazed at the preschool age group as I felt that my daughter was well prepared for kindergarten. She still attends during the summer, which they provide a ton of field trips and summer activities. She would rather go the CC then stay home all summer.  The front office staff is also amazing! They truly do care for my kids and I am confident that they are well taken care of and safe while I am at work.  I have changed jobs and could move my kids to a daycare closer to my house but I trust this daycare so much that we will not be going anywhere any time soon!  Thanks CC for everything that you provide for my children!

My daughter hates coming here. I informed the owner prior to my daughter going about some issues she’s had and the owner didn’t feel the need to tell her staff who watch my child. I haven’t received any incident reports so if anything happens I’ll have to sue. This place is dirty. Half of the staff don’t speak English which isn’t an issue with Spanish speaking children, but they have difficulty understanding so it’s a concern when around my child: also half of the staff that speak Spanish aren’t listed as staff; which is weird because they should be. When I addressed my concerns about my child she pretty much tried to blame my child and told me my daughter needs to go elsewhere instead of apologizing and fixing whatever issue. The staff also treats their children better than others and just seems like the owner doesn’t care about children just a place for her children to go when she’s busy. Places like this tend to mistreat children especially children with special needs.

I really enjoyed my experience! It was my very first time putting my baby in daycare and Franchesca made me feel like family! My daughter learned how to play and eat on her own. I received updates and her teacher was so professional yet friendly. They truly care about each individual child and family.

This place has taken care of my daughter Julaysa since she was 1 going on 2 yrs old. I must admit that at first I was scared being that it was my first time separating from her, but Francisca did a tremendous job in making me feel comfortable and updated me of my daughters process and well being. We moved from Fort Worth and till this day Little Steps Academy takes care of my daughter who is 5 yrs old now and she is always wanting to go “to her daycare” like she tells me. Ms. Shannon always taking care of my daughter and all the kids like they are her own! The teachers here are also great!  If you are looking for a good trustworthy place this is the place!

My son grew so much from attending this daycare. From the teachers to the owner I never had a bad experience. At the beginning it was a hard transition for my son but as time went on he grew excited to attend. Ms. Sharon will forever be his favorite teacher. Thank you all so much for helping my son grow, and providing me with the peace of mind knowing he was safe with you! Thank you! Definitely recommend.

This place is terrible. No structure very unprofessional. The kids are always running around pushing and shoving, nasty nose screaming and crying. The workers just let them do what they want to. The owner is VERY UNPROFESSIONAL. She can never show you the tape of what is going on and will not meet with you. But she want you to pay even if your child is not there. If you call her out on her BS she will drop your child. It is 100 a week do it's cheap. So you can bet you not getting good service.

You will not be disappointed!

As first time parents, you are always concern if they will treat your child right and will they meet their needs. Worry not, they will surely be taken care of in Infant Class 1 (Newborns - New Crawlers). Ms. Pam and Ms. Aleiyah have been god sends! They care about the babies and treat them as if they were their own. They let me know how much they have ate, when they ate, if they refuse to eat, when they potty, and play! They are truly such amazing care givers. They also let us know when to work on new skills so they can further define their motor skills. Talk about amazing care and at an affordable price range.

For reference, this is the second daycare my child has been at and we always felt on edge for the last one but Children's Courtyard we are confident in their care. On a Friday, when my Husband and I were at home but needed time to clean and study we choose to leave our baby in their care to quickly take care of things and ensure she still got the attention she needed. This was a huge step for us since we always want our baby next to us. This shows how much trust we have in them as well.

You will not go wrong with entrusting your baby with Ms. Pam and Ms. Aleiyah. Thank you both for giving two working parents a piece of mind during stressful times. We cannot wait to see our baby grow with your help.

I always struggled to trust a daycare or anyone to watch my kids but this daycare goes above and beyond for my kids. I can go to work in peace knowing my kids are in good  hands. All the staff are amazing and attentive to all kids. Mrs April did excellent with my 4 year old when he started there at only 2 years old. Transitioning my kids to other classes has never been an issue because all the staff are just overall amazing and so caring. Mrs. Juju did great in helping me potty train my son he still sees her and cherish her even after transitioning to his preschool class. Mrs Katherine and Mrs Jessica were amazing with my other son as well when he started there at 3. My kids have grown and see all the staff there as family, for that I am grateful! Thank you to Mr. Jj my sons have grown so much and learned so many academic skills and they love and talk about him all the time and refer him as their best-friend!

I am truly so happy and confident in the decision I made choosing childcare for my children. Children’s Courtyard has been nothing short of amazing. They do an incredible job making the kids feel safe, loved, and comfortable, and I can genuinely say they treat my children like their own. I absolutely love the constant communication through the app—it gives me peace of mind knowing what’s going on throughout the day. I recently had a baby and was extremely nervous about sending my daughter since she’s so little, practically still a newborn. But her teacher, Ms. Pam, has been such a blessing to our family. She communicates so well and always makes sure to send pictures so I don’t feel like I’m missing out while I’m at work. It means more to me than she probably knows. She is truly amazing with the kids. My other daughter was scared at first, but Ms. Danielle took the time to help her feel comfortable and safe. Now she’s happy and confident. She also absolutely loves seeing Ms. April in the mornings—she runs right to her with excitement. There are so many wonderful teachers here, and you can feel the care the moment you walk in. Everyone is friendly, welcoming, and genuinely invested in the children. I’m beyond grateful for this place and the love they show my babies everyday. It may be a little expensive but you get quality childcare. From people who actually cares.

Ms. April was truly a blessing in our son’s life. Even though he no longer attends the daycare, he still talks about her and asks about her often — which says everything about the kind of impact she made. She was always so sweet, patient, and kind, and you could tell she genuinely cared about each child. Knowing my son was in her classroom gave me so much peace of mind.
I am so grateful for the love, guidance, and positive influence she had during those important early years. She helped create such a happy and nurturing environment, and that has stayed with him.
I also want to mention that all of the staff were wonderful and welcoming throughout the years we were there. From the front desk to the other teachers, everyone made our family feel comfortable and supported. We will always look back on our time there with gratitude

We’ve had a wonderful experience at Children’s Courtyard! The facility is clean, welcoming, and truly feels like a safe place for our daughter to learn and grow. Communication between parents and teachers is excellent, and I especially love being able to check in on her through the app—it gives us so much peace of mind.

A special thank you to Miss Shelby and Miss April, who go above and beyond every day. Their kindness, patience, and genuine care mean so much to our family. We’re so grateful for them! 💛

The ministers are terrific along with the staff.  The church is beautiful.
I'm more of a small church person.
The church has small groups you may join.
Very active church

I went with some family members the first time several years ago.  I knew it was a large church but the minute I walked in, I was greeted with genuine smiles and welcome.  This big church didn't feel like a big church,  it felt like a small church where everyone was welcome,  loved and wrapped into loving arms.

I visited this church seeking fellowship and spiritual growth. The teaching was biblically grounded, and I appreciated that. However, I found it challenging to build meaningful connections with others. It sometimes felt like a tight-knit community that could be difficult for newcomers to engage with.

I’m sharing this with care, in the hope it encourages thoughtfulness. In my experience, vibrant church communities grow strongest through openness, grace, and shared respect — values that help everyone feel seen and welcomed.

I am blessed to be here. I have found a home for my family my grand kids go to school here and My wife loves her job working with the kids. My daughter works full time here and has stepped up to be recognized. She has shown her ability to work in any job given to her. Pastor Tucker is the senior Pastor and leads the church in a positive direction. This is a great place to bring family and friends.
Thank You
Michael

Most awesome drive thru complete with an app telling the Christmas story at each stop, live music, cookies, camels, donkeys, sheep, angels, and a real baby Jesus! They made us feel at home. We were wished Merry Christmas by everyone and even got to enter a drawing for a $100 gift card! This is our 4th year and highly recommend this event!

If  you need a Day Care that care and will teach your kids then ANGEL"S ON EARTH IS THE BEST PLACE  to Be..

OPERATION_NAME: Angels on Earth Learning & Adventure Center
review_text: Today is SEPT 23rd 2015 around 11:25am. I had to run to the library quick and as I was walking up to the library I couldn't help but notice a large crowd of little tiny kiddos and a "childcare worker" screaming loudly at the kids telling them to hurry and get to the van where she was already at. First of all, why are you yelling at a 1yr old like he understands you??? To me that looks so unprofessional and very dangerous. I'm very protective when it comes to children. Especially a large amount of kids in a group. There should always be 2 teachers. 1 teacher should ALWAYS stay behind the children and another 1 infront of them to PROTECT THEM!!! The van that they arrived in was already parked at the curbside, and both teachers were already at the van and there were still kids left behind almost by he front door of the library. I would NOT suggest this daycare if this is how they are. It just doesn't look safe. MOMS PLEASE BE INFORMED THAT ONE OF YOUR BABIES COULD HAVE BEEN IN THAT CROWD!!! The kids in the crowd look maybe 1yr-2yr. Hope this review helps, and Allah forbid it happens again!

We started at CN 307 almost a year ago, and one of the main reasons we chose this school was the way Tewuanna treated me and my girls from the very first moment we walked in. From day one, she has been nothing but kind, welcoming, and accommodating. She has truly been my go-to person, and we are heartbroken to hear the news of her resignation.

I am especially concerned about what this means for the morale and overall atmosphere of the school once she leaves. After visiting many childcare centers in the area, Houston Heights Daycare was the one where I immediately felt comfortable and at peace. That feeling never changed.

I enrolled my children after taking a career gap to raise them, and going back to work was a big emotional step for me. Thanks to the support, care, and what I truly felt was a partnership with the school, I never once doubted my decision to return to my career. That means everything to a mom.

The teachers, assistant teachers, and staff are simply amazing. My kids were always well cared for, engaged, and learning. The structure and attention they give the kids really stand out.

It actually took me a while to write this review because I wanted to take the time to reflect. My children are now in kindergarten, and we truly miss this place. They made wonderful friends and have such beautiful memories. The graduation ceremony was so special, the Christmas recital was precious (see my pic), and all the events throughout the year were thoughtfully done. Both of my kids also attended summer camp, and they loved it.

I’ve had friends who returned to work but struggled because they didn’t have reliable childcare and eventually had to quit. Having a center you trust makes all the difference. This school was a huge support for our family.

I also loved the daily app updates and notifications. Receiving pictures and information every day gave me peace of mind and helped me feel connected to my kids’ day.

Thank you for the patience Mrs. Kandance, Mrs. Lily, Mrs. Yanderi❤️, the love, and the genuine care you gave my children. This is a wonderful place, and I really recommend it with complete confidence. If we were still in the area, we would absolutely continue with summer camps.

God bless you for everything.

From a very grateful mom💕

The Youngs fam

I feel incredibly lucky to have found this center. From day one, they have been attentive, caring, and truly invested in my children. The quality of care and education here is absolutely top notch.

They offer a strong curriculum and have truly become an extension of our family. They helped prepare my oldest (now 5) for Kindergarten, and I cannot thank them enough. He just received his report card and tested at a master's level in all subjects, placing in the 90th percentile! I credit this center for building such a strong educational foundation.

They even helped potty train my eldest, which was a huge milestone for us.

My youngest started at just 6 weeks old and was later diagnosed with severe eczema that required constant care. Even though this was beyond their normal responsibilities, the staff went above and beyond to support him (and me!). They gave him one-on-one attention, helped me find long-term solutions, and showed so much compassion. I’ve built real friendships with some of the teachers and the director because they genuinely care.

The kindness they’ve shown my kids and our family is something I will always be grateful for. They have a diverse and thoughtful curriculum, offer amazing programs, are always improving the center, and they clearly value and take care of their employees.

If you’re looking for a place where your children will be loved, supported, challenged, and truly seen, this is it. I’m forever grateful.

We have loved this center for both our kids and highly recommend! Writing as mom who had her first daughter there from 3months of age in 2020, all the way through to this summer '25, when she started kindergarten. As well as currently have a son in preschool here. The teachers truly care about the kids and my children have been excited to go everyday. I appreciate the daily updates, including videos and photos, throughout the day. They are transparent, even if there was an incident such as a fall or scrape, and I value that honesty. They take all the credit for potty training both my kids! The curriculum more than prepared my daughter for kinder including starting to read. Splash day activities in the summer, field trips to parks and recreation facilities, fall festivals, Christmas programs, mother and father day events all build community for kids and parents.

After visiting several daycares, I can confidently say that none compare to this one. From the moment we walked in, we felt the warmth of the team, they truly care about the kids, and it shows every single day. The structure they’ve created is amazing: it’s organized yet so dynamic and engaging for the little ones. The facility itself is always clean and very well organized, which gives us so much peace of mind. Another thing we love is that they often share photos and videos through their platform, so we get to see those special little moments throughout the day. We have had an amazing experience with Houston Heights Learning Center and highly recommend it! Your child will be very well taken care of here. Our daughter thrived here from 4 months to two years before we had to move out of state :(

The teachers provide frequent updates, pictures, and videos so you feel like you’re experiencing the day with them. My daughter always ran into school without a backwards glance. They have structed, fun learning and so many crafts for those tiny hands and feet. The center is kept very clean.

Thank you for a wonderful experience supporting our daughters growth! Keep up the great work.

We love Amiguitos! Our son started when he was almost 10 months old, and it’s been the best experience for him. We love the curriculum, community events, and just the overall loving environment they create for our son! He’s 3 now and always comes home excited to tell us about his friends and activities the teachers had planned for the day. We love the constant communication and updates with photos. We appreciate so much that every staff member at Amiguitos knows our son and the culture they have created for us as parents!

Enrolling our 2 year old daughter in this early education Spanish immersion program has been one of the best decisions we’ve made. From the moment we arrived on the campus, it was clear that this is more than just a school—it’s a community where children are genuinely loved, supported, and inspired to grow. The location is beautiful, inviting, and feels like home.

The small student-teacher ratios are so wonderful for both the kids and the teachers! It’s clear that the teachers treat our children with so much love and care, and we know our daughter is getting individual attention throughout the day. It’s been so reassuring for us as parents to see how our daughter is thriving at Amiguitos, and such a relief that she asks every day if she can go to school to see her “amigos”!

Despite coming from a single language household, our daughter has quickly picked up on Spanish during her almost 6 months at Amiguitos, and we are surprised at her progress every day! We can’t wait to see how the full immersion approach affects her development and appreciation for different cultures long-term.

We absolutely adore Amiguitos! Our daughter has been a student since she was 6 months old (she's now almost 3) and our 5 month old son just started last month. We feel so comforted that our kids are in fantastic, loving hands during the day. Could not recommend this school enough!

I absolutely love this school/daycare. My eldest attended since he was 2 yrs old, loved it, then went on to Elementary School. My youngest currently attends. She started there when she was 2.5 yrs old and is upset come the weekend because she wants to be there every day. We started her at 2 days a week and she continued to request she be taken “every single day.” We fulfilled her wish and enrolled her full time. She now wants to spend the weekends at Amiguitos. Unfortunately, they are not open on the weekends. My daughter’s motivation and demand to be at Amiguitos is confirmation I chose the right school for her. The staff are amazing, warm, welcoming and very attentive to the children.
The Owner/Director, Ms. Mary knows what she’s doing. When I interviewed her, I was incredibly impressed. I knew right away, she has the children’s and her staff’s interest at heart. Ms. Mary’s philosophy is unlike any other, and I have had some awful experiences at other Spanish Immersion schools/childcares where they are in the business to make money and treat every family and child like another number. Not here! As a parent, it is crucial my children are well cared for, educated, learn a second language and they not only enjoy their school but look forward to returning. Not to mention, feel like family and this is exactly how Amiguitos has you feel; like you are part of their family. I highly recommend Amiguitos.

We love Amiguitos because they truly care about the kids and go above and beyond to help whenever needed. We have watched our child thrive under their care and feel assured that they are providing academic support and social skills in a positive and fun environment. This daycare is amazing. My children are learning so much. I also love that they stick to their policies. My child attended another daycare before and was always getting sick now that she is here I have no issues keep up the great work ladies

We’ve had a great experience at Montessori Children's House. It’s a truly personalized environment where each child is supported and encouraged to grow at their own pace.
Our kids are very happy there and genuinely enjoy going to school every day, which says everything. The owner Ms Ynoli is always close to the students, very present, and deeply involved.
We highly recommend this school to any family looking for a caring, individualized learning environment.

This School is an INVESTMENT in your child’s future. My daughter spent her formative years here from 1-4 years old and it has shaped her into being an independent, kind, well spoken, emotionally regulated child.

I can really tell the difference when we go to outside classes for gym and dance. Other children her age run rampant and don’t listen to instructors, meanwhile my daughter is given praise for being a good listener and has advanced in age groups because of the skills she has learned at the Montessori Children’s School.

The foundational work that has been instilled into my daughter is priceless, she’s growing into a beautiful human and I 100% attribute that to Montessori teachings. Ms. Ynoli and staff are qualified and demonstrate day by day Maria Montessori’s methods and the prepared environment. These kids are less wired and over stimulated because of the spaces the School has created. I’d choose my daughter to attend this daycare over and over again.

We love that Montessori Children's House & School feels like a home rather than a traditional daycare. It was home for our kids for multiple years. The highlights are the great environment, the seasonal events, and the Montessori curriculum. Unfortunately, the school is not immune to teacher turnover and sometimes the teachers that you've grown accustomed to leave. Also, communication is key, and because it is a smaller operation, parents need to reach out to stay in the loop sometimes. We are very grateful to Ms. Ynoli for providing a true Montessori daycare for our kids. My oldest still remembers the good times he had there.

I feel incredibly fortunate to have found this Montessori daycare for our son. From the moment you walk through the doors, it’s clear this is more than just childcare. it’s a place where children are genuinely seen, respected, and encouraged to grow at their own pace.

The teachers are caring, patient, and wonderfully attentive. Ms Wynns understands my son’s unique personality and gently guides him to explore, discover, and become more independent every day. We’ve seen our son blossom in confidence, curiosity, and social skills since he started here. When I’m at a local park I’m asked how he knows so much for his age, and tell everyone it’s through the help of this school.

What we love most is the peaceful, thoughtful environment. The classrooms are calm, beautifully organized, and full of activities that spark our son’s imagination and love of learning. My son is picked up happy and lots of love for the friends he’s made there.

If you’re looking for a Montessori program that truly honors your child’s individuality and lays a strong foundation for a lifelong love of learning, I wholeheartedly recommend this daycare. It’s a warm, safe community that feels like an extension of our own family — and we couldn’t be happier.

We love this school and Ms. Ynoli!  Both our kids have thrived here- our oldest has been there for 3+ years. Love the true Montessori education they are getting, and it has such a loving and cozy atmosphere. It has been a home away from home for them. They love going to school in the morning. Ms. Ynoli, Ms. Wynn and all the teachers and helpers are truly wonderful with hearts of gold. I’ve never had any problems communicating with teachers and always get a prompt response. We feel so lucky to have found this hidden gem!

I love it here!  I was so sad when I had to change from our previous daycare due to us moving but this one was such a great choice. My girls have been here a year and a half now and they love it too! My oldest has talked highly of the ladies here since the beginning. She’d always say, “they take really good care of us mommy” and I know they do. When I first moved to the area from out of state, I tried a larger Methodist church significantly closer to my new house.  Unfortunately, I only met one person there in four visits to the church.  Then someone suggested that I try John Wesley and what a difference!  The people at John Wesley were so welcoming that I knew almost immediately that I had found my new church home.

While researching online for a new church to visit yesterday, I noticed that John Wesley had a two (2) hour GriefShare therapy meeting where people come to discuss the hardships of losing a loved one.  Since my sister and I both lost our mother nearly one year ago to the day, I thought this would be the perfect opportunity for us to take advantage of.

My sister and I arrived at the church unannounced and uninvited, but we were still welcomed with open arms, love and care.  Believe it or not, this doesn't happen at churches as often as you might think... Sad, I know, but true.

The experience we shared together with our new friends at the meeting was a moving rollercoaster full of ups and downs.  My sister let out A LOT of tears, whereas I was able to talk about many things that I've been wanting to say for awhile now.

My sister even went downstairs after the meeting concluded to speak directly to, and privately with, someone who specializes in this type of situation.  I, on the other hand, went outside the church to reflect on the meeting and enjoy this beautiful Autumn weather we are so fortunate to have this time of year.

We will definitely be back to this church for more meetings, and I personally can't wait to attend a Sunday church service with my sister in tow.

God bless all those grieving souls we met yesterday at the church.  I know the pain you all are experiencing at the moment, and if you ever need some help around the house, someone to go to dinner with, or even just someone to talk to, then please reach out as my sister and I are more than happy to be there for you.
No matter what you are going through, always remember that our time on this earth (in the material world) is short-lived.  However, an eternity of peace, love and joy, exists for us in the afterlife for everyone who follows the teachings of our Lord and Savior.  One love.

God bless and good journey!

As it pertains to the school, I wanted to love John Wesley, but as with most businesses, JW has some highlights and some huge disappoints. Of the 4 teachers our family has experienced, they have all ranged from good to excellent! Other pros- there's lots of engaging, fun activities for the kids and good communication about events that are happening. I also like that the school is clean and well maintained, and the curriculum seems on par with other schools. My biggest issue however is that we don't feel the welcoming spirit that I had hoped for (other than from the kids' teachers and other families.) Realistically 10-15% of the time someone greets us with a "good morning" or a smile when we walk in, despite there being 3-5 ladies at the front on any given day. Most days we are completely ignored. I'm not even sure they know our names. Sadly that Texas charm is completely lost on these ladies! I was hoping to see the leadership from them that my daughters could emulate and learn from but unfortunately they are not warm people. Other schools we've been to, the staff lights up and takes interest in the kids to the point where my kids run up to hug them when they see them; not here though. Their internal barometer knows it's not that sort of kind and loving environment. This leads me to my other criticism: where is God's abundant love here? I don't see my kids being taught much about the Bible at all. No dittos with Jesus or Bible stories. The majority of the Christmas program is "Jingle Bells and Rudolph the Red nosed Reindeer" type of material, where Santa is given more praise than Jesus (is this a Christian school or not?) Very secular and almost like the school is scared to spread the good news that God wants all to know! Personally I want my girls to know God first and foremost and be strong in their faith, which is what I teach them. But if you are looking for that message being spread and taught at JW, look elsewhere. Basically the attitude from the admin support is poor and the Godly leadership is absent.

John Wesley has been our church home for over 30 years. We have “done life” there. review_text: My child did 2 years with Mi Escuelita because her birthday is after the start of the school year. 4 stars only because this school is very hands on for parents which is a great thing but definitely expect to be super involved with your children’s teachers especially if they are in a private class. Amazing teachers who you can tell genuinely love their students!!! Ms. Luna and Ms. Martinez are God sends. Thank you Mi Escuelita for preparing my child for 2 years for kindergarten! Flexible tuition for private class and tons of grace when it comes to late or tardy drop off/pick up. The school has many activities and gifts each year and each holiday for the children like new bikes for Christmas and toys as well. Highly recommend

OPERATION_NAME: Mi Escuelita Preschool at Casa View
review_text: The best thing that has ever happened to my children is joining this learning center. My oldest son is now 10, and I loved this experience so much that with my second son, I didn't hesitate to include him here. The teachers are kind and very friendly, and the office staff are attentive and helpful. 100% recommended!

OPERATION_NAME: Mi Escuelita Preschool at Casa View
review_text: My child has learned a lot, and his teachers are very kind to the children and always attentive to any incident; they let you know immediately.

OPERATION_NAME: Mi Escuelita Preschool at Casa View

OPERATION_NAME: Mi Escuelita Preschool at Casa View
review_text: The teachers are lovely, the entire staff, the ladies at the entrance, and everyone is so professional. If I could give 10,000 stars, I would. ❤️
This place was a gift to me and my family. If you want a safe, loving and child led experience for your kids (and to make great friends with other parents), send them to Open Door. ❤️

We were accepted into Open Door after having a really tough experience at a Montessori school.  My son was extremely unhappy and often had anxiety about going to school.  Behavior problems started at some point in that year and became routine. I quickly realized the Montessori environment with 27 kids in one class was not a good fit for him so I started frantically hunting for something better.  We were thrilled to get the last spot in the Pre-K class at Open Door.  School has gone from a major source of anxiety and frustration to a place of joy and happiness.  The pre-k class is super small, only 10 kiddos, which was a big part of the reason we selected Open Door.  Our teacher, Sam Breman, is extremely patient, hands on and has worked especially hard with the kids on their social emotional development.  He also coaches most of the class in Soccer at the YMCA, total bonus!  But not only Sam, all of the teachers and staff on campus are very involved with the children, my son knows them all by name and has made many special bonds.  He has really blossomed in this nurturing environment and has gained so much confidence.  And most importantly, he is having FUN in pre-school, as it should be. Open Door has been a big warm hug to our family and we know our son will be prepped and ready for Kindergarten next year.  In fact, we love Open Door so have transferred to Mathews Elementary (right down the street from Open Door Central campus) so that our son can attend the Open Door after school care program next year when he goes to Kinder!
Definitely recommend this school to families who are struggling to find an all inclusive school

Open Door is someplace special - we are really grateful to have found our village here. The school started over 50 years ago when a family couldn't find one school that would accept both their typically developing child and their child with special needs, and the rest is history.

We LOVE the teachers and admins at Open Door (our #1 reason for choosing this preschool)! They are deeply caring and invested in the kids, and the staff turnover is incredibly low. It's been such a joy to watch our kids grow, develop, and have just fun here. Open Door is also NAEYC accredited, which means they've hit a high standard for early childhood development programs. This is the original location, plus they have 2 other campuses in Austin.

I can honestly say I trust every single person who works here with my son. The staff is safe, reliable, caring, and truly nurturing. I’ve never had a moment where I felt unease every experience has been nothing but positive. All of the teachers go above and beyond, and I’m so grateful for everything they do. Every time I walk in, I’m greeted right away and everyone is so friendly and easy to talk to, which always makes me feel welcome.
They also have great programs that make the daycare extra special. I would recommend this place a thousand times—it really is that amazing! Thank you! Open Door, for all the hard work and love you put into caring for our kids!

My 2 year old son attends this child care center and I am truly happy with it overall! The owner and her staff are the kindest people! They are always in a happy mood and the children look comfortable and happy around them ! My son has been to other centers before and this is the first one that I can give a high rating on. I am grateful that my son attends this wonderful childcare center! Thank you Ms. Cheryl and her staff! ❤️

Both of my kids had been attending a different daycare prior to attending here (Today’s Childcare), according to the other facility my oldest (3yr old) would cry for hours and the teacher could just not deal with her anymore (3 months) so I had to find another facility for them. On there 1st day here (Today’s Childcare) with in just minutes of leaving she stopped crying and made friends very quickly. She was happy for most of the day. I’m thankful for the owner Cheryl and her staff for taking us in. My children are happy and not crying.

review_text: I felt very welcomed by the priest and all the church helpers. Wonderful place. If I lived in Dallas I would definitely attend there! I recommend it to my friends in Dallas.

review_text: Warm and welcoming - and a beautiful place to worship.  On our first visit, the childrens' ministry pastor introduced herself to us  and our  4 year old, so he felt comfortable joining children's church part all by himself.
