review_text: After visiting all the Episcopal churches in the area we chose Good Shepherd 21 years ago.  It was so warm and welcoming- its like belonging to a small town in the middle of the big city.  What a great decision that turned out to be.

OPERATION_NAME: Good Shepherd Ep Church Parents Day Out
review_text: Visited my grandson for grandparent's day.  The school chapel is a beautiful place of worship. Needless to say, I enjoyed my time with my grandson.
What a nice experience! The people at the front desk were very kind. I came here as a visitor with my friend and felt very welcome.

I visited Lifetime Fitness twice this week and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience due to the attitude of one of the front desk employees.

The first time we came in, we asked about getting a tour and were told there were no tour times available. When we decided to leave and schedule for another time, the employee seemed dismissive and uninterested in helping us.

We later scheduled a tour online and returned the next day. When we arrived, that same employee was at the front desk and unprofessionally mocked and mimicked my behavior from the previous day, implying that I had an attitude. It was disrespectful, unnecessary, and made me feel very uncomfortable. This type of behavior is unacceptable, especially from someone who is the first point of contact for potential members.

The staff member who actually gave us the tour was excellent — he was polite, professional, and represented Lifetime Fitness well. The facility itself is nice overall, although the bathrooms were not as clean as expected for a premium gym.

However, due to the front desk employee’s immature and disrespectful attitude, I will not be joining. First impressions matter, and his behavior alone was enough to change my decision. It’s unfortunate, because the rest of the experience and the touring staff member were positive.

I hope management addresses this, because no potential member should be mocked or made to feel unwelcome.

I had a wonderful experience with Sherry at Life Time. She consistently provides exceptional customer service and goes above and beyond to make everyone feel welcome and supported. Sherry is always smiling, approachable, and genuinely eager to help, which makes every interaction pleasant and positive. Her professionalism, kindness, and attentiveness truly stand out, and she is a big reason why Life Time feels like such a great place to be. Thank you, Sherry, for your outstanding service and positive energy!

I have been a member for over twelve years, regularly visited the gym at all hours since l am retired. When l first joined, this gym was affordable, clean and had a correct number of members to the size of the facility.
The last two years, they keep selling too many memberships  while making dramatic price increases on existing memberships.
Now the gym is super overcrowded, used towels everywhere, and general cleanliness has dropped.
Would cancel my membership, but no other gym offers the wet area facilities that Lifetime does, so l will put up with the overcrowding for now.

High prices + Low standards. This gym used to be worth the high costs years ago but lately it’s gone downhill, fast. Expect to have your dues increase every 3-4 months with no new machines or amenities added in to justify the cost increase. Additionally, they’ve been pushing patrons out of the gym area and sauna area 20 mins earlier than their listed closing time. If a business is open until 11pm, then it should be open for complete use until 11pm. Paying customers shouldn’t be rushed to leave an establishment they pay high costs for just because the staff wants to leave early. I own businesses and I can’t close my doors early because I want to go home. Very unprofessional. You’re better off spending your money at a more affordable gym that has better/newer equipment and better hours.

A heartfelt thank you to Kido!
As a parent, there’s nothing more reassuring than knowing your child is in a safe, loving, and enriching environment—and that’s exactly what we’ve found at Kido.
Every morning, my 4-year-old daughter wakes up with excitement, eager to be greeted by the warm smiles of the reception team. That enthusiasm alone speaks volumes about the kind of care and joy she experiences each day.
Since joining Kido, we’ve seen such a beautiful transformation in her—she’s become more confident, independent, and curious about learning. Her social skills have blossomed, and she surprises us daily with new things she’s learned or tried.
The teachers and staff truly go above and beyond. Their care and attention make it easy for me to trust them completely with my child. It feels like a second home for her, and for that, I’m incredibly grateful.
One of the things I appreciate most is the open communication. The regular updates and sweet photos we receive throughout the day help us feel connected and part of her journey, even while we’re apart.
Thank you, Kido, for nurturing our daughter with such love, patience, and dedication. You’ve made such a positive impact on her early years—and on our family

My daughter loves this school, she walks in excited every day and never wants to leave! The staff are warm, supportive, and great at communicating with families. The director and assistant director,are always polite, professional, and it’s clear they deeply care about the children and their families. They’ve helped my daughter work through big emotions with patience and care. We’ve also made real friendships here. the sense of community is truly special. We’re so grateful to be part of it! We love to be part of the Kido family

We are absolutely thrilled with our experience at Kido International Preschool! From the moment we enrolled our daughter in the program, we've seen nothing but dedication, warmth, and excellence from the entire staff. It’s been a joy to watch our child grow in such a nurturing and stimulating environment.
One of the things that stands out most is teacher retention, it speaks volumes about the culture at Kido. The consistency has allowed our daughter to build strong, trusting relationships with her teachers.
As for the communication at Kido, whether it's updates from the classroom, monthly newsletters, or even quick chats at pick-up, we always feel informed and connected. The leadership team, from the Director to the front desk staff, is approachable, responsive, and genuinely invested in every family’s experience. It’s rare to find a school where every level of staff is so engaged and aligned in their mission.
In every way, Kido has exceeded our expectations. It's clear that this school is run with heart, vision, and professionalism. We’re so grateful to be part of the Kido community!

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this school based on our experience. My daughter has been enrolled since it opened, and while the staff seem warm and welcoming during tours, the day-to-day reality has been quite different.

Safety is one of my biggest concerns. The security guard is not present during morning drop-off and is inconsistent overall. For a tuition of $1,900 per month, I would expect a much higher level of security—ideally involving a professional or HPD presence, not just part-time coverage. In today’s environment, safety should be a top priority.

There is also a high turnover rate among teachers, which disrupts consistency and negatively impacts the learning environment. While some staff members are kind and dedicated, others fall short of professional expectations. Alexa Perez, the director, has been particularly disappointing. Despite appearing friendly during initial tours, she has been rude, dismissive, and difficult to approach when concerns arise. Several other parents have expressed similar frustrations, indicating this is not an isolated experience. Melany Thompson has also demonstrated a lack of professionalism and knowledge, further contributing to a poor leadership structure at this campus.

The program feels more like a daycare than a preschool focused on early childhood education. My daughter enjoys attending, but mostly because of the unstructured playtime—not because she’s being challenged or stimulated academically. Despite being marketed as a Spanish immersion program, there’s been little to no educational progress in the language. In fact, my daughter has regressed. Before attending this school, she spoke Spanish fluently with her grandmother, please note her grandmother only speaks Spanish with no English who was also her primary caregiver. Since starting here, she’s lost much of that fluency, which is deeply disappointing considering that staff reportedly speak Spanish 95% of the time.

It’s also worth noting that the Rice Village location appears to be slightly better in terms of structure and staff quality. Unfortunately, this particular campus has not met even basic expectations. Now, with the school opening another new location, it seems the organization is more focused on expansion than truly investing in the care and education of the children already enrolled.

One bright spot has been Ms. Consuelo/Ms. Julissa and Ms. Maria—she is a dedicated and compassionate educator who clearly cares about the children and tries her best despite the challenges.

It breaks my heart to move my daughter, but making difficult decisions is part of being a parent. If you’re looking for a high-quality preschool in Houston, I strongly recommend doing thorough research. A simple search for “Top 10 Best Preschools in Houston” will lead you to far better options that prioritize both education and the well-being of their students.

My daughter spent a whole year in the adventurer class and experimenter class here before we moved to another city. She learned so much during her time here. I can tell she had a good time because she often refused to leave right away when I came to pick her up. She made friends in her class and sometimes mentioned her friends' names to me. She also enjoyed being her teachers' little helper. She told her teacher that she would miss her after she moved. The director here is very responsive: she really listens to what's on my mind as a mom and acts immediately in response. The school has a protocol for all the daily stuff. That gives me peace of mind.

My son has been coming to this day care for about 2 years and it was the best decision ever. He loves it here, he loves his teachers, his friends and he’s learned so much! His current teacher Ms. Bridges taught him Sign Language (which I love so much) She’s the sweetest teacher ever and I wish I can take her to my sons next school so she can keep teaching him! My son is 4 now so this will be his last summer here, but it’s ok baby number #2 is on the way and I’m definitely bringing my baby here. The teachers are so nice and always have the best attitude. Mrs. Amanda and Ms. Alyssa always have a smile on there face when they greet you at the door it’s the best thing!

My son has been attending this daycare since he was 6 weeks old. I visited many daycares before deciding on this one. To be completely honest, from the outside, it does not look like much but as soon as you walk in, you feel welcomed by both directors and the staff. My experience has only been with the infant class and the teachers in there (Ms. Crystal and Ms. Kalena). The classroom is very spacious, full of toys, bumbos, bouncers, swings, and exersaucers. His teachers are very good about communicating how his day went, if he was fussy / gassy/ happy/ etc. Yes, they will call you if they think your baby is not feeling good or sick(fever or diarrhea) but for me it has never been in harsh manner. As a mom, I do not want my son being at school ill and spreading the sickness to other babies, so I don't mind when I do get a call. My son is now 6 months old, he recognizes his teachers and greets them with a smile. When I pick him up, his diaper is always dry (never a rash), they follow my instructions on feedings (breastmilk and formula) and on prescribed medicines. The center also incorporates holiday pictures and activities the kids can participate in. Attached are pictures of my son at the center and some were sent by his teachers while I was at work. This center and his teachers are amazing and I can not thank them enough for taking very good care of my baby!

I know this was lengthy, but I hope this helps any new moms looking for a  daycare for their baby :)

We have had an excellent experience with Handprints Academy. My son has been attending since he was 3 months old and he is now 3. It may not look like much from the outside, but the staff is incredibly caring and attentive, making sure each child feels valued and safe. My son looks forward to going to daycare/school every day, and it's evident that he's learning and growing in a nurturing environment. The facilities aren't fancy by any means, but they are well-maintained and the activities are both fun and educational. When picking a daycare for my son, I wasn't focused on the appearance of the place, but more on the type of care and love my child would receive while there. Communication with the staff is clear and generally prompt, and they are very responsive to any concerns or questions we have. We couldn't be happier with our choice and highly recommend Handprints Academy to any parents looking for a loving and supportive daycare for their child.

HandPrints Academy has been my choice for both my kiddos. My kids love going since I enrolled them there at age 2. They are very active and informative. Every staff in that building welcomes you with open arms! I give much props to the directors Mrs. Amanda & Ms. Alyssa & Ms. Tonya for keeping this such a safe place for my kids! My son started pre k at a public school and the teachers were impressed on how much he knows for his age!! Will definitely be my only choice if I have more kids!

My son has been going to Handprints since he was 3 months old and is now 3 years old. He loves handprints…all of the activities, guidance, trainings of all sorts, and his friends he’s made there. They have a great chemistry as a complete unit. Would highly recommend Handprints Academy!!!

I absolutely love this daycare, and my kids love it too. The way they care for my two boys is like no other. I want to give a special shout-out to Ms. Dee, Mrs. Sharon, Ms. Shelly, Ms. Darielle, and Ms. Laura. Without them, I don’t know what I would do, and my boys adore them.

This isn’t just a daycare—it truly feels like family. It reminds me of those old-school daycares where you can trust the people watching your kids and have no worries.

Thank you all for everything you do each and every day. I also want to show appreciation to the wonderful ladies who help care for my youngest and show him so much love, even though they aren’t his teachers: Mrs. Yolanda, Mrs. Makayla, Ms. Mary, Ms. Kamiyah, and Ms. Mia.

If I forgot anyone, please forgive me. All the ladies here are truly amazing, and I’m so grateful for every single one of you.

The Nest has been a safe place for my daughter. My daughter grows so much. Her teacher, Ms. Shelley, is very patient, professional and knowledgeable. She genuinely care for all of her students while preparing them for the big school.

review_text: Amazing place for my baby to attend. I don't call it a daycare, I say she's basically going to a private school!!!! All the staff are so warm and welcoming

OPERATION_NAME: Center For Transforming Lives Riverside CDC
review_text:
This building is brand new and used to be an empty parking lot. HOW are there so many bad reviews, especially reviews that are years old already...??? That has to be fake.

That said, I visited the website and don't understand what this organization actually DOES. It sounds like they just rent out offices, maybe have some childcare for people who work there, and offer counseling, but no actual services like employment and food assistance, both of which would be enormously helpful since this neighborhood is something of a food desert with no safe gas stations or places to work (above minimum wage) anywhere in sight. That's why there's so much poverty in the area. Maybe offer services to fix things like that. Connect people to jobs with wages that actually pay the rent and don't require a bus ride to the other side of town. Lobby for access to food and gas that doesn't require a trip down the highway, especially since so many people here have to walk to get there.

There's a lot of undeveloped land and dilapidated former businesses in the area. Help transform lives by making the actual infrastructure of the neighborhood something people can use, so they're not just squeezed into these enormous apartment complexes being built here with no hope for a life outside of government assistance. THAT'S what we need here.

OPERATION_NAME: Center For Transforming Lives Riverside CDC
review_text: Their program is beneficial for tenants during the initial term. However, most are evicted afterward because they cannot afford the rent on their own. In the end, the people this program aims to help often end up in a worse situation than before. I tried contacting their director to provide constructive feedback but received no response.

My daughter has been here for about 6 months. She loves going to school and is always talking about all of the activities that they do. The small class sizes have really made her enjoy being there. I can't say enough positive things about her preschool teacher and how much my daughter enjoys her. I'm happy we found Ascension.

Ascension Episcopal School is a great school. The teachers and staff are professional and genuinely care about each and every child. The school has a great atmosphere where the children are encouraged to grow and excel academically and spiritually. My girls are in PK3 and 3rd grade and we couldn’t ask for a more perfect place for them to be able to learn and grow.

Best little school house in Texas, to my thinking.   AES is a great community of dedicated staff, visionary leadership and caring parents.  The children flourish in the small classes, and build lasting friendships with classmates.  They grow curiosity for the world around them, and develop a mindset of stewardship that will carry that world gracefully into the future.   Can't go wrong here.

This has been a great school for my children. They started at 18 months and 3 months and are now in 2nd grade and kindergarten. My son is shy so the small class size has enabled him to really grow and develop and the sports program has allowed him to grow from the child on the sidelines to the child who believes in his own capabilities. The community around the school has created great friendships for us as well as lasting memories for our children and family. Academically we started doing the STAR test and I am pleased to see my children working several grades higher than the one they are in. There is now a science lab for Kindergarten and up so they can start to really see the world. A great little school.

Ascension was the place where I grew up. It was like a second home to me. I formed so many special bonds with teachers and friends. I loved being a part of the Ascension community. It helped me gain confidence and knowledge to become the person I am today. I am currently in the 6th grade and I am so glad I came to Ascension!

I have been bringing my children to Kidz Rockets and I must say it is an amazing place for kids. The environment is safe, fun, and nurturing. Mr Ahmed is nothing short of amazing. New to the area and I can say I’m NOT disappointed! I’m so happy I went with kidz rockets! This day care is at convenient location they have happy faces welcoming the children every morning, the summer activities were excellent, kept the children happy and occupied. Not to mention my son loves coming to day care each day. I highly recommend anyone looking for a day care to visit and bring their children to Kidz Rocket Learning Center!

Our daughter attended this daycare in the infant room for about four months. During that time, we experienced both positives and challenges.

When we first enrolled, the director who led our onboarding left about two months into our time there. After her departure, we noticed a significant shift. Administration became noticeably more distant, and when we raised questions or concerns about our child, it often felt like an inconvenience rather than a priority.

Our experience within the classroom itself was mixed. Our daughter’s lead teacher was consistently kind, loving, and attentive, and we truly appreciated the care she provided. Unfortunately, there were issues with other staff. In the late afternoons, a floating teacher in particular often came across as rude and was frequently on her phone, which raised concerns about professionalism and attentiveness.

Additionally, the assistant teacher in our daughter’s classroom left or no longer worked there, and there was no communication sent to parents about the change. We only became aware after the fact, which added to the overall feeling of poor communication and lack of transparency from administration.

There were also serious care concerns. On at least two occasions, we picked up our daughter and found that she had poop caked on her skin, indicating she had been sitting in a soiled diaper for an extended period of time. This is completely unacceptable for an infant. When we brought this to the director’s attention, we were told that the diaper logs showed a longer gap between changes in one instance, but overall the concern felt minimized rather than fully addressed.

The facility itself is clean, but we did not feel that classroom sanitation protocols were consistently followed. There were multiple cases of hand, foot, and mouth disease within a short period, which raised concerns about hygiene practices. In hindsight, we wish we had taken more seriously other parent reviews that mentioned similar hygiene issues, including children being picked up in soiled diapers.

Overall, while we are grateful for the care provided by our daughter’s lead teacher, ongoing administrative issues, lack of communication, inconsistent staff professionalism, and concerns around hygiene and responsiveness ultimately led us to decide this was not the right fit for our family.

They started cutting benefits and hours for the staff, and bringing in under-qualified and untrained staff to the facility to make up for it. We are grateful everyday that we found MKU Shavano. 🤍

I also wanted a program with a rich Spanish language curriculum to support my trilingual children.
I’m so thrilled to say that these past two months at MKU Shavano have felt like a self-fulfilling prophecy come true. My children love going to school and come home each day sharing their newfound love for literature and the arts. Their bond with their teachers runs deep – it warms my heart when they talk excitedly about what they learned while we eat dinner together. The front office staff is my daily dose of positivity each morning as I drop them off.
Through my journey with MKU over the past year and three months, I can confidently say this place is a home away from home for my kids. If you are looking for an academically rich, safe, and loving environment for your child, look no further. I only wish I had enrolled my son and daughter sooner. I deeply appreciate Ms. Brigitte, Ms. Viví, Ms. Elvira, Ms. Alé, and Mr. Sandoval (the newest teacher there!). Within just one day, my son couldn’t stop talking about the fun activities he did in Mr. Sandoval’s classroom. Thank you, Ms. Chrissy, for accommodating my children into your school.

Making a decision on full time childcare can feel like a daunting task. Of course it's a big expense, but mostly you're concerned if your child will be loved and cared for when you're not around. I can say for certain this has never been an issue at MKU. Both of my girls have been there for over two years, and not a single day has gone by that I was worried about their safety or general well-being. The staff is extremely attentive, and they know every student by name. Additionally, the Spanish immersion PLUS Montessori is a game changer; learning life skills and another language from such a young age has had a positive impact on their overall growth and development. We moved further away from this school and made the easy decision to keep them there even though the drive is longer. Selecting MKU where our girls have a safe, clean environment to thrive in has been one of the best choices we've made as parents!

My family (my husband, myself and my children) have all had wonderful growing experiences.  We love the program and the genuine labor of love from the teachers and management at MKU Shavano. Anytime I have questions, they are addressed. Concerns are valued. My personal choice of financial investment in my daughters’ (2) earliest developmental stages is taken serious. In just under 1 year, my daughters have made a huge leap in their Spanish learning. The staff always try to upload pictures and provide updates throughout the day. Our children have progressed with their potty training and life skills in this program. We have full confidence in the program, and plan to keep our children in it until they age out. The extra opportunities in music, soccer, and dance that are available are greatly appreciated by me and loved by my girls.

OPERATION_NAME: My Little Rascals New Start CDC
review_text: Poor Management! I enrolled my 1 month old son here because at first glance the people were nice, facility was clean, price was decent, and it was in close proximity to my job. Well within 4 days a worker diluted my babies formula and lied about it. She blamed it on the previous lady that worked before her and the director reviewed the tape and found out she was lying. Babies can die especially that young from having too much water I explained that I did not want her watching my baby again and that she is a hazard to all babies. The director assured me she would not be in the infant room again only to tell me the next day that because they are short handed she had to be. Well my son didn't go back after that because obviously negligence is tolerated here and I do not want my child attending a facility that does not put the children first at all times. They seem to be more concerned about there ratio coverage then safety. Also they used my babies water and diapers on other children. I'm am one upset mom and rightfully so. I do not recommend this daycare its is very unprofessional and horrible staff.

This place has literally changed my whole life! My two children and I was invited to come check out the place and to see if it was a good fit for my children and I (we were sleeping in our Jeep) That was September 7,2023 we left there May 5,2025! When you surrender to God it’s not about what YOU want but what GOD WANTS YOU TO DO! Every staff member including the volunteers there literally adopted us and helped us in ways I never ever knew was possible. We got involved in counseling, the discipleship program (which we graduated from 🙌🏽) parenting classes, financial literacy classes, etc…I now have structure in my life, something I never had before. This place is no “quick fix” a lot of people go there looking for housing, but once you sit down and let God do his job you’ll see that you can do much better than housing. Ms. Patrice would say “get yourself together so you can choose your own ZIP Code instead of letting the housing authority pick one for you” and that’s what happened to me! I stayed down until I was fully able and prepared to pick where I wanted my babies and I to live. A safe neighborhood. Living there my mindset completely changed I will forever be thankful for those people. I renewed my CDL while living there, my chaplain took me to every single appointment I had (dentist,  DMV,etc) yes they have rules but if you need help like I did then you’ll follow those rules so you can get the help you need! Amazing programs for the children, parents, and single ladies. The holidays there are absolutely phenomenal especially Christmas and back to school time they literally spoiled my kids and I, I’m truly blessed to have passed through this place now we’re thriving because of COH ❤️🥹

Thanking The Shelter Staff For All They Did For Me. Thanking Ms Carolyn & Mr Billy For Their Dedication To Helping & Assisting In Times Of Need - High Blessings To Everyone Who Helped The Homeless Psalms 41 v 1-3 (UK)

I stayed here over a year ago for about four months, and my experience was amazing. They had strict rules, but they made sense and were reasonable. My caseworker, Miss Gwen was a true blessing—sweet, kind, and incredibly motivational. She believed in me during a very stressful time of being homeless, helping me believe in myself.

As someone of faith, I found strength in our prayers together. The rules regarding cleaning and chores were manageable, and my kids loved it there, feeling cared for and respected. Thanks to the support I received, I was able to move into my own place with my family, a significant accomplishment for me.

I’m grateful for the kindness and encouragement I experienced. I hope to volunteer someday to help other women, just as I was helped in this program.
Thank you Ms.Harmony & Ms.Patrice for all the love and support you have given me and my son! Words can’t describe how much it means to us.

I thought they would help with housing if you join the discipleship program but the reviews are saying otherwise. This shelter is clean and safe, that’s about it. If you need housing or employment resources, work with resource centers. When I was here, the people were very nice to me but there were a handful of crazies.

We LOVE St Martin's!  Our daughter started there right after she turned one and she is now in the 3YO program.  She was offered a spot at some smaller montessori programs, but St Martin's had a bigger faculty, more diversity, and honestly better hours (7 AM to 6 PM).  Her vocabulary, social skills, and confidence have grown so much--and she has so many friends!  The teachers are invested in the kids' growth and they have a thoughtful curriculum that is a great balance of learning and fun.  She looks forward to school every day.   Best decision we could have made.

Our family loves this preschool! We have a lot of friends whose children have also gone to the school, and we've heard nothing but great things. The teachers are wonderful and truly care about the kids. I'm confident that my kids are receiving loving care here - highly recommend!
We couldn’t love St. Martin’s Preschool more!  Our son Jack is learning, thriving, and so happy thanks to the wonderful teachers and caring environment.

We started our 5mo old baby at St. Martin’s in October and have been blown away with the ease to our transition into daycare! They felt like family from the tour into day 1 to now. They really go above and beyond to take care of the babies and make us parents feel confident leaving them in the best hands.

We have had our daughter at St. Martin’s for years and absolutely love it. The teachers and administration are engaged, thoughtful, and seem to truly love their jobs and working with children. St. Martin’s provides introductions into lesson plans in a school setting, arts & crafts, outside play, and more. Highly recommend!
