Had 2 of our kids come through Lighthouse Learning Center.  Fantastic care for our kids, great education to prepare them for elementary, and the kids loved it as well.  The teachers have a heart to nurture the kids and help the parents; administration is top notch as well.  Highly recommend!

The lighthouse Learning center was a temporary day care for my kids. Soon I knew I had made the best choice. My kids have attended LLC since they were 2 years old . I love how all staff is caring and it shows in the way kids come home sharing what they do in class.. The best part is they teach kids God’s word !!

Deciding who will take care of your child while you are at work is one of the most important decisions you will make for your child.  We tried several child care centers for my daughter before finding Lighthouse Learning Center, none of them ever felt right.  There was just a nagging in me that there was something better.  One day I looked into LLC and stopped by to look around.  The difference was immediate!  I felt PEACE in my spirit!  They pray with your children and learn the Bible as well as learning the basics of math, reading, etc. My daughter has been coming to LLC since she was 4 and now at 9 she goes to their after school program and summer care.  She loves it, I love it!  I thank God I found Lighthouse Learning Center:)
Amazing staff! They don’t just teach our kids — they love them. Every one of the ladies is wonderful. I truly feel like they are part of our family.

We were blessed to have both our children attend the Lighthouse Learning Center. Their staff genuinely cares for our family and loves our children. Our youngest is autistic and he’s flourished thanks to their teaching and encouragement.

Absolutely love the teachers. Every time I walk in and out I get welcomed by the teachers. It took me a long time to find something right for my toddler being his first time in daycare. He speaks to me more now that he has been here and can definitely see improvement. I am glad I made the right choice and its right by my job. Director is very friendly. All the other parents that I see pick up their child are always happy and smiling. Totally recommend to any parent. Thanks.
Great care, really nice and controlled environment, amazing community. Great attention to detail to kids necessities, amazing teachers, they’re all very kindhearted and welcoming

DO NOT PUT YOUR CHILD IN THIS PLACE!!! My son is 2 years old and attended for a few months, he would come home with these huge bites all over him, I eventually had to take him to the hospital for, the sleeping area is not clean enough and they have some kind of bug issue. that aside my son was left on a changing table alone, he fell off it of course and ended up with a 10 inch scar from the top of his back to the bottom. they had no remorse they tried to tell me a fake story at first but the girl ended up admitting she walked to the back and left him there. They literally told me I can find another daycare as if I did something wrong by asking to see the video footage which they refused to provide. So I called the police and I did. I do not recommend this place at all, the first red flag was the director doesn't speak any kind of English so the staff is always relaying and communicating information and on several accession's there were discrepancy on what was being said they were never all on the same page, it was truly an unorganized broke down mess. Me being a first time mom, and this being my sons first experience in daycare I didn't really know what to expect so I tried to give them the benefit of the doubt, until they just blatantly neglected my son and ended up scaring him for life. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!!!
I love the way the teachers teach the toddler and the preschool they are very nice with the children’s they teach them to be ready for school

Make sure your kids acting like grown out person because they don’t have not tolerance I moved my son here because my job is closed to them for any emergency I can’t pick up faster but I think I make bad decisions

Ms. White, Ms. Francesca, Ms. D are the Best!!!!! Club Busy Bee has been so fun for my son since they have joined Mayde Creek!!! They are always engaging with our kids and giving lots of fun activities to do, as well as, helping out with homework making sure it gets completed on time. I enjoy their positive engagement with both the parents and the kids! They are also so very supportive to both us parents and kids! Highly recommend ☺️

We love busy bee at Mayde Creek Elementary. All of the staff are always super helpful, friendly, and very supportive when it comes to drop off and pick up of our son everyday. Shout to the amazing Ms. White she has been consistently going over and beyond to assist our son. Busy bee is great!

My son absolutely loves his Busy Bee family! He is upset if I pick him up too early. The organization and structure of this after care program is top notch! Activities are intentional and school work is their number one priority.

I love the Busy Bee Program at Mayde Creek Elementary!
Ms. White, Ms. D , and Ms. Francesca are phenomenal this is my sons first year as a PK student in busy bee and he loves it so much. They are so supportive and amazing as a team!

------PSA------
Club Busy Bee (Bear Creek) is more than a childcare organization, it's a vital source of support and community. Trust, quality and safety are the primary values that can be attributed to the program. Special thanks to Director Amani who is a welcoming, ray of sunshine with every encounter! Only program my boys have attended regularly possibly will ever be the only.....

My kids have been coming here for about 6 years now and I absolutely love it, the teacher to students ratio is great. The environment is super friendly the staff is amazing The curriculum they use I love, my toddler comes homes talking with new words everyday and also learns something new. The have a big play area for the kids to play around and also have things for them to do outside, my favorite thing is the spirit weeks or how they do random activities with the kids throughout the week to have fun. The staff is super good at communicating I know something about my child the moment it happens. The cleanliness, the moment you walk in to the daycare you can smell how clean it is, they are also always disinfecting. I definitely recommend sending your kiddos here.

We are beyond grateful to have found this daycare. The staff care for my children as if they were their own, with so much love, patience, and genuine attention. Every day, my kids come home happy, safe, and full of stories about the fun and learning they experienced. The environment is clean, nurturing, and thoughtfully organized to support each child’s development. It gives me such peace of mind knowing they are in the best hands. I can’t recommend this daycare enough, it truly feels like a second home for our family.

This daycare is the best daycare I have ever encountered. I can’t even express the relief of finding a daycare you know you can drop your child off at and go to work with absolutely no worries in the back of your mind. My son has been there since he was 6 weeks old and he is now 3! I can’t even specify one name because every person there is absolutely amazing and he has climbed the ladder through each class. From baby room to toddler room. I always wondered man how do they do their hiring process cause every person here seriously just loves kids! I walk past the baby room still every day and the teacher is just smiling and playing with the babies and you can tell she truly enjoys being with them. In his prior class with Miss Chachi I always giggle cause she’s still there dancing and singing away with the class. His class now with Miss Margarita she’s so calm and gentle. My son is a firecracker but she doesn’t get flustered or annoyed she handles it so well. & Miss Gloria the director! OMG! Sweetest person ever! She has been with my son since the beginning! She’s devoted to the daycare and all the kids. When I see how a great of leader she is it makes sense why every teacher there is great also. & also, I don’t get any assistance so let me tell you daycares aren’t cheap! But I feel like I won the lottery here with not only the loving staff but also the great prices! I absolutely love this daycare and I’ll never leave until he’s aged out! Thank you for all that you all do! We are truly blessed! 🙏🏻❤️🙏🏻❤️

Ms. Gloria, Ms. Emmy, the rest of the staff were amazing with our two daughters. From the beginning they were able to adjust to our infant's schedule. We weren't sure in the beginning due to different people in the infant's room but overtime it all worked out. Great people. Never had a complaint in regards to my daughter's safety nor being tended to as far as food, change of diapers etc. The staff really does work with you and they are very friendly. Never had an issue with the staff nor the facility itself. Reccomend.

I bring my two kids here and they treat me like family. All the teachers are nice and very welcoming. The Director is nice and approachable. My preschooler teacher, Ms. Sylvia is so good to my daughter and my daughter loves her. She teaches the kids and makes them feel welcome. The owner, Mr. Sydney is available to speak, understanding and nice. They are creating good memories for my kids while they teach them and take care of them. I wouldn't trade them for anyone.

We are so blessed and grateful to have found baby boss! My 2 year old (almost 3) loves this place! She talks about the teachers at home and gets excited when she sees the building when we’re pulling in.
The staff seems very close; which translates down to how they care for the children. This is a home away from home ❤️

My son has autism and can’t speak for himself, and I came across Baby Boss Learning Center through a friend. I can proudly say my son has adjusted so well (we’re still working on drop off lol) it’s only been two weeks since he joined! The staff keeps you updated on everything: potty breaks, nap times, accidents, and even shares pictures of your little ones having fun and doing art. It gives such peace of mind knowing there are amazing people who truly care and take the time to keep parents informed. It’s not just the child going through the transition the parents are too and they’ve made it so much easier for us. Huge shoutout to Baby Boss Learning Center for being so patient, caring, and accepting!❤️❤️❤️❤️

As a single parent, finding a daycare you feel comfortable with can be scary—but Boss Babies made the transition so welcoming for both my son and me. I previously had my son in another daycare, and right off the bat I can honestly say that switching over has been such a blessing.

The location is very convenient, especially for parents without a vehicle. At the beginning of the school year, there are no additional fees—just the weekly \$170 tuition—because they understand this is a time when families are adjusting to new routines. This saved me so much money compared to other daycares.

Most importantly, my son is being cared for so well. The staff sends me constant updates with real time stamps and pictures throughout the day, which eases my anxiety while I’m in class. Seeing photos of my baby eating well and smiling truly gives me joy. The meals provided are wonderful—I’ve never seen my son so excited to eat!

From the convenient location, to the cost savings, to the excellent care my child receives, I feel like I’m definitely getting my money’s worth. I am deeply satisfied and grateful for Boss Babies.

Love it here! Our baby is now super socialized. At only 20 months, she can recite numbers, letters and nursery rhymes. Baby Boss has really helped Elaina to gain confidence and radiate positivity. She even helps clean her area after dinner! Best staff and really helped me and my husband feel confident in choosing them as our learning center.

This day care is amazing! My kids have been here for 4 years and they have learned so much and grown with them. It is amazing to know I can trust rely upon them. I’m more then grateful for their help and support  thank you boss baby staff

La Petite Daycare Academy has been an amazing place for our family. The teachers truly care about every child, and it genuinely feels like an extension of our own family. They host fun events throughout the year, and summers are packed with exciting field trips that our kids look forward to. Our children are always safe, inspired, and engaged. Ms. Paulene is incredible. Her leadership, warmth, and professionalism are unmatched. We’ve never experienced a better environment for our kids at any other center.

My children have been attending La Petite Academy for five years, and from the very beginning, they’ve been treated like family. Deciding to send your children to daycare is never easy—especially with everything happening in the world—and I came in with anxiety from previous negative experiences. This has been completely different.
The Director, Mrs. Paulene and Teachers Mrs. Lula are truly exceptional. They are actively involved in the children’s daily activities and genuinely know what’s going on with each child. Mrs. P is incredibly attentive, and the care and awareness she shows gives parents real peace of mind.
They don’t just care for the kids—they care for the families. I trust them completely and know my children are in very good hands.

Love love love this daycare!! My oldest is Autistic and the way Ms Paulene is with him makes my heart happy. My younger two have thrived and grown so much since being here. My daughter’s writing and reading skills at her age are beyond expectation. My youngest son has come out of his shell and is more social and friendly. I 100% recommend if you’re looking for a place for your children. Also the camera access was a must for me as it gives me comfort in being able to check on my kids. Shout out to Ms Paulene, Lexi, Ms Davis, Alexis, & Sabina (or as my daughter calls her Ms Teacher). Lol.

I absolutely love the staff and they keep my informed about my kiddo anytime he is there. He has become so outgoing and independent. He’s become more adventurous in trying new foods. I 100% recommend this daycare if you are in the area. It’s worth it.

I just want to say how absolutely appreciative I am of this daycare facility and all their staff! From Ms Paulene, to Ms Lula, and Ms Alexis, I know when I drop them off my kids are being taken care of and loved dearly, and I know they’re SAFE! I cannot say enough good things about this daycare family, and honestly I wish I would’ve swapped my 3 long before this past summer! My children absolutely adore the staff there and they’re sad when it’s time to leave! Thank you Ms Paulene for having such a wonderful care environment where I know my kids are good when I’m away from them! We love you all! -Allie, Colton, Eleanor, and Addie

I absolutely love Westchase Academy and Daycare! I started bringing my oldest daughter here when she was just 3 years old, she’s now 9 and the experience has been nothing short of amazing. Over the years, I’ve also enrolled my son when he was just 3 months old, and later my youngest daughter as well. Each of my children has been cared for, taught, and treated with the utmost respect.

The teachers and staff at Westchase truly go above and beyond. They don’t just watch the kids they nurture them, teach them, and create an environment where they feel safe and loved. It’s clear they genuinely care about each child’s growth and well-being. I’ve watched my children learn so much and develop socially and academically because of the foundation Westchase has provided.

As a parent, having a place you can trust with your children is priceless, and for me, Westchase has been that place for years. I am so grateful for the role they’ve played in my kids’ lives and highly recommend them to any parent looking for a safe, caring, and educational environment for their children.

My kids been at Westchase Academy for a long time. I would highly recommend, Treat us like family. The team is great staffing, with kids making sure breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks are giving out. My little ones do learn, before going to Pre-K. My oldest ones does homework before coming home. My Baby is well taken care of, with making sure they are clean before pickup and etc. This daycare also make sure kids go outside for play time also goes on field trips when kids are out of school, bc some parents like me will be at work when school is out. This daycare totally rocks, They also worked with me for my special needs child as well and I really love them for that my second family 🫶🏾

Trustworthy people working there. Very kind to my child. Always making sure the kids are well fed and give as much extra as the child asks for. Always getting snacks ( cake juices fruit ) from their own pockets to treat the kids.

I love this daycare.  My kids have learnt so much.  Their vocabulary has improved immensely.  The teachers are so loving and welcoming.  They serve healthy food.  Their place is clean, the toys sanitized .  Basically I would recommend every parent who is looking out for a daycare should go to Westchase Academy only as this daycare has everything a parent and child would want.

I absolutely love this daycare. My twins and 2 year old have been going there for a year and a half and they love every single second of it. It is clean, loving, they feed the kids very well and also like to do little parties and take the kids out on field trips some times.  You can tell that the teachers love their students along with the staff.  I highly recommend Westchase Academy!

I absolutely love this daycare! The staff is amazing, especially Mrs. Roshanda and Mrs. Miracle — they take such good care of my children. The management is great, and you can truly feel the love and care they give to every child. I definitely recommend this daycare to anyone! Your children will be safe, happy, and they’ll enjoy being here. Most importantly, they’ll learn valuable skills that help them grow and succeed.

I absolutely love this daycare! All three of my kids attend, and I couldn’t be happier with the care and attention they receive every day. The staff are so patient, loving, and truly treat the children like their own. My kids have learned so much and always come home happy, talking about what they did that day.

The communication with parents is great, the facility is always clean and safe, and I can tell they put real effort into helping each child grow and feel loved. It’s such a comfort knowing my kids are in a place where they’re not just watched but genuinely cared for. I’m so grateful to have found this daycare — I highly recommend it to any parent looking for a nurturing, trustworthy environment for their children!

I LOVEEEEE Crayola! My daughter has been attending Crayola since she was 11 months (she's 2 now) and I wouldn't have trusted anyone else with my child! You can tell every single one of the staff members really care for the children from the way they teach all the way to the FOOD they feed the kids! (Which is what really sold me on choosing Crayola) my baby is only 2 and she speaks like she's in kindergarten! Im so thankful for them teaching and pouring into my baby the way they do

Crayola Learning Center is the most amazing daycare my child & I have ever experienced. My daughter has been there for 2 years and they have never (literally never) missed a beat. Every person who works there from the Director/Owner Ms. Miracle all the way to Ms.Linda the chef is very nice and sweet. My daughter Ale starts school this year and it’s really bittersweet that we might be departing from CLC. But I Thank you CLC staff . Sincerely Ale’s Mom ❤️

I highly recommend this learning center to all! I’m very appreciative of the staff especially my child’s Teacher Ms.Skyla she’s always communicating with me and amazing at making sure my baby is clean & fed . I love the way she interacts with the children and not to mention my daughter LOVES her ! Thank you so much for easing my mind and ensuring the safety of not only just my child but others as well!

We love Stepping Stone Mueller/UT!!! After having the opportunity to keep my son home for his first year, we had to make the tough decision to pivot to daycare and this location came as a recommendation from friends whom have their sons enrolled. And I can confidently say that I only wish I would’ve done so sooner. My son LOVES it!

He thrives getting to interact with the other kids and completes 2-3 activities a day with his teacher Ms. Rochelle which has been so good for him. Not to mention every morning she takes the time to make my son feel comfortable before dropoff so he can transition to the day in a positive way. He has developed a ton of new skills, including counting, sign language, and proper manners and I am so impressed at their ability to teach him. The teachers have been super informative and receptive and are so tentative to my son and his needs. They also get lots of outdoor time which is great for getting energy out and not being pent up inside. Principal Mrs. Devin runs a tight ship and is always involved in the students care and safety but also warm to staff. We love Ms. Trinity and Ms. Lydia who are great helpers to Mrs Devin as well.

There’s been multiple times where I have been emotional expressing my gratitude to the staff and explaining to others how fortunate we are to have him in such a great spot. Could not recommend a place more 🤍

We absolutely love this Stepping Stone location! The staff is so kind, patient, and truly invested in the children. You can feel how much they care every single day. Our son truly sees them as family!

Our son has grown so much socially and academically since starting here, and we always feel confident dropping him off knowing he’s in a safe and nurturing environment.

A special thank-you to Ms. Devin, the principal, who sets the tone for such a welcoming and positive atmosphere. She communicates so well with families, and leads with so much heart. We couldn’t be happier with our experience and are so grateful for everyone here. Highly recommend!

My son has been at Stepping Stone Mueller since he was 6 weeks old and he is now 3.5 - it is truly his second home and he loves it! He talks about Ms. Devin, Ms. Trinity, and Ms. Aliyah at home all the time. When he was an baby he loved Ms. Julia and Ms. Nardis. He feels safe, has a ton of fun, and they really care about him. It feels so good to know that I'm dropping him off every day to a warm, welcoming environment filled with books, art, and laughter!

We've really loved our experience at Stepping Stone Mueller. What stands out to me the most is how responsive and caring the principal, Ms. Devin is, and the close attention she pays to each family and caregiver that make up the community of this school. After deciding to leave our previous daycare due to extreme disappointment with that experience, we're so relieved to have found a place that shows us how positive of an experience a daycare can be.

Mrs's Devin, Trinity, and Aliyah have been key in my son's growth and success! Their passion for his passion has built his confidence, started him towards a love of learning, and shaped him into a happy, well rounded child. Thank you for everything Stepping Stone!

This park is such a depressing little park. I hope that it they have plans to upgrade the playground because it’s in dire need of safety updates. The newly updated Eastide YMCA is a beautiful facility inside but this playground is an eyesore!

I am very happy with the Y. It has been fully remodeled in the last couple years, and looks brand new. It is kept very clean and the staff is extremely friendly and accommodating. All the workout machines are new and kept clean. They have activities for adults (I don’t have kids) and all the people I’ve been in an activity with are also very friendly, which promotes socialization and a relaxed atmosphere. I enjoy their free fresh vegetables, (and cooking classes to show great ideas on how to prepare them), bingo, guest speakers, chair volleyball and more.

Everyone is so welcoming and kind, the sweet lady at the check in greets me by name. My kids have loved child care and the attention they get. Everything is clean and well kept. Great variety of equipment and machines. Most importantly, I love how close it is to my house.

Staff were extremely nice, and the selection of workout equipment was great. Never got to see the pool or go to a cooking class due to the work schedule being sporadic. Only went a few times, as I had to walk a few miles to get there, which took a lot of time in and of itself, hence, another reason I went up there only a few times.

I appreciate the activities and programs offered. There is no better way to enhance my physical activity, flexibility and learning healthy cooking skills. Feels great to be out in the community and making new friends and acquaintances.

Unprofessional staff ! Called to let company know there was a van that was speeding uncontrollably toward the school. Person answering the phone for company unconcerned about a van that could be carrying kids speeding on the road during school hours in a school zone.

I have to say this place is certainly an unexpected "GEM"... You can feel the love in the atmosphere of this place.
The owners are in center / hands on with everything in the children. They take time to get to know you and your child, your not just another customer.

I can say my child had never cried at the front door of a daycare because he thought he would not be able to attend that day. This spoke volumes to how he loves this place!

My kids (5) of them love this daycare. It’s not most biggest daycare or materialistic daycare. But it’s more like family, trust. My kids never had a issue in the whole five years they been going. Larry learning is not perfect but they perfect for me.
They don’t take care of your child.
Your children are left unsupervised.

OPERATION_NAME: The Prep School of Bee Cave
review_text:
We’ve been part of the Prep for five years, and it has truly felt like an extension of our family. From the very beginning, it’s been a place where our kids feel safe, loved, and encouraged to be themselves. We currently have a three-year-old and an 11-month-old here, and the bonds we’ve built with their teachers mean so much to us.

Our oldest recently transitioned to kindergarten, and it went far more smoothly than we ever expected. He felt confident and prepared, and that’s a direct result of the thoughtful academic and emotional preparation he received here.

We are incredibly grateful for this school and the people in it. I recommend it wholeheartedly to any family looking for a nurturing, high-quality place for their children.

OPERATION_NAME: The Prep School of Bee Cave
review_text:
Our daughter has been at this school since she was an infant, and now nearing two years old, we continue to feel so grateful for the love, care, and professionalism she receives every day. The teachers are warm, engaging, and genuinely invested in the kids’ development. We’ve seen her grow and learn at such an incredible pace since joining.

What stands out most is how safe she feels—she adores her teachers and gets excited whenever she sees both current and former ones. The leadership team is also exceptional: they communicate clearly, act thoughtfully, and handle any concerns with seriousness and care. We deeply trust them and feel confident she is in the very best hands.

OPERATION_NAME: The Prep School of Bee Cave
review_text:
My two kids, each at very different stages/ages, have absolutely thrived at The Prep! We have been there for almost 4 years now—it is the best private preschool / daycare in Bee Cave and even Westlake. Trust me, I have toured them all! I drive all the way to Bee Cave from Westlake because we love it so much! Finding a school around here that supports both a younger and an older child can be challenging, but the Prep truly excels at meeting kids where they are while helping them grow and learn! The balance of play and education is outstanding. Each day, our 4yo comes home excited to share what she did all day! The teachers know how to keep learning fun while still building real skills, and it shows in our kids’ confidence and development.

The administrative team deserves special praise. They are incredibly organized, communicative, and genuinely invested in every family’s experience. Whether it’s daily updates, thoughtful check-ins, or seamless handling of schedules and transitions, the admin staff sets the tone for a warm and well-run environment.

The school and its amenities is my fave part and why I won’t ever leave! Bright, clean, and purposefully designed, the classrooms and play areas create an inviting space where children can explore safely and comfortably. No other school in the area has a tech room, multi-purpose room (gym), cafeteria, SEVERAL Playgrounds, and an amazing splash pad!

We’re grateful to have found a school that provides such a nurturing, enriching environment for both of our kids. Highly recommend to any family in the Bee Cave area!

OPERATION_NAME: The Prep School of Bee Cave
review_text:
We’ve had such a wonderful experience at The PREP! My son has been in the infant room since he was 5 months old, and his teachers are the best — they don’t just take care of my child, they care for him. Their warmth, patience, and genuine love towards the kiddos give me total peace of mind every day.

From the directors to the classroom teachers, everyone we’ve interacted with has been consistently kind, professional, and supportive. It’s clear that the entire team is dedicated to creating a safe, nurturing environment where little ones can grow and thrive.

I’m so grateful to have found a place where my child smiles big when being dropped off and that I know is in great hands while my husband and I are at work.

OPERATION_NAME: The Prep School of Bee Cave
review_text: My family has called the PREP home for 5 years and have loved our time at this sweet school! Both of our children started in the infant school and our oldest is currently in the 5K program. The teachers work so hard to nurture and care for our babies and the friendships my kids (and my husband and I) have made are so special! We appreciate management so much for working to make each week fun and enriching! Highly recommend!!

My family and I have had the absolute best experiences with CDC and the CREW. They have been kind, understanding, reliable, and very accommodating for us. My son loves his school CREW counselors and is so excited to be spending his first summer with them for camp. CDC has been outstanding ever since they first opened in 1993. I feel calm having them look after my child and know that he is safe. They are the best with caring for children with disabilities as well and I don’t know what we would do without them. I truly recommend anyone that needs childcare to sign up! They are worth any waitlist.

My daughter joined CDC when she was just a baby 4 months old.  She loves it I always feel so happy dropping her off because I know she is left in the best hands.  Wonderful caring teachers and staff.  They have outdoor learning time that gives the kids opportunities to explore and play.  The most important part about CDC it give the opportunity for my daughter to socialize.

This place's waitlist is fake. It's that simple. I don't know how they actually decide if your kid gets to go here or not but they definitely have a million excuses if they don't want your kids at their school. I'm left only to assume my children aren't welcome because I'm a single mother using financial aid. Unfortunately they're not even kind to you if you don't understand how you could be on the waitlist for over 1.5 years and there's been no change at all. I've spoken to Mary multiple times where she scoffs at almost every question I ask, as if I'm the one that works there and how dare I not know all the answers already, it's like i'm wasting her time. Still i'm left desperate for care which has kept me from leaving this review multiple times. I don't know if the facility can be as good as it looks if the people are this rude to moms (especially those in need). Good luck out there guys, I know it's not easy to find somewhere you'll trust.

I had great luck at The Children's Courtyard, they're just no longer accepting CCS. Maybe look there if you don't use financial aid.

Obviously I don't remember much since I went here, but I certainly remember enjoying the experience. I DISTINCTLY remember one cool toy in the gravel pit that was like an excavator. That machine inspired my career as a gold miner, and also a side-job of burying important police evidence. Without that cool toy I would never know the joys of loading gold bearing rock into a gold dredge, or have the sweet, sweet cash from hiding Jimmy Hoffa's corpse.

Our 2 year old son got scratched & bit badly on his face. There were 3 teachers in the classroom as per their staff. It’s the case of child negligence. Same day I picked him up, I got all of his belongings from there. Don’t feel comfortable sending my child over there anymore.

The Kids' World Learning Center has been an incredible place for my kids. The owner and the staff are very professional, the teachers are very competent, and the building is always kept spotless. I currently have my third child attending this daycare, and my oldest two children also attended here. It has been a blessing. Thank you, Mr.Rick and Mrs. Nancy.

This day care has been wonderful for  family. Everyone  is kind, welcoming, and genuinely caring with the children. From the moment you walk in, you feel the supportive and friendly atmosphere. We’re grateful for the safe, nurturing environment they create every day.

If I could leave a rating higher than 5 stars, I most certainly would!
Kids World Learning Center is a loving, safe, trustworthy and supportive center. ❤️
The staff is kind, caring, and patient with all students, from infant to school age.
Students are encouraged to be creative🖍️✨
The building is kept clean to the highest standards 🧼
Photos are uploaded throughout the day, which gives great peace of mind. Students love attending and walk into school with a smile on their face every morning. 😊
I would recommend Kids World to everyone and anyone! ⭐️

Kids World Learning Center is truly the best daycare—I highly recommend it!
My niece has been attending since she was a baby, and she’s always excited to go in the morning and just as happy when I pick her up. That kind of joy says a lot about the care she receives.
The environment is warm and welcoming, and the staff is  friendly and attentive. It’s clear they genuinely care about the kids, and it really shows in everything they do. I’m so grateful for the peace of mind they’ve given our family.
Nallely and Valentina

I can personally say KWLC is amazing! The owners are so welcoming. My personal experience with KWLC started when my daughter was 3.  Her time at KWLC was amazing and therefore I have recommended them to several of my teacher friends that currently have children attending. My daughter was recently hired to work there part time. We have kept in touch with the owners and I am so thankful they are giving my daughter an opportunity for her first job to be for them! What makes it even more special is this is where she attended child care from 3 to school age. Anyone looking for a family oriented facility for their infant through school age child needs to take a tour of KWLC! Make sure to mention this review to the owner :) I’m sure it would make her smile!

I absolutely love this daycare. The staff is amazing!!! This is the first daycare that my child has attended and he absolutely loves it. I was skeptical because he’s extremely attached, of course to us his parents, so I didn’t know how he would react, but he goes in running to the staff and the other children there they are very professional The facility is very clean and the staff is very humble I would recommend this Daycare to anyone
Very clean and like new.

After doing a lot of research and touring the facility twice, I fell in love with the staff, the curriculum, and what this company stands for. The energy in everyone who works here is absolutely amazing and makes it feel like home. I appreciate how much they care about my son and everything is provided! This Daycare is sent from heaven! If you love your child, send them to Big Dreams & Lil Wonders❤️

My daughter started at this center in May, and I can confidently say it was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. The love, care, and attention the staff show each child is truly evident. Their flexible hours have been a tremendous support for our family, and in just under two months, I’ve seen remarkable growth in my daughter—spiritually, emotionally, educationally, and developmentally.

She’s always happy and well-fed when I pick her up, which hasn’t been our experience at other centers. The teachers are incredibly attentive and provide detailed feedback and reports that keep me informed and reassured (and I ask a LOT of questions!). I’m beyond grateful to have found this place—God definitely led us here!

If you're reading this and wondering whether this center is the right fit, stop wondering and go ahead and enroll. You won’t regret it.

My child transitioned here from another daycare about a month ago. So far, we are very happy we made this decision! The teachers pay close attention and can give details about every child. They are welcoming and encouraging. They do an amazing job with communicating what's going on at the school. We have seen our son make tremendous growth in a month. Some days, he doesn't even want to leave. I can't wait to see how much more he will grow in 3 months.

I am forever grateful to the amazing team at Big Dreams and LittleWonders! When I needed a safe, nurturing, and loving environment for my child, they opened their doors and provided exceptional care. Their dedication, and professionalism are truly remarkable.

From the moment my child started, I noticed the positive impact of the daycare's warm and welcoming atmosphere. The staff's patience, kindness, and expertise have been invaluable to my child's growth and development.

What truly sets "BDLW" apart is their willingness to go above and beyond. They've been a rock for our family during challenging times, offering support and understanding when we needed it most.

I highly recommend this Day Care to any family seeking a trustworthy, high-quality childcare solution. The love, care, and attention they provide are priceless, and I'll be eternally grateful for their role in my child's life. And in addition they are part of the Texas Rising Star!

Thank you again!

I came across this daycare through Google.I contacted this location to see if I could get a tour of daycare. I felt very comfortable with my daughter at this daycare since day one.Staff is awesome.Registration was easy.The Perry location stays open late.THATS a plus for me as a full time parent.This location actually teaches the students.

Bell’s Little Angels is a family-run daycare and pre-kindergarten that is both professional and genuinely loving. You can immediately feel how deeply they care about their students.

They provide a safe, nurturing environment and even have buses for field trips, which shows how committed they are to giving the kids real experiences beyond the classroom. They use the Abeka curriculum, and it truly shows in the success of their students. Children who attend Bell’s Little Angels consistently do well in their future educational journeys.

Every time I walk in, I see happy kids who eagerly run to hug their teachers and the management. That alone speaks volumes about the environment they’ve created. My baby is still too young to fully understand what’s going on, but seeing the love, structure, and joy in this place gives me complete confidence that we’ll love it even more as he grows and becomes more aware.

Highly recommended for any parent looking for a caring, structured, and high-quality early education experience.

My daughter started at this day care when she was 4 years old and entering pre-K. It was very difficult for me to find a place I could trust — I visited several in the area, and this was the one I chose.

I had just moved here, and my daughter didn’t speak English very well yet. Even so, her adjustment was excellent, and I can honestly say the experience was very positive. She attended for two years, and I really have nothing to complain about regarding the care and attention she received. Whenever she wasn’t feeling well, the school would call me, which made me feel at ease.

The only thing I would mention is that, at times, I found the financial side a bit strict, and it could be slightly more flexible.

Overall, I highly recommend this day care — it was a great place for my daughter’s development and well-being.
The school bus that picks up kids from Falcon Pass is very good — clean, well-maintained, unlike some others I’ve seen.
My daughter really enjoyed the food, which is healthier than what is served at many schools.
The summer program is also excellent, with fun and engaging activities.
One feature I really appreciated is that the day care has cameras, which gave me peace of mind when she was in pre-K

She always had reading activities, and she learned sign language, which was very different from other day cares I’ve seen that mostly show movies or don’t provide much intellectual stimulation.

Unfortunately, I had to move to another city, and they don’t serve my new area. It’s a shame they don’t have other locations, because I would definitely continue sending my daughter there.

I love Bells! My kids have been going there for a while now. My 2 year old son has learned so much from his teacher and he is genuinely attached to her. Everyone on staff is kind, caring, and professional. You truly can't put a price on a wonderful daycare you can trust like Bells.

We absolutely love Bells. We love the camera access in the rooms. They help ease my mind knowing I can check in on her to make sure she is doing well. The office/ support staff are all extremely helpful and friendly. If you ever have any questions or concerns, they deal with them immediately. Each teacher she had has been great with her. They helped us get her used to her glasses, were always soothing and helped calm all the kids at drop off, and are just really sweet and caring ladies. We even like the kindness drives Bell has periodically throughout the year (shoes for school kids, sponsoring kids at Christmas, appreciation gifts for staff.) The location is so convenient. We honestly cant rave about them enough.

Our kids have been going to Bell’s Little Angels for 9 years now and there’s no where we’d rather have them. They are well cared for and loved by Bell and the teachers there. All of our kids loved their time there and our 3 year old says “I love my teacher!” and everyday wants to go say bye to her previous teachers. They all really have made a lasting positive impact on our kids!

I love this place. I brought my 10 week infant here up until 5 months and was sad that we had to leave. Mukta and Jessica do a phenomenal job and it was always surprising to see how calm and content the babies usually are. I was looking forward to taking my baby to their toddler class as well, it seems like those sweet toddlers get plenty of love and attention too. Shout out to Misty for always being kind and available! I highly recommend this school.

I can’t say enough good things about this place, Misty is a great leader and has been honest and transparent with me about everything related to my child, including staff changes, teacher students interactions, and how everything is being handled while I am away. They made me feel so confident that my daughter was in good hands after transitioning from another place where we had very bad experience, so coming here made us a happier family and my daughter learned a lot!!!

The only reason we left that we were offered the free prek 3 program, otherwise, I will always consider them whenever I need childcare assistance with my kids.

My family has had a wonderful experience at Cadence Academy! This was my child's first time in school so I was apprehensive but the amazing staff and teachers made all the difference. The adjustment was smooth and we felt supported every step of the way. I just adore my child's teachers. It is clear they not only care for their students, they treat them with so much love and compassion. It's been such a wonderful experience to know that my baby is in such a caring and supportive environment. I highly recommend Cadence!

Amazing Experience at Cadence Academy!

Our family has been a part of Cadence Academy for several years, and we couldn’t be happier with the care and education our children have received. From day one, the director and assistant director have been incredibly attentive, supportive, and dedicated to creating a nurturing environment.

The staff and teachers go above and beyond, treating our family like their own. Their warmth, patience, and dedication to each child’s growth and development truly stand out. It’s clear that they genuinely care about the well-being and success of every child in their care.

We are beyond grateful for the positive impact Cadence Academy has had on our children’s early years. If you’re looking for a loving, safe, and enriching daycare, this is the place to be! Highly recommend!

My son got his collarbone broken here.. I honestly don't know how it happened. I truly believe someone hurt him here. Apparently it was an accident, but even the doctor said that the collarbone is a hard bone to break. CPS got involved and they never really told me if they saw the video of how it happened. Just a sketchy place and they didn't let me see the video....

The Woods has been such a blessing for our family! From the very first day, the staff made us feel welcome and supported. The teachers are truly amazing — they care so deeply for the kids and take the time to really get to know each child as an individual.

My kids are so excited to go to school every morning, and it makes me so happy to see them come home smiling, telling me about their day. The balance of learning, creativity, and play is just perfect. I’ve seen so much growth not only in academics, but also in confidence, independence, and kindness.

As a parent, it gives me so much peace of mind knowing my child is in such a safe, nurturing, and fun environment. The Woods feels more like a family than just a school, and I am beyond grateful for everything they do.

I can’t recommend The Woods enough!

We absolutely love The Woods! My son has been here from kindergarten through fifth grade and our experience has been nothing short of amazing. The teachers, administrators, and staff are all caring, supportive, and truly dedicated to the kids. It feels like a family, and we are so grateful for the strong foundation they’ve given our son.

We’ve also had a wonderful experience with The Woods Preschool at Cedar Point with our younger child. The staff there are just as incredible and make learning fun while creating such a warm environment.

We couldn’t ask for a better school for our children.

There are so many good things about the Woods, from the staff, teachers to the quality of education it offers. The school is everything a parent would hope for and more. The teachers care and challenge the students to reach their full potential. The staff is always friendly and warm, we have formed a bond with the school easily. We have had the most wonderful school year. Thank you for all you do!

We just started our boys here and cannot be more happy with the school. The staff and all of the teachers are so so caring and have helped my boys not only adjust but thrive! They are doing so amazing and growing and learning so much!!

This school blends warmth and excellence in a way every parent hopes for. Children are challenged with a strong, well-rounded education while surrounded by kindness, encouragement, and respect. It’s a place where young minds are prepared for the future and hearts are guided to do good in the world. We appreciate all that they have done for our family.

I have no complaints. I love this place and they love my child. He has learned so much he went in not speaking at all and now he speaks more every day he even started eating more things that he doesn’t eat at home. The staff is loving and very understanding.
Browns Earlybird Academy 4 employs an unsafe driver. I witnessed them weaving in and out of rush hour traffic and cutting off other drivers. I can only hope no kids were on board.
They truly care about the kids. We have since moved and my kids still tell me all the time how much they miss their teachers.

I was lucky to find out about this new school for my daughter. Unlike her previous daycare, the teachers aren’t constantly rotated , the establishment is very clean and peaceful. They genuinely care about my daughter. The curriculum is in Spanish which is great for reinforcing her language skills. She seems much happier in this school which I highly recommend.

We’ve had a great experience at Didactica Spanish Immersion. Our 18 month old has grown so much in just 3 months - he understands a lot of Spanish and actually looks forward to going, which we never expected.

He gets excited to see Ms. Sabrina and Ms. Katy, which gives me so much peace of mind. You can truly feel how much they care. We have a highly rated Montessori school within walking distance, but we intentionally chose Didactica for the intimate setting and teachers. It’s been such a great fit for our family, and I highly recommend!

We adore Bright Beginnings for our 3 year old daughter. The kids and teachers have formed such an incredible community. She’s encouraged to use her imagination and creativity here. All staff is incredibly supportive and will work with the family to create the best possible environment for each child. There are fun weekly activities: Stretch and Grow, cooking activities, arts and crafts, science experiments, and more. Plus, they offer two healthy snacks each day which has been fantastic.

Can’t wait for our littlest one to be old enough to attend along with his big sister!

Such a wonderful experience here!  We enrolled our 4 year old in the fall of '22 because he was getting lost in the shuffle at his current daycare with high student to teacher ratio.  The teaching staff at Bright Beginnings gave him excellent attention, learning tools, manners and life skills and he began to open up and flourish.  The calendar of events are extremely organized and creative, our son enjoyed all the activities month to month.  The communication between parent and teacher were excellent.  The schoolhouse is set up for hands-on play and very tidy,  and the outdoor area has plenty of areas for exploration.  Owners and staff make holidays so fun for all.  We will miss everyone as we march into Pre-K, and cherish the great friends along the way :)

I enrolled my daughter in Bright Beginnings in Aug 2020 and she's had a great experience, we're sad she's starting pre-k in the Fall. It has the cozy feel of an in home daycare but also the curriculum and schedule of a professional preschool, it's really the best of both worlds. The teachers are very professional, caring, and communicate with parents well. The director is very involved and is always available to discuss any questions I've had. Each month has a different learning theme and my daughter comes home telling me new things, singing new songs, and is so proud to show me her artwork.

Alot of both pros and cons about this place.  My baby started attending when she was alittle over a year.  They have ALOT of random closures and half days.   I mean for every single holiday even valentine's day and st Patricks day.  They will even close for an entire week for non federal holidays and still expect a payment.  Don't expect to depend on the handbook for anything,  most of their closures were not listed in thier handbook and the schedule in there was also inaccurate.  Although I could never really see what was going on in the back,  almost secretive sometimes depending on who was working, my child was always happy when i picked her up. She loved everyone and everyone loved her and staff is always super friendly. But when she turned 2, they moved her into a different classroom.  There was a Caucasian woman working that would call me to pick her up every time she cried.  My baby never hurt anyone or was destructive she was just a toddler who is learning how to express her emotions, but It seemed there was very little patience for frustrated 2 year olds. One day when I picked her up they handed me a letter stating she could no longer attend.  No warning, no explanation, no formal  communication.  Id say this is a good place if you're just looking for something cheap and don't really need anything dependable.

My daughter Harper attended for some time. It is a nice facility and the staff is great as well. She enjoyed her time in class. I’d definitely recommend  them I had no issues , I just left due to a location change.

My 2 kids love it here. Their teachers are the best at what they do. They care and love your children as much as you do and that is what makes this daycare special. I have always been a SAHM and so putting my kids in someone else care was the scariest thing to do, but they made me feel welcome as soon as I walked through those doors. The place is clean and highly taken care of. My kids love eating the meals they prepare especially their
Green beans, my kids have me stalking my pantry with it. They will feed your kids good. If you are looking for a daycare that will feed and treat your kids like how you would  I highly recommend this daycare, you won’t regret it. I haven’t seen a daycare that cares about your kids like I have seen with them. They truly love their job. You can’t get anything better at any other daycare than this.

My son started daycare about a week ago at childcare express & it’s his first experience. (even being almost 3 years old) I know paying for daycare can be hard but this center is affordable and is VERY close to my work, 2 big pros that attracted me to this center. As a mom I was very nervous to put him in daycare but I went to do a tour and I loved the center ! The daycare is very clean & cute! The admin Nicole and Natalie answered all my questions, were very sweet, made me feel very comfortable with enrolling my son at their center. I was able to meet a few of the teachers and overall, the entire staff is sooo sweet and made me feel comfortable in every way , felt very reassured that my son would be well taken care of. They give updates throughout the day on their daycare app which also helps my mommy mind have some peace knowing he’s eating, napping, being changed, playing, learning, etc. I can tell my son enjoys being there and has fun, he looks happy when I drop in to check in on him. Happy I made the choice to enroll my son here, whole process was easy and I’m just happy overall. Highly recommend this daycare center !
My daughter loves her new daycare! That’s the best feeling for a parent. Some days my child runs to class and forgets to give me my hug!! This place is amazing and the staff feels like a big family!!

We love Bilingual Minds Austin school! Sofia enjoys going to school every day, and it's been incredible to see how much she has grown. It's important to us that she learns about Brazilian culture and speaks Portuguese, and this school makes that possible in a fun and engaging way. The staff is incredibly caring and attentive, creating a warm and nurturing environment where Sofia feels right at home. We couldn't be happier with the education and cultural connection she receives here!
Is this business still operating? I have tried to call several times over the past week but no one picks up the phone. And voicemail is disabled.

Our son recently started attending Bilingual Minds and we couldn't be happier with our decision. As Portuguese/Brazilian descendants, it has been a priority to us to ensure that our son is immersed in the Portuguese language while still advancing in the appropriate skillsets for his age. Bilingual Minds was exactly what we were looking for and more. We can tell that our son is genuinely excited to go to school everyday, and he has fostered such wonderful relationships with both the caretakers and classmates alike. We love receiving all the updates of the multiple activities and lessons they do in a day, and seeing that translate to our son's communication and understanding of Portuguese has been simply amazing. We are so very grateful for this special community, and can't say enough good things about it. Thank you, Bilingual Minds, for all the love and care!

É difícil encontrar palavras para demonstrar nosso apreço e gratidão pela Bilingual Minds e por cada uma da equipe! É um local de extremo carinho e acolhimento, nos trazendo o calor brasileiro que tanto prezamos. Nosso filho foi recebido e olhado em todas as suas particularidades, teve tempo para sua adaptação, para se sentir seguro, criar vínculos e desabrochar suas potencialidades! O desenvolvimento da escola também é visível, todos estão sempre buscando aprimoramentos e melhorias, a cada dia. Em quase um ano de escola, vimos ganhos em todas as áreas, nosso filho não quer ir embora e se sente feliz e motivado. Recomendamos de coração esse espaço cheio de amor!!

Eu estou tão feliz que eu encontrei essa escolas para meus filhos. Todas as professoras e assistentes são atenciosas e educadas, eu vou para o trabalho sabendo que meus filhos estão em ótimas mãos. Recomendo para todas as mães que estão procurando escolinha para seus filhos. E o melhor é que a escolinha é bilíngue e traz um pouco da nossa cultura para os nossos pequenos brasileirinhos.

We have loved our experience at La Tribu Rural. Everyone is so welcoming and kind to our child and to us. They provide such a robust curriculum full of experiences my child would not have had otherwise and really challenge her while staying respectful of her individual speed of development. The school also integrates nature and learning about different cultures. They have great play areas and the kids help care for the school goats. I so appreciate the community they have fostered and of course that they have taught my daughter to speak Spanish. I will be sending my next child as well. Highly recommend.

Our son loves La Tribu, his loving guides Ms. Yanis and Ms. Marlen, and the rest of the team. The facilities are charming, and the kids get lots of nature and outdoor play. The kids are also privileged to care for two little goats that live among them. La Tribu is also a community, and parents have many opportunities to get involved and participate in fun events organized by the school.
We are very fortunate to have our son at La Tribu and are thankful to the guides and team for being so caring and kind to our son.

Our two children love La Tribu! All of the teachers are absolutely wonderful. We love that they get to play outside every day, learn life skills, and learn to speak Spanish. It’s a very nurturing and loving environment and we will be sad when the kids have to graduate.

La Tribu has felt like a second home for my daughter over the past 2+ years... most days she doesn’t want to leave! Admin and classroom staff are so warm and attentive to the children’s needs and development. We have also found a sense of community amongst staff and other families enrolled.

La Tribu is a wonderful childcare facility. It’s not just a school - it’s a community. Our son loves going to school every day. He loves his teachers whom care deeply for him and his education. And he comes home every day, tired and dirty from all the play (which we love!). Truly, we couldn’t ask for a better place for our son to be on a daily basis.

When my twins were four, They were still a little bit afraid to go to daycare. However, the fun and kind staff helped them feel comfortable and after a few days, they couldn’t wait to go back again. As the mom, this was comforting, knowing they were in a place I was confident they were happy and would be loved while I was at work. Most importantly, they learned about Jesus and his plan for their life

Grace Point Day School offered our child a great learning environment. He received not only a strong academic foundation but also one that teaches the Bible and God. The curriculum aligns and reinforces the values we teach at home.
Thankful for Gracepoint and the services they offer. Look forward to one day my grandchildren attending.

All of my kids attended this school and we loved our time there. They had teachers that loved on them, taught them about Jesus, helped them build skills, and provided a wonderful and safe environment for them. I never had to worry about tears at drop off or pick up because they genuinely loved this place, and I did too. I can not recommend this place my highly!

Years ago my son attended Grace Point and he learned so much about Jesus and even recited Bible verses from A-Z by the time he was 3.
The teachers and staff were amazing. I still remember the love and kindness that they showed me when they heard I was going through a difficult time. Grace Point is such a special place , I would recommend it to anyone as I recall this was the first time that I felt the love of Jesus and began my walk with Christ.
My child will soon begin his first visit and he loved what will be his new school.
Montessori school, a wonderful experience for my child!

SproutStart is an incredible place for children to learn and grow. My son has gained so much during his time there. The teachers are kind, and the director’s dedication is remarkable. They truly care about every child.

I was really hesitant on where to place my young son but Sproutstart has been the absolute best school. He’s 2 years old and Ms Bessy is a wonderful teacher. The kids do educational activities and have crafts that come home almost every day. They keep the kids busy and minds engaged. My son has loved being in Ms Bessy’s classroom and talks about her and his classmates when away from school. He’s excited every morning to attend and I love that the teachers use gentle words and redirection for discipline. This is the best place.

Note! The school is not affiliated with the church they’re in. They just rent the space. They do a Christian based curriculum and tell them about God. My son came home singing cute Sunday school songs. They have a great relationship with the kids, and encourage them to love one another and treat each person with kindness and respect.

We truly are so blessed to have found SproutStart and would recommend them to any family or friend. I’m a single mom and I cannot say how important it was for me to find a safe haven for him while I worked. This was it for us and I hope you will give them a shot. They’ve exceeded every expectation I had.

My son has been attending SproutStart for a year now- he is 15 months old and started at 3 months old. We love SproutStart! The facility is always clean and the teachers are always friendly and warm.

I have not had any issues with any of the teachers around my son and he truly does love them, which makes it so much easier for us as first time parents to leave him in the care of someone else all day. Any adjustments I've had to his schedule, etc. I've addressed with them and they've made the corrective actions on their part no problem.

They are very communicative through the app where you can see the daily updates, pictures, videos of the child. They have come to me with concerns they've noticed as he's grown and I've always appreciated their commitment to keeping him safe and happy. I love that they don't suppress his feelings, but rather let him know it's ok to have emotions and guide him through the big feelings he's having until he's ready to move on to the next activity.

I would definitely recommend SproutStart to other parents needing childcare.

The experience with the staff at this daycare was great and my son clearly loved his teachers in the infant room. I still have the sheets that were provided at the end of each day stating how much they had to eat and when, and most importantly what activities they had done during the day: I was using the information to practice at home (especially the songs).
I loved that they would give us pictures and art that I could keep or send to the family. It is rather small but works well for the number of students.
Such a shame that we moved too far to keep him enrolled in this daycare.

One of the greatest daycare‘s in Spring branch thank you for all the amazing teachers and the director at this place you guys are always been so helpful and wonderful. Keep up the amazing work and I can’t wait to enroll my kids here.

OPERATION_NAME: The PREP School of Stone Oak
review_text:
We LOVE The Prep! Both of my kiddos started here at just one year old, and it has been an incredible experience. The teachers are truly the best! My daughter is currently in 5K (Private Kinder) with Mrs. Sanchez, and she is simply amazing.

Thanks to her dedication, my daughter is learning both English and Spanish, and she's thriving beautifully. The nurturing environment and engaging curriculum have made a world of difference for our family. We couldn't be happier with The Prep and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a fantastic early education!

OPERATION_NAME: The PREP School of Stone Oak
review_text:
I have my 14‑month‑old daughter enrolled at The Prep, and she is always excited to see Ms. Alia and Ms. Armida! My little one has very sensitive skin, and the staff has been so accommodating with her frequent diaper changes, which gives me great peace of mind. I’ve also noticed incredible progress in her sign language and basic communication skills since starting here.
In addition, I use the “drop off” option for my 5‑year‑old when her school is closed and I need to work. She always has a wonderful time, and we especially love Ms. Sanchez!
The Prep has been such a supportive, nurturing environment for both of my children, and I’m so grateful for the care and attention they receive. Highly recommend!

OPERATION_NAME: The PREP School of Stone Oak
review_text:
Miss Ana, Miss Armida, and Miss Alia are wonderful.
They are caring and attentive to what each child needs. They are always smiling and ready to show affection to the children.
They bring joy to the environment, help the children develop their abilities with gentleness, and spark their curiosity to learn even more. I am very grateful for each one of them and so happy for the opportunity my son has to learn and be cared for by such amazing teachers.

Thank you so much for everything ❤️

OPERATION_NAME: The PREP School of Stone Oak
review_text: YOU FOUND IT! Moms and dads, look no further. After trying so so many daycares across San Antonio, this is the ONE. It is clean (sparkling even), with perfect classrooms, curriculum and play areas tailored to each child and their needs. It’s affordable, serves delicious fresh foods, and the teachers are so incredible. My 18mo old is thriving! I’ve never had a single complaint or issue unlike so many other daycares. The mom guilt is AWFUL having to leave her for so long every day. She used to scream all day and be overwhelmed and exhausted by the time we got home. But when I drop her off at The Prep, she immediately runs up to her teachers and sits down, ready for the day! When I pick her up, I always ask her how her day was. She yells “happy happy happy” all the way home.. which makes mama’s heart so very happy happy happy 🥹. We love Mrs. Alia, Mrs. Ana and Mrs. Armida ❤️❤️❤️

OPERATION_NAME: The PREP School of Stone Oak
review_text: I really love The Prep School. They have an incredible staff always caring and professional. The facilities are spotless and very well maintained. The kids truly learn and have fun; you can tell they’re growing in a happy environment. They also have such a lovely sense of community, and I absolutely love the events they organize.

This is a great church with a dynamic pastor. They have many ministries for all ages and situations. I love what they are doing for the community and thier prison ministry. I felt the spirit  from the moment I walked through the doors. Beautiful sanctuary, beautiful pastor and beautiful friendly members. God bless!
Excellent place to worship. Great preacher who teaches. Glorious choir.

Great place to worship, the messages are power pack. The music is awesome and a very friendly congregation. Lots of different ministries there too. They even have an excellent youth ministry there. Church service is great every Sunday. The choir is amazing and of course the spirit of the Lord is there. I am a member for 30 yrs and the pastor is great, welcoming and caring. Come by and visit for a Holy Spirit time.
It's Always a blessing to serve and be served!  Thx so much HPUMC!
Awesome pre-school!
Excellent school, children learn a lot. 2 experiences

The BEST daycare I love everything about it! I had my kids in a daycare previously to this one and it was not a great experience until I came here. My son who is now in grade school went here and my daughter is still going here and has been since she was 6 weeks old! You know it’s a great daycare when your kids LOVE going and even ask to go on the weekends! 😂
Highly recommend this daycare for your little ones, you won’t be disappointed!

Finding a safe, fun and learning environment for our son was very important. Cornerstone has not disappointed. Director Henry answers all our questions and keeps us abreast of what’s occurring with him. Our son enrolled around 13 months of age and he has thrived so much within the short time he’s attended.
