Also, the occasional pictures are the best to receive through the app. I hope to keep our son with Cornerstone up to school age.

As a first time parent It is very scary to leave your child at a daycare when you have been home with them for months or even years! But when I step foot at CLA I automatically felt welcomed and so informed with my child's daycare , my son has learned soo much since he has enrolled and he loves his teachers we are so grateful for them he has done so much progression with his teachers they are phenomenal and we appreciate them so much even during Hurricane Beryl they were there for my child and other children while others lost electricity I felt so relieved he was able to stay cool during that difficult time, we love our CLA staff ❤️

My granddaughter attends Cornerstone Learning Center.  She is one years old and can count,  sing songs,  talk and sign.  She is crazy about the staff. They are a wonderful group of teachers.  They love her and she loves them.  She is always ready to go to school.

I’m a FTM & I was so nervous when it came time to place my 16 month old daughter into daycare. When I say nervous.. I was nervous and full of anxiety. It was super hard finding a place that enrolled infants under 18 months. My daughter started attending CLA around 13.5-14 months of age. The first few weeks took her some time to get adjusted but now.. my daughter jumps to DeAngela as soon as she see’s her. CLA is really good at respecting my wishes when it comes to her care (ie: acceptable foods) & very communicative. They’ve made me super comfortable with leaving my child with them. I don’t see my daughter withdrawing from the center no time soon. Thank you CLA!
Bad my my cousin is not going to get into the school she's on the waiting list on number six she used to be number one

My children love coming here. Before they can even get out of the car, they are screaming their teachers' names and eager to go in. The staff instills morals and values and most of all they instill confidence. If you want great gentle loving care, if you want your children to be taught not only academics but how to respect themselves and others then this is the childcare center for you.

This is the bests place I find for my kids, the staff are always there for them and you, if you have any situation they always try the best way to help you right away my kids attended this place for about 2 years,and they love this place, we are blessed that we find this place
The owner of this place is A Nice Angel who always care about every child that attend this place.

This is one of few daycares in the area that I was comfortable leaving my child. We changed daycares several times before finding and staying with this one until my child started elementary school and we moved out of the area. He was here over a year and that was the longest we ever stayed at any daycare. You can tell the owner really cares about the children and puts her heart into what she does.

We shopped around, out of all the local child care places this one was the smallest but most inviting. Pam(the owner) has been great, she is always there, we only needed child care for 3 days a week, Pam worked out a deal, were happy. My 2 year old son doesn't want to come home so we know he's happy there. There are cheaper places but remember you get what you pay for...
Driver with what appeared to be dreads is not a safe driver. I wouldnt trust them to drive my kids. They forced merged into the lane and almost caused an accident with a car and school bus

I tell everyone I know: send your kids to Spanish School 4 Kids! The teachers don't just 'show up for work, they truly care for the children like family. The environment is so kind and tender, and the curriculum is fantastic. We especially love Miss Aby—she is an incredible human being and a gift to the students. 10/10 recommend! If you are looking for the absolute best place for your child to learn Spanish, look no further than Spanish School 4 Kids! My daughter has had an incredible experience here. This isn’t just a school where kids learn a language and do crafts; it’s a place where every single teacher treats the students like their own family.

We absolutely LOVE Spanish School 4 Kids! Choosing a preschool is such a big decision, and this has been one of the best ones we’ve made for our son. From the moment we walked in, we felt welcomed, cared for, and completely at peace.

The teachers are incredible! So nurturing, patient, and truly invested in each child’s growth. He comes home so happy and genuinely excited about what he learned that day.

The environment is warm, structured, and full of joy. We’ve seen so much growth in his confidence, social skills, and independence since starting here. It’s such a great community!

We are so grateful for Spanish School 4 Kids and highly recommend it to any family looking for a loving, high-quality preschool experience!

I can’t say enough good things about this school. Everyone here is incredibly kind and genuinely flexible, which meant a lot to me as a first-time mom trusting someone else to care for my daughter. I was nervous about how she’d adapt to a new environment, but she absolutely loves it. She walks in on her own now, and every teacher greets her by name. You can tell they truly care about the kids, and the kids feel it too.

My niece also attended this school when she was younger and has participated in their summer camp program. They even offer Parents’ Night Out, and we’ve dropped my niece off with my daughter, and she begs to go back. That alone says so much.

I’m really grateful for this place. It’s been such a positive experience for our family.

Our nearly 3 year old has been apart of the community that SS4K offers for over a year. At drop off he walks into the school on his own because he actually wants to be there. Couldn't ask for a better feeling than your child being happy and welcome.

We love Abi and the teachers at SS4k. They treat the kids as if they were their own. There’s a strong sense of community here that you rarely find in daycares. We are currently on our second child attending. You won’t regret sending your child here.

I’m really overjoyed and grateful to have came in contact with this church/school. It is absolutely AMAZING! Ms.Cecilia is a great person. The staff pray with the children, have positive spirits, treat you with so much respect and it’s a wonderful place for children to learn, be surrounded with gentle care and love. This is what you call a village. Southern Crest is definitely a great place for your babies and I’m appreciative that my babies have been introduced to such an amazing place to learn and grow. I’ve gained a trusted relationship with them. If you looking for a great daycare and support Southern Crest is the place to be for your little ones.
I LOVE THIS CHURCH/SCHOOL so much. My daughter  enjoys it and she is learning so much and the staffs have beautiful spirits.
godly people

Both my kids went to Cuthbert school for their pre school programs. The teachers are very friendly and welcoming. The administrative staff are also very supportive and communicative. Feels like family. Kids do learn a lot and have plenty of activities that keep them engaged

My granddaughter has been in St Cuthbert since September 2024! Her teachers have been absolutely amazing!! My granddaughter is 2.9 yrs old and already knows 1-10 and over 15 letters and sounds and her art projects are a wonderful keepsake!! If you have a toddler, I highly recommend st Cuthbert!!!
I cannot recommend this school enough! The staff is absolutely amazing! They’re sweet, kind, loving! Best experience we could ever ask for with our little one.

St. Cuthbert School is a fantastic school. My child has attended since last year and it’s been wonderful to watch her develop academically, spiritually and socially because of the engaging and loving school staff. Everyone at St. Cuthbert takes the charge of educating these young souls seriously and it shows in everything they do.

I really enjoyed talking to the Director Melinda, she is vey knowledgeable and has a very strong curriculum but also an understanding that children need to play! Can’t wait for my toddler to start this coming new year!

MFH is a wonderful school that I regularly recommend to other parents. My two kids attended from 2018-2025. They started as babies and stayed until it was time for kindergarten. We loved our time there and are so grateful to the teachers and staff who gave our kids the very best care.

As a former pediatric ICU nurse turned NP, I am very cautious about who watches my children. Safety is incredibly important to me because I have seen many of the worst case scenarios.

Finding the right childcare was a challenge, especially during the pandemic. I immediately felt welcomed and comfortable at My Friend’s House.

We sent our two children to MFH from toddlerhood on and I cannot begin to express my gratitude. All of the staff is so kind and loving, which in return has helped my kids develop into kind and loving little humans.

The teachers all go above and beyond to educate and keep the kids engaged, with ample outdoor time and some academics. The kids get to grow their imaginations in a supervised and nurturing environment. As an added bonus, meals are included in tuition. There are a lot of fun events like Friday dance parties, a holiday performance, and Parents Night Out.

I highly recommend MFH to anyone looking for a warm and nurturing, yet fun environment for their kids. It truly is a special place.

I do not know if I will ever be able to express the gratitude my family has for MFH. The care my daughter received here was beyond exceptional. We unfortunately had to move out of state and leaving this daycare and our little family here has been one of the things we miss the most. All of her teachers throughout each stage have shown her the most love and care. All of the staff know her by name and she obviously knows them too as she always runs to give them hugs. The director, Elvir, is the most amazing human who expresses compassion and empathy for any concerns you may bring. We loved every minute here and wish MFH all the best as we depart from Austin.

Updating my review 2.5 years later as our love for MFH has only grown :) We now have two children at MFH and have nothing but great things to say. We love all our kids' teachers (some of whom have been there for a LONG time!). MFH is a truly unique place and they care deeply about maintaining a warm, nurturing environment for the kids. Older MFH students also benefit from the close affiliation with NW Hills United Methodist (getting to attend weekly chapel, VBS, etc.), which has been wonderful. Very thankful for this place!

_______

Our daughter gets so excited every morning when we pull in the parking lot. The teachers and administrators are amazing. They do so many fun activities with the kids and I'm always amazed at the new words she learns on a daily basis. Love getting to see pictures and updates throughout the day. So thankful to have gotten a spot at MFH!

We’ve loved our time at MFH. Such kind teachers and administration, great experience with all other parents, great communication from the school, great response to COVID. Our daughter is always so excited to go, and I love having a place that feels like a safe second home to her.

We had the best experience at Bright Horizons and only left because of a move out of state. Our daughter spent most of her first year here, and we couldn’t have asked for more. Every morning, our daughter would light up with excitement to go to school, which speaks volumes about the care she received. In fact every morning I would see kids running INTO school not away from.

Her teacher Ms. Monique was an absolute blessing. She treated our daughter like family, guided us through every milestone, and gave us so much peace of mind as first-time parents. Having someone like her in our corner during that first year meant the world to us.

The administration staff—Felicia, Shannon, and Sammi—go above and beyond to make every family feel welcome and heard. We felt like we were part of a supportive community, not just a daycare.

The facilities are top-notch with outdoor-facing classrooms that foster a love of nature, and the curriculum gave our daughter plenty of social and learning opportunities. The food program is incredible (yes, chicken fried rice and turkey tetrazzini at daycare!) and the parent app was such a comfort to see her daily updates.

Bright Horizons truly set the bar for what childcare should be—safe, nurturing, and full of love. We can’t recommend them enough!
We

We’re so happy with our experience at Bright Horizons. Miss Shannon and Miss Felicia have been incredibly supportive and attentive—they patiently listened to every query we had and made sure our child was well cared for and comfortable from the very beginning.

Miss Ella and Miss Celeste have done a fantastic job for our child engaged with a variety of fun and meaningful activities. Their dedication to creating a stimulating environment really shows, and we’ve seen our child thrive under their care.

We truly appreciate the entire team at Bright Horizons for their warmth, professionalism, and commitment.

I can't say enough positive things about Bright Horizons. As a first-time parent without local recommendations, my husband and I researched a couple of daycare options and decided on Bright Horizons. Our daughter started attending at 3 months old and stayed until she began kindergarten. The teachers and staff were incredible throughout her time there. Now that she's in kindergarten, I truly feel she's ahead of the curve compared to her peers, thanks to the wonderful foundation she received at Bright Horizons!

Average at best and definitely not worth the high price.  My grandson went to Bright Horizons in another city and it was a wonderful experience, so we naturally expected the same here.  But, it was very disappointing.  In the other location, they posted pics and updates to the app multiple times daily and it was great to be able to see and know what was going on.  He was having fun and the staff was so engaged.  In the 3+ months my grandson went to this location, I could count on one hand how many pics or updates were posted.  The teachers and staff were always so engaging and friendly in our previous location, but here, they barely made eye contact when we dropped him or picked him up.  Often he would have his clothes on inside out or his shoes on the wrong feet when we picked him up.  They seemed to pay very little attention to the kids.  Really sad, actually. And the price was $500 per month higher here! Do yourself a favor and shop around.  Visit other schools in the area.  There are some great alternatives and you’ll save yourself some money and frustration.

My Grandchildren were going here.  I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.

Rev. Knott is so insightful and articulate, and I leave every week feeling grateful for the opportunity to learn and grow in my faith. History, culture, etymology… If you are looking for light shows and drum kits, this isn’t the church for you.

Thank you, Grace Youth Academy, and especially Ms. Julissa—you’re making a world of difference.

My family and I are so happy that we decided to take our children to Grace kids Academy. They have a lot of extracurricular activities and they really love their students. Grace Kids Academy is a wonderful place. The staff treats children with unique love and care, always attentive to their needs and the development of each one. Without a doubt, an excellent option for any parent looking for the best for their little ones.

I highly recommend Angel Watch Academy to any parent/caregiver looking for a safe and amazing space to send their child to prevail!
My son attended AWA from age 1.5 years old until he was 4. He has now graduated and is prepared at his new school! The staff are so loving and in tune with their role for your child! My son started here at 6 months he’s 14 months  now and I trust the staff here completely. My son is shy and he allowed his teacher to hold him the first time we toured. All while still being very professional we love Angel watch there’s no there place I’d send my baby!!!!

The staff is warm, caring, and truly dedicated. Our child is always excited to go and comes home happy and learning new things. The environment is clean, safe, and full of fun activities. We feel completely at ease knowing our child is in great hands. Highly recommend!

Angel Watch was heaven sent for my family. After 2 bad experiences with daycare/preschool programs, I was very apprehensive about starting a new one. I met the Director, Mrs. Thomas, at an outing, where she invited me to come and tour. It took a couple of months, but I popped up and was in complete awe! I saw the friendly faces of Mrs. Thomas and Ms. Lynn, super clean and sanitized rooms and most importantly, happy and healthy babies and toddlers. I breathed a sigh of relief and immediately registered my daughter! They embraced her with loving and open arms. I noticed they took time to get to know her and eventually learned her  personality and learning style. My daughter was very prepared for kindergarten and is now a distinguished honor student at a Math and Science charter school. The staff and families have become extended family and we could not be more happier with our decision to attend Angel Watch.

The staff is caring and attentive, and the facility is clean and safe. My daughter has attended Angel Watch Academy since 10 weeks old. As a new mom, they made me feel confident knowing she is in good hands. AWA is a wonderful place for children to learn and grow!

We’ve seen a remarkable improvement in our child’s development since joining this daycare, and we are so glad we chose it. The program is well-organized, goal-oriented, and the staff are always prompt with follow-ups whenever incidents arise. The transition has been seamless, and we can’t emphasize enough how invested the team is in the growth and progress of every child in their care. Truly an excellent team!

As a military service member, I am glad we have the opportunity to have Children’s Lighthouse as our care facility!
The staff is outstanding and extremely caring with the care of our kids!
I would recommend not only to military but civilians parents as well!!

If you're looking to endure a three-month waitlist, pay over $650 for what amounted to a week of childcare, only to be abruptly left without care, Children's Lighthouse at Potranco is precisely the place for you. Our experience at this facility was a nightmare of financial exploitation, alarming safety negligence, and profound inconsistency.
We paid a non-refundable $150 registration fee three months in advance to hold a spot for our two-year-old daughter. After this three-month waitlist, she was permitted to attend for less than six full days (she was dismissed just 2 hours into her sixth day). In total, we paid over $650 for this minimal care, only to be abruptly left without childcare.
The billing issues were relentless and unethical. We were unjustly charged an annual curriculum fee of $185. When questioned about this for a child who barely attended, they refused to waive the full amount, reducing it only to $50. This clearly shows their priority is collecting maximum fees, not providing fair service. When trying to work out these discrepancies, we were repeatedly cited 'policy' and told there was nothing they could do. We were instructed to contact Cyndi, the Executive Director. We emailed her and never received a response. Upon following up, the admin staff claimed Cyndi was on vacation and would get back to us, but she never did. The very next communication we received was a collections call demanding an additional $50 for an outstanding tuition balance, specifically for a day our daughter wasn't even able to attend since she'd already been dismissed. This call came with an explicit threat to send the bill to a collection agency and impact our credit. This is egregious.
Their stated reason for dismissal was 'safety concerns,' a claim that directly contradicted a conversation we had with our daughter's teacher just the Friday before. The teacher explicitly reassured us that our daughter's behavior was typical for a two-year-old and that she had seen 'worse children eventually thrive.' Our daughter was not even given the opportunity to adjust or grow, despite this assessment. This is especially frustrating given that she thrived for over a year at Children's Lighthouse of Alamo Ranch (same franchise, different owner), with no similar issues or an excessive number of reports.
Beyond our personal ordeal and the unfair charges, we observed a critical and alarming safety hazard at the Potranco location: the playground is situated directly adjacent to the parking lot with only a thin fence and absolutely no bollards separating the play area from moving vehicles. I attached pictures of this flimsy barrier, which has already been struck by a vehicle. This deeply concerning lack of protection is eerily similar to the tragic incident at ExcellED Montessori Plus Daycare Preschool near Fair Oaks Ranch this past January, where a child died due to a comparable setup.
While the teachers at CLH Potranco seemed genuinely friendly, it's clear they are visibly overworked. The administrative staff at the front desk consistently appear disengaged and unhelpful, offering no support or solutions regarding our daughter's situation or the egregious billing discrepancies. This facility's readiness to dismiss a toddler for subjective 'safety concerns' while neglecting a glaring, objective safety risk for all children, coupled with their predatory billing practices, refusal to communicate, and passing accounts to collections with credit threats... it's truly beyond frustrating.

An awesome experience with Children’s Lighthouse on Potranco! It has been so great that we’re only moving from Potranco to another children’s lighthouse. They have ALWAYS answered the phone when we call. They have ALWAYS provided timely answers and remained professional during our three years with them on Potranco. The providers are very personable and relate to us as parents. Absolutely recommend 10/10!

My youngest daughter has been there almost a year, and she LOVES it and so do I! She has transitioned smoothly through 3 classrooms (based on age and skill sets) and EVERY SINGLE ONE of her teachers have been fantastic. They're great with communicating and give lots of daily updates and pictures. I wish I would have been able to send my other kiddos here before they started Kindergarten. My only "complaint" is the waiting list time, BUT given how amazing the school is, it's well worth it if you can get away with it. (I would suggest filling out paperwork before your kiddo is even born haha).

Luv & Care has been a blessing and an incredible experience for my son and I. First I want to say the center director Mrs. Cynthia is amazing she is very kind and professional every concern I've had she has addressed and eased my mind I 100% trust the staff with my son. I truly cannot say enough wonderful things about this facility. Mrs. Mary Ann and Mrs. Jojo are exceptional caregivers who go above and beyond every single day. Their patience, kindness, and genuine love for the children are evident in everything they do. They take the time to understand each child’s needs and make sure every child feels safe, valued, and supported.

The after-school daycare and summer camp programs are well-organized, engaging, and thoughtfully planned. The children stay active, involved, and excited through a variety of fun and educational activities. For summer camp they are constantly taking the kids on trips every week movies, water parks golfing etc also during summer camp they have their own pool so the kids go swimming every day and they do have a life guard on duty. My child always looks forward to attending and comes home happy, confident, and full of positive stories about his day.

What truly sets Luv & Care apart is the strong sense of trust and communication. Mrs. Mary Ann and Mrs. Jojo keep parents informed and are always approachable, which gives me complete peace of mind. Knowing my child is in such a nurturing, structured, and loving environment means everything to me. I am extremely grateful for the care they provide and would highly recommend Luv & Care to any parent seeking reliable, high-quality after-school care and summer camp.

If you are looking for a calm, educational, and appropriately stimulating child development center for your child, I would not recommend this facility.

During my time here, I observed a high turnover of staff and inconsistent communication from administration. On more than one occasion, I personally witnessed administrative staff making unprofessional comments about employees to parents — including remarks implying that some staff left after tax season because they "didn't want to work." This behavior was concerning and did not reflect the level of professionalism I expect from leadership in a childcare setting.

In addition, staff often struggled to appropriately teach and reinforce classroom rules or redirect children effectively. My child, who does have some behavioral challenges, was not being supported in a constructive or consistent way. Instead of collaborating on strategies or using positive behavioral methods, I was frequently asked to pick him up from school — sometimes two to three times per week — which made it very difficult to maintain stable employment.

As a parent, I am simply looking for a provider who will keep my child safe, supported, and engaged while I am at work. Unfortunately, the lack of structure and leadership here made that impossible.

I do want to acknowledge that several of the teachers in the younger classrooms were caring, patient, and genuinely invested in their students. I’m deeply grateful for their efforts despite the poor example set by management. Sadly, given the constant turnover, I’m unsure how many of those wonderful teachers are still there.

Overall, this center needs significant improvement in leadership, communication, and behavioral support before it could meet the standards of a quality early childhood program. Based on my experience, I do not believe it currently meets the standards expected of a Texas Rising Star facility.

As a first time mom, I was hesitant on any day care. This location has amazing teachers and consistent staff. I do appreciate the care from the director, assistant director, staff, and the teachers taking care of my twins. I do recommend this Luv n care on Gathering oak for your day care needs.

Luv-n-Care was a great daycare for my son and nephew. Unlike other places with frequent staff changes, their consistent caregivers created a stable, caring environment, which really helped my boys feel secure. They loved fun activities like storytime and outdoor play, which helped them grow socially and physically. The center was clean, with healthy snacks and a solid routine. Their updates on my kids’ day were super helpful. Luv-n-Care got my boys ready for Pre-K, and I highly recommend them!

Thank you Luv and Care for your exceptional service! The staff were always incredibly friendly and loving, making my child feel right at home. Your warm and welcoming environment, along with your genuine care, has made a significant positive impact on our family. We truly appreciate all that you do and highly recommend Luv and Care Daycare to any parents looking for a nurturing and supportive place for their children.

I wish we had a better experience with this facility. We took a tour and It’s being forced into a daycare, as the restrooms are adult stalls not suitable for kids with doors that lock and adult toilets and sinks, there’s an auditorium with instruments a lot of chairs that they hold the kiddos in so there’s no structure and it’s unsafe. They have a few rooms but the kids are not separated they have the older kids with the little ones and it’s just very disorganized. We went to another facility and noticed such a huge difference. It’s not ready for kids yet there’s a lot of work needing to be done.

We are so grateful for this facility. It's clean, organized, professional, and we can trust that our daughter is in good hands. We get frequent updates, she gets plenty of attention, and they are ALWAYS accommodating of our requests regarding our most important and cherished gift. Thank you!

As an owner of my own learning center for over 10 years, I can say this center has everything you need for your child to be prepared and kindergarten ready. They have a warm and caring staff and an amazing owner who is committed to high quality education.

My daughter is 3y/o. She’s been at this daycare since November & has learned so much!! She’s learned her abc’s, how to write her name on paper, her colors IN spanish (which she was able to teach me lol), the months of the year, days of the week, counting more & more. I love that she’s been able to learn so much in such a short amount of time. I recommend this daycare for anyone looking for childcare!
The staff were very welcoming and genuinely care. I highly recommend to anyone looking for child care.

Carousel has been an absolute dream daycare for our baby. From our first impressions during the tour and every day since, we felt such a warm, loving energy from the staff. Ms. Yaz is soo loving, patient, and genuinely invested in my baby’s happiness and development. She spoils us daily with so many pictures and videos throughout the day! The director Mrs. Julie is transparent, supportive, and I can feel her love for all the kids beaming off of her!!
Another thing I love most is their commitment to serving healthy, plant-based meals. Seeing the daily pictures of the nutritious, thoughtfully prepared food every day gives me so much peace of mind.
Their curriculum is engaging, hands-on, and my girl is coming home DAILY singing circle time songs & showing us all the knowledge she’s gaining at daycare!
As a helicopter mom, Carousel has far exceeded our expectations. It’s a safe, nurturing place where children are encouraged to grow, explore, and be themselves. I’m incredibly grateful we stumbled upon this center and would recommend it wholeheartedly to any family looking for an amazing daycare.

We enrolled our daughter in Carousel at 6 months old. As a 1st time parent I was nervous but MrsJulie and her staff made me feel better. That 1st day I cried but quickly received photos, videos and messages about how well she was doing. Because of the care of her staff my daughter thrived and was soon on to solid food. Not only was she eating well but she was enjoying vegetables and still does. That alone is a great head start. She learned colors and numbers. She participated in every event and can’t home. Excited to show us her art and crafts. She learned to share and not hit due to the great teachers she had. What I really appreciate is that they make you feel welcomed and part of the daycare family. The staff looked after my child like their own and never hesitated to reach out if they noticed something like when she started teething. When my daughter did have a health issue that was ongoing for months, Mrs Julie & her staff were supportive, caring and helpful in trying to improve my daughter’s comfort. They shared advice and tips. My daughter is a healthy and thriving toddler with a great appetite and it’s particularly due to her getting great care at Carousel.

Carousel has been my family’s daycare for years, and we couldn’t be more grateful! We are truly blessed to have all of our kids attend. The staff is so loving, supportive, and genuinely cares for each child like their own.

One of the things we love most is that Carousel is 100% vegan, which gives us peace of mind knowing our kids are eating healthy, balanced meals every day. Every month they do show and tell and dress-up days, making learning fun and interactive for the little ones — our kids absolutely look forward to it!

Thank you, Mrs. Julie and the entire Carousel team, for being a true second home for our babies. We can’t imagine trusting anyone else with their care! 💕

My daughter has been enrolled with Carousel for over a year. I love how the staff truly put in their all for our babies to have fun and how they make learning exciting for them. Every month they have a theme around the curriculum for the kids. My daughter loves when they have show & tell days, pajama days and when she gets to dress up based off the month’s theme. I definitely recommend Carousel to anyone looking for a safe & loving place for their babies! ❤️

We love carousel so much, 7 years later we enrolled our last baby. Ms.Julie, ms.brianna, ms.brooks, all the staff are awesome. My babygirl loves going to school and enjoys all the yummy home-cooked meals. Couldn't be more grateful to find such an amazing daycare!!

Update: if you have a child who is quite and shy, chances are they will get left out of fun activities it seems like. My daughter has been over looked and left out of multiple activities (multiple school years) including a field trip and picture day.  I find it disappointing because she never gets in trouble and to be left out because she's quite and doesn't always speak up for herself is bs.

Trying to get someone to answer the phone is nearly impossible. My daughter has been going here for 3 yrs now and it's always been like this. So far most teachers have been great.
It is great that we have an IDEA school inside of the neighborhood (78741) now. I believe many children could benefit by going here! Great school.

Children need this special treatment for educational growth and Idea school can give this new start as a stepping stone for a child to grow learning not to be afraid to learn and be happy learning everyday.
They put this school right accross River Ridge (the mobile houses) and really close to it another school which was originally there. WHY!? DO THEY WANT TO CREATE DRAMA WITH TRAFFIC!?
Don't send your kids here unless you want them distracted by awful students that administration refuses to deal with.
It's 2025, don't do this University Baptist Church, use technology like the rest. Going up to people's cars at strange hours of the day on private property!? NOT OKAY

When our Church wasn't meeting in person because of COIVD in 2019, my family attended here instead. I knew we found a gold mine after we heard Pastor Norman's sermon. Expositional and faithful to God's word. He was new to the Church at the time and was still at the beginning stages of developing relationships. Even though he and the members of UBC knew that we were attending on a temporary basis, we were still welcomed. Although we are now back at our regular Church, Pastor David and I remain good friends and we see each other almost weekly.
Great people and great community.
Best kept secret in SA. Probably shouldn't post this...

OPERATION_NAME: Primrose School of Austin at Mueller
review_text: We absolutely love Primrose School of Austin at Mueller! The teachers are truly amazing—caring, patient, and dedicated to our child’s growth. The classroom ratios are small, which means our child gets plenty of individual attention and support. Every day at drop off, he is happy to see his teachers which further melts my heart. We especially appreciate the updates and photos we receive through the school’s app—it’s a great way to stay connected and see what he’s doing throughout the day. We couldn’t be happier with our experience here and are so grateful for the wonderful team at Primrose!

OPERATION_NAME: Primrose School of Austin at Mueller
review_text: Our daughter has been at Primrose Mueller for 3 months now and we love the little family we’ve made there! Her teachers in her first classroom, infant 1 were nothing short of amazing! We felt so cared for and our daughter was always happy with Ms. Brenda, Ms. Chrissie and Ms. Nae. We were a little nervous about her moving up to infant 2, but they’ve already proven to be just as wonderful. We receive thoughtful notes, and timely updates throughout the day. We’re all so thankful our baby girl is in such great hands!

OPERATION_NAME: Primrose School of Austin at Mueller
review_text: The staff has provided the best care for our little one. They document all incidents no matter how small and provide photo updates through the app. Our little one has learned so much in the past 6 months and loves attending Primrose.

OPERATION_NAME: Primrose School of Austin at Mueller
review_text: We've had a very positive experience at Primrose Mueller. All of the teachers and staff are friendly and genuinely seem to care, the facilities are clean and updated, and I've been impressed with the thoughtfulness of their lessons and activities. Our child actually looks forward to going to Primrose in the morning which is probably the most important consideration of all.

OPERATION_NAME: Primrose School of Austin at Mueller
review_text: We absolutely LOVED Primrose Mueller and were so sad to leave when we moved. The staff and teachers are so caring and constantly went above and beyond to make sure our daughter was thriving. A special shout-out to Ms. Dulce and Ms. Brittany in the infant classroom — they were always communicative, engaged our little one in activities that helped her grow and learn, and treated our baby with the same kind of attention and love as if she was part of their family. We are so thankful to the Primrose Mueller team for all that they’ve done for our family!

We’ve had a great experience with Kiddie Krafts. The teachers are caring, experienced, and great with the kids. The school is well-run, communication is clear, and everything feels thoughtfully planned. We’ve always felt confident and at ease sending our child there.

Kiddie Krafts Preschool has been the absolute best experience for my 3 year old and 1 year old. I love that the school implements the best of Montessori, Waldorf and Reggio-Emilia methods. Being an outdoor preschool give my kids a chance to be kids and learn through playing and exploring outside in addition to the classroom. Best of all, I know that my kids are loved by the teachers and staff the same way they are at home – it's like being part of a big family. The teachers and staff are always great at communicating and sharing photo updates each week, and there are so many opportunities for parents to be involved. My kids are excited to go to school every day. We love KKP!!

If you believe that there's no such thing as bad weather, only bad clothes, then this is the school for you! My child thrived at Kiddie Kraft (both the camps and the school) and so much of it was due to their nature-based program. She absolutely loved being outside and getting to participate in all the activities from the age of one through kinder. The skills they learn from being hands on are what children really need – not sitting a class for 6-8 hours a day. I originally put my child in the program for 1-2 days a week but quickly realized she was thriving so much while there that I moved her into the program full time and it was the best decision I ever made. My child also benefited from learning about all the different cultures they celebrate at the school. The teachers are all amazing and you'll be hard pressed to find a person as dedicated to your child's growth as Julie. Kiddie Kraft Preschool is a one in a million type of place that we feel lucky to have found and couldn’t be happier to be part of the KKP family!! Check it out, you won’t regret it!

We love Kiddie Krafts! My son is 3 and has a blast in their full time nature-based learning program. I love that the kids are constantly outside playing, exploring, and constantly flexing those creative muscles. The staff are so knowledgeable, friendly, and fast to respond through the daycare app.  We also love the camps that they have during the winter, spring, and summer as well; fire trucks, water sports, crazy times galore!

This school has been a DREAM for us! Our son started attending when he was 2 years old, and now he's in Pre-K and flourishing! I love that they spend a huge amount of time outside playing in nature. The curriculum is wonderful and provides great structure while also being child led learning. Julie, the teachers, and admin are so caring and truly love each individual child. I can't recommend this school enough! ❤️

Now that my children no longer attend this daycare, I feel comfortable sharing my honest review.

While there are some staff members we genuinely appreciated and our kids made meaningful connections, the overall experience was deeply troubling.

The biggest issue was safety and supervision. Our 14-month-old had seven separate incidents in just 6–8 weeks, including a severe head injury from hitting a bookshelf that left a permanent mark. In some weeks, she was hurt multiple times just days apart.

She was also bitten multiple times by the same child, including one bite that broke the skin. When we addressed this with the assistant director, our concerns were downplayed, and we were told it was “to be expected.” Despite multiple children being injured by the same child, that child was never removed, which made us feel financial gain was prioritized over safety.

One morning, we dropped her off at 7 a.m., and by 9 a.m., she had been physically attacked by another child, coming home with scratches on her face.

Our 3-year-old, who was nearly potty trained, was sent in underwear but often came home in pull-ups — despite clear communication that he didn’t need them. He also came home upset, saying another child had hit or pushed him. Staff told us he “fell,” even when we witnessed another child push him ourselves.

We raised concerns about the dangerous bookshelf and other hazards. Temporary fixes, like rubber bumpers, were put in place but not maintained.

For a daycare charging $2,000/month, this level of care is unacceptable. Despite repeated conversations, no meaningful changes were made. We ultimately left because we no longer felt our children were safe here.

I have had my 3 children in a variety of child care centers across 3 different states. For my children, knowing they are comfortable in a place is my utmost priority and I measure that with the joy they show in the morning upon arrival and the sometimes disappointment they experience when they are picked up. Most importantly, I love the individual feedback on my child I hear from teachers and staff.
My daughter has speech delay and gets overwhelmed in large groups so after much deliberation on a facility, I held my breath when she was enrolled here. I have had to remove all 3 of my children from places that did not treat them with respect, and gave my daughter time to adjust and soaked in the vibe of the staff and students alike. I am SO pleased on how they have genuinely loved her. This place is a "diamond in the rough" for me so don't pass it by. Special shout out to Ms. Anna for the love she radiates in this center and Ms. Amber who my daughter adores!

My children went to Little Tykes for a little over 6 months, and I can say we had a great experience here from the first day.  All the teachers there are great very nice, my kids really liked their teachers .Ms. Harris was my daughter's teacher and she absolutely LOVED her she would always talk about what Ms. Harris was teaching her and would come home will all kinds of arts and crafts, Mrs. Anna always greeted us so kindly every morning and addressed any questions or concerns I had.  There was another teacher that was there near closing time I can't seem to remember her name (I'm so sorry ill probably remember after submitting this review) long curly soft orange-ish brownish hair she was very nice and would joke around with the kids as they were leaving. Overall, we had a great experience and if it weren't for having to move away we wouldn't have left, thank you Little Tykes!

Little Tyke has great staff and great activities. My son has been there for 6 months (he is now 15 months old) and he has developed socially and physically as a toddler. He can stack blocks, play and be full of fun. His teachers update us everyday and provide great care from: weekly activities, playing stations and a clean environment. He has yet to show fear or crying when he goes, so I know he enjoys this daycare and his teachers. And when we drop him off he is ready to play with his little friends, such a great place!

My baby have been attending this school for 6 months an the director was wonderful at first. Ms Anna expressed concern about turnover recently which became noticeable due to the lack of structure in the school. When picking up our 12 month old on thursday 3/31 an my daughters left cheek had about 8 scratches . I addressed it with the director the next morning . Upon picking up my daughter on Friday evening, the other side of her face was all scratched up. I addressed it again with the director at that moment . I was told that its normal for kids this age to scratch & bite . I contacted corporate an was advised that the owner would call me back the next day . Ive not received a call from anyone. I removed my child from this school an im extremely disappointed with the lack of concern little tykes has shown to my child..

Father Alejandro Montes has always treat us with love and respect.Thank you, padre Alejandro for all what you have done for my mom.

The leadership is also diverse and working hard to offer a lot of activities. If you are looking for a church, check this one out at 10:00 Sunday morning. They have a good website online too.
I attended as regularly as I can now.

I highly recommend it even if you haven't been a regular church attender for a while. Grace Episcopal will make you feel welcome. You'll be glad you came.

I can only speak to the school part of Grace, but it is fantastic. Great staff who really love the kids. Learning seemed to happen pretty organically and the kids seem to really love going there and love their teachers.

review_text: The review below was in reference to the program that previously occupied the building.  Since taking over operation, we have received wonderful feedback from parents about the care their children are receiving and the amazing teachers working at the school.

OPERATION_NAME: University of Texas Child Dev Center
review_text: So far, really great experience and my child is happy, excited to go to 'school', excited about learning, and has not had any complaints.

My daughter attended here from right before her 2nd birthday till she was 12 and she received nothing but love and the best care. Later my grandson attended and it was the same experience. Now my niece is on her way there as a 8 week old and I have no concerns that this experience will be any different. All the teachers are A1 and provide the best of care and attention to all the children.

This daycare has seen my boys grow up and have demonstrated lots of love for them. They have helped them learn and grow in so many ways, they have seen them spread their wings I don’t have them in daycare anymore they all go to school but they still love to go and visit their daycare teachers…

Posting for my friend, this daycare should be out of the question if you want your child to be treated with care and love. Please reconsider going somewhere else. You should have peace of mind knowing you are working and your child is actually being taken care of. 0/10 DO NOT RECOMMEND. This place doesn’t even deserve one star!

Rocks in my autistic child's dirty diaper because the playground is nothing but rocks. My son crying everyday because the teachers were on the phone instead of handing situations between kids. The best thing about this daycare is the day they told us they couldn't handle my autistic child. My children are happier and better since leaving this place.

DO NOT take your child here if you seek honest and professional treatment. Someone should call CPS on this daycare. Shut it down.
A lot of very sketchy and dangerous things happen here. DO NOT BRING YOUR CHILD HERE.
Children left in buses after pick up for hours alone.

Our infant son has been attending this Stepping Stone location since the end of my maternity leave 5 months ago. It's clear from his interactions with the caregivers—especially Miss Barbara and Miss Bella—that he feels loved, happy, and safe around them. The front office staff (Jessica and Simone) are also familiar with all the children and families they serve. They always greet us with big smiles and give a friendly sendoff. Simone in particular gave us frequent check-ins during our child's first week of starting daycare that made the transition feel less stressful.

The staff have been so helpful with our son's developmental changes, like his transition to eating solid foods. He's been introduced to a variety of food through the lunches and snacks that the school offers.

The teachers are always communicative, and we love receiving photos and videos of our little one throughout the work day on the Tadpoles app. The art projects that the teachers do with the babies are so cute, too.

As a first-time parent, knowing that everyone at Stepping Stone School is part of our child-rearing village has made me feel more confident in and at ease with being a working mom. I know my baby boy is in excellent hands!

Ms. Jeanne and Ms. Laura are amazing with my now 5 month old son! As a first time mom, I had so much anxiety about daycare. But these two teachers really made me feel more confident and comfortable. You can tell they truly care and have been so helpful! My son enjoys his time there. I always look forward to taking home his artwork they do in class and the tadpoles pictures from his school activities. All the other staff has been super friendly too every time I walk through. Ms. Lisa, among many others, who just always greet us with smiles and say hi to my son by name.

I have transferred my 4 yr old daughter at least 3 times and I am not moving her again until she goes to big girl school!
Jessica is the most heart felt, amazing, and really cool director :)
My daughter has a free spirit and sometimes doesn't like to be told to sit in one place, yet.
Her teachers have found a beautiful way to let her be free and also be disciplined to learn in class!
I haven't heard my baby talked this much in a long time, she is learning so much with Miss Sapna!  and I am happy to say if she is having a bad day, her teachers always find a way to make her feel better :)
5 stars to Stepping Stone School

Stepping stone has been wonderful! My oldest son has been attending for the past year, and he is learning so much! His teachers (Sapna and Sydney) are very engaged and share pictures/videos of their activities throughout the day.

It was an easy decision to enroll my second son in the infant classroom! Jeanne, Khadijah, and Barbara have been with him for the past 4 months and he has a big smile every day I drop him off!

The principal, Jessica, and assistant principal, Samone, have been lovely and helpful!

We really like the staff and teachers. The principal Jessica and Shannon they both are super nice to talk too.My elder one is in technologist classroom where Ms Divya teaches them. She is taking good care of him and my son is super happy with her. My younger one goes to infant classroom where his teachers ( Ms Jenny and Ms Barbara) are also very caring and attentive. My husband and I are supper happy and satisfied with the school.

I love this daycare, my son has been going here since he was 4 months he’s now 1. The routine that they’ve set has helped me a lot at home. He’s learned how to crawl, eat is now walking with the support of the amazing staff at the facility. It’s always clean, everyone is always happy and my baby loves going.

My 3 year old daughter has Autism she is nonverbal, I was so nervous about putting her in daycare. I initially wanted a daycare where I could watch her on camera, But I can truly say she loves her daycare! Ms Shonda the owner is the best she is so kind and patient with her she takes her time to understand her. The other ladies are nice also my daughter has been going here for 10 months now and I can rest during the day because of these ladies. My daughter is a very picky eater they accommodate her with the food/snacks/juice  that she only wants to eat & drink. I have two older daughters that are teenagers now who attended this daycare as well when they were 2&3. If you are looking for a daycare this one is #1 in my books.

Loved the staff, they were very accommodating with the tuition and  they took walk Ins with no problem.Treated my children very nicely.
My 2yr old son was pushed down by a another (unknown child by me but known to them) and his front tooth became loose from the fall. The teacher admitted she saw it happen in person.Not only did they not write a report they refused to inform the parents of the child that harmed my child so I could at least talk to them or they know. Lucky for us I called the dental office and they stayed open past hours and waited for us to get there."Blessed Dental". They discounted me and the charges came out to only $50 so I let it go and payed my last week of tuition in full on the due date even though my child did not go for any of those days.I kept my agreement (hope I can be a good example to someone)but I was most upset that the Owner wouldn't talk to me nor see me for a meeting and her close morning helper/cook who I always talk too would not even do the right thing(In the past she asked me to talk to CPS and let them know my good experiences here and I gladly did it to help). No incident report people make mistakes or forget (forgivable)not informing parents about their child accidentally hurting another child and they might be liable is unprofessional and could lead to bigger charges in the future. Theses are children..."You can't do nothing" I would prefer to know/try to fix any situation if my kid hurts someone "possible"  before being served and summoned to court randomly while I'm at work or home.
That's my experience with this Daycare.
They are greay with my kid!! Love the staff!!

We cannot recommend Trina and her entire team at Amazon Jungle Learning Center enough. Our family recently had to move, and one of the saddest parts of leaving was saying goodbye to this wonderful center.
​From our very first day, Trina and the staff were incredibly kind, patient, and showed so much genuine love for our girls and our whole family.
​One of the things I valued most was their communication. The team was always clear, prompt, and kept us wonderfully informed, which gave us such peace of mind.
​We will greatly miss everyone at Amazon Jungle Learning Center. They set a very high bar for childcare, and any family would be lucky to be apart of this center.
Very professional, Trina is well experienced and has the most amazing staff. She’ll work with you. I highly recommend this day care. Feel free to check for yourself.

I've been bringing my son here for a year and we both love it! Ms.Trina and her teachers are sweet  and amazing. My son has learned a lot his time here. It's a safe, fun and clean place to bring your kiddos.
I love this daycare! Ms. Trina is absolutely amazing and patient. My 2 year old is EXCITED to go to daycare and play with his friends everyday! The daycare is clean and safe too.
Called to find out pricing and about programs. The lady who answered the phone was rude. She Sounded annoyed to even take the call. Immediate turn off to even try to schedule a tour!

We’re not active raters, but anyone who’s says differently than 5 stars hasn’t spent anytime with this school. They love the kids and the kids love school. One of the best experiences me and the spouse have had with any childcare or teachers.

Our son was at Kipling between ages of 12 months-28 months. We had a good experience and loved his teachers. Our son warmed up to daycare after few weeks and it was really fun to see him start to get more independent. He cried the first couple weeks -- it's normal. By the end, he was running happily into the building and leading the charge up the stairs to his classroom.

They have lots of outdoors time and keep a water cooler for the kids at playtime - loved that. They have cute celebrations around holidays. The admin seems super involved. Nice place!
Facility is top notch. Teachers are beyond wonderful - shoutout Ocean Room! Our child has shown great progress and is always happy when I pick him up. 10/10 would recommend.

We had a great experience at the Kipling Street Academy. Incredible teachers, clean school and wonderful families. I feel that rating the school a "1" based on the fact that you're waitlisted and didn't get in isn't really fair. It certainly is a fair watch out for the school to know, but it would seem more important to give feedback on the school itself. When you get into applying to private schools, you'll likely have your fair share of schools that you'll give a deposit to and unfortunately won't see the money back.

Our son attended Kipling Street Academy from the ages of 14 months to 2 years. We absolutely loved our experience. We only changed care providers because we moved and even then we kept him at Kipling as long as we could. Our teachers were qualified, caring and created a rich learning environment for our son. While attending Kipling, his language exploded. At 2, he’s able to repeat and understand almost any simple word and construct short sentences. He can count independently to 8. He learned some ASL (which is so useful when communicating with young children) and Spanish. Kipling even assisted with initiating potty training! Our son has great focus when completing tasks. We are just amazed by our son’s development at just 2 years old and know that we have his time at Kipling to thank for that.

The school has reasonable and well communicated policies. Food provided by the school was approachable, interesting and nutritious. Administration was accommodating and assisted with delivering medications when that was necessary.

Can say enough good things about KSA! Wish we could have attended for longer. Thank you for nurturing our little!

Kipling St., Academy is a great school !!  Our son  absolutely loves his teachers, Mayra and Kristen, and so do we. He’s made tremendous progress in the short time he’s been there. We couldn’t be happier with the quality education and attention our son receives every day. I would highly recommend this school.

As first-time daycare parents (our older two were always with family), we were incredibly nervous about leaving our 3-month-old with people we didn’t know. But this experience has been nothing short of amazing. From the very beginning, the level of communication and care blew us away. We receive updates for every feeding, diaper change, and even adorable photos throughout the day.

Our son is absolutely thriving here. He always greets drop-off and pick-up with the biggest smiles, which gives us so much peace of mind. I’ve even picked him up early a few times just to see how he’s doing — and every time, I’ve been reassured by how happy and well cared for he is.

Ms. Cassie, the director, is phenomenal. She’s incredibly attentive, not just with the kids, but also with her staff. She’s a truly hands-on leader, and it shows in the warm, nurturing environment she’s created. We’re so grateful to have found this place!

The staff at this location is wonderful ...they are truly concerned with issues and issues are addressed and resolved ..Its hard to find a place to trust with our little ones but I can honestly say I know my kid is in good hands...thanks Emerald Forest Staff you are greatly appreciated

We loved going to the Emerald Wood Kindercare! As a first time mom, putting our son in daycare at 3 months was scary. We instantly felt welcomed and felt our son was safe at school. It was easy to build trust with his teachers. Even teachers that did not directly work with our son, seemed to care about him so much and always greeted him with a smile and excitement. He got to play all day, and the days were embedded with natural learning opportunities and activities,  even for infants and toddlers! He learned so much there, we always called it school versus daycare. I have to brag about the app, it was so easy to use and the teachers were the best about sending updates and pictures everyday. Turn over can be typical in early childhood care but any time our son did get a new teacher, we loved them. He had many of the same teachers there with him for a year and a half, as well as the same little buddies! It was hard to leave when we had to move when he was 1.5 years old. We'll always be so grateful for the care given and remember Miss Cassie, his teachers and little buddies that helped shape his early months.

- JP's mom & dad

My daughter started here at 3 months, and we kept her here till she was about 1 and a half. Our general experience was pretty aweful, but I do want to put in here that there are some wonderful teachers here who truly care! I wish my daughter could have just stayed in the care of Miss Laura or Miss Jeniffer, or a few other teachers who left KC during our time there. There was an extremely high turnover rate, and many teachers who we really liked that came and went. Towards the end of our time here, though, I didn't even feel that my daughter was safe, much less tended to with love and kindness. The place is constantly short staffed and under legal ratios, the teachers are all overworked and many of them are grumpy, overly defensive, and indifferent to the individual needs of the children in their care. My daughter suffered almost constant diaper rashes while there, like raw and bloody, and it was a battle getting them to use her rash cream or even the diapers and wipes that I supplied for them. She came home almost everyday extremely dehydrated, hungry, and exhausted. Towards the end she would cry and try to hide under bed when I told her it was time to go to school. She was bit 5 times in her last month there, and she even came home one day with large bloody gashes down the back of her neck. When we took a picture and sent it to them asking what happened and why there was no incident report, they clearly hadn't even known about it. She frequently came home with fingerprint shaped bruises on her arms. I understand that children bite and scratch and accidents happen, but it was clear that there was gross negligence going on. At her new daycare, for contrast, she has come home a little beat up twice in 2 months, and each time there was an incident report with pictures explaining she fell off a swing or got a papercut while painting. There is a kindercare app where parents are supposed to get updates about things like food, diapers, and incidents. It is not actually utilized by the teachers though. They do not tell you what foods they're feeding your child, and even when my daughter had a medical issue and I told them I needed to know exact details about her diet, they only occasionally gave me the info I needed. At one point, my daughter was very successfully using her potty at home every time for a about a week. I told her teacher and asked that they try to offer her the potty at school. That evening when my daughter came home, when I offered her the potty like normal she fell on the floor crying and to this day she is scared of bathrooms. I dont know what happened at daycare but clearly i never should have said anything. Because the director always became very irate and defensive whenever we brought up issues that ought to be simple, we were a little afraid to tell her when we were leaving the daycare. When we did, 2 weeks before my daughter's last paid day there, she became irate like usual and told my husband, "well don't think you can get out of paying for anything." We were glad we waited to tell her. We sent the official notice of leaving a bit later then we verbally told them, and now I'm getting calls for bogus payment due to KinderCare. I don't owe them anything and wish I could take back all the horrible time we were there. My daughter thrives at her new daycare, and the contrast confirms to me how bad it was at KinderCare Emerald Wood.

Ms.Cassie and Gailia are awesome and have been a big help these last several years my children attended KinderCare. Ms. Cassie is always in communication when it comes to the center and to my children. She and staff go out of their way to make sure all children are safe and are having a great learning experience.

We love this school for our toddler! His teachers have been fantastic, especially Ms Vanessa, Ms Ixel, Ms Christina, and Ms Hina. We are so grateful for the patience, thoughtfulness, and effort they put into caring for our little one. Switching to a Montessori school has been such a benefit for both him and us. It’s not just about using different materials or taking a slower approach, it is about shifting how you and your child interact with one another and the world around you. Fostering our son’s independence and giving him more responsibilities both in the classroom and at home has allowed him to blossom in so many ways. People say toddler parenting is tough, but this school, this approach, and especially these teachers have made it so enjoyable for us.

I couldn't be happier with our experience. The individualized Montessori approach allows my child to explore their interests at their own pace, fostering a genuine love for learning. The teachers are dedicated and nurturing, guiding without imposing, which has built my child's confidence and critical thinking skills.

The sense of community is wonderful, with open communication between parents and teachers. My child has formed great friendships and learned essential values like empathy and responsibility. Overall, guidepost @ Beecave provides a nurturing and enriching environment that sets the foundation for a lifetime of learning. I highly recommend it to any parent seeking a holistic education for their child!

We have had a wonderful experience at Guidepost Montessori in Bee Cave and would highly recommend to anyone! Before Guidepost, we had been to 3 other daycares and no other school compares in terms of the quality of the staff, care, education, cleanliness and the happiness of our children. Our two children have attended the Nido (Infant), Toddler and Children's House programs and have absolutely thrived in the Montessori-based curriculum. Ms. Christine, Ms. Ixel, and Ms. Hina have all been wonderful guides for our children in helping them to learn new skills, reach developmental milestones, and provide loving and attentive care. We can't say enough positive things about Guidepost!

We love Guidepost Montessori at Bee Cave!  The school does a wonderful job of engaging both the children and the parents.  We see the progress our son is making in Ms. Angelica's class, both educationally and socially.  The curriculum is very thoughtfully designed and incorporates a lot of outdoor and nature themes.  The staff is communicative and friendly.  We adore Ms. Angelica and Ms. Madelyn!!! The school has settled into a great rhythm that allows our family to enjoy the school experience with very little stress and a lot of excitement.

Both of my children have thrived at Guidepost Montessori Bee Cave. The staff are all incredibly caring, kind, responsible, and skilled educators, tailoring education to each child’s individual needs. My kids have grown tremendously under the care of Ms. Angelica, Ms. Madelyn, and Ms. Jessica in the Children’s House classes and Ms. Shanise in Toddler class. My son is now thriving in kindergarten, a lot of which I attribute to the guidance he received at Guidepost Bee Cave. The leadership, Mr. Mike (head of school) and Ms. Nakita (assistant head of school), are always very helpful and responsive. Everyone at this school truly cares about your kids and your family. I am very thankful for this community!

Very great daycare! My niece and nephew attended this daycare many years ago, and now I have my own children and I decided to choose this daycare for them! All of the staff are welcoming and nice! Ms. Beverly, the director is amazing and Ms. Tina is awesome as well! My kids are happy to go to daycare to see their friends and teachers. Very clean, well organized school. My son has autism and they’re very patient with him and never single him out, huge thank you to them!! 10/10!!

I’ve been connected to this daycare for several years now, with two of my older grandchildren having attended in the past and two of my younger grandchildren currently enrolled. Over time, I’ve seen notable improvements in both the environment and the level of care. It’s clear that the daycare has grown and made strides in creating a more positive and enriching space for children.

While it may not be perfect, I genuinely believe it's a good daycare with many strengths. The caregivers are kind and attentive, and the children seem happy, safe, and engaged. The facility has continued to improve, and I appreciate the effort that’s been made to evolve over the years.

Based on my ongoing experience, I would absolutely recommend this daycare to anyone looking for  child care.

Kreative kids academy is the best day care I seen so far. Very clean and neat every classroom is organized and the teachers are so sweet. Kids got engaged with activities and whenever i pick them up they are happy.My 3 kids been here the past two years and are still there. I definitely recommend parents who are looking for a daycare.

We are so grateful for the time our son has spent at this wonderful preschool from day one, the staff made us feel like family. Every teacher was incredibly kind and treated our son with the same love and care they would give their own.

The environment is filled with warmth, compassion, and genuine dedication. Our son thrived here, and we always felt at ease knowing he was in such caring hands.

Thank you to the entire team.We truly  love ❤️ it here!!!

Kreative Kids Academy has been a true blessing for our family, and we can’t say enough great things about this amazing center especially the wonderful Ms. Beverly!

From the moment we met Ms. Beverly, we knew our child would be in loving, capable hands. She is the heart of Kreative Kids Academy warm, nurturing, and full of positive energy that radiates throughout the center. She greets every child with a smile and treats each one like they’re her own. You can tell she truly loves what she does, and it shows in how the children respond to her.

Ms. Beverly has a natural gift for connecting with kids. She’s patient, kind, and always willing to go the extra mile to make sure every child feels safe, happy, and supported. Whether she’s leading activities, helping with transitions, or simply giving a comforting hug, she brings so much joy and care to each day.
The environment at Kreative Kids Academy is organized and filled with fun and learning. As a parent, it’s incredibly reassuring to know that your child is surrounded by people who truly care.
We are so thankful for Ms. Beverly and all she brings to Kreative Kids Academy. If you’re looking for a daycare with heart, dedication, and an amazing team—this is the place!

Before attending Holy Word, our daughter was at a different daycare where we constantly felt stressed—she was sick all the time, and the staff seemed to change every month. We honestly didn’t know how good it could be until we came to Holy Word.

Here, we found peace sending both of our children each day, and we’ve also gained an incredible community of friends in the parents and staff. This is not just a place to drop your kids off—every teacher genuinely cares and puts so much time, energy, and heart into making each day fun, safe, and educational.

We are thankful for Holy Word every single day.

When we had our first kid 3 years ago, we were on the fence about sending them so young to daycare vs doing a nanny share. Since then, we've had no regrets due to the great care, learning and faith environment that Holy Word fosters. Its been a great experience and the newest member of our family also now attends. Highly recommend and the price point is also well worth it. Shout out to the Holy Word teachers because they rock!!!!

I’m not a member of Holy Word Church, but my daughter attends their daycare in the Toucans group, and I’ve been absolutely blown away by the quality of care and educations she is receiving!

Her teacher, Mrs. Yessie, and the other staff are wonderful. My daughter adores them, and every time I visit, the children are clearly engaged, happy, and well-supervised. The daycare also shares photos and updates throughout the day on the Brightwheel app, which is a pleasant way to stay connected to what they are doing!

I especially appreciate that they follow the HighScope educational philosophy, which encourages kids to plan, do, and review through hands-on, active learning rather than direct instruction. It’s a fantastic approach, and most importantly, my daughter truly enjoys it.

Overall, I couldn’t be more impressed or grateful. Highly recommend Holy Word’s daycare!

We toured and interviewed an embarrassing amount of schools before deciding to take our daughter to Holy Word. I was convinced that we were looking for the best combination of sterility and safety in a school, and nothing else. While Holy Word has the best parts of those things, what it really feels like is home. In no other visit did we find all of the kids, teachers, and parents all smiling and happy. 3 years in, and nothing has changed. It’s the best decision we’ve made for our family and I’d highly recommend anyone searching for values-based development and learning to take a look.

Our son loved his time at Holy Word! His teachers were so loving and encouraging. He met friends that he still stays in touch with. As parents, we loved our time at Holy Word because it had such a welcoming, family atmosphere and his teachers were very caring. They made sure to communicate with us and we knew he was in great hands every day!

Mother Theresa Daycare is one of the best daycare I have see in a very long time. The owner is so nurturing and cares for not only the children, but her staff as well. She is always going above and beyond for the children and the business has always stayed clean. My granddaughter loves it there!
My child has been attending this daycare for the past 2yrs and never has she complained about being in this welcoming environment. Thank you for your kindness!

Mother Theresa Daycare is one of the best daycares — I highly recommend it!
I enrolled my son when he was 8 months old, and now he’s 7. Like any daycare, they have their rules and consistently remind you of them. They follow set schedules for meals/breakfast and for taking the children to school.

They also celebrate the children’s birthdays and always keep them engaged with fun activities.

My daughter started attending the daycare at just 2 months old, and now she’s 2 years old. She already knows her ABCs and numbers 1–10 in both English and Spanish!

It’s such a joy to see them walk in happy and dancing — it shows me they enjoy being there and feel safe.

Thank you, Ms. Chantal and all the staff! 🫶

I don’t know how this daycare has a 4.4 review. If I could give a 0 review I would. I’m speaking for my mother in law since she doesn’t know English. My brother in law has been coming to this daycare for 3 years. Ms. Chantal is very rude and unprofessional. As an owner of a daycare you are responsible for feeding and caring for the children that go there. As parents we trust that our children are being taken care of. Well not here. They don’t feed the kids breakfast because according to Ms. Chantal they need to eat at school. Also, schoolers need to be there by 6:30 am. If they’re a minute late she will NOT take them even though she leaves to drop them off at 7:30. They AC, she turns it off. What kind of daycare is this? Ms. Chantal please be more professional because I promise you if you keep treating families this way you will no longer have a daycare.
Very good daycare, love the teachers and how they make the environment feel safe .

We have loved our time at Ridgewood. The teachers, staff, and director truly care about the children. My child came home saying she was happy and wanted to stay at school! They also have fun events throughout the year such as a petting zoo, splash day, and a gallery art night. Lots of hands on learning and a sweet community!

We’ve been at Ridgewood Park Preschool for 2 years and absolutely love it! The most caring staff and teachers, great activities and schedule, daily communication, lots of learning, playing, and socialization. I know both my girls will be so sad when they “graduate” the program.
Great Teachers!!!

review_text: My daughter has been going here for over 2 years. She has made tremendous strides in speech, counting and more importantly interacting with other children her age. Worst center my baby got into any beds and had bumps all over her and nobody in the staff wanted to explain what happen to her

My son has been attending Stepping Stone Northcross for two years, and as a first-time mom, the transition has been seamless thanks to the incredible support from the staff.

The attention, care, and warmth provided by Principal Mrs. Connie and the teachers have made a significant impact on both my son and me. I feel at ease dropping him off everyday, knowing that the staff are friendly and kind.

As a working and single mom, I am amazed at how much this school has helped my son develop. He is advanced compared to his peers, and I truly could not have achieved this alone.

The school has tailored a curriculum that fosters his growth and advancement in extraordinary ways. I am forever grateful for their support and would recommend this location to anyone I know.

We love Stepping Stone Northcross! One of our favorite things is the small campus size; it truly feels like a close-knit family. The children know each other well, get along beautifully, and there’s a genuine sense of community that the staff intentionally fosters.

We really appreciate the balanced approach to learning: a thoughtful curriculum that prepares kids for kindergarten, plenty of class play, and a strong emphasis on social-emotional development. It feels developmentally appropriate and well-rounded.

The staff are consistently caring, attentive, and considerate of each child’s individual needs, which means so much to us as parents. We’ve tried a larger campus before, and while it worked for some families, the smaller setting here has been a much better fit for our child. We have been at this campus for about 3 years now.

Overall, they are doing an amazing job, and we’re so grateful to be part of this community. Highly recommend.

We have had such a great experience with Stepping Stone Northcross! Our kiddo started in late spring/early summer 2025 and although I was a nervous first time mom putting my little 2mo in daycare, Connie's warmth and expertise really put us at ease. My kid loves the teachers, especially Miss Yolette and Miss Alondra, and has big smiles for them in the mornings at drop off.
