We’ve had a great experience at Primrose Park Cities. The communication from the staff is terrific, and our child is genuinely happy and excited to go each day. It’s been a wonderful environment for learning and growth.

As a parent who has entrusted Primrose Park Cities with the care of my children for 4.5 years, I wanted to share an honest review of our experience.

Pros:
• Reliable Hours: One of the biggest advantages of Primrose is its availability. They are open almost every weekday of the year, from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM, which is a huge help for working parents.
• Dedicated Teachers: We were fortunate to have had several teachers who truly cared for and connected with our children. Special thanks to Princese, Keyla, Yeny, Nemi, Rose, and Margaret.
• Educational Activities & Socialization: The school offers a structured environment with engaging activities that promote learning.
• Wonderful Community: We met many wonderful families through the school, some of whom have become our close friends.

Cons:
• Staffing Ratios: We regularly observed classrooms that did not reflect the advertised teacher-to-child ratios. Seeing one teacher managing 12+ toddlers was not uncommon, and though management cited issues like tardiness or illness, this was a repeated issue that remained unresolved throughout our time there.
• High Turnover: Turnover is common in the childcare industry, but it was particularly noticeable at Primrose Park Cities. Staff and leadership turnover was a recurring challenge. In 4.5 years, we saw four different school directors, and our child's Preschool Pathways Plus classroom had four or more teacher changes within just a few months, which affected continuity and stability.
• Communication Challenges: In August 2024, our son transitioned to a new class, where most children were not potty trained. The classroom had no changing table — only toilets. Children were changed while lying on the floor or standing. Despite teacher concerns and multiple emails to the school’s director, it took three months to have a changing table installed. The director citied corporate approval was needed for a changing table. If this was the case, the children shouldn’t have been moved to a more advanced classroom.
• Inconsistent Teacher Quality: While there are outstanding teachers at Primrose, we also encountered a few who lacked a positive attitude, raised their voices at children, and seemed disengaged.

Overall, our experience at Primrose Park Cities was mixed. There are many positives, especially in terms of community, structure, and certain dedicated teachers. However, persistent concerns around staffing, turnover, communication, and leadership consistency ultimately impacted our confidence in the program.

We absolutely LOVE Primrose Park Cities!  Since day 1, we have felt confident as first time parents leaving our child in their care. We don't know what we would do without this school and the amazing people that work there!

Choosing a daycare is one of the most important decisions a parent can make—and I can say with complete confidence that enrolling our child at Bent Tree Day School was the best choice we’ve ever made. This place is truly exceptional, and a huge part of that is because of the incredible leadership of the director, Ms. Beard.

From day one, Ms. Beard has gone above and beyond to create a safe, nurturing, and enriching environment for every child who walks through the door.
Ms. Beard has a unique gift for making both parents and children feel seen, heard, and valued. She leads with compassion, strength, and professionalism. It’s clear that she cares deeply about her students and her team, and she works tirelessly to ensure the center runs smoothly and joyfully.
It’s rare to find a daycare that feels like both a classroom and a second home—but Ms. Beard and her team have created exactly that. We’re so thankful to be part of this community, and we can’t recommend Bent Tree Day School enough!

If I could give 10 stars, I absolutely would! I will start with the director, Ms. Beard. During my daycare center search, she won me over on the very first day with her transparency about what to expect and her genuine passion for the well-being of the children in their care. My daughter, who was 3 years old when she enrolled, has now been attending for a year, and our experience has been nothing short of awesome. I continue to feel completely comfortable dropping her off each day. When choosing a center, staff and teacher turnover was a major concern for me. At Bent Tree Day School, not only has the staff remained consistent, but they show up—day after day—with great energy for the kids. Their presence and reliability have truly stood out. My daughter loves her time at Bent Tree and in her words, she says “I love my school.”  She comes home excited about her “little homework” each week and is usually happy to share what new things she’s learned. I appreciate that the environment mirrors what she will experience in primary school. The structure, the learning approach, and the expectations all make me confident that she’ll be well-prepared for kindergarten when the time comes. Her teacher, Ms. Jamie, has been wonderful. She has the perfect balance between passion and assertiveness—she is super invested in the kids’ learning and growth, while also being able to gently remind them that they are capable of learning, even hard things. Lastly, I want to highlight something especially important to me: no matter what time of day I arrive—whether it's early or unexpected—I have never seen or heard anything that made me feel uncomfortable or uncertain about leaving my daughter in their care. That level of trust means everything to me. Hope this review helps anyone looking!

I was a student at this school from 1989-1993 (K-3, before we moved out of state). I attended the Oakdale campus for kindergarten, and the Rosedale campus for grades 1-3. I have many fond memories, especially of the teachers at Rosedale. They allowed us to learn at our own pace, and gave us extra challenges when we requested them. They also taught us to manage our time and assignments for the week. They taught me some valuable household skills as well! (Fridays were cleaning days.) I remember loving the regular trips to the library and the gymnastics studio, and the monthly trip to the Natural History Museum - I remember looking at mummies, and petting hissing cockroaches while the museum leader held a baby crocodile. I must have read every book in the school's own library - the teachers were always encouraging me to read, though sometimes they had to remind me that I had to practice my spelling and math as well! I even remember asking for homework, which I had heard about from kids at other schools. (We did not have either homework or grades.) The lead teacher therefore came up with a homework book of math problems for me. We learned Spanish, botany, geography - they basically introduced us to all the different areas of learning, and encouraged our curiosity. The teachers were very kind and loving. Even today I can remember all their names and faces, and I'm 23. (They were Mrs. Kirkiedee, Ms. Reid, Yolanda Barker, and Miss Marie-Nelly.) I even invited one of them to my seventh birthday party, I loved her so much. When I moved out of state, the founder of the school, Miss Marge, gave me a pinata in the shape of a triceratops because she knew I loved dinosaurs. I also enjoyed attending year-round. This school made sure my early experiences of school were exciting and pleasant, setting a pattern of loving school that has continued to this day. When I have children, I will be sending them to Montessori. I greatly love this school.

After going and looking at all of these schools, there’s only so many questions to be asked and only so much information to review. At the end of the day, we had to go by which school had a good ‘feeling’. Did the kids seem happy? Did the teachers seem positive and sane? As much as the program or approach or schedule matters, I am pretty sure that small kids are soaking up the environment and culture as much as information or social skills.

Point is, we are very happy with this school. I’ve had my 4yr old there since he was 2, and my younger son (2yrs) has been there for a year. (Rosedale house).  My kids are happy going there and the Montessori approach works well with how we, ourselves, teach our kids. They get good outdoor time. The Montessori method gives a clear development path. The ‘culture’ of the teachers and kids is kind and not threatening.

I think they’re the best out there. That’s not to say perfect. Here are the warts as far as I can see them:

•	I’ve seen better schedules. They say they’re on the HISD time off schedule….which is true, but in addition to HISD days off they’ve got a bunch of additional days they’re closed, which has burnt up a chunk of our days off from work.

•	They’re not cheap. Although I wouldn’t go so far as to say they overcharge. It may be that you get what you pay for….but… ouch.

•	I have seen some turnover in the teachers. I saw an earlier review to that effect and I concur– although I don’t know what normal turnover is for this kind of job (I would last approximately 4.8 hours). However, I would balance that statement with noting that the new teachers they have hired are all as fantastic and positive as the previous ones, which frankly, more important to me than the continuity that my boys would ideally experience.

Hope that helps.

Our toddler has been attending Northwood Montessori for the last 8 months, and it has been a wonderful experience! All of the staff are patient, respectful, and knowledgeable, and we have seen such growth since she has started attending. It is a true Montessori environment and my husband and I have learned so much about how to set our toddler up for independence and success. Almost every evening she tells me “I want to go to school again” 😊 we love Northwood!

Our family absolutely loves this Montessori school. Not only does my child attend, but all of my nieces and nephews have gone here as well — and that alone speaks volumes. It has truly become part of our family’s story.
The environment is calm, nurturing, and thoughtfully prepared to encourage independence and confidence. The teachers are patient, attentive, and genuinely invested in each child’s growth. They meet every child where they are and help them develop not just academically, but socially and emotionally as well.
What stands out most is the consistency and quality over the years. Watching so many children in our family grow through this program — all becoming confident, capable, and kind little humans — has been such a blessing. Now seeing my own child thrive in the same environment feels incredibly special.
We are so grateful for the love, guidance, and strong foundation this school provides. I highly recommend it to any family looking for a Montessori experience that truly feels like home

Both my kiddos have gone to this school. We've been very impressed with the experience. When we looked around for a Montessori school, we found plenty of imitators, but Northwood turned out to be the real deal. The place is organized in such a neat fashion. The classrooms are wonderfully curated, and the grounds are fantastic for the kiddos. My kiddo's teachers have been top notch, and the ratio of student to teacher excellent.
I know that the area is not where you'd expect to find this gem, but go down that road and meet with them. Go and see the grounds for yourself. See the kids during their school hours. It is truly a marvel of a place to send your kids to.

Northwood Montessori has become our son’s constant after home .He joined the toddler community at 18 months and not only has it helped with his development but he is very happy when we pick him up - which I think is a great sign .It is truly a school that fosters independence , curiosity and a love for learning . As an educator myself , I can go on and on … but I can truly say Northwood Montessori is the real deal when it comes to the Montessori philosophy. All the guides are AMI trained . It truly provides a very solid foundation for learning .

It is one of the finest school a parent could wish for their child. I like  everything about it, from teachers to classroom setups to raw nature around. Certified teachers and authentic Montessori approached has have helped my child and her development so far. Highly recommend!

When you can drop off your child without a worry and pick them up with a big smile on their face, you know you’ve found an amazing daycare! That’s exactly how we felt every single day at CFCC Kingdom Kids. We always had peace of mind knowing our son was well cared for.

Unfortunately, we had to leave the daycare because we relocated to a different city for work. If it weren’t for that move, we would have happily stayed until our son was ready for elementary school—no doubt about it!

Our son attended the daycare for about 1.5 years, starting when he was 1.5 years old. This was his first preschool/daycare experience, and naturally, we were nervous about how he’d adjust. But the teachers here are absolutely outstanding. You can tell how much they genuinely care about the kids. Our son not only adjusted quickly but also made friends, learned so many new things, and was excited to go to school every morning. Seeing him happy at drop-off and pick-up every day says it all!

For me and my wife, knowing our son was in such great hands was priceless—it let us focus on work without worry. We loved all the adorable arts and crafts he brought home, and one of my favorite parts was getting photos throughout the day. A big thank you to Ms. Emily, who always took the time to post detailed daily notes on the app about his activities. That extra effort made us feel so connected to his growth and learning. We feel so lucky to have found this daycare!

A special shoutout to the director, Ms. Paige—she’s absolutely amazing! And we’re incredibly grateful to all the teachers who cared for our son over the period of his stay — Ms. Emily, Ms. Morisol, and Ms. Jessica. You’re all wonderful, and we can’t thank you enough!

I have had all 5 of my kids go through this school and it had helped them be prepared for kindergarten socially and educationally. The teachers are awesome and professional. They have lesson plans for every week. The y have a schedule and routine. My favorite is they keep God in all of their teachings while still keeping them up to date with early educational activities. I would recommend them 9/10 over any other programs out there.
They really know there stuff and the teachers are certified and the school is always kept up to code.

This is our first year at Kingdom Kids- we are in 2’s and 18 months class, and we love it so far! Paige is the most amazing director and the teachers are all so friendly and sweet. My children love coming here, they have neat activities that encourage my kids to come home talking about their day!

We absolutely love it here!  The teachers and Paige are kind, caring and go above and beyond for the kiddos as well as the families.  Whether it's extra one on one time, thoughtful communication through the app or just a general sense of community and safety you'll find it here.  If I could give more stars I would.

I will never be able to say enough good things about this school! God definitely led us here. Immediately upon visiting two years ago we felt the warmth and love the director, Paige, and all the staff have for the kids in their care. Our son had been cared for solely at home, so Kingdom Kids was his first introduction to a school structure. He was understandably nervous, but when we toured the school and went into the class he’d be in, he walked right in and began playing. My husband and I knew then that this was going to be the best place for Logan. As a June baby we had him do PreK 4 twice as a bridge year, so he will have had two years at Kingdom Kids by the time we move on to kindergarten. Our only regret is that we didn’t start him there when he was younger because we are going to miss our Kingdom Kids family this next school year - two years with them isn’t enough. Logan has flourished in his time there! He’s made so many friends and learned so much, not just about letters and numbers and reading and writing and Spanish but also about God. Nothing warms our hearts more than hearing our 5 year old tell us about a story from the Bible or recite the Lord’s Prayer or ask to pray before he eats. We love this school and the leaders and staff so much! I’ll forever be grateful for everything they do and the genuine and authentic care they show the kids and families who walk through those doors.

We started taking our daughter here when she was 4 months old, shortly after this Primrose location opened. While we were apprehensive about taking our kid to daycare (any daycare), we felt stress-free and comfortable at Primrose from Day 1 orientation and our tour of the school with Tara. While it was a new Primrose school, Brittney and Tara made it a seamless process for us and handled our many questions so gracefully. Not only that, but the teachers worked hard to help us through the key milestones with our girl (rolling, 2-1 naps, no pacifiers, potty training, etc.).

Fast forward a few years, and we are SO sad to have to leave PSWR (so much that we actually reconsidered our move to the suburbs)!! Although we will not be leaving the Primrose brand, this place truly felt like a second home/family for our daughter. Everyone knew her name from her first few weeks in the infant room, and we could tell the teachers and staff really cared about our girl and were sad to see her leave. This school holds a special place in my heart and others would be very lucky to send their kids here!!

From the staff, administrators, and teachers- they are so nice and kind! They make you feel like family and it feels like such a small school because even teachers who aren’t my daughter’s teachers know her name and say hi in the hallways. The school is clean, and they have so many activities throughout the year that are fun for the kids. My daughter receives a great education and is taught good manners. She is THRIVING at Primrose :) They also go out of their way to honor us parents which is not necessary but much appreciated!!
The teachers are so caring and take such good care of the kids! They are all so friendly and nice and our daughter loves going.

We're so thankful for the opportunity for our child to attend this magnificent school. Caring and competent teachers and staff exemplify professionalism and dedication to children on a daily basis. Wonderful facility includes an indoor rotunda for play during inclement weather. Chef Charles prepares nutritious and delicious cuisine. Efficient and effective systems and communication via phone, email, and app. Weekly/monthly/seasonal celebrations and theme days, including "Cookie Friday!" The school is very well organized and structured, providing a safe and pleasant atmosphere conducive to learning and play.

They are very responsive and work to provide fun activities for the children and parents. They hosted an awesome trunk or treat event this year.
The teachers are absolutely wonderful and really made me feel like my children were loved as individuals. They gently helped my son gain comfort with sitting on the potty and created such a positive experience for him. The teachers would give me updates on my youngest’s progression in crawling and interests.

The facilities are new and so nice. It’s especially nice that there is a large rotunda area where the kids can play when the weather is not nice enough to go outside.

During our time, there were staffing shortages, however only a half hour was cut off from both opening and closing which did not affect us. The staffing ratios appeared appropriate while we were there and it really seemed like they were trying to strike a balance between minimal impact to parents while supporting their staff.

We moved states and unfortunately could no longer attend PRWR but still think about it and miss it dearly! I would recommend it to anyone!

The Mandarin immersion is seamlessly integrated into daily activities, making learning feel natural and exciting . We’ve seen incredible growth in our son’s confidence, development, and language skills, and we couldn’t be happier with our experience at Crossing Borders. I have nothing but positive things to say about Crossing Borders Rice Village and recommend it to any parents I talk to. I have one kid that graduated from CB and another that is soon graduating. I enrolled at CB for their Mandarin Immersion program and I am glad I did. Miss Jessica has been their teacher and she is amazing!! She is very structured and that has done wonders for my kids. They thrive under her education and I am so happy. She is truly a children's whisperer and has an incredible ability to connect with my kids, make them feel comfortable while keeping them in line, and bring out the best in them. My oldest enjoys re-visiting at pick-up. I never worry about my kids when I drop them off at CB.

Both of my girls truly love the school, especially the Mandarin class, where they have been exposed to structured and engaging instruction in both Mandarin and math.

Every morning when I drop them off, I feel completely at ease knowing they are receiving attentive care and a strong educational foundation at Crossing Borders International School.

My son is in Ms. Jessica's Mandarin class and he absolutely loves going to school. He loves his teacher and classmates and comes home from school eager to tell stories about his day. Ms. Jessica is so affectionate and caring - you can tell she takes pride in being an educator.

All the staff at CBIS are great. They always greet you with smiles and put together amazing activities for the kids. Highly recommend!

My son started here at 2 years old and is now almost 3.5. He genuinely loves coming to daycare each day. He’s learned so much, enjoys learning, and absolutely adores his classmates.

You can feel confident knowing your child will be in caring and capable hands at BeYOU.

Our daughter attends BeYOUtiful Beginnings and it has been such a wonderful experience! You can tell Sophia & Brianna are passionate about teaching and the children’s overall experience. We get continuous updates all day with pictures and the fun activities they have planned for the kiddos. When I drop my daughter off I know she is in the best hands and having a blast! We are so thankful to have found BeYOUtiful Beginnings ❤

We’ve been using this daycare a few years and it’s an amazing place. Sophia and Brianna are exceptionally caring, thoughtful, and loving - and put so much work and effort into what they do. They both have a background in education and are very well organized with thoughtful weekly schedules and clear communication. We really appreciate the balance between play based learning and educational activities - my child has learned so much in their care. You can tell that they love all the kids in everything they do. We love this place so much and can’t wait until my second kid is 18m and old enough to attend.

I absolutely love this daycare! management and staff are so caring and kind to kids and parents. it was my first time putting my kids in day care and i’m so glad i was guided to this one! it truly feels like home and my kids adapted quickly! they’re very communicative and respectful to each child’s needs. i would recommend this day care to any and everyone i know!

Everyone very friendly. I was travelling through and decided to go to the classic and modern Sunday service. Loved them both for different reasons. The message is the same just a different delivery. Whichever you choose is great. Thank you to Ben for taking me through some thoughts, you helped me so much. Wish your family health and happiness

My friend and I went to a worship service here this past Sunday.  It was our first time going to a Presbyterian Church.  I can't remember what time we went, but I know it was their modern/contemporary service that we attended.

I absolutely LOVE seeing it when REAL BREAD is used at communion.  Hats off to you all!

Even though I live on a different side of town, I am interested in experiencing a traditional Presbyterian worship service some day in the future (God willing of course).

Thank you so much for welcoming us with open arms this past weekend as fellow followers of Christ.

God bless and good journey!
I went with a patient for Sunday morning service. The service was so spiritually fulfilling. The minister and the choir was so uplifting. I Must tell Jeus. Oh my God! Enjoyed every minute!!

Visited this church a few times, and each time I have noticed a few things. Some good and some not so good. They have childcare services and my kids enjoyed it. The Sunday school teacher was quite nice, but my kids were not allowed to touch or play with certain items, which I find to be strange 🤔 It appears to be a lot of division within this Holy place 😳...I  can't quite put my words together to explain better....the families I've encountered were nice, but there's an awful lot of unfriendly people, including staff, that gives an unwelcoming feeling. I  think they could do better, we will see. Have a blessed day
Lovely church.   I was there for a school program so I'm not familiar with church related activities.

A hidden gem! 15 month-5 year old school! Amazing group of very passionate and enthusiastic teachers. I cannot say enough. They have an excellent curriculum which is carefully planned a year ahead. The director of education as well as each and every teacher and staff is just absolutely lovely.
Great school! My kiddo has learned so much in such a short amount of time there. The teachers are all amazing and so caring. The tuition is also very comparable to other daycares in the area.

Great program, kind teachers, awesome caring for children.
The program is based on hands-on activities and child-centered curriculum. This school teaches children English, Korean, Spanish, Chinese, and American Sign Language every morning. They have violin lessons once or twice a week for free. Teachers give children loving cares. The facility is new, so it's clean and neat. The price is very reasonable.
We feel so grateful to have found this school. Thank you for making such a great environment for our daughter!
100 stars ❤️👍🙏

My company has partnered with this Montessori as a vendor for a couple of years, and it’s been a very positive experience. The manager here, Ms. Betty, and the owner, Jennifer, are always accessible, quick to address concerns, and proactive in finding solutions. On several occasions, their fast action has made our job much easier. I truly enjoy working with them and highly recommend this school to both parents seeking a quality Montessori in Austin and other vendors considering a partnership.

Our family has had the best experience at International Montessori. Both my children attended this school from 18 months through the start of primary school. Their curriculum is excellent but above all, the love and care that they give the children is what kept us. My youngest is ending his season with International Montessori but we will forever be grateful for their influence in our children’s lives!!!

Our company has had the pleasure of partnering with International Montessori Far West for a couple of years. Ms. Betty and Jennifer, the owner, are always available and proactive in addressing anything that arises. There have been multiple times they’ve acted immediately to help us keep everything running smoothly. I appreciate the strong working relationship we’ve built and would highly recommend this location to other vendors and to parents seeking a well-run, supportive Montessori in the Austin area.

The school, curriculum and teachers & staff are all incredible. The curriculum incorporates cognitive, sensory and fine & gross motor activities in addition to play. The teachers and staff are very intentional about their curriculum and fostering a safe, inclusive environment for the students and families. The school also does a great job of inviting families in for various activities and celebrations. We have a kid in each classroom and we also love that there is play between the toddler and primary classroom.

We absolutely loved it here!!! Jennifer, the owner, is so caring and hands-on, and Ms. Mayada is the sweetest, most loving teacher. It was Sun’s very first daycare experience and they made him feel safe, happy, and so loved from day one. Couldn’t ask for a better place!

This place is the real deal. Our boys have been going here for the past 3 years. Mr. Moses is a fantastic man, easy going and very understanding. He is always willing to work with us when we are running late to pick up our boys. And to top it up, we love their Christian values. I will recommend this place any day and at any time. Keep up the work 💪 👌 👏 👍 🙌

From the moment you interact with Moses you know that your kids will be in great hands. A family owned business that make you feel like family. It’s been nearly four years since we’ve entrusted my son to Moses and team and we are grateful to have found a place that gives us peace of mind when our son is with them.

We have had an excellent experience at Inspiring Hearts. Moses is great with the kids and has truly made a positive impact on our Granddaughter. She started as a preschooler there and learned a lot and now attends the after school program. When I pick her up. She always has positive feedback about her time there. We are truly grateful for the engagement with Moses and blessed that we  found such a great environment for her to thrive in.
Great safe place for our son for after school care. Our son enjoys going there. Mr. Moses is awesome! Very reliable and communicative

We absolutely love our son’s school. We’ve had our boy at Inspiring Hearts for a year now and we couldn’t be more pleased with their preschool program. He’s now entering Elementary and signed him up for after school care. We highly recommend this daycare!!!

OPERATION_NAME: Genesis Foundation Child Care Learning Center
review_text:
My most honest review!
I had a really bad experience with previous child care and was looking for a new location. When I came upon with Genesis Foundation spoke with mrs Dade and Mr Dade they were both very sweet they showed my around gave me the info.
My kids had a hard time but after the first couple days they would be off happy. I have one in each age group a baby, a 2 year old a 4 year old and 8 year. They pick my two oldest from school which have been a blessing because I do not have to worry about a different person picking them up. My oldest is Autistic and lots of daycare didnt want to care for him but Ms Dade has experience, and I do have to say the teachers are firm and sweet, Ms Perez, Ms Hill and Ms Molina have grown to love my kids aswell, they know there a hand full and my kids love being there. They Also have activities for the kids during the Summer! I can say my kids are boys and they need the firmness, Mr Dade helps with that. To top it off my kids have learn to bless the food they say it all the time at home. I truly recommend this daycare. They are like family a true Blessing 🙌 🙏
Its been almost a year and its been great

OPERATION_NAME: Genesis Foundation Child Care Learning Center
review_text: Me and my kids just moved to this side of town and I enrolled them here they have been going a little over 3 months now and I love this day care so much. Best one they have attended I love the staff Mr and Mrs Dade are great people I love them so much. They have an awesome establishment I love this facility teachers are great overall  10/10 I DO recommend. I pray that God continues to lead them and provide everything they need to keep going and to keep blessing others and their families ❤️

OPERATION_NAME: Genesis Foundation Child Care Learning Center
review_text: When I tell you this is the most family oriented daycare I’ve ever been to. They are a real learning center my grand baby has learned so much in the little time she has been here. They also make us feel like family. I love the fact that they provide for all of our babies equally and I can truly say I trust them with all my babies.

OPERATION_NAME: Genesis Foundation Child Care Learning Center
review_text: I am new to Texas and had a hard time looking for childcare. My sister referred me to Genesis because she works across the street from the school. I called and set up an appointment to view the school and Mr. and Mrs. Dade were sweet and they were telling me about their Learning Center. I decided to give them a try. During my son’s first three days he would cry when I drop him off, but after that he was excited about going to school. When I pick him up he’d be on the back seat singing and clapping. He’s also interacting with other kids more

OPERATION_NAME: Genesis Foundation Child Care Learning Center
review_text: Genesis family had done an amazing job with my child and his education. They have great staff and communication well! They go above and beyond to make sure my child is on track. I would definitely recommend this facility to anyone looking for a daycare that puts in the time and effort to make sure your child has the best opportunity to be successful when they are ready to go in the school system. 10/10 I would definitely recommend!!

I wanted to write this review because this daycare has been the best choice for me and my son 🥹. He truly loves it here, and this place has been nothing short of amazing to both of us. I highly recommend it. I feel so much better knowing he is safe and well cared for, and the fact that my job is close by and I can visit him whenever I want makes it even better. I absolutely love it.
I really love the little inspires Montessori stuff is really good. School is nice and clean. very much organized. Prices are reasonable. Nice staff.
It's a wonderful place.  Miss Lisa and Miss Denise have started a new daycare, combining more than 50 years experience in teaching preschool children. Definitely recommend.

Very professional and courteous staff.
My kids love it there
Loving caring environment with the best team to work with very affordable price! Highly recommended

This daycare center is everything you could ask for.

All of the staff is incredibly kind and compassionate.
We wanted to prepare our daughter for kindergarten so we enrolled her in the preschool program, and even though she'd never been in daycare before, any worries we had disappeared as soon as she started.

They not only provide amazing care and a great curriculum, but they truly care about the students and families. You can tell that the director Ms. Annie really loves this center.
There are so many events and opportunities to get involved as the family. They keep you updated every day, and my daughter comes home talking about how much she loves her teachers every day.

We love Discovery World and can't recommend them enough!

We LOVE this location! We’ve been attending since 2023 and have seen so much growth cognitively, physically and emotionally in our little ones. They handle any behavior issues in age-appropriate ways and are great at communicating with parents through their app and by phone. My baby girl reaches out for the infant teachers at morning drop-off, and my toddler comes home singing new songs and talking up a storm. They have an optional weekly dance/gymnastics program that has been a fun and convenient way to explore extracurricular activity. They prioritize hands-on learning and guided play and share photos of our kids throughout the day! We love how the center leans into holidays and makes each season feel special and magical with different parties, events and themed days. At discovery world - prue, staff feels like family and this center is a home away from home for both of our kids. Special shout out to ms chy, ms alexis, and the director,  ms annie for being absolutely amazing with kids of all abilities and temperaments. ❤️❤️❤️ we are so grateful!
I love discovery world! My daughter loves learning while having fun. The director Ms. Annie is a great leader and you can see how much she cares for all the kids!

My children have been attending Discovery World for 2 years, and we couldn't be happier with our experience. The teachers here are truly amazing – so kind, patient, and dedicated. My children always come home excited to share what they've learned and the fun activities they did that day.
The director is a fantastic leader. A welcoming and supportive environment is created for both children and families. Communication from the center is excellent, and families are always informed and included in their child's progress. It is reassuring to know that children are in capable and caring hands. I highly recommend to any family looking for exceptional childcare
Highly recommend!!! The director Ms Annie puts her all into this center. She runs a clean, bright, fun and full of love facility. The children love her!

The owner is very rude unorganized, unprofessional, the place is filthy, roaches in the main play area. The teachers and directors are very sweet but as the owner if you don’t want to be contacted you should update your direct number to the actual daycare. They allowed my daughter to come without paperwork or shot records but over two months later want to scream at me about records when I asked since day one when will I meet and do my paperwork. This is for the rice location the owner has no class. The directors should be first point of contact. Both times my daughter ended up with pneumonia and a head cold because they keep allowing this one sick baby to return back as the mom just drops the son off and keep going. They left my baby milk out all day in her bag and the one infant teacher can not speak English at all so it’s hard to communicate what is wrong.

This is a great place to have your kids at. My child loves it. Miss Ann and her crew are a God sent team and the school is one place I will always recommend to anyone who needs childcare. Also their 24hrs service which was recently started is perfect for our date nights. We Highly recommend this center.

This has been the best school/daycare for our kids! Both my children started as infants . My daughter loves her teacher Ms.Alma, and is always coming home telling me everything she learned I can’t believe this will be her last year as she’s starting kinder! I’m glad she was able to have mrs alma throughout her 4 years there!
& My son omg he loves his teacher Mrs deisy! He even cries to go to daycare to see his teacher and friends!  I love how they treat the kids as their own ! Thank you so much to everyone ! Oh and before I forget Mrs Kari! My kids come home talking about how good her food is lol they serve fresh and delicious meals through the day!
Simply the best in town!

I want to start by saying that this review is long overdue! I only wish I had enrolled my daughter at Twinkle Wonders from the very beginning. After a difficult experience at another daycare, where she attended for just two months, I decided to switch her to Twinkle Wonders and it was the best decision I could have made. From her very first day, my daughter has been showered with love and care by the entire staff and her teacher.

The team at Twinkle Wonders genuinely fosters a nurturing and supportive environment for all the children. My daughter loves attending daycare each day, and knowing how happy and excited she is to go gives me so much peace of mind. If you're considering Twinkle Wonders, don't hesitate they will treat your child with the utmost care, and you'll know they're in great hands.

I've had now 3 children to go through Twinkle Wonders. The staff is accommodating, and they truly care about the children's learning and general well being. My kids are happy to go to this center every day and are sad when they can't be there during the week for illness or some other reason. Thanks for giving my kids lasting memories and offering a home away from home!

We had the pleasure of having our two grandchildren attend Baptist Temple Early Learning Center.I am beyond thankful for all the love and extraordinary care each one received. The staff was amazing and became part of our village .We will forever be grateful. We received updates throughout the day of their many accomplishment's. We experienced their first Christmas play and so much more. I give them the Grandma and Grandpa seal of approval.

This daycare is unacceptable. The building reeks of urine, and cleanliness is clearly not a priority. Required state documentation is not properly kept, and staff have manipulated files when questioned. Children sit idle in classrooms all day with nothing to do, which leads to behavior problems. Meals are cold food from the food bank, served every time. They even offer incentives for positive reviews, making the posted reviews unreliable. This is not a safe or caring environment for children.

Baptist Temple has been a foundational part of my children’s early years, and I couldn’t be more thankful for the love and care they provide. All four of my kids—now ages 14, 8, 7, and 3—have attended daycare here, and each experience has been nothing short of amazing.

Ms. Pat is truly a gem and one of the main reasons I felt completely comfortable leaving my kids in their care. My youngest son has severe food allergies, and as a mom, it’s always hard to trust someone else with his safety—but at Baptist Temple, I know he’s in good hands. They’ve gone above and beyond to ensure his well-being.

I’ll never forget the time I walked in and saw my oldest receiving her inhaler right on time—it gave me such peace of mind. The staff is experienced, caring, and consistent. Many of the teachers have been there for years, and that speaks volumes. They aren’t just staff—they’re a family, and they treat our children like their own.
Great place for the kids. Excellent teacher's. The staff really cares.  Love the new Engage App that allow photos real time photos and updates throughout the day.

Absolutely love this place. My daughter loves it. She doesn't cry when I drop her off, she, she is happy to go to school. She has learned so much from going here. Such a family friendly environment. Definitely recommend if you are looking for child care

Fantastic pastor & caring congregation. Lots to do & many ways to serve the community. Beautiful prayer garden that comes with a huge, active prayer team! St. Phil's is a great place to explore a closer relationship with a truly loving God.

We went to the Pet Blessing (early due to my guy being a little extra 😁🐾)
The Pastor came out and blessed my guy early as well. We got some Pumkins and Pictures too.
Everyone was Very Sweet, Caring, and Fun!!
We will definitely go back!!!

I visited this church for about 4 years before eventually making the commitment to join. I was repeatedly drawn back to the various outreach initiatives they have for the community such as the fire works show, the garage sales, the Easter egg hunt, pumpkin patch, and Halloween trunk or treat. The real appeal though was that every time I came to visit everyone was so welcoming and seemed genuinely accepting and appreciative that we were there. I never felt judged with my little one during service and I realized that this church truly modeled the love of Christ and was a safe place where I could grow and practice my faith.

I’m reviewing St. Philip’s in regards to their Day School. My son has attended there for two years and I couldn’t be more pleased with this school! I love the school’s simplicity and the teachers’ passion for what they do! Every day I’m truly surprised at what my 4-year-old has learned from his teachers. The activities are very hands-on, lots of sensory-based activities, cooking together, planting seeds, and creative art projects. Not only is my son sounding out words at age 4, but also his math/science skills also impress me! The students know their daily routines well and the program is very well-structured. Did I mention St. Philip’s is by far the best-priced pre-k program in the area? You will not be disappointed!

As far as the church, I love their heart for the community. They offer fabulous free activities for the neighborhood! Check them out!

Service is always very uplifting. The congregation greets guests with open arms, and very loving,and caring atmosphere. An excellent place to worship. God has a plan for each of us. God bless St.Phiilip's United Methodist Church.

I can't say enough good things about Bezos Academy. It sets such a strong foundation for their learning endeavors. My son graduated from Bezos and now my daughter will to. I only wish they could have stayed longer. The Montessori teaching methods they use are great and the children benefit so much!

I have now sent both of my boys to Bezos and I truly appreciate the care and attention they give to the children. The staff is amazing and my childrens educational growth has been tremendous to see. I recommend them to all who have the oppprtunity.

Bezos Academy has been such a great experience for our family. My son is learning, growing, and doing well in a caring and structured environment. We really appreciate the kind teachers and the way the program helps children build confidence and independence. We are very thankful for this school.

We’ve had a great experience at Bezos Academy. As our daughter moves on to kindergarten, we’re sad to leave and wish they offered higher grade levels.

We’ve seen her grow so much—from shy to confident, outgoing, and independent. She loves sharing what she learns each day. We really appreciate that they focus not just on academics, but also life skills like organization, simple food prep, and independence.

This school also introduced us to the Montessori style of education, and it completely changed our perspective. We even made the decision to move her brother into a Montessori school as well, and it’s been one of the best choices for our family. At this point, we truly don’t see ourselves going back to a traditional public school setting.

The teachers are amazing, the hours work well for our family, and communication is excellent. We love getting updates and photos throughout the day.

Our only small note is the change in meal providers—it wasn’t bad, just an adjustment from the previous one.

Overall, we highly recommend Bezos Academy!

Bezos Academy has been a wonderful experience for my daughter and our family. The teachers and staff truly care about the children’s learning and growth and they go above and beyond to support families at home, sharing photos of her work and offering helpful workshops so I can stay connected to her education.

The environment feels warm, nurturing and like one big family. The teachers, administrators and other parents all work together and it is clear that this school cares deeply about each child’s success. If you want a loving, learning focused preschool community, this is a fantastic choice. I am so grateful for the support and I know other parents will be happy here too.

Highly recommend for families who value education in a caring and supportive environment.

The staff at Carriage Lane is amazing.  My 2 children both attended another daycare that was part of the Carriage Lane Family for 7 years total.  My son enrolled at Carriage Lane after some behavioral issues and they worked with him and went ABOVE and beyond to help my boy.  In the end, he needed to be somewhere with a smaller group for his age, but it is not a failure on the part of Carriage Lane.  I would recommend them to anyone.  The center is clean, warm and friendly.  The kids all seem to really enjoy themselves. They have a playground out back, and they provide cooked meals and a nice curriculum.  If you're considering them, definitely go ahead and enroll.  Tammy (the owner) and Amanda (director) are just good people.  And the teachers are, too.  Miss Brett and Miss Rosie were my son's teachers and they are fantastic.  Can't say enough about them.

We love this daycare! All of the staff is wonderful and friendly. I placed my daughter here when I had to go back to work after my maternity leave and they made such a difficult time as stress free as possible. I cannot say enough good things about Carriage Lane!

My kids had a great experience at Carriage Lane. They were there for some months the first half of 2015. They had a chance to see their friends from school, make new friends, and I could see that they were kept busy and active during their time there. The staff was pretty friendly too. Unfortunately my wife couldn't get full-time at her job so we had to take the kids out, but the time we did have there was enjoyable. I'd definitely recommend.

My daughter attended the school from 2y-4y and now my son from 2mo- now.  We have never had any problems and the rates are very competitive for the area.  There also seems to be pretty low turn over-- its almost all the same staff as fas as I can tell from when my daughter started about 3 years ago.  My kids are always happy to go to daycare. Large outdoor area too!

I have 2 daughters that have been in and out (due to school) for the past year in a half. I love them! And trust them! Which is big when it comes to your children. Because of my schedule my kids would sometimes go in at random times. They would always tell me to call so they keep a plate of food for them, or be sure they have a spot in the activity they're working on that day. Tammy, Amanda and the rest of the staff truly get to know you and your child(ren). I highly recommend them.

Smart ducklings has been a huge blessing for me. My son went there starting as an infant. They were very understanding with my anxiety as a first time mom leaving her baby at daycare. They gave updates and pictures in the app to help my anxiety about the transition. My son continued to go there and loved it. The teachers truly care about the children. He has since started school and his teacher is very impressed with him, which I attribute to Smart Ducklings. My daughter has also started daycare at Smart Ducklings and she is well taken care of there. Their rates are very reasonable and the care they provide is outstanding. Thank you for all you do!

We are so grateful for Smart Ducklings! The staff here are wonderful and caring. I am so thankful for the love and care my children receive and I have a peace of mind leaving my babies there that I never thought I would have!
Love smart ducklings daycare! They are very accommodating to my family’s needs. Great with communication and listening. I’m glad my child enjoys the environment! 😊

When first looking for a day care, I kept getting this huge gut sense about smart ducklings to chose this daycare, and I’m so grateful I followed my instincts. My son has been coming here since he was 6 months. As a first time mom with so many question and excitement, the entire staff here has been my babies second home getting to enjoy and experience this journey with me. They’re not only there for him, but they’re there for me as a mom, they get excited when I do when he learns something new, and they get sad when I do, like when he doesn’t feel well or when they don’t see him for a few days lol. They have become family to us.  He’s developed so much more since he’s been attending smart ducklings. I never question dropping him off. They are so legal, and always doing things to make their staff more experienced. From one mom to another, you will not be disappointed.

My daughters absolutely love going to school! With personable teachers, open communication, and affordable rates, we are SO happy to have found them. You will not be disappointed! Keep up the good work Ducks!!

My granddaughter has been extremely happy meeting her new classmates at Smarty Pants! I've also seen substantial growth in her learning, communication, and personal development- something that is highly important to me and my family. I definitely recommend Smarty Pants to any working family that needs a trusting facility to send their growing babies. All the staff have been extremely patient and professional every time I see them. Facility is clean and organized too!! 👌

I needed to find care for my youngest while I’m attending college and this daycare was the perfect fit, no worries about it! It’s been about 2 weeks and my daughter raves about wanting to go to “school”. Kashauna, the director/owner,  sets the environment to prepare the kids for school. She and her staff (which I honestly thinks she treats as family because they seem to love their job) are very transparent, caring, and responsive. Not just educating the kids, but keeping the kids safe (secure drop off and pick up system) and healthy (at the door temperature checks and symptoms) is literally their top priority.

We teachers make an effort to engage with each kid. We provide a safe, fun and loving environment. We are a great staff and very welcoming. Mrs. Kashauna is great! She genuinely loves each and every child. As a parent I would recommend this center. We can assure you your child is safe and taken care of.

100% recommend this center!
My daughter who is special needs has been attending this center since she was 2 months old and the staff and director are just awesome with her. I never thought I would feel comfortable leaving my daughter in anyone else’s care until she started here. Ms kashuana the director is kind, understanding and always listens to your concerns. I will also be having my newborn son attend here as well when I return back to work.

If you’re looking for a daycare, this is the one! The owner is extremely professional and kind. The rooms are super cute. Her staff is very informative and loving to the children. My child loves Smarty Pants and as a parent I love it too! I highly recommend this place!

Ms brown is a cool lady just don't do good business she told me we had a conversation we never had about my child getting to and from daycare from school but everything okay I found something else God bless
Awesome childcare facility and staff ….
The best care for my grandbabies,nieces and nephews,well satisfied

My son Alex attended Mount olive for 5 years and Ashley and all the teachers prepared Alex for elementary. Best daycare I could have chosen . It’s like family and we will miss all the teachers and the director Ashley. My son love to come to daycare everyday and learn so much. Thank you!

My twins were here for preschool and loved it.  I was so grateful to have gotten them in.  I never realized what the children needed to know to get into kindergarden.  Very pleased with their facilities.  So clean and organized.
Love visiting from Austin and would join this Church if I lived anywhere close.  Pastor L. and wife doing wonderful work for our Lord Jesus:  much appreciated.  Jack and Kay Reeves.
Love this church very nice Pastor and people. I have been a member all my life. I couldn't ask for a better place, when you need someone to listen to you or help you the Pastor will always do so
Mount Olive has been my church home for over 20 years. Pastor John delivers a great sermon & teaches our Bible class too!

I started bringing my son to this daycare in October, and it has been an amazing experience from the very beginning. The owner Ms Seema is so caring, attentive, and always keeps me updated. She sends me pictures and messages throughout the day so I always know how my son is doing, which gives me so much peace of mind.

My son’s teacher, Ms Denise, is also wonderful. She’s patient, kind, and truly great at what she does. She always tells me my son is a great student, and I can tell she really cares about him and all the kids. That means so much as a mom.

My son absolutely loves being here he’s comfortable, happy, and always excited to go back. You can tell the environment is safe, loving, and focused on helping the kids grow.

If you’re looking for a daycare where the staff treats your child like family and communication is amazing, this is definitely the place to send your kids. I’m so grateful we found it!

We absolutely love this daycare! My baby is always happy and well taken care of. The staff is loving, patient, and professional. Special thanks to Ana, Sofía, Denise, and Seema for being so kind and attentive every day — you truly make a difference. We feel so grateful to have you caring for our little one! 💕

When I took my grandson to this daycare, I immediately felt the love and compassion from Ms. Seema and her staff. They made me feel so comfortable and welcomed. I truly appreciate how Ms. Seema provides regular updates about my grandson through text messages—it gives me such peace of mind. I also want to highlight Ms. Denise, who is an absolute gem. She is a wonderful asset to the daycare, and I love the care she shows every day.🎉🎉🎉🎉

Excellent daycare, both the staff and the facilities are very safe for the care of my children. All the teachers are trained and very nice and attentive with the children, especially Miss Denis and the director, Sinepre, they are attentive to the children so I can go to work peacefully. My little ones have been attending for more than a year, they are delighted to be there. Thank you to all the teachers.

My son has been attending this center since January and in a few months this center has treated us like family. The way all teachers know him , the students all know each other and interact with one another. My son is always excited to start his day at daycare with his classmates and teachers. Teachers always have daily activities for my little one , which are so cute and I get to bring home. All this for a great price as well. Best daycare center, highly recommended!

They have a beautiful newly remodeled location right on Kiest. My husband and I  feel 100% confident that the teachers love and care for my two kids enrolled in KPCP. We love seeing our kids enjoy themselves through updates on an app!  KPCP ensures confidence and independence in each student and have a fun curriculum they follow! My son is doing SO much better now that he is with Ms. Symmer. They have well balanced meals and are strict in ensuring all areas are clean. This is a GEM in Oak Cliff! Don’t hesitate to place your babes with this wonderful team.

The ladies are really good with my son. They have a wonderful curriculum that helps the children to learn easily. My son could say his ABC’s and count to ten in English and Spanish by 18 months. If you are looking for a place where you feel peace about leaving your child this is it!

I cannot say enough good things about KPCA. Our oldest daughter went here 10 years ago and wr had such a wonderful experience we could not wait for them to open back up for our youngest to attend. The staff is amazing and feel like part of your family. Our daughter is doing so well and learning so much thanks to these ladies!

I love that they use an app to keep us up to date on everything going on during the day. They post cute pictures and our daughter always looks happy.

I highly recommend KPCA to everyone I talk to. It is more than just a daycare, they are family.

Best school ever. My kids are very well cared for  there. I get daily reports on the activities, the food they eat and pictures of them through out the day. The teachers there really care about the children’s wellbeing and growth. I have sent my kids to other school and daycares before, and Kiest Park Christian Academy is the best one so far in all perspectives.

Our first son who is 9years old went to this daycare for several years and we absolutely loved the staff and curriculum. When our second child was ready to begin daycare, it was a no- brainer on where he would be attending. They still surpass all of our expectations daily. He has learned so much in the last year and we are so grateful to our daycare for the commitment they put into his education. They push him and encourage him so much and we are blessed to call this establishment his daycare.

We cannot say enough wonderful things about this preschool! Our daughter attended from 18 months old until she turned 5, when we moved away, and we couldn’t imagine a better place for her to have grown up. It’s a great community of teachers and parents who care.

The teachers here are absolutely exceptional - they genuinely care about each child's development and wellbeing. Ms. Patty has been teaching Alex from the beginning and has such a special way with children and made such a lasting impact on our daughter. Ms. Aarti, the school’s Director, creates a nurturing environment where kids feel safe, loved, and excited to learn.

The emphasis on outdoor time was fantastic - our daughter is a high energy kid, so this was so great for her. She spent so much time exploring, playing, and learning outside, which we know contributed to her love of nature and physical activity.

Most importantly, we watched our daughter grow tremendously during her time here, both socially and academically. She developed confidence, independence, and genuine friendships, while also building a strong foundation for kindergarten.

We miss this special place and would recommend it to any family looking for exceptional early childhood care and education. Thank you, Ms. Aarti and teachers, for giving our daughter such a beautiful start to her educational journey!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

I can't say enough good things about Nature Preschool! This nature-based preschool is a true gem. From the moment we enrolled our child, we noticed a remarkable difference in his enthusiasm for learning and love for the outdoors. The curriculum is thoughtfully designed to blend academic learning with hands-on exploration of nature, which is both engaging and educational.

The teachers (particularly Mr. Aarti, the director) are incredibly passionate and nurturing, fostering a sense of curiosity and wonder in the children. They make each day exciting with outdoor adventures, nature crafts, yoga, and interactive lessons that connect kids with their environment. It’s clear that they genuinely care about each child's development and well-being. Our son has moved on to Kindergarten and one month later, still misses everything about Nature school!

If you’re looking for a preschool that encourages a love for nature and supports holistic development, Nature Preschool is the place to be. We are grateful for the wonderful experience and highly recommend it to other families.

Our two boys have been attending Nature Preschool since 2019, and now we are closing the chapter there as our younger one moves on to the elementary school this fall. We are truly sad to be leaving this special little school that has been a second home to our boys for several years.
The focus on not just outdoor play but learning and socialization are what drew us in and kept us there. We felt it was important for our kids to be in nature at this age, exploring & getting dirty, using nature itself as art supplies and enjoying yoga and dance parties between learning sessions.
Aarti and the teachers are phenomenal. They care so much about the children and their enrichment and it shows. Aarti takes great effort in keeping everyone safe and healthy in her school and it works.
I wish we could stay at Nature longer but we leave knowing our kids were well prepared for kindergarten and that they had a truly amazing experience in their early years. I would recommend this school to anyone in a heartbeat!

Nature Preschool has been a wonderful experience. Miss Aarti and her team have done an amazing job with my son. The first week he was there we saw huge improvements in his academic capability. I would highly recommend The Nature Preschool!

This has been an Amazing school for our 5yr old as he transitions to kindergarten next semester. The teachers are so caring & have done so great in his continued education. I love that the school encompasses so much outdoor activity & crafts using "supplies" from nature. The whole experience of a day at this school is wonderful. From starting off the day with kid friendly yoga, playing outside, the weekly lessons, & making friends, our son has Loves this school. I wish it was one he could go to longer. We love it ❤

A year later and new leadership!
Our family has had an outstanding experience with this daycare, and we could not be more grateful for the incredible team that supports our daughter every day. As parents of an only child, choosing the right caregivers was extremely important to us—and we feel truly blessed to have found a place where she is not only cared for, but nurtured, challenged, and genuinely understood.

Our daughter can be selective about who she interacts with or shows her true personality to, yet she has completely opened up with her teachers Ms. Lisa, Ms. Jenn, and Mr. Joel (and her wonderful teachers that came before them). She lets them see her full, authentic self every single day, which speaks volumes about the trust and comfort she feels in their classrooms. She’s also very honest about how others treat her, and she has never once expressed that anyone has been unkind. That means everything to us.

We also deeply appreciate the leadership team—the Director (Antonio) and Assistant Director(Jewells)—for fostering a warm, professional, and communicative environment. We trust that our daughter is safe and cared for, and we know that if any questions or concerns arise, we can openly and respectfully discuss them. That level of partnership is rare and invaluable.

We could not ask for a more devoted, compassionate, and skilled group of educators. Our daughter is thriving, learning, and genuinely happy—and for that, we are endlessly thankful. We highly recommend this daycare to any family looking for a place where children are truly seen, supported, and loved.

We absolutely love La Petite! From the very first tour to signing our child up, everything felt welcoming, organized, and reassuring. Drop-off is always quick and easy, and the after-school pickup has been a lifesaver for our schedule. The staff is amazing, so caring, attentive, and truly treats the kids like their own. The center is always spotless and well-maintained. My child comes home smiling every single day, and that says everything. Highly recommend!

This daycare has been absolutely amazing for us. My 2 year old been coming to this daycare for a year and a half now. The teachers keep them engaged in activities and play so they do learn a lot. They provide meals and snacks which was a big deal when I was looking for childcare. My baby is very particular and she loves her teachers and the directors which makes me feel comfortable knowing that she feels safe here. As a single mom it’s a big deal. I greatly appreciate everyone here who treats my baby so great. The directors are amazing they listen to any concerns you may have and try their best to make sure your experience here is the best.

My daughter has been attending this daycare since she was 2 years old (Now 4) , and I truly couldn’t be happier with the care she receives. They played a huge role in helping potty train her, and the entire staff has always been amazing, kind, patient, and great at communicating with me about her day.
I love that they always have fun activities planned, and one of my favorite things is getting picture updates throughout the day. The live camera feed also gives me so much peace of mind.
Ms. Lisa and Ms. Jewells have been there since before we enrolled, and their friendliness and consistency mean so much to us. The newer staff—Ms. Erin, Ms. Jen, and Mr. Joel—have been wonderful additions and show the same level of kindness and care. The new director, Antonio, is awesome as well. He’s easy to talk to, great with communication, and always willing to answer any questions I have.
I am so grateful for this daycare and the loving environment they’ve created for my daughter. Highly recommend! 💕

As a first-time parent, choosing a daycare was a huge decision for our family, but from the moment we stepped into La Petite, we knew we were in the right place. The Director and Assistant Director have been nothing short of amazing. Their leadership is evident in every aspect of the daycare’s operation, from the cleanliness of the facility to the warm, welcoming atmosphere they foster.

The Director’s hands-on approach and open communication made the transition smooth and worry-free for us. She takes the time to know each child and family personally, and her genuine care and attention to detail have given us great peace of mind.

The Assistant Director is equally wonderful. Her professionalism and kindness shine through in every interaction. She’s always available to address any concerns or questions, and she has a fantastic rapport with both the children and the staff. Together, they create a supportive, nurturing environment where our child has thrived.

We couldn’t be happier with our experience at La Petite and highly recommend it to any parent looking for a daycare where the leadership truly cares about the children and families they serve.

It is clear that Rekha genuinely cares about each child’s development and happiness. Their warmth, patience, and passion for teaching are evident every day.

The lesson plans are well thought-out and engaging, striking the perfect balance between learning and play.

The passion and compassion is evident with every single teacher we have encountered.

If you like unorganized, unprofessional daycares then this is the place for you. The daycare owner:director talks in circles. That should have been my first clue.there’s no accountability, just excuses. Has been a tumultuous journey from day one. From not communicating to staff to pick my son up from school when he started to last minute changes and issues after my daughter was supposed to start at 8 weeks. You have to call and ask them to do things multiple times. My daughter was there 7 months still didn’t have access to her virtual profile for communication with her teacher.  On my children’s last day I went to pick up there things and she magically didn’t have any diapers, baby food, wipes, or bottles. I guess I’m supposed to be believe that they have been supplying those things for her… NOT . They hide behind “COVID” as a way to not allow you into the daycare. Every time I would pick up my daughter I would be left outside for minutes on end because they “are in the middle of changing her”  also paid for a month of services, kids were dropped and she has not gave me a refund although I have called up there asking for a refund. Again unprofessional and problematic
A great daycare. My 2 old goes here. They have events often and fun days at daycare ( pajama day, movie day ) etc. I highly recommend this daycare.
The center is very maintained, very well equipped, safe and organized.  The staff is always kept informed of what is happening with the student.  They also prepare children for school.
It’s very professional, very clean & respectful of what you would like for your child to do I have a 6 month old & they have explained everything very clearly.
Since my daughter started here she has been thriving. Great daycare

I can’t say enough great things about MBS Kids. From the moment we joined, the entire experience has been nothing but positive, welcoming, and professional. The staff genuinely care about each child’s growth and well-being, and it really shows in everything they do.

My child has grown so much in confidence, discipline, and skill since being with Ms. Georgia. The teachers make learning fun while still maintaining a structured and supportive environment.

The communication from the Director and Assistant Director is always clear and organized, and the programs are thoughtfully designed. The atmosphere is warm, inclusive, and family-oriented, which makes it easy for parents to feel part of the community too.

We’re so grateful to have been a part of this wonderful program and wish we didn’t have to move away. Hoping to be able to reunite and visit with the amazing director, assistant director and Ms. Georgia someday soon. Best wishes for the best school.

My daughter absolutely loves her teacher Ms. Kayla. She is really sweet, patient,  and constantly updating pictures on Procare.

Our daughter also loves Mrs. Marilu she has a big heart and treats everyone with kindness. You can tell they  deeply care about every child who walks through the door.

We recently attended their Fall Festival, and it was absolutely amazing! Ms. Cecilia, the Director, truly went above and beyond to make the event special. The games were so colorful, vivid, and creative — I was very impressed! You could really see the care and effort that went into every detail. Can’t wait for the next one!

I would not recommend this daycare to parents of older school-age children.

There was an incident involving the phone policy on a Friday, which I addressed with my son at home. The following Monday, although he did not have his phone, he was still required to open his backpack to prove it and had his entire backpack confiscated — including his laptop — despite not actively using any device.

While I understand enforcing rules, the situation felt unnecessarily escalated and created tension that did not seem proportionate. Instead of working toward resolution through communication, the situation ultimately resulted in my children being dismissed from the program.

Parents should be aware that this daycare appears to have a very strict enforcement style and limited flexibility when concerns are raised. If you value open communication and collaborative problem-solving, you may want to ask detailed questions before enrolling. My children were here for four years without any issues until the new director showed up.

MBS Academy is a second home to my kids! The teachers and staff are so attentive and caring, they go above and beyond I'm glad to have found them. My kids love it there and they have learned so much, I recommend them 100%.

I can honestly say that MBS Learning Academy has completely exceeded my expectations. The facility is always clean, the staff are incredibly knowledgeable and friendly, and the activities and events they organize really get both the children and their families involved.

When my daughter, who is now 3 years old (will be 4 in February), transferred from her previous daycare at 2 and a half, she was barely speaking and had little interaction with her peers. She also wasn't participating as much as the other kids in her class.
I want to emphasize that her previous daycare did their best, but they just couldn't connect with my daughter. I did find out later that she is mildly autistic and had a speech impairment, however before her diagnosis, at MBS, the teachers were able to make genuine connections with her, and she had become so much more engaged with the other children.

My daughter adores her school so much that she wishes she could go on weekends and gets really bummed out when she can't go every day (part of her Autism diagnosis). But, I'm so happy that she loves it and it reassures me that she's in the right place. My son will be starting in the spring, and I'm keeping my fingers crossed for a positive experience for him too. 😊
