review_text: I have worked with them as an event vendor for some of the recent events they have put on to give the kids some fun evenings to dance, celebrate, and do awards. The owners and the employees have always showed kindness, gratitude, generosity, and respect with every single interaction! I always enjoy working with them, and am looking forward to conducting working future events. Thank you Tia!

We couldn’t be happier with our experience at La Maternelle. Both of our children attended from the time they were 3 months old until we moved out of state—our oldest at 3 years old and our youngest at 11 months. If not for the move, we would have never considered leaving; La Maternelle truly set the standard for what exceptional childcare should be.

From day one, the staff was warm, welcoming, and incredibly attentive. They made our children feel comfortable and excited to arrive each morning, and they gave us complete peace of mind knowing our kids were safe, loved, and well cared for.

The facility is clean, organized, and thoughtfully designed with age-appropriate activities that support both learning and social development. The teachers foster a joyful, creative atmosphere where play and education go hand in hand.

We saw remarkable growth in both children—especially in confidence, independence, and language. By the time we left, our oldest was speaking impressive French for his age!

Most importantly, the staff genuinely cares for each child as if they were their own. We wholeheartedly recommend La Maternelle to any family looking for a safe, nurturing, and enriching environment.

My kids have been attending la Maternelle for 7 months now and I have loved the excellent communication, clean location, and small class sizes.  They get the attention they need in a loving environment.  The 3 year olds are always doing fun craft activities or learning new songs, it's a wonderful learning experience.  And my 1 year olds cling to their teachers, they love spending time with them!

Leaving LMFA has been so bittersweet for our family. From the very beginning, the love and care the staff showed my daughter meant the world to us. As a first-time parent, I’ll admit I came in with strong opinions and a lot of anxiety, but the team was nothing but patient, understanding, and accommodating every step of the way. Watching my daughter grow, learn, and feel truly loved here has been such a gift.

LMFA will forever have a place in our hearts. Thank you for creating such a warm, nurturing environment and for treating our little one like family. ❤️

La Maternelle has been an exceptional environment for my children. The educators are fully bilingual and demonstrate a high level of professionalism. Since the transition to new management, the improvements have been both significant and evident. Enhancements to the curriculum, the introduction of new activities, and a thoughtfully diverse summer camp have all contributed to a greatly enriched experience for students and families alike.

Ms. Ouly, the new director, is outstanding. She exhibits genuine care for the children, treating them with the warmth and attention one would expect from a devoted parent, while also showing strong leadership and empathy toward her staff. I confidently and wholeheartedly recommend La Maternelle without reservation.

I have been sending my children to LA Maternelle since 2017, starting with my first child, and I can confidently say it has been a fantastic experience. All four of my kids are enrolled, and the education they receive is truly exceptional. By the time my oldest reached 1st grade, they were already ahead of their peers, a testament to the quality of education at LA Maternelle.
My two younger children are still attending, and I continue to be impressed by the creativity of the teachers. Their out-of-the-box teaching methods not only engage the kids but also foster a love for learning. The program offers an authentic French immersion experience that provides a foundational education akin to what you'd find in a traditional French kindergarten.
I wholeheartedly recommend LA Maternelle to any parent looking for a nurturing and academically enriching environment for their children.

We love Empower Kidz! My kids have a blast here! My 2 year old loves to come and walks right in - without even saying bye! He's comfortable and always leaves with a smile. I'm so happy we have this playspace in Lakeway - it's clean, warm, and beautifully designed. The staff is wonderful. We've also attended the family events and weekly stay and plays and they are great!

We have had such a wonderful experience at Empower Kidz! We have been bringing our 5-month-old in for a drop-in visits, and from the moment we walk in, the staff make us feel so welcome and at ease. As new parents it can be nerve-wracking leaving our baby, but their caring and attentive team took the time to learn our baby’s routines, preferences, and personality.

The space is clean, bright, and full of engaging toys and activities even for little ones. They provide an in depth log of all feedings/diapers/activities/naps so we can be assured our baby is getting what he needs while he is there. When we pick him up, he is usually happy, well-rested, and clearly comfortable with the caregivers.

We’re so grateful to have found such a safe, nurturing place that we can trust for our childcare needs. Highly recommend Empower Kidz to any parents looking for flexible, high-quality childcare!

We love Empowered Kidz! This place is truly a life saver when you need excellent quality childcare drop in style. The facility is super clean and I love that they do fun activities during the day. My 2 year old loves going here!
Beautiful and thoughtfully made space - staff was wonderful with both our toddlers and infants. Spotless space full of enriching toys for a huge range of ages. We will definitely be coming back!!!

We couldn’t be happier that our daughter attends Empower Kidz!   It has become her happy place. Every time we say, “Do you want to go to the playhouse?” (that is our special name for it) She lights up and jumps with excitement!

From the moment she walks in, the team and the space make her feel safe, welcomed, and full of joy. The rooms are thoughtfully designed with separate areas for different ages, so she’s always playing with kids her size and exploring just-the-right activities.

If you’re looking for a place where your child will look forward to going, feel comfortable, and actually have fun, we wholeheartedly recommend Empower Kidz Drop-In. It’s been such a gift to our family.  Thank you!

5 stars all the way. Amazing staff. Our son went from crying to not wanting to go home. Everyone from Ms. Diana, Ms. Maria is amazing. Ms Angela was the morning drop off teacher she helped a lot especially at the beginning. Our son has never been in daycare before so there was definitely an adjustment period. It’s been about 2.5 months I’ve seen a lot of progressive in his speech. Amazing daycare.  Great price, great staff, lots of educacional instruction.

We started at Brentwood about a month ago, The staff here really held my hand through the whole transition from fully at home to daycare. I went here as a child and loved it, so coming back with a child was definitely a new experience. It’s Christian-based and such a relief knowing my little one is in a place where they’re learning about kindness and God’s love while they play. The teachers are right there on the floor getting messy and playing with the kids and actually ENGAGING unlike those who are only there for a check. My phone also pings with updates throughout the day with the cutest pictures and videos of my baby. I never have to wonder what they’re up to or if they’ve eaten/napped because the communication is on point.
For the level of care and all the fun activities they do, it’s actually really affordable. It feels like a premium experience without the crazy price tag you see at a lot of other places.
If you’re looking for a spot where your kid will be genuinely loved and you’ll actually have peace of mind, this is it. So glad we found them (again)!

This is my second review so obviously this place is amazing and has been such a blessing to me and my daughter. My daughter has been attending Brentwood since she was one and she is four now. This place has never disappointed me the establishment stays clean, you get a warm welcome when you walk through the entrance, the staff are like family and they treat my daughter like she is their own. Ms. Maria, Ms. Kat, Ms. Lacey, Ms. Maya, Ms. Diana, Ms. Esmey, Ms. Rachel, Ms. Lexi, Ms. Amber, and Ms. Angela, Thank you so much ladies for all your hard work and dedication to the kiddos. If I missed anybody else you are amazing as well and thank you. THANK YOU BRENTWOOD! ♥

I would add more stars if I could, Brentwood is just that great. We found them through a recommendation and I couldn’t be happier. Our son loves all of the staff and has had a connection with every teacher he’s had so far. They genuinely care about the kids and the parents. They’ve been so attentive to us when we’ve come to them with worries or concerns and always offer helpful solutions. The director and assistant director, Ms. Maria & Ms. Kat are truly the best and we appreciate them so much. I just had my second child and the separation will be difficult, but I’m really grateful to have a daycare that we trust.

Great staff , great teachers. Since my son has been going for the last year he’s been really enjoying it. I see the developing my son has made . Safe clean environment that is family oriented . I highly recommend this to parents .

My child has been at this daycare for almost 3 years and enjoys going to school.  The prices are reasonable for more than one kid to attend and they treat you like family. Also, my baby has shown improvement in academics using what they do at school and what we do at home to help with comprehension skills.

I love tiny tots daycare, because the center is very clean neat and very family oriented, love when family is participating with the different activities especially Thanksgiving dinner time the food is delicious and overall my niece and nephew has learned alot at the daycare and both are ready for kindergarten.

I don't have my children at this daycare, however I've had not only today at 7:21 AM on a school day in front of Cunningham Middle School a van pass me up (basically speeding in a school zone that starts at 7 AM off Normandy) but also in a previous day in the afternoon school zone do the same thing is very unsafe and speaks volumes of the integrity of the childcare services provided. Would question if the drivers of the childcare center are monitored and given proper training to ensure the safety of your children as they are transported from the childcare center to their respective schools.

My grandchild attends this daycare.

The building always tidy and clean.

So transparent, helpful, and supportive!
It’s always a great feeling walking in to the school. The kids create a community of friendship with each other and between the families as well. Truly an open door with information and support for the families. Great place great people!

My child enjoys Open Door North and going to learn, play, and engage with staff and other kids.  I like the teacher to child ratio. I feel the kids get adequate attention. The daily updates and photos are also really great because I want to know everything lol. The staff is extremely kind and welcoming! If your child needs help with certain issues like emotional regulation, speech, and beyond they’re there to help navigate.

Open Door North has an amazing staff. Shout out to Ms. Sheila, Ms. Rasha, Ms. BreNae and Ms. Shanice! I definitely feel very confident about the care my child receives, and I’m able to work worry free knowing she’s in good hands.

The staff is very understanding, positive and consistent.
Amazing daycare! The staff there are amazing and love and treat my kids like their own.

We are so grateful to have found Open Door Preschool for our kids. The teachers are incredibly thoughtful and experienced. You can tell they genuinely care about every child's growth and well-being.

What makes Open Door truly special is their commitment to supporting kids with special needs. Because of this, our kids have been surrounded by children of all abilities and differences from an early age. They've learned not just academics, but something far more important: how to be kind, how to be patient, and how to help others. That kind of exposure and understanding is something you can't teach from a textbook.

If you're looking for a preschool in Austin that values inclusion and builds compassion in children, Open Door is the place. We couldn't recommend it more highly.

Leaving this review because I love this day care , Aiden started this day care when he was 2 year old he doesn’t attend anymore because he is 4 now and is attending school but when he did they treated him so well & now my other son Abraham is attending this day care since he was 2 months, he is 1 year and 4 months old and he loves it I can feel safe to leave him there they all take good care of him . I would definitely recommend this place to anyone that wants to enroll there children because they have the best employees working there .

We tried two other day care centers that my 2 yr old never grew to like before I decided to try Riding Rainbow again.  Foolish of me not to have started there in the first place. They all love the kids : )  Your child will not only be well cared for, but will also learn and develop as well. You won't regret enrolling your child.

OPERATION_NAME: Cedars Montessori School of Oak Hill
review_text: Our kids attended Cedars from ages 4-12.  We loved the natural environment, the connection to outdoor spaces, as well as the individualized care and respect that was shown to both kids throughout their educational journey.  They both absolutely thrived at Cedars, each in their own way, and are now on to middle school with a sense of capability, independence, and agency over their education that I credit entirely to their time at Cedars.  I honestly could not have asked for a better elementary school for them.

OPERATION_NAME: Cedars Montessori School of Oak Hill
review_text: We love Cedars. We have been at this small, family run school for over 10 years. Our oldest son graduated two years ago and youngest son is in the Rockwood classroom. This beautiful school, situated among oaks and junipers, has been their second home.  Any issues we have had (as things are always going to come up in a school) have been dealt with swiftly and satisfactorily. The administration is accessible and responsive. The new director is doing a fabulous job. Our boys are inquisitive, confident, and engage in conversations with children and adults alike. I attribute a large part of this to this lovely school and fabulous teachers, especially in primary and upper elementary.

OPERATION_NAME: Cedars Montessori School of Oak Hill
review_text: Our son has been at Cedars in the primary program for the past two years. We have seen him grow immensely emotionally, socially and academically. He loves the gardening time, open ended creative time and lessons from his guide. At age four he can sew crafts, count to 100 by ones and 10s, basic addition and subtraction, recognize letters with sounds and starting to sound out words. We are thankful for the nurturing environment Cedars has created for learning.

OPERATION_NAME: Cedars Montessori School of Oak Hill
review_text: Choosing a school for your child is such a deeply personal decision that can feel very fraught especially when selecting your child’s first experience with formal education.  As parents, we do our research on teaching philosophy, staff to child ratios, cost, and other important variables.  Those things matter. But, at the end of the day, I think what we all want is a place where our child can be seen, heard and understood. Cedars has given my children exactly that.  A place where they are deeply seen and encouraged to be exactly who they are.  All while learning letters and numbers yes, but more than that, while learning to explore the world around them with curiosity and confidence that if they don’t know something yet, they can, and will, learn.  In short, Cedars fostered a sense of wonder and has given my kids the tools to never stop exploring the world around them.

OPERATION_NAME: Cedars Montessori School of Oak Hill
review_text:
We spent three years here: one in primary and two in lower elementary.  We felt so grateful to find this place our first year.  We were very happy with the teacher and the programming, and the school offered many opportunities to build community.  At the end of the first year, there was a large change in leadership, and conditions have deteriorated considerably.  It became apparent to our family that the administration was no longer acting in the interest of the children.

The school is owned and run by a family.  It is a for-profit institution with no oversight or accountability.  The current leadership’s actions indicate the school’s purpose is to support themselves and maintain a bizarre class structure for the benefit of the family’s children.  The nepotism has become so overt that even our young children are expressing examples.

Funding favors advertising and recruiting new students over recruiting and retaining qualified staff or providing quality programming.  All community-building opportunities have been undermined or dismantled.  Parents are shut-out. Communication is abysmal, unprofessional at best.  Concerns are gas-lighted. Grownups behave poorly and do not lead by example. There are no benchmarks for academics and children are assessed as behind at other institutions.  The teachers withhold recess as punishment.  The focus on the outdoors, how much time the children spend outside, the children interacting with animals, how nature is incorporated into the curriculum: it’s a facade.

Now that we have begun anew at a new school, we remember the excitement and hopefulness that we once had for our children at Cedars before we became habituated to wild disorganization, dysfunction, and dread.  Some really amazing families and staff have held on through some very challenging times with memories of what it once was and with hope that things would get better, that our children could still thrive there.  Yet the school is rehiring failed staff and even more family.  There is now a mass exodus of both students and quality staff, with the realization that our children don’t have any more time to waste on selfishness, greed, and gross ineptitude.

i can't say enough good things about habibi's.  my two sons, an 18-month-old and an almost-3-year-old absolutely love going to habibi's hutch, or as they call it, baby's hutch.  it took about three weeks for each of them to get into the swing of school, but once they realized that they were safe, they also realized that they'd hit the jackpot!  this place is outdoor playtime all the time!  the teachers are so kind and patient, and they treat the children like friends.  i have never heard a harsh word from a teacher and i see nothing but happy kids everywhere i look.

the school is set up in two neighboring houses, with a giant combined play yard filled with bikes, swings, playhouses, balls, buckets, water-play, toys, and sand.  there is always music playing (real music, not baby stuff) and a bubble machine blowing out thousands of bubbles.  it's like a party all day long!   but don't be thinking there's no order, because there is more happiness and peace at habibi's than in most homes.  they've got a system that works, including a schedule for mealtime and naptime, hand-washing and potty-parties, and disciplinary policies that force nothing, but show the social ramifications of one's choices. my boys have both grown up a great deal while at habibi's, and i am certain that the natural way of letting them interact with one another has had huge benefits on their social skills.  and, best of all, they're having a good time!  saturday mornings i have to explain to my boys that no, they can't go to school today.

my family is moving to florida soon, and of all the things i am sad to leave behind, habibi's hutch looms largest.  so for now, we will count our lucky stars to have found this perfect wonderland, and enjoy every day there we have left!

From her early photos and videos—where she was shy and often hiding in a corner—to now, when she won’t leave until she has hugged her dear classmates goodbye for the day, the transformation has been remarkable.

At home, she eagerly tells me all about her wonderful friends and the teachers. We are so grateful for the friendships, the school, and especially the teachers for their genuine love and care. We love love love Ms. Nay Nay as she is always thinking of creative ways to help the kids grow and shine. Ms. Sara braids my daughter’s hair into a true princess style. And Ms. Eliza is always patiently waiting for buzzer finish pickup.

Our daughter is in a thriving environment, and we couldn’t be more thankful. We’re so excited that she will be transitioning to the next class with her group of friends, though we know we will miss these amazing teachers so much.

Amazing teachers, administration and school! Everyone knows you and cares. My toddler walks down the hall hugging her former infant teachers and running to her current teacher. My son thrived and was admitted to a local private school, fully prepared. He returned for summer camp and had a blast! My husband and I could not be happier with our experience and the wonderful families we have met.

SBPA has been an incredible place for our family of three boys!

My oldest started in 2021 in the infant class. It is always tough, especially with your first, to send them off, but SBPA soon became an amazing little community for us in the midst of the pandemic and beyond. They took really good care of my son and I knew we had made a really good choice picking this school for our family.

I believe we have had most teachers at SBPA now having been there five years and counting with three kids! One thing that has been consistent in all the classes is how much they care for the kids. I really wanted a place where my kids would learn new skills but was a loving and nurturing environment above all. I really feel like the teachers CARE about my kids at this school and truly love them. They all know them and say hi to them by name even after they’ve moved on to other classes. The other thing that stood out to me as I got new class packets each new school year is how long the teachers stay at the school. Ms. Carmen and Ms. Aurora in the infant class, for example, have been there 19 and 20 years. They are truly baby whisperers and I have learned from them. They make great suggestions and it’s truly a blessing to have their expertise as I navigate parenthood.

In the toddlers classes we have had amazing teachers like Ms. Betty who was our first toddler teacher and then Ms Liliana. Both so caring and set a great foundation. Ms. Tracei and Ms. Kesia in Turtles class helped my son as he started learning to write and start a more formal curriculum. And in PreK Stars (prek4) with Ms Jessica, Ms citaly and Mr Ben it was amazing to see my son’s growth over the year! At the beginning of the year I had some areas I hoped would improve for kindergarten and they addressed them fully spending time with him 1 on 1 to help him improve. By the end of the year his growth was astounding and I attribute it to how much they helped him in the class. When my middle son had Ms. NayNay as his toddler teacher, he would come home and use skills he learned in her class to calm down. NayNay and Sara also helped me with some techniques when we had challenging behavior that really helped at home! Ms Jackie, Ms Michelle and Ms Vicky all took great care of my middle kiddo and he will still stop by their classes or see them in the hall and say hi to them.

Aside from the fantastic daily teachers, there are great additional resource classes at the school like spanish, music and stretch and grow. Kids have plenty of time to play, have fun, make friends and just be kids too! The facility itself is well equipped with gym, newly installed playground equipment, fellowship hall ect. and it is very safe with updated safety system. They also create opportunities for families to connect and spend time together outside of the class through things like the trunk or treat and afternoon Idea Spring series where they bring in speakers and do special presentations (Houston Arboretum animal presentation, magic shows, ect.) Admin is so supportive as well and I have seen them step in to help and really support the teachers.

I feel like we got so lucky with this school and community. From the teachers to admin and other parents and kids, we have been really fortunate to be here. We as parents have learned a lot of techniques too from the teachers about skills we can use at home to be better parents. It’s bittersweet my oldest son is leaving to go to kindergarten but so happy he will have familiar faces as we have chosen to have him use the school for aftercare and our younger sons will be at the school still too! I would highly recommend the school to anyone who wants a safe, loving, supportive environment for their kids. Thank you, SBPA, for taking great care of my kids all these years and helping them grow into good individuals.
